However, existing end-to-end and hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely on text-only cues while keeping plan intent latent, which undermines referential grounding in cluttered or underspecified scenes, impedes effective task decomposition of long-horizon goals with close-loop interaction, and limits causal explanation by obscuring the rationale behind action choices. To address these issues, we first introduce Visual Sketch, an implausible visual intermediate that renders points, boxes, arrows, and typed relations in the robot's current views to externalize spatial intent, connect language to scene geometry, and provide a human-verifiable bridge between high-level reasoning and low-level control. Building on Visual Sketch, we present Action-Sketcher, a VLA framework that operates in a cyclic See -> Think -> Sketch -> Act workflow coordinated by adaptive token-gated strategy for reasoning triggers, sketch revision, and action issuance, thereby supporting reactive corrections and human interaction while preserving real-time action prediction. To enable scalable training and evaluation, we curate diverse corpus with interleaved images, text, Visual Sketch supervision, and action sequences, and train Action-Sketcher with a multi-stage curriculum recipe that combines interleaved sequence alignment for modality unification, language-to-sketch consistency for precise linguistic grounding, and imitation learning augmented with sketch-to-action reinforcement for robustness. Extensive experiments on cluttered scenes and multi-object tasks, in simulation and on real-world tasks, show improved long-horizon success, stronger robustness to dynamic scene changes, and enhanced interpretability via editable sketches and step-wise plans.
papers.title_zh: Action-Skecher:通过机器人操纵视觉动画片从理性到行动
papers.abstract_zh: 长视距机器人操纵对于现实世界的部署越来越重要,要求在复杂的布局中进行空间解耦,并在动态互动下保持时间弹性,但是,现有的端对端和上下级视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策往往依赖只使用文字的提示,同时保持计划意图潜伏,这破坏了在布局紧凑或未定的场景中的优先定位,妨碍将长视距目标与近距离互动有效地分解任务,并由于掩盖了行动选择背后的理由而限制了因果关系。 为了解决这些问题,我们首先介绍视觉Sletch,这是一个令人难以置信的视觉中间体,它使机器人当前观点中的点、盒子、箭头和打字关系外化空间意图,将语言与现场几何相连接,并在高层次推理和低层次控制之间提供可人核查的桥梁。 在视觉Sletch的基础上,我们介绍了“行动-Sketscher”这一VLA框架,它以“循环观察-思维-> Sletch-> Act”为操作,通过适应性象征性战略协调,通过推理触发、草图修改和行动发布来协调,从而支持反应性纠正和人际互动,同时保持实时行动预测。 为了进行可扩缩的培训和评估,我们以不同图像、文字、视觉图纸监督和行动序列等形式整理各种内容,对Action-Sketscher进行培训,培训多阶段课程配方,将不同序列的组合结合起来,以统一模式、语言和背景一致的方式精确进行语言定位,以及模仿学习,辅之以加强素描对行动,以强化强健性。 在模拟和现实世界任务中,对各种场景和多对象任务进行广泛的实验,展示了更好的长方位成功、对动态场景变化的更强的坚固性以及通过可编辑的草图和渐进计划提高解释性。

papers.title: ACE-Merging: Data-Free Model Merging with Adaptive Covariance Estimation
papers.authors: Bo Xu, Haotian Wu, Hehai Lin, Weiquan Huang, Beier Zhu, Yao Shu, Chengwei Qin
papers.abstract: Model merging aims to combine multiple task-specific experts into a single model, but inter-task interference often causes severe degradation, especially when the experts are trained on heterogeneous objectives. Existing data-free methods are practical, yet largely rely on parameter-space heuristics without explicitly modeling task statistics. In this paper, we show that under a local linear approximation, the input covariance of each task can be estimated directly from its fine-tuning update, providing a principled bridge between parameter changes and data geometry in the data-free setting. Based on this insight, we propose ACE-Merging, a closed-form model merging framework with adaptive covariance normalization, a collective structural prior, and spectral refinement. Across both vision and language benchmarks, ACE-Merging achieves strong overall performance among data-free baselines. In particular, it improves the average score on GPT-2 by more than 4 points over prior methods, while also delivering strong scalability and competitive efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/unravel-xu/ACE-Merging/tree/main.
papers.title_zh: ACE-Merging:无数据模型与适应性共差估计合并
papers.abstract_zh: 模型合并的目的是将多重任务专家合并为单一模型,但任务间干扰往往导致严重退化,特别是在专家接受关于不同目标的培训时。现有的无数据方法是实用的,但在很大程度上依赖参数-空间超常,而没有明确的模拟任务统计。在本文中,我们表明,在当地线性近似值下,每项任务的投入共差可以直接从其微调更新中估算,在无数据环境下提供参数变化和数据几何测量之间的原则桥梁。基于这一见解,我们提议ACE-Merging(ACE-Merging)是一个封闭式模型,与适应性共同变迁正常化、集体结构前和光谱完善合并框架。 在视觉和语言基准方面,ACE-Merging在无数据基线中取得了良好的总体业绩,特别是使GPT-2的平均分数比以往方法提高了4个百分点以上,同时也提供了强大的可缩放性和竞争效率,我们的代码可在https://github.com/unravel-xu/ACE-Merging/tree/main上查阅,网址是https://github.com/unravel-xu/ACE-Merging/tree/main。

papers.title: Accelerating Transformer-Based Monocular SLAM via Geometric Utility Scoring
papers.authors: Xinmiao Xiong, Bangya Liu, Hao Wang, Dayou Li, Nuo Chen, Andrew Feng, Mingyu Ding, Suman Banerjee, Yang Zhou, Zhiwen Fan
papers.abstract: Geometric Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently advanced monocular SLAM by providing robust, calibration-free 3D priors. However, deploying these models on dense video streams introduces significant computational redundancy. Current GFM-based SLAM systems typically rely on post hoc keyframe selection. Because of this, they must perform expensive dense geometric decoding simply to determine whether a frame contains novel geometry, resulting in late rejection and wasted computation. To mitigate this inefficiency, we propose LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward frame-gating network. LeanGate predicts a geometric utility score to assess a frame's mapping value prior to the heavy GFM feature extraction and matching stages. As a predictive plug-and-play module, our approach bypasses over 90% of redundant frames. Evaluations on standard SLAM benchmarks demonstrate that LeanGate reduces tracking FLOPs by more than 85% and achieves a 5x end-to-end throughput speedup. Furthermore, it maintains the tracking and mapping accuracy of dense baselines. Project page: https://lean-gate.github.io/
papers.title_zh: 通过几何功用扫描加速以变速器为基础的单体SLM
papers.abstract_zh: 几何基础模型(GFMS)最近通过提供强健、无校准的3D前置技术,推进了单方SLMM。然而,在密集视频流上部署这些模型会引入大量计算冗余。当前以GFM为基础的SLM系统通常依赖后特设键框架选择。因此,它们必须进行昂贵的密集几何解码,以便确定一个框架是否包含新的几何方法,导致延迟拒绝和浪费计算。为了减轻这种效率低下,我们提议建立轻量进料前向框架定位网络LeanGate。 LeanGate预测一个几何实用分,以便在重GFM特征提取和匹配阶段之前评估一个框架的绘图值。作为预测性的插和游戏模块,我们的方法绕过90%以上的冗余框架。 对标准SLAM基准的评价表明,LeanGate将跟踪FLOP减少85%以上,并实现了5x端到端输送速度的加速,此外,它还维持密集基线的跟踪和绘图准确性,项目网页:https://lean-gate.github.io/。

papers.title: 4D-RGPT: Toward Region-level 4D Understanding via Perceptual Distillation
papers.authors: Chiao-An Yang, Ryo Hachiuma, Sifei Liu, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Raymond A. Yeh, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Min-Hung Chen
papers.abstract: Despite advances in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), their ability to reason over 3D structures and temporal dynamics remains limited, constrained by weak 4D perception and temporal understanding. Existing 3D and 4D Video Question Answering (VQA) benchmarks also emphasize static scenes and lack region-level prompting.We tackle these issues by introducing:(a) 4D-RGPT, a specialized MLLM designed to capture 4D representations from video inputs with enhanced temporal perception;(b) Perceptual 4D Distillation (P4D), a training framework that transfers 4D representations from a frozen expert model into 4D-RGPT for comprehensive 4D perception; and(c) R4D-Bench, a benchmark for depth-aware dynamic scenes with region-level prompting, built via a hybrid automated and human-verified pipeline.Our 4D-RGPT achieves notable improvements on both existing 4D VQA benchmarks and the proposed R4D-Bench benchmark.
papers.title_zh: 4D-RGPT:通过概念蒸馏实现地区一级4D理解
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在多模式LMS(MLLM)方面取得了进展,但由于4D观念和时间理解薄弱,他们了解3D结构和时间动态的能力仍然有限。 现有的3D和4D视频问题解答(VQA)基准也强调静态场景,缺乏区域一级的提示。 我们处理这些问题的方法是:(a) 4D-RGPT,这是一个专门的MLLM,旨在从视频输入中获取4D陈述,同时提高时间感;(b) 概念4蒸馏(P4D),这是一个培训框架,将4D陈述从一个冻结的专家模型转移到4D-RGPT,以综合4D感知;(c) R4D-Bench,这是一个通过自动化和人核查混合管道建立的区域一级深度觉悟动态场景基准。 我们的4D-RGPT在现有的4D VQA基准和拟议的R4D-Bench基准上都取得了显著的改进。

papers.title: YOLO Meets Mixture-of-Experts: Adaptive Expert Routing for Robust Object Detection
papers.authors: Ori Meiraz, Sharon Shalev, Avishai Weizman
papers.abstract: This paper presents a novel Mixture-of-Experts framework for object detection, incorporating adaptive routing among multiple YOLOv9-T experts to enable dynamic feature specialization and achieve higher mean Average Precision (mAP) and Average Recall (AR) compared to a single YOLOv9-T model.
papers.title_zh: YOLO 遇到专家混合:用于强力物体探测的适应性专家流程
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一个新颖的物体探测专家混合框架,其中纳入了多个YOLOv9-T专家的适应性路线,以便能够进行动态特征专门化,实现比单一的YOLOv9-T模型更高的平均精度和平均回调(AR)。

papers.title: UniSTD: Towards Unified Spatio-Temporal Learning across Diverse Disciplines
papers.authors: Chen Tang, Xinzhu Ma, Encheng Su, Xiufeng Song, Xiaohong Liu, Wei-Hong Li, Lei Bai, Wanli Ouyang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Traditional spatiotemporal models generally rely on task-specific architectures, which limit their generalizability and scalability across diverse tasks due to domain-specific design requirements. In this paper, we introduce UniSTD, a unified Transformer-based framework for spatiotemporal modeling, which is inspired by advances in recent foundation models with the two-stage pretraining-then-adaption paradigm. Specifically, our work demonstrates that task-agnostic pretraining on 2D vision and vision-text datasets can build a generalizable model foundation for spatiotemporal learning, followed by specialized joint training on spatiotemporal datasets to enhance task-specific adaptability. To improve the learning capabilities across domains, our framework employs a rank-adaptive mixture-of-expert adaptation by using fractional interpolation to relax the discrete variables so that can be optimized in the continuous space. Additionally, we introduce a temporal module to incorporate temporal dynamics explicitly. We evaluate our approach on a large-scale dataset covering 10 tasks across 4 disciplines, demonstrating that a unified spatiotemporal model can achieve scalable, cross-task learning and support up to 10 tasks simultaneously within one model while reducing training costs in multi-domain applications. Code will be available at https://github.com/1hunters/UniSTD.
papers.title_zh: UNISTD: 走向跨不同学科的统一空间-时间学习
papers.abstract_zh: 传统的时空模型一般依赖特定任务的结构,由于特定领域的设计要求,这些结构限制了它们的普遍性和可伸缩性,因而限制了它们在不同任务中的普遍性和可伸缩性。在本文中,我们引入了UniSTD,这是一个基于单一Transformer的时空模型统一框架,其灵感来自最近基础模型的进展和两阶段培训前的适应性模式。具体地说,我们的工作表明,2D视觉和视觉文本数据集的任务不可知性预培训可以建立一个可概括的时空学习模型基础,随后是有关加强具体任务适应性的随机数据集的专门联合培训。 为提高各领域的学习能力,我们的框架采用按级调整的专家混合适应办法,利用分解内插来放松离散变量,以便在连续空间中实现最佳化。此外,我们引入了时间模块,明确纳入时间动态。我们评估了我们关于涵盖4个学科10项任务的大规模数据集的方法,表明统一的时空模型可以在一个模型内同时实现可扩展、跨任务学习和支持多达10项任务,同时降低多领域应用的培训成本。代码将在https://github.com/1hunters/UniSTD上公布。

papers.title: Unifying and Enhancing Graph Transformers via a Hierarchical Mask Framework
papers.authors: Yujie Xing, Xiao Wang, Bin Wu, Hai Huang, Chuan Shi
papers.abstract: Graph Transformers (GTs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for graph representation learning due to their ability to model diverse node interactions. However, existing GTs often rely on intricate architectural designs tailored to specific interactions, limiting their flexibility. To address this, we propose a unified hierarchical mask framework that reveals an underlying equivalence between model architecture and attention mask construction. This framework enables a consistent modeling paradigm by capturing diverse interactions through carefully designed attention masks. Theoretical analysis under this framework demonstrates that the probability of correct classification positively correlates with the receptive field size and label consistency, leading to a fundamental design principle: an effective attention mask should ensure both a sufficiently large receptive field and a high level of label consistency. While no single existing mask satisfies this principle across all scenarios, our analysis reveals that hierarchical masks offer complementary strengths, motivating their effective integration. Then, we introduce M3Dphormer, a Mixture-of-Experts-based Graph Transformer with Multi-Level Masking and Dual Attention Computation. M3Dphormer incorporates three theoretically grounded hierarchical masks and employs a bi-level expert routing mechanism to adaptively integrate multi-level interaction information. To ensure scalability, we further introduce a dual attention computation scheme that dynamically switches between dense and sparse modes based on local mask sparsity. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that M3Dphormer achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of our unified framework and model design.
papers.title_zh: 通过等级面具框架统一和加强图表变形器
papers.abstract_zh: 图形变换器(GTs)由于能够建模不同的节点互动关系,已成为图形代表学习的强大范例。 但是,现有的GTs往往依赖适合具体互动关系的复杂建筑设计,限制了它们的灵活性。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议了一个统一的等级掩码框架,显示模型结构与注意力掩码结构之间的基本等值。 这个框架通过精心设计的注意掩码捕捉不同互动关系,形成了一个一致的模型模式。 依据这一框架进行的理论分析表明,正确分类的概率与可接受字段大小和标签一致性呈正相关,从而形成一项基本的设计原则:有效的关注面罩应当确保足够大的可接受字段和高水平标签一致性。虽然没有任何一个现有掩盖面罩在所有情景中都能满足这一原则,但我们的分析表明,等级面罩具有互补优势,促进其有效整合。然后,我们引入了M3Dphormer, 一种基于专家混合模型变形器, 配有多层次遮罩和双引力计算。 M3Dphormer 包含三个基于理论的等级面罩,并使用双级专家路由机制,以适应性地整合多层次的互动信息。 为确保可缩放性,我们进一步引入了双重关注计算办法,根据本地面罩宽度,在密度和稀疏模式之间动态转换。 多基准的广泛实验表明M3Dphormer取得了SOTA 性能,证实了我们统一框架和模型设计的有效性。

papers.title: Unified Multi-Agent Trajectory Modeling with Masked Trajectory Diffusion
papers.authors: songru Yang · Zhenwei Shi · Zhengxia Zou
papers.abstract: Understanding movements in multi-agent scenarios is a fundamental problem in intelligent systems. Previous research assumes complete and synchronized observations. However, real-world partial observation caused by occlusions leads to inevitable model failure, which demands a unified framework for coexisting trajectory prediction, imputation, and recovery. Unlike previous attempts that handled observed and unobserved behaviors in a coupled manner, we explore a decoupled denoising diffusion modeling paradigm with a unidirectional information valve to separate the interference from uncertain behaviors. Building on this, we proposed a Unified Masked Trajectory Diffusion model (UniMTD) for arbitrary levels of missing observations. We designed a unidirectional attention as a valve unit to control the direction of information flow between the observed and masked areas, gradually refining the missing observations toward a real-world distribution. We construct it into a unidirectional MoE structure to handle varying proportions of missing observations. A Cached Diffusion model is further designed to improve generation quality while reducing computation and time overhead. Our method has achieved a great leap across human motions and vehicle traffic. UniMTD efficiently achieves 65% improvement in minADE20 and reaches SOTA with advantages of 98%, 50%, 73%, and 29% across 4 fidelity metrics on out-of-boundary, velocity, and trajectory length. Our code will be released here.
papers.title_zh: 带有蒙面轨迹扩散的单一多源轨迹模型
papers.abstract_zh: 理解多试剂情景中的移动是智能系统的一个根本问题。 以前的研究假设了完整和同步的观测。 但是,由于隐蔽性造成的现实世界部分观测导致不可避免的模型失败,这要求有一个统一的框架来同时进行轨迹预测、估算和恢复。 与以往试图同时处理观察和未观察行为的尝试不同,我们探索了一种分解的分散模型模式,配有一个单向信息阀,以区分干扰与不确定行为的干扰。 在此基础上,我们提出了一个用于任意缺失观测的统一蒙面转移模型(UniMTD ) 。 我们设计了单向关注作为阀门单位,以控制被观察地区和蒙面地区之间的信息流动方向,逐步完善缺失的观测结果,使之走向真实世界分布。我们将其建成一个单向MOE结构,处理不同比例的缺失观测。一个散装扩散模型进一步设计,以提高生产质量,同时减少计算和时间管理。我们的方法跨越了人类运动和车辆交通的巨大飞跃。UNIMTD在分钟ADE20中有效地实现了65%的改进,到达SOTA, 优势为98%、50%、73%和29%,横跨边界、速度和轨迹长度的4个忠诚度指标。我们的代码将在这里发布。

papers.title: UNIALIGN: Scaling Multimodal Alignment within One Unified Model
papers.authors: Bo Zhou, Liulei Li, Yujia Wang, Huafeng Liu, Yazhou Yao, Wenguan Wang
papers.abstract: We present UNIALIGN, a unified model to align an arbitrary number of modalities ( text e.g. , image, text, audio, 3D point cloud, etc.) through one encoder and a single training phase. Existing solutions typically employ distinct encoders for each modality, resulting in increased parameters as the number of modalities grows. In contrast, UNIALIGN proposes a modality-aware adaptation of the powerful mixture-of-experts (MoE) schema and further integrates it with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), efficiently scaling the encoder to accommodate inputs in diverse modalities while maintaining a fixed computational overhead.Moreover, prior work often requires separate training for each extended modality. This leads to task-specific models and further hinders the communication between modalities.To address this, we propose a soft modality binding strategy that aligns all modalities using unpaired data samples across datasets. Two additional training objectives are introduced to distill knowledge from well-aligned anchor modalities and prior multimodal models, elevating UNIALIGN into a high performance multimodal foundation model.Experiments on 11 benchmarks across 6 different modalities demonstrate that UNIALIGN could achieve comparable performance to SOTA approaches, while using merely 7.8M trainable parameters and maintaining an identical model with the same weight across all tasks. Our code shall be released.
papers.title_zh: UNIALIGIN: 在统一模式内实现比例化多模式对齐
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出UNIALIGIN,这是一个统一的模式,通过一个编码器和一个单一的培训阶段,对任意模式(例如文字,如图像、文字、音频、3D点云等)加以统一。 现有解决办法通常为每种模式使用不同的编码器,随着模式数量的增加,参数增加。 与此相反,UNIALIGINT建议对强大的专家混合计划进行模式意识调整,并进一步将其与低Rank适应(LORA)相结合,高效率地扩大编码器,以适应不同模式的投入,同时保持固定的计算间接费用。 此外,以往的工作往往要求对每一种延长模式进行单独培训。 为此,我们提议采取软模式约束性战略,利用各数据集之间未受控制的数据样本调整所有模式。 引入了另外两个培训目标,以从一致的锚定模式和先前的多式联运模式中提取知识,将UNIALIGN提升为高性能的多式联运基础模式,对6种不同模式的11项基准的实验表明,UNIALIGIN可以达到与SOTA方法相似的绩效,同时仅使用7.8M培训参数,并在所有任务中保持同等份量的相同模式。 我们的代码将被发布。

papers.title: Tra-MoE: Learning Trajectory Prediction Model from Multiple Domains for Adaptive Policy Conditioning
papers.authors: Jiange Yang, Haoyi Zhu, Yating Wang, Gangshan Wu, Tong He, Limin Wang
papers.abstract: Learning from multiple domains is a primary factor that influences the generalization of a single unified robot system. In this paper, we aim to learn the trajectory prediction model by using broad out-of-domain data to improve its performance and generalization ability. Trajectory model is designed to predict any-point trajectories in the current frame given an instruction and can provide detailed control guidance for robotic policy learning. To handle the diverse out-of-domain data distribution, we propose a sparsely-gated MoE (Top-1 gating strategy) architecture for trajectory model, coined as Tra-MoE. The sparse activation design enables good balance between parameter cooperation and specialization, effectively benefiting from large-scale out-of-domain data while maintaining constant FLOPs per token. In addition, we further introduce an adaptive policy conditioning technique by learning 2D mask representations for predicted trajectories, which is explicitly aligned with image observations to guide action prediction more flexibly. We perform extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world scenarios to verify the effectiveness of Tra-MoE and adaptive policy conditioning technique. We also conduct a comprehensive empirical study to train Tra-MoE, demonstrating that our Tra-MoE consistently exhibits superior performance compared to the dense baseline model, even when the latter is scaled to match Tra-MoE's parameter count.
papers.title_zh: Tra-MoE:从适应政策条件的多域学习轨迹预测模型
papers.abstract_zh: 从多个领域学习是影响单一统一机器人系统一般化的一个主要因素。 在本文中, 我们的目标是通过使用广泛的外部数据来学习轨迹预测模型, 以提高其性能和一般化能力。 轨迹模型旨在预测当前框架中的任何点轨迹, 给予指示, 并为机器人政策学习提供详细的控制指导 。 为了处理多种外向数据分布, 我们建议为轨迹模型建立一个微小的 MOE( Top-1 Gateting 战略) 结构, 以 Tra- MoE 生成。 稀疏激活设计可以在参数合作和专业化之间实现良好的平衡, 有效地受益于大规模外向数据, 同时保持恒定的 FLOP 。 此外,我们还引入了适应性政策调节技术,对预测轨迹学习2D掩码表示,这与图像观测明确一致,以更灵活地指导行动预测。我们在模拟和现实情景上进行了广泛的实验,以核实Tra-MoE和适应性政策调节技术的有效性。我们还开展了一项全面的经验研究,以培训Tra-MoE,表明我们的Tra-MoE一贯表现出优于密集基线模型的性能,即使后者的尺寸与Tra-MoE的参数数相当。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Foundation Model for Zero-shot Amodal Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhaochen Liu, Limeng Qiao, Xiangxiang Chu, Lin Ma, Tingting Jiang
papers.abstract: Aiming to predict the complete shape of partially occluded objects, amodal segmentation is an important capacity towards visual intelligence. In order to promote the practicability, zero-shot foundation model competent for the open world gains growing attention in this field. Nevertheless, prior models exhibit deficiencies in efficiency and stability. To address this problem, utilizing the implicit prior knowledge, we propose the first SAM-based amodal segmentation foundation model, SAMBA. Methodologically, a novel framework with multilevel facilitation is designed to better adapt the task characteristics and unleash the potential capabilities of SAM. In the modality level, a separation-to-fusion structure is employed that jointly learns modal and amodal segmentation to enhance mutual coordination. In the instance level, to ease the complexity of amodal feature extraction, we introduce a principal focusing mechanism to indicate objects of interest. In the pixel level, mixture-of-experts is incorporated with a specialized distribution loss, by which distinct occlusion rates correspond to different experts to improve the accuracy. Experiments are conducted on several eminent datasets, and the results show that the performance of SAMBA is superior to existing zero-shot and even supervised approaches. Furthermore, our proposed model has notable advantages in terms of speed and size.
papers.title_zh: 实现 " 零拍零拍现代分割法 " 高效基础模型
papers.abstract_zh: 为了预测部分隐蔽物体的完整形状,对视觉情报来说,现代分解是一种重要的能力;为了促进实用性,对开放世界具有能力的零点基础模型在这一领域引起越来越多的注意;然而,以前的模型在效率和稳定性方面显示出缺陷;为了解决这一问题,我们利用隐含的先前知识,提议采用第一个以SAMM为基础的基于SAMMA模式分解基础模型,SAMBA。从方法上讲,设计了一个具有多层次便利的新框架,以更好地调整任务特点,释放SAM的潜在能力。在模式一级,采用了一个从分离到融合的结构,共同学习模式和模式分解,以加强相互的协调。 在实例层面,为了减轻现代特征提取的复杂性,我们引入了一种主要重点机制,以表明感兴趣的对象。在像素层面,专家混合与专门分布损失相结合,不同的隔离率与不同专家相对应,以提高准确性。在几个知名数据集上进行了实验,结果显示SAMBA的性能优于现有的零弹射甚至受监督的方法。此外,我们提议的模型在速度和规模上都具有显著的优势。

papers.title: The Human Brain as a Dynamic Mixture of Expert Models in Video Understanding
papers.authors: Christina Sartzetaki, Anne Zonneveld, Pablo Oyarzo, Alessandro T. Gifford, Radoslaw Martin Cichy, Pascal Mettes, Iris I. A. Groen
papers.abstract: A bstract The human brain is the most efficient and versatile system for processing dynamic visual input. By comparing representations from deep video models to brain activity, we can gain insights into mechanistic solutions for effective video processing, important to better understand the brain and to build better models. Current works in model-brain alignment primarily focus on fMRI measurements, leaving open questions about fine-grained dynamic processing. Here, we introduce the first large-scale model benchmarking on alignment to dynamic electroencephalography (EEG) recordings of short natural videos. We analyze 100+ models across the axes of temporal integration, classification task, architecture, and pretraining, using our proposed Cross-Temporal Representational Similarity Analysis (CT-RSA) which matches the best time-unfolded model features to dynamically evolving brain responses, distilling 10 7 alignment scores. Our findings reveal novel insights on how continuous visual input is integrated in the brain, beyond the standard temporal processing hierarchy from low to high-level representations. After initial alignment to hierarchical static object processing, responses in posterior electrodes best align to mid-level temporally-integrative action features, showing high temporal correspondence to feature timings. In contrast, responses in frontal electrodes best align with high-level static action representations and show no temporal correspondence to the video. Additionally, temporally-integrating state-space models show superior alignment to intermediate posterior activity, in which self-supervised pretraining is also beneficial. We draw a metaphor to a dynamic mixture of expert models for the changing neural preference in tasks and temporal integration reflected in the alignment to different model types across time. We posit that a single best-aligned model would need such training and architecture as to allow combining and dynamically switching between these capacities.
papers.title_zh: 人脑作为视频理解专家模型的动态混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 人类大脑是处理动态视觉输入的最有效率和最多功能的系统。通过比较深层视频模型和大脑活动的表现,我们可以深入了解有效视频处理的机械解决方案,这对于更好地了解大脑和构建更好的模型十分重要。目前模型-脑调整工作主要侧重于FMRI测量,留下关于细微感应动态处理的开放问题。在这里,我们引入了第一个大型模型基准,用于与动态电脑造影(EEEG)短短自然视频记录相匹配。 我们分析了跨时间整合、分类任务、架构和预培训等轴线的100+模型,我们使用我们提议的跨时代表相似性分析(CT-RSA),该分析将最佳的时空无边模型特征与动态演变的大脑反应相匹配,提炼了10 7个对齐分。我们的调查结果揭示了大脑中连续视觉输入如何融合的新见解,超越了从低到高层次的标准时间处理等级结构。在初步与等级静态物体处理接轨之后,后后后,后电极的反应最符合中层时间整合动作特征,显示与特征时间的高度时间对应。 相比之下,前电极的反应最符合高层次静态动作表示,也没有显示与视频的时间对应性。 此外,时间上整合的州空间模型显示与中间后方活动高度一致,在中间后方活动中,自我监督的预培训也是有益的。 我们用专家模型的动态组合进行隐喻,以适应任务中不断变化的神经偏好和时间整合,这反映在与不同类型模型的对齐上。 我们假设,一个单一的最佳匹配模型需要这样的培训和结构,以便能够在这些能力之间进行整合和动态转换。

papers.title: Temporal-Guided Mixture-of-Experts for Zero-Shot Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Yixin Qin, Lei Zhao, Lianli Gao, Haonan Zhang, Pengpeng Zeng, Heng Tao Shen
papers.abstract: Video Question Answering (VideoQA) is a challenging task in the vision-language field. Due to the time-consuming and labor-intensive labeling process of the question-answer pairs, fully supervised methods are no longer suitable for the current increasing demand for data. This has led to the rise of zero-shot VideoQA, and some works propose to adapt large language models (LLMs) to assist zero-shot learning. Despite recent progress, the inadequacy of LLMs in comprehending temporal information in videos and the neglect of temporal differences, e.g., the different dynamic changes between scenes or objects, remain insufficiently addressed by existing attempts in zero-shot VideoQA. In light of these challenges, a novel Temporal-guided Mixture-of-Experts Network (T-MoENet) for zero-shot video question answering is proposed in this paper. Specifically, we apply a temporal module to imbue language models with the capacity to perceive temporal information. Then a temporal-guided mixture-of-experts module is proposed to further learn the temporal differences presented in different videos. It enables the model to effectively improve the capacity of generalization. Our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple zero-shot VideoQA benchmarks, notably improving accuracy by 5.6% on TGIF-FrameQA and 2.3% on MSRVTT-QA while remaining competitive with other methods in the fully supervised setting. The codes and models developed in this study will be made publicly available at <uri xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">https://github.com/qyx1121/T-MoENet</uri>.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
papers.title_zh: 零热视频解答问题实时指导专家混合混合
papers.abstract_zh: 视频问答(VideoQA)是视觉语言领域的一项艰巨任务。由于问答对口的标签过程耗时费力,因此,完全监督的方法不再适合当前日益增长的数据需求。这导致了零弹视频QA的上升,有些作品提议调整大型语言模型(LLMS)以帮助零弹学习。尽管最近取得了进展,但LLMs对视频中时间信息的理解不够,忽视时间差异,例如场景或对象之间的不同动态变化,在零弹视频QA中的现有尝试仍未充分解决。 鉴于这些挑战,本文提议为零弹式视频问答建立一个新型的T-MoENet(T-MoENet)时间-制导探索者混合网络(T-MoENet) 。 具体地说,我们应用一个时间模块,使语言模型具备感知时间信息的能力。然后建议一个时间制专家混合模块,以进一步学习不同视频中的时间差异。它使模型能够有效地提高一般化能力。我们建议的方法在多个零光视频QA基准上达到最先进的性能,显著提高了TGIF-FrameQA的精确度5.6%和MSRVTT-QA的2.3%,同时在充分监督的环境下与其他方法保持竞争。本研究开发的代码和模型将在<uri xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink>https://github.com/qyx111/T-MoENet</uri>上公布。

papers.title: Stretching Each Dollar: Diffusion Training from Scratch on a Micro-Budget
papers.authors: Vikash Sehwag, Xianghao Kong, Jingtao Li, Michael Spranger, Lingjuan Lyu
papers.abstract: As scaling laws in generative AI push performance, they simultaneously concentrate the development of these models among actors with large computational resources. With a focus on text-to-image (T2I) generative models, we aim to unlock this bottleneck by demonstrating very low-cost training of large-scale T2I diffusion transformer models. As the computational cost of transformers increases with the number of patches in each image, we propose randomly masking up to 75% of the image patches during training. We propose a deferred masking strategy that preprocesses all patches using a patch-mixer before masking, thus significantly reducing the performance degradation with masking, making it superior to model downscaling in reducing computational cost. We also incorporate the latest improvements in transformer architecture, such as the use of mixture-of-experts layers, to improve performance and further identify the critical benefit of using synthetic images in micro-budget training. Finally, using only 37M publicly available real and synthetic images, we train a 1.16 billion parameter sparse transformer with only 1,890 USD economical cost and achieve a 12.7 FID in zero-shot generation on the COCO dataset. Notably, our model achieves competitive performance across both automated and human-centric evaluations, as well as high-quality generations, while incurring 118xlower costs than Stable Diffusion models and 14xlower costs than the current state-of-the-art approach, which costs 28,400. We also further investigate the influence of synthetic images on performance and demonstrate that micro-budget training on only synthetic images is sufficient for achieving high-quality data generation. Our end-to-end training pipeline and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/SonyResearch/micro_diffusion.
papers.title_zh: 将每一美元拉伸:微预算从Scratch向Scratch的传播培训
papers.abstract_zh: 作为在创新的AI推动业绩方面扩大法律规模,它们同时将开发这些模型的重点放在拥有大量计算资源的行为者之间。 以文字到图像(T2I)的基因化模型为重点,我们的目标是通过展示对大型T2I扩散变压器模型的低成本培训来解开这一瓶颈。 随着变压器的计算成本随着每张图像中的补丁数量而增加,我们提议在培训期间随机遮盖高达75%的图像补丁。 我们提议一项推迟的遮罩战略,在遮罩前先使用补丁混合器处理所有补丁,从而显著减少遮罩的性能退化,使其优于降低计算成本的模型降尺度。 我们还纳入了变压器结构的最新改进,例如使用专家混合层,以改进业绩,并进一步确定在微观预算培训中使用合成图像的重要好处。 最后,我们仅使用公开提供的37M真实和合成图像,用1 890美元的经济成本培训了11.6亿个参数稀释变压器,并在COCO数据集上实现了12.7个零速生成的FID。 值得注意的是,我们的模型在自动化评价和以人为中心的评价以及高素质的一代人之间都取得了竞争性业绩,而比稳定传播模式成本低118x倍,比目前最先进的方法成本低14x倍,后者成本为28 400美元。 我们还进一步调查合成图像对性能的影响,并表明仅对合成图像进行微观预算培训足以实现高质量数据生成。 我们的端对端培训管道和示范检查站可在https://github.com/SonyResearch/micro_difulation上查阅。

papers.title: SPMTrack: Spatio-Temporal Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Mixture of Experts for Scalable Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Wenrui Cai, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang
papers.abstract: Most state-of-the-art trackers adopt one-stream paradigm, using a single Vision Transformer for joint feature extraction and relation modeling of template and search region images. However, relation modeling between different image patches exhibits significant variations. For instance, background regions dominated by target-irrelevant information require reduced attention allocation, while foreground, particularly boundary areas, need to be be emphasized. A single model may not effectively handle all kinds of relation modeling simultaneously. In this paper, we propose a novel tracker called SPMTrack based on mixture-of-experts tailored for visual tracking task (TMoE), combining the capability of multiple experts to handle diverse relation modeling more flexibly. Benefiting from TMoE, we extend relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context, further improving tracking accuracy with minimal increase in model parameters. Moreover, we employ TMoE as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, substantially reducing trainable parameters, which enables us to train SPMTrack of varying scales efficiently and preserve the generalization ability of pretrained models to achieve superior performance. We conduct experiments on seven datasets, and experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. The source code is available at https://github.com/WenRuiCai/SPMTrack.
papers.title_zh: SPMTrack: 与可缩放视觉跟踪专家混合进行SPMTRK: SPATIO-TTP-时时参数-高效精密授精
papers.abstract_zh: 多数最先进的跟踪者采用一流模式,使用单一的Vision Transformer对模板和搜索区域图像进行联合特征提取和关系模型模拟。然而,不同图像补丁之间的关系模型存在重大差异。例如,以目标不相关信息为主的背景区域需要减少关注分配,而需要强调前景区域,特别是边境地区。单一模型可能无法同时有效处理所有类型的关系模型。在本文中,我们提议使用一种新型跟踪器,称为SPMTTrac, 其基础是专门为视觉跟踪任务设计的专家混合(TMoE),将多个专家更灵活地处理不同关系模型的能力结合起来。 从TMoE中受益,我们扩展了从图像配对到时空环境的关系模型,进一步提高了跟踪准确性,模型参数的增幅最小。此外,我们使用TMoE作为一种具有参数效率的微调方法,大大减少了可培训参数,从而使我们能够高效地培训不同规模的SPMTRack,并保持预先培训模型的普及能力,以取得优异的性能。我们在7个数据集上进行实验,实验结果显示,我们的方法大大优于目前最先进的跟踪者。源代码见https://github.com/WenRuiCai/SPMTrack。

papers.title: Soft-Masked Mixture of Experts for Point-Cloud Denoising
papers.authors: Jian Liu, Yanli Yang, Mingwu Ren
papers.abstract: With LiDAR increasingly used in autonomous driving and robotics, robust point-cloud denoising is essential for accurate 3D understanding. Yet mainstream score- and flowbased frameworks still struggle to balance structure preservation and noise suppression on highly non-uniform or reflective surfaces. We propose a lightweight, generic residual-head plugin that strengthens common denoisers via (i) adaptive residual control and (ii) selective expert fusion: a soft residual mask attenuates uncertain updates, and a two-expert MoE with a scalar gate plus mild balance regularizer blends detail-preserving and smoothing behaviors. The head is backbone-agnostic by design, requiring only per-point features and a residual/score output. We instantiate it on PD-LTS and add a minimal cross-backbone check showing gains on PD-Flow and IterativePFN. On PUNet, test EMD improves from 0.038 to 0.006 under matched training. Ablations and multi-seed statistics indicate the mask stabilizes early training while the gate improves the bias-variance tradeoff, supporting the method's stability, interpretability, and plug-and-play generalization.
papers.title_zh: 点环低温专家软模软混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 随着LiDAR越来越多地用于自主驾驶和机器人,强大的点球拆卸对于准确的三维理解至关重要。然而主流分数和流动框架仍然在努力平衡高度非统一或反射表面的结构维护和噪音抑制。我们提议了一个轻量级、通用的残余头插件,通过(一) 适应性残余控制,和(二) 选择性专家聚合:软残余面罩可以降低不确定的更新,以及双专家模件,配有螺旋门,加上微量平衡调节器的组合细节保存和平滑行为。头在设计上具有骨干性,只需要每个点的特征和残余/核心输出。我们将其立即放在PD-LTS上,并添加一个显示PD-Flow和IterativePFN收益的最小交叉骨检查。 在PUNet上,测试EMD在匹配的培训下从0.038提高到0.006。 减法和多种子统计数据显示,面具稳定了早期培训,而大门则改善了偏差权衡,支持了该方法的稳定性、可解释性以及插头和玩耍的概括化。 在PUNet上,测试EMD的EMD在培训匹配下从0.038提高到0.006。 减法和多种子统计数据显示,面具稳定了早期培训,而大门则改善了偏差权衡,支持了该方法的稳定性、可解释性以及插头和玩耍的概括化。

papers.title: Smart CSWin-UNet: Integrating prototype attention gate and mixture-of-experts skip connections for medical image segmentation
papers.authors: Chuanbo Feng, Xuebao Lu, Jing Qin, Daoqiang Zhang, Xiaoke Hao
papers.title_zh: Smart CSWin-UNet: 整合原型关注门和专家混合连接的医学图像分割连接

papers.title: Shape Distribution Matters: Shape-specific Mixture-of-Experts for Amodal Segmentation under Diverse Occlusions
papers.authors: Zhixuan Li, Yujia Liu, Chen Hui, Jeonghaeng Lee, Sanghoon Lee, Weisi Lin
papers.abstract: Amodal segmentation targets to predict complete object masks, covering both visible and occluded regions. This task poses significant challenges due to complex occlusions and extreme shape variation, from rigid furniture to highly deformable clothing. Existing one-size-fits-all approaches rely on a single model to handle all shape types, struggling to capture and reason about diverse amodal shapes due to limited representation capacity. A natural solution is to adopt a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework, assigning experts to different shape patterns. However, naively applying MoE without considering the object's underlying shape distribution can lead to mismatched expert routing and insufficient expert specialization, resulting in redundant or underutilized experts. To deal with these issues, we introduce ShapeMoE, a shape-specific sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework for amodal segmentation. The key idea is to learn a latent shape distribution space and dynamically route each object to a lightweight expert tailored to its shape characteristics. Specifically, ShapeMoE encodes each object into a compact Gaussian embedding that captures key shape characteristics. A Shape-Aware Sparse Router then maps the object to the most suitable expert, enabling precise and efficient shape-aware expert routing. Each expert is designed as lightweight and specialized in predicting occluded regions for specific shape patterns. ShapeMoE offers well interpretability via clear shape-to-expert correspondence, while maintaining high capacity and efficiency. Experiments on COCOA-cls, KINS, and D2SA show that ShapeMoE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, especially in occluded region segmentation. The code will be released.
papers.title_zh: 形状分布事项: 不同封闭状态下适合不同形状的分类模式专家混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 由于从硬家具到高度变形服装的复杂隔离和极端形状变异,这项任务带来了重大挑战。现有的 " 一刀切 " 办法依靠单一模型来处理所有形状类型,由于代表能力有限,难以捕捉和解释多种现代形状。自然的解决办法是采用专家混合框架,指派专家处理不同的形状模式。然而,不考虑物体的基本形状分布,就天真地应用MoE可能导致专家路由不匹配和专家专业化不足,导致专家多余或利用不足。 为了处理这些问题,我们引入了形状模型,这是一个形状特有的稀有专家混合模型框架,用于调节分解。关键的想法是学习潜在的形状分布空间,并动态地将每个对象引向适合其形状特点的轻量级专家。具体地说,形状模型将每个对象编码成一个包含关键形状特征的包紧的高斯嵌入装置。一个形状-软件散射路由器然后将对象绘制成最合适的专家,以便精确和高效的形状识别专家路线。每个专家的设计都是轻量级的,专门用来预测特定形状形态形态的隐蔽区域。形状模型通过明确的形状与专家的通信提供很好的解释性,同时保持高的能力和效率。 在COCOA-cls、KINS和D2SA上进行的实验表明,“形状模型”一贯优于最先进的方法,特别是在隐蔽的区域分割中。该代码将被发布。

papers.title: RS-MoE: A Vision–Language Model With Mixture of Experts for Remote Sensing Image Captioning and Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Hui Lin, Danfeng Hong, Shaodi Ge, Chuyao Luo, Kai Jiang, Hao Jin, Congcong Wen
papers.abstract: Remote sensing image captioning (RSIC) presents unique challenges and plays a critical role in applications such as environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management. Traditional RSIC methods often struggle to produce rich and diverse descriptions. Recently, with significant advancements in vision-language models (VLMs), efforts have emerged to integrate these models into the remote sensing domain and to introduce richly descriptive datasets specifically designed to enhance VLM training. However, most current RSIC models generally apply only fine-tuning to these datasets without developing models tailored to the unique characteristics of remote sensing imagery. This article proposes RS-MoE, the first mixture of expert (MoE)-based VLM specifically customized for remote sensing domain. Unlike traditional MoE models, the core of RS-MoE is the MoE block, which incorporates a novel instruction router and multiple lightweight large language models (LLMs) as expert models. The instruction router is designed to generate specific prompts tailored for each corresponding LLM, guiding them to focus on distinct aspects of the RSIC task. This design not only allows each expert LLM to concentrate on a specific subset of the task, thereby enhancing the specificity and accuracy of the generated captions, but also improves the scalability of the model by facilitating parallel processing of subtasks. In addition, we present a two-stage training strategy for tuning our RS-MoE model to prevent performance degradation due to sparsity. We fine-tuned our model on the RSICap dataset using our proposed training strategy. Experimental results on the RSICap dataset, along with evaluations on other traditional datasets where no additional fine-tuning was applied, demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating precise and contextually relevant captions. Notably, our RS-MoE-1B variant achieves performance comparable to 13B VLMs, demonstrating the efficiency of our model design. Moreover, our model demonstrates promising generalization capabilities by consistently achieving state-of-the-art performance on the remote sensing visual question answering (RSVQA) task.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
papers.title_zh: RS-MOE:与遥感图像描述和视觉问题解答专家混合的视觉-语言模型
papers.abstract_zh: 遥感图像字幕(RSIC)是独特的挑战,在环境监测、城市规划和灾害管理等应用中发挥着关键作用,传统的RSIC方法往往难以产生丰富多样的描述,最近,随着视觉语言模型(VLM)的显著进步,人们开始努力将这些模型纳入遥感领域,并引进大量专为增强VLM培训而设计的描述数据集,然而,大多数目前的RSIC模型一般只对这些数据集进行微调,而没有开发适合遥感图像独特特点的模型。 与传统的MoE模型不同,RS-MOE的核心是MoE的单元,其中包括一个新的教学路由器和多种轻量级大语言模型(LLMS)作为专家模型。教学路由器的设计是为了产生针对每个相应的LLM的具体提示,指导它们注重RSIC任务的不同方面。这一设计不仅使每个专家LLM能够集中从事具体的任务,从而增强所产生说明的特性和准确性,而且通过促进子任务平行处理,提高模型的可扩展性。此外,我们提出了一个两阶段培训战略,以调整我们的RS-MOE模型,防止由于松散而造成性能退化。我们利用拟议的培训战略对RSICap数据集模型进行了调整。 RSICap数据集的实验结果,加上对其他传统数据集的评价,没有进行额外的微调,都表明我们的模型在制作精确和符合背景的字幕方面达到了最先进的性能,值得注意的是,我们的RS-MOE-1B变量的性能相当于13BVLM,显示了我们模型设计的效率。此外,我们的模型通过在遥感直观回答(RSVQA)任务上不断实现最先进的性能,显示了有希望的概括性能力。

papers.title: Robustifying Routers Against Input Perturbations for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Masahiro Kada, Ryota Yoshihashi, Satoshi Ikehata, Rei Kawakami, Ikuro Sato
papers.abstract: Mixture of experts with a sparse expert selection rule has been gaining much attention recently because of its scalability without compromising inference time. However, unlike standard neural networks, sparse mixture-of-experts models inherently exhibit discontinuities in the output space, which may impede the acquisition of appropriate invariance to the input perturbations, leading to a deterioration of model performance for tasks such as classification. To address this issue, we propose Pairwise Router Consistency (PRC) that effectively penalizes the discontinuities occurring under natural deformations of input images. With the supervised loss, the use of PRC loss empirically improves classification accuracy on ImageNet-1 K, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 datasets, compared to a baseline method. Notably, our method with 1-expert selection slightly outperforms the baseline method using 2-expert selection. We also confirmed that models trained with our method experience discontinuous changes less frequently under input perturbations.
papers.venue: IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing
papers.title_zh: 为专家的视觉Transformer提供强大的路由器,防止专家的浅状混集物投入扰动
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,专家与专家甄选规则稀少的专家混合,因其可伸缩性而不损害推论时间,引起了人们的极大注意,然而,与标准的神经网络不同,分散的专家混合模型在产出空间本身就表现出不连续,这可能会妨碍对输入干扰的适当变化,导致诸如分类等任务的模型性能恶化。为了解决这一问题,我们提议对输入图像的自然变形所造成的不连续行为给予有效惩罚,但与基线方法相比,利用PRC损失实际提高了图像Net-1K、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集的分类准确性。 值得注意的是,我们采用1名专家选择的方法略优于使用2名专家选择的基线方法。 我们还确认,接受过我们方法培训的模型在输入干扰下经历不连续变化的情况较少。

papers.title: Resilient Sensor Fusion Under Adverse Sensor Failures via Multi-Modal Expert Fusion
papers.authors: Konyul Park, Yecheol Kim, Daehun Kim, Jun Won Choi
papers.abstract: Modern autonomous driving perception systems utilize complementary multi-modal sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras. Although sensor fusion architectures enhance performance in challenging environments, they still suffer significant performance drops under severe sensor failures, such as LiDAR beam reduction, LiDAR drop, limited field of view, camera drop, and occlusion. This limitation stems from inter-modality dependencies in current sensor fusion frameworks. In this study, we introduce an efficient and robust LiDAR-camera 3D object detector, referred to as MoME, which can achieve robust performance through a mixture of experts approach. Our MoME fully decouples modality dependencies using three parallel expert decoders, which use camera features, LiDAR features, or a combination of both to decode object queries, respectively. We propose Multi-Expert Decoding (MED) framework, where each query is decoded selectively using one of three expert decoders. MoME utilizes an Adaptive Query Router (AQR) to select the most appropriate expert decoder for each query based on the quality of camera and LiDAR features. This ensures that each query is processed by the best-suited expert, resulting in robust performance across diverse sensor failure scenarios. We evaluated the performance of MoME on the nuScenes-R benchmark. Our MoME achieved state-of-the-art performance in extreme weather and sensor failure conditions, significantly outperforming the existing models across various sensor failure scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 通过多模式专家融合,在反感感应器故障下,通过多模式专家融合,具有弹性感感应器融合
papers.abstract_zh: 现代自主驱动感知系统使用辅助性多式传感器,如LiDAR和相机。虽然感应聚变结构提高了在具有挑战性的环境中的性能,但在严重传感器失灵(如LiDAR光束减少、LiDAR下降、视场有限、摄像下降和隐蔽)下,它们仍遭受显著的性能下降。这一限制源于当前感应聚变框架中的时态依赖性。在本研究中,我们引入了高效和强大的LiDAR-camera 3D物体探测器,称为MoME,通过专家混合方法可以实现强力性能。我们的MME完全分离模式依赖性,使用三个平行的专家解码器,分别使用相机特征、LIDAR特征或两者的组合来解码对象Query。 我们建议多专家解码框架,其中每个Query都有选择地使用三个专家解码器之一进行解码。MOME利用适应性Query路由器(AQR)根据相机质量和LIDAR特性为每个Query选择最合适的专家解码器。这确保了每个Query由最合适的专家处理,从而在不同传感器故障假设中产生强有力的性能。我们评估了MOME在Nuscenes-R基准中的性能。我们的MOME在极端天气和传感器失灵条件下取得了最先进的性能,大大超过各种传感器故障假设中的现有模型。

papers.title: R^2MoE: Redundancy-Removal Mixture of Experts for Lifelong Concept Learning
papers.authors: Xiaohan Guo, Yusong Cai, Zejia Liu, Zhengning Wang, Lili Pan, Hongliang Li
papers.abstract: Enabling large-scale generative models to continuously learn new visual concepts is essential for personalizing pre-trained models to meet individual user preferences. Existing approaches for continual visual concept learning are constrained by two fundamental challenges: catastrophic forgetting and parameter expansion. In this paper, we propose Redundancy-Removal Mixture of Experts (R^2MoE), a parameter-efficient framework for lifelong visual concept learning that effectively learns new concepts while incurring minimal parameter overhead. Our framework includes three key innovative contributions: First, we propose a mixture-of-experts framework with a routing distillation mechanism that enables experts to acquire concept-specific knowledge while preserving the gating network's routing capability, thereby effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Second, we propose a strategy for eliminating redundant layer-wise experts that reduces the number of expert parameters by fully utilizing previously learned experts. Third, we employ a hierarchical local attention-guided inference approach to mitigate interference between generated visual concepts. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that our method generates images with superior conceptual fidelity compared to the state-of-the-art (SOTA) method, achieving an impressive 87.8 % reduction in forgetting rates and 63.3 % fewer parameters on the CustomConcept 101 dataset. Our code is available at {https://github.com/learninginvision/R2MoE}
papers.title_zh: R2MOE:终身概念学习专家的裁员-退休混合
papers.abstract_zh: 使大规模基因化模型能够不断学习新的视觉概念,对于使经过培训的模型个性化,以满足个人用户的喜好至关重要。 持续视觉概念学习的现有方法受到两个基本挑战的制约:灾难性的遗忘和参数扩展。 在本文中,我们提出专家的裁员-再流动混合(R2MoE),这是一个终身视觉概念学习的参数高效框架,有效学习新概念,同时产生最低参数管理费。 我们的框架包括三项重要的创新贡献:第一,我们提议建立一个专家混合框架,并配有一个路由蒸馏机制,使专家能够获取特定概念知识,同时保持挂网路由能力,从而有效地减轻灾难性的遗忘。 第二,我们建议一项消除多余的层层专家的战略,通过充分利用以前所学的专家来减少专家参数的数量。 第三,我们采用地方分级引人注意的推论方法来减少生成的视觉概念之间的干扰。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法产生的图像与最新技术方法相比,在概念上的忠诚性较高,使遗忘率下降87.8%,用户概念101数据集参数减少63.3%,令人印象深刻。 我们的代码可在 {https://github.com/learninginvision/R2MoE}查阅。

papers.title: Question-Aware Gaussian Experts for Audio-Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Hongyeob Kim, Inyoung Jung, Dayoon Suh, Youjia Zhang, Sangmin Lee, Sungeun Hong
papers.abstract: Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) requires not only question-based multimodal reasoning but also precise temporal grounding to capture subtle dynamics for accurate prediction. However, existing methods mainly use question information implicitly, limiting focus on question-specific details. Furthermore, most studies rely on uniform frame sampling, which can miss key question-relevant frames. Although recent Top-K frame selection methods aim to address this, their discrete nature still overlooks fine-grained temporal details. This paper proposes QA-TIGER, a novel framework that explicitly incorporates question information and models continuous temporal dynamics. Our key idea is to use Gaussian-based modeling to adaptively focus on both consecutive and non-consecutive frames based on the question, while explicitly injecting question information and applying progressive refinement. We leverage a Mixture of Experts (MoE) to flexibly implement multiple Gaussian models, activating temporal experts specifically tailored to the question. Extensive experiments on multiple AVQA benchmarks show that QA-TIGER consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.title_zh: 视听问题问答专家
papers.abstract_zh: 视听问题回答(AVQA)不仅要求基于问题的多式联运推理,而且要求准确的时间依据,以捕捉精确预测的微妙动态,但是,现有方法主要暗含地使用问题信息,限制对特定问题细节的关注;此外,大多数研究依赖统一的框架抽样,这可能错过关键的问题相关框架;虽然最近的Top-K框架选择方法旨在解决这一问题,但其离散性质仍然忽略了细微的时段细节;本文提出了QA-TIGER,这是一个明确纳入问题信息的新框架,并模拟持续的时间动态模型。 我们的主要想法是利用高斯模式,以适应性地侧重于基于问题的连续和非连续框架,同时明确注入问题信息并逐步完善。 我们利用专家混合(MOE)灵活实施多种高斯模式,激活专门针对该问题的时间专家。 关于多个AVQA基准的广泛实验表明,QA-TIGER始终能取得SOTA 性能。

papers.title: PSReg: Prior-guided Sparse Mixture of Experts for Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Xiaoshui Huang, Zhou Huang, Yifan Zuo, Yongshun Gong, Chengdong Zhang, Deyang Liu, Yuming Fang
papers.abstract: The discriminative feature is crucial for point cloud registration. Recent methods improve the feature discriminative by distinguishing between non-overlapping and overlapping region points. However, they still face challenges in distinguishing the ambiguous structures in the overlapping regions. Therefore, the ambiguous features they extracted resulted in a significant number of outlier matches from overlapping regions. To solve this problem, we propose a prior-guided SMoE-based registration method to improve the feature distinctiveness by dispatching the potential correspondences to the same experts. Specifically, we propose a prior-guided SMoE module by fusing prior overlap and potential correspondence embeddings for routing, assigning tokens to the most suitable experts for processing. In addition, we propose a registration framework by a specific combination of Transformer layer and prior-guided SMoE module. The proposed method not only pays attention to the importance of locating the overlapping areas of point clouds, but also commits to finding more accurate correspondences in overlapping areas. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art registration recall (95.7%/79.3%) on the 3DMatch/3DLoMatch benchmark. Moreover, we also test the performance on ModelNet40 and demonstrate excellent performance.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: PSReg: 点云登记专家先前制导的散状混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 对点云登记来说,歧视特征至关重要。最近的方法通过区分非重叠和重叠的区域点来改进区别特征。但是,在区分重叠区域的模糊结构方面,这些方法仍然面临着挑战。因此,这些方法的模糊特征导致与重叠区域的大量异差匹配。为了解决这一问题,我们提议了一种基于事先指导的SMoE注册方法,通过向同一批专家发送可能的通信来改进特征特征特征。具体地说,我们提议了一种事先指导的SMoE模块,将先前的重叠和可能的通信嵌入作为路由,为最合适的处理专家分配标牌。 此外,我们还提议了一个登记框架,将变压层和先前制导的SMoE模块具体结合起来,提议的方法不仅注意确定点云重叠区域的重要性,而且承诺在重叠区域寻找更准确的对应信息。我们的广泛实验证明了我们的方法的有效性,实现了3DMatch/3DloMatch基准的最新登记(95.7%/79.3% ) 。此外,我们还测试了ModelNet40的性能并展示了出色的表现。

papers.title: Plant disease classification in the wild using vision transformers and mixture of experts
papers.authors: Salman Zafar, Abdullah Muhammad, Dongil Han
papers.abstract: Plant disease classification using deep learning techniques has shown promising results, especially when models are trained on high-quality images. However, these models often suffer from a significant drop in their accuracies when tested in real-world agricultural settings. In the wild, models encounter images that are significantly different from the training data in aspects like lighting conditions, capturing conditions, image resolution, and the severity of disease. This discrepancy between the training images and images in-the-wild conditions poses a major challenge for deploying these models in agricultural settings. In this paper, we present a novel approach to address this issue by combining a Vision Transformer backbone with a Mixture of Experts, where multiple expert models are trained to specialize in different aspects of the input data, and a gating mechanism is implemented to select the most relevant experts for each input. The use of Mixture of Experts allows the model to dynamically allocate specialized experts to different types of input data, improving model performance across diverse image conditions. The approach significantly improves performance on diverse datasets that contain a range of image capturing conditions and disease severities. Furthermore, the model incorporates entropy regularization and orthogonal regularization, aiming to enhance the robustness and generalization capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieved a 20% improvement in accuracy compared to Vision Transformer (ViT). Furthermore, it demonstrated a 68% accuracy on cross-domain datasets like PlantVillage to PlantDoc, surpassing baseline models such as InceptionV3 and EfficientNet. This highlights the potential of our model for effective deployment in dynamic agricultural environments.
papers.title_zh: 使用视觉变压器和专家混合对野外植物疾病进行分类
papers.abstract_zh: 利用深层学习技术对植物疾病进行分类,已经显示出可喜的成果,特别是当模型接受高质量图像培训时,这些模型在现实世界农业环境中进行测试时,其适应能力往往显著下降。在野生环境中,模型在照明条件、捕捉条件、图像分辨率和疾病严重程度等方面遇到与培训数据大不相同的图像。培训图像与当前条件下的图像之间存在差异,这对在农业环境中应用这些模型构成了重大挑战。 在本文中,我们提出了一个解决这一问题的新办法,将视觉变换元件与专家混合体结合起来,对多个专家模型进行培训,使其在投入数据的不同方面具有专长,并采用格子机制为每项投入选择最相关的专家。使用专家混合体使模型能够将专家动态地分配到不同类型的投入数据上,改善不同图像条件下的模型性能。这种方法极大地改进了包含一系列图像捕捉条件和疾病分量的多种数据集的性能。此外,模型还包含酶正规化和正方形正规化,目的是增强稳健性和通用能力。 实验结果表明,与视觉Transformer(VIT)相比,拟议模型的准确性提高了20%。 此外,还展示了68%的跨领域数据集的准确性,如植物村到植物院,超过了 " 受孕V3 " 和 " 高效网络 " 等基线模型。 这凸显了我们模式在动态农业环境中有效部署的潜力。

papers.title: OmniAID: Decoupling Semantic and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild
papers.authors: Yuncheng Guo, Junyan Ye, Chenjue Zhang, Hengrui Kang, Haohuan Fu, Conghui He, Weijia Li
papers.abstract: A truly universal AI-Generated Image (AIGI) detector must simultaneously generalize across diverse generative models and varied semantic content. Current methods learn a single, entangled forgery representation, conflating content-dependent flaws with content-agnostic artifacts, and are further constrained by outdated benchmarks. We propose OmniAID, a novel framework centered on a decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that separates: (1) semantic flaws across distinct content domains via Routable Specialized Semantic Experts, and (2) content-agnostic universal artifacts from content-dependent flaws via a Fixed Universal Artifact Expert. A two-stage training strategy first specializes experts independently with domain-specific hard-sampling, then trains a lightweight gating network for effective input routing. By explicitly decoupling "what is generated" (content-specific flaws) from "how it is generated" (universal artifacts), OmniAID achieves robust generalization. We also introduce Mirage, a large-scale, contemporary dataset comprising a modern training set and a challenging test set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniAID surpasses existing detectors, establishing a new standard for AIGI detection against modern, in-the-wild threats. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/OmniAID.
papers.title_zh: OmniAID:将语义和艺术解耦,用于在野生生物中进行全AI光化图像探测
papers.abstract_zh: 真正具有普遍性的AI-Generation图像探测器必须同时对各种基因模型和各种语义内容加以普及。 现行方法学习单一、缠绕在一起的伪造代表,将内容依赖的缺陷与内容不可知的文物混为一谈,并进一步受到过时基准的限制。 我们建议OmniAID,这是一个以分解的专家混合(MOE)架构为中心的新框架,它区分:(1) 通过常规专门语言专家,不同内容领域的语义缺陷;(2) 通过固定通用艺术专家,从内容依赖的缺陷中取出内容不可知的通用文物。 一项两阶段培训战略首先专门专家独立地进行具体领域的硬抽样,然后训练轻量级网,以有效输入路由。 通过将“产生什么”(具体内容的缺陷)与“如何产生”(普遍文物)明确区分开来,OmniAID实现了有力的概括化。 我们还引入了“幻影 ” , 一个由现代培训组和具有挑战性的测试组组成的大规模当代数据集。 广泛的实验表明,OmniAID超过了现有的探测器,为AIGI探测现代的、现成的威胁确立了新的标准,守则可在https://github.com/yuncheng/OmniAID上查阅。

papers.title: Object Detection using Event Camera: A MoE Heat Conduction based Detector and A New Benchmark Dataset
papers.authors: Xiao Wang, Yu Jin, Wentao Wu, Wei Zhang, Lin Zhu, Bo Jiang, Yonghong Tian
papers.abstract: Object detection in event streams has emerged as a cutting-edge research area, demonstrating superior performance in low-light conditions, scenarios with motion blur, and rapid movements. Current detectors leverage spiking neural networks, Transformers, or convolutional neural networks as their core architectures, each with its own set of limitations including restricted performance, high computational overhead, or limited local receptive fields. This paper introduces a novel MoE (Mixture of Experts) heat conduction-based object detection algorithm that strikingly balances accuracy and computational efficiency. Initially, we employ a stem network for event data embedding, followed by processing through our innovative MoE-HCO blocks. Each block integrates various expert modules to mimic heat conduction within event streams. Subsequently, an IoU-based query selection module is utilized for efficient token extraction, which is then channeled into a detection head for the final object detection process. Furthermore, we are pleased to introduce EvDET200K, a novel benchmark dataset for event-based object detection. Captured with a high-definition Prophesee EVK4-HD event camera, this dataset encompasses 10 distinct categories, 200,000 bounding boxes, and 10,054 samples, each spanning 2 to 5 seconds. We also provide comprehensive results from over 15 state-of-the-art detectors, offering a solid foundation for future research and comparison.
papers.title_zh: 使用事件相机探测物体:以摩热导导为基地的探测器和新的基准数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 事件流中的物体探测已经成为一个尖端研究领域,表明低光条件下的优异性能、运动模糊的情景和快速移动。 当前探测器的杠杆作用冲刷神经网络、变形器或进化神经网络,作为核心结构,每个网络都有自己的一系列限制,包括性能受限、高计算间接费用或有限的当地可容纳场。 本文介绍一个新的基于热导的物体探测算法,它能平衡准确性和计算效率。 最初,我们使用一个事件数据嵌入干网,然后通过我们创新的部-部-部块进行处理。 每个区块整合了各种专家模块,以在事件流中模仿热导。 随后,利用基于IoU的Query选择模块高效提取符号,然后将该模块输送到最终天体探测过程的探测头上。 此外,我们很高兴引入EvDET200K,这是一个用于事件物体探测的新型基准数据集。 该数据集由高清晰的预言EVK4-HD事件相机拍摄,包含10个不同类别、200 000个捆绑盒和10 054个样本,每个样本的长度为2至5秒。 我们还从超过15个最先进的探测器中提供全面的结果,为今后的研究和比较提供了坚实的基础。

papers.title: MoVE-KD: Knowledge Distillation for VLMs with Mixture of Visual Encoders
papers.authors: Jiajun Cao, Yuan Zhang, Tao Huang, Ming Lu, Qizhe Zhang, Ruichuan An, Ningning Ma, Shanghang Zhang
papers.abstract: Visual encoders are fundamental components in vision-language models (VLMs), each showcasing unique strengths derived from various pre-trained visual foundation models. To leverage the various capabilities of these encoders, recent studies incorporate multiple encoders within a single VLM, leading to a considerable increase in computational cost. In this paper, we present Mixture-of-Visual-Encoder Knowledge Distillation (MoVE-KD), a novel framework that distills the unique proficiencies of multiple vision encoders into a single, efficient encoder model. Specifically, to mitigate conflicts and retain the unique characteristics of each teacher encoder, we employ low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and mixture-of-experts (MoEs) to selectively activate specialized knowledge based on input features, enhancing both adaptability and efficiency. To regularize the KD process and enhance performance, we propose an attention-based distillation strategy that adaptively weighs the different encoders and emphasizes valuable visual tokens, reducing the burden of replicating comprehensive but distinct features from multiple teachers. Comprehensive experiments on popular VLMs, such as LLaVA and LLaVA-NeXT, validate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is available at:https://github.com/hey-cjj/MoVE-KD.
papers.title_zh: MoVE-KD:利用视觉编码器混合体对VLMs进行知识蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉编码器是视觉语言模型(VLMs)的基本组成部分,每个模型都展示各种经过培训的视觉基础模型的独特优势。 为了利用这些编码器的各种能力,最近的研究将多个编码器纳入一个单一的VLM内,导致计算成本大幅度增加。 在本文中,我们提出“视觉-环境知识的混合蒸馏”(MOVE-KD),这是一个新颖的框架,将多种视觉编码器的独特熟练性提炼成一个单一、有效的编码器模型。 具体地说,为了减轻冲突和保留每个教师编码器的独特性,我们采用低级别适应(LORA)和专家混合(MOEs)来有选择地激活基于投入特征的专门知识,同时提高适应能力和效率。 为了规范KD进程,提高绩效,我们建议采取以关注为基础的蒸馏战略,适应性地权衡不同的编码器,强调宝贵的视觉象征物,减轻推广全面但与多位教师不同的特征的负担。 关于广受欢迎的VLMs(如LLAVA和LLAVA-NEXT)的全面实验证实了我们的方法的有效性,我们的代码可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/hey-cjj/MOVE-KD。

papers.title: Mono-InternVL: Pushing the Boundaries of Monolithic Multimodal Large Language Models with Endogenous Visual Pre-training
papers.authors: Gen Luo, Xue Yang, Wenhan Dou, Zhaokai Wang, Jiawen Liu, Jifeng Dai, Yu Qiao, Xizhou Zhu
papers.abstract: In this paper, we focus on monolithic Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that integrate visual encoding and language decoding into a single LLM. In particular, we identify that existing pre-training strategies for monolithic MLLMs often suffer from unstable optimization or catastrophic forgetting. To address this issue, our core idea is to embed a new visual parameter space into a pre-trained LLM, thereby stably learning visual knowledge from noisy data while freezing the LLM. Based on this principle, we present Mono-InternVL, a novel monolithic MLLM that seamlessly integrates a set of visual experts via a multimodal mixture-of-experts structure. Moreover, we propose an innovative pre-training strategy to maximize the visual capability of Mono-InternVL, namely Endogenous Visual Pre-training (EViP). In particular, EViP is designed as a progressive learning process for visual experts, which aims to fully exploit the visual knowledge from noisy data to high-quality data. To validate our approach, we conduct extensive experiments on 16 benchmarks. Experimental results confirm the superior performance of Mono-InternVL over existing monolithic MLLMs on 13 of 16 multimodal benchmarks, e.g., +80 points over Emu3 on OCRBench. Compared to the modular baseline, i.e., InternVL-1.5, Mono-InternVL still retains comparable multimodal performance while reducing up to 67% first token latency. Our project is available at https://internvl.github.io/blog/2024-10-10-Mono-InternVL/.
papers.title_zh: 单一内部语言:推进单利多模式大语言模型的边界,并进行内源视觉预科培训
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们侧重于将视觉编码和语言解码纳入单一的LLM(MLLM)的单一多式多式大语言模型(MLLM)(MLLM)(MLLM)(将视觉编码和语言解码纳入单一的LLM)。 特别是,我们确定,单式MLLM(MLLM)的现有培训前战略常常因不稳定的优化或灾难性的遗忘而受到影响。 为了解决这一问题,我们的核心想法是将一个新的视觉参数空间嵌入预先培训的LLM中,从而在冻结LLM的同时,从噪音数据中不断学习视觉知识。 基于这一原则,我们提出单一国际VL,这是一个新颖的单曲MLLM,通过多式专家混合结构,将一组视觉专家无缝地融合在一起。 此外,我们提议了一项创新的培训前战略,以最大限度地提高单体-内体VL的视觉能力,即内体视觉预科培训(EViP)。 特别是,EViP是作为视觉专家的渐进学习过程设计的,其目的是充分利用从噪音数据到高质量数据的视觉知识。 为了验证我们的方法,我们在16个基准上进行了广泛的实验。 实验结果证实,根据16项多式联运基准中的13项标准,如OCRBench上的Emu3+80点,单体内VL优于现有的单体MLLMs。 与模块基线相比,即InternVL-1.5, Mono-InternVL仍然保留类似的多式联运业绩,同时将首次象征性的延迟率降至67%。 我们的项目可在https://internvl.github.io/blog/2024-10-Mono-InternVL/上查阅。

papers.title: MoIIE: Mixture of Intra- and Inter-Modality Experts for Large Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Dianyi Wang, Siyuan Wang, Zejun Li, Yikun Wang, Yitong Li, Duyu Tang, Xiaoyu Shen, Xuanjing Huang, Zhongyu Wei
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across multi-modal tasks by scaling model size and training data. However, these dense LVLMs incur significant computational costs and motivate the exploration of sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures. While MoE improve parameter efficiency, effectively applying MoE to simultaneously model modality-specific features and cross-modal associations in LVLMs remains challenging. In this work, we propose to incorporate Mixture of Intra- and Inter-Modality Experts (MoIIE) to LVLMs. For each token, expert routing is guided by its modality, directing tokens to their respective intra-modality experts as well as a shared pool of inter-modality experts, enabling the model to jointly learn rich intra-modal features and cross-modal interactions. We further introduce an effective and straightforward two-stage training strategy, which facilitates the direct activation of both MoE and multi-modal capabilities. Extensive experiments across different data scales and LLM backbone demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency and generality of our approach. Notably, our MoIIE models with 5.5B and 11.3B activated parameters match or even surpass the performance of existing advanced open-source MoE-LLMs based multi-modal models that involve more activated parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/AlenjandroWang/MoIIE.
papers.title_zh: MoIIE:大视觉语言模型内部和跨模式专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型(LVLM)通过扩大模型规模和培训数据,在多模式任务中表现出了显著的绩效,然而,这些密集的LVLMS产生了巨大的计算成本,激发了对稀有的专家混合结构的探索。 虽然MoE提高了参数效率,但将MoE有效应用于LVLM中模式特有特点和跨模式协会的模式,仍然具有挑战性,在这项工作中,我们提议将内部和跨模式专家混合体(MoIIE)纳入LVLMS。 对于每一种方式,专家路线都以其方式为指导,将标牌指示给各自内部的现代专家,以及一个共同的现代专家库,使模型能够共同学习丰富多彩的现代内部特征和跨模式的互动。 我们进一步引入有效和直截了当的两阶段培训战略,促进MoE和多模式能力的直接启动,在不同数据尺度和LLM主干线上进行的广泛实验显示了我们方法的有效性、效率和一般性。 值得注意的是,我们拥有5.5B和11.3B活性参数的部电模型与现有先进的开放源MoE-LLMs的多模式模型相匹配,甚至超过了这些模型的性能,这些模型涉及更活性参数,代码见https://github.com/AlenjandroWang/MoIIE。

papers.title: MoEDiff-SR: Mixture of Experts-Guided Diffusion Model for Region-Adaptive MRI Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Zhe Wang, Yuhua Ru, Aladine Chetouani, Fang Chen, Fabian Bauer, Liping Zhang, Didier Hans, Rachid Jennane, Mohamed Jarraya, Yung Hsin Chen
papers.abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) at lower field strengths (e.g., 3T) suffers from limited spatial resolution, making it challenging to capture fine anatomical details essential for clinical diagnosis and neuroimaging research. To overcome this limitation, we propose MoEDiff-SR, a Mixture of Experts (MoE)-guided diffusion model for region-adaptive MRI Super-Resolution (SR). Unlike conventional diffusion-based SR models that apply a uniform denoising process across the entire image, MoEDiff-SR dynamically selects specialized denoising experts at a fine-grained token level, ensuring region-specific adaptation and enhanced SR performance. Specifically, our approach first employs a Transformer-based feature extractor to compute multi-scale patch embeddings, capturing both global structural information and local texture details. The extracted feature embeddings are then fed into an MoE gating network, which assigns adaptive weights to multiple diffusion-based denoisers, each specializing in different brain MRI characteristics, such as centrum semiovale, sulcal and gyral cortex, and grey-white matter junction. The final output is produced by aggregating the denoised results from these specialized experts according to dynamically assigned gating probabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that MoEDiff-SR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of quantitative image quality metrics, perceptual fidelity, and computational efficiency. Difference maps from each expert further highlight their distinct specializations, confirming the effective region-specific denoising capability and the interpretability of expert contributions. Additionally, clinical evaluation validates its superior diagnostic capability in identifying subtle pathological features, emphasizing its practical relevance in clinical neuroimaging. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZWang78/MoEDiff-SR.
papers.title_zh: MEDiff-SR:区域适应性磁RI超级分辨率专家辅助扩散模型混合
papers.abstract_zh: 实地强力较低的磁共振成像(如3T)的空间分辨率有限,因此难以捕捉临床诊断和神经成像研究所必需的细解剖细节。 为了克服这一限制,我们提议采用区域适应性磁共振超级分辨率(SR)专家混合制(MOE)制导扩散模型(MOE),作为区域适应性磁共振超分辨率(SR)。 与传统的基于扩散的SR模型不同,这些模型在整个图像中采用统一的分水分配程序。 MOEDiff-SR动态地挑选了精细标记级别的专家,确保针对具体区域的适应和增强SR的性能。 具体地说,我们的方法首先使用一个基于Transformer的特征提取器来计算多尺度的补丁嵌入,捕捉全球结构信息和地方质地细节。 然后将提取的特征嵌入器输入MoE的定位网,对多种基于扩散的低水层动物进行适应性加权,每个动物都专门研究不同的脑部磁共振特性,如中子半卵、肺和毛皮皮层以及灰白物质交汇处。 最后产出是根据动态分配的概率将这些专家的无记名结果汇总起来的。 实验结果表明,在定量图像质量衡量标准、认知忠诚度和计算效率方面,MoE-斯洛伐克共和国的绩效超过了现有的最新方法。 每位专家的相异地图进一步突显了他们不同的专业,确认了有效的区域专用专用能力以及专家贡献的可解释性。 此外,临床评价还证实它在查明微妙病理特征方面的高级诊断能力,强调其在临床神经成像方面的实用相关性,我们的代码可在https://github.com/ZWang78/MoEDiff-SR上查阅。

papers.title: Modality Interactive Mixture-of-Experts for Fake News Detection
papers.authors: Yifan Liu, Yaokun Liu, Zelin Li, Ruichen Yao, Yang Zhang, Dong Wang
papers.abstract: The proliferation of fake news on social media platforms disproportionately impacts vulnerable populations, eroding trust, exacerbating inequality, and amplifying harmful narratives. Detecting fake news in multimodal contexts-where deceptive content combines text and images-is particularly challenging due to the nuanced interplay between modalities. Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often emphasize cross-modal consistency but ignore the complex interactions between text and visual elements, which may complement, contradict, or independently influence the predicted veracity of a post. To address these challenges, we present Modality Interactive Mixture-of-Experts for Fake News Detection (MIMoE-FND), a novel hierarchical Mixture-of-Expert framework designed to enhance multimodal fake news detection by explicitly modeling modality interactions through an interaction gating mechanism. Our approach models modality interactions by evaluating two key aspects of modality interactions: unimodal prediction agreement and semantic alignment. The hierarchical structure of MIMoE-FND allows for distinct learning pathways tailored to different fusion scenarios, adapting to the unique characteristics of each modality interaction. By tailoring fusion strategies to diverse modality interaction scenarios, MIMoE-FND provides a more robust and nuanced approach to multimodal fake news detection. We evaluate our approach on three real-world benchmarks spanning two languages, demonstrating its superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. By enhancing the accuracy and interpretability of fake news detection, MIMoE-FND offers a promising tool to mitigate the spread of misinformation, with potential to better safeguard vulnerable communities against its harmful effects.
papers.title_zh: 假新闻探测的交互式互动专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台上假新闻的泛滥对弱势人口造成不成比例的影响,侵蚀信任,加剧不平等,扩大有害叙事。 在多式联运环境中检测假消息----欺骗性内容将文字和图像结合起来,由于模式之间的微妙相互作用,这种假消息尤其具有挑战性。 现有的多式联运假新闻探测方法往往强调跨模式的一致性,但忽视了文本和视觉要素之间的复杂互动,这些互动可能补充、矛盾或独立影响某一文章的预测真实性。 为应对这些挑战,我们介绍假新闻探测专家互动混合模型(MIMoE-FND),这是一个新的等级级专家混合模型框架,旨在通过互动定位机制明确模拟模式互动,加强多式联运假新闻探测。 通过评价模式互动的两个关键方面:单一方式预测协议和语义一致,我们的方法模式模式模式互动。 MIMoE-FND的等级结构允许根据不同的融合情景,根据每种模式互动的独特特点,采用不同的学习途径。 MIMoE-FND通过根据不同模式互动情景制定融合战略,为多式联运假新闻探测提供了更加有力和细致的方法。 我们评估了我们使用两种语言的三种现实世界基准的方法,表明其优于最先进的方法。 MIMoE-FND通过提高假新闻探测的准确性和可解释性,为减少错误信息的传播提供了一个很有希望的工具,有可能更好地保护弱势群体免受其有害影响。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Shape-Experts (MoSE): End-to-End Shape Dictionary Framework to Prompt SAM for Generalizable Medical Segmentation
papers.authors: Jia Wei, Xiaoqi Zhao, Jonghye Woo, Jinsong Ouyang, Georges El Fakhri, Qingyu Chen, Xiaofeng Liu
papers.abstract: Single domain generalization (SDG) has recently attracted growing attention in medical image segmentation. One promising strategy for SDG is to leverage consistent semantic shape priors across different imaging protocols, scanner vendors, and clinical sites. However, existing dictionary learning methods that encode shape priors often suffer from limited representational power with a small set of offline computed shape elements, or overfitting when the dictionary size grows. Moreover, they are not readily compatible with large foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM). In this paper, we propose a novel Mixture-of-Shape-Experts (MoSE) framework that seamlessly integrates the idea of mixture-of-experts (MoE) training into dictionary learning to efficiently capture diverse and robust shape priors. Our method conceptualizes each dictionary atom as a shape expert, which specializes in encoding distinct semantic shape information. A gating network dynamically fuses these shape experts into a robust shape map, with sparse activation guided by SAM encoding to prevent overfitting. We further provide this shape map as a prompt to SAM, utilizing the powerful generalization capability of SAM through bidirectional integration. All modules, including the shape dictionary, are trained in an end-to-end manner. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.
papers.title_zh: Mixture Shape-Experts(MOSE):用于可通用医疗分解的快速 SAM 加速 SAM 的终端到终端形状词典框架
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,单一域一般化(SDG)在医学图像分割中引起了越来越多的关注。 SDG的一个有希望的战略是在不同成像协议、扫描仪供应商和临床网站之间利用一致的语义形状前缀。 然而,将前身编码的现有字典学习方法,往往因代表权有限而受到影响,有少量的离线计算形状元素,或者在字典大小扩大时过于适合。 此外,它们也不容易与大型基础模型兼容,如 " 片段 " 模式(SAM)等。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个新型的混合组合-专家(MOSE)框架,将专家混合(MOE)培训的概念无缝地纳入字典学习,以便有效地捕捉多样化和稳健的形状前科。 我们的方法将每个字典原子概念化为形状专家,该功能专家专门致力于编码独特的语义形状信息。 带刺网络将这些形状专家动态地连接到一个坚固的形状图中,在SAM编码的指导下,微弱地激活,以防止超配。 我们通过双向集成,利用SAM的强大一般化能力,进一步向SAM提供这一形状图。 包括形状字典在内的所有模块都经过端对端培训。 多个公共数据集的广泛实验证明了其有效性。

papers.title: Mixpert: Mitigating Multimodal Learning Conflicts with Efficient Mixture-of-Vision-Experts
papers.authors: Xin He, Xumeng Han, Longhui Wei, Lingxi Xie, Qi Tian
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require a nuanced interpretation of complex image information, typically leveraging a vision encoder to perceive various visual scenarios. However, relying solely on a single vision encoder to handle diverse task domains proves difficult and inevitably leads to conflicts. Recent work enhances data perception by directly integrating multiple domain-specific vision encoders, yet this structure adds complexity and limits the potential for joint optimization. In this paper, we introduce Mixpert, an efficient mixture-of-vision-experts architecture that inherits the joint learning advantages from a single vision encoder while being restructured into a multi-expert paradigm for task-specific fine-tuning across different visual tasks. Additionally, we design a dynamic routing mechanism that allocates input images to the most suitable visual expert. Mixpert effectively alleviates domain conflicts encountered by a single vision encoder in multi-task learning with minimal additional computational cost, making it more efficient than multiple encoders. Furthermore, Mixpert integrates seamlessly into any MLLM, with experimental results demonstrating substantial performance gains across various tasks.
papers.title_zh: Mixpert:以高效的想象-专家混合组合缓解多式学习冲突
papers.abstract_zh: 多模式大型语言模型(MLLM)要求对复杂的图像信息进行细微的解读,通常使用视觉编码器来观察各种视觉情景。 但是,仅仅依靠单一的视觉编码器来处理不同任务领域证明是困难的,并且不可避免地会导致冲突。 最近的工作通过直接整合多个具体领域的视觉编码器,提高了数据认识,但这一结构增加了复杂性,限制了联合优化的潜力。 在本文中,我们引入了一种高效的混合观点专家结构Mixpert,它从单一的视觉编码器中继承了共同学习优势,同时被重组为一个多专家模式,用于对不同视觉任务进行具体任务微调。 此外,我们设计了一个动态路径机制,将输入图像分配给最合适的视觉专家。 Mixpert有效地缓解了多任务学习中的单一视觉编码器所遭遇的域冲突,其计算成本最低,使其比多个编码器更有效。 此外,Mixpert无缝地融入了任何MLLM,实验结果显示,在各项任务中取得了可观的业绩收益。

papers.title: MicarVLMoE: A Modern Gated Cross-Aligned Vision-Language Mixture of Experts Model for Medical Image Captioning and Report Generation
papers.authors: Amaan Izhar, Nurul Japar, Norisma Idris, Ting Dang
papers.abstract: Medical image reporting (MIR) aims to generate structured clinical descriptions from radiological images. Existing methods struggle with fine-grained feature extraction, multimodal alignment, and generalization across diverse imaging types, often relying on vanilla transformers and focusing primarily on chest X-rays. We propose MicarVLMoE, a vision-language mixture-of-experts model with gated cross-aligned fusion, designed to address these limitations. Our architecture includes: (i) a multiscale vision encoder (MSVE) for capturing anatomical details at varying resolutions, (ii) a multihead dual-branch latent attention (MDLA) module for vision-language alignment through latent bottleneck representations, and (iii) a modulated mixture-of-experts (MoE) decoder for adaptive expert specialization. We extend MIR to CT scans, retinal imaging, MRI scans, and gross pathology images, reporting state-of-the-art results on COVCTR, MMR, PGROSS, and ROCO datasets. Extensive experiments and ablations confirm improved clinical accuracy, cross-modal alignment, and model interpretability. Code is available at https://github.com/AI-14/micar-vl-moe.
papers.title_zh: MiccarVLMoE:医学图像描述和报告生成专家现代通用的跨统一视觉-语言混合模型
papers.abstract_zh: 医疗图像报告(MIR)旨在从放射图像中产生结构化的临床描述。 现有方法与精细地貌提取、多式组合以及不同成像类型(往往依赖香草变压器,主要侧重于胸部X光)的概括化挣扎。 我们建议米卡VLMoE, 一种视觉语言专家混合模型, 配有封闭的交叉融合, 旨在克服这些限制。 我们的架构包括:(一) 一个多尺度的视觉编码器(MSVE),用于在不同决议中获取解剖细节;(二) 一个多头双部门潜在关注模块,用于通过潜在的瓶颈表示进行视觉-语言调整;(三) 一个调制专家混合解码器,用于适应性专家专业化。 我们把MIR推广到CT扫描、视网膜成像、MRI扫描和毛病理图象,报告有关COVCTR、MMR、PGRSOS和ROCO数据集的最新结果。 广泛的实验和推算证实临床准确性、跨模式调整和模型可解释性得到了提高。 法规可在https://github.com/AI-14/micar-vl-moe查阅。

papers.title: MExD: An Expert-Infused Diffusion Model for Whole-Slide Image Classification
papers.authors: Jianwei Zhao, Xin Li, Fan Yang, Qiang Zhai, Ao Luo, Yang Zhao, Hong Cheng, Huazhu Fu
papers.abstract: Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification poses unique challenges due to the vast image size and numerous non-informative regions, which introduce noise and cause data imbalance during feature aggregation. To address these issues, we propose MExD, an Expert-Infused Diffusion Model that combines the strengths of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism with a diffusion model for enhanced classification. MExD balances patch feature distribution through a novel MoE-based aggregator that selectively emphasizes relevant information, effectively filtering noise, addressing data imbalance, and extracting essential features. These features are then integrated via a diffusion-based generative process to directly yield the class distribution for the WSI. Moving beyond conventional discriminative approaches, MExD represents the first generative strategy in WSI classification, capturing fine-grained details for robust and precise results. Our MExD is validated on three widely-used benchmarks--Camelyon16, TCGA-NSCLC, and BRACS--consistently achieving state-of-the-art performance in both binary and multi-class tasks.
papers.title_zh: MExD:全流图像分类专家应用传播模型
papers.abstract_zh: 整个幻灯片图像分类(WSI)由于图像幅员辽阔和许多非信息化区域,造成了独特的挑战,在特征汇总期间,它们造成噪音和数据不平衡。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用MExD,即专家应用传播模型,将专家混合机制的优势与推广模型结合起来,加强分类。 MExD通过一个基于MoE的新型聚合器,有选择地强调相关信息,有效地过滤噪音,解决数据不平衡问题,并提取基本特征,从而平衡了拼接特征的分布。 这些特征随后通过基于传播的基因化过程整合而成,直接产生西方空间倡议的阶级分布。 超越传统的歧视性方法,劳动和社会发展部代表了西方空间倡议分类的第一个基因化战略,收集了精细的细节,以取得稳健和准确的结果。 在三个广泛使用的基准 -- -- Camelyon16、TCGA-NSCLC和BRACS -- -- 一致地在二进制和多级任务中取得最先进的业绩 -- -- 上,验证了我们的MExD。

papers.title: MEGAN: Mixture of Experts for Robust Uncertainty Estimation in Endoscopy Videos
papers.authors: Damola Agbelese, Krishna Chaitanya, Pushpak Pati, Chaitanya Parmar, Pooya Mobadersany, Shreyas Fadnavis, Lindsey Surace, Shadi Yarandi, Louis R. Ghanem, Molly Lucas, Tommaso Mansi, Oana Gabriela Cula, Pablo F. Damasceno, Kristopher Standish
papers.abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential in medical AI. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers a computationally efficient way to quantify model uncertainty alongside predictions, unlike traditional methods such as Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout and Deep Ensembles (DE). However, all these methods often rely on a single expert's annotations as ground truth for model training, overlooking the inter-rater variability in healthcare. To address this issue, we propose MEGAN, a Multi-Expert Gating Network that aggregates uncertainty estimates and predictions from multiple AI experts via EDL models trained with diverse ground truths and modeling strategies. MEGAN's gating network optimally combines predictions and uncertainties from each EDL model, enhancing overall prediction confidence and calibration. We extensively benchmark MEGAN on endoscopy videos for Ulcerative colitis (UC) disease severity estimation, assessed by visual labeling of Mayo Endoscopic Subscore (MES), where inter-rater variability is prevalent. In large-scale prospective UC clinical trial, MEGAN achieved a 3.5% improvement in F1-score and a 30.5% reduction in Expected Calibration Error (ECE) compared to existing methods. Furthermore, MEGAN facilitated uncertainty-guided sample stratification, reducing the annotation burden and potentially increasing efficiency and consistency in UC trials.
papers.title_zh: MEGAN: 内镜影视视频中强力不确定性估算专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 可靠的不确定性量化(UQ)在医学AI中至关重要。 证据深入学习(EDL)提供了一种高效的计算方法,可以将模型不确定性与预测一起量化,这不同于传统方法,如蒙特卡洛(MC)辍学和深团(DE)。 然而,所有这些方法往往都依赖单一专家的说明作为示范培训的实地真相,忽略了保健方面的跨国家差异。 为解决这一问题,我们提议建立多专家定位网络,即多专家定位网络,通过经培训具有不同地面真相和建模战略的EDL模型,汇总多个大赦国际专家的不确定性估计和预测。 MEGAN的定位网将每个EDL模型的预测和不确定因素最佳地结合起来,提高总体预测信心和校准。 我们广泛以内镜检查录像为基准,用于对聚性肺炎(UC)疾病严重程度进行估计,评估方法是对大鼠间位变异普遍存在的Mayo Endoscopic子芯片(MES)进行直观标记。 在大规模未来的UC临床试验中,MEGAN在F1芯片上取得了3.5%的改善,与现有方法相比,预期校准错误(ECE)减少了30.5%。 此外,地中海环境网还促进了不确定因素引导抽样分层,减轻了批注负担,并有可能提高联合调查组审判的效率和一致性。

papers.title: MdaIF: Robust One-Stop Multi-Degradation-Aware Image Fusion with Language-Driven Semantics
papers.authors: Jing Li, Yifan Wang, Jiafeng Yan, Renlong Zhang, Bin Yang
papers.abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary multi-modal information into a single fused result. However, existing methods 1) fail to account for the degradation visible images under adverse weather conditions, thereby compromising fusion performance; and 2) rely on fixed network architectures, limiting their adaptability to diverse degradation scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a one-stop degradation-aware image fusion framework for multi-degradation scenarios driven by a large language model (MdaIF). Given the distinct scattering characteristics of different degradation scenarios (e.g., haze, rain, and snow) in atmospheric transmission, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) system is introduced to tackle image fusion across multiple degradation scenarios. To adaptively extract diverse weather-aware degradation knowledge and scene feature representations, collectively referred to as the semantic prior, we employ a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) in our framework. Guided by the semantic prior, we propose degradation-aware channel attention module (DCAM), which employ degradation prototype decomposition to facilitate multi-modal feature interaction in channel domain.
