In addition, to achieve effective expert routing, the semantic prior and channel-domain modulated features are utilized to guide the MoE, enabling robust image fusion in complex degradation scenarios. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our MdaIF, demonstrating superior performance over SOTA methods.
papers.title_zh: MdaIF: 一站一站式多分解- 软件图像与语言驱动语义融合
papers.abstract_zh: 红外和可见的图像集成旨在将互补的多模式信息纳入单一的引信结果。 然而,现有方法(1) 未能说明在恶劣天气条件下可见的退化图像,从而损害聚变性能;(2) 依赖固定网络结构,限制其适应各种退化情景的能力。 为解决这些问题,我们提议为由大型语言模式驱动的多降解情景设想方案建立一个一站式退化意识图像聚合框架。 鉴于大气传播中不同降解情景(如烟雾、雨和雪)的分散特性,采用了专家混合系统来处理多种降解情景中的图像聚合问题。 为了适应性地提取各种有天气意识的退化知识和场景特征说明(统称为先前的语义),我们在我们的框架中采用了预先培训的视觉语言模型(VLM)。 在先前语义学的指导下,我们提议采用降解原型分解的降解觉觉觉分流注意模块(DCAM),以促进频道域的多模式特征交互。 此外,为了实现有效的专家路线,还利用语义学前和频道主控调特点来指导MoE,使图像在复杂的降解情景中形成强力融合。 广泛的实验验证了我们MdaIF的有效性,显示了比SOTA方法的优异性能。

papers.title: Mamba Goes HoME: Hierarchical Soft Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Szymon Płotka, Gizem Mert, Maciej Chrabaszcz, Ewa Szczurek, Arkadiusz Sitek
papers.abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence has significantly advanced medical image segmentation. Nonetheless, challenges remain, including efficient 3D medical image processing across diverse modalities and handling data variability. In this work, we introduce Hierarchical Soft Mixture-of-Experts (HoME), a two-level token-routing layer for efficient long-context modeling, specifically designed for 3D medical image segmentation. Built on the Mamba Selective State Space Model (SSM) backbone, HoME enhances sequential modeling through adaptive expert routing. In the first level, a Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) layer partitions input sequences into local groups, routing tokens to specialized per-group experts for localized feature extraction. The second level aggregates these outputs through a global SMoE layer, enabling cross-group information fusion and global context refinement. This hierarchical design, combining local expert routing with global expert refinement, enhances generalizability and segmentation performance, surpassing state-of-the-art results across datasets from the three most widely used 3D medical imaging modalities and varying data qualities. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/gmum/MambaHoME.
papers.title_zh: Mamba Goes HoME: 3D 医学图像分割的高级软专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,人工智能已大大推进了医学图像分割,但挑战依然存在,包括以不同方式高效进行三维医学图像处理和处理数据变异。 在这项工作中,我们引入了高级软软专家混合(HOME),这是一个两级的象征性路由层,用于高效的长期模型模型,专门为3D医学图像分割设计。 在Mamba选择性国家空间模型(SSM)主干线上,HOME通过适应性专家路线加强顺序模型的建模。 在第一个层次上,Soft Mixture of-Experters(SMoE)层分隔层(SMoE)将输入序列输入到本地组中,为本地特征提取向专业的每个小组专家发送路标。 第二层通过全球SMoE层汇总这些产出,使跨组信息融合和全球背景完善成为可能。 这种分级设计将当地专家路线与全球专家改进相结合,提高了常识性和分解性能,超越了最广泛使用的三种3D医学成像模式和不同数据质量的成套数据的最新结果。 该守则可在https://github.com/gmum/MambaHOME上公开查阅。

papers.title: MACE: Mixture-of-Experts Accelerated Coordinate Encoding for Large-Scale Scene Localization and Rendering
papers.authors: Mingkai Liu, Dikai Fan, Haohua Que, Haojia Gao, Xiao Liu, Shuxue Peng, Meixia Lin, Shengyu Gu, Ruicong Ye, Wanli Qiu, Handong Yao, Ruopeng Zhang, Xianliang Huang
papers.abstract: Efficient localization and high-quality rendering in large-scale scenes remain a significant challenge due to the computational cost involved. While Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) methods perform well in small-scale localization, they are limited by the capacity of a single network when extended to large-scale scenes. To address these challenges, we propose the Mixed Expert-based Accelerated Coordinate Encoding method (MACE), which enables efficient localization and high-quality rendering in large-scale scenes. Inspired by the remarkable capabilities of MOE in large model domains, we introduce a gating network to implicitly classify and select sub-networks, ensuring that only a single sub-network is activated during each inference. Furtheremore, we present Auxiliary-Loss-Free Load Balancing(ALF-LB) strategy to enhance the localization accuracy on large-scale scene. Our framework provides a significant reduction in costs while maintaining higher precision, offering an efficient solution for large-scale scene applications. Additional experiments on the Cambridge test set demonstrate that our method achieves high-quality rendering results with merely 10 minutes of training.
papers.title_zh: MACE: 大型环境本地化和招标专家混合加速协调编码
papers.abstract_zh: 由于涉及计算成本,大规模现场的高效本地化和高质量化仍然是一个重大挑战。 虽然场景协调倒退方法在小规模本地化方面表现良好,但是在扩大到大规模场景时,由于单一网络的能力而受到限制。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用基于专家混合快速协调编码方法,以便能够在大规模场景中有效地本地化和高质量地传播。 受MoE在大型模型领域非凡能力的启发,我们引入了诱导网,对子网络进行隐性分类和选择,确保每个推论中只有一个子网络被激活。 此外,我们提出辅助性-无损-无负载平衡(ALF-LB)战略,以提高大规模现场的本地化精确度。 我们的框架大大降低了成本,同时保持了更高的精确度,为大规模现场应用提供了有效的解决方案。 在剑桥测试集上进行的额外实验表明,我们的方法只经过10分钟的培训,就能取得高质量的成果。

papers.title: M4: Multi-proxy multi-gate mixture of experts network for multiple instance learning in histopathology image analysis
papers.authors: Junyu Li, Ye Zhang, Wen Shu, Xiaobing Feng, Yingchun Wang, Pengju Yan, Xiaolin Li, Chulin Sha, Min He
papers.abstract: Multiple instance learning (MIL) has been successfully applied for whole slide images (WSIs) analysis in computational pathology, enabling a wide range of prediction tasks from tumor subtyping to inferring genetic mutations and multi-omics biomarkers. However, existing MIL methods predominantly focus on single-task learning, resulting in not only overall low efficiency but also the overlook of inter-task relatedness. To address these issues, we proposed an adapted architecture of Multi-gate Mixture-of-experts with Multi-proxy for Multiple instance learning (M4), and applied this framework for simultaneous prediction of multiple genetic mutations from WSIs. The proposed M4 model has two main innovations: (1) adopting a multi-gate mixture-of-experts strategy for multiple genetic mutation simultaneous prediction on a single WSI; (2) introducing a multi-proxy CNN construction on the expert and gate networks to effectively and efficiently capture patch-patch interactions from WSI. Our model achieved significant improvements across five tested TCGA datasets in comparison to current state-of-the-art single-task methods. The code is available at: https://github.com/Bigyehahaha/M4 . • Proposed M4 architecture to simultaneously predict multiple genetic mutations from WSIs. • Constructed an MMoE network with multi-proxy adaptation for MIL tasks. • Achieved notable improvements on five TCGA datasets over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: M4:多代理多端专家混合网络,在组织病理图象分析中进行多实例学习
papers.abstract_zh: 在计算病理学中的整个幻灯片图像分析中成功应用了多实例学习(MIL),使从肿瘤亚型到推导基因突变和多组生物标记等一系列广泛的预测任务成为可能。 然而,现有的MIL方法主要侧重于单一任务学习,不仅导致整体效率低下,而且忽视了任务之间相互关系。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议了一种适应性结构,即多功能专家混合与多实例学习多重代理专家(M4)相结合的结构,并运用这一框架同时预测来自西方国家倡议的多重基因突变。 拟议的M4模式有两个主要创新:(1) 采用多端专家混合战略,对单一的西西西西岛倡议进行多重基因突变同时预测;(2) 在专家和门网上采用多代用CNN结构,以便有效和高效地捕捉来自西西岛倡议的补缝互动。 与目前最先进的单一任务方法相比,我们的模型在五个测试过的TCGA数据集方面取得了显著改进,该代码可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/Bigyehahaha/M4。 • 建立了MOE网络,对MIL任务进行多种代用调整。

papers.title: Long-Tailed Distribution-Aware Router For Mixture-of-Experts in Large Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Chaoxiang Cai, Longrong Yang, Minghe Weng, Xuewei Li, Zequn Qin, Xi Li
papers.abstract: The mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture, which replaces dense networks with sparse ones, has attracted significant attention in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for achieving comparable performance while activating far fewer parameters. Existing MoE architectures for LVLMs primarily focus on token-to-expert routing (TER), encouraging different experts to specialize in processing specific tokens. However, these methods typically rely on the load balancing mechanism, neglecting the inherent distributional differences between vision and language modalities. To address this limitation, we propose the Long-Tailed Distribution-aware Router (LTDR) for vision-language TER, which tackles two key challenges: (1) Modality-specific distribution-aware routing. We observe that language TER generally follows a relatively uniform distribution, whereas vision TER exhibits a long-tailed distribution. This modality discrepancy motivates the design of specialized routing strategies for each modality. (2) Vision-specific dynamic expert activation. Recognizing the importance of high-information vision tail tokens, we introduce a data-augmentation-inspired strategy that increases the number of activated experts, ensuring sufficient learning for these rare but informative tokens. On vision-language and vision benchmarks, our approach achieves consistent improvements, boosting performance by 1.2% / 2.1% on vision-language and 1.6% on vision benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型中专家混合模型长期学习的分发器-软件路由器
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合结构以稀少的网络取代密集的网络,在大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)中引起了很大的注意,以取得可比较的性能,同时启用的参数要少得多。 现有LVLMS的现有MoE结构主要侧重于象征性到专家路线,鼓励不同专家专门处理特定标志。 然而,这些方法通常依赖负载平衡机制,忽视了视觉和语言模式之间固有的分配差异。 为解决这一限制,我们提议为视觉语言TER使用长途旅行配送识别路由器(LTDR),该路由器应对两个主要挑战:(1) 具体方式的配送识别路由。 我们注意到,语言毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/接触通常遵循相对统一的分布,而视觉毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/ 毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/接触/////接触/毒性/接触/接触/////////////////// / / /接触/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/毒性/接触/毒性/毒性/接触/毒性/接触/毒性/接触/毒性/接触/接触/毒性/ 毒性/接触/ 毒性/接触/接触/接触/接触/接触/接触/接触/接触/接触/毒性/接触/毒性/接触/毒性/毒性/接触/毒性/毒性/毒性/接触 我们认识到高信息视觉尾品的重要性,我们采用了一种数据增强型战略,增加活跃专家的人数,确保为这些稀有但信息丰富的象征性品充分学习。 在视觉语言和视觉基准方面,我们的方法取得了一致的改进,使视觉语言的业绩提高了1.2%/2.1%,视觉基准提高了1.6%。

papers.title: LiMoE: Mixture of LiDAR Representation Learners from Automotive Scenes
papers.authors: Xiang Xu, Lingdong Kong, Hui Shuai, Liang Pan, Ziwei Liu, Qingshan Liu
papers.abstract: LiDAR data pretraining offers a promising approach to leveraging large-scale, readily available datasets for enhanced data utilization. However, existing methods predominantly focus on sparse voxel representation, overlooking the complementary attributes provided by other LiDAR representations. In this work, we propose LiMoE, a framework that integrates the Mixture of Experts (MoE) paradigm into LiDAR data representation learning to synergistically combine multiple representations, such as range images, sparse voxels, and raw points. Our approach consists of three stages: i) Image-to-LiDAR Pretraining, which transfers prior knowledge from images to point clouds across different representations; ii) Contrastive Mixture Learning (CML), which uses MoE to adaptively activate relevant attributes from each representation and distills these mixed features into a unified 3D network; iii) Semantic Mixture Supervision (SMS), which combines semantic logits from multiple representations to boost downstream segmentation performance. Extensive experiments across eleven large-scale LiDAR datasets demonstrate our effectiveness and superiority. The code has been made publicly accessible.
papers.title_zh: LiMoE:LiDAR代表制学习者与汽车场景的混合
papers.abstract_zh: LIDAR数据预培训为利用大规模、现成的数据集加强数据利用提供了一个很有希望的方法,但是,现有方法主要侧重于稀疏的 voxel代表,忽略了LIDAR其他代表所提供的互补特征。 在这项工作中,我们提议使用LiMoE,这是一个将专家混合模式纳入LiDAR数据表述学习的框架,以便协同结合多种表达方式,如分布图象、稀疏的氧化物和原始点。 我们的方法包括三个阶段:(一) 图像到激光雷达预培训,将先前的知识从图像传到云层,跨越不同的表达形式;(二) 对比混合学习(CML),利用MoE从每个表达形式上适应性地激活相关属性,并将这些混合特征提炼成统一的3D网络;(三) 语义混合监督(SMS),将语义逻辑从多个表达形式上结合到促进下游分解性能。 横跨11个大型LiDAR数据集的广泛实验显示了我们的有效性和优越性,该代码已向公众开放。

papers.title: Lightweight Metadata-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Masked Autoencoder for Earth Observation
papers.authors: Mohanad Albughdadi
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Earth Observation have focused on large-scale foundation models. However, these models are computationally expensive, limiting their accessibility and reuse for downstream tasks. In this work, we investigate compact architectures as a practical pathway toward smaller general-purpose EO models. We propose a Metadata-aware Mixture-of-Experts Masked Autoencoder (MoE-MAE) with only 2.5M parameters. The model combines sparse expert routing with geo-temporal conditioning, incorporating imagery alongside latitude/longitude and seasonal/daily cyclic encodings. We pretrain the MoE-MAE on the BigEarthNet-Landsat dataset and evaluate embeddings from its frozen encoder using linear probes. Despite its small size, the model competes with much larger architectures, demonstrating that metadata-aware pretraining improves transfer and label efficiency. To further assess generalization, we evaluate on the EuroSAT-Landsat dataset, which lacks explicit metadata, and still observe competitive performance compared to models with hundreds of millions of parameters. These results suggest that compact, metadata-aware MoE-MAEs are an efficient and scalable step toward future EO foundation models.
papers.title_zh: 用于地球观测的轻量元元元元数据-软件元件-对地观测专家混合元数据
papers.abstract_zh: 地球观测最近的进展侧重于大型基础模型,然而,这些模型在计算上成本昂贵,限制了其可及性和再用于下游任务。 在这项工作中,我们调查了将紧凑结构作为通往小型一般用途 EO 模型的实用途径。 我们建议使用一个具有元数据意识的蒙面自动编码专家混合模型(MOE-MAE),该模型只有2.5M参数。 该模型将稀少的专家路线与地理时空调节结合起来,将图像与纬度/纬度和季节/日周期编码结合。 我们在大地球网Landsat数据集上预设了MoE-MAE,并利用线性探测器评估其冷冻编码器的嵌入。 尽管模型规模小,但它与大得多的架构竞争,这表明元数据识别前培训提高了传输和标签效率。 为了进一步评估一般化,我们评价欧洲卫星卫星Landsat数据集,该数据集缺乏明确的元数据,与具有数亿参数的模型相比,仍然有竞争力。 这些结果表明,具有元数据意识的紧凑的部-部-部-部-部是迈向未来EO基础模式的一个有效和可扩展的步骤。

papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tissues with Mixture of Experts for Gigapixel Whole Slide Images
papers.authors: Junxian Wu, Minheng Chen, Xinyi Ke, Tianwang Xun, Xiaoming Jiang, Hongyu Zhou, Lizhi Shao, Youyong Kong
papers.abstract: Analyzing gigapixel Whole Slide Images (WSIs) is challenging due to the complex pathological tissue environment and the absence of target-driven domain knowledge. Previous methods incorporated pathological priors to mitigate this issue but relied on additional inference steps and specialized workflows, restricting scalability and the model's capacity to identify novel outcome-related factors. To address these challenges, we propose a plug-and-play Pathology-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (PAMoE) module, which based on mixture of experts to learn pathology-related knowledge and extract useful information. We train the experts to become 'specialists' in specific intratumoral tissues by learning to route each tissue to its mapped expert. In addition, to reduce the impact of irrelevant content on the model, we introduce a new routing rule that discards patches in which none of the experts express interest, which helps the model better capture the relationships between relevant patches. Through a comprehensive evaluation of PAMoE on survival task, we demonstrate that 1) Our module enhances the performance of baseline models in most cases, and 2) The sparse expert processing across different tissues enhances the learning of patch representations by addressing tissue heterogeneity.
papers.title_zh: Gigappixel 整张幻灯片图像专家混合的学习异异基因组织
papers.abstract_zh: 由于复杂的病理组织环境以及缺乏目标驱动的域知识,分析千兆像素整片幻灯片图像具有挑战性。 以前的方法结合了病理学前科来缓解这一问题,但依赖额外的推论步骤和专门的工作流程,限制了可缩放性,限制了模型确定与结果有关的新因素的能力。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个插座和剧本病理学-知识专家混合(PAMoE)模块,该模块以专家混合为基础,学习病理学相关知识并提取有用的信息。 我们训练专家成为特定内脏组织的“专家”, 此外,为了减少不相关内容对模型的影响,我们引入了一条新的路由规则,即弃鱼补丁,没有任何专家对此感兴趣,这有助于模型更好地捕捉相关补丁之间的关系。 通过对PAMoE生存任务的全面评价,我们证明:(1) 我们的模块在多数情况下提高了基线模型的性能;(2) 不同组织之间处理的专家稀少,通过解决组织差异性,增强了对补丁表示的学习。

papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Mixture of Scene Experts for Large-scale Neural Radiance Fields
papers.authors: Zhenxing Mi, Ping Yin, Xue Xiao, Dan Xu
papers.abstract: Recent NeRF methods on large-scale scenes have underlined the importance of scene decomposition for scalable NeRFs. Although achieving reasonable scalability, there are several critical problems remaining unexplored, i.e., learnable decomposition, modeling scene heterogeneity, and modeling efficiency. In this paper, we introduce Switch-NeRF++, a Heterogeneous Mixture of Hash Experts (HMoHE) network that addresses these challenges within a unified framework. It is a highly scalable NeRF that learns heterogeneous decomposition and heterogeneous NeRFs efficiently for large-scale scenes in an end-to-end manner. In our framework, a gating network learns to decompose scenes and allocates 3D points to specialized NeRF experts. This gating network is co-optimized with the experts by our proposed Sparsely Gated Mixture of Experts (MoE) NeRF framework. We incorporate a hash-based gating network and distinct heterogeneous hash experts. The hash-based gating efficiently learns the decomposition of the large-scale scene. The distinct heterogeneous hash experts consist of hash grids of different resolution ranges, enabling effective learning of the heterogeneous representation of different scene parts. These design choices make our framework an end-to-end and highly scalable NeRF solution for real-world large-scale scene modeling to achieve both quality and efficiency. We evaluate our accuracy and scalability on existing large-scale NeRF datasets and a new dataset with very large-scale scenes ($>6.5km^2$) from UrbanBIS. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach can be easily scaled to various large-scale scenes and achieve state-of-the-art scene rendering accuracy. Furthermore, our method exhibits significant efficiency, with an 8x acceleration in training and a 16x acceleration in rendering compared to Switch-NeRF. Codes will be released at https://github.com/MiZhenxing/Switch-NeRF.
papers.title_zh: 大型神经辐射场的大型神经辐射场现场专家的异异质混合学习
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的NERF大规模场景方法凸显了场景分解对于可伸缩的NERF的重要性。 尽管实现了合理的伸缩性,但仍有几个关键问题尚未探索,即可以学习的分解、场景异质建模和建模效率。 在本文中,我们介绍“切换-NERF++”网络,这是一个在统一框架内应对这些挑战的散装专家异质混合网络(HMoHE),是一个高度可伸缩的内RF,它以端到端的方式有效地为大型场景学习各种分解和异质内RFs。 在我们的框架中,一个刺网学会分解场景,并将3D点分给专门的NeRF专家。这个刺网通过我们提议的粗糙的专家混合(MoE)NeRF框架与专家共同优化。 我们加入了一个基于散列的凝胶网络和独特的不同散列的散列专家。 散列的凝胶高效地了解了大规模场景的分解情况。 我们加入了一个基于散列的凝胶网络和不同的不同杂列的散列专家。 散列的凝胶高效地了解了大规模场景的分解情况。 不同的杂类散列专家由不同分辨率范围的散列网格组成,从而能够有效地了解不同场景部分的多元代表性。 这些设计选择使我们的框架成为最终到最终的高度可伸缩的NERF解决方案,用于实现质量和效率两方面的实实在在的大规模场景建模。 我们评估了现有大型NERF数据集的准确性和可扩缩性,并评估了一个新的数据集,该数据集拥有来自UrbanBIS的非常大型的场景(>6.5km2$),广泛的实验表明,我们的方法可以很容易地推广到各种大型场景,实现最先进的场景的准确性。 此外,我们的方法也显示出显著的效率,培训加速8x,与Switch-NERF相比加速16x。 代码将在https://github.com/MiZhenxing/Switch-NERF上公布。

papers.title: Interpretable Alzheimer's Diagnosis via Multimodal Fusion of Regional Brain Experts
papers.authors: Farica Zhuang, Shu Yang, Dinara Aliyeva, Zixuan Wen, Duy Duong-Tran, Christos Davatzikos, Tianlong Chen, Song Wang, Li Shen
papers.abstract: Accurate and early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (AD) is critical for effective intervention and requires integrating complementary information from multimodal neuroimaging data. However, conventional fusion approaches often rely on simple concatenation of features, which cannot adaptively balance the contributions of biomarkers such as amyloid PET and MRI across brain regions. In this work, we propose MREF-AD, a Multimodal Regional Expert Fusion model for AD diagnosis. It is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that models mesoscopic brain regions within each modality as independent experts and employs a gating network to learn subject-specific fusion weights. Utilizing tabular neuroimaging and demographic information from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), MREF-AD achieves competitive performance over strong classic and deep baselines while providing interpretable, modality- and region-level insight into how structural and molecular imaging jointly contribute to AD diagnosis.
papers.title_zh: 区域脑力专家通过多模式融合对可解释的阿尔茨海默氏病的诊断
papers.abstract_zh: 对阿尔茨海默氏病(AD)的准确和早期诊断对有效干预至关重要,需要综合多式神经成像数据提供的补充信息。 然而,传统的聚合方法往往依赖于简单的特征组合,无法适应性地平衡各个脑区域诸如氨基聚苯乙烯PET和MRI等生物标志的贡献。 在这项工作中,我们提议MREF-AD,一个用于自动诊断的多模式区域专家融合模型。 这是一个专家混合(MOE)框架,以独立专家的身份在每种模式内模拟中观脑区域,并使用格丁网学习特定主题的聚变重量。 利用来自阿尔茨海默氏病神经神经成像倡议(ADNI)的表格式神经成像和人口信息,MREF-AD在强大的传统和深层基线上取得了竞争性业绩,同时提供了可解释、模式和区域层面的深入了解,了解结构和分子成像如何共同促进自动成像诊断。

papers.title: HMVLM: Human Motion-Vision-Lanuage Model via MoE LoRA
papers.authors: Lei Hu, Yongjing Ye, Shihong Xia
papers.abstract: The expansion of instruction-tuning data has enabled foundation language models to exhibit improved instruction adherence and superior performance across diverse downstream tasks. Semantically-rich 3D human motion is being progressively integrated with these foundation models to enhance multimodal understanding and cross-modal generation capabilities. However, the modality gap between human motion and text raises unresolved concerns about catastrophic forgetting during this integration. In addition, developing autoregressive-compatible pose representations that preserve generalizability across heterogeneous downstream tasks remains a critical technical barrier. To address these issues, we propose the Human Motion-Vision-Language Model (HMVLM), a unified framework based on the Mixture of Expert Low-Rank Adaption(MoE LoRA) strategy. The framework leverages the gating network to dynamically allocate LoRA expert weights based on the input prompt, enabling synchronized fine-tuning of multiple tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting during instruction-tuning, we introduce a novel zero expert that preserves the pre-trained parameters for general linguistic tasks. For pose representation, we implement body-part-specific tokenization by partitioning the human body into different joint groups, enhancing the spatial resolution of the representation. Experiments show that our method effectively alleviates knowledge forgetting during instruction-tuning and achieves remarkable performance across diverse human motion downstream tasks.
papers.title_zh: HMVLM: 通过MoE的人类运动 -- -- 视觉 -- -- 游客模型
papers.abstract_zh: 教学调整数据的扩大使基础语言模型能够显示,在各种下游任务中,遵守教学要求的情况有所改善,业绩优异。 人类运动正在逐渐与这些基础模型相结合,以加强多式联运理解和跨模式生成能力,但是,人类运动与案文之间模式上的差距引起了对一体化期间灾难性遗忘的尚未解决的关切。 此外,发展自动递减和相容的表示方式,以维护各不同下游任务的通用性,这仍然是一个关键的技术障碍。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用人类运动-视觉-语言模型,这是以专家低射线适应混合(MoE LoRA)战略为基础的统一框架。 该框架利用引线网,根据快速投入动态分配 LoRA 专家权重,使多项任务能够同步调整。 为了减轻教学调整过程中的灾难性遗漏,我们引入了一位新的零专家,为一般语言任务保留预先培训的参数。 对于代表制,我们通过将人体分成不同的联合团体,加强代表制的空间分辨率,落实特定机构部分的象征性化。 实验表明,我们的方法有效地减轻了在教学调整过程中遗忘的知识,在人类运动的下游任务中取得了显著成绩。

papers.title: HAMoBE: Hierarchical and Adaptive Mixture of Biometric Experts for Video-based Person ReID
papers.authors: Yiyang Su, Yunping Shi, Feng Liu, Xiaoming Liu
papers.abstract: Recently, research interest in person re-identification (ReID) has increasingly focused on video-based scenarios, which are essential for robust surveillance and security in varied and dynamic environments. However, existing video-based ReID methods often overlook the necessity of identifying and selecting the most discriminative features from both videos in a query-gallery pair for effective matching. To address this issue, we propose a novel Hierarchical and Adaptive Mixture of Biometric Experts (HAMoBE) framework, which leverages multi-layer features from a pre-trained large model (e.g., CLIP) and is designed to mimic human perceptual mechanisms by independently modeling key biometric features--appearance, static body shape, and dynamic gait--and adaptively integrating them. Specifically, HAMoBE includes two levels: the first level extracts low-level features from multi-layer representations provided by the frozen large model, while the second level consists of specialized experts focusing on long-term, short-term, and temporal features. To ensure robust matching, we introduce a new dual-input decision gating network that dynamically adjusts the contributions of each expert based on their relevance to the input scenarios. Extensive evaluations on benchmarks like MEVID demonstrate that our approach yields significant performance improvements (e.g., +13.0% Rank-1 accuracy).
papers.title_zh: HAMoBE:视频人雷ID生物测定专家的等级和适应性混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,研究对人员再识别的兴趣日益集中在视频情景上,这些情景对于在不同和动态环境中进行强有力的监视和安全至关重要。 然而,现有的视频ReID方法往往忽略了从两个视频中找出和选择两个视频中最具歧视性的特征的必要性,以便有效匹配。 为解决这一问题,我们提议建立一个新的生物测定专家等级和适应性混合框架,利用预先培训的大型模型(如CLIP)的多层特征,并设计成通过独立模拟关键生物鉴别特征的出现、静态身体形状以及动态步态和适应性融合,模仿人类感知机制。 具体而言,HAMoBE包括两个层次:第一层从冻结的大模型提供的多层表现中提取低层次特征,而第二层则由专门专家组成,侧重于长期、短期和时间特征。 为确保强有力的匹配,我们引入一个新的双重投入决策网,根据每个专家对投入情景的关联性,积极调整每位专家的贡献。 对教育、VID等基准的广泛评价表明,我们的方法取得了显著的业绩改进(例如,+13.0%一级精确度)。

papers.title: Guiding the Experts: Semantic Priors for Efficient and Focused MoE Routing
papers.authors: Chengxi Min, Wei Wang, Yahui Liu, Weixin Ye, Enver Sangineto, Qi Wang, Yao Zhao
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as a promising direction for scaling vision architectures efficiently. Among them, Soft MoE improves training stability by assigning each token to all experts via continuous dispatch weights. However, current designs overlook the semantic structure which is implicitly encoded in these weights, resulting in suboptimal expert routing. In this paper, we discover that dispatch weights in Soft MoE inherently exhibit segmentation-like patterns but are not explicitly aligned with semantic regions. Motivated by this observation, we propose a foreground-guided enhancement strategy. Specifically, we introduce a spatially aware auxiliary loss that encourages expert activation to align with semantic foreground regions. To further reinforce this supervision, we integrate a lightweight LayerScale mechanism that improves information flow and stabilizes optimization in skip connections. Our method necessitates only minor architectural adjustments and can be seamlessly integrated into prevailing Soft MoE frameworks. Comprehensive experiments on ImageNet-1K and multiple smaller-scale classification benchmarks not only showcase consistent performance enhancements but also reveal more interpretable expert routing mechanisms.
papers.title_zh: 指导专家:高效和重点突出的MoE前言
papers.abstract_zh: 专家混合模式(MOE)已成为有效提升视觉架构的有希望的方向。 其中软化的MOE通过连续发送权重向全体专家分配每件象征物,改善了培训稳定性。 然而,目前的设计忽略了这些加权中隐含编码的语义结构,导致专家路线的偏差。 在本文中,我们发现软MoE的发送权重本身就呈现了相似的分解模式,但并不与语义区域明确一致。 基于这一观察,我们提出了一个地表引导增强战略。 具体地说,我们引入了一种具有空间意识的辅助损失,鼓励专家激活以配合语系地表区域。 为了进一步加强这一监督,我们整合了一种轻量级层机制,改善信息流动,稳定连接的优化。 我们的方法只需要稍作建筑调整,就可以顺利地融入当前的软体MoE框架。 关于图像Net-1K和多个小规模分类基准的全面实验不仅展示了一贯的绩效提高,而且还展示了更可解释的专家路线机制。

papers.title: Galaxy Walker: Geometry-aware VLMs For Galaxy-scale Understanding
papers.authors: Tianyu Chen, Xingcheng Fu, Yisen Gao, Haodong Qian, Yuecen Wei, Kun Yan, Haoyi Zhou, Jianxin Li
papers.abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) develop patch embedding and convolution backbone within vector space, especially Euclidean ones, at the very founding. When expanding VLMs to a galaxy-scale for understanding astronomical phenomena, the integration of spherical space for planetary orbits and hyperbolic spaces for black holes raises two formidable challenges. a) The current pre-training model is confined to Euclidean space rather than a comprehensive geometric embedding. b) The predominant architecture lacks suitable backbones for anisotropic physical geometries. In this paper, we introduced Galaxy-Walker, a geometry-aware VLM, for the universe-level vision understanding tasks. We proposed the geometry prompt that generates geometry tokens by random walks across diverse spaces on a multi-scale physical graph, along with a geometry adapter that compresses and reshapes the space anisotropy in a mixture-of-experts manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, with Galaxy-Walker achieving state-of-the-art performance in both galaxy property estimation (R2 scores up to 0.91) and morphology classification tasks (up to +0.17 F1 improvement in challenging features), significantly outperforming both domain-specific models and general-purpose VLMs.
papers.title_zh: Galaxy Walker: 用于银河系统系统理解的几何觉测甚低LMS
papers.abstract_zh: 现代视觉语言模型(VLMs)在矢量空间内,特别是欧几里德空间建立补丁嵌入和组合骨干。 当将VLMS扩大到一个银河系尺度以了解天文现象时,行星轨道球体空间和黑洞双曲空间的结合带来了两个巨大的挑战。 (a) 目前的培训前模式仅限于欧几里德空间,而不是全面的几何嵌入。 (b) 主要建筑缺乏适合厌异物理地形的骨干。 在这份文件中,我们介绍了银河-Walker,一个具有几何特征的VLM,用于宇宙层面的视觉理解任务。 我们建议了几何速率,通过在多尺度物理图解上随机穿越不同空间,产生几何符号,以及一个几何适配器,以专家混合的方式压缩和重塑空间的反向粒子。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法是有效的,银河-Walker在银河系财产估计(R2得分达0.91)和形态分类任务(在挑战性特点方面达到+0.17F1改进)两方面都取得了最先进的业绩,大大优于特定领域模型和通用甚低频LMS。

papers.title: Frequency-Domain Decomposition and Recomposition for Robust Audio-Visual Segmentation
papers.authors: Yunzhe Shen, Kai Peng, Leiye Liu, Wei Ji, Jingjing Li, Miao Zhang, Yongri Piao, Huchuan Lu
papers.abstract: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) plays a critical role in multimodal machine learning by effectively integrating audio and visual cues to precisely segment objects or regions within visual scenes. Recent AVS methods have demonstrated significant improvements. However, they overlook the inherent frequency-domain contradictions between audio and visual modalities--the pervasively interfering noise in audio high-frequency signals vs. the structurally rich details in visual high-frequency signals. Ignoring these differences can result in suboptimal performance. In this paper, we rethink the AVS task from a deeper perspective by reformulating AVS task as a frequency-domain decomposition and recomposition problem. To this end, we introduce a novel Frequency-Aware Audio-Visual Segmentation (FAVS) framework consisting of two key modules: Frequency-Domain Enhanced Decomposer (FDED) module and Synergistic Cross-Modal Consistency (SCMC) module. FDED module employs a residual-based iterative frequency decomposition to discriminate modality-specific semantics and structural features, and SCMC module leverages a mixture-of-experts architecture to reinforce semantic consistency and modality-specific feature preservation through dynamic expert routing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our FAVS framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on three benchmark datasets, and abundant qualitative visualizations further verify the effectiveness of the proposed FDED and SCMC modules. The code will be released as open source upon acceptance of the paper.
papers.title_zh: 强力视听分解的频率余下分解和再组合
papers.abstract_zh: 视听分解(AVS)在多式联运机器学习中发挥着关键作用,它有效地将视听提示与直观场景内的精确分解物体或区域结合起来,从而在多式机器学习中发挥着关键作用。 然而,它们忽略了视听模式之间固有的频率域自相矛盾----高频音频信号中普遍存在的干扰噪音与高频视觉信号中结构上丰富的细节。 忽视这些差异可能导致不理想的性能。 在本文中,我们从更深层次的角度重新思考反车辆地雷的任务,将反车辆地雷的任务改写为频率-磁场分解和再组合问题。 为此,我们推出一个新的频率-软件视听分离框架,由两个关键模块组成:频率-磁场增强分解器模块和协同跨模式协调模块。 FDED模块采用基于残余迭代频率分解法,以区别特定模式的语义和结构特征,SCMC模块利用专家混合结构,通过动态专家路线加强语义一致性和特定模式特征保护。 广泛的实验表明,我们的FAVS框架在三个基准数据集上取得了最先进的业绩,大量的定性可视化进一步核实了拟议的FDED和SCMC模块的有效性,一旦接受该文件,该代码将作为公开来源发布。

papers.title: Extracting Uncertainty Estimates from Mixtures of Experts for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Svetlana Pavlitska, Beyza Keskin, Alwin Faßbender, Christian Hubschneider, J. Marius Zöllner
papers.abstract: Estimating accurate and well-calibrated predictive uncertainty is important for enhancing the reliability of computer vision models, especially in safety-critical applications like traffic scene perception. While ensemble methods are commonly used to quantify uncertainty by combining multiple models, a mixture of experts (MoE) offers an efficient alternative by leveraging a gating network to dynamically weight expert predictions based on the input. Building on the promising use of MoEs for semantic segmentation in our previous works, we show that well-calibrated predictive uncertainty estimates can be extracted from MoEs without architectural modifications. We investigate three methods to extract predictive uncertainty estimates: predictive entropy, mutual information, and expert variance. We evaluate these methods for an MoE with two experts trained on a semantical split of the A2D2 dataset. Our results show that MoEs yield more reliable uncertainty estimates than ensembles in terms of conditional correctness metrics under out-of-distribution (OOD) data. Additionally, we evaluate routing uncertainty computed via gate entropy and find that simple gating mechanisms lead to better calibration of routing uncertainty estimates than more complex classwise gates. Finally, our experiments on the Cityscapes dataset suggest that increasing the number of experts can further enhance uncertainty calibration. Our code is available at https://github.com/KASTEL-MobilityLab/mixtures-of-experts/.
papers.title_zh: 语义分离专家混合体的不确定性估计
papers.abstract_zh: 估计准确和经充分校准的预测不确定性对于提高计算机视觉模型的可靠性十分重要,特别是在交通现场感知等安全关键应用中。 虽然通常采用混合方法,结合多种模型来量化不确定性,但专家混合(MoE)可提供一个有效的替代方法,即利用挂网网络来利用基于投入的动态加权专家预测。 在以往作品中,MoE有前途地利用MoE来进行语义分解,在此基础上,我们表明,在不进行建筑修改的情况下,可以从MoE提取经过适当校准的预测不确定性估计数。 我们调查了三种方法来提取预测不确定性的估计数:预测酶、相互信息和专家差异。 我们为MoE评估了这些方法,其中两名专家接受了有关A2D2数据集的语义分割的培训。 我们的结果表明,MoE得出的不确定性估计数比根据分配外数据在有条件的正确度度度指标方面得出的估计数更加可靠。 此外,我们评估了通过登机门加密计算出的路线不确定性,发现简单的格子机制比更复杂的门更能校准路线不确定性估计值。 最后,我们在城景数据集方面的实验表明,增加专家人数可以进一步加强不确定性的校准。我们的代码可在https://github.com/KASTEL-MocultiLab/mixtures-of-experts/上查阅。

papers.title: Exploring Sparse MoE in GANs for Text-conditioned Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Jiapeng Zhu, Ceyuan Yang, Kecheng Zheng, Yinghao Xu, Zifan Shi, Yifei Zhang, Qifeng Chen, Yujun Shen
papers.abstract: Due to the difficulty in scaling up, generative adversarial networks (GANs) seem to be falling out of grace with the task of text-conditioned image synthesis. Sparsely activated mixture-of-experts (MoE) has recently been demonstrated as a valid solution to training large-scale models with limited resources. Inspired by this, we present Aurora, a GAN-based text-to-image generator that employs a collection of experts to learn feature processing, together with a sparse router to adaptively select the most suitable expert for each feature point. We adopt a two-stage training strategy, which first learns a base model at 64x64 resolution followed by an upsampler to produce 512x512 images. Trained with only public data, our approach encouragingly closes the performance gap between GANs and industry-level diffusion models, maintaining a fast inference speed. We release the code and checkpoints href https://github.com/zhujiapeng/Aurora here to facilitate the community for further development.
papers.title_zh: 探索 GANs 中文本附加图像合成 GANs 的微缩 MoE
papers.abstract_zh: 由于在扩大规模方面的困难,基因对抗网络(GANs)似乎在以文字为条件的图像合成任务方面失之优雅。 最近证明,分散的活跃专家混合(MOE)是培训资源有限的大规模模型的有效解决办法。 受此启发,我们介绍Aurora, 这个以GAN为基础的文本到图像生成器, 使用一批专家学习特征处理, 以及一个稀少的路由器, 来适应地为每个特征点选择最合适的专家。 我们采取了两阶段培训战略,首先以64x64分辨率学习一个基础模型,然后是制作512x512图像的升级机。 我们只接受公共数据培训,我们的方法令人振奋地缩小了GANs和行业级扩散模型之间的性能差距,保持了快速推导速度。 我们在此发布守则和检查站条例, 以便利社区进一步发展。 https://github.com/zhujiapeng/Aurora。

papers.title: Efficient Data Driven Mixture-of-Expert Extraction from Trained Networks
papers.authors: Uranik Berisha, Jens Mehnert, Alexandru Paul Condurache
papers.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have emerged as the state-of-the-art models in various Computer Vision (CV) tasks, but their high computational and resource demands pose significant challenges. While Mixture of Experts (MoE) can make these models more efficient, they often require costly retraining or even training from scratch. Recent developments aim to reduce these computational costs by leveraging pretrained networks. These have been shown to produce sparse activation patterns in the Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) of the encoder blocks, allowing for conditional activation of only relevant subnetworks for each sample. Building on this idea, we propose a new method to construct MoE variants from pretrained models. Our approach extracts expert subnetworks from the model's MLP layers post-training in two phases. First, we cluster output activations to identify distinct activation patterns. In the second phase, we use these clusters to extract the corresponding subnetworks responsible for producing them. On ImageNet-1k recognition tasks, we demonstrate that these extracted experts can perform surprisingly well out of the box and require only minimal fine-tuning to regain 98% of the original performance, all while reducing FLOPs and model size, by up to 36% and 32% respectively.
papers.title_zh: 从经过培训的网络中提取数据
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉转换器(VITs)已成为各种计算机视觉(CV)任务中最先进的模型,但其高的计算和资源需求构成重大挑战。 虽然专家混合可以提高这些模型的效率,但往往需要花费昂贵的再培训甚至从零开始的培训。 最近的事态发展旨在通过利用预先培训的网络来降低这些计算成本。 事实证明,在编码器区块的多功能倍感器中,这些元件产生了稀疏的激活模式,允许为每个样本只有条件地激活相关的子网络。 基于这一想法,我们提出了一个新的方法,从预培训模型中构建MoE变量。 我们的方法分两个阶段从模型的 MLP 层培训后训练中提取专家子网络。 首先,我们分组产出启动以确定不同的激活模式。 在第二阶段,我们利用这些分组来提取相应的子网络来生产这些网络。 在图像Net-1k识别任务上,我们证明,这些被抽取的专家能够以出乎意料的方式出色地发挥出外表,只需要微小的微调才能恢复98%的原有业绩,同时将FLOPs和模型规模分别减少36%和32%。

papers.title: DM-Adapter: Domain-Aware Mixture-of-Adapters for Text-Based Person Retrieval
papers.authors: Yating Liu, Zimo Liu, Xiangyuan Lan, Wenming Yang, Yaowei Li, Qingmin Liao
papers.abstract: Text-based person retrieval (TPR) has gained significant attention as a fine-grained and challenging task that closely aligns with practical applications. Tailoring CLIP to person domain is now a emerging research topic due to the abundant knowledge of vision-language pretraining, but challenges still remain during fine-tuning: (i) Previous full-model fine-tuning in TPR is computationally expensive and prone to overfitting.(ii) Existing parameter-efficient transfer learning (PETL) for TPR lacks of fine-grained feature extraction. To address these issues, we propose Domain-Aware Mixture-of-Adapters (DM-Adapter), which unifies Mixture-of-Experts (MOE) and PETL to enhance fine-grained feature representations while maintaining efficiency. Specifically, Sparse Mixture-of-Adapters is designed in parallel to MLP layers in both vision and language branches, where different experts specialize in distinct aspects of person knowledge to handle features more finely. To promote the router to exploit domain information effectively and alleviate the routing imbalance, Domain-Aware Router is then developed by building a novel gating function and injecting learnable domain-aware prompts. Extensive experiments show that our DM-Adapter achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming previous methods by a significant margin.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: DM-Adapter: 用于基于文本的人检索的域名- Aware Mixture- Adapter 的域名- Aware Mixture- Adapter
papers.abstract_zh: 以文字为基础的人员检索(TPR)作为与实际应用密切相关的精细和具有挑战性的任务,已受到极大关注。 将CLIP专门适用于个人领域现在是一个新出现的研究专题,因为对视力语言预科培训有丰富的知识,但是在微调期间仍然存在挑战:(一) TRP以前的全模微调在计算上费用昂贵,容易过度适应。 (二) TRP的现有参数效率转让学习缺乏精细的特征提取。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议DM-Aware Mixture-Adapter(DM-Adapter)将专家Mixture(MOE)和PETL(PETL)统一起来,以便在保持效率的同时,加强精细地貌表现。 具体地说,在视觉和语言分支中,与MLP层平行设计了粗略的混合成像仪,不同的专家专门从事个人知识的不同方面,以便更精细地处理特征。 为促进路由器有效利用域域信息并减轻路由不平衡,然后通过建立新颖的招贴功能和注射可学习域觉提示来开发域-软件路由器。 广泛的实验表明,我们的DM-Adapter取得了最先进的业绩,大大优于以往的方法。

papers.title: Divide, Weight, and Route: Difficulty-Aware Optimization with Dynamic Expert Fusion for Long-tailed Recognition
papers.authors: Xiaolei Wei, Yi Ouyang, Haibo Ye
papers.abstract: Long-tailed visual recognition is challenging not only due to class imbalance but also because of varying classification difficulty across categories. Simply reweighting classes by frequency often overlooks those that are intrinsically hard to learn. To address this, we propose DQRoute, a modular framework that combines difficulty-aware optimization with dynamic expert collaboration. DQRoute first estimates class-wise difficulty based on prediction uncertainty and historical performance, and uses this signal to guide training with adaptive loss weighting. On the architectural side, DQRoute employs a mixture-of-experts design, where each expert specializes in a different region of the class distribution. At inference time, expert predictions are weighted by confidence scores derived from expert-specific OOD detectors, enabling input-adaptive routing without the need for a centralized router. All components are trained jointly in an end-to-end manner. Experiments on standard long-tailed benchmarks demonstrate that DQRoute significantly improves performance, particularly on rare and difficult classes, highlighting the benefit of integrating difficulty modeling with decentralized expert routing.
papers.title_zh: 分数、重量和路线:与长尾识别动态专家融合的难度-软件优化
papers.abstract_zh: 长期的目视识别不仅因为阶级不平衡,而且因为不同类别之间的分类困难也不同,因此具有挑战性。 简单地按频率重新加权的班级往往忽略了内在难以学习的班级。 为了解决这个问题,我们建议DQRoute(DQRoute),这是一个模块化框架,将难觉优化与动态专家协作相结合。 DQRoute首先根据预测不确定性和历史表现估算了等级方面的困难,并利用这个信号指导适应性损失加权培训。 在建筑方面,DQRoute采用专家混合设计,每名专家在班级分配的不同区域从事专业工作。 推论时间,专家预测按专家专用OOD探测器产生的信心分数加权,使输入适应路径无需中央路由器,所有组成部分都以端对端方式联合培训。 关于标准长距基准的实验表明,DQRoute大大提高了业绩,特别是在稀有和困难的班级,突出显示了将困难模式与分散的专家路线相结合的好处。

papers.title: dFLMoE: Decentralized Federated Learning via Mixture of Experts for Medical Data Analysis
papers.authors: Luyuan Xie, Tianyu Luan, Wenyuan Cai, Guochen Yan, Zhaoyu Chen, Nan Xi, Yuejian Fang, Qingni Shen, Zhonghai Wu, Junsong Yuan
papers.abstract: Federated learning has wide applications in the medical field. It enables knowledge sharing among different healthcare institutes while protecting patients' privacy. However, existing federated learning systems are typically centralized, requiring clients to upload client-specific knowledge to a central server for aggregation. This centralized approach would integrate the knowledge from each client into a centralized server, and the knowledge would be already undermined during the centralized integration before it reaches back to each client. Besides, the centralized approach also creates a dependency on the central server, which may affect training stability if the server malfunctions or connections are unstable. To address these issues, we propose a decentralized federated learning framework named dFLMoE. In our framework, clients directly exchange lightweight head models with each other. After exchanging, each client treats both local and received head models as individual experts, and utilizes a client-specific Mixture of Experts (MoE) approach to make collective decisions. This design not only reduces the knowledge damage with client-specific aggregations but also removes the dependency on the central server to enhance the robustness of the framework. We validate our framework on multiple medical tasks, demonstrating that our method evidently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches under both model homogeneity and heterogeneity settings.
papers.title_zh: dFLMoE:通过医疗数据分析专家混合方式分散的联邦学习
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习在医疗领域具有广泛的应用性,可以在不同保健机构之间分享知识,同时保护病人的隐私。 然而,现有的联邦学习系统通常是集中的,要求客户将客户特有的知识上传到中央服务器,以便汇总。 这种集中化办法将把每个客户的知识纳入一个集中化的服务器,在集中集成的过程中,知识在回到每个客户手中之前就会受到损害。 此外,中央化办法还造成对中央服务器的依赖,如果服务器故障或连接不稳定,可能会影响培训稳定性。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个名为 dFLMoE 的分散化联合学习框架。 在我们的框架中,客户直接互换轻量级头型。 互换后,每个客户将本地和接收的顶级头型视为个体专家,并使用客户特有的专家混合(MoE)方法做出集体决定。 这一设计不仅减少了特定客户群的知识损害,而且消除了对中央服务器的依赖,以加强框架的稳健性。 我们验证了我们关于多重医疗任务的框架,表明我们的方法显然优于在模型同质性和异质性环境中采用的最新方法。

papers.title: DeRS: Towards Extremely Efficient Upcycled Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.authors: Yongqi Huang, Peng Ye, Chenyu Huang, Jianjian Cao, Lin Zhang, Baopu Li, Gang Yu, Tao Chen
papers.abstract: Upcycled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have shown great potential in various tasks by converting the original Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers in pre-trained dense models into MoE layers. However, these models still suffer from significant parameter inefficiency due to the introduction of multiple experts. In this work, we propose a novel DeRS (Decompose, Replace, and Synthesis) paradigm to overcome this shortcoming, which is motivated by our observations about the unique redundancy mechanisms of upcycled MoE experts. Specifically, DeRS decomposes the experts into one expert-shared base weight and multiple expert-specific delta weights, and subsequently represents these delta weights in lightweight forms. Our proposed DeRS paradigm can be applied to enhance parameter efficiency in two different scenarios, including: 1) DeRS Compression for inference stage, using sparsification or quantization to compress vanilla upcycled MoE models; and 2) DeRS Upcycling for training stage, employing lightweight sparse or low-rank matrixes to efficiently upcycle dense models into MoE models. Extensive experiments across three different tasks show that the proposed methods can achieve extreme parameter efficiency while maintaining the performance for both training and compression of upcycled MoE models.
papers.title_zh: DeRS: 走向效率极高的循环混合型专家模型
papers.abstract_zh: 通过将培训前密集模型中的原始进餐前网络(FFN)层转换为MoE的层,循环型专家混合模型(MOE)在各种任务中显示出巨大的潜力,但是,由于引入了多位专家,这些模型仍然受到参数效率严重低下的影响。 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个新颖的DERS(标准、替换和综合)范式,以克服这一缺陷,其动因是我们对循环循环的MoE专家的独特冗余机制的看法。 具体地说,DeRS将专家分解成一个专家共享的基准加权数和多个专家特有三角洲加权数,随后以轻重形式代表这些三角洲加权数。 我们提议的DERS模式可用于在两种不同的假设情景中提高参数效率,包括:(1) 应用DeRS压缩推导阶段,利用电压或量化来压缩香草中循环的MOE模型;和(2) 利用轻量级的稀有或低级矩阵进行脱氧循环,以高效上循环密集模型进入MOE模型。 涉及三项不同任务的广泛实验表明,拟议方法可以实现极端参数效率,同时保持培训和压缩循环式MoE模型的性能。

papers.title: DeMo: Decoupled Feature-Based Mixture of Experts for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
papers.authors: Yuhao Wang, Yan Liu, Aihua Zheng, Pingping Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-modal object Re-IDentification (ReID) aims to retrieve specific objects by combining complementary information from multiple modalities. Existing multi-modal object ReID methods primarily focus on the fusion of heterogeneous features. However, they often overlook the dynamic quality changes in multi-modal imaging. In addition, the shared information between different modalities can weaken modality-specific information. To address these issues, we propose a novel feature learning framework called DeMo for multi-modal object ReID, which adaptively balances decoupled features using a mixture of experts. To be specific, we first deploy a Patch-Integrated Feature Extractor (PIFE) to extract multi-granularity and multi-modal features. Then, we introduce a Hierarchical Decoupling Module (HDM) to decouple multi-modal features into non-overlapping forms, preserving the modality uniqueness and increasing the feature diversity. Finally, we propose an Attention-Triggered Mixture of Experts (ATMoE), which replaces traditional gating with dynamic attention weights derived from decoupled features. With these modules, our DeMo can generate more robust multi-modal features. Extensive experiments on three object ReID benchmarks verify the effectiveness of our methods.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: Demo: 解码的多模式对象重新识别专家混合功能
papers.abstract_zh: 现有多式物体再识别(ReID)方法主要侧重于混杂特性的融合,目的是通过综合多种模式的补充信息,检索特定物体,现有的多式物体再识别(ReID)方法主要侧重于混杂特性的融合。 然而,它们往往忽视多模式成像质量的动态变化,此外,不同模式之间共享信息会削弱特定模式的信息。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议了一个名为“多模式物体ReID的DeMo”的新特色学习框架,它通过专家混合,在适应性上平衡了被分离的特征。 具体地说,我们首先部署一个补丁集成综合特征提取器(PIFE)来提取多形式和多模式的特征。 然后,我们推出一个等级解耦模块(HDM),将多模式特征分离为非重叠形式,保持模式的独特性,增加特征多样性。 最后,我们建议采用“关注式专家混合组合 ” ( ATMOE ) , 取代传统的“关注式混合 ” ( ATMOE ) , 代之以由解耦特征产生的动态关注权重。 有了这些模块,我们的“DeMo”就能产生更强大的多模式特征。 在三个物体ReID基准上进行广泛试验,以核实我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: CorrMoE: Mixture of Experts with De-stylization Learning for Cross-Scene and Cross-Domain Correspondence Pruning
papers.authors: Peiwen Xia, Tangfei Liao, Wei Zhu, Danhuai Zhao, Jianjun Ke, Kaihao Zhang, Tong Lu, Tao Wang
papers.abstract: Establishing reliable correspondences between image pairs is a fundamental task in computer vision, underpinning applications such as 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Although recent methods have made progress in pruning outliers from dense correspondence sets, they often hypothesize consistent visual domains and overlook the challenges posed by diverse scene structures. In this paper, we propose CorrMoE, a novel correspondence pruning framework that enhances robustness under cross-domain and cross-scene variations. To address domain shift, we introduce a De-stylization Dual Branch, performing style mixing on both implicit and explicit graph features to mitigate the adverse influence of domain-specific representations. For scene diversity, we design a Bi-Fusion Mixture of Experts module that adaptively integrates multi-perspective features through linear-complexity attention and dynamic expert routing. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CorrMoE achieves superior accuracy and generalization compared to state-of-the-art methods. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/peiwenxia/CorrMoE.
papers.title_zh: CorrMoE: 将专家与非晶化学习混合起来,促进跨气候和跨域通信的保密
papers.abstract_zh: 在图像配对之间建立可靠的对应关系是计算机视觉的基本任务,是3D重建和视觉定位等应用的基础。 虽然最近的一些方法在从密集的通信机组中排出外部线方面取得了进展,但它们往往假设了一致的视觉领域,忽视了不同场景结构构成的挑战。 在本文中,我们提议CorrMoE,这是一个新的通信支线框架,在跨领域和跨犯罪现场变化下加强稳健性。 为解决领域转移问题,我们引入了非标准化双重部门,在隐含和清晰的图形特征上进行风格混合,以减轻具体领域表述的不利影响。 对于现场多样性,我们设计一个双功能专家混合模块,通过线性复杂关注和动态专家路线,适应性地结合多视角特征。 关于基准数据集的广泛实验表明,CorrMoE与最新方法相比,实现了更高的准确性和概括性,代码和预先培训的模型可在https://github.com/peiwenxia/CorrMoE上查阅。

papers.title: Correlative and Discriminative Label Grouping for Multi-Label Visual Prompt Tuning
papers.authors: Lei-Lei Ma, Shuo Xu, Ming-Kun Xie, Lei Wang, Dengdi Sun, Haifeng Zhao
papers.abstract: Modeling label correlations has always played a pivotal role in multi-label image classification (MLC), attracting significant attention from researchers. However, recent studies have overemphasized co-occurrence relationships among labels, which can lead to overfitting risk on this overemphasis, resulting in suboptimal models. To tackle this problem, we advocate for balancing correlative and discriminative relationships among labels to mitigate the risk of overfitting and enhance model performance. To this end, we propose the Multi-Label Visual Prompt Tuning framework, a novel and parameter-efficient method that groups classes into multiple class subsets according to label co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity relationships, and then models them respectively to balance the two relationships. In this work, since each group contains multiple classes, multiple prompt tokens are adopted within Vision Transformer (ViT) to capture the correlation or discriminative label relationship within each group, and effectively learn correlation or discriminative representations for class subsets. On the other hand, each group contains multiple group-aware visual representations that may correspond to multiple classes, and the mixture of experts (MoE) model can cleverly assign them from the group-aware to the label-aware, adaptively obtaining label-aware representation, which is more conducive to classification. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that our proposed approach achieves competitive results and outperforms SOTA methods on multiple pre-trained models.
papers.title_zh: 多标签视觉快速导图的关联性和区别性标签分组
papers.abstract_zh: 在多标签图像分类(MLC)中,建模标签关联始终发挥着关键作用,吸引了研究人员的极大关注。 然而,最近的研究过分强调标签之间相互关系的共生关系,这可能导致过度强调这种过分强调的风险,导致模型不尽人意。 为了解决这一问题,我们主张平衡标签之间的相关和歧视性关系,以减少过度装配的风险,提高示范性业绩。 为此,我们提议多标签视觉快速提款框架,这是一种创新的、有参数效率的方法,根据标签的共发和相互排他性关系,将分类成多类子集,然后分别进行模拟,以平衡这两种关系。 在这项工作中,由于每个群体包含多个类别,在Vision Transformer(VIT)中采用多个快速标志,以捕捉每个群体内部的关联性或歧视性标签关系,并有效地学习对类别子集的关联性或歧视性表述。 另一方面,每一组包含多个群体了解的直观表述,可能与多个类别相对应,专家混合模型可以巧妙地将他们从群体了解中划归标签了解组织,在适应性上获得更有利于分类的标签了解组织。 对多个基准数据集的实验表明,我们提议的方法取得了竞争性成果,在多个预先培训的模型上优于SOTA方法。

papers.title: Complexity Experts are Task-Discriminative Learners for Any Image Restoration
papers.authors: Eduard Zamfir, Zongwei Wu, Nancy Mehta, Yuedong Tan, Danda Pani Paudel, Yulun Zhang, Radu Timofte
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in all-in-one image restoration models have revolutionized the ability to address diverse degradations through a unified framework. However, parameters tied to specific tasks often remain inactive for other tasks, making mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures a natural extension. Despite this, MoEs often show inconsistent behavior, with some experts unexpectedly generalizing across tasks while others struggle within their intended scope. This hinders leveraging MoEs' computational benefits by bypassing irrelevant experts during inference.We attribute this undesired behavior to the uniform and rigid architecture of traditional MoEs. To address this, we introduce "complexity experts" -- flexible expert blocks with varying computational complexity and receptive fields. A key challenge is assigning tasks to each expert, as degradation complexity is unknown in advance. Thus, we execute tasks with a simple bias toward lower complexity.To our surprise, this preference effectively drives task-specific allocation, assigning tasks to experts with the appropriate complexity. Extensive experiments validate our approach, demonstrating the ability to bypass irrelevant experts during inference while maintaining superior performance. The proposed MoCE-IR model outperforms state-of-the-art methods, affirming its efficiency and practical applicability. The source code and models are publicly available at href https://eduardzamfir.github.io/moceir/ texttt eduardzamfir.github.io/MoCE-IR/
papers.title_zh: 复杂度专家是任何图像恢复任务与差异性学习者
papers.abstract_zh: 最近所有一成不变图像恢复模型的进展使通过统一框架解决各种退化问题的能力发生了革命性的变化,然而,与具体任务相关的参数往往仍然不用于其他任务,使专家混合结构成为自然延伸。 尽管如此,MoE往往表现出不一致的行为,有些专家出乎意料地泛泛阐述了各项任务,而另一些专家则在其预定范围内挣扎。 这阻碍了MoE通过在推论期间绕过不相关的专家来利用计算效益。 我们将此不可取的行为归咎于传统MoE的统一和僵硬结构。 为此,我们引入了“复杂专家”这个灵活的专家小组,它们具有不同的计算复杂性和可接受领域。 一项关键的挑战就是为每位专家分配任务,因为退化的复杂性事先不为人所知。 因此,我们执行的任务简单倾向于降低复杂性。令我们惊讶的是,这种偏好有效地推动了具体任务的分配,将任务分配给了具有适当复杂性的专家。 广泛的实验验证了我们的方法,表明在推断过程中能够绕过无关专家,同时保持优异性能。 拟议的中、中、英、法、法模型优于最先进的方法,证明了其效率和实用性。 源代码和模型可在以下网站查阅:https://eduardzamfir.github.io/moceir/textt eduardzamfir.github.io/MoCE-IR/

papers.title: CNC: Cross-modal Normality Constraint for Unsupervised Multi-class Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Xiaolei Wang, Xiaoyang Wang, Huihui Bai, Eng Gee Lim, Jimin Xiao
papers.abstract: Existing unsupervised distillation-based methods rely on the differences between encoded and decoded features to locate abnormal regions in test images. However, the decoder trained only on normal samples still reconstructs abnormal patch features well, degrading performance. This issue is particularly pronounced in unsupervised multi-class anomaly detection tasks. We attribute this behavior to ‘over-generalization’ (OG) of decoder: the significantly increasing diversity of patch patterns in multi-class training enhances the model generalization on normal patches, but also inadvertently broadens its generalization to abnormal patches. To mitigate ‘OG’, we propose a novel approach that leverages class-agnostic learnable prompts to capture common textual normality across various visual patterns, and then apply them to guide the decoded features towards a ‘normal’ textual representation, suppressing ‘over-generalization’ of the decoder on abnormal patterns. To further improve performance, we also introduce a gated mixture-of-experts module to specialize in handling diverse patch patterns and reduce mutual interference between them in multi-class training. Our method achieves competitive performance on the MVTec AD and VisA datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: CNC: 不受监督的多类异常检测的跨模式常态约束
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的未经监督的蒸馏法依赖于编码和解码特性之间的差别,以在测试图像中定位异常区域,然而,仅接受正常样本培训的解码器仍然对异常补丁特性进行良好的重建,降低性能。 这一问题在无人监督的多级异常探测任务中尤为突出。 我们将此行为归结为解码器的“超一般化 ” ( OG) : 多级培训中的补丁模式差异性显著增加, 加强了普通补丁模式的典型化, 但也无意中将其扩大为异常补丁。 为了减少“OG”,我们提出一种新的办法,利用阶级、不可知的学习灵敏来捕捉各种视觉模式的共同文本常态,然后运用这些新办法引导解码特征形成“正常”的文本代表,抑制解码者对异常模式的“超一般化”。 为了进一步提高绩效,我们还引入了一个门锁式专家混合模块,专门处理不同的补丁模式,并减少他们在多级培训中的相互干扰。 我们的方法在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上取得了竞争性业绩,证明了其有效性。

papers.title: CL-MoE: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Model with Dual Momentum Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Tianyu Huai, Jie Zhou, Xingjiao Wu, Qin Chen, Qingchun Bai, Ze Zhou, Liang He
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have garnered widespread attention from researchers due to their remarkable understanding and generation capabilities in visual language tasks (e.g., visual question answering). However, the rapid pace of knowledge updates in the real world makes offline training of MLLMs costly, and when faced with non-stationary data streams, MLLMs suffer from catastrophic forgetting during learning. In this paper, we propose an MLLMs-based dual momentum Mixture-of-Experts ( texttt CL-MoE ) framework for continual visual question answering. We integrate MLLMs with continual learning to utilize the rich commonsense knowledge in LLMs.We introduce a Dual-Router MoE (RMoE) to select the global and local experts using task-level and instance-level routers, to robustly assign weights to the experts most appropriate for the task. Then, we design a dynamic Momentum MoE (MMoE) to update the parameters of experts dynamically based on the relationships between the experts and tasks, so that the model can absorb new knowledge while maintaining existing knowledge. The extensive experimental results indicate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on 10 VQA tasks, proving the effectiveness of our approach. The codes and weights will be released on GitHub.
papers.title_zh: CL-MoE:加强具有持续视觉问题解答双重动力专家混合的多式大语言模式
papers.abstract_zh: 多式大型语言模式(MLLM)由于在视觉语言任务(如视觉问答)方面有着非凡的理解和生成能力,引起了研究人员的广泛关注。 然而,在现实世界中,知识更新的快速步伐使得MLLM的离线培训费用昂贵,当面临非静止数据流时,MLLMs在学习过程中遭受灾难性的遗忘。 在本文中,我们提出一个基于MLLMs的双动力双动力专家混合(Texttt CL-MoE)框架,用于持续直观回答问题。 我们采用双路移动式移动器(RMoE),利用任务级别和实例级别路由器选择全球和地方专家,并大力为最适合这项任务的专家分配权重。 然后,我们设计一个动态动力momentum MoE(MMOE),根据专家与任务之间的关系动态更新专家参数,以便模型吸收新知识,同时保持现有知识。 广泛的实验结果表明,我们的方法在10项VQA任务上取得了最先进的业绩,证明了我们的方法的有效性。 代码和重量将在GitHub上公布。

papers.title: Bridging the Scale Gap: Balanced Tiny and General Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.authors: Zhicheng Zhao, Yin Huang, Lingma Sun, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang
papers.abstract: Tiny object detection in remote sensing imagery has attracted significant research interest in recent years. Despite recent progress, achieving balanced detection performance across diverse object scales remains a formidable challenge, particularly in scenarios where dense tiny objects and large objects coexist. Although large foundation models have revolutionized general vision tasks, their application to tiny object detection remains unexplored due to the extreme scale variation and density distribution inherent to remote sensing imagery. To bridge this scale gap, we propose ScaleBridge-Det, to the best of our knowledge, the first large detection framework designed for tiny objects, which could achieve balanced performance across diverse scales through scale-adaptive expert routing and density-guided query allocation. Specifically, we introduce a Routing-Enhanced Mixture Attention (REM) module that dynamically selects and fuses scale-specific expert features via adaptive routing to address the tendency of standard MoE models to favor dominant scales. REM generates complementary and discriminative multi-scale representations suitable for both tiny and large objects. Furthermore, we present a Density-Guided Dynamic Query (DGQ) module that predicts object density to adaptively adjust query positions and numbers, enabling efficient resource allocation for objects of varying scales. The proposed framework allows ScaleBridge-Det to simultaneously optimize performance for both dense tiny and general objects without trade-offs. Extensive experiments on benchmark and cross-domain datasets demonstrate that ScaleBridge-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance on AI-TOD-V2 and DTOD, while exhibiting superior cross-domain robustness on VisDrone.
papers.title_zh: 缩小规模差距:遥感图像中的平衡微小和一般物体探测
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,遥感图像中的微小物体探测吸引了相当大研究兴趣,尽管最近取得了进展,但在不同天体尺度上实现平衡的探测性能仍然是一项艰巨的挑战,特别是在密度小的物体和大型物体共存的情况下。 虽然大型基础模型使一般的视野任务发生了革命性变化,但由于遥感图像本身具有巨大的规模变化和密度分布,这些模型在小型物体探测中的应用仍未得到探索。 为了缩小这一规模差距,我们根据我们的知识,提议建立第一个针对小物体的大型探测框架,通过采用比例尺的专家路线安排和密度引导Query分配,可以实现不同规模的均衡性能。 具体地说,我们引入了REM(REM)模块,该模块通过适应性路线,动态地选择和引信特定规模的专家特征,以应对MoE标准模式倾向于主导规模的趋势。 REM产生适合于小物体和大型物体的互补和歧视性的多尺度表象。 此外,我们还推出一个“密度引导动态Query”模块,该模块预测物体密度,以适应性调整Query位置和数字,为不同规模的物体高效分配资源。 拟议框架使SclimateBridge-Det能够同时优化密集小物体和一般物体的性能,而不取舍。 关于基准和跨域数据集的广泛实验表明,ScaleBridge-Det在AI-TOD-V2和DTOD上取得了最先进的性能,同时在VisDrone上展示了超强的跨域性强。

papers.title: Attentive Large Kernel Network With Mixture of Experts for Video Deblurring
papers.authors: Chaopeng Zhang, Ruiqin Xiong, Xiaopeng Fan, Debin Zhao
papers.abstract: Video deblurring is a fundamental problem in low-level vision, and many methods have employed designs based on CNNs and transformers. Traditional CNNs often require deeper architectures to achieve a larger receptive field, which may not be optimal for spatially non-uniform blurs and intense motion blurs. While transformers offer a large receptive field, their quadratic complexity due to attention designs typically imposes a significant computational burden. In addressing these issues, we present an Attentive Large Kernel Network with Mixture of Experts (ALK-MoE). In ALK-MoE, an attentive large kernel backbone network is proposed. On one hand, it inherently extends the network’s receptive field through its large kernel design. On the other hand, it addresses the quadratic complexity of attention by employing a sophisticated attention design, thus maintaining its ability to capture long-range dependencies. Furthermore, to achieve more precise and robust alignment of inter-frame features using optical flow for better utilization of clear frames, a mixture of experts model is proposed. It involves integrating optical flow updates between different experts in a residual manner. Our ablation experiments and experiments on multiple datasets indicate that ALK-MoE achieves comparable or superior performance compared to Transformer-based methods, with lower complexity.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
papers.title_zh: 带视频稀释专家混合的高级大型核心网络
papers.abstract_zh: 视频破碎是低水平视野的根本问题,许多方法都采用了基于CNN和变压器的设计。 传统CNN往往需要更深层次的架构来实现更大的开放场,这也许不是空间上非统一模糊和强烈运动模糊的最佳方式。 虽然变压器提供了大面积的可容纳场,但由于注意设计,变压器的二次复杂程度通常带来巨大的计算负担。 在解决这些问题时,我们提出了一个由专家混合体组成的快速大中枢网络(ALK-MoE ) 。 在ALK-MoE中,提出了一个关注的大型内核主干网。 一方面,它通过大型内核设计,内在地扩展了网络的可接受领域。 另一方面,它通过采用复杂的关注设计来解决关注的四重复杂问题,从而保持其捕捉长期依赖性的能力。 此外,为了利用光学流动来更好地利用清晰框架,更精确和有力地调整各框架的功能,建议采用专家混合模式,包括以剩余方式将不同专家之间的光学流动最新信息综合起来。 我们在多个数据集上进行的模拟实验和实验表明,ALK-MoE的性能与以变形器为基础的方法相比,具有可比或优异的性能,复杂性较低。

papers.title: A Novel Trustworthy Video Summarization Algorithm Through a Mixture of LoRA Experts
papers.authors: Wenzhuo Du, Gerun Wang, Xin Li, Guancheng Chen, Jian Gao, Hang Zhao
papers.abstract: With the exponential growth of user-generated content on video-sharing platforms, the challenge of facilitating efficient searching and browsing of videos has garnered significant attention. To enhance users’ ability to swiftly locate and review pertinent videos, the creation of concise and informative video summaries has become increasingly important. Video-llama is an effective tool for generating video summarization, but it cannot effectively unify and optimize the modeling of temporal and spatial features and requires a lot of computational resources and time. Therefore, we propose MiLoRA-ViSum to more efficiently capture complex temporal dynamics and spatial relationships inherent in video data and to control the number of parameters for training. By extending traditional Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into a sophisticated mixture-of-experts paradigm, MiLoRA-ViSum incorporates a dual temporal–spatial adaptation mechanism tailored specifically for video summarization tasks. This approach dynamically integrates specialized LoRA experts, each fine-tuned to address distinct temporal or spatial dimensions. Extensive evaluations of the VideoXum and ActivityNet datasets demonstrate that MiLoRA-ViSum achieves the best summarization performance compared to state-of-the-art models, while maintaining significantly lower computational costs. The proposed mixture-of-experts strategy, combined with the dual adaptation mechanism, highlights the model’s potential to enhance video summarization capabilities, particularly in large-scale applications requiring both efficiency and precision.
papers.title_zh: 通过LORA专家混合体,新颖、可信赖的视频视频总结算法
papers.abstract_zh: 随着视频共享平台上用户生成的内容成倍增长,促进有效搜索和浏览视频的挑战引起了人们的极大关注。 为提高用户迅速找到和审查相关视频的能力,制作简明、内容翔实的视频摘要已变得日益重要。 录像带是制作录像摘要的有效工具,但不能有效地统一和优化时间和空间特征的模型,需要大量计算资源和时间。 因此,我们建议米洛拉-维苏姆更有效地捕捉视频数据所固有的复杂的时间动态和空间关系,并控制培训参数的数量。 MiLORA-ViSum将传统的低射线适应(LORA)扩展为复杂的专家混合模式,纳入了一个专门针对视频总结任务的双重时间空间适应机制。 这种方法积极融合了洛拉地区专业专家,每个专家都经过细微调整,以处理不同的时间或空间层面。 对录象Xum和活动网数据集的广泛评价表明,MiLora-ViSum与最先进的模型相比,取得了最佳的总结性能,同时保持了显著较低的计算成本。 拟议的专家混合战略,加上双重适应机制,突显了该模型在加强视频总结能力方面的潜力,特别是在需要效率和精确性的大规模应用方面。

papers.title: XAG-Net: A Cross-Slice Attention and Skip Gating Network for 2.5D Femur MRI Segmentation
papers.authors: Byunghyun Ko, Anning Tian, Jeongkyu Lee
papers.abstract: Accurate segmentation of femur structures from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is critical for orthopedic diagnosis and surgical planning but remains challenging due to the limitations of existing 2D and 3D deep learning-based segmentation approaches. In this study, we propose XAG-Net, a novel 2.5D U-Net-based architecture that incorporates pixel-wise cross-slice attention (CSA) and skip attention gating (AG) mechanisms to enhance inter-slice contextual modeling and intra-slice feature refinement. Unlike previous CSA-based models, XAG-Net applies pixel-wise softmax attention across adjacent slices at each spatial location for fine-grained inter-slice modeling. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that XAG-Net surpasses baseline 2D, 2.5D, and 3D U-Net models in femur segmentation accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency. Ablation studies further validate the critical role of the CSA and AG modules, establishing XAG-Net as a promising framework for efficient and accurate femur MRI segmentation.
papers.title_zh: XAG-Net: 2.5D Femur MRI分离的交叉切分注意和跳过导航网络
papers.abstract_zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)的股骨结构的准确分解对整形诊断和外科手术规划至关重要,但由于现有的2D和3D深层基于学习的分解方法的局限性,仍然具有挑战性。 在此研究中,我们提议建立XAG-Net,这是一个新型的2.5D U-Net型结构,它包含像素交叉切除关注(CSA),并跳过关注(AG)机制,以加强切除间背景建模和切除内特征的完善。 与以前以加空局为基础的模型不同的是,XAG-Net在每个空间位置的相邻切片上应用像素智软峰值注意度,进行细微的切除间建模。 广泛的评价表明,XAG-Net在保持计算效率的同时,在骨折精度方面超过了基线2D、2.5D和3D U-Net模型。 模拟研究进一步验证了加空局和AG模块的关键作用,建立了XAG-Net,作为高效和准确进行磁共振分解的有希望的框架。

papers.title: VL-GenRM: Enhancing Vision-Language Verification via Vision Experts and Iterative Training
papers.authors: Jipeng Zhang, Kehao Miao, Renjie Pi, Zhaowei Wang, Runtao Liu, Rui Pan, Tong Zhang
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) with verifiable rewards has advanced large language models but remains underexplored for Vision-Language (VL) models. The Vision-Language Reward Model (VL-RM) is key to aligning VL models by providing structured feedback, yet training effective VL-RMs faces two major challenges. First, the bootstrapping dilemma arises as high-quality training data depends on already strong VL models, creating a cycle where self-generated supervision reinforces existing biases. Second, modality bias and negative example amplification occur when VL models hallucinate incorrect visual attributes, leading to flawed preference data that further misguides training. To address these issues, we propose an iterative training framework leveraging vision experts, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales, and Margin-based Rejection Sampling. Our approach refines preference datasets, enhances structured critiques, and iteratively improves reasoning. Experiments across VL-RM benchmarks demonstrate superior performance in hallucination detection and multimodal reasoning, advancing VL model alignment with reinforcement learning.
papers.title_zh: VL-GenRM:通过视觉专家和迭接培训加强视觉-语言核查
papers.abstract_zh: 具有可核查回报的强化精炼计划(RFT)已经推进了大型语言模式,但对于视觉语言模式(VL)的探索仍然不足。 视觉语言奖励模式(VL-RM)通过提供结构化反馈,是调整 VL模式的关键,但有效的 VL-RM培训面临两大挑战。 首先,由于高质量的培训数据依赖于已经十分强大的VL模式,从而形成了自我监督强化现有偏见的循环。 第二,当VL模型产生幻觉,产生不正确的视觉特征时,模式偏差和负面实例放大,导致偏好数据有缺陷,进一步误导了培训。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个利用视觉专家、思考链原理和边际拒绝抽样的迭代培训框架。 我们的方法完善了偏好数据集,强化了结构化批评,并反复改进推理。 贯穿VL-RM基准的实验表明,幻觉检测和多式联运推理表现优异,推动VL模式与强化学习保持一致。

papers.title: VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model For 3D Medical Imaging
papers.authors: Yufan He, Pengfei Guo, Yucheng Tang, Andriy Myronenko, Vishwesh Nath, Ziyue Xu, Dong Yang, Can Zhao, Benjamin Simon, Mason Belue, Stephanie Harmon, Baris Turkbey, Daguang Xu, Wenqi Li
papers.abstract: Foundation models for interactive segmentation in 2D natural images and videos have sparked significant interest in building 3D foundation models for medical imaging. However, the domain gaps and clinical use cases for 3D medical imaging require a dedicated model that diverges from existing 2D solutions. Specifically, such foundation models should support a full workflow that can actually reduce human effort. Treating 3D medical images as sequences of 2D slices and reusing interactive 2D foundation models seems straightforward, but 2D annotation is too time-consuming for 3D tasks. Moreover, for large cohort analysis, it's the highly accurate automatic segmentation models that reduce the most human effort. However, these models lack support for interactive corrections and lack zero-shot ability for novel structures, which is a key feature of "foundation". While reusing pre-trained 2D backbones in 3D enhances zero-shot potential, their performance on complex 3D structures still lags behind leading 3D models. To address these issues, we present VISTA3D, Versatile Imaging SegmenTation and Annotation model, that targets to solve all thesechallenges and requirements with one unified foundation model. VISTA3D is built on top of the well-established 3D segmentation pipeline, and it is the first model to achieve state-of-the-art performance in both 3D automatic (supporting 127 classes) and 3D interactive segmentation, even when compared with top 3D expert models on large and diverse benchmarks. Additionally, VISTA3D's 3D interactive design allows efficient human correction, and a novel 3D supervoxel method that distills 2D pretrained backbones grants VISTA3D top 3D zero-shot performance. We believe the model, recipe, and insights represent a promising step toward a clinically useful 3D foundation model. Code and weights are publicly available at https://github.com/Project-MONAI/VISTA
papers.title_zh: VISTA3D: 3D医学成像统一分类基金会模型
papers.abstract_zh: 2D自然图像和视频互动分离基础模型引起了对建立3D医学成像基础模型的极大兴趣,然而,3D医学成像领域差距和临床使用案例需要不同于现有2D解决方案的专门模型。 具体地说,这种基础模型应该支持一个能够实际减少人类劳动的全面工作流程。 将3D医疗图像作为2D切片的序列处理,并重复使用互动的 2D 基础模型似乎直截了当,但2D 注释对于 3D 任务太费时了。 此外,对于大型组群分析来说,正是高度精确的自动分解模型减少了人类最大的努力。然而,这些模型缺乏对互动校正的支持,并且缺乏新结构的零速能力,而新结构是“创建”的关键特征。 虽然在3D中重新使用经过预先训练的2D骨干增加了零发射潜力,但其在复杂的3D结构中的性能仍然落后于领先的3D模式。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了VISTA3D,Visatile Imaging Segmentiation和批注模式,目标是用一个统一的基础模式解决所有这些挑战和要求。 VISTA3D建在成熟的三维分解管道之上,是第一个在三维自动(支持127个级)和三维交互分解中取得SOTA 性能的模式,即使与关于大型和多样化基准的三维顶级专家模型相比也是如此。 此外,VISTA3D的3D互动设计可以高效地进行人类矫正,而一种创新的3D超蒸汽法 — — 蒸馏二维预先训练的骨架 — — 授予VISTA3D顶级3D零弹性能。 我们相信,模型、配方和洞察力是朝着临床上有用的3D基础模型迈出的充满希望的一步。 代码和权重可在https://github.com/Project-MONAI/VISTA上公开查阅。

papers.title: VILA-M3: Enhancing Vision-Language Models with Medical Expert Knowledge
papers.authors: Vishwesh Nath, Wenqi Li, Dong Yang, Andriy Myronenko, Mingxin Zheng, Yao Lu, Zhijian Liu, Hongxu Yin, Yee Man Law, Yucheng Tang, Pengfei Guo, Can Zhao, Ziyue Xu, Yufan He, Stephanie Harmon, Benjamin Simon, Greg Heinrich, Stephen Aylward, Marc Edgar, Michael Zephyr, Pavlo Molchanov, Baris Turkbey, Holger Roth, Daguang Xu
papers.abstract: Generalist vision language models (VLMs) have made significant strides in computer vision, but they fall short in specialized fields like healthcare, where expert knowledge is essential. Current large multimodal models like Gemini and GPT-4o are insufficient for medical tasks due to their reliance on memorized internet knowledge rather than the nuanced expertise required in healthcare. Meanwhile, existing medical VLMs (e.g. Med-Gemini) often lack expert consultation as part of their design, and many rely on outdated, static datasets that were not created with modern, large deep learning models in mind. VLMs are usually trained in three stages: vision pre-training, vision-language pre-training, and instruction fine-tuning (IFT). IFT has been typically applied using a mixture of generic and healthcare data. In contrast, we propose that for medical VLMs, a fourth stage of specialized IFT is necessary, which focuses on medical data and includes information from domain expert models. Domain expert models developed for medical use are crucial because they are specifically trained for certain clinical tasks, e.g. to detect tumors and classify abnormalities through segmentation and classification, which learn fine-grained features of medical data-features that are often too intricate for a VLM to capture effectively. This paper introduces a new framework, VILA-M3, for medical VLMs that utilizes domain knowledge via expert models. We argue that generic VLM architectures alone are not viable for real-world clinical applications and on-demand usage of domain-specialized expert model knowledge is critical for advancing AI in healthcare. Through our experiments, we show an improved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with an average improvement of ~9% over the prior SOTA model Med-Gemini and ~6% over models trained on the specific tasks. Our approach emphasizes the importance of domain expertise in creating precise, reliable VLMs for medical applications.
papers.title_zh: VILA-M3:利用医学专家知识加强视觉-语言模式
papers.abstract_zh: 通用视觉语言模型(VLMs)在计算机视觉方面取得了长足的进步,但在医疗保健等专业领域却不足,这些领域的专家知识是必不可少的。 目前的大型多式联运模式,如Gemini和GPT-4o,由于依赖记忆化的互联网知识,而不是医疗保健所需的细微专门知识,不足以完成医疗任务。 梅德-吉米尼(Med-Gemini)经常缺乏专家咨询作为设计的一部分,许多人依赖过时的静态数据集,这些数据集并不是用现代的、大型的深层学习模式创建的。 甚低频LMS通常分三个阶段接受培训:视觉培训前阶段、视觉语言培训前阶段和教学微调(IFT ) 。 相反,我们建议,对于医学上VLMs,有必要采用专门IFT的第四阶段,该阶段侧重于医疗数据,包括来自领域专家模型的信息。 为医疗目的开发的域专家模型至关重要,因为它们接受特定临床任务(如临床任务)的专门培训。 通过分解和分类来检测肿瘤和对异常进行分类,通过分解和分类来学习医学数据特征的细微特征,这些特征往往过于复杂,无法有效捕捉到甚低频磁共振。 本文介绍了医学VLA-M3的新框架,即VILA-M3,即通过专家模型利用领域知识的医学VLMs。 我们认为,光是通用的VLM结构在现实世界临床应用方面不可行,按需使用域专门专家模型知识对于在保健领域推进AI至关重要。 通过我们的实验,我们展示出最新技术(SOTA)表现的改善,比以前的SOTA模型Med-Gemini平均提高了9%,比经过具体任务培训的模型提高了6%。 我们的方法强调,在为医疗应用创造准确、可靠的甚低频终端方面,域内专门知识的重要性。

papers.title: Video-MME: The First-Ever Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark of Multi-modal LLMs in Video Analysis
papers.authors: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
papers.abstract: In the quest for artificial general intelligence, Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a focal point in recent advancements. However, the predominant focus remains on developing their capabilities in static image understanding. The potential of MLLMs to process sequential visual data is still insufficiently explored, highlighting the lack of a comprehensive, high-quality assessment of their performance. In this paper, we introduce Video-MME, the first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis. Our work distinguishes from existing benchmarks through four key features: 1) Diversity in video types, spanning 6 primary visual domains with 30 subfields to ensure broad scenario generalizability; 2) Duration in temporal dimension, encompassing both short-, medium-, and long-term videos, ranging from 11 seconds to 1 hour, for robust contextual dynamics; 3) Breadth in data modalities, integrating multi-modal inputs besides video frames, including subtitles and audios, to unveil the all-round capabilities of MLLMs; 4) Quality in annotations, utilizing rigorous manual labeling by expert annotators to facilitate precise and reliable model assessment. With Video-MME, we extensively evaluate various state-of-the-art MLLMs, and reveal that Gemini 1.5 Pro is the best-performing commercial model, significantly outperforming the open-source models with an average accuracy of 75%, compared to 71.9% for GPT-4o. The results also demonstrate that Video-MME is a universal benchmark that applies to both image and video MLLMs. Further analysis indicates that subtitle and audio information could significantly enhance video understanding. Besides, a decline in MLLM performance is observed as video duration increases for all models. Our dataset along with these findings underscores the need for further improvements in handling longer sequences and multi-modal data, shedding light on future MLLM development.
papers.title_zh: 视频-MME:视频分析中多模式LMS第一期综合评价基准
papers.abstract_zh: 在寻求人造一般情报的过程中,多式大语言模型(MLLM)已成为最近进展的协调中心,但主要重点仍然是发展他们了解静态图像的能力。 MLLMS处理相继视觉数据的潜力仍未得到充分探索,这凸显出缺乏对其业绩的全面、高质量评估。 在本文中,我们介绍视频MME,这是有史以来第一个全光谱、多模式评价的视频分析MLLMS基准。 我们的工作通过四个关键特征与现有基准有区别:(1) 视频类型的多样性,涵盖6个主要视觉领域,有30个子领域,以确保广泛的情景可概括性;(2) 时间层面,包括短、中、长期视频,从11秒到1小时,以保持稳健的背景动态;(3) 数据模式的粗体,将视频框架以外的多模式投入(包括字幕和音频)整合在一起,以展示MLLMs的全方位能力;(4) 说明质量,利用专家说明员的严格手工标签,促进准确和可靠的模型评估。 通过视频-MME,我们广泛评价了各种最先进的MLLMs,并显示Gemini 1.5 Pro是最佳商业模型,大大优于开放源码模型,平均精确度为75%,而GPT-4o为71.9%。 研究结果还表明,视频-MME是一个通用基准,适用于图像和视频MLLMs。 进一步的分析表明,字幕和音频信息可大大提高视频理解度,此外,随着所有模型视频持续时间的增加,视频-MME的性能也有所下降。 我们的数据集连同这些调查结果突出表明,在处理较长序列和多模式数据方面需要进一步改进,并阐明未来的最低生活水平和最低生活水平发展。

papers.title: VEU-Bench: Towards Comprehensive Understanding of Video Editing
papers.authors: Bozheng Li, Yongliang Wu, Yi Lu, Jiashuo Yu, Licheng Tang, Jiawang Cao, Wenqing Zhu, Yuyang Sun, Jay Wu, Wenbo Zhu
papers.abstract: Widely shared videos on the internet are often edited. Recently, although Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) have made great progress in general video understanding tasks, their capabilities in video editing understanding (VEU) tasks remain unexplored. To address this gap, in this paper, we introduce VEU-Bench (Video Editing Understanding Benchmark), a comprehensive benchmark that categorizes video editing components across various dimensions, from intra-frame features like shot size to inter-shot attributes such as cut types and transitions. Unlike previous video editing understanding benchmarks that focus mainly on editing element classification, VEU-Bench encompasses 19 fine-grained tasks across three stages: recognition, reasoning, and judging. To enhance the annotation of VEU automatically, we built an annotation pipeline integrated with an ontology-based knowledge base. Through extensive experiments with 11 state-of-the-art Vid-LLMs, our findings reveal that current Vid-LLMs face significant challenges in VEU tasks, with some performing worse than random choice. To alleviate this issue, we develop Oscars(Named after the Academy Awards.), a VEU expert model fine-tuned on the curated VEU-Bench dataset. It outperforms existing open-source Vid-LLMs on VEU-Bench by over 28.3% in accuracy and achieves performance comparable to commercial models like GPT-4o. We also demonstrate that incorporating VEU data significantly enhances the performance of Vid-LLMs on general video understanding benchmarks, with an average improvement of 8.3% across nine reasoning tasks. The code and data will be made available.
papers.title_zh: VEU-Bench:争取全面了解录像编辑
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,尽管视频大语言模型(Vid-LLMs)在一般视频理解任务方面取得了巨大进步,但其视频编辑理解任务的能力仍未探索。 为了弥补这一差距,本文将介绍VEU-Bench(Video Editench Review Lider Base),这是一个综合基准,将视频编辑组成部分分为不同层面,从射线大小到截断类型和过渡等截断属性等内部特征。 与以前主要侧重于编辑要素分类的视频编辑理解基准不同, VEU-Bench包含分三个阶段的19项细微任务:承认、推理和判断。 为了自动加强对VEU的批注,我们建造了与基于本体知识库相结合的批注管道。 通过对11个最先进的Vid-LLMS进行广泛的实验,我们的研究结果显示,目前的Vid-LLMS在VEU任务中面临重大挑战,有些比随机选择更差。 为了缓解这一问题,我们开发了奥斯卡(以奥斯卡奖命名 ) , 这是一种VEU专家模型,它以开发的VEU-Bench数据集进行微调。 它的精度比VEU-Bench的现有开放源维基-LLMs高出28.3%以上,并取得了与GPT-4o等商业模型相当的效绩。 我们还表明,纳入VEU数据将极大地提高Vid-LLMs在一般视频理解基准方面的性能,在九项推理任务中平均提高8.3%,将提供代码和数据。

papers.title: V^2Dial: Unification of Video and Visual Dialog via Multimodal Experts
papers.authors: Adnen Abdessaied, Anna Rohrbach, Marcus Rohrbach, Andreas Bulling
papers.abstract: We present V2Dial - a novel expert-based model specifically geared towards simultaneously handling image and video input data for multimodal conversational tasks. Current multimodal models primarily focus on simpler tasks (e.g., VQA, VideoQA, video-text retrieval) and often neglect the more challenging conversational counterparts, such as video and visual/image dialog. Moreover, works on both conversational tasks evolved separately from each other despite their apparent similarities limiting their applicability potential. To this end, we propose to unify both tasks using a single model that for the first time jointly learns the spatial and temporal features of images and videos by routing them through dedicated experts and aligns them using matching and contrastive learning techniques. Furthermore, we systemically study the domain shift between the two tasks by investigating whether and to what extent these seemingly related tasks can mutually benefit from their respective training data.
