Extensive evaluations on the widely used video and visual dialog datasets of AVSD and VisDial show that our model achieves new state-of-the-art results across four benchmarks both in zero-shot and fine-tuning settings.
papers.title_zh: V2Dial:通过多式联运专家统一视频和视觉对话
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了V2Dial,这是一个新的专家型新模式,专门用于同时处理图像和视频输入数据,用于多式谈话任务。 目前的多式联运模式主要侧重于更简单的任务(如VQA、VVEQA、VEVA、视频文本检索),往往忽视了更具挑战性的对话对口方,如视频和视觉/图像对话。 此外,尽管这两个对话任务显然有相似之处,限制了其适用性,但这两个任务的工作是分别演变而成的。 为此,我们提议采用单一模式,将这两项任务统一起来。 单一模式首次通过专职专家将图像和视频的空间和时间特征与时间特征联系起来,并使用匹配和对比式学习技术对其进行调整。 此外,我们系统地研究这两项任务之间的领域转移,调查这些似乎相关的任务是否以及在何种程度上能够相互受益于各自的培训数据。 对广泛使用的AVSD和VisDial视频和视频对话数据集的广泛评价表明,我们的模型在零射和微调环境中,在四个基准上取得了新的最新成果。

papers.title: UrbanCAD: Towards Highly Controllable and Photorealistic 3D Vehicles for Urban Scene Simulation
papers.authors: Yichong Lu, Yichi Cai, Shangzhan Zhang, Hongyu Zhou, Haoji Hu, Huimin Yu, Andreas Geiger, Yiyi Liao
papers.abstract: Photorealistic 3D vehicle models with high controllability are essential for autonomous driving simulation and data augmentation. While handcrafted CAD models provide flexible controllability, free CAD libraries often lack the high-quality materials necessary for photorealistic rendering. Conversely, reconstructed 3D models offer high-fidelity rendering but lack controllability. In this work, we introduce UrbanCAD, a framework that generates highly controllable and photorealistic 3D vehicle digital twins from a single urban image, leveraging a large collection of free 3D CAD models and handcrafted materials. To achieve this, we propose a novel pipeline that follows a retrieval-optimization manner, adapting to observational data while preserving fine-grained expert-designed priors for both geometry and material. This enables vehicles' realistic 360-degree rendering, background insertion, material transfer, relighting, and component manipulation. Furthermore, given multi-view background perspective and fisheye images, we approximate environment lighting using fisheye images and reconstruct the background with 3DGS, enabling the photorealistic insertion of optimized CAD models into rendered novel view backgrounds. Experimental results demonstrate that UrbanCAD outperforms baselines in terms of photorealism. Additionally, we show that various perception models maintain their accuracy when evaluated on UrbanCAD with in-distribution configurations but degrade when applied to realistic out-of-distribution data generated by our method. This suggests that UrbanCAD is a significant advancement in creating photorealistic, safety-critical driving scenarios for downstream applications.
papers.title_zh: 城市CAD:迈向高度可控和摄影现实的三维车辆用于城市景象模拟
papers.abstract_zh: 具有高度可控性的超现实的三维机动车模型对于自动驾驶模拟和数据增强至关重要。 虽然手工制作的CAD模型提供了灵活的可控性,但免费的CAD图书馆往往缺乏摄影真实性所需的高质量材料。 相反,经过重建的三维模型具有高度不忠性,但缺乏可控性。 在这项工作中,我们引入了 " 城市CAD " ,这是一个框架,利用大量免费的3D CAD模型和手工制作材料,从一个城市图像中产生高度可控和具有摄影现实性的3D型汽车数字双胞胎。 为此,我们提议采用检索优化方式建立一个新的管道,适应观测数据,同时保留精细专家设计的几何和材料前科。 这使得车辆能够进行现实的360度翻译、背景插入、材料转移、降压和部件操纵。 此外,考虑到多视角背景观点和鱼眼图像,我们用鱼眼图像来估计环境照明,并用3DGS重建背景,从而能够将优化的CAD模型以摄影现实化的方式融入新的视图背景。 实验结果显示,城市气候中心在光现实性方面的表现超过了基线。 此外,我们还表明,在用分布式配置评价城市住户抽样分析中心时,各种认知模型保持准确性,但在应用到我们的方法产生的现实的分布外数据时,则会降低准确性。 这表明,在为下游应用创造具有摄影现实性、对安全至关重要的驾驶假想方面,城市中心是一大进步。

papers.title: Uni3DL: A Unified Model for 3D Vision-Language Understanding
papers.authors: Xiang Li · Jian Ding · Zhaoyang Chen · Mohamed Elhoseiny
papers.abstract: In this work, we present Uni3DL, a unified model for 3D Vision-Language understanding. Distinct from existing unified vision-language models in 3D which are limited in task variety and predominantly dependent on projected multi-view images, Uni3DL operates directly on point clouds. This approach significantly expands the range of supported tasks in 3D, encompassing both vision and vision-language tasks in 3D. At the core of Uni3DL, a query transformer is designed to learn task-agnostic semantic and mask outputs by attending to 3D visual features, and a task router is employed to selectively generate task-specific outputs required for diverse tasks. With a unified architecture, our Uni3DL model enjoys seamless task decomposition and substantial parameter sharing across tasks. Uni3DL has been rigorously evaluated across diverse 3D vision-language understanding tasks, including semantic segmentation, object detection, instance segmentation, visual grounding, 3D captioning, and text-3D cross-modal retrieval. It demonstrates performance on par with or surpassing state-of-the-art (SOTA) task-specific models. We hope our benchmark and Uni3DL model will serve as a solid step to ease future research in unified models in the realm of 3D and language understanding.
papers.title_zh: Uni3DL:3D视觉语言理解统一模式
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们展示了Uni3DL, 3D视觉-语言理解的统一模式。 与现有的3D统一视觉-语言模式不同,3D统一视觉-语言模式的任务种类有限,主要依赖预测的多视图图像。 Uni3DL直接在点云上运作。 这种办法大大扩大了3D支助任务的范围,包括3D的视觉和视觉语言任务。 在Uni3DL的核心,设计了一个Query变压器,通过关注 3D 视觉特征来学习任务不可知的语义和掩码输出,并使用一个任务路由器有选择地产生各种任务所需的具体任务产出。 有了统一的架构,我们的Uni3DL模式享有无缝的任务分解和任务间实质性的参数共享。 Uni3DL在各种3D视觉语言理解任务中受到严格评价,包括语义分割、物体探测、实例分割、视觉地面、3D字幕和文本-3D跨模式检索。 它展示了与最先进(SOTA)具体任务模型同等或超前的绩效,我们希望我们的基准和Uni3DL模型将成为坚实的一步,方便今后在3D和语言理解领域统一模型的研究。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Driven Expert Control: Enhancing the Reliability of Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Xiao Liang · Di Wang · Zhicheng Jiao · Ronghan Li · Pengfei Yang · Quan Wang · Tat-Seng Chua
papers.abstract: The rapid advancements in Vision Language Models (VLMs) have prompted the development of multi-modal medical assistant systems. Despite this progress, current models still have inherent probabilistic uncertainties, often producing erroneous or unverified responses—an issue with serious implications in medical applications. Existing methods aim to enhance the performance of Medical Vision Language Model (MedVLM) by adjusting model structure, fine-tuning with high-quality data, or through preference fine-tuning. However, these training-dependent strategies are costly and still lack sufficient alignment with clinical expertise. To address these issues, we propose an expert-in-the-loop framework named Expert-Controlled Classifier-Free Guidance (Expert-CFG) to align MedVLM with clinical expertise without additional training. This framework introduces an uncertainty estimation strategy to identify unreliable outputs. It then retrieves relevant references to assist experts in highlighting key terms and applies classifier-free guidance to refine the token embeddings of MedVLM, ensuring that the adjusted outputs are correct and align with expert highlights. Evaluations across three medical visual question answering benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed Expert-CFG, with 4.2B parameters and limited expert annotations, outperforms state-of-the-art models with 13B parameters. The results demonstrate the feasibility of deploying such a system in resource-limited settings for clinical use. The anonymous link to our project can be found in the Supplemental Material.
papers.title_zh: 不确定性-挥发性专家控制:加强医学视觉-语言模型的可靠性
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模式的迅速发展促进了多模式医疗助理系统的开发。 尽管取得了这些进展,但目前的模式仍然存在着固有的概率不确定性,往往产生错误或未经核实的反应——这是一个在医疗应用方面有严重影响的问题。 现有方法旨在通过调整模式结构、对高质量数据进行微调,或通过优惠微调,提高医疗远景语言模型(MedVLM)的绩效,但是,这些依赖培训的战略费用高昂,仍然与临床专门知识不完全一致。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议了一个名为专家控制分类-免费指导(专家控制-分类-免费指导(CFG))的专家流动中专家框架,以便在没有额外培训的情况下,使医疗VLM与临床专业知识接轨。 这个框架引入了不确定性估算战略,以确定不可靠的产出。 然后,它检索相关参考资料,以协助专家突出关键术语,并采用无分类指导来完善MedVLM象征性嵌入,确保调整后的产出正确,并与专家重点保持一致。 对三个医疗直观问题回答基准的评价表明,提议的CFG专家,具有4.2B参数和有限的专家说明,优于13B参数的最新模型。 结果显示,在资源有限的环境中部署这种系统供临床使用的可行性,与我们项目的匿名链接见补充材料。

papers.title: TSDW: A Tri-Stream Dynamic Weight Network for Cloth-Changing Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Ruiqi He, Zihan Wang, Xiang Zhou
papers.abstract: Cloth-Changing Person Re-identification (CC-ReID) aims to solve the challenge of identifying individuals across different temporal-spatial scenarios, viewpoints, and clothing variations. This field is gaining increasing attention in big data research and public security domains. Existing ReID research primarily relies on face recognition, gait semantic recognition, and clothing-irrelevant feature identification, which perform relatively well in scenarios with high-quality clothing change videos and images. However, these approaches depend on either single features or simple combinations of multiple features, making further performance improvements difficult. Additionally, limitations such as missing facial information, challenges in gait extraction, and inconsistent camera parameters restrict the broader application of CC-ReID. To address the above limitations, we innovatively propose a Tri-Stream Dynamic Weight Network (TSDW) that requires only images. This dynamic weighting network consists of three parallel feature streams: facial features, head-limb features, and global features. Each stream specializes in extracting its designated features, after which a gating network dynamically fuses confidence levels. The three parallel feature streams enhance recognition performance and reduce the impact of any single feature failure, thereby improving model robustness. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets (e.g., PRCC, Celeb-reID, VC-Clothes) demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.title_zh: TSDW: 衣物变化人员识别三层动态重量网络
papers.abstract_zh: 改变衣物的人重新识别(CC-ReID)旨在解决在不同的时间空间情景、观点和服装差异中识别个人的挑战,这一领域在海量数据研究和公共安全领域日益受到关注。 现有的ReID研究主要依靠面部识别、步态语义识别和与服装无关的特征识别,这些特征识别在高质量服装变化视频和图像的情景中表现相对较好。 然而,这些办法取决于单一的特征或多种特征的简单组合,因而难以进一步改进业绩。 此外,面部信息缺失、动作提取方面的挑战以及相片参数不一致等局限性限制了CC-ReID的更广泛应用。 为了解决上述局限性,我们创新地提议建立一个仅需要图像的三星动态重力网络(TSDW ) 。 这一动态加权网络由三个平行的特征流组成:面部特征、头部图像特征和全球特征。 每个流都专门提取指定特征, 之后, 刺网会动态地连接信任度 。 这三个平行的特征流可提高认知性,减少任何单一特征失灵的影响,从而提高模型的稳健性。 关于基准数据集的广泛实验(例如,PRCC、Caleb-reID、VC-Clothes)表明,我们的方法大大优于现有的最新方法。

papers.title: Triad: Empowering LMM-based Anomaly Detection with Vision Expert-guided Visual Tokenizer and Manufacturing Process
papers.authors: Yuanze Li, Shihao Yuan, Haolin Wang, Qizhang Li, Ming Liu, Chen Xu, Guangming Shi, Wangmeng Zuo
papers.abstract: Although recent methods have tried to introduce large multimodal models (LMMs) into industrial anomaly detection (IAD), their generalization in the IAD field is far inferior to that for general purposes. We summarize the main reasons for this gap into two aspects. On one hand, general-purpose LMMs lack cognition of defects in the visual modality, thereby failing to sufficiently focus on defect areas. Therefore, we propose to modify the AnyRes structure of the LLaVA model, providing the potential anomalous areas identified by existing IAD models to the LMMs. On the other hand, existing methods mainly focus on identifying defects by learning defect patterns or comparing with normal samples, yet they fall short of understanding the causes of these defects. Considering that the generation of defects is closely related to the manufacturing process, we propose a manufacturing-driven IAD paradigm. An instruction-tuning dataset for IAD (InstructIAD) and a data organization approach for Chain-of-Thought with manufacturing (CoT-M) are designed to leverage the manufacturing process for IAD. Based on the above two modifications, we present Triad, a novel LMM-based method incorporating an expert-guided region-of-interest tokenizer and manufacturing process for industrial anomaly detection. Extensive experiments show that our Triad not only demonstrates competitive performance against current LMMs but also achieves further improved accuracy when equipped with manufacturing processes. Source code, training data, and pre-trained models will be publicly available at https://github.com/tzjtatata/Triad.
papers.title_zh: 三合一:赋予以LMM 为基础的以LMM为基础的超常探测能力,采用视觉专家指导的视觉控制器和制造工艺
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的一些方法试图将大型多式联运模式(LMMs)引入工业异常现象检测(IAD),但在IAD领域,这些模式的概括性远远低于一般目的,我们将造成这一差距的主要原因归纳为两个方面。 一方面,一般用途LMM系统缺乏对视觉模式缺陷的认知,因此未能充分关注缺陷领域,因此,我们提议修改LLAVA模型的AnyRes结构,向LVA模型提供现有IAD模型确定的潜在异常领域。 另一方面,现有方法主要侧重于通过学习缺陷模式或与正常样本进行比较来查明缺陷,但无法理解这些缺陷的原因。 考虑到缺陷的产生与制造过程密切相关,我们建议采用由制造部门驱动的内部审计司模式。 设计IAD(InstructIAD)的指令调整数据集和与制造有关的研究链(CoT-M)的数据组织办法,目的是利用IAD的制造过程。 根据上述两项修改,我们介绍三合会,这是一种基于LMM的新颖的LMM方法,其中含有专家指导的利息地区代用品和工业异常现象检测制造过程。 广泛的实验表明,我们的三合会不仅展示了与目前的LMM相比的竞争性业绩,而且在配备制造工艺时也进一步提高了准确性。 来源代码、培训数据和预培训模型将公布在https://github.com/tzjtatata/Triad上。

papers.title: Towards Stable and Storage-efficient Dataset Distillation: Matching Convexified Trajectory
papers.authors: Wenliang Zhong, Haoyu Tang, Qinghai Zheng, Mingzhu Xu, Yupeng Hu, Weili Guan
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of deep learning and large language models has led to an exponential growth in the demand for training data, prompting the development of Dataset Distillation methods to address the challenges of managing large datasets. Among these, Matching Training Trajectories (MTT) has been a prominent approach, which replicates the training trajectory of an expert network on real data with a synthetic dataset. However, our investigation found that this method suffers from three significant limitations: 1. Instability of expert trajectory generated by Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD); 2. Low convergence speed of the distillation process; 3. High storage consumption of the expert trajectory. To address these issues, we offer a new perspective on understanding the essence of Dataset Distillation and MTT through a simple transformation of the objective function, and introduce a novel method called Matching Convexified Trajectory (MCT), which aims to provide better guidance for the student trajectory. MCT creates convex combinations of expert trajectories by selecting a few expert models, guiding student networks to converge quickly and stably. This trajectory is not only easier to store, but also enables continuous sampling strategies during the distillation process, ensuring thorough learning and fitting of the entire expert trajectory. The comprehensive experiment of three public datasets verified that MCT is superior to the traditional MTT method.
papers.title_zh: 稳定与储存效率高的数据集蒸馏:匹配集成轨迹
papers.abstract_zh: 深层学习和大型语言模式的迅速演变导致对培训数据的需求成倍增长,促使发展数据集蒸馏方法,以应对管理大型数据集的挑战。 其中,匹配培训轨迹(MTT)是一个突出的方法,它利用合成数据集复制了实际数据专家网络的培训轨迹。 3. 专家轨道的高度储存消耗。 为解决这些问题,我们从新的角度通过对目标功能的简单转换,了解数据集提炼和MTT的本质,并采用一种叫作 " 匹配的电解轨迹 " (MCT)的新颖方法,目的是为学生的轨迹提供更好的指导。 MCT通过选择少数专家模型,引导学生网络迅速和稳定地汇合,创造了专家轨迹的曲线组合。 这一轨迹不仅更容易储存,而且有助于在蒸馏过程中采取连续的取样战略,确保透彻地学习和适应整个专家轨迹。 对三个公共数据集的全面实验证实,MCT优于传统的MTT方法。

papers.title: Towards Continual Universal Segmentation
papers.authors: Zihan Lin, Zilei Wang, Xu Wang
papers.abstract: Despite the significant progress in continual image segmentation, existing arts still strive to balance between stability and plasticity. Additionally, they are specialist to specific tasks and models, which hinders the extension to more general situations. In this work, we present CUE, a novel Continual Universal sEgmentation pipeline that not only inherently tackles the stability-plasticity dilemma, but unifies any segmentation across tasks and models as well. Our key insight: any segmentation task can be reformulated as an understanding-then-refinement paradigm, which is inspired by humans' visual perception system to first perform high-level semantic understanding, then focus on low-level vision cues. We claim three desiderata for this design: Continuity by inherently avoiding the stability-plasticity dilemma via exploiting the natural differences between high-level and low-level knowledge. Generality by unifying and simplifying the landscape towards various segmentation tasks. Efficiency as an interesting by-product by significantly reducing the research effort. Our resulting model, built upon this pipeline by complementary expert models, shows significant improvements over previous state-of-the-arts across various segmentation tasks and datasets. We believe that our work is a significant step towards making continual segmentation more universal and practicable.
papers.title_zh: 实现世界持久分化
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在图像分割方面不断取得显著进展,但现有艺术仍在努力在稳定与可塑性之间取得平衡,此外,它们专门从事具体的任务和模型,这阻碍了将范围扩大到更普遍的情况。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了CUE,这是一个新的“世界持续增长管道”,它不仅从本质上解决稳定-可塑性的两难处境,而且将任务和模式之间的任何分化也统一起来。 我们的主要洞察力:任何分解任务都可以重新拟订为一种理解-即精炼的范式,这种范式受人类视觉认知系统的启发,首先进行高层次的语义理解,然后侧重于低层次的视觉提示。 我们声称,这一设计有三个不同之处:通过利用高层次和低层次知识之间的自然差异,内在地避免稳定-塑料两难困境,从而保持连续性。 通过统一和简化地貌以完成各种分割任务,实现普遍性。 作为有趣的副产品效率,我们大幅削减了研究工作。 我们通过补充专家模型建立在这个管道上的模型表明,与以往不同分类任务和数据集的最新技术相比,我们取得了显著进步。 我们认为,我们的工作是朝着使持续分割更加普遍和切实可行迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: ToVE: Efficient Vision-Language Learning via Knowledge Transfer from Vision Experts
papers.authors: Yuanchen Wu, Junlong Du, Ke Yan, Shouhong Ding, Xiaoqiang Li
papers.abstract: Vision-language (VL) learning requires extensive visual perception capabilities, such as fine-grained object recognition and spatial perception. Recent works typically rely on training huge models on massive datasets to develop these capabilities. As a more efficient alternative, this paper proposes a new framework that Transfers the knowledge from a hub of Vision Experts (ToVE) for efficient VL learning, leveraging pre-trained vision expert models to promote visual perception capability. Specifically, building on a frozen CLIP encoder that provides vision tokens for image-conditioned language generation, ToVE introduces a hub of multiple vision experts and a token-aware gating network that dynamically routes expert knowledge to vision tokens. In the transfer phase, we propose a "residual knowledge transfer" strategy, which not only preserves the generalizability of the vision tokens but also allows detachment of low-contributing experts to improve inference efficiency. Further, we explore to merge these expert knowledge to a single CLIP encoder, creating a knowledge-merged CLIP that produces more informative vision tokens without expert inference during deployment. Experiment results across various VL tasks demonstrate that the proposed ToVE achieves competitive performance with two orders of magnitude fewer training data.
papers.title_zh: TOV:通过视觉专家的知识转让,高效的视觉-语言学习
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言(VL)学习需要广泛的视觉感知能力,如细微的物体识别和空间感知。 最近的工作通常依靠对大型数据集的巨型模型的培训来发展这些能力。 作为更有效的替代办法,本文提出一个新的框架,从视觉专家中心(TOVE)转让知识,以高效学习甚低频学习,利用预先培训的视觉专家模型,提高视觉认知能力。 具体地说,TOVE以一个冷冻的CLIP编码器为基础,该编码器为图像化语言生成提供视觉标志,它引进了一个由多个视觉专家组成的中心和一个象征性认知网络,将专家知识动态引导到视觉标志上。 在转让阶段,我们提议了一项“知识的再转移”战略,不仅保持了视觉象征的可普及性,而且允许低贡献专家的分遣队提高推论效率。 此外,我们探索将这些专家知识与单一的CLIP编码器合并,建立一个知识合并的CLIP,在没有专家推断部署期间产生更多信息化的视觉标志。 各种VL任务的实验结果表明,拟议的TOVE以两个数量级较少的培训数据实现竞争性业绩。

papers.title: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression
papers.authors: Xinjie Wang, Yifan Zhang, Ting Liu, Xinpu Liu, Ke Xu, Jianwei Wan, Yulan Guo, Hanyun Wang
papers.abstract: Efficient Point Cloud Geometry Compression (PCGC) with a lower bits per point (BPP) and higher peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is essential for the transportation of large-scale 3D data. Although octree-based entropy models can reduce BPP without introducing geometry distortion, existing CNN-based models struggle with limited receptive fields to capture long-range dependencies, while Transformer-built architectures always neglect fine-grained details due to their reliance on global self-attention. In this paper, we propose a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction Network, termed TopNet, to overcome these challenges by developing several novel components: Locally-enhanced Context Encoding (LeCE) for enhancing the translation-invariance of the octree nodes, Adaptive-Length Sliding Window Attention (AL-SWA) for capturing both global and local dependencies while adaptively adjusting attention weights based on the input window length, Spatial-Gated-enhanced Channel Mixer (SG-CM) for efficient feature aggregation from ancestors and siblings, and Latent-guided Node Occupancy Predictor (LNOP) for improving prediction accuracy of spatially adjacent octree nodes. Comprehensive experiments across both indoor and outdoor point cloud datasets demonstrate that our TopNet achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters, further advancing the reduction-efficiency boundaries of PCGC. The code is available at https://github.com/xinjiewang1995/TopNet.
papers.title_zh: 顶端网络:Octrie-Stenciate-Squated Poor Cloud 几何压缩的变换器-高效占用预测网络
papers.abstract_zh: 高效点云几何压缩(PCGC),每点比特较低(BPP),峰值信号对噪音比较高(PSNR),对于大规模3D数据的运输至关重要。 虽然以树为主的昆虫模型可以在不引入几何失真的情况下减少BPP,但现有的有线电视新闻网模型在有限的可接受领域挣扎,以捕捉远距离依赖性,而由变形器建造的建筑则总是忽视细微的细节,因为它们依赖于全球的自我关注。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个称为TopNet的变换式高效占用预测网络,以通过开发以下几个新组成部分来克服这些挑战:加强本地环境编码,以加强奥氏树节点的翻译差异;适应性-Length滑动窗口注意(AL-SWA),以捕捉全球和当地依赖性,同时根据输入窗口长度调整关注权重;空间-Gated-增强型信道混合(SG-CM),以有效收集祖先和兄弟姐妹的地貌;以及长式引导的北流渗透预测(LNOP),以提高空间相邻蚂蚁节点的预测准确性。 室内和室外云点数据集综合实验表明,我们的顶端网络以较少的参数取得了SOTA 性能,进一步推进了PCGC的降低效率界限,该代码可在https://github.com/xinjiewang1995/TopNet上查阅。

papers.title: Taming Object Hallucinations with Verified Atomic Confidence Estimation
papers.authors: Jiarui Liu, Weihao Xuan, Zhijing Jin, Mona Diab
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often suffer from hallucinations, particularly errors in object existence, attributes, or relations, which undermine their reliability. We introduce TACO (Verified Atomic Confidence Estimation), a simple framework that mitigates hallucinations through self-verification and confidence calibration without relying on external vision experts. TACO decomposes responses into atomic queries, paraphrases them to reduce sensitivity to wording, and estimates confidence using self-consistency (black-box) or self-confidence (gray-box) aggregation, before refining answers with a language model. Experiments on five benchmarks (POPE, MME, HallusionBench, AMBER, and MM-Hal Bench) with two MLLMs (LLaVA-1.5-7B and CogVLM2) show that TACO consistently outperforms direct prompting and Visual Contrastive Decoding, reduces systematic biases, and improves confidence calibration, demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing the faithfulness of MLLMs.
papers.title_zh: 以经过验证的原子能信任度估计来描述物体的幻觉
papers.abstract_zh: 多式大语言模型经常出现幻觉,特别是对象存在、属性或关系方面的错误,从而损害其可靠性。 我们引入一个简单的框架TACO(经过核查的原子能信心估计),通过自我核查和信心校准来减轻幻觉,而不必依赖外部的视觉专家。 TACO将答复分解成原子问题,将其改写为减少对措辞的敏感度,并用自我一致性(黑盒)或自信心(灰盒)汇总来估计信心,然后用语言模型来完善答案。 在五个基准(POPE、MME、Hallusion Bench、AMBER和MM-Hal Book)上进行的两个MLLM(LLAVA-1.5-7B和CogVLM2)实验显示,TACO的性能一贯超过直接的促动和视觉反比解码,减少了系统性偏见,改进了信心校准,表明其在提高MLLMs的忠诚性方面的有效性。

papers.title: SynerGen-VL: Towards Synergistic Image Understanding and Generation with Vision Experts and Token Folding
papers.authors: Hao Li, Changyao Tian, Jie Shao, Xizhou Zhu, Zhaokai Wang, Jinguo Zhu, Wenhan Dou, Xiaogang Wang, Hongsheng Li, Lewei Lu, Jifeng Dai
papers.abstract: The remarkable success of Large Language Models (LLMs) has extended to the multimodal domain, achieving outstanding performance in image understanding and generation. Recent efforts to develop unified Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) that integrate these capabilities have shown promising results. However, existing approaches often involve complex designs in model architecture or training pipeline, increasing the difficulty of model training and scaling. In this paper, we propose SynerGen-VL, a simple yet powerful encoder-free MLLM capable of both image understanding and generation. To address challenges identified in existing encoder-free unified MLLMs, we introduce the token folding mechanism and the vision-expert-based progressive alignment pretraining strategy, effectively supporting high-resolution image understanding while reducing training complexity. After being trained on large-scale mixed image-text data with a unified next-token prediction objective, SynerGen-VL achieves or surpasses the performance of existing encoder-free unified MLLMs with comparable or smaller parameter sizes, and narrows the gap with task-specific state-of-the-art models, highlighting a promising path toward future unified MLLMs. Our code and models shall be released.
papers.title_zh: SynerGen-VL:与视觉专家和Token Folding合作,努力实现对图像的同步理解和生成
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的显著成功已扩展到多式联运领域,在图像理解和生成方面取得了杰出的成绩,最近为开发整合这些能力的统一的多语言大语言模型所做的努力取得了令人乐观的成果。 然而,现有方法往往涉及模型结构或培训管道的复杂设计,增加了模型培训和规模的难度。 在本文中,我们建议SynerGen-VL,这是一个简单而有力的无编码器的无编码器MLLM,既能理解图像,又能生成图像。 为了应对现有无编码的统一多边LLMS中查明的挑战,我们引入象征性折叠机制和基于视觉的专家渐进调整培训前战略,有效支持高清晰度的图像理解,同时减少培训的复杂性。 SynerGen-VL在接受了关于大型混合图像文本数据的培训,并具有统一的下一吨预测目标之后,实现了或超过了现有无编码者、参数大小相似或较小的统一 MLLMs的性能,缩小了与具体任务的最新模型之间的差距,突出了通向未来统一的MLLMs的一条有希望的道路。 我们的代码和模型将被发布。

papers.title: Stabilizing and Accelerating Autofocus with Expert Trajectory Regularized Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Shouhang Zhu, Chenglin Li, Yuankun Jiang, Li Wei, Nuowen Kan, Ziyang Zheng, Wenrui Dai, Junni Zou, Hongkai Xiong
papers.abstract: Autofocus is a crucial component of modern digital cameras. While recent learning-based methods achieve state-of-the-art in focus prediction accuracy, they unfortunately ignore the potential focus hunting phenomenon of back-and-forth lens movement in the multi-step focusing procedure. To address this, in this paper, we propose an expert regularized deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based approach for autofocus, which can utilize the sequential information of lens movement trajectory to both enhance the multi-step in-focus prediction accuracy and reduce the chance of focus hunting. Our method generally follows an actor-critic framework. To accelerate the DRL's training with a higher sample efficiency, we initialize the policy with a pre-trained single-step prediction network, where the network is further improved by modifying the output of absolute in-focus position distribution to the relative lens movement distribution to establish a better mapping between input images and lens movement. To further stabilize DRL's training with a lower occurrence of focus hunting in the resulting lens movement trajectory, we generate some offline trajectories based on prior knowledge to avoid focus hunting, which are then leveraged as an offline dataset of expert trajectories to regularize the actor network's training. Empirical evaluations show that our method outperforms those learning-based methods on public benchmarks, with higher single- and multi-step prediction accuracy, and a significant reduction of focus hunting rate.
papers.title_zh: 与专家轨迹(正规化深强化学习)一起稳定并加速自动聚焦
papers.abstract_zh: 自动聚焦是现代数字相机的一个关键组成部分。 尽管最近的基于学习的方法在重点预测准确性方面达到了最新水平,但不幸的是,它们忽视了多步骤聚焦程序中的后、后、后镜头移动的潜在重点狩猎现象。 为此,我们在本文中提议采用专家正规化的深层强化学习(DRL)自动重点方法,该方法可以利用透视运动轨迹的顺序信息,既提高多步重点预测准确性,又减少重点狩猎的机会。 我们的方法通常遵循一个行为方-批评框架。 为了以更高的取样效率加速DRL培训,我们以预先培训的单步预测网络为政策初始,通过将绝对重点位置分布的产出修改为相对镜头移动分布,从而在输入图像和镜头移动之间建立更好的绘图,从而进一步改善网络。 为了进一步稳定DRL的培训,在由此产生的透镜运动轨迹中减少重点狩猎的发生率,我们根据先前的知识制作了一些离线轨迹,以避免重点狩猎,然后将这些轨迹作为专家轨迹的离线数据集加以利用,使行为体网络的培训正规化。 经验性评价表明,我们的方法优于这些以学习为基础的公共基准方法,单步和多步预测准确度较高,重点狩猎率显著下降。

papers.title: SnowMaster: Comprehensive Real-world Image Desnowing via MLLM with Multi-Model Feedback Optimization
papers.authors: Jianyu Lai, Sixiang Chen, Yunlong Lin, Tian Ye, Yun Liu, Song Fei, Zhaohu Xing, Hongtao Wu, Weiming Wang, Lei Zhu
papers.abstract: Snowfall presents significant challenges for visual data processing, necessitating specialized desnowing algorithms. However, existing models often fail to generalize effectively due to their heavy reliance on synthetic datasets. Furthermore, current real-world snowfall datasets are limited in scale and lack dedicated evaluation metrics designed specifically for snowfall degradation, thus hindering the effective integration of real snowy images into model training to reduce domain gaps. To address these challenges, we first introduce RealSnow10K, a large-scale, high-quality dataset consisting of over 10,000 annotated real-world snowy images. In addition, we curate a preference dataset comprising 36,000 expert-ranked image pairs, enabling the adaptation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to better perceive snowy image quality through our innovative Multi-Model Preference Optimization (MMPO). Finally, we propose the SnowMaster, which employs MMPO-enhanced MLLM to perform accurate snowy image evaluation and pseudo-label filtering for semi-supervised training. Experiments demonstrate that SnowMaster delivers superior desnowing performance under real-world conditions.
papers.title_zh: Snowmaster: 通过多模式反馈优化的 MLLM 将综合真实世界图像通过 MLLM 去除
papers.abstract_zh: 雪落对视觉数据处理提出了重大挑战,需要专门的脱落算法,但是,现有模型由于严重依赖合成数据集,往往无法有效地推广。 此外,目前真实世界降雪数据集的规模有限,缺乏专门为降雪退化设计的专门评价指标,从而阻碍了将真正的降雪图像有效纳入示范培训,以减少领域差距。 为了应对这些挑战,我们首先介绍RealSnow10K,这是一个由10 000多张附加注释的真实世界雪景图像组成的大型高质量数据集。 此外,我们制作了一套优惠数据集,由36 000个专家级图像配对组成,使多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)能够适应,通过我们创新的多模式优化模式(MMPO)更好地了解雪色图像质量。 最后,我们建议使用MMPO增强的 MLLM 的“雪地马斯特 ” ( SnowMaster ) , 进行精确的雪地图像评估和假标签过滤,以进行半监督培训。 实验表明,在现实世界条件下,雪地马斯特能带来超强的脱水性能。

papers.title: Self-Expansion of Pre-trained Models with Mixture of Adapters for Continual Learning
papers.authors: Huiyi Wang, Haodong Lu, Lina Yao, Dong Gong
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) aims to continually accumulate knowledge from a non-stationary data stream without catastrophic forgetting of learned knowledge, requiring a balance between stability and adaptability. Relying on the generalizable representation in pre-trained models (PTMs), PTM-based CL methods perform effective continual adaptation on downstream tasks by adding learnable adapters or prompts upon the frozen PTMs. However, many existing PTM-based CL methods use restricted adaptation on a fixed set of these modules to avoid forgetting, suffering from limited CL ability. Periodically adding task-specific modules results in linear model growth rate and impaired knowledge reuse. We propose Self-Expansion of pre-trained models with Modularized Adaptation (SEMA), a novel approach to enhance the control of stability-plasticity balance in PTM-based CL. SEMA automatically decides to reuse or add adapter modules on demand in CL, depending on whether significant distribution shift that cannot be handled is detected at different representation levels. We design modular adapter consisting of a functional adapter and a representation descriptor. The representation descriptors are trained as a distribution shift indicator and used to trigger self-expansion signals. For better composing the adapters, an expandable weighting router is learned jointly for mixture of adapter outputs. SEMA enables better knowledge reuse and sub-linear expansion rate. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed self-expansion method, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared to PTM-based CL methods without memory rehearsal. Code is available at https://github.com/huiyiwang01/SEMA-CL.
papers.title_zh: 与适应器混合组合的训练前模式的自我推广,用于持续学习
papers.abstract_zh: 持续学习(CL)旨在不断从非静止数据流中积累知识,不至于灾难性地忘记所学知识,要求在稳定和适应性之间保持平衡。 借助在培训前模式中可实现的普遍代表性,基于PTM的CL方法通过增加可学习的适应器或对冻结的PTM的提示,有效地持续适应下游任务。 然而,许多现有的基于PTM的CL方法在固定的这些模块中使用了有限的适应,以避免遗忘,因为CL能力有限。 定期增加任务特定模块的结果是线性模型增长率和知识再利用受损。 我们建议自我推广经过培训的模型,采用模块化适应(SEMA),这是一种新颖的办法,以加强对以PTM为基础的CL中稳定-塑料平衡的控制。 SEMA自动决定重新使用或根据CL的需求添加适应模块,这取决于是否在不同代表级别检测到无法处理的重大分布变化。我们设计模块适应器,由功能适配器和代表描述符组成。 为了更好地组成适应器,联合学习了可扩展的加权路由器,以混合适应器产出。 SEMA使知识得到更好的再利用和次线性扩展速度成为可能。 广泛的实验表明拟议的自我扩展方法的有效性,实现了最先进的性能,而没有进行记忆性排练,而没有进行记忆性排减法的CL方法,代码见https://github.com/huiyiwang01/SEMA-CL。

papers.title: Segmenting Maxillofacial Structures in CBCT Volumes
papers.authors: Federico Bolelli, Kevin Marchesini, Niels van Nistelrooij, Luca Lumetti, Vittorio Pipoli, Elisa Ficarra, Shankeeth Vinayahalingam, Costantino Grana
papers.abstract: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is a standard imaging modality in orofacial and dental practices, providing essential 3D volumetric imaging of anatomical structures, including jawbones, teeth, sinuses, and neurovascular canals. Accurately segmenting these structures is fundamental to numerous clinical applications, such as surgical planning and implant placement. However, manual segmentation of CBCT scans is time-intensive and requires expert input, creating a demand for automated solutions through deep learning. Effective development of such algorithms relies on access to large, well-annotated datasets, yet current datasets are often privately stored or limited in scope and considered structures, especially concerning 3D annotations. This paper proposes ToothFairy2, a comprehensive, publicly accessible CBCT dataset with voxel-level 3D annotations of 42 distinct classes corresponding to maxillofacial structures. We validate the dataset by benchmarking state-of-the-art neural network models, including convolutional, transformer-based, and hybrid Mamba-based architectures, to evaluate segmentation performance across complex anatomical regions. Our work also explores adaptations to the nnU-Net framework to optimize multi-class segmentation for maxillofacial anatomy. The proposed dataset provides a fundamental resource for advancing maxillofacial segmentation and supports future research in automated 3D image analysis in digital dentistry.
papers.title_zh: CBCT 体积中积积积结构
papers.abstract_zh: Cone-波束计算断层摄影(CBCT)是口腔和牙科做法中的一种标准成像模式,提供剖析结构(包括下巴骨、牙齿、鼻梁和神经血管运河)的基本3D体积成像。 准确分割这些结构对于许多临床应用,如外科规划和植入定位等至关重要,然而,CBCT扫描的人工分割需要时间密集,需要专家投入,通过深层学习产生对自动化解决方案的需求。 有效发展这种算法取决于能否获得大量附有说明的数据集,然而,目前的数据集往往在范围和考虑的结构方面,特别是在3D说明方面,是私人储存或有限。 本文提出“牙仙2号”,这是一个综合的、可公开查阅的CBCT数据集,内含与最大叶面结构相对应的42个不同类别的三维氧化物注解。 我们通过对最新神经网络模型,包括革命型、变压型和混合型曼巴型结构进行基准测试,对数据集进行验证,以评估复杂解剖区域分解性能。 我们的工作还探索如何适应NNU-Net框架,以优化最大脊髓畸形解剖的多层分解。 拟议的数据集为推进最大脊椎分解提供了基本资源,并支持今后对数字牙医自动化3D图像分析的研究。

papers.title: SCSegamba: Lightweight Structure-Aware Vision Mamba for Crack Segmentation in Structures
papers.authors: Hui Liu, Chen Jia, Fan Shi, Xu Cheng, Shengyong Chen
papers.abstract: Pixel-level segmentation of structural cracks across various scenarios remains a considerable challenge. Current methods encounter challenges in effectively modeling crack morphology and texture, facing challenges in balancing segmentation quality with low computational resource usage. To overcome these limitations, we propose a lightweight Structure-Aware Vision Mamba Network (SCSegamba), capable of generating high-quality pixel-level segmentation maps by leveraging both the morphological information and texture cues of crack pixels with minimal computational cost. Specifically, we developed a Structure-Aware Visual State Space module (SAVSS), which incorporates a lightweight Gated Bottleneck Convolution (GBC) and a Structure-Aware Scanning Strategy (SASS). The key insight of GBC lies in its effectiveness in modeling the morphological information of cracks, while the SASS enhances the perception of crack topology and texture by strengthening the continuity of semantic information between crack pixels. Experiments on crack benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms other state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, achieving the highest performance with only 2.8M parameters. On the multi-scenario dataset, our method reached 0.8390 in F1 score and 0.8479 in mIoU.
papers.title_zh: SCSegamba: 结构中裂缝分割的轻量结构结构- 视觉视觉 Mamba
papers.abstract_zh: 不同假设情景的结构裂缝的像素分解仍是一个相当大的挑战。 目前的方法在有效模拟裂缝形态和质地方面面临着挑战,在平衡分解质量和低计算资源使用方面面临着挑战。 为了克服这些限制,我们提议建立一个轻量级结构-意识视觉Mamba网络(SCSegamba),能够利用形态信息和裂纹像素的纹理提示,以最低的计算成本制作高质量的像素分解图。 具体地说,我们开发了一个结构-意识视觉国家空间模块(SAVSS),其中包括一个轻量级Gated Bottleneck Conclution(GBC)和一个结构-意识扫描战略(SSSS)。 GBC的关键洞察力在于其在模拟裂缝形态信息方面的有效性,而SASS则通过加强裂缝像素之间语义信息的连续性,增进对裂缝地形学和质地感知。 关于快克基准数据集的实验表明,我们的方法优于其他最先进的方法,只达到2.8M参数的最高性能。 在多设想数据集方面,我们的方法在F1分达到0.8390,在MIOU达到0.8479。

papers.title: Science-T2I: Addressing Scientific Illusions in Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Jialuo Li, Wenhao Chai, Xingyu Fu, Haiyang Xu, Saining Xie
papers.abstract: We present a novel approach to integrating scientific knowledge into generative models, enhancing their realism and consistency in image synthesis. First, we introduce Science-T2I, an expert-annotated adversarial dataset comprising adversarial 20k image pairs with 9k prompts, covering wide distinct scientific knowledge categories. Leveraging Science-T2I, we present SciScore, an end-to-end reward model that refines the assessment of generated images based on scientific knowledge, which is achieved by augmenting both the scientific comprehension and visual capabilities of pre-trained CLIP model. Additionally, based on Science-T2I, we propose a two-stage training framework, comprising a supervised fine-tuning phase and a masked online fine-tuning phase, to incorporate scientific knowledge into existing generative models. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in establishing new standards for evaluating the scientific realism of generated content. Specifically, SciScore attains performance comparable to human-level, demonstrating a 5% improvement similar to evaluations conducted by experienced human evaluators. Furthermore, by applying our proposed fine-tuning method to FLUX, we achieve a performance enhancement exceeding 50% on SciScore.
papers.title_zh: 科学-T2I:在图像合成中处理科学幻觉
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的方法,将科学知识纳入基因模型,加强它们的现实主义和图像合成的一致性。 首先,我们介绍Science-T2I,这是一个专家附加说明的对抗数据集,由对抗性20k图像配对和9k提示组成,涵盖广泛的不同科学知识类别。 利用科学-T2I,我们介绍SciScore,这是一个端到端奖励模式,通过增强预先培训的CLIP模型的科学理解和视觉能力,完善对基于科学知识产生的图像的评估。 此外,根据科学-T2I,我们提议一个两阶段培训框架,包括监督的微调阶段和蒙面的在线微调阶段,以便将科学知识纳入现有的基因模型。 通过全面试验,我们展示了我们框架在为评价所产生内容的科学现实性制定新标准方面的效力。 具体地说,SciScore的成绩与人的水平相当,表明比有经验的人类评价员进行的评价提高了5%。 此外,通过将我们提议的微调方法应用到FLUX,我们在SciScore的绩效提升超过50%。

papers.title: SALOVA: Segment-Augmented Long Video Assistant for Targeted Retrieval and Routing in Long-Form Video Analysis
papers.authors: Junho Kim, Hyunjun Kim, Hosu Lee, Yong Man Ro
papers.abstract: Despite advances in Large Multi-modal Models, applying them to long and untrimmed video content remains challenging due to limitations in context length and substantial memory overhead. These constraints often lead to significant information loss and reduced relevance in the model responses. With the exponential growth of video data across web platforms, understanding long-form video is crucial for advancing generalized intelligence. In this paper, we introduce SALOVA: Segment-Augmented LOng Video Assistant, a novel video-LLM framework designed to enhance the comprehension of lengthy video content through targeted retrieval process. We address two main challenges to achieve it: (i) We present the SceneWalk dataset, a high-quality collection of 87.8K long videos, each densely captioned at the segment level to enable models to capture scene continuity and maintain rich descriptive context. (ii) We develop robust architectural designs integrating dynamic routing mechanism and spatio-temporal projector to efficiently retrieve and process relevant video segments based on user queries. Our framework mitigates the limitations of current video-LMMs by allowing for precise identification and retrieval of relevant video segments in response to queries, thereby improving the contextual relevance of the generated responses. Through extensive experiments, SALOVA demonstrates enhanced capability in processing complex long-form videos, showing significant capability to maintain contextual integrity across extended sequences.
papers.title_zh: SALOVA: 长式视频分析中定向检索和流出部分强化长式视频助理
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在大型多模式模型方面取得了进展,但由于上下文长度的限制和大量的记忆管理费用,将这些模型应用于长长的、未剪短的视频内容仍具有挑战性,这些制约因素往往导致信息大量丢失,并降低了模型答复的相关性。 随着视频数据在网络平台上的指数增长,了解长式视频对于推进普遍情报至关重要。 在本文中,我们介绍SALOVA:部分增强的LOng视频助理,这是一个新颖的视频LLM框架,旨在通过有针对性的检索过程提高对长视频内容的理解。 我们应对实现该目标的两个主要挑战:(一) 我们介绍SceeneWalk数据集,这是87.8K长视频的高质量收集,每个视频都以段段为单位,内容密集,使模型能够捕捉现场的连续性并保持丰富的描述背景。 (二) 我们开发强有力的建筑设计,结合动态路由机制和时空阵列投影机,以便根据用户询问有效检索和处理相关视频段。 我们的框架减轻了目前视频-LMM的局限性,允许在回答询问时准确识别和检索相关视频段,从而改进所收到的答复的关联性。 通过广泛的实验,SALOVA展示了处理复杂长式视频的能力得到加强,显示了在长序列中保持背景完整性的巨大能力。

papers.title: SAGE: Shape-Adapting Gated Experts for Adaptive Histopathology Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Gia Huy Thai, Hoang-Nguyen Vu, Anh-Minh Phan, Quang-Thinh Ly, Tram Dinh, Thi-Ngoc-Truc Nguyen, Nhat Ho
papers.abstract: The significant variability in cell size and shape continues to pose a major obstacle in computer-assisted cancer detection on gigapixel Whole Slide Images (WSIs), due to cellular heterogeneity. Current CNN-Transformer hybrids use static computation graphs with fixed routing. This leads to extra computation and makes it harder to adapt to changes in input. We propose Shape-Adapting Gated Experts (SAGE), an input-adaptive framework that enables dynamic expert routing in heterogeneous visual networks. SAGE reconfigures static backbones into dynamically routed expert architectures via a dual-path design with hierarchical gating and a Shape-Adapting Hub (SA-Hub) that harmonizes feature representations across convolutional and transformer modules. Embodied as SAGE with ConvNeXt and Vision Transformer UNet (SAGE-ConvNeXt+ViT-UNet), our model achieves a Dice score of 95.23 % on EBHI, 92.78 %/91.42 % DSC on GlaS Test A/Test B, and 91.26 % DSC at the WSI level on DigestPath, while exhibiting robust generalization under distribution shifts by adaptively balancing local refinement and global context. SAGE establishes a scalable foundation for dynamic expert routing in visual networks, thereby facilitating flexible visual reasoning.
papers.title_zh: SAGE: 适应性病理病理病理图象分割学专家
papers.abstract_zh: 由于细胞差异性,细胞大小和形状的显著变化继续构成在千兆瓦全幻灯片图像中检测计算机辅助癌症的主要障碍,目前CNN-Transed混合体使用固定路径的静态计算图。 这导致额外的计算,并使得更难适应投入的变化。 我们提议“形状-改进 Gated 专家 ” ( SAGE) , 这是一种投入-适应性框架, 使多功能视觉网络的专家能够动态地运行。 SAGE将静态骨干重新配置为动态式的专家结构,通过一种双路径设计,配有等级格和形状-成形枢纽(SA-Hub),使各种变压模块和变压器模块的特征表现统一起来。 我们的模型与ConvNXt和视觉TransformerUNet(SAGE-ConvNXt+VIT-UNet)的SAGE相联,在EBHI上实现了95.23%的骰子分数,在格拉斯试验A/测试B中实现了92.78%的91.42%的DSC分数,在WSI级的DimportPath中实现了91.26%的DSC分数,同时通过适应性地平衡地方的完善和全球环境,在分布变化中展示了强有力的概括化。 SAGE为视觉网络的动态专家路线奠定了可扩展的基础,从而促进了灵活的视觉推理。

papers.title: Robust Multimodal Survival Prediction with Conditional Latent Differentiation Variational AutoEncoder
papers.authors: Junjie Zhou, Jiao Tang, Yingli Zuo, Peng Wan, Daoqiang Zhang, Wei Shao
papers.abstract: The integrative analysis of histopathological images and genomic data has received increasing attention for survival prediction of human cancers. However, the existing studies always hold the assumption that full modalities are available. As a matter of fact, the cost for collecting genomic data is high, which sometimes makes genomic data unavailable in testing samples. A common way of tackling such incompleteness is to generate the genomic representations from the pathology images. Nevertheless, such strategy still faces the following two challenges: (1) The gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs) are huge and thus hard for representation. (2) It is difficult to generate the genomic embeddings with diverse function categories in a unified generative framework. To address the above challenges, we propose a Conditional Latent Differentiation Variational AutoEncoder (LD-CVAE) for robust multimodal survival prediction, even with missing genomic data. Specifically, a Variational Information Bottleneck Transformer (VIB-Trans) module is proposed to learn compressed pathological representations from the gigapixel WSIs. To generate different functional genomic features, we develop a novel Latent Differentiation Variational AutoEncoder (LD-VAE) to learn the genomic and function-specific posteriors for the genomic embeddings with diverse functions. Finally, we use the product-of-experts technique to integrate the genomic posterior and image posterior for the joint latent distribution estimation in LD-CVAE. We test the effectiveness of our method on five different cancer datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate its superiority in both complete and missing modality scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 具有条件性、即时差异变化式自动编码器的强力多模式生存预测
papers.abstract_zh: 在人类癌症的存活预测方面,对组织病理学图象和基因组数据的综合分析日益受到重视,但是,现有的研究总是假定有完整的模式。 事实上,收集基因组数据的费用很高,有时使基因组数据无法用于测试样品,解决这种不完备问题的一个共同办法是从病理图象中得出基因组的表示。 然而,这种战略仍面临以下两个挑战:(1) 整个幻灯片图象(SWIs)是巨大的,因此很难代表。 (2) 难以在一个统一的基因框架内产生具有不同功能类别的基因组嵌入。 为了应对上述挑战,我们提议建立一个有条件的远程差异变异自动编码器(LD-CVAE),用于稳健的多式联运生存预测,即使缺少基因组数据。 具体地说,提议采用一个变式信息瓶颈变压器模块,以学习从Gappixel WSIs中学到压缩病理表征。 为了产生不同的功能性基因组特征,我们开发了一种新型的远程差异变异自动编码器(LD-VAE),以学习具有不同功能的基因组嵌入的基因组和特定功能的后座。 最后,我们利用专家产品技术,将基因组后台和图像后台结合到LD-CVAE的共同潜在分布估计中。 我们在五个不同的癌症数据集上测试我们的方法的有效性,实验结果显示,在完整和缺失的模式情景中,我们的方法具有优越性。

papers.title: RoboTwin: Dual-Arm Robot Benchmark with Generative Digital Twins
papers.authors: Yao Mu, Tianxing Chen, Zanxin Chen, Shijia Peng, Zhiqian Lan, Zeyu Gao, Zhixuan Liang, Qiaojun Yu, Yude Zou, Mingkun Xu, Lunkai Lin, Zhiqiang Xie, Mingyu Ding, Ping Luo
papers.abstract: In the rapidly advancing field of robotics, dual-arm coordination and complex object manipulation are essential capabilities for developing advanced autonomous systems. However, the scarcity of diverse, high-quality demonstration data and real-world-aligned evaluation benchmarks severely limits such development. To address this, we introduce RoboTwin, a generative digital twin framework that uses 3D generative foundation models and large language models to produce diverse expert datasets and provide a real-world-aligned evaluation platform for dual-arm robotic tasks. Specifically, RoboTwin creates varied digital twins of objects from single 2D images, generating realistic and interactive scenarios. It also introduces a spatial relation-aware code generation framework that combines object annotations with large language models to break down tasks, determine spatial constraints, and generate precise robotic movement code. Our framework offers a comprehensive benchmark with both simulated and real-world data, enabling standardized evaluation and better alignment between simulated training and real-world performance. We validated our approach using the open-source COBOT Magic Robot platform. Policies pre-trained on RoboTwin-generated data and fine-tuned with limited real-world samples demonstrate significant potential for enhancing dual-arm robotic manipulation systems by improving success rates by over 70% for single-arm tasks and over 40% for dual-arm tasks compared to models trained solely on real-world data.
papers.title_zh: RoboTwin:双臂机器人基准,带有创世数字双双
papers.abstract_zh: 在迅速发展的机器人领域,双武器协调和复杂的物体操纵是发展先进自主系统的基本能力,但是,缺乏多样化的高质量示范数据和符合现实世界的评价基准,严重限制了这种发展。 为此,我们引入了机器人双胞胎,这是一个基因化数字双胞胎框架,使用3D基因基础模型和大型语言模型来制作各种专家数据集,并为双臂机器人任务提供一个与现实世界一致的评价平台。 具体地说,RoboTwin从单一的2D图像中创造出各种数字双胞胎,产生现实和互动的情景。 它还引入了一个空间关系意识代码生成框架,将物体说明与大语言模型结合起来,以拆分任务、确定空间制约因素和生成精确的机器人移动代码。 我们的框架提供了一个包含模拟数据和真实世界数据的全面基准,使得能够进行标准化评价,并使模拟培训和真实世界业绩之间更加一致。 我们用开放源码COBOT机器人平台验证了我们的方法。 预先培训了机器人双向生成数据的政策,并微调了有限的真实世界样本,这表明,通过将单臂任务的成功率提高70%以上,将双臂任务的成功率提高40%以上,而只对实际世界数据进行培训的模式则只是将单臂任务的成功率提高40%以上,从而在加强双臂机器人操纵系统方面具有巨大潜力。

papers.title: RoadSocial: A Diverse VideoQA Dataset and Benchmark for Road Event Understanding from Social Video Narratives
papers.authors: Chirag Parikh, Deepti Rawat, Rakshitha R. T., Tathagata Ghosh, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla
papers.abstract: We introduce RoadSocial, a large-scale, diverse VideoQA dataset tailored for generic road event understanding from social media narratives. Unlike existing datasets limited by regional bias, viewpoint bias and expert-driven annotations, RoadSocial captures the global complexity of road events with varied geographies, camera viewpoints (CCTV, handheld, drones) and rich social discourse. Our scalable semi-automatic annotation framework leverages Text LLMs and Video LLMs to generate comprehensive question-answer pairs across 12 challenging QA tasks, pushing the boundaries of road event understanding. RoadSocial is derived from social media videos spanning 14M frames and 414K social comments, resulting in a dataset with 13.2K videos, 674 tags and 260K high-quality QA pairs. We evaluate 18 Video LLMs (open-source and proprietary, driving-specific and general-purpose) on our road event understanding benchmark. We also demonstrate RoadSocial's utility in improving road event understanding capabilities of general-purpose Video LLMs.
papers.title_zh: 《道路社会:不同视频QA数据集和从社会视频叙事理解路边活动基准》
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出“路社”(Road Social)这个大型、多样的视频QA数据集, 与受区域偏见、观点偏见和专家驱动的说明所限制的现有数据集不同,路社协会以不同的地理分布、相机观点(CCTV、手持、无人驾驶飞机)和丰富的社会讨论,捕捉了道路事件的全球复杂性。 我们可扩缩的半自动说明框架利用Text LLMs和视频LLMs,在12项具有挑战性的质量保证任务中生成全面的问答配对,推动对道路事件理解的界限。 《道路社会》来自涵盖14M框架和414K社会评论的社交媒体视频,产生了13.2K视频、674个标签和260K高质量QA配对的数据集,我们评估了道路事件理解基准的18个视频LMS(开放源码和专有、专用和通用)。 我们还展示了道路社会在提高一般用途视频LMs对道路活动理解能力的有用性。

papers.title: RipVIS: Rip Currents Video Instance Segmentation Benchmark for Beach Monitoring and Safety
papers.authors: Andrei Dumitriu, Florin Tatui, Florin Miron, Aakash Ralhan, Radu Tudor Ionescu, Radu Timofte
papers.abstract: Rip currents are strong, localized and narrow currents of water that flow outwards into the sea, causing numerous beach-related injuries and fatalities worldwide. Accurate identification of rip currents remains challenging due to their amorphous nature and the lack of annotated data, which often requires expert knowledge. To address these issues, we present RipVIS, a large-scale video instance segmentation benchmark explicitly designed for rip current segmentation. RipVIS is an order of magnitude larger than previous datasets, featuring 184 videos (212,328 frames), of which 150 videos (163,528 frames) are with rip currents, collected from various sources, including drones, mobile phones, and fixed beach cameras. Our dataset encompasses diverse visual contexts, such as wave-breaking patterns, sediment flows, and water color variations, across multiple global locations, including USA, Mexico, Costa Rica, Portugal, Italy, Greece, Romania, Sri Lanka, Australia and New Zealand. Most videos are annotated at 5 FPS to ensure accuracy in dynamic scenarios, supplemented by an additional 34 videos (48,800 frames) without rip currents. We conduct comprehensive experiments with Mask R-CNN, Cascade Mask R-CNN, SparseInst and YOLO11, fine-tuning these models for the task of rip current segmentation. Results are reported in terms of multiple metrics, with a particular focus on the F2 score to prioritize recall and reduce false negatives. To enhance segmentation performance, we introduce a novel post-processing step based on Temporal Confidence Aggregation (TCA). RipVIS aims to set a new standard for rip current segmentation, contributing towards safer beach environments. We offer a benchmark website to share data, models, and results with the research community, encouraging ongoing collaboration and future contributions, at https://ripvis.ai.
papers.title_zh: RipVIS: 海滩监测与安全的提取洋流视频事件分类基准
papers.abstract_zh: 流向海洋的水流强劲、局部和狭窄,造成世界各地与海滩有关的无数伤亡。 准确识别裂流仍然具有挑战性,因为裂流具有不固定的性质,而且缺乏附带说明的数据,而这往往需要专业知识。 为了解决这些问题,我们介绍了RipVIS(RipVIS ) ( RipVIS ) ( RipVIS ) ( RipVIS ) ( RipVIS ) ( RipVIS ) ) , 这个大规模视频实例分割基准是专门为裂流当前分割设计的。 RipVIS是一个规模大于以往的数据集的级级,包含184个视频(212 328个框架),其中150个视频(163 528个框架)带有裂流,来自各种来源,包括无人驾驶飞机、移动电话和固定海滩摄像机。 我们的数据集包含不同的视觉背景,如波浪破碎模式、沉积物流和水色变化,跨越多个全球地点,包括美国、墨西哥、哥斯达黎加、葡萄牙、意大利、希腊、罗马尼亚、斯里兰卡、澳大利亚和新西兰。 大部分视频都是在5个FPS上加注的,以确保动态情景的准确性,另外还有34个视频(48 800框架)没有裂纹。 我们与Mask R-CNN、Cascade Mask R-CNN、SprassInst和YOLO11进行了全面实验,对这些模型进行微调,以完成裂纹当前分割任务。 以多种衡量标准报告结果,特别侧重于F2分,以优先召回和减少虚假负值。 为了提高分化性能,我们引入了基于时间信任聚合的新颖的后处理步骤(TCA ) 。 RipVIS旨在为裂流分割制定新的标准,促进更安全的海滩环境。 我们提供了一个基准网站,与研究界分享数据、模型和结果,鼓励正在进行的合作和今后的贡献,网址是https://ripvis.ai。

papers.title: ReID5o: Achieving Omni Multi-modal Person Re-identification in a Single Model
papers.authors: Jialong Zuo, Yongtai Deng, Mengdan Tan, Rui Jin, Dongyue Wu, Nong Sang, Liang Pan, Changxin Gao
papers.abstract: In real-word scenarios, person re-identification (ReID) expects to identify a person-of-interest via the descriptive query, regardless of whether the query is a single modality or a combination of multiple modalities. However, existing methods and datasets remain constrained to limited modalities, failing to meet this requirement. Therefore, we investigate a new challenging problem called Omni Multi-modal Person Re-identification (OM-ReID), which aims to achieve effective retrieval with varying multi-modal queries. To address dataset scarcity, we construct ORBench, the first high-quality multi-modal dataset comprising 1,000 unique identities across five modalities: RGB, infrared, color pencil, sketch, and textual description. This dataset also has significant superiority in terms of diversity, such as the painting perspectives and textual information. It could serve as an ideal platform for follow-up investigations in OM-ReID. Moreover, we propose ReID5o, a novel multi-modal learning framework for person ReID. It enables synergistic fusion and cross-modal alignment of arbitrary modality combinations in a single model, with a unified encoding and multi-expert routing mechanism proposed. Extensive experiments verify the advancement and practicality of our ORBench. A wide range of possible models have been evaluated and compared on it, and our proposed ReID5o model gives the best performance. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Zplusdragon/ReID5o_ORBench.
papers.title_zh: ReID5o:在单一模式中实现全模式多模式人的重新确认
papers.abstract_zh: 在真实的字句情景中,个人重新识别(ReID)预期通过描述性Query确定有关的人,而不论Query是单一模式还是多种模式的组合。 然而,现有方法和数据集仍受有限模式的限制,无法满足这一要求,因此,我们调查了一个新的挑战性问题,称为 " 全体多模式人员重新识别 " (OM-ReID),其目的是通过不同模式的Query实现有效检索。 为了解决数据集稀缺问题,我们建造了ORBENCH,这是第一个高质量的多模式数据集,包括以下五种模式的1,000个独特身份:RGB、红外线、彩色铅笔、草图和文字描述。 这一数据集在多样性方面也具有显著优势,例如绘画视角和文字信息,可以作为OM-ReID的后续调查的理想平台,此外,我们提议ReID5o,这是一个新的个人ReID多模式学习框架。 它能够使任意方式组合在单一模式下产生协同结合和跨模式的结合,并提议一个统一的编码和多专家路线机制,进行广泛的实验,核查我们ORBENCH的进展和实用性。 已经对各种可能的模式进行了评估和比较,我们拟议的ReID5o模型表现最佳,数据集和代码将在https://github.com/Zpladragon/ReID5o_ORBench上公布。

papers.title: Rashomon Sets for Prototypical-Part Networks: Editing Interpretable Models in Real-Time
papers.authors: Jon Donnelly, Zhicheng Guo, Alina Jade Barnett, Hayden McTavish, Chaofan Chen, Cynthia Rudin
papers.abstract: Interpretability is critical for machine learning models in high-stakes settings because it allows users to verify the model's reasoning. In computer vision, prototypical part models (ProtoPNets) have become the dominant model type to meet this need. Users can easily identify flaws in ProtoPNets, but fixing problems in a ProtoPNet requires slow, difficult retraining that is not guaranteed to resolve the issue. This problem is called the "interaction bottleneck." We solve the interaction bottleneck for ProtoPNets by simultaneously finding many equally good ProtoPNets (i.e., a draw from a "Rashomon set"). We show that our framework - called Proto-RSet - quickly produces many accurate, diverse ProtoPNets, allowing users to correct problems in real time while maintaining performance guarantees with respect to the training set. We demonstrate the utility of this method in two settings: 1) removing synthetic bias introduced to a bird-identification model and 2) debugging a skin cancer identification model. This tool empowers non-machine-learning experts, such as clinicians or domain experts, to quickly refine and correct machine learning models without repeated retraining by machine learning experts.
papers.title_zh: Rashomon 原型部件网络集:实时编辑可解释模型
papers.abstract_zh: 解释性对于高取量环境下的机器学习模型至关重要,因为它让用户能够验证模型的推理。 在计算机视觉中,原型部件模型(ProtoPNets)已经成为满足这一需要的主要模型类型。 用户可以很容易地发现ProtoPNets的缺陷,但解决ProtoPNet的问题需要缓慢而困难的再培训,而再培训不能保证解决这个问题。 这个问题被称为“ 互动瓶颈 ” 。 我们同时找到许多同样好的 ProtoPNets( 即来自“ Rashomon 集 ” ( Rashomon set) ) , 来解决ProtoPNets 的交互瓶颈 。 我们表明,我们的框架——称为Proto-RSet——迅速产生许多准确、多样的ProtoPNets,使用户能够实时纠正问题,同时保持对培训的绩效保障。 我们证明这种方法在两种情况下是有用的:(1) 消除鸟类识别模型中引入的合成偏差;(2) 调试皮肤癌识别模型。 这一工具使非机械学习专家,如临床医生或域专家等能够迅速完善和纠正机器学习模式,而无需机器学习专家反复再培训。

papers.title: Pyramidal Adaptive Cross-Gating for Multimodal Detection
papers.authors: Zidong Gu, Shoufu Tian
papers.abstract: Object detection in aerial imagery is a critical task in applications such as UAV reconnaissance. Although existing methods have extensively explored feature interaction between different modalities, they commonly rely on simple fusion strategies for feature aggregation. This introduces two critical flaws: it is prone to cross-modal noise and disrupts the hierarchical structure of the feature pyramid, thereby impairing the fine-grained detection of small objects. To address this challenge, we propose the Pyramidal Adaptive Cross-Gating Network (PACGNet), an architecture designed to perform deep fusion within the backbone. To this end, we design two core components: the Symmetrical Cross-Gating (SCG) module and the Pyramidal Feature-aware Multimodal Gating (PFMG) module. The SCG module employs a bidirectional, symmetrical "horizontal" gating mechanism to selectively absorb complementary information, suppress noise, and preserve the semantic integrity of each modality. The PFMG module reconstructs the feature hierarchy via a progressive hierarchical gating mechanism. This leverages the detailed features from a preceding, higher-resolution level to guide the fusion at the current, lower-resolution level, effectively preserving fine-grained details as features propagate. Through evaluations conducted on the DroneVehicle and VEDAI datasets, our PACGNet sets a new state-of-the-art benchmark, with mAP50 scores reaching 82.2% and 82.1% respectively.
papers.title_zh: 用于多式探测的双膜适应性交叉定位
papers.abstract_zh: 航空图像中的物体探测是无人驾驶航空器侦察等应用中的一项关键任务,虽然现有方法广泛探索了不同模式之间的特征交互,但通常依靠简单的聚合战略进行特征汇总。 这带来了两个严重的缺陷:它容易发生超现代噪音,扰乱特征金字塔的等级结构,从而损害对小物体的精细探测。 为了应对这一挑战,我们建议建立 " 潮湿适应性交叉定位网络(PACGNet) " (PACGNet),这是一个旨在在骨干内进行深度融合的建筑。 为此,我们设计了两个核心组成部分:对称交叉定位模块和潮湿地貌多式组合模块。 SCG模块使用双向、对称的“横向”标签机制,有选择地吸收补充信息,抑制噪音,并维护每种模式的语义完整性。 PFMG模块通过渐进等级机制重建特征等级。 这利用了前一个高分辨率层次的详细特征,指导当前低分辨率水平的聚合,随着特征的传播,有效保存细细的细微细节。 通过对DroneVehicle和VEDAI数据集进行的评估,我们的PACGNet建立了新的最新基准,MAP50得分分别达到82.2%和82.1%。

papers.title: PromptHash:Affinity-Prompted Collaborative Cross-Modal Learning for Adaptive Hashing Retrieval
papers.authors: Qiang Zou, Shuli Cheng, Jiayi Chen
papers.abstract: Cross-modal hashing is a promising approach for efficient data retrieval and storage optimization. However, contemporary methods exhibit significant limitations in semantic preservation, contextual integrity, and information redundancy, which constrains retrieval efficacy. We present PromptHash, an innovative framework leveraging affinity prompt-aware collaborative learning for adaptive cross-modal hashing. We propose an end-to-end framework for affinity-prompted collaborative hashing, with the following fundamental technical contributions: (i) a text affinity prompt learning mechanism that preserves contextual information while maintaining parameter efficiency, (ii) an adaptive gated selection fusion architecture that synthesizes State Space Model with Transformer network for precise cross-modal feature integration, and (iii) a prompt affinity alignment strategy that bridges modal heterogeneity through hierarchical contrastive learning. To the best of our knowledge, this study presents the first investigation into affinity prompt awareness within collaborative cross-modal adaptive hash learning, establishing a paradigm for enhanced semantic consistency across modalities. Through comprehensive evaluation on three benchmark multi-label datasets, PromptHash demonstrates substantial performance improvements over existing approaches. Notably, on the NUS-WIDE dataset, our method achieves significant gains of 18.22% and 18.65% in image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval tasks, respectively. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShiShuMo/PromptHash.
papers.title_zh: PenthHash: 适应性散列回收回收利用的亲近、促进合作跨模式学习
papers.abstract_zh: 跨模式散列是高效数据检索和储存优化的一个很有希望的方法,但当代方法在语义保存、背景完整性和信息冗余方面都存在重大局限性,这限制了检索的功效。 我们提出 " 迅速哈什 " 倡议,这是一个创新框架,它利用亲近、即时觉悟的合作学习促进适应性跨模式散列。 我们提议一个 " 端对端 " 框架,用于促进近亲合作散列,并作出以下基本技术贡献:(一) 文本 " 亲和 " 即时学习机制 " ,既保留背景信息,又保持参数效率;(二) 适应性封闭式选择聚合结构,将国家空间模型与Transformer网络结合起来,以精确的跨模式特征整合;(三) 迅速 " 亲和 " 协调战略,通过等级对比学习,将模式异质连接起来。 就我们所知,本研究报告首次调查了在合作性的跨模式适应性散列学习中亲和即时认识的问题,为加强不同模式的语义一致性树立了范例。 通过对三个基准多标签数据集的全面评价,PaintHash展示了与现有方法相比的显著业绩改进。 值得注意的是,在NUS-WIDE数据集方面,我们的方法在图像到文本和文字到图像检索任务方面分别取得了18.22%和18.65%的显著收益。 该守则可在https://github.com/ShishShumo/PromptHash上公开查阅。

papers.title: Pixel-SAIL: Single Transformer For Pixel-Grounded Understanding
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Xiangtai Li, Zilong Huang, Yanwei Li, Weixian Lei, Xueqing Deng, Shihao Chen, Shunping Ji, Jiashi Feng
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve remarkable performance for fine-grained pixel-level understanding tasks. However, all the works rely heavily on extra components, such as vision encoder (CLIP), segmentation experts, leading to high system complexity and limiting model scaling. In this work, our goal is to explore a highly simplified MLLM without introducing extra components. Our work is motivated by the recent works on Single trAnsformer as a unified vIsion-Language Model (SAIL) design, where these works jointly learn vision tokens and text tokens in transformers. We present Pixel-SAIL, a single transformer for pixel-wise MLLM tasks. In particular, we present three technical improvements on the plain baseline. First, we design a learnable upsampling module to refine visual token features. Secondly, we propose a novel visual prompt injection strategy to enable the single transformer to understand visual prompt inputs and benefit from the early fusion of visual prompt embeddings and vision tokens. Thirdly, we introduce a vision expert distillation strategy to efficiently enhance the single transformer's fine-grained feature extraction capability. In addition, we have collected a comprehensive pixel understanding benchmark (PerBench), using a manual check. It includes three tasks: detailed object description, visual prompt-based question answering, and visual-text referring segmentation. Extensive experiments on four referring segmentation benchmarks, one visual prompt benchmark, and our PerBench show that our Pixel-SAIL achieves comparable or even better results with a much simpler pipeline. Code and model will be released at https://github.com/magic-research/Sa2VA.
papers.title_zh: 像素- SAIL: 用于像素四面了解的单一Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: 多式大语言模式在细微的像素级理解任务方面取得了显著成绩,但是,所有工作都严重依赖额外组成部分,如视觉编码器(CLIP)和分区专家,导致系统高度复杂,限制了模式规模。 在这项工作中,我们的目标是探索一个高度简化的 MLLM , 而不引入额外的组件。 我们工作的动力是最近关于单一变压器作为统一的 vISON-Language 模型设计(SAIL)的工程,这些工程在变压器中共同学习视觉符号和文本符号。 我们提出像素- SAIL, 用于像素- 智能 MLLM 任务的单一变压器。 特别是, 我们提出了三个简单的基线技术改进。 首先, 我们设计了一个可学习的模拟模块, 以完善视觉符号特性 。 第二,我们提议一个新的视觉快速注射战略,使单一变压器能够理解视觉快速投入,并受益于视觉快速嵌入器和视觉标志的早期融合。 第三,我们引入了视觉专家蒸馏战略,以有效增强单一变压器精细地貌提取能力。 此外,我们通过人工检查收集了全面的像素理解基准(PerBench ) 。 它包括三项任务:详细的物体说明、直观即时回答问题和视觉-文字参考分解。 有关四个参考分解基准、一个直观快速基准和我们的PerBench的广泛实验表明,我们的像素-SAIL通过一个简单得多的管道取得了可比甚至更好的结果。 代码和模型将在https://github.com/magic-research/Sa2VA上公布。

papers.title: PEACE: Empowering Geologic Map Holistic Understanding with MLLMs
papers.authors: Yangyu Huang, Tianyi Gao, Haoran Xu, Qihao Zhao, Yang Song, Zhipeng Gui, Tengchao Lv, Hao Chen, Lei Cui, Scarlett Li, Furu Wei
papers.abstract: Geologic map, as a fundamental diagram in geology science, provides critical insights into the structure and composition of Earth's subsurface and surface. These maps are indispensable in various fields, including disaster assessment, resource exploration, and civil engineering. Despite their significance, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often fall short in geologic map understanding. This gap is primarily due to the challenging nature of cartographic generalization, which involves handling high-resolution map, managing multiple associated components, and requiring domain-specific knowledge. To quantify this gap, we construct **GeoMap-Bench**, the first-ever benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in geologic map understanding, which assesses the full-scale abilities in extracting, referring, grounding, reasoning, and analyzing. To bridge this gap, we introduce **GeoMap-Agent**, the inaugural agent designed for geologic map understanding, which features three modules: Hierarchical Information Extraction (HIE), Domain Knowledge Injection (DKI), and Prompt-enhanced Question Answering (PEQA). Inspired by the interdisciplinary collaboration among human scientists, an AI expert group acts as consultants, utilizing a diverse tool pool to comprehensively analyze questions. Through comprehensive experiments, GeoMap-Agent achieves an overall score of 0.811 on GeoMap-Bench, significantly outperforming 0.369 of GPT-4o. Our work, em**P**owering g**E**ologic m**A**p holisti**C** und**E**rstanding (**PEACE**) with MLLMs, paves the way for advanced AI applications in geology, enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of geological investigations. The code and data are available at https://github.com/microsoft/PEACE.
papers.title_zh: PEACE: 与MLLLMs一起增强地理地图整体理解能力
papers.abstract_zh: 地质地图作为地质科学的基本图表,对地球地表以下和地表的结构和构成提供了至关重要的洞察力,这些地图在灾害评估、资源勘探和土木工程等各个领域不可或缺。 尽管具有重大意义,但目前的多式大语言模型在地质地图理解方面往往不尽如人意。 这一差距主要是由于地图的概括具有挑战性,涉及处理高分辨率地图、管理多个相关组成部分和需要特定领域知识。 为了量化这一差距,我们建造了** GeoMap-Bench**,这是在地质地图理解中评价最低时程模型的第一个基准,该基准评估了提取、Query、定位、推理和分析的全面能力。 为了弥合这一差距,我们介绍**GeoMap-Agency**,这是为地质地图理解设计的初始代理,它有三个模块:等级信息提取(HIE)、域知识注射(DKI)和快速强化的回答问题(PEQA)。 在人类科学家跨学科合作的启发下,大赦国际的一个专家组充当顾问,利用各种工具库全面分析问题。 通过全面试验,地理测绘局在地理测绘区取得0.811的总分,大大超过GPT-4o的0.369分。 我们的工作包括:** P** 向G** E**ologic m** A**p holisti** C** und** E**rstanti (** PEACE**) 与MLLMs合作,为先进的AI应用于地质学铺平了道路,提高了地质调查的效率和准确性,代码和数据见https://github.com/microsoft/PEACE。

papers.title: OneGT: One-Shot Geometry-Texture Neural Rendering for Head Avatars
papers.authors: Jinshu Chen · Bingchuan Li · Fan Zhang · Songtao Zhao · Qian HE
papers.abstract: Existing solutions for creating high-fidelity digital head avatars encounter various obstacles. Traditional rendering tools offer realistic results, while heavily requiring expert skills. Neural rendering methods are more efficient but often compromise between the generated fidelity and flexibility. We present OneGT that, for the first time, adheres to the frameworks of the rendering tools, while restructuring individual stages of the rendering pipeline through neural networks. OneGT maintains high systemic interpretability, inheriting the superior performances of neural rendering approaches. Specifically, OneGT contains a skeleton-anchoring stage and a texture-rendering stage, in which well-designed Transformers learn the geometric transformations and the proposed reference-perceptible DiT renders the textures respectively. Our framework learns geometric consistency from the innovatively introduced synthetic data, thus achieving superior performance while requiring only 10%-30% of the real-world data typically used by competitive methods. Experimental results demonstrate that OneGT achieves high fidelity in producing portrait avatars, meanwhile maintaining the flexibility of editing.
papers.title_zh: 1GT: 首席神户的单位几何测量仪式神经神经测试
papers.abstract_zh: 创造高忠诚度数字头骨的现有解决方案遇到了各种障碍。 传统化工具提供了现实的结果,同时非常需要专家技能。 神经化方法效率更高,但往往在生成的忠诚和灵活性之间有所妥协。 我们首次提出一个GT,它遵守了制造工具的框架,同时对通过神经网络输送管道的各个阶段进行了重组。 一个GT保持高度系统的可解释性,继承了神经制造方法的优异性能。 具体地说,OneGT包含一个骨架组合阶段和一个质地转换阶段,在这个阶段,设计完善的变形器学习几何变形,而拟议的参考可感知 DiT 则分别使这些质地变得质地。 我们的框架从创新引进的合成数据中学习几何一致性,从而取得优异的性能,而通常通过竞争方法使用的实际世界数据仅需要10%-30%。 实验结果表明,OneGT在制作肖像阿凡达方面实现了高度忠诚,同时保持了编辑的灵活性。

papers.title: One-Minute Video Generation with Test-Time Training
papers.authors: Karan Dalal, Daniel Koceja, Jiarui Xu, Yue Zhao, Shihao Han, Ka Chun Cheung, Jan Kautz, Yejin Choi, Yu Sun, Xiaolong Wang
papers.abstract: Transformers today still struggle to generate one-minute videos because self-attention layers are inefficient for long context. Alternatives such as Mamba layers struggle to produce coherent scenes because their hidden states are small and less expressive. We experiment with Test-Time Training (TTT) layers, whose hidden states themselves can be neural networks, therefore larger and more expressive. Adding TTT layers into a pre-trained Transformer enables it to generate one-minute videos from text storyboards. We curate a dataset based on Tom and Jerry cartoons as a proof-of-concept benchmark. Compared to baselines such as Mamba 2, Gated DeltaNet, and sliding-window attention layers, TTT layers generate much more coherent videos that tell complete stories, leading by 34 Elo points in a human evaluation of 100 videos per method. Although promising, our results are still limited in physical realism, and the efficiency of our implementation can be further improved. Sample videos, code and annotations are available at: https://test-time-training.github.io/video-dit
papers.title_zh: 带有测试时间培训的一次性视频制作
papers.abstract_zh: 如今,变异者仍在挣扎着制作一分钟的视频,因为自我关注层在长背景下效率低下。 类似曼巴层的替代品因为其隐藏状态小且不那么直观而为产生一致的场景而挣扎。 我们实验了测试时间培训(TTT)层,其隐藏状态本身可以是神经网络,因此规模更大,更能表达。 将TTT层添加到培训前的变形器中,使其能够从文字故事板上生成一分钟的视频。 我们根据汤姆和杰里卡通 制作了一个数据集,作为概念的证明基准。 与Mamba 2、Gated DeltaNet 和滑坡窗口关注层等基线相比, TTT 层制作的视频更加连贯, 虽然我们的成果很有希望,但实际现实主义方面的结果仍然有限,我们执行的效率还可以进一步提高,例如录像样本、代码和说明可在以下网址查阅:https://test-time-training.github.io/victive-dit。

papers.title: Olympus: A Universal Task Router for Computer Vision Tasks
papers.authors: Yuanze Lin, Yunsheng Li, Dongdong Chen, Weijian Xu, Ronald Clark, Philip Torr
papers.abstract: We introduce Olympus, a new approach that transforms Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into a unified framework capable of handling a wide array of computer vision tasks. Utilizing a controller MLLM, Olympus delegates over 20 specialized tasks across images, videos, and 3D objects to dedicated modules. This instruction-based routing enables complex workflows through chained actions without the need for training heavy generative models. Olympus easily integrates with existing MLLMs, expanding their capabilities with comparable performance. Experimental results demonstrate that Olympus achieves an average routing accuracy of 94.75% across 20 tasks and precision of 91.82% in chained action scenarios, showcasing its effectiveness as a universal task router that can solve a diverse range of computer vision tasks.
papers.title_zh: Olympus:计算机视觉任务通用任务路由器
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了奥林匹斯(Olympus ) , 这是一种将多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)转化为一个能够处理各种计算机视觉任务的统一框架的新方法。 将控制器MLLM( MLLM ) 、 奥林匹斯(Olympus)代表超过20项专门任务, 包括图像、 视频和 3D 对象, 用于专门的模块 。 这种基于指令的路线使得通过连锁行动而无需培训重基因模型的复杂工作流程得以实现。 奥林匹斯(Olympus)很容易与现有的MLLMs(MLLMs)结合,从而以可比较的性能扩大其能力。 实验结果表明,Olympus在20项任务中实现了平均路线精确度94.75%,在连锁行动情景中实现了91.82%的精确度91.82%,这表明它作为能够解决各种计算机视觉任务的通用任务路由器的有效性。

papers.title: ODA-GAN: Orthogonal Decoupling Alignment GAN Assisted by Weakly-supervised Learning for Virtual Immunohistochemistry Staining
papers.authors: Tong Wang, Mingkang Wang, Zhongze Wang, Hongkai Wang, Qi Xu, Fengyu Cong, Hongming Xu
papers.abstract: Recently, virtual staining has emerged as a promising alternative to revolutionize histological staining by digitally generating stains. However, most existing methods suffer from the curse of staining unreality and unreliability. In this paper, we propose the Orthogonal Decoupling Alignment Generative Adversarial Network (ODA-GAN) for unpaired virtual immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining. Our approach is based on the assumption that an image consists of IHC staining-related features, which influence staining distribution and intensity, and staining-unrelated features, such as tissue morphology. Leveraging a pathology foundation model, we first develop a weakly-supervised segmentation pipeline as an alternative to expert annotations. We introduce an Orthogonal MLP (O-MLP) module to project image features into an orthogonal space, decoupling them into staining-related and unrelated components. Additionally, we propose a Dual-stream PatchNCE (DPNCE) loss to resolve contrastive learning contradictions in the staining-related space, thereby enhancing staining accuracy. To further improve realism, we introduce a Multi-layer Domain Alignment (MDA) module to bridge the domain gap between generated and real IHC images. Evaluations on three benchmark datasets show that our ODA-GAN reaches state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Our source code is available at https://github.com/ittong/ODA-GAN.
papers.title_zh: MADA-GAN:通过微弱监督的虚拟免疫史化学储存学习辅助的常规解耦协调GAN
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,虚拟污点已经出现,成为通过数字生成污点来革命性历史污点的有希望的替代方法。 然而,大多数现有方法都受到污点不真实和不可靠的诅咒。 在本文中,我们提议为未接受的虚拟免疫史化学(IHC)染色而建立矫形解耦协调基因反转网络(ODA-GAN)。 我们的方法所依据的假设是,一种图像包含与国际健康标准有关的污点特征,这些特征影响污点分布和强度,以及与污点无关的特征,如组织形态学。 利用病理学基础模型,我们首先开发了一条受微弱监督的分解管道,作为专家注释的替代。我们引入了一个正正方形 MLP(O-MLP)模块,将图像特性投射到正方形空间,将其分离成与污点相关和无关的部件。 此外,我们提议进行双流补丁补丁(DPNCE)损失,以解决与污点有关的空间中对比鲜明的学习矛盾,从而提高污点的准确性。 为了进一步改善现实主义,我们引入了一个多层域对齐模块,以弥合生成的和真实的IHC图像之间的领域差距。 对三个基准数据集的评估表明,我们的官方发展援助全球网络达到了最新水平。 我们的来源代码可在https://github.com/ittong/ODA-GAN上查阅。

papers.title: Navigating the Unseen: Zero-shot Scene Graph Generation via Capsule-Based Equivariant Features
papers.authors: Wenhuan Huang, Yi JI, Guiqian Zhu, Li Ying, Chunping Liu
papers.abstract: In scene graph generation (SGG), the accurate prediction of unseen triples is essential for its effectiveness in downstream vision-language tasks. We hypothesize that the predicates of unseen triples can be viewed as transformations of seen predicates in feature space, and the essence of the zero-shot task is to bridge the gap caused by this transformation. Traditional models, however, have difficulty addressing this challenge, which we attribute to their inability to model the predicates equivariant. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a novel framework based on capsule networks (CAPSGG). We propose a Three-Stream Pipeline that generates modality-specific representations for predicates, while building low-level predicate capsules of these modalities. Then these capsules are aggregated into high-level predicate capsules using a Routing Capsule Layer. In addition, we introduce GroupLoss to aggregate capsules with the same predicate label into groups. This replaces the global loss with the intra-group loss, effectively balancing the learning of predicate invariance and equivariant features, while mitigating the impact of the severe long-tail distribution of the predicate categories. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the notable superiority of our approach over state-of-the-art methods, with zero-shot indicators outperforming up to 132.26% on SGCls task than the T-CAR [21]. Our code will be available upon publication.
papers.title_zh: 导航未见光:通过基于 Capsule 的等效地貌生成零弹射场景图
papers.abstract_zh: 在现场图表生成(SGG)中,准确预测不可见的三联数对于其在下游视觉语言任务中的有效性至关重要。 我们假设,可以将不可见的三重物的上游物视为特征空间所见上游物的转变,零结果任务的实质是弥合这一转变所造成的差距。 然而,传统模式难以应对这一挑战,我们把这一挑战归咎于它们无法模拟上游变异。 为了克服这一限制,我们引入了一个基于胶囊网络的新框架(CAPSGG ) 。 我们建议使用三层管道,在建立这些模式的低层上游胶囊的同时,生成特定方式的上游代表,然后将这些胶囊用例常胶囊制成高层上游胶囊。 此外,我们还采用GroupLos, 将带有同一上层标签的胶囊合成成组。 这取代了全球损失,代之以集团内部损失,有效地平衡了对上游变化和等同特征的学习,同时减轻了上游类别严重长尾分布的影响。 我们的广泛实验表明,我们的做法明显优于最先进的方法,在SGCls任务上,零结果指标比T-CAR[21]高132.26%。 我们的代码将在公布时公布。

papers.title: Multi-modal Medical Diagnosis via Large-small Model Collaboration
papers.authors: Wanyi Chen, Zihua Zhao, Jiangchao Yao, Ya Zhang, Jiajun Bu, Haishuai Wang
papers.abstract: Recent advances in medical AI have shown a clear trend towards large models in healthcare. However, developing large models for multi-modal medical diagnosis remains challenging due to a lack of sufficient modal-complete medical data. Most existing multi-modal diagnostic models are relatively small and struggle with limited feature extraction capabilities. To bridge this gap, we propose **AdaCoMed**, an **ada**ptive **co**llaborative-learning framework that synergistically integrates the off-the-shelf **med**ical single-modal large models with multi-modal small models. Our framework first employs a mixture-of-modality-experts (MoME) architecture to combine features extracted from multiple single-modal medical large models, and then introduces a novel adaptive co-learning mechanism to collaborate with a multi-modal small model. This co-learning mechanism, guided by an adaptive weighting strategy, dynamically balances the complementary strengths between the MoME-fused large model features and the cross-modal reasoning capabilities of the small model. Extensive experiments on two representative multi-modal medical datasets (MIMIC-IV-MM and MMIST ccRCC) across six modalities and four diagnostic tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, making it a promising solution for real-world medical diagnosis applications.
papers.title_zh: 通过大小型模式协作进行多模式医疗诊断
papers.abstract_zh: 医疗自主诊断的近期进展表明,医疗自主诊断出现了向大型医疗模式发展的明确趋势,然而,由于缺乏足够的模式完整的医疗数据,开发多模式医疗诊断的大型模式仍具有挑战性。 大多数现有的多模式诊断模型规模相对较小,与有限的特征提取能力作斗争。 为了弥合这一差距,我们提议**AdaCoMed**,这是一个**ad**aptiive **co**bolbreati-学习框架,协同将现成**med**cical单一模式大模型与多模式小模型合二为一。 我们的框架首先采用混合模式-专家(MME)架构,将从多种单一模式大型医疗模型中提取的特征结合起来,然后引入一种新的适应性共同学习机制,与多模式小型模型合作。 这一共同学习机制以适应性加权战略为指导,积极平衡了由MEO使用的大型模型特征与小型模型的跨模式推理能力之间的互补优势。 对两个具有代表性的多模式医疗数据集(MIMIMI-IV-MM-MM和MMIST ccRCC)进行了广泛的试验,涉及六种模式和四项诊断任务,表明在最新基线方面不断改进,使之成为现实世界医疗诊断应用的一个有希望的解决办法。

papers.title: MP-SfM: Monocular Surface Priors for Robust Structure-from-Motion
papers.authors: Zador Pataki, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Johannes L. Schönberger, Marc Pollefeys
papers.abstract: While Structure-from-Motion (SfM) has seen much progress over the years, state-of-the-art systems are prone to failure when facing extreme viewpoint changes in low-overlap, low-parallax or high-symmetry scenarios. Because capturing images that avoid these pitfalls is challenging, this severely limits the wider use of SfM, especially by non-expert users. We overcome these limitations by augmenting the classical SfM paradigm with monocular depth and normal priors inferred by deep neural networks. Thanks to a tight integration of monocular and multi-view constraints, our approach significantly outperforms existing ones under extreme viewpoint changes, while maintaining strong performance in standard conditions. We also show that monocular priors can help reject faulty associations due to symmetries, which is a long-standing problem for SfM. This makes our approach the first capable of reliably reconstructing challenging indoor environments from few images. Through principled uncertainty propagation, it is robust to errors in the priors, can handle priors inferred by different models with little tuning, and will thus easily benefit from future progress in monocular depth and normal estimation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/cvg/mpsfm.
papers.title_zh: MP-SfM:强力结构-调出运动的单表表面前置
papers.abstract_zh: 多年来,结构-从运动(SfM)取得了很大进展,但当面临低重叠、低平行或高对称情景的极端观点变化时,最先进的系统容易失败。 由于捕捉避免这些陷阱的图像具有挑战性,这严重限制了SfM的更广泛使用,特别是非专家用户的使用。 我们克服了这些限制,以单眼深度和由深层神经网络推断的正常前科来强化传统SfM模式。 由于单眼和多视角制约的紧密结合,我们的方法在极端观点变化的情况下大大优于现有方法,同时在标准条件下保持强劲的业绩。 我们还表明,单眼前科可以帮助拒绝因对称而形成的错误协会,这对SfM来说是一个长期存在的问题。 这使得我们的方法成为第一个能够从少数图像中可靠地重建具有挑战性的室内环境的方法。 通过传播有原则的不确定性,它强于前题错误,可以处理不同模型的前科,但微调不多,因此很容易从单眼深度和正常估计的未来进展中受益。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/cvg/mpsfm上公开查阅。

papers.title: MotionBench: Benchmarking and Improving Fine-grained Video Motion Understanding for Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Wenyi Hong, Yean Cheng, Zhuoyi Yang, Weihan Wang, Lefan Wang, Xiaotao Gu, Shiyu Huang, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.abstract: In the quest for artificial general intelligence, Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a focal point in recent advancements. However, the predominant focus remains on developing their capabilities in static image understanding. The potential of MLLMs in processing sequential visual data is still insufficiently explored, highlighting the absence of a comprehensive, high-quality assessment of their performance. In this paper, we introduce Video-MME, the first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis. Our work distinguishes from existing benchmarks through four key features: 1) Diversity in video types, spanning 6 primary visual domains with 30 subfields to ensure broad scenario generalizability; 2) Duration in temporal dimension, encompassing both short-, medium-, and long-term videos, ranging from 11 seconds to 1 hour, for robust contextual dynamics; 3) Breadth in data modalities, integrating multi-modal inputs besides video frames, including sub- titles and audios, to unveil the all-round capabilities of MLLMs; 4) Quality in annotations, utilizing rigorous manual labeling by expert annotators to facilitate precise and reliable model assessment. 900 videos with a total of 254 hours are manually selected and annotated by repeatedly viewing all the video content, resulting in 2,700 question-answer pairs. With Video-MME, we extensively evaluate various state-of-the-art MLLMs, including GPT-4 series and Gemini 1.5 Pro, as well as open-source image models like InternVL-Chat-V1.5 and video models like LLaVA-NeXT-Video. Our experiments reveal that Gemini 1.5 Pro is the best-performing commercial model, significantly outperforming the open-source models with an average accuracy of 75%, compared to 71.9% for GPT-4o.
