papers.abstract: Foundational models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) are gaining traction in medical imaging segmentation, supporting multiple downstream tasks. However, such models are supervised in nature, still relying on large annotated datasets or prompts supplied by experts. Conventional techniques such as active learning to alleviate such limitations are limited in scope and still necessitate continuous human involvement and complex domain knowledge for label refinement or establishing reward ground truth. To address these challenges, we propose an enhanced Segment Anything Model (SAM) framework that utilizes annotation-efficient prompts generated in a fully unsupervised fashion, while still capturing essential semantic, location, and shape information through contrastive language-image pretraining and visual question answering. We adopt the direct preference optimization technique to design an optimal policy that enables the model to generate high-fidelity segmentations with simple ratings or rankings provided by a virtual annotator simulating the human annotation process. State-of-the-art performance of our framework in tasks such as lung segmentation, breast tumor segmentation, and organ segmentation across various modalities, including X-ray, ultrasound, and abdominal CT, justifies its effectiveness in low-annotation data scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 加强SAM,对半监督医疗图像分割进行高效快速和优先优化的半监督医疗图像分割
papers.abstract_zh: 诸如 " 片段 " 模式(SAM)等基本模型在医学成像分离方面正在获得牵引作用,支持多项下游任务,然而,这类模型在性质上受到监督,仍然依赖大量附加说明的数据集或专家提供的提示。 诸如积极学习以减轻这种限制的常规技术,其范围有限,仍需要人的持续参与和复杂的领域知识,以完善标签或确立奖励性的实地真相。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议一个强化的 " 部分无所事事模式 " 框架,利用以完全不受监督的方式生成的注释高效提示提示,同时仍然通过对比性语言图像培训前和视觉问题回答掌握基本的语义、位置和形状信息。 我们采用了直接优惠优化技术,以设计一种最佳政策,使该模型能够产生高纤维分化,通过模拟人类批注过程的虚拟代言人提供简单的评级或排名。 我们的框架在诸如肺分解、乳腺癌分解以及包括X射线、超声波和腹部CT在内的各种模式的器官分解等任务方面最先进的业绩证明,在低批注数据情景中,它的有效性是有道理的。

papers.title: Enhancing Online Continual Learning with Plug-and-Play State Space Model and Class-Conditional Mixture of Discretization
papers.authors: Sihao Liu, Yibo Yang, Xiaojie Li, David A. Clifton, Bernard Ghanem
papers.abstract: Online continual learning (OCL) seeks to learn new tasks from data streams that appear only once, while retaining knowledge of previously learned tasks. Most existing methods rely on replay, focusing on enhancing memory retention through regularization or distillation. However, they often overlook the adaptability of the model, limiting the ability to learn generalizable and discriminative features incrementally from online training data.To address this, we introduce a plug-and-play module, S6MOD, which can be integrated into most existing methods and directly improve adaptability. Specifically, S6MOD introduces an extra branch after the backbone, where a mixture of discretization selectively adjusts parameters in a selective state space model, enriching selective scan patterns such that the model can adaptively select the most sensitive discretization method for current dynamics.We further design a class-conditional routing algorithm for dynamic, uncertainty-based adjustment and implement a contrastive discretization loss to optimize it. Extensive experiments combining our module with various models demonstrate that S6MOD significantly enhances model adaptability, leading to substantial performance gains and achieving the state-of-the-art results. The code is available at https://github.com/MyToumaKazusa/S6MOD.
papers.title_zh: 利用插和插插国家空间模型和分类条件分解混合,加强在线持续学习
papers.abstract_zh: 在线持续学习(OCL)试图从仅出现一次的数据流中学习新任务,同时保留对以往所学到任务的知识。 大多数现有方法依靠重播,侧重于通过正规化或蒸馏加强记忆保留。 然而,他们往往忽视模型的可调适性,限制了从在线培训数据中逐步学习普遍和歧视性特征的能力。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了一个插接和游戏模块S6MOD, 它可以融入大多数现有方法,直接改进适应性。 具体地说,S6MOD在主干后引入了一个额外的分支,其中分解化组合有选择地调整了选择性国家空间模型中的参数,丰富了选择性扫描模式,使模型能够适应性地选择当前动态的最敏感分解方法。 我们还为动态的、基于不确定性的调整设计了级条件路径算法,并实施了对比性分解损失以优化其优化。 将我们的模块与各种模型相结合的广泛实验表明,S6MOD极大地增强了模型的适应能力,从而取得了巨大的绩效收益并取得了最新成果,该代码可在https://github.com/MyToumaKazusa/S6MOD上查阅,网址是https://github.com/MyToumaKazusa/S6MOD。

papers.title: EMOE: Modality-Specific Enhanced Dynamic Emotion Experts
papers.authors: Yiyang Fang, Wenke Huang, Guancheng Wan, Kehua Su, Mang Ye
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) aims to predict human emotions by leveraging multiple modalities, such as vision, acoustics, and language. However, due to the heterogeneity of these modalities, MER faces two key challenges: modality balance dilemma and modality specialization disappearance. Existing methods often overlook the varying importance of modalities across samples in tackling the modality balance dilemma. Moreover, mainstream decoupling methods, while preserving modality-specific information, often neglect the predictive capability of unimodal data. To address these, we propose a novel model, Modality-Specific Enhanced Dynamic Emotion Experts (EMOE), consisting of: (1) Mixture of Modality Experts for dynamically adjusting modality importance based on sample features, and (2) Unimodal Distillation to retain single-modality predictive ability within fused features. EMOE enables adaptive fusion by learning a unique modality weight distribution for each sample, enhancing multimodal predictions with single-modality predictions to balance invariant and specific features in emotion recognition. Experimental results on benchmark datasets show that EMOE achieves superior or comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, we extend EMOE to Multimodal Intent Recognition (MIR), further demonstrating its effectiveness and versatility.
papers.title_zh: EMOE: 模式-具体特点增强动态情感专家
papers.abstract_zh: 多模式情感认知(MER)旨在通过利用多种模式(如视觉、声学和语言)预测人的情感,但是,由于这些模式的多样性,MER面临两大挑战:模式平衡两难和模式专业化消失。 现有方法往往忽略了不同样本在解决模式平衡难题方面不同模式的不同重要性。 此外,主流解耦方法在保留特定模式信息的同时,往往忽视单模式数据的预测能力。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个新型模式,即 " 模式特异增强动态情感专家 " (EMOE),其中包括:(1) 模式专家组合,以便根据样本特征动态调整模式的重要性,以及(2) 将单一模式预测能力保留在引信特性中。 EMOE通过学习每种样本独特的模式重量分布,加强多式预测,加上单一方式预测,以平衡情感识别的变异性和具体特征,使适应性融合成为可能。 基准数据集的实验结果表明,EMOE的性能优于或可比于最先进的方法。 此外,我们把EMOE推广到多模式元素识别(MIR ) , 进一步证明了其有效性和多功能性。

papers.title: Efficient Concertormer for Image Deblurring and Beyond
papers.authors: Pin-Hung Kuo · Jinshan Pan · Shao-Yi Chien · Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: The Transformer architecture has excelled in NLP and vision tasks, but its self-attention complexity grows quadratically with image size, making high-resolution tasks computationally expensive. We introduce { ours}, featuring Concerto Self-Attention (CSA) for image deblurring. CSA splits self-attention into global and local components while retaining partial information in additional dimensions, achieving linear complexity. A Cross-Dimensional Communication module enhances expressiveness by linearly combining attention maps. Additionally, our gated-dconv MLP merges the two-staged Transformer design into a single stage. Extensive evaluations show our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art works in deblurring, deraining, and JPEG artifact removal. Code and models will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 图像稀释及其他图像高效协奏器
papers.abstract_zh: 变换器结构在NLP和视觉任务中取得了卓越成就,但其自我关注的复杂性随着图像大小的四重奏式增长,高分辨率任务在计算上变得昂贵。 我们引入了 { ours} , 以协奏自控( CSA)为主 , 用于图像破碎 。 加空局将自我关注分为全球和地方部分,同时保留额外部分信息,实现线性复杂度,跨多功能通信模块通过线性合并关注地图,提高表达性。 此外,我们的Gated-dconv MLP将两级变形器设计合并到一个单一的阶段。 广泛的评估表明,我们的方法优于最先进的拆解、排污和JPEG工艺品清除工程。 代码和模型将公开提供。

papers.title: Dynamic Attention Mechanism in Spatiotemporal Memory Networks for Object Tracking
papers.authors: Meng Zhou, Jiadong Xie, Mingsheng Xu
papers.abstract: Mainstream visual object tracking frameworks predominantly rely on template matching paradigms. Their performance heavily depends on the quality of template features, which becomes increasingly challenging to maintain in complex scenarios involving target deformation, occlusion, and background clutter. While existing spatiotemporal memory-based trackers emphasize memory capacity expansion, they lack effective mechanisms for dynamic feature selection and adaptive fusion. To address this gap, we propose a Dynamic Attention Mechanism in Spatiotemporal Memory Network (DASTM) with two key innovations: 1) A differentiable dynamic attention mechanism that adaptively adjusts channel-spatial attention weights by analyzing spatiotemporal correlations between the templates and memory features; 2) A lightweight gating network that autonomously allocates computational resources based on target motion states, prioritizing high-discriminability features in challenging scenarios. Extensive evaluations on OTB-2015, VOT 2018, LaSOT, and GOT-10K benchmarks demonstrate our DASTM's superiority, achieving state-of-the-art performance in success rate, robustness, and real-time efficiency, thereby offering a novel solution for real-time tracking in complex environments.
papers.title_zh: 用于跟踪物体的时空记忆网络中的动态关注机制
papers.abstract_zh: 主流视觉物体跟踪框架主要依赖模板匹配模式,其性能在很大程度上取决于模板特征的质量,在涉及目标变形、隔离和背景杂乱的复杂情景中,要保持模板特征越来越具有挑战性。 虽然现有的基于时空记忆的现有跟踪器强调扩大记忆能力,但它们缺乏能动特征选择和适应性融合的有效机制。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议在时空记忆网络中建立一个动态关注机制,有两个主要创新:(1) 一个不同的动态关注机制,通过分析模板与记忆特征之间的时空相关性,适应性调整频道空间关注权重;(2) 一个轻量级网络,根据目标运动状态自主分配计算资源,在具有挑战性的情景中优先考虑高差异性特征。 对OTB-2015、VOT-2018、LaSOT和GOD-10K基准的广泛评价显示了我们DASTM的优越性,在成功率、稳健性和实时效率方面取得了最先进的业绩,从而为在复杂环境中实时跟踪提供了新的解决办法。

papers.title: DyFo: A Training-Free Dynamic Focus Visual Search for Enhancing LMMs in Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
papers.authors: Geng Li, Jinglin Xu, Yunzhen Zhao, Yuxin Peng
papers.abstract: Humans can effortlessly locate desired objects in cluttered environments, relying on a cognitive mechanism known as visual search to efficiently filter out irrelevant information and focus on task related regions. Inspired by this process, we propose DyFo (Dynamic Focus), a training-free dynamic focusing visual search method that enhances fine-grained visual understanding in large multi-modal models (LMMs). Unlike existing approaches which require additional modules or data collection, DyFo leverages a bidirectional interaction between LMMs and visual experts, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm to simulate human-like focus adjustments. This enables LMMs to focus on key visual regions while filtering out irrelevant content, without introducing additional training caused by vocabulary expansion or the integration of specialized localization modules. Experimental results demonstrate that DyFo significantly improves fine-grained visual understanding and reduces hallucination issues in LMMs, achieving superior performance across both fixed and dynamic resolution models.
papers.title_zh: DyFo: 开展无培训的动态焦点视觉搜索,在精美视觉理解中加强LMMs
papers.abstract_zh: 人类可以不遗余力地在混乱的环境中找到想要的物体,依靠一种称为视觉搜索的认知机制,有效地过滤无关的信息,并注重任务相关区域。 在这一过程的启发下,我们提议DyFo(动态焦点),这是一种不培训的动态动态焦点视觉搜索方法,可以提高大型多模式模型(LMMs)的精细视觉理解度。 DyFo公司与目前需要额外模块或数据收集的办法不同,它利用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法模拟类似人类的重点调整,利用LMMs和视觉专家之间的双向互动。 这使LMM能够侧重于关键的视觉区域,同时过滤不相关的内容,而不引进因词汇扩展或专门化本地化模块整合而导致的额外培训。 实验结果表明,DyFo公司大大提高了精细的视觉理解,减少了LMMs的幻觉问题,在固定和动态分辨率模型中都取得了优异的性能。

papers.title: DViN: Dynamic Visual Routing Network for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension
papers.authors: Xiaofu Chen, Yaxin Luo, Gen Luo, Jiayi Ji, Henghui Ding, Yiyi Zhou
papers.abstract: In this paper, we focus on weakly supervised referring expression comprehension (REC), and identify that the lack of fine-grained visual capability greatly limits the upper performance bound of existing methods. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework for weakly supervised REC, namely Dynamic Visual routing Network (DViN), which overcomes the visual shortcomings from the perspective of feature combination and alignment. In particular, DViN is equipped with a novel sparse routing mechanism to efficiently combine features of multiple visual encoders in a dynamic manner, thus improving the visual descriptive power. Besides, we further propose an innovative weakly supervised objective, namely Routing-based Feature Alignment (RFA), which facilitates the visual understanding of routed features through the intra-modal and inter-modal alignment. To validate DViN, we conduct extensive experiments on four REC benchmark datasets. Experiments demonstrate that DViN achieves state-of-the-art results on four benchmarks while maintaining competitive inference efficiency. Besides, the strong generalization ability of DViN is also validated on weakly supervised referring expression segmentation. Source codes are anonymously released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DViN-7736.
papers.title_zh: DVN: 弱视低监视的表达式理解的动态视觉运行网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们侧重于监督不力的参考表达理解(REC),并查明缺乏精细的视觉能力极大地限制了现有方法的上层性能。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议为受监管薄弱的REC建立一个新框架,即动态视觉路径网络,从特征组合和组合的角度克服视觉缺陷。 特别是,家庭暴力网络配备了一种新颖的稀少路线机制,以便以动态方式有效地将多种视觉编码器的特征结合起来,从而改进视觉描述能力。 此外,我们进一步提议了一个监管薄弱的创新目标,即基于路标的特征调整(RFA),通过内部和模式间调整,促进对路由特征的视觉理解。 为了验证DVIN,我们对四个REC基准数据集进行了广泛的实验。 实验表明,DVN在保持竞争性推论效率的同时,在四个基准上取得了最新的结果,此外,DVN的强力一般化能力也通过监督不力的转介表达式分割得到验证。 来源代码在以下网址匿名发布:https://anonnymous.4open.science/r/DVIN-7736。

papers.title: Dual-view X-ray Detection: Can AI Detect Prohibited Items from Dual-view X-ray Images like Humans?
papers.authors: Renshuai Tao, Haoyu Wang, Yuzhe Guo, Hairong Chen, Li Zhang, Xianglong Liu, Yunchao Wei, Yao Zhao
papers.abstract: To detect prohibited items in challenging categories, human inspectors typically rely on images from two distinct views (vertical and side). Can AI detect prohibited items from dual-view X-ray images in the same way humans do? Existing X-ray datasets often suffer from limitations, such as single-view imaging or insufficient sample diversity. To address these gaps, we introduce the Large-scale Dual-view X-ray (LDXray), which consists of 353,646 instances across 12 categories, providing a diverse and comprehensive resource for training and evaluating models. To emulate human intelligence in dual-view detection, we propose the Auxiliary-view Enhanced Network (AENet), a novel detection framework that leverages both the main and auxiliary views of the same object. The main-view pipeline focuses on detecting common categories, while the auxiliary-view pipeline handles more challenging categories using "expert models" learned from the main view. Extensive experiments on the LDXray dataset demonstrate that the dual-view mechanism significantly enhances detection performance, e.g., achieving improvements of up to +24.7%for the challenging category of umbrellas. Furthermore, our results show that AENet exhibits strong generalization across seven different detection models.
papers.title_zh: 双视X射线探测:大赦国际能够检测到像人类这样的双视X射线图像中的违禁物品吗?
papers.abstract_zh: 为了探测具有挑战性的类别被禁物品,人类视察员通常依靠两种不同观点(纵向和侧面)的图像,大赦国际能否像人类一样从双视X射线图像中探测到被禁止物品? 现有的X射线数据集往往受到限制,例如单一视像成像或样本多样性不足。 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了大型双视X射线(LDXray),其中包括12个类别的353 646例,为培训和评价模式提供了多样和全面的资源。 为了在双视探测中仿效人类情报,我们提议建立辅助视图增强网络,这是一个利用同一物体的主视图和辅助视图的新发现框架。 主要观点管道的重点是探测共同类别,辅助观点管道则利用从主要观点学到的“专家模型”处理更具挑战性的类别。 有关LDXray数据集的广泛实验表明,双眼机制大大提高了探测性能,例如,在具有挑战性的伞类方面实现了高达24.7%的改进。 此外,我们的结果表明,AENet在七个不同的探测模型中表现出了强烈的概括性。

papers.title: Dual-Granularity Semantic Guided Sparse Routing Diffusion Model for General Pansharpening
papers.authors: Yinghui Xing, Litao Qu, Shizhou Zhang, Di Xu, Yingkun Yang, Yanning Zhang
papers.abstract: Pansharpening aims at integrating complementary information from panchromatic and multispectral images. Available deep-learning based pansharpening methods typically perform exceptionally with particular satellite datasets. At the same time, it has been observed that these models also exhibit scene dependence, for example, if the majority of the training samples come from the urban scenes, the model's performance may decline in the river scene. To address the domain gap produced by varying satellite sensors and distinct scenes, we propose a dual-granularity semantic guided sparse routing diffusion model for general pansharpening. By utilizing the large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in the field of geoscience, e.g, GeoChat, we introduce the dual granularity semantics to generate dynamic sparse routing scores for adaptation of different satellite sensors and scenes. This scene-level and region-level dual-granularity semantic information serves as guidance for dynamically activating specialized experts within the diffusion model. Extensive experiments on WorldView-3, QuickBird, and GaoFen-2 datasets show the effectiveness of our proposed method. Notably, the proposed method outperforms the comparison approaches in adapting to new satellite sensors and scenes. The codes are available at https://github.com/codgodtao/SGDiff.
papers.title_zh: 通用泛光喷射系统扩散模型
papers.abstract_zh: Pansharping旨在整合全色和多光谱图像中的补充信息,现有基于深层学习的全局光谱方法通常在特定卫星数据集中表现特殊。 同时,据观察,这些模型也显示出对景象的依赖性,例如,如果大多数培训样本来自城市,模型在河流现场的性能可能会下降。 为解决不同卫星传感器和不同场景造成的领域差距,我们提议为一般泛太平洋开发提供一个双毛性语义、有指导的稀疏路线扩散模式。 通过利用地球科学(例如GeoChat)领域的大型视觉语言模型,我们引入了双颗粒语义学,为适应不同的卫星传感器和场景生成动态微小路由分数。 这种场景级别和地区一级的双管语义信息为在扩散模式内积极调动专家提供了指导,关于世界展望-3、QuickBird和GaoFen-2的大规模实验显示了我们拟议方法的有效性。 值得注意的是,拟议的方法在适应新的卫星传感器和场景方面优于比较方法,这些代码可在https://github.com/codgodtao/SGDiff上查阅。

papers.title: DriveGPT4-V2: Harnessing Large Language Model Capabilities for Enhanced Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zhenhua Xu, Yan Bai, Yujia Zhang, Zhuoling Li, Fei Xia, Kwan-Yee K. Wong, Jianqiang Wang, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) possess the ability to comprehend visual images or videos, and show impressive reasoning ability thanks to the vast amounts of pretrained knowledge, making them highly suitable for autonomous driving applications. Unlike the previous work, DriveGPT4-V1, which focused on open-loop tasks, this study explores the capabilities of LLMs in enhancing closed-loop autonomous driving. DriveGPT4-V2 processes camera images and vehicle states as input to generate low-level control signals for end-to-end vehicle operation. A multi-view visual tokenizer (MV-VT) is employed enabling DriveGPT4-V2 to perceive the environment with an extensive range while maintaining critical details. The model architecture has been refined to improve decision prediction and inference speed. To further enhance the performance, an additional expert LLM is trained for online imitation learning. The expert LLM, sharing a similar structure with DriveGPT4-V2, can access privileged information about surrounding objects for more robust and reliable predictions. Experimental results show that DriveGPT4-V2 outperforms all baselines on the challenging CARLA Longest6 benchmark. The code and data of DriveGPT4-V2 will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: GPT4-V2:利用大语言示范能力促进增强闭路自主驾驶
papers.abstract_zh: 多式大型语言模式(MLLMs)有能力理解视觉图像或视频,并表现出令人印象深刻的推理能力,这要归功于大量预先培训的知识,使它们非常适合自主驾驶。 与以前侧重于开放通道任务的DriverGPT4-V1号驱动器不同,本研究探索了LLMs在加强封闭通道自动驾驶方面的能力。DriveGPT4-V2号驱动器处理相机图像和车辆状态,作为生成端到端车辆操作低水平控制信号的投入。 采用了多视图视觉标记器(MV-VT),使驱动器GPT4-V2能够在保存关键细节的同时,对环境进行广泛观察,并改进模型结构,以改进决策预测和推断速度。 为了进一步提高绩效,又培训了一名专家LLM进行网上模仿学习。 专家LLM与DriveGPT4-V2拥有类似的结构,可以获取关于周围物体的特许信息,以获得更有力和可靠的预测。 实验结果表明,驱动器GPT4-V2的性能超过了具有挑战性的CARLA Long6基准上的所有基线,驱动器GPT4-V2的代码和数据将公开提供。

papers.title: DORNet: A Degradation Oriented and Regularized Network for Blind Depth Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Zhengxue Wang, Zhiqiang Yan, Jinshan Pan, Guangwei Gao, Kai Zhang, Jian Yang
papers.abstract: Recent RGB-guided depth super-resolution methods have achieved impressive performance under the assumption of fixed and known degradation (e.g., bicubic downsampling). However, in real-world scenarios, captured depth data often suffer from unconventional and unknown degradation due to sensor limitations and complex imaging environments (e.g., low reflective surfaces, varying illumination). Consequently, the performance of these methods significantly declines when real-world degradation deviate from their assumptions. In this paper, we propose the Degradation Oriented and Regularized Network (DORNet), a novel framework designed to adaptively address unknown degradation in real-world scenes through implicit degradation representations. Our approach begins with the development of a self-supervised degradation learning strategy, which models the degradation representations of low-resolution depth data using routing selection-based degradation regularization. To facilitate effective RGB-D fusion, we further introduce a degradation-oriented feature transformation module that selectively propagates RGB content into the depth data based on the learned degradation priors. Extensive experimental results on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate the superiority of our DORNet in handling unknown degradations, outperforming existing methods.
papers.title_zh: DORNet:以退化为导向和正规化的盲深超级分辨率网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在固定和已知的降解(例如双立下取样)的假设下,最近RGB制导的深度超分辨率方法取得了令人印象深刻的业绩。 然而,在现实世界情景中,由于传感器的局限性和复杂的成像环境(例如低反射面、不同照明度),所捕捉的深度数据往往受到非常规和未知的降解。 因此,当现实世界的退化偏离其假设时,这些方法的效绩就会显著下降。 在本文中,我们提议建立以退化为导向的正规化网络(DORNet),这是一个新颖的框架,旨在通过隐含的退化表现,适应性地解决现实世界中未知的退化问题。 我们的方法首先是制定自我监督的退化学习战略,该战略利用基于选择途径的退化正规化模式,模拟低分辨率深度数据的退化表现。 为了促进有效的RGB-D融合,我们进一步引入了一个面向退化的特征转换模块,根据所学的退化前科,有选择地将RGB内容传播到深度数据中。 实际和合成数据集的广泛实验结果表明,我们的DORNet在处理未知退化方面优于现有方法,优于现有方法。

papers.title: Distilling Long-tailed Datasets
papers.authors: Zhenghao Zhao, Haoxuan Wang, Yuzhang Shang, Kai Wang, Yan Yan
papers.abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to synthesize a small information-rich dataset from a large dataset for efficient neural network training. However, existing dataset distillation methods struggle with long-tailed datasets, which are prevalent in real-world scenarios. By investigating the reasons behind this unexpected result, we identified two main causes: 1) The distillation process on imbalanced datasets develops biased gradients, leading to the synthesis of similarly imbalanced distilled datasets. 2) The experts trained on such datasets perform suboptimally on tail classes, resulting in misguided distillation supervision and poor-quality soft-label initialization. To address these issues, we first propose Distribution-agnostic Matching to avoid directly matching the biased expert trajectories. It reduces the distance between the student and the biased expert trajectories and prevents the tail class bias from being distilled to the synthetic dataset. Moreover, we improve the distillation guidance with Expert Decoupling, which jointly matches the decoupled backbone and classifier to improve the tail class performance and initialize reliable soft labels. This work pioneers the field of long-tailed dataset distillation (LTDD), marking the first effective effort to distill long-tailed datasets. Our code will be made public at https://github.com/ichbill/LTDD.
papers.title_zh: 蒸馏长尾数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 数据集蒸馏(DD)旨在合成从大型数据集中提取的少量信息丰富的数据集,以便进行有效的神经网络培训,但是,现有的数据集蒸馏方法与长尾数据集挣扎,而长尾数据集在现实世界情景中很普遍。 通过调查这一意外结果背后的原因,我们查明了两个主要原因:(1) 不平衡数据集的蒸馏过程发展了偏差梯度,从而合成了同样不平衡的蒸馏数据集。 2) 接受过此类数据集培训的专家在尾巴类上表现极佳,导致错误的蒸馏监管和低质量的软标签初始化。 为了解决这些问题,我们首先建议分配-不可知匹配,以避免直接匹配有偏向的专家轨迹。 它缩短了学生与有偏向的专家轨道之间的距离,防止了尾品类别偏向被提炼到合成数据集。 此外,我们改进了与专家解耦的蒸馏指南,该指南与解耦的骨干和分类器联合配合,以提高尾品级的性能,并启动可靠的软标签。 这项工作开创了长尾数据集蒸馏(LTDD)领域,标志着首次有效地努力蒸馏长尾数据集。 我们的代码将在https://github.com/ichbill/LTDD上公布。

papers.title: DiGIT: Multi-Dilated Gated Encoder and Central-Adjacent Region Integrated Decoder for Temporal Action Detection Transformer
papers.authors: Ho-Joong Kim, Yearang Lee, Jung-Ho Hong, Seong-Whan Lee
papers.abstract: In this paper, we examine a key limitation in query-based detectors for temporal action detection (TAD), which arises from their direct adaptation of originally designed architectures for object detection. Despite the effectiveness of the existing models, they struggle to fully address the unique challenges of TAD, such as the redundancy in multi-scale features and the limited ability to capture sufficient temporal context. To address these issues, we propose a multi-dilated gated encoder and central-adjacent region integrated decoder for temporal action detection transformer (DiGIT). Our approach replaces the existing encoder that consists of multi-scale deformable attention and feedforward network with our multi-dilated gated encoder. Our proposed encoder reduces the redundant information caused by multi-level features while maintaining the ability to capture fine-grained and long-range temporal information. Furthermore, we introduce a central-adjacent region integrated decoder that leverages a more comprehensive sampling strategy for deformable cross-attention to capture the essential information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiGIT achieves state-of-the-art performance on THUMOS14, ActivityNet v1.3, and HACS-Segment.
papers.title_zh: DIGIT: 用于时间行动探测Transformer的多层加固编码器和中毗邻区域综合解码器
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们研究了基于Query的探测时间行动探测探测器中的一个关键限制,其原因是它们直接调整了最初设计的物体探测结构。 尽管现有模式是有效的,但它们在努力全面应对贸易与发展的独特挑战,例如多尺度特征的冗余和掌握足够时间背景的能力有限。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个多层密封门式编码器和中央邻接区综合解码器,用于时间动作检测变压器(DiGIT),我们的方法是用多层可变换的注意和进化前网络的编码器替换现有的编码器,由多层密封门式编码器取代。 我们提议的编码器减少了多层次特征造成的多余信息,同时保持捕捉精细和长距离时间信息的能力。 此外,我们引入了中邻区域综合解码器,利用更全面的取样战略,使获取基本信息的跨方努力变形。 广泛的实验表明,DiGIT在THUMOS14、活动网v1.3和HACS部分取得了最先进的表现。

papers.title: DiG: Scalable and Efficient Diffusion Models with Gated Linear Attention
papers.authors: Lianghui Zhu, Zilong Huang, Bencheng Liao, Jun Hao Liew, Hanshu Yan, Jiashi Feng, Xinggang Wang
papers.abstract: Diffusion models with large-scale pre-training have achieved significant success in the field of visual content generation, particularly exemplified by Diffusion Transformers (DiT). However, DiT models have faced challenges with quadratic complexity efficiency, especially when handling long sequences. In this paper, we aim to incorporate the sub-quadratic modeling capability of Gated Linear Attention (GLA) into the 2D diffusion backbone. Specifically, we introduce Diffusion Gated Linear Attention Transformers (DiG), a simple, adoptable solution with minimal parameter overhead. We offer two variants, i.e., a plain and U-shape architecture, showing superior efficiency and competitive effectiveness. In addition to superior performance to DiT and other sub-quadratic-time diffusion models at 256x256 resolution, DiG demonstrates greater efficiency than these methods starting from a 512 resolution. Specifically, DiG-S/2 is 2.5x faster and saves 75.7% GPU memory compared to DiT-S/2 at a 1792 resolution. Additionally, DiG-XL/2 is 4.2x faster than the Mamba-based model at a 1024 resolution and 1.8x faster than DiT with FlashAttention-2 at a 2048 resolution. The code is released at https://github.com/hustvl/DiG.
papers.title_zh: diG: 具有Gated线性注意的可缩放和高效扩散模型
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模培训前推广模式在视觉内容生成领域取得了显著成功,特别是以Diful Transformer为例。 然而,DiT模式面临复方复杂效率的挑战,特别是在处理长序列时。 在本文中,我们的目标是将Gated线性注意(GLA)的次赤道建模能力纳入二维扩散主干网。 具体地说,我们引入了Difulted线性注意Transformer(DiG ) , 这是一种简单、可采纳的解决方案,其参数管理费极少。 我们提供两种变体,即平原和U形结构,显示出更高的效率和竞争力。 除了DIT和其他256x256分辨率的次水分配时间扩散模型的优异性能外,DIG还表现出比从512分辨率开始的这些方法更高的效率。 具体地说,DiG-S/2比1792年分辨率的Dit-S/2更快2.5x,节省75.7%的GPU内存,此外,DiG-XL/2比1024年分辨率的Mamba模型快4.2x,比2048年分辨率的FlashAttention-2的DIT快1.8x,该代码在https://github.com/hustvl/DIG上公布。

papers.title: DiffFNO: Diffusion Fourier Neural Operator
papers.authors: Xiaoyi Liu, Hao Tang
papers.abstract: We introduce DiffFNO, a novel diffusion framework for arbitrary-scale super-resolution strengthened by a Weighted Fourier Neural Operator (WFNO). Mode Rebalancing in WFNO effectively captures critical frequency components, significantly improving the reconstruction of high-frequency image details that are crucial for super-resolution tasks. Gated Fusion Mechanism (GFM) adaptively complements WFNO's spectral features with spatial features from an Attention-based Neural Operator (AttnNO). This enhances the network's capability to capture both global structures and local details. Adaptive Time-Step (ATS) ODE solver, a deterministic sampling strategy, accelerates inference without sacrificing output quality by dynamically adjusting integration step sizes ATS. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffFNO achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, outperforming existing methods across various scaling factors by a margin of 2-4 dB in PSNR, including those beyond the training distribution. It also achieves this at lower inference time. Our approach sets a new standard in super-resolution, delivering both superior accuracy and computational efficiency.
papers.title_zh: DiffFNO: 扩散四级神经操作员
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了DiffFNO,这是一个新的传播框架,通过一个重力四架神经操作员(WFNO)加强的专制超分辨率超大分辨率的传播框架。 WFNO重新平衡模式有效捕捉了关键频率组件,大大改进了对超分辨率任务至关重要的高频图像细节的重建。 GUDD融合机制适应性地补充了WFNO的光谱特征,其空间特征来自一个以注意为主的神经操作员(AttnNO),这增强了网络捕捉全球结构和当地细节的能力。 适应性时间步骤(ATS)ODE求解器是一种确定性抽样战略,它加速推论,而不会通过动态调整整合步数大小而牺牲产出质量。 广泛的实验表明,DiffFNO实现了最新技术成果,在PSNR中以2-4 dB的差幅超过现有各种比例因素的方法,包括培训分布以外的方法。 我们的方法在超级分辨率方面确立了新的标准,既提供了更高的准确性,又提供了计算效率。

papers.title: DiC: Rethinking Conv3x3 Designs in Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Yuchuan Tian, Jing Han, Chengcheng Wang, Yuchen Liang, Chao Xu, Hanting Chen
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have shown exceptional performance in visual generation tasks. Recently, these models have shifted from traditional U-Shaped CNN-Attention hybrid structures to fully transformer-based isotropic architectures. While these transformers exhibit strong scalability and performance, their reliance on complicated self-attention operation results in slow inference speeds. Contrary to these works, we rethink one of the simplest yet fastest module in deep learning, 3x3 Convolution, to construct a scaled-up purely convolutional diffusion model. We first discover that an Encoder-Decoder Hourglass design outperforms scalable isotropic architectures for Conv3x3, but still under-performing our expectation. Further improving the architecture, we introduce sparse skip connections to reduce redundancy and improve scalability. Based on the architecture, we introduce conditioning improvements including stage-specific embeddings, mid-block condition injection, and conditional gating. These improvements lead to our proposed Diffusion CNN (DiC), which serves as a swift yet competitive diffusion architecture baseline. Experiments on various scales and settings show that DiC surpasses existing diffusion transformers by considerable margins in terms of performance while keeping a good speed advantage. Project page: https://github.com/YuchuanTian/DiC
papers.title_zh: DiC: 重新思考传播模型中的Conv3x3 设计
papers.abstract_zh: 传播模型在视觉生成任务中表现出了非凡的绩效。 最近,这些模型从传统的U-Shaped CNN-NPN-注意力混合结构转向完全基于变压器的异热带结构。 虽然这些变压器具有很强的可缩放性和性能,但依赖复杂的自控操作导致推导速度缓慢。 与这些作品相反,我们重新思考了深层学习中最简单但最快的单元之一,即3x3革命,以构建一个规模扩大的纯革命扩散模型。 我们首先发现,Encoder-Decoder Hourclass设计优于Conv3x3可缩放的异热带结构,但仍未能达到我们的期望。 进一步改进这一结构,我们引入了稀疏的跳过连接,以减少冗余,提高伸缩性。 基于这一架构,我们引入了条件改进,包括针对特定阶段的嵌入、中区条件注射和有条件加固。 这些改进导致我们提议的有线电视新闻网(DIC ) , 作为快速但有竞争力的传播架构基线。 各种规模和设置的实验表明,DIC在保持良好的速度优势的同时,在性能方面比现有的扩散变压器高出相当大的距离,项目网页:https://github.com/YuchuanTian/DIC。

papers.title: Detect, Classify, Act: Categorizing Industrial Anomalies with Multi-Modal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Sassan Mokhtar, Arian Mousakhan, Silvio Galesso, Jawad Tayyub, Thomas Brox
papers.abstract: Recent advances in visual industrial anomaly detection have demonstrated exceptional performance in identifying and segmenting anomalous regions while maintaining fast inference speeds. However, anomaly classification-distinguishing different types of anomalies-remains largely unexplored despite its critical importance in real-world inspection tasks. To address this gap, we propose VELM, a novel LLM-based pipeline for anomaly classification. Given the critical importance of inference speed, we first apply an unsupervised anomaly detection method as a vision expert to assess the normality of an observation. If an anomaly is detected, the LLM then classifies its type. A key challenge in developing and evaluating anomaly classification models is the lack of precise annotations of anomaly classes in existing datasets. To address this limitation, we introduce MVTec-AC and VisA-AC, refined versions of the widely used MVTec-AD and VisA datasets, which include accurate anomaly class labels for rigorous evaluation. Our approach achieves a state-of-the-art anomaly classification accuracy of 80.4% on MVTec-AD, exceeding the prior baselines by 5%, and 84% on MVTec-AC, demonstrating the effectiveness of VELM in understanding and categorizing anomalies. We hope our methodology and benchmark inspire further research in anomaly classification, helping bridge the gap between detection and comprehensive anomaly characterization.
papers.title_zh: 检测、分类、法案:用多模式大语言模型对工业异常模式进行分类
papers.abstract_zh: 近期在视觉工业异常现象探测方面取得的进展表明,在查明异常区域并将其分解,同时保持快速推论速度方面表现非常出色。 然而,尽管异常分类在现实世界的检查任务中至关重要,但不同类别的异常分类基本上仍未得到探讨。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议VELM,这是一条基于LLM的新型异常分类管道。 鉴于推论速度的至关重要性,我们首先使用一种不受监督的异常现象探测方法,作为视觉专家评估观测的正常性。 如果发现异常现象,则LLM将其分类。 制定和评价异常现象分类模型的一个关键挑战是,在现有数据集中缺乏异常类别的确切说明。 为解决这一限制,我们引入了MVTec-AC和VisA-AC,即广泛使用的MVTec-AD和VisA数据集的改良版,其中包括准确异常等级标签,供严格评估。 我们的方法在MVTec-AD上达到了80.4%的最新异常分类精确度,比先前的基线高出5%,在MVTec-AC上超过了84%,这表明VELM在理解异常和分类方面的有效性。 我们希望,我们的方法和基准激发了对异常现象分类的进一步研究,有助于弥合探测与全面异常特征描述之间的差距。

papers.title: Degradation-Aware Feature Perturbation for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.authors: Xiangpeng Tian, Xiangyu Liao, Xiao Liu, Meng Li, Chao Ren
papers.abstract: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clear images from various degradation types and levels with a unified model. Nonetheless, the significant variations among degradation types present challenges for training a universal model, often resulting in task interference, where the gradient update directions of different tasks may diverge due to shared parameters. To address this issue, motivated by the routing strategy, we propose DFPIR, a novel all-in-one image restorer that introduces Degradation-aware Feature Perturbations(DFP) to adjust the feature space to align with the unified parameter space. In this paper, the feature perturbations primarily include channel-wise perturbations and attention-wise perturbations. Specifically, channel-wise perturbations are implemented by shuffling the channels in high-dimensional space guided by degradation types, while attention-wise perturbations are achieved through selective masking in the attention space. To achieve these goals, we propose a Degradation-Guided Perturbation Block (DGPB) to implement these two functions, positioned between the encoding and decoding stages of the encoder-decoder architecture. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that DFPIR achieves state-of-the-art performance on several all-in-one image restoration tasks including image denoising, image dehazing, image deraining, motion deblurring, and low-light image enhancement. Our codes are available at https://github.com/TxpHome/DFPIR.
papers.title_zh: 全在一体图像恢复的降解- 软件特性扰动
papers.abstract_zh: All in-one图像恢复工作旨在以统一的模型从各种降解类型和水平上恢复清晰的图像。 然而,各种退化类型之间的巨大差异对培训通用模式提出了挑战,往往导致任务干扰,因为由于共有参数,不同任务的梯度更新方向可能不同。 为了解决这一问题,在路线战略的推动下,我们提议DFPIR,这是一个全新的全功能图像恢复器,引入退化觉变地貌扰动(DFP),以调整特征空间,使之与统一的参数空间相一致。 在本文中,特征扰动主要包括频道扰动和注意力扰动。 具体地说,通过在降解类型指导下对高维空间的频道进行转换,从而实现频道干扰,而通过在注意空间有选择地遮掩,则实现引人注意的扰动。 为实现这些目标,我们提议建立一个退化引导干扰区,以履行这两个功能,位于编码器-编码器结构编码和编码解码阶段之间。 广泛的实验结果表明,DFPIR在一些全成图像恢复任务上取得了最先进的业绩,包括图像脱色、图像脱色、图像脱光、运动脱光和低光图像增强。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/TxpHome/DFPIR上查阅。

papers.title: Decentralized Diffusion Models
papers.authors: David McAllister, Matthew Tancik, Jiaming Song, Angjoo Kanazawa
papers.abstract: Large-scale AI model training divides work across thousands of GPUs then synchronizes gradients across them at each step. This incurs a significant network burden that only centralized, monolithic clusters can support, driving up infrastructure costs and straining power systems. We propose Decentralized Diffusion Models, a scalable framework to distribute diffusion model training across independent clusters or datacenters by eliminating the dependence on a centralized, high-bandwidth networking fabric. Our method trains a set of expert diffusion models over partitions of the dataset, each in full isolation from one another. At inference time, they ensemble through a lightweight router. We show that this ensemble collectively optimizes the same objective as a single model trained over the whole dataset. This means we can divide the training burden among a number of "compute islands," lowering infrastructure costs and improving resilience to localized GPU failures. Decentralized diffusion models empower researchers to take advantage of smaller, more cost-effective and more readily available compute like on-demand GPU nodes rather than central integrated systems. We conduct extensive experiments on ImageNet and LAION Aesthetics, showing that decentralized diffusion models FLOP-for-FLOP outperform standard diffusion models. We finally scale our approach to 24 billion parameters, demonstrating that high-quality diffusion models can now be trained with just eight individual GPU nodes in less than a week.
papers.title_zh: 分散分散传播模式
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模AI型培训模式在数千个GPU上工作,然后在每一步上同步它们之间的梯度。 这造成了巨大的网络负担,只有集中的、单一的集群才能支撑、抬高基础设施成本和压力发电系统。 我们建议采用分散传播模式,这是一个可扩展的框架,通过消除对中央、高带宽网络结构的依赖,将传播模式培训分散到独立的集群或数据中心。 我们的方法在数据集的分区上训练一套专家的传播模型,每个模型完全相互隔离。在推论时,它们通过轻量级路由器组合在一起。我们显示,这个组合可以共同优化同一目标,就像一个对整个数据集进行训练的单一模型一样。 这意味着我们可以将培训负担分给几个“计算岛屿”, 降低基础设施成本, 提高本地GPU失灵的抗御能力。 分散传播模式使研究人员能够利用更小、更具成本效益和更容易获得的计算方法,如按需计算GPU节点,而不是中央综合系统。 我们对图像网和LAION审美学进行了广泛的实验,表明分散式扩散模型FLOP-FLOP-FLOP优于标准扩散模型。 我们最终将我们的方法扩大到240亿参数,表明现在可以在不到一周的时间里仅用8个单个的GPU节点来训练高质量的传播模型。

papers.title: DeCafNet: Delegate and Conquer for Efficient Temporal Grounding in Long Videos
papers.authors: Zijia Lu, A S M Iftekhar, Gaurav Mittal, Tianjian Meng, Xiawei Wang, Cheng Zhao, Rohith Kukkala, Ehsan Elhamifar, Mei Chen
papers.abstract: Long Video Temporal Grounding (LVTG) aims at identifying specific moments within lengthy videos based on user-provided text queries for effective content retrieval. The approach taken by existing methods of dividing video into clips and processing each clip via a full-scale expert encoder is challenging to scale due to prohibitive computational costs of processing a large number of clips in long videos. To address this issue, we introduce DeCafNet, an approach employing "delegate-and-conquer" strategy to achieve computation efficiency without sacrificing grounding performance. DeCafNet introduces a sidekick encoder that performs dense feature extraction over all video clips in a resource-efficient manner, while generating a saliency map to identify the most relevant clips for full processing by the expert encoder. To effectively leverage features from sidekick and expert encoders that exist at different temporal resolutions, we introduce DeCaf-Grounder, which unifies and refines them via query-aware temporal aggregation and multi-scale temporal refinement for accurate grounding. Experiments on two LTVG benchmark datasets demonstrate that DeCafNet reduces computation by up to 47% while still outperforming existing methods, establishing a new state-of-the-art for LTVG in terms of both efficiency and performance.
papers.title_zh: DeCafNet:在长视频中高效时间定位的代表和代表
papers.abstract_zh: 长时间视频定位(LVTG)旨在根据用户提供的文本Query,在长长视频中确定具体时刻,以便有效检索内容。 由于长视频中处理大量剪辑的计算成本高得令人望而却步,因此目前采用的方法,将视频分为剪辑,并通过一个全面的专家编码器处理每个剪辑,这种做法具有挑战性。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了DeCafNet,这是一种采用“远程化与征服”战略的方法,以便在不牺牲地基业绩的情况下实现计算效率。 DeCafNet推出一个侧边编码器,以资源效率高的方式对所有视频剪辑进行密集特征提取,同时绘制一个突出的地图,以确定最相关的剪辑,供专家编码器全面处理。 为了有效地利用不同时间分辨率上存在的旁听器和专家编码器的功能,我们引入了DeCaf-Gourer,通过Query识别时间汇总和多尺度时间改进来统一和完善这些功能,以便准确定位。 在两个LTVG基准数据集上进行的实验表明,DeCafNet将计算减少高达47%,但仍超过现有方法,在效率和业绩方面为LTVG建立了新的最新技术。

papers.title: Co-AttenDWG: Co-Attentive Dimension-Wise Gating and Expert Fusion for Multi-Modal Offensive Content Detection
papers.authors: Md. Mithun Hossain, Md. Shakil Hossain, Sudipto Chaki, M. F. Mridha
papers.abstract: Multi-modal learning has emerged as a crucial research direction, as integrating textual and visual information can substantially enhance performance in tasks such as classification, retrieval, and scene understanding. Despite advances with large pre-trained models, existing approaches often suffer from insufficient cross-modal interactions and rigid fusion strategies, failing to fully harness the complementary strengths of different modalities. To address these limitations, we propose Co-AttenDWG, co-attention with dimension-wise gating, and expert fusion. Our approach first projects textual and visual features into a shared embedding space, where a dedicated co-attention mechanism enables simultaneous, fine-grained interactions between modalities. This is further strengthened by a dimension-wise gating network, which adaptively modulates feature contributions at the channel level to emphasize salient information. In parallel, dual-path encoders independently refine modality-specific representations, while an additional cross-attention layer aligns the modalities further. The resulting features are aggregated via an expert fusion module that integrates learned gating and self-attention, yielding a robust unified representation. Experimental results on the MIMIC and SemEval Memotion 1.0 datasets show that Co-AttenDWG achieves state-of-the-art performance and superior cross-modal alignment, highlighting its effectiveness for diverse multi-modal applications.
papers.title_zh: 共同-DWG:多模式进攻性攻击物质探测联合加速维维维-韦兹交织和专家混合
papers.abstract_zh: 多模式学习已成为一个关键的研究方向,因为将文字和视觉信息结合起来可以大大提高分类、检索和实地了解等任务的业绩。 尽管在大型培训前模式方面取得了进展,但现有办法往往缺乏充分的跨模式互动和僵硬的融合战略,未能充分利用不同模式的互补优势。 为了克服这些限制,我们建议共同-DWG, 共同关注维维维维度的引力和专家融合。 我们的方法是首先将文字和视觉特征投放到一个共同嵌入空间,在这个空间里,一个专门的共同保护机制可以使各种模式之间同时进行细微的相互作用。 通过一个多维智能网络进一步加强了这一点,这个网络适应性地调整了频道一级的贡献,以强调突出的信息。 同时,双轨制编码器独立地完善了具体模式的表述方式,而另一个跨关注层进一步调整了模式,由此产生的特征通过专家聚合模块加以汇总,该模块整合了学到的格言和自我关注,形成强有力的统一表述方式。 MIMIC和SemEval Memotion 1.0数据集的实验结果显示,联合-高级DWG取得了SOTA 性能和卓越的跨模式协调,突出显示了其在多种多模式应用方面的效力。

papers.title: ClusIR: Towards Cluster-Guided All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.authors: Shengkai Hu, Jiaqi Ma, Jun Wan, Wenwen Min, Yongcheng Jing, Lefei Zhang, Dacheng Tao
papers.abstract: All-in-One Image Restoration (AiOIR) aims to recover high-quality images from diverse degradations within a unified framework. However, existing methods often fail to explicitly model degradation types and struggle to adapt their restoration behavior to complex or mixed degradations. To address these issues, we propose ClusIR, a Cluster-Guided Image Restoration framework that explicitly models degradation semantics through learnable clustering and propagates cluster-aware cues across spatial and frequency domains for adaptive restoration. Specifically, ClusIR comprises two key components: a Probabilistic Cluster-Guided Routing Mechanism (PCGRM) and a Degradation-Aware Frequency Modulation Module (DAFMM). The proposed PCGRM disentangles degradation recognition from expert activation, enabling discriminative degradation perception and stable expert routing. Meanwhile, DAFMM leverages the cluster-guided priors to perform adaptive frequency decomposition and targeted modulation, collaboratively refining structural and textural representations for higher restoration fidelity. The cluster-guided synergy seamlessly bridges semantic cues with frequency-domain modulation, empowering ClusIR to attain remarkable restoration results across a wide range of degradations. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks validate that ClusIR reaches competitive performance under several scenarios.
papers.title_zh: ClusIR: 走向群集制导全一图像恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 一体行动图象恢复(AiOIR)的目标是在一个统一的框架内从各种退化中恢复高质量的图像,然而,现有方法往往不能明确地模拟退化类型,难以使其恢复行为适应复杂或混合退化。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议CLusIR,这是一个集成指导图像恢复框架,通过可学习的集群,明确模拟退化语义,并在整个空间和频度领域传播集群认知信号,以适应性恢复。 具体而言,CLusIR由两个关键部分组成:一个概率性集束引导运行机制(PCGRM)和一个降解软件频率移动模块(DAFMM)。 拟议的PCGRM将降解识别与专家启动解耦,从而促成歧视性降解感和稳定的专家路线。 同时,DAFMM利用分组制的前身进行适应性频率分解和有针对性的调整,合作完善结构和结构,以提高恢复的忠诚度。 集群引导的协同作用无缝连接了带有频域调控的语义信号,使CLusIR能够在各种退化中取得显著的恢复成果。 对不同基准的广泛实验证实,CLusIR在若干情景下取得了竞争性业绩。

papers.title: Classifier-to-Bias: Toward Unsupervised Automatic Bias Detection for Visual Classifiers
papers.authors: Quentin Guimard, Moreno D'Incà, Massimiliano Mancini, Elisa Ricci
papers.abstract: A person downloading a pre-trained model from the web should be aware of its biases. Existing approaches for bias identification rely on datasets containing labels for the task of interest, something that a non-expert may not have access to, or may not have the necessary resources to collect: this greatly limits the number of tasks where model biases can be identified. In this work, we present Classifier-to-Bias (C2B), the first bias discovery framework that works without access to any labeled data: it only relies on a textual description of the classification task to identify biases in the target classification model. This description is fed to a large language model to generate bias proposals and corresponding captions depicting biases together with task-specific target labels. A retrieval model collects images for those captions, which are then used to assess the accuracy of the model w.r.t. the given biases. C2B is training-free, does not require any annotations, has no constraints on the list of biases, and can be applied to any pre-trained model on any classification task. Experiments on two publicly available datasets show that C2B discovers biases beyond those of the original datasets and outperforms a recent state-of-the-art bias detection baseline that relies on task-specific annotations, being a promising first step toward addressing task-agnostic unsupervised bias detection.
papers.title_zh: 分类器到比亚斯:为视觉分类器进行不受监督的自动比亚检测
papers.abstract_zh: 从网上下载预培训模型的人应了解其偏见。 现有的偏见识别方法依赖于含有有关任务标签的数据集,非专家可能无法或没有必要的资源收集这些标签:这极大地限制了可确定模式偏见的任务数量。 在这项工作中,我们提出分类到Bias(C2B),这是第一个无法获取任何标签数据而起作用的偏见发现框架:它只依靠对分类任务的文字说明,以确定目标分类模式中的偏差。 这一描述被输入一个大型语言模型,以产生偏差建议和描述偏差的相应说明以及特定任务的目标标签。 检索模型收集这些说明的图像,然后用来评估模型的准确性。 C2B没有培训,不需要任何说明,对偏见清单没有限制,可适用于任何分类任务的培训前模式。 在两个公开的数据集上进行的实验表明,C2B发现了超出原始数据集的偏差,并超过了最近依靠具体任务说明的最先进的偏差检测基线,这是朝向处理任务不可知性、不受监督的偏差检测迈出的有希望的第一步。

papers.title: ChatHuman: Chatting about 3D Humans with Tools
papers.authors: Jing Lin, Yao Feng, Weiyang Liu, Michael J. Black
papers.abstract: Numerous methods have been proposed to detect, estimate, and analyze properties of people in images, including the estimation of 3D pose, shape, contact, human-object interaction, emotion, and more. While widely applicable in vision and other areas, such methods require expert knowledge to select, use, and interpret the results. To address this, we introduce ChatHuman, a language-driven system that combines and integrates the skills of these specialized methods. ChatHuman functions as an assistant proficient in utilizing, analyzing, and interacting with tools specific to 3D human tasks, adeptly discussing and resolving related challenges. Built on a Large Language Model (LLM) framework, ChatHuman is trained to autonomously select, apply, and interpret a diverse set of tools in response to user inputs. Adapting LLMs to 3D human tasks presents challenges, including the need for domain-specific knowledge and the ability to interpret complex 3D outputs. The innovative features of ChatHuman include leveraging academic publications to instruct the LLM how to use the tools, employing a retrieval-augmented generation model to create in-context learning examples for managing new tools, and effectively discriminating and integrating tool results to enhance tasks related to 3D humans by transforming specialized 3D outputs into comprehensible formats. Our experiments demonstrate that ChatHuman surpasses existing models in both tool selection accuracy and overall performance across various 3D human tasks, and it supports interactive chatting with users. ChatHuman represents a significant step toward consolidating diverse analytical methods into a unified, robust system for 3D human tasks.
papers.title_zh: 聊天:用工具聊天关于3D人类
papers.abstract_zh: 已经提出了许多方法来探测、估计和分析图像中的人的特性,包括估计3D形貌、形状、接触、人体物体相互作用、情感等等。 虽然这些方法广泛适用于视觉和其他领域,但需要专家知识来选择、使用和解释结果。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了“聊天人”这个语言驱动系统,它综合并整合了这些专门方法的技能。 人文交流职能是助理,精通利用、分析和与3D人类任务特定工具互动,精通于讨论和解决相关挑战。 根据大语言模型框架,ChatHuman接受了自主选择、应用和解释一套针对用户投入的各种工具的培训。 使LMS适应3D人类任务带来了挑战,包括需要具体领域的知识和解释复杂的3D产出的能力。 " 聊天人 " 的创新特点包括:利用学术出版物来指导专卖局长如何使用这些工具;采用检索增强的生成模型来创建用于管理新工具的内流学习范例;通过将专门的3D产出转化为可理解的格式,有效地区分和整合工具成果,以加强与3D人有关的任务。 我们的实验表明,查特人超越了在各种3D人类任务中工具选择准确性和总体业绩方面的现有模式,它支持与用户进行互动式对话。 ChatHuman是朝着将各种分析方法整合为一个统一的、强有力的3D人任务系统迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: Chain-of-Visual-Thought: Teaching VLMs to See and Think Better with Continuous Visual Tokens
papers.authors: Yiming Qin, Bomin Wei, Jiaxin Ge, Konstantinos Kallidromitis, Stephanie Fu, Trevor Darrell, XuDong Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at reasoning in linguistic space but struggle with perceptual understanding that requires dense visual perception, e.g., spatial reasoning and geometric awareness. This limitation stems from the fact that current VLMs have limited mechanisms to capture dense visual information across spatial dimensions. We introduce Chain-of-Visual-Thought (COVT), a framework that enables VLMs to reason not only in words but also through continuous visual tokens-compact latent representations that encode rich perceptual cues. Within a small budget of roughly 20 tokens, COVT distills knowledge from lightweight vision experts, capturing complementary properties such as 2D appearance, 3D geometry, spatial layout, and edge structure. During training, the VLM with COVT autoregressively predicts these visual tokens to reconstruct dense supervision signals (e.g., depth, segmentation, edges, and DINO features). At inference, the model reasons directly in the continuous visual token space, preserving efficiency while optionally decoding dense predictions for interpretability. Evaluated across more than ten diverse perception benchmarks, including CV-Bench, MMVP, RealWorldQA, MMStar, WorldMedQA, and HRBench, integrating COVT into strong VLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA consistently improves performance by 3% to 16% and demonstrates that compact continuous visual thinking enables more precise, grounded, and interpretable multimodal intelligence.
papers.title_zh: 视野-探索链:用连续直视方式教导VLMs, 以观察和思考方式更好地看待和思考
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLM)在语言空间的推理方面十分出色,但与需要密集视觉感知的观念理解(如空间推理和几何意识)挣扎不休。 这一限制源于以下事实,即目前的甚低频成像模型在捕捉跨越空间维度的密集视觉信息方面机制有限。 我们引入了视觉探索链(COVT),这个框架使VLMs不仅能够用语言解释,而且能够通过连续的视觉象征形式 -- -- 集成丰富的感知提示的潜在代表形式来解释。 在大约20个象征性的小额预算内,COVT从轻量级视觉专家那里提取知识,获取2D外观、3D几何、空间布局和边缘结构等互补特性。 在培训期间,VLM与COVT自动反向预测这些视觉标志,以重建密集的监督信号(如深度、分离、边缘和DINO特征)。 根据推断,模型的理由直接出现在连续的视觉象征性空间,既保持效率,又可选择解码可解释性的密集预测。 评价了10多个不同的认知基准,包括CV-Bench、MMVP、RealWorldQA、MMStar、WorldMedQA和HRBench,将COVT纳入强大的VLMs,如Quwen2.5-VL和LLLAVA, 不断提高3%至16%的绩效,并表明连续的直观思维能够提供更准确、有根有据和可解释的多式联运情报。

papers.title: CGTrack: Cascade Gating Network with Hierarchical Feature Aggregation for UAV Tracking
papers.authors: Weihong Li, Xiaoqiong Liu, Heng Fan, Libo Zhang
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in visual object tracking have markedly improved the capabilities of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tracking, which is a critical component in real-world robotics applications. While the integration of hierarchical lightweight networks has become a prevalent strategy for enhancing efficiency in UAV tracking, it often results in a significant drop in network capacity, which further exacerbates challenges in UAV scenarios, such as frequent occlusions and extreme changes in viewing angles. To address these issues, we introduce a novel family of UAV trackers, termed CGTrack, which combines explicit and implicit techniques to expand network capacity within a coarse-to-fine framework. Specifically, we first introduce a Hierarchical Feature Cascade (HFC) module that leverages the spirit of feature reuse to increase network capacity by integrating the deep semantic cues with the rich spatial information, incurring minimal computational costs while enhancing feature representation. Based on this, we design a novel Lightweight Gated Center Head (LGCH) that utilizes gating mechanisms to decouple target-oriented coordinates from previously expanded features, which contain dense local discriminative information. Extensive experiments on three challenging UAV tracking benchmarks demonstrate that CGTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance while running fast. Code will be available at https://github.com/Nightwatch-Fox11/CGTrack.
papers.title_zh: CGTrack: 带有无人驾驶飞行器跟踪的等级特征聚合的连级导航网络
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉物体跟踪最近的进展明显提高了无人驾驶飞行器跟踪能力,而无人驾驶飞行器是现实世界机器人应用中的一个关键组成部分。 虽然整合等级轻量级网络已成为提高无人驾驶飞行器跟踪效率的一个普遍战略,但往往导致网络能力大幅下降,进一步加剧了无人驾驶飞行器情景的挑战,例如频繁的隔离和视角的极端变化。 为了解决这些问题,我们引进了新型的无人驾驶航空器跟踪器系统,称为CGTrack,将明确和隐含的技术结合起来,在粗略到精密的框架内扩大网络能力。 具体地说,我们首先推出一个等级特征级联模块,利用特征再利用精神,通过将深层语义提示与丰富的空间信息相结合,提高网络能力,在提高特征代表性的同时,尽量减少计算成本。 基于这一点,我们设计了一个新的轻量级Gated中心负责人(LGCH),利用格子机制将目标导向坐标与先前扩大的特征解耦,后者含有密集的当地歧视信息。 关于三个具有挑战性的无人驾驶航空器跟踪基准的广泛实验表明,CGTrack在快速运行的同时取得了SOTA 性能,代码可在https://github.com/Nightwatch-Fox11/CGTrack查阅。

papers.title: Category-Agnostic Neural Object Rigging
papers.authors: Guangzhao He, Chen Geng, Shangzhe Wu, Jiajun Wu
papers.abstract: The motion of deformable 4D objects lies in a low-dimensional manifold. To better capture the low dimensionality and enable better controllability, traditional methods have devised several heuristic-based methods, i.e., rigging, for manipulating dynamic objects in an intuitive fashion. However, such representations are not scalable due to the need for expert knowledge of specific categories. Instead, we study the automatic exploration of such low-dimensional structures in a purely data-driven manner. Specifically, we design a novel representation that encodes deformable 4D objects into a sparse set of spatially grounded blobs and an instance-aware feature volume to disentangle the pose and instance information of the 3D shape. With such a representation, we can manipulate the pose of 3D objects intuitively by modifying the parameters of the blobs, while preserving rich instance-specific information. We evaluate the proposed method on a variety of object categories and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Project page: https://guangzhaohe.com/canor.
papers.title_zh: 类别 - 不可知神经物体
papers.abstract_zh: 变形的 4D 对象的动作在于一个低维的多维体。 为了更好地捕捉低维度和更好地控制,传统方法已经设计了几种基于超自然法的方法,即操纵,用直觉的方式操控动态物体。 然而,由于需要特定类别的专家知识,这种表述是无法伸缩的,相反,我们只研究以纯粹数据驱动的方式自动探索这种低维结构。 具体地说,我们设计了一个新的表达方式,将可变形的四维物体编码成一组空基小块体和体能特征体积,以解析立体形状的外形和实例信息。 有了这样的表述,我们可以通过修改三维对象的参数,直观地操纵三维对象的外形,同时保存丰富的实例特有信息,我们评估关于各种对象类别的拟议方法,并表明拟议框架的有效性。 项目网页:https://guangzhaohe.com/canor。

papers.title: CarPlanner: Consistent Auto-regressive Trajectory Planning for Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Dongkun Zhang, Jiaming Liang, Ke Guo, Sha Lu, Qi Wang, Rong Xiong, Zhenwei Miao, Yue Wang
papers.abstract: Trajectory planning is vital for autonomous driving, ensuring safe and efficient navigation in complex environments. While recent learning-based methods, particularly reinforcement learning (RL), have shown promise in specific scenarios, RL planners struggle with training inefficiencies and managing large-scale, real-world driving scenarios.In this paper, we introduce CarPlanner, a Consistent auto-regressive Planner that uses RL to generate multi-modal trajectories. The auto-regressive structure enables efficient large-scale RL training, while the incorporation of consistency ensures stable policy learning by maintaining coherent temporal consistency across time steps. Moreover, CarPlanner employs a generation-selection framework with an expert-guided reward function and an invariant-view module, simplifying RL training and enhancing policy performance.Extensive analysis demonstrates that our proposed RL framework effectively addresses the challenges of training efficiency and performance enhancement, positioning CarPlanner as a promising solution for trajectory planning in autonomous driving.To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate that the RL-based planner can surpass both IL- and rule-based state-of-the-arts (SOTAs) on the challenging large-scale real-world dataset nuPlan. Our proposed CarPlanner surpasses RL-, IL-, and rule-based SOTA approaches within this demanding dataset.
papers.title_zh: CarPlanner:在自主驾驶中大规模加强学习的一致的自动递减轨迹规划
papers.abstract_zh: 轨迹规划对于自主驾驶、确保在复杂环境中安全高效的航行至关重要。 虽然最近的以学习为基础的方法,特别是强化学习(RL),在具体情景中显示了希望,但RL规划者努力克服培训效率低下的问题,并管理大规模、现实世界的驾驶方案。 本文介绍CarPlanner, 是一个一致的自动递减计划者,利用RL生成多模式轨迹。 自动递减结构使得能够进行高效率的大规模RL培训,而纳入一致性则通过保持时间跨步的一致性,确保政策学习的稳定,从而保持时间上的一致性。 此外,CarPlanner还采用代代选择框架,具有专家指导的奖赏功能和一个不变观点模块,简化了RL培训并提高了政策绩效。广泛的分析表明,我们拟议的RL框架有效地应对了培训效率和绩效提高的挑战,将CarPlanner定位为自主驾驶轨迹规划的一个有希望的解决办法。 根据我们所知,我们首先证明,基于RL的计划者能够超越具有挑战性的大规模真实世界数据集的IL和基于规则的艺术现状。 我们提议的CarPlanner超过RL、IL-和基于规则的SOTA方法,

papers.title: BIOMEDICA: An Open Biomedical Image-Caption Archive, Dataset, and Vision-Language Models Derived from Scientific Literature
papers.authors: Alejandro Lozano, Min Woo Sun, James Burgess, Liangyu Chen, Jeffrey J. Nirschl, Jeffrey Gu, Ivan Lopez, Josiah Aklilu, Anita Rau, Austin Wolfgang Katzer, Yuhui Zhang, Collin Chiu, Xiaohan Wang, Alfred Seunghoon Song, Robert Tibshirani, Serena Yeung-Levy
papers.abstract: The development of vision-language models (VLMs) is driven by large-scale and diverse multi-modal datasets. However, progress toward generalist biomedical VLMs is limited by the lack of annotated, publicly accessible datasets across biology and medicine. Existing efforts are limited to narrow domains, missing the opportunity to leverage the full diversity of biomedical knowledge encoded in scientific literature. To address this gap, we introduce BIOMEDICA: a scalable, open-source framework to extract, annotate, and serialize the entirety of the PubMed Central Open Access subset into an easy-to-use, publicly accessible dataset. Our framework produces a comprehensive archive with over 24 million unique image-text pairs from over 6 million articles. Metadata and expert-guided annotations are additionally provided. We demonstrate the utility and accessibility of our resource by releasing BMC-CLIP, a suite of CLIP-style models continuously pre-trained on BIOMEDICA dataset via streaming (eliminating the need to download 27 TB of data locally). On average, our models achieve state-of-the-art performance across 40 tasks -- spanning pathology, radiology, ophthalmology, dermatology, surgery, molecular biology, parasitology, and cell biology -- excelling in zero-shot classification with 6.56% average improvement (as high as 29.8% and 17.5% gains in dermatology and ophthalmology, respectively) and stronger image-text retrieval while using 10x less compute. To foster reproducibility and collaboration, we release our codebase and dataset to the broader research community
papers.title_zh: BIOMEDIICA: 开放生物医学图像档案、数据集和来自科学文献的视觉语言模型
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)的开发是由大规模和多样化的多模式数据集驱动的,然而,由于缺乏生物和医学方面的附加说明的、可公开查阅的数据集,通俗生物医学多模式数据集的进展有限。 现有努力仅限于狭隘的领域,没有机会利用科学文献中生物医学知识的充分多样性。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了BIOMEDICA:一个可扩展的开放源码框架,将整个PubMed中央开放存取子集提取、注解和序列成一个易于使用、可公开查阅的数据集。 我们的框架产生了一个全面的档案库,有来自600多万篇文章的2 400多万对独特的图像文本,另外还提供了元数据和专家指导的说明。 我们通过释放BMC-CLIP(BMC-CLIP),展示了我们资源的实用性和可获取性。 BMC-CLIP是一组CLIP式的模型,不断通过流流(消除当地下载27种数据TB的需要),对BIOMEDICA数据集进行预先培训。 平均而言,我们的模型在40项任务 -- -- 包括病理学、放射学、眼科、皮肤科、皮肤科、外科、分子生物学、寄生虫科和细胞生物学 -- -- 中取得了SOTA 性能,在零发分类方面表现优异,平均改进6.56%(皮肤学和眼科分别高达29.8%和17.5%的增益),在使用10x的计算较少的情况下,图像文本检索能力更强。 为了促进可复制和协作,我们向更广泛的研究界发布我们的代码库和数据集

papers.title: Bayesian Prompt Flow Learning for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Zhen Qu, Xian Tao, Xinyi Gong, ShiChen Qu, Qiyu Chen, Zhengtao Zhang, Xingang Wang, Guiguang Ding
papers.abstract: Recently, vision-language models (e.g. CLIP) have demonstrated remarkable performance in zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD). By leveraging auxiliary data during training, these models can directly perform cross-category anomaly detection on target datasets, such as detecting defects on industrial product surfaces or identifying tumors in organ tissues. Existing approaches typically construct text prompts through either manual design or the optimization of learnable prompt vectors. However, these methods face several challenges: 1) handcrafted prompts require extensive expert knowledge and trial-and-error; 2) single-form learnable prompts struggle to capture complex anomaly semantics; and 3) an unconstrained prompt space limits generalization to unseen categories. To address these issues, we propose Bayesian Prompt Flow Learning (Bayes-PFL), which models the prompt space as a learnable probability distribution from a Bayesian perspective. Specifically, a prompt flow module is designed to learn both image-specific and image-agnostic distributions, which are jointly utilized to regularize the text prompt space and improve the model's generalization on unseen categories. These learned distributions are then sampled to generate diverse text prompts, effectively covering the prompt space. Additionally, a residual cross-model attention (RCA) module is introduced to better align dynamic text embeddings with fine-grained image features. Extensive experiments on 15 industrial and medical datasets demonstrate our method's superior performance. The code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhen228/Bayes-PFL.
papers.title_zh: Bayesian 用于零热异常检测的快速流动学习
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,视觉语言模型(如CLIP)在零射反常探测(ZSAD)方面表现显著。 通过在培训期间利用辅助数据,这些模型可在目标数据集中直接进行跨类异常现象探测,如发现工业产品表面的缺陷或查明器官组织中的肿瘤。 现有方法通常通过手工设计或优化可学习的快速矢量来构建文本。 然而,这些方法面临若干挑战:(1) 手工制作的提示需要广泛的专业知识和试探和试探;(2) 单式可学习的提示,以捕捉复杂的异常语义学;和(3) 不受限制的迅速空间限制,将空间限制概括到不可见的类别。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用贝叶斯语即时流动学习(Bayes-PFL)模式,将快速空间作为从巴伊斯语角度可以学习的概率分布模型。 具体地说,设计了一个即时流模块,以学习特定图像和图像不可知性分布,共同利用这两个模块来规范文本的快速空间,改进模型对看不见类别的概括性。 然后对这些学到的分布进行抽样,以生成不同的文本提示,有效地覆盖快速空间。 此外,还引入了一个留置的跨模范关注模块(RCA),以更好地将动态文本嵌入带有精细图像特征的动态文本进行匹配。 关于15个工业和医疗数据集的广泛实验表明我们的方法表现优异,该代码可在https://github.com/xiaozhen228/Bayes-PFL查阅。

papers.title: AvatarArtist: Open-Domain 4D Avatarization
papers.authors: Hongyu Liu, Xuan Wang, Ziyu Wan, Yue Ma, Jingye Chen, Yanbo Fan, Yujun Shen, Yibing Song, Qifeng Chen
papers.abstract: This work focuses on open-domain 4D avatarization, with the purpose of creating a 4D avatar from a portrait image in an arbitrary style. We select parametric triplanes as the intermediate 4D representation, and propose a practical training paradigm that takes advantage of both generative adversarial networks (GANs) and diffusion models. Our design stems from the observation that 4D GANs excel at bridging images and triplanes without supervision yet usually face challenges in handling diverse data distributions. A robust 2D diffusion prior emerges as the solution, assisting the GAN in transferring its expertise across various domains. The synergy between these experts permits the construction of a multi-domain image-triplane dataset, which drives the development of a general 4D avatar creator. Extensive experiments suggest that our model, termed AvatarArtist, is capable of producing high-quality 4D avatars with strong robustness to various source image domains. The code, the data, and the models will be made publicly available to facilitate future studies.
papers.title_zh: Afatar 艺术家:开放域 4D
papers.abstract_zh: 这项工作侧重于开放域域 4D 变异化,目的是从任意风格的肖像中创建 4D 变异。 我们选择几何三边形作为中间4D代表,并提出实用培训模式,既利用基因对抗网络(GANs),又利用推广模式。 我们的设计源自于4D GANs在没有监督的情况下成功搭桥图像和三联网,但通常在处理不同数据分布方面会面临挑战。 一个强大的2D传播前作为解决方案出现,协助GAN在各个领域转让专门知识。 这些专家之间的协同作用使得能够构建一个多域图像三角机数据集,推动开发一个通用的4D阿凡达创建者。 广泛的实验表明,我们的模型“阿凡达艺术家 ” ( Avatar Artistist)有能力在各种源图像领域产生高品质的4D阿凡达。 代码、数据和模型将公开提供,以便利未来的研究。

papers.title: Asynchronous Large Language Model Enhanced Planner for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yuan Chen · Zi-han Ding · Ziqin Wang · Yan Wang · Lijun Zhang · Si Liu
papers.abstract: Despite real-time planners exhibiting remarkable performance in autonomous driving, the growing exploration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened avenues for enhancing the interpretability and controllability of motion planning. Nevertheless, LLM-based planners continue to encounter significant challenges, including elevated resource consumption and extended inference times, which pose substantial obstacles to practical deployment. In light of these challenges, we introduce AsyncDriver, a new asynchronous LLM-enhanced closed-loop framework designed to leverage scene-associated instruction features produced by LLM to guide real-time planners in making precise and controllable trajectory predictions. On one hand, our method highlights the prowess of LLMs in comprehending and reasoning with vectorized scene data and a series of routing instructions, demonstrating its effective assistance to real-time planners. On the other hand, the proposed framework decouples the inference processes of the LLM and real-time planners. By capitalizing on the asynchronous nature of their inference frequencies, our approach have successfully reduced the computational cost introduced by LLM, while maintaining comparable performance. Experiments show that our approach achieves superior closed-loop evaluation performance on nuPlan's challenging scenarios.
papers.title_zh: 自主驾驶非同步大语言模式增强型增强型自动驾驶规划员
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管实时规划人员在自主驱动方面表现出色,但越来越多地探索大语言模型,为加强运动规划的可解释性和可控制性开辟了途径。 然而,以LLM为基础的规划人员继续面临重大挑战,包括资源消耗增加和推论时间延长,这对实际部署构成重大障碍。 鉴于这些挑战,我们介绍AsyncDriver,这是一个新的非同步的LLM-加强封闭通道框架,旨在利用LLM制作的现场相关教学功能,指导实时规划者作出精确和可控制的轨迹预测。 一方面,我们的方法突出了LLMS在理解和推理病媒化现场数据和一系列路线指示方面的威力,表明它对实时规划者的有效帮助。 另一方面,拟议框架打破了LLM和实时规划者的推论过程。 通过利用其推论频率的非同步性质,我们的方法成功地减少了LLM采用的计算成本,同时保持了可比较的性能。 实验表明,我们的方法在NuPlan的富有挑战性的情况下,实现了优异的闭环评价业绩。

papers.title: AnyEdit: Mastering Unified High-Quality Image Editing for Any Idea
papers.authors: Qifan Yu, Wei Chow, Zhongqi Yue, Kaihang Pan, Yang Wu, Xiaoyang Wan, Juncheng Li, Siliang Tang, Hanwang Zhang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.abstract: Instruction-based image editing aims to modify specific image elements with natural language instructions. However, current models in this domain often struggle to execute complex user instructions accurately, as they are trained on low-quality data with limited editing types. We present AnyEdit, a comprehensive multi-modal instruction editing dataset, comprising 2.5 million high-quality editing pairs spanning over 20 editing types and five domains. We ensure the diversity and quality of the AnyEdit collection through three aspects: initial data diversity, adaptive editing process, and automated selection of editing results. Using the dataset, we further train a novel AnyEdit Stable Diffusion with task-aware routing and learnable task embedding for unified image editing. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets show that AnyEdit consistently boosts the performance of diffusion-based editing models. This presents prospects for developing instruction-driven image editing models that support human creativity.
papers.title_zh: 任意编辑: 掌握任何理想的通用高品质图像编辑
papers.abstract_zh: 以指示为基础的图像编辑旨在用自然语言指令修改具体的图像要素,然而,目前这一领域的模式往往难以准确地执行复杂的用户指令,因为它们在编辑类型有限的低质量数据方面接受了培训。 我们介绍一个综合的多模式指示编辑数据集 " AnyEdit " ,由250万对高质量的编辑组成,涉及20多个编辑类型和五个领域。 我们通过三个方面确保 " 任何编辑 " 收集工作的多样性和质量:初步数据多样性、适应性编辑程序和自动选择编辑结果。 使用该数据集,我们进一步培训了一部新颖的《AnyEdit Stabilt Splent Division 》 ( AnyEdit Snable Divolution ) , 包括任务认知路径和可学习的任务嵌入到统一的图像编辑中。 对三个基准数据集的全面实验显示, AnyEdit 一贯提升基于扩散的编辑模型的性能。 这为开发支持人类创造力的由教学驱动的图像编辑模型提供了前景。

papers.title: Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Suruchi Kumari, Pravendra Singh
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of deep learning-based methods in medical image segmentation, their use in clinical practice remains limited for two main reasons. First, obtaining a large medical dataset with precise annotations to train segmentation models is challenging. Secondly, most current segmentation techniques generate a single deterministic segmentation mask for each image. However, in real-world scenarios, there is often significant uncertainty regarding what defines the "correct" segmentation, and various expert annotators might provide different segmentations for the same image. To tackle both of these problems, we propose Annotation Ambiguity Aware Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation (AmbiSSL). AmbiSSL combines a small amount of multi-annotator labeled data and a large set of unlabeled data to generate diverse and plausible segmentation maps. Our method consists of three key components: (1) The Diverse Pseudo-Label Generation (DPG) module utilizes multiple decoders, created by performing randomized pruning on the original backbone decoder. These pruned decoders enable the generation of a diverse pseudo-label set; (2) a Semi-Supervised Latent Distribution Learning (SSLDL) module constructs a common latent space by utilizing both ground truth annotations and pseudo-label set; and (3) a Cross-Decoder Supervision (CDS) module, which enables pruned decoders to guide each other's learning. We evaluated the proposed method on two publicly available datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AmbiSSL can generate diverse segmentation maps using only a small amount of labeled data and abundant unlabeled data, offering a more practical solution for medical image segmentation by reducing reliance on large labeled datasets.
papers.title_zh: 认知半半半超模外医学图像分割
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在医学图象分割方面的深层学习方法取得了显著进展,但在临床实践中使用这些方法仍然有限,原因有二。 首先,要获得具有精确说明的大型医疗数据集,以训练分解模型,这具有挑战性。 第二,大多数目前的分解技术为每个图像产生单一的确定性分解面罩。 然而,在现实世界的情景中,对于“正确”分割的定义往往有很大的不确定性,不同的专家说明员可能为同一图像提供不同的分割。 为了解决这两个问题,我们建议用说明性说明性说明性 " 认识半强化医学图像分割 " (AmbiSSL)。 AMbiSSL将少量贴有标签的多标签数据与一大批未贴标签的数据结合起来,以产生多样化和可信的分割图。 我们的方法由三个关键组成部分组成:(1) 多样化普塞杜-拉贝尔(DPG)模块使用多个解码器,这些解码器是在原主干网解码器上随机剪切产生的。 这些修剪的解码器能够生成多种假标签; (2) 一个半监督的边端分发学习模块(SSLDL)通过利用地面真相说明和假标签集构建共同的潜在空间; (3) 一个跨Decoder监督模块(CDS),它使经修剪的解码器能够相互指导学习。 我们评估了两个公开数据集的拟议方法。 广泛的实验表明,AMbiSSL只能利用少量贴标签数据和大量未贴标签数据制作多种分解图,通过减少对大贴标签数据集的依赖,为医疗图象分解提供更实际的解决办法。

papers.title: Animate and Sound an Image
papers.authors: Xihua Wang, Ruihua Song, Chongxuan Li, Xin Cheng, Boyuan Li, Yihan Wu, Yuyue Wang, Hongteng Xu, Yunfeng Wang
papers.abstract: This paper addresses a promising yet underexplored task, Image-to-Sounding-Video (I2SV) generation, which animates a static image and generates synchronized sound simultaneously. Despite advances in video and audio generation models, challenges remain to develop a unified model for generating naturally sounding videos. In this work, we propose a novel approach that leverages two separate pretrained diffusion models and makes vision and audio influence each other during generation based on the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture. First, the individual video and audio pretrained generation models are decomposed into input, output, and expert sub-modules. We propose using a unified joint DiT block to integrate the expert sub-modules to effectively model the interaction between the two modalities, resulting in high-quality I2SV generation. Then, we introduce a joint classifier-free guidance technique to boost the performance during joint generation. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments on three popular benchmark datasets, and in both objective and subjective evaluation our method surpass all the baseline methods in almost all metrics. Case studies show our generated sounding videos are high quality and synchronized between video and audio.
papers.title_zh: 动动和声音图像
papers.abstract_zh: 本文论述一项有希望但探索不足的任务,即图像到声音-视频(I2SV)生成,它能激励静态图像并同时生成同步声音。 尽管在视频和音频生成模式方面取得了进展,但在开发一个用于生成自然探测视频的统一模式方面仍然存在挑战。 在这项工作中,我们提出一种新的办法,利用两个经过训练的单独传播模型,在以传播Transformer(DIT)结构为基础的一代人中,使视觉和音频相互影响。 首先,单个的视频和音频预产模型被分解成投入、输出和专家次模块。 我们提议使用统一的DIT联合模块整合专家次模块,以有效模拟两种模式之间的互动,从而产生高质量的I2SV生成。 然后,我们引入了一种联合免分类指导技术来提高联合代际的绩效。 最后,我们对三个流行的基准数据集进行了广泛的实验,在客观和主观评价中,我们的方法几乎在所有指标中都超过了所有基线方法。 案例研究显示,我们制作的音频视频质量很高,视频和音频同步。

papers.title: ALTER: All-in-One Layer Pruning and Temporal Expert Routing for Efficient Diffusion Generation
papers.authors: Xiaomeng Yang, Lei Lu, Qihui Fan, Changdi Yang, Juyi Lin, Yanzhi Wang, Xuan Zhang, Shangqian Gao
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in generating high-fidelity images. However, their iterative denoising process results in significant computational overhead during inference, limiting their practical deployment in resource-constrained environments. Existing acceleration methods often adopt uniform strategies that fail to capture the temporal variations during diffusion generation, while the commonly adopted sequential pruning-then-fine-tuning strategy suffers from sub-optimality due to the misalignment between pruning decisions made on pretrained weights and the model's final parameters. To address these limitations, we introduce ALTER: All-in-One Layer Pruning and Temporal Expert Routing, a unified framework that transforms diffusion models into a mixture of efficient temporal experts. ALTER achieves a single-stage optimization that unifies layer pruning, expert routing, and model fine-tuning by employing a trainable hypernetwork, which dynamically generates layer pruning decisions and manages timestep routing to specialized, pruned expert sub-networks throughout the ongoing fine-tuning of the UNet. This unified co-optimization strategy enables significant efficiency gains while preserving high generative quality. Specifically, ALTER achieves same-level visual fidelity to the original 50-step Stable Diffusion v2.1 model while utilizing only 25.9% of its total MACs with just 20 inference steps and delivering a 3.64x speedup through 35% sparsity.
papers.title_zh: 全层在一层中环流和时时时专家为高效扩散产生而运行
papers.abstract_zh: 传播模型在生成高忠诚图像方面表现出了非凡的能力,但是,其迭代除空过程导致在推断过程中出现大量计算间接费用,限制了在资源受限制的环境中实际部署。 现有的加速方法往往采用统一战略,无法反映扩散生成过程中的时间变化,而通常采用的按顺序调整的即时调整战略则因在预先培训的重量上作出的调整决定与模型的最后参数之间不协调而出现不优化的情况。 为了克服这些限制,我们引入了 " 同一层人 " :全层人 " 观光和 " 时空专家 " 列车,这是一个统一框架,将扩散模型转化为高效时间专家混合体。 ALTER实现单阶段优化,通过使用可训练的超网络,统一层修剪、专家路由和模型微调,这种超网络动态地产生层修剪决定,并在整个UNet正在进行的微调过程中管理向专门、精细的专家子网络的定时路线。 这一统一的共同优化战略既能大大提高效率,又能保持高基因质量。 具体地说,ALTER实现了对最初的50步稳定扩散V2.1模型的同等水平的直观忠诚,同时只使用了其总MAC的25.9%,只有20个推论步骤,并提供了3.64x的加速度,达到35%的宽度。

papers.title: Alignment, Mining and Fusion: Representation Alignment with Hard Negative Mining and Selective Knowledge Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Yuanhao Zou, Zhaozheng Yin
papers.abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) is a challenging task that requires a deep understanding of both medical images and textual questions. Although recent works leveraging Medical Vision-Language Pre-training (Med-VLP) have shown strong performance on the Med-VQA task, there is still no unified solution for modality alignment, and the issue of hard negatives remains under-explored. Additionally, commonly used knowledge fusion techniques for Med-VQA may introduce irrelevant information. In this work, we propose a framework to address these challenges through three key contributions: (1) a unified solution for heterogeneous modality alignments across multiple levels, modalities, views, and stages, leveraging methods such as contrastive learning and optimal transport theory; (2) a hard negative mining method that employs soft labels for multi-modality alignments and enforces the hard negative pair discrimination; and (3) a Gated Cross-Attention Module for Med-VQA that integrates the answer vocabulary as prior knowledge and select relevant information from it. Our framework outperforms the previous state-of-the-art on widely used Med-VQA datasets like RAD-VQA, SLAKE, PathVQA and VQA-2019. The code will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 对齐、采矿和融合:与硬性负式采矿和选择性知识融合的代表比例对齐,供医疗视觉问题解答
papers.abstract_zh: 医疗视觉问题解答是一项具有挑战性的任务,需要深入了解医疗图像和文字问题。 虽然最近利用医疗视觉-语言培训前(Med-VLP)开展的工作在医疗-VQA任务方面表现良好,但模式协调方面仍然没有统一的解决办法,硬性负面因素问题仍未得到充分探讨。 此外,用于Med-VQA的常用知识聚合技术可能会引入不相关的信息。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个框架,通过三个主要贡献应对这些挑战:(1) 统一解决不同模式在多个层次、模式、观点和阶段的协调统一,利用对比学习和最佳运输理论等方法;(2) 采用硬式负面采矿方法,采用软标签,促进多种模式的协调统一,并强制执行硬式负面对对式歧视;(3) 将回答词汇作为先前的知识纳入,并从中选择相关信息的Med-VQA通用交叉注意力模块。 我们的框架优于以往关于广泛使用的Med-VQA数据集的最新数据,如RAD-VQA、SLAKE、PathVQA和VQA-2019。

papers.title: AIGV-Assessor: Benchmarking and Evaluating the Perceptual Quality of Text-to-Video Generation with LMM
papers.authors: Jiarui Wang, Huiyu Duan, Guangtao Zhai, Juntong Wang, Xiongkuo Min
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of large multimodal models (LMMs) has led to the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence generated videos (AIGVs), which highlights the pressing need for effective video quality assessment (VQA) models designed specifically for AIGVs. Current VQA models generally fall short in accurately assessing the perceptual quality of AIGVs due to the presence of unique distortions, such as unrealistic objects, unnatural movements, or inconsistent visual elements. To address this challenge, we first present AIGVQA-DB, a large-scale dataset comprising 36,576 AIGVs generated by 15 advanced text-to-video models using 1,048 diverse prompts. With these AIGVs, a systematic annotation pipeline including scoring and ranking processes is devised, which collects 370k expert ratings to date. Based on AIGVQA-DB, we further introduce AIGV-Assessor, a novel VQA model that leverages spatiotemporal features and LMM frameworks to capture the intricate quality attributes of AIGVs, thereby accurately predicting precise video quality scores and video pair preferences. Through comprehensive experiments on both AIGVQA-DB and existing AIGV databases, AIGV-Assessor demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, significantly surpassing existing scoring or evaluation methods in terms of multiple perceptual quality dimensions. The dataset and code are released at https://github.com/IntMeGroup/AIGV-Assessor.
papers.title_zh: AIGV-AIGASAsser:与LMM公司一道确定和评估文本到视频生成概念质量的基准和评估
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多式联运模式(LMMs)的迅速发展导致人工智能生成视频(AIGVs)的迅速扩展,这突出表明迫切需要为AIGVs设计有效的视频质量评估模式(VQA)。 由于存在独特的失真现象,如不切实际物体、非自然运动或视觉要素不一致,目前的自愿质量评估模式一般不能准确评估独立国际自愿保险协会的观念质量。 为了应对这一挑战,我们首先介绍AIGVQA-DB,这是一个大型数据集,由15个高级文本到视频模型(使用1 048种不同提示)生成的36 576个AIGVs组成。 利用这些AIGV,设计了一个系统的说明管道,包括评分和排名过程,迄今已收集了370公里的专家评分。 根据AIGVQA-DB,我们进一步引入AIGV-Assessor,这是一个创新的VQA模式,利用时空特征和LMM框架来捕捉AIGV的复杂质量特征,从而准确预测准确的视频质量分数和视频配对偏好。 通过对AIGVQA-DB和现有的AIGV数据库进行全面试验,AIGV-Assessor展示了SOTA 性能,在多重感知质量方面大大超过现有的评分或评价方法。 数据集和代码在https://github.com/IntMeGroup/AIGV-Assessor上公布。

papers.title: AdMiT: Adaptive Multi-Source Tuning in Dynamic Environments
papers.authors: Xiangyu Chang, Fahim Faisal Niloy, Sk Miraj Ahmed, Srikanth V. Krishnamurthy, Basak Guler, Ananthram Swami, Samet Oymak, Amit Roy-Chowdhury
papers.abstract: Incorporating transformer models into edge devices poses a significant challenge due to the computational demands of adapting these large models across diverse applications. Parameter-efficient tuning (PET) methods (e.g. LoRA, Adapter, Visual Prompt Tuning, etc.) allow for targeted adaptation by modifying only small parts of the transformer model. However, adapting to dynamic unlabeled target distributions at the test time remains complex. To address this, we introduce AdMiT: Adaptive Multi -Source Tuning in Dynamic Environments. AdMiT innovates by pre-training a set of PET modules, each optimized for different source distributions or tasks, and dynamically selecting and integrating a sparse subset of relevant modules when encountering a new, few-shot, unlabeled target distribution. This integration leverages Kernel Mean Embedding (KME)-based matching to align the target distribution with relevant source knowledge efficiently, without requiring additional routing networks or hyperparameter tuning. AdMiT achieves adaptation with a single inference step, making it particularly suitable for resource-constrained edge deployments. Furthermore, AdMiT preserves privacy by performing an adaptation locally on each edge device, without the need for data exchange. Our theoretical analysis establishes guarantees for AdMiT's generalization, while extensive benchmarks demonstrate that AdMiT consistently outperforms other PET methods across a range of tasks, achieving robust and efficient adaptation.
papers.title_zh: AdMT: 动态环境中适应性多来源多来源支付
papers.abstract_zh: 将变压器模型纳入边缘装置是一项重大挑战,因为需要从计算上将这些大型模型应用于各种应用。 LoRA、适应器、视觉快速调试等)允许通过只修改变压器模型的小部分进行有针对性的调整。 但是,在测试时适应动态的无标签目标分布仍然很复杂。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了AdMIT:适应性多源在动态环境中的调整性多源调试。 AdMIT创新,办法是预先培训一套PET模块,每个模块都优化用于不同源的分布或任务,在遇到新的、少见的、无标签的目标分布时动态地选择和整合少量相关模块。 这一整合利用了以核心中位嵌入(KME)为基础的匹配,使目标分布与相关源知识高效地保持一致,而不需要额外的路由网络或超参数调整。 亚地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地安地地保护隐私,无需数据交换。 我们的理论分析为AdMIT的概括化提供了保障,而广泛的基准表明,AdMIT在一系列任务中一贯优于其他PET方法,实现了有力和有效的适应。

papers.title: A Spatially Masked Adaptive Gated Network for multimodal post-flood water extent mapping using SAR and incomplete multispectral data
papers.authors: Hyunho Lee, Wenwen Li
