papers.authors: Youngjoong Kwon, Stefano Petrangeli, Dahun Kim, Haoliang Wang, Eunbyung Park, Viswanathan Swaminathan, Henry Fuchs
papers.abstract: Novel view video synthesis aims to synthesize novel viewpoints videos given input captures of a human performance taken from multiple reference viewpoints and over consecutive time steps. Despite great advances in model-free novel view synthesis, existing methods present three limitations when applied to complex and time-varying human performance. First, these methods (and related datasets) mainly consider simple and symmetric objects. Second, they do not enforce explicit consistency across generated views. Third, they focus on static and non-moving objects. The fine-grained details of a human subject can therefore suffer from inconsistencies when synthesized across different viewpoints or time steps. To tackle these challenges, we introduce a human-specific framework that employs a learned 3D-aware representation. Specifically, we first introduce a novel siamese network that employs a gating layer for better reconstruction of the latent volumetric representation and, consequently, final visual results. Moreover, features from consecutive time steps are shared inside the network to improve temporal consistency. Second, we introduce a novel loss to explicitly enforce consistency across generated views both in space and in time. Third, we present the Multi-View Human Action (MVHA) dataset, consisting of near 1200 synthetic human performance captured from 54 viewpoints. Experiments on the MVHA, Pose-Varying Human Model and ShapeNet datasets show that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines both in view generation quality and spatio-temporal consistency."
papers.title_zh: 人文绩效视频动态动态同步新观点合成
papers.abstract_zh: 新颖的新视角视频合成旨在综合新观点视频,从多个参考角度和连续步骤中,从输入中捕捉到人类业绩。 尽管在无模型的新观点合成方面取得了巨大进展,但现有方法在适用于复杂和时间变化的人类性能时有三种限制。 首先,这些方法(和相关数据集)主要考虑简单和对称天体。 其次,它们没有在形成的观点中实施明确的一致性。第三,它们侧重于静态和不移动的物体。因此,如果将不同观点或时间步骤综合在一起,细微的人类主题细节可能会受到不一致的影响。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了一个针对人的具体框架,其中采用了一个有学识的三维意识代表制。 具体地说,我们首先引入了一个新颖的智商网络,这个网络将利用一个层来更好地重建潜在的体积代表制,并由此带来最终的视觉结果。 此外,从连续的时间步骤到网络内部共享特征,以提高时间的一致性。 其次,我们引入了一种新的损失,以明确在空间和时间上使形成的观点保持一致。 第三,我们介绍多视角人类行动数据集,该数据集由54个角度所捕捉的近1 200个合成人类性能组成。 在MVHA、Pose-Varying Human Model和形状网络数据集上的实验显示,我们的方法在生成质量和时空一致性两方面都优于最先进的基线。

papers.title: Prompt-Driven Dynamic Object-Centric Learning for Single Domain Generalization
papers.authors: Deng Li, Aming Wu, Yaowei Wang, Yahong Han
papers.abstract: Single-domain generalization aims to learn a model from single source domain data attaining generalized performance on other unseen target domains. Existing works primarily focus on improving the generalization ability of static networks. However static networks are unable to dynamically adapt to the diverse variations in different image scenes leading to limited generalization capability. Different scenes exhibit varying levels of complexity and the complexity of images further varies significantly in cross-domain scenarios. In this paper we propose a dynamic object-centric perception network based on prompt learning aiming to adapt to the variations in image complexity. Specifically we propose an object-centric gating module based on prompt learning to focus attention on the object-centric features guided by the various scene prompts. Then with the object-centric gating masks the dynamic selective module dynamically selects highly correlated feature regions in both spatial and channel dimensions enabling the model to adaptively perceive object-centric relevant features thereby enhancing the generalization capability. Extensive experiments were conducted on single-domain generalization tasks in image classification and object detection. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods which validates the effectiveness and versatility of our proposed method.
papers.title_zh: 用于单一域通用的即时动态动态对象中心学习
papers.abstract_zh: 单一域一般化的目的是从单一源域数据中学习一个模型,在其他未见目标领域实现普遍业绩,现有工作主要侧重于提高静态网络的普及能力。 然而,静态网络无法动态地适应不同图像场景的不同变化,导致一般化能力有限,不同场景的复杂程度不同,图像的复杂性在跨领域情景中差异很大。 在本文中,我们提出了一个动态的以目标为中心的认知网络,其基础是速成学习,旨在适应图像复杂性的变化。具体地说,我们提出了一个以目标为中心的定位模块,其基础是速成学习,将注意力集中在以各种场景提示为指导的以目标为中心的特征上。 然后,用以物体为中心的格子遮盖动态选择性模块,动态地选择空间和频道两个层面高度关联的特征区域,使模型能够适应以物体为中心的相关特征,从而增强一般化能力。 在图像分类和天体探测方面,就单一域一般化任务进行了广泛的实验,实验结果表明,我们的方法优于最先进的方法,这些方法验证了我们拟议方法的有效性和多功能性。

papers.title: Polos: Multimodal Metric Learning from Human Feedback for Image Captioning
papers.authors: Yuiga Wada, Kanta Kaneda, Daichi Saito, Komei Sugiura
papers.abstract: Establishing an automatic evaluation metric that closely aligns with human judgments is essential for effectively developing image captioning models. Recent data-driven metrics have demonstrated a stronger correlation with human judgments than classic metrics such as CIDEr; however they lack sufficient capabilities to handle hallucinations and generalize across diverse images and texts partially because they compute scalar similarities merely using embeddings learned from tasks unrelated to image captioning evaluation. In this study we propose Polos a supervised automatic evaluation metric for image captioning models. Polos computes scores from multimodal inputs using a parallel feature extraction mechanism that leverages embeddings trained through large-scale contrastive learning. To train Polos we introduce Multimodal Metric Learning from Human Feedback (M2LHF) a framework for developing metrics based on human feedback. We constructed the Polaris dataset which comprises 131K human judgments from 550 evaluators which is approximately ten times larger than standard datasets. Our approach achieved state-of-the-art performance on Composite Flickr8K-Expert Flickr8K-CF PASCAL-50S FOIL and the Polaris dataset thereby demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.
papers.title_zh: Polos:从人类反馈中学习多式计量学,用于图像描述
papers.abstract_zh: 建立与人类判断密切吻合的自动评价指标,对于有效开发图像字幕模型至关重要。 最近的数据驱动指标与人类判断的关联性比CIDER等经典指标更强;然而,它们缺乏处理幻觉和概括不同图像和文本的足够能力,部分原因是它们仅仅利用从与图像说明评价无关的任务中学习的嵌入法计算标量相似性。 在这次研究中,我们建议波洛斯为图像字幕模型提供受监督的自动评价指标。 Polos利用一个平行的特征提取机制来计算多式联运投入的分数,这一机制利用通过大规模对比学习培训的嵌入器。 为了培训Polos,我们引入了“从人类反馈中多模式学习 ” ( M2LHF ) ( M2LHF ) , 一个基于人类反馈制定衡量标准的框架。 我们构建了“极地”数据集,由550名评价员的131K人类判断组成,比标准数据集高出约十倍。 我们的方法在Composite Flickr8K-Expert Flickr8K-Flickr8K-CF PASCAL-50S FOIL和Pollaris数据集上取得了最先进的表现,从而显示了其有效性和稳健性。

papers.title: PIA: Your Personalized Image Animator via Plug-and-Play Modules in Text-to-Image Models
papers.authors: Yiming Zhang, Zhening Xing, Yanhong Zeng, Youqing Fang, Kai Chen
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in personalized text-to-image (T2I) models have revolutionized content creation empowering non-experts to generate stunning images with unique styles. While promising animating these personalized images with realistic motions poses significant challenges in preserving distinct styles high-fidelity details and achieving motion controllability by text. In this paper we present PIA a Personalized Image Animator that excels in aligning with condition images achieving motion controllability by text and the compatibility with various personalized T2I models without specific tuning. To achieve these goals PIA builds upon a base T2I model with well-trained temporal alignment layers allowing for the seamless transformation of any personalized T2I model into an image animation model. A key component of PIA is the introduction of the condition module which takes as inputs the condition frame and inter-frame affinity. This module leverages the affinity hint to transfer appearance information from the condition frame to individual frames in the latent space. This design mitigates the challenges of appearance-related frame alignment within PIA and allows for a stronger focus on aligning with motion-related guidance. To address the lack of a benchmark for this field we introduce AnimateBench a comprehensive benchmark comprising diverse personalized T2I models curated images and motion-related prompts. We show extensive evaluations and applications on AnimateBench to verify the superiority of PIA.
papers.title_zh: PIA: 您个人化图像动画器, 通过文本到图像模型中的插图和插图模块
papers.abstract_zh: 最近个性化文本到图像模型(T2I)的进展,使内容创造发生了革命性的变化,使非专家能够产生具有独特风格的惊人图像。 虽然有希望以现实的动作动画这些个性化图像,但在保留不同风格的高忠诚细节和通过文字实现运动可控性方面提出了重大挑战。 在本文中,我们介绍PIA一个个性化图像动画器,它与条件性图像相匹配,通过文字实现运动控制,与各种个性化T2I模型不作具体调整的兼容性。 为实现上述目标,PIA以一个基础T2I模型为基础,该模型具有经过良好培训的时间调整层,可以将任何个性化T2I模型无缝转换成图像动画模型。 PIA的一个关键组成部分是引入条件模块,该模块将条件框架和框架间亲和作为输入。该模块利用亲和提示将外观信息从条件框架转移到潜在空间的单个框架。 这一设计减轻了与外观有关的框架在投资政策影响评估内部协调的挑战,并使得能够更加注重与与动议有关的指导保持一致。 为了解决这一领域缺乏基准的问题,我们引入了AnimateBench(AnimateBench)综合基准,其中包括各种个性化的T2I模型,这些模型都塑造了图像和与运动有关的提示。 我们展示了对AnimateBench(动因Bench)的广泛评价和应用,以核实PIA的优越性。

papers.title: PathMMU: A Massive Multimodal Expert-Level Benchmark for Understanding and Reasoning in Pathology
papers.authors: YUXUAN SUN · Hao Wu · Chenglu Zhu · Sunyi Zheng · Qizi Chen · Kai Zhang · Yunlong Zhang · Dan Wan · Xiaoxiao Lan · Mengyue Zheng · Jingxiong Li · Xinheng Lyu · Tao Lin · Lin Yang
papers.abstract: The emergence of large multimodal models has unlocked remarkable potential in AI, particularly in pathology. However, the lack of specialized, high-quality benchmark impeded their development and precise evaluation. To address this, we introduce PathMMU, the largest and highest-quality expert-validated pathology benchmark for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). It comprises 33,428 multimodal multi-choice questions and 24,067 images from various sources, each accompanied by an explanation for the correct answer. The construction of PathMMU harnesses GPT-4V's advanced capabilities, utilizing over 30,000 image-caption pairs to enrich captions and generate corresponding Q&As in a cascading process. Significantly, to maximize PathMMU's authority, we invite seven pathologists to scrutinize each question under strict standards in PathMMU's validation and test sets, while simultaneously setting an expert-level performance benchmark for PathMMU. We conduct extensive evaluations, including zero-shot assessments of 14 open-sourced and 4 closed-sourced LMMs and their robustness to image corruption. We also fine-tune representative LMMs to assess their adaptability to PathMMU. The empirical findings indicate that advanced LMMs struggle with the challenging PathMMU benchmark, with the top-performing LMM, GPT-4V, achieving only a 49.8% zero-shot performance, significantly lower than the 71.8% demonstrated by human pathologists. After fine-tuning, significantly smaller open-sourced LMMs can outperform GPT-4V but still fall short of the expertise shown by pathologists. We hope that the PathMMU will offer valuable insights and foster the development of more specialized, next-generation LMMs for pathology.
papers.title_zh: 病理学理解和解释的大规模多模式专家级标准
papers.abstract_zh: 大型多式联运模式的出现在大赦国际中,特别是在病理学方面,已释放出显著的潜力,然而,由于缺乏专门、高质量的基准,妨碍了这些模式的发展和准确评估。 为此,我们引入了大多式联运模型的最大和最高质量的专家鉴定病理基准 " 病理学模型 " ,其中包括33,428个多式联运多选择问题和来自不同来源的24,067个图像,每个图像都附有对正确答案的解释。 PathMMMU的建设利用GPT-4V的先进能力,利用3万多对图像插图来丰富字幕,并在一个级联过程中产生相应的As。 重要的是,为了最大限度地发挥MathMMMU的权威,我们邀请7名病理学家在MathMMMU的鉴定和测试组中严格标准下仔细检查每个问题,同时为MathMMMMU制定专家一级的业绩基准。 我们进行了广泛的评价,包括对14个公开来源的和4个封闭来源的LMM公司进行零点评估,以及它们对腐败形象的稳健性。 我们还对代表LMM公司进行微调,以评估其适应MMMU的适应性。 经验调查结果显示,先进的LMMM公司与具有挑战性的LMMM公司基准挣扎,表现最佳的LMM公司GPT-4V公司只实现了49.8%的零弹性能,大大低于人类病理学家显示的71.8%。 经过微调后,大得多的开放源码LMMs能够超过GPT-4V,但仍不能达到病理学家所显示的专业知识水平。 我们希望,PathMMMU将提供宝贵的洞察力,并促进发展更专业化的、下一代病理学LMMs。

papers.title: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning
papers.authors: Xinyu Geng, Jiaming Wang, Jiawei Gong, Yuerong Xue, Jun Xu, Fanglin Chen, Xiaolin Huang
papers.abstract: Redundancy is a persistent challenge in Capsule Networks (CapsNet) leading to high computational costs and parameter counts. Although previous studies have introduced pruning after the initial capsule layer dynamic routing's fully connected nature and non-orthogonal weight matrices reintroduce redundancy in deeper layers. Besides dynamic routing requires iterating to converge further increasing computational demands. In this paper we propose an Orthogonal Capsule Network (OrthCaps) to reduce redundancy improve routing performance and decrease parameter counts. Firstly an efficient pruned capsule layer is introduced to discard redundant capsules. Secondly dynamic routing is replaced with orthogonal sparse attention routing eliminating the need for iterations and fully connected structures. Lastly weight matrices during routing are orthogonalized to sustain low capsule similarity which is the first approach to use Householder orthogonal decomposition to enforce orthogonality in CapsNet. Our experiments on baseline datasets affirm the efficiency and robustness of OrthCaps in classification tasks in which ablation studies validate the criticality of each component. OrthCaps-Shallow outperforms other Capsule Network benchmarks on four datasets utilizing only 110k parameters - a mere 1.25% of a standard Capsule Network's total. To the best of our knowledge it achieves the smallest parameter count among existing Capsule Networks. Similarly OrthCaps-Deep demonstrates competitive performance across four datasets utilizing only 1.2% of the parameters required by its counterparts.
papers.title_zh: OrthCaps : 带有分散注意路由和节奏的正正统卡普斯网
papers.abstract_zh: 在Capsule Networks(CapsNet)中,裁员是一个持续的挑战,导致计算成本和参数计数高。 尽管先前的研究已经引入了最初的胶囊层动态路由完全相连的自然和非垂直重量矩阵在更深层重新引入冗余。 除了动态路由需要循环,以进一步整合不断增长的计算需求。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个矫形胶囊网络(OrthCaps),以减少冗余性能改善路线性能和减少参数计数。 首先,在丢弃多余胶囊时引入高效的细管胶囊层。 第二条动态路线由垂直偏差的注意线取代,消除迭代和完全连通结构的需要。 最后在路由过程中的重量矩阵正对齐,以维持低粒子相似性,这是在CapsNet中采用家居式正对分解法以强制执行正对分解的第一种方法。 我们在基线数据集方面的试验确认,在分类任务中,正统资本的效率和稳健性得到确认,在分类任务中,通货膨胀研究证实每个组成部分的关键性。 OrthCaps-Shallow在四个数据集上的业绩优于其他Capsule 网络基准,四个数据集仅使用110k参数,仅占标准Capsule 网络总参数的1.25%。据我们所知,它达到现有Capsule 网络中最小的参数数。 同样,深孔孔雀显示四个数据集的竞争性业绩,只使用对应方要求的参数的1.2%。

papers.title: Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing Online Continual Learning with Multi-Level Supervision and Reverse Self-Distillation
papers.authors: Hongwei Yan, Liyuan Wang, Kaisheng Ma, Yi Zhong
papers.abstract: To accommodate real-world dynamics artificial intelligence systems need to cope with sequentially arriving content in an online manner. Beyond regular Continual Learning (CL) attempting to address catastrophic forgetting with offline training of each task Online Continual Learning (OCL) is a more challenging yet realistic setting that performs CL in a one-pass data stream. Current OCL methods primarily rely on memory replay of old training samples. However a notable gap from CL to OCL stems from the additional overfitting-underfitting dilemma associated with the use of rehearsal buffers: the inadequate learning of new training samples (underfitting) and the repeated learning of a few old training samples (overfitting). To this end we introduce a novel approach Multi-level Online Sequential Experts (MOSE) which cultivates the model as stacked sub-experts integrating multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. Supervision signals across multiple stages facilitate appropriate convergence of the new task while gathering various strengths from experts by knowledge distillation mitigates the performance decline of old tasks. MOSE demonstrates remarkable efficacy in learning new samples and preserving past knowledge through multi-level experts thereby significantly advancing OCL performance over state-of-the-art baselines (e.g. up to 7.3% on Split CIFAR-100 and 6.1% on Split Tiny-ImageNet).
papers.title_zh: Orchantate Orchestrate 中专:推进在线持续学习,实行多级监督和逆向自我蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 为了适应现实世界动态,人造情报系统需要以在线方式处理按顺序传送的内容。 除了试图通过在线持续学习的离线培训来解决灾难性的遗忘问题,在线持续学习是一个更具挑战性但更现实的环境,在一次性数据流中进行连续学习。 当前连续学习方法主要依靠旧培训样本的记忆回放。 然而,从CL到OCL之间的一个显著差距源于与使用排练缓冲有关的额外过于适合的两难处境:对新的培训样本的学习不足(不完善)和对一些旧的培训样本的反复学习(不完善)。 为此,我们引入了一种新的方法,即多层次在线序列专家(MOSE),将模型培养成堆叠的次专家,将多层次的监督和逆向自我蒸馏结合起来。 不同阶段的监督信号有助于适当统一新任务,同时通过知识蒸馏从专家那里收集各种力量,减轻旧任务的业绩下降。 MOSE通过多级专家在学习新样本和保存过去知识方面显示出显著的功效,从而大大促进了OCL在最新基线方面的业绩(例如,在Split CIFAR-100和Split Tiny-ImagageNet上分别高达7.3%和6.1%)。

papers.title: Open-World Human-Object Interaction Detection via Multi-modal Prompts
papers.authors: Jie Yang, Bingliang Li, Ailing Zeng, Lei Zhang, Ruimao Zhang
papers.abstract: In this paper we develop MP-HOI a powerful Multi-modal Prompt-based HOI detector designed to leverage both textual descriptions for open-set generalization and visual exemplars for handling high ambiguity in descriptions realizing HOI detection in the open world. Specifically it integrates visual prompts into existing language-guided-only HOI detectors to handle situations where textual descriptions face difficulties in generalization and to address complex scenarios with high interaction ambiguity. To facilitate MP-HOI training we build a large-scale HOI dataset named Magic-HOI which gathers six existing datasets into a unified label space forming over 186K images with 2.4K objects 1.2K actions and 20K HOI interactions. Furthermore to tackle the long-tail issue within the Magic-HOI dataset we introduce an automated pipeline for generating realistically annotated HOI images and present SynHOI a high-quality synthetic HOI dataset containing 100K images. Leveraging these two datasets MP-HOI optimizes the HOI task as a similarity learning process between multi-modal prompts and objects/interactions via a unified contrastive loss to learn generalizable and transferable objects/interactions representations from large-scale data. MP-HOI could serve as a generalist HOI detector surpassing the HOI vocabulary of existing expert models by more than 30 times. Concurrently our results demonstrate that MP-HOI exhibits remarkable zero-shot capability in real-world scenarios and consistently achieves a new state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks. Our project homepage is available at https://MP-HOI.github.io/.
papers.title_zh: 通过多模式提示手段对开放世界人体物体进行交互探测
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们开发了MP-HOI一个强大的多式即时即时HOI探测器,旨在利用开放式集成一般化和视觉示范的文字描述,处理在开放世界中实现HOI检测的描述中非常模糊的描述。 具体而言,它将视觉提示纳入现有的只用语言指导的HOI探测器,以处理文本描述在概括方面遇到困难的情况,并处理互动模糊度高的复杂情况。 为促进MP-HOI培训,我们建立了一个名为 Magic-HOI的大型HOI数据集,将现有的六个数据集收集成一个统一标签空间,由186K图像组成,有2.4K天体1.2K动作和20K HOI互动。 此外,为了在魔术-HOI数据集内解决长尾问题,我们引入了一条自动管道,以产生现实的附加说明的HOI图像,并向SynHOI提供了包含100K图像的高质量合成HOI数据集。 利用这两个数据集,MP-HOI将HOI的任务优化为多模式提示与对象/互动之间的类似学习过程,通过统一的对比性损失,从大规模数据中学习通用和可转移的物体/互动表示。 MP-HOI可作为普通HOI探测器,超过现有专家模型HOI词汇30倍以上。 同时,我们的结果显示,MP-HOI在现实世界情景中表现出惊人的零弹能力,并始终在不同基准中取得新的SOTA 性能。 我们的项目主页可在https://MP-HOI.github.io/上查阅。

papers.title: OneLLM: One Framework to Align All Modalities with Language
papers.authors: Jiaming Han, Kaixiong Gong, Yiyuan Zhang, Jiaqi Wang, Kaipeng Zhang, Dahua Lin, Yu Qiao, Peng Gao, Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have gained significant attention due to their strong multimodal understanding capability. However existing works rely heavily on modality-specific encoders which usually differ in architecture and are limited to common modalities. In this paper we present OneLLM an MLLM that aligns eight modalities to language using a unified framework. We achieve this through a unified multimodal encoder and a progressive multimodal alignment pipeline. In detail we first train an image projection module to connect a vision encoder with LLM. Then we build a universal projection module (UPM) by mixing multiple image projection modules and dynamic routing. Finally we progressively align more modalities to LLM with the UPM. To fully leverage the potential of OneLLM in following instructions we also curated a comprehensive multimodal instruction dataset including 2M items from image audio video point cloud depth/normal map IMU and fMRI brain activity. OneLLM is evaluated on 25 diverse benchmarks encompassing tasks such as multimodal captioning question answering and reasoning where it delivers excellent performance. Code data model and online demo are available at https://github.com/csuhan/OneLLM
papers.title_zh: 1个LLM:一个使所有方式与语言一致的框架
papers.abstract_zh: 由于多式大语言模式具有很强的多式理解能力,因此受到高度重视,但现有工作严重依赖特定模式的编码器,这些编码器在结构上通常不同,仅限于共同模式。 在本文中,我们介绍了一个将8种模式与使用统一框架的语言相匹配的MLLM,我们通过一个统一的多式联运编码器和一个渐进式多式联运协调管道实现这一目标。我们首先培训一个图像投影模块,将视觉编码器与LLM连接起来。 然后,我们通过混合多个图像投影模块和动态路径来构建一个通用投影模块(UPM ) 。 最后,我们逐渐将更多模式与LLM和UPM相匹配。 为了充分利用ONLLM在遵守指示方面的潜力,我们还开发了一个综合的多式联运教学数据集,其中包括来自图像音频视频点云层深度/正常地图IMU和FMRI大脑活动的2M项目。 以25个不同基准对一个LLM进行了评价,其中包括多式字幕问题回答和推理等任务,如果它表现优异,代码数据模型和在线演示可在https://github.com/csuhan/OneLLM上查阅。

papers.title: Omni-SMoLA: Boosting Generalist Multimodal Models with Soft Mixture of Low-rank Experts
papers.authors: Jialin Wu, Xia Hu, Yaqing Wang, Bo Pang, Radu Soricut
papers.abstract: In this work we present Omni-SMoLA a multimodal architecture that mixes many multi-modal experts efficiently and achieves both high specialist and generalist performance. In contrast to previous models for which we see performance degradation on average when training the models on a wide range of tasks we show that the SMoLA low-rank experts are able to model different skills and task and overall improve the performance of a generalist model. This finding indicates that simple LMM fine-tuning is suboptimal for handling a wide range of tasks and that pairing the act of fine-tuning with specifically-designed architecture changes leads to better performing models.
papers.title_zh: Omni-SMoLA:利用低级专家的软混合体促进通用主义多模式模型
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们向Omni-SMoLA展示了一种多式联运结构,它有效地混合了许多多模式专家,并取得了高水平的专家和通才业绩。 与以往的模式不同,我们看到,在对模型进行广泛任务培训时,业绩平均下降,而以往的模式则表明,SMOLA低级专家能够模拟不同的技能和任务,全面改进通才模式的绩效。 这一调查结果表明,简单的LMM微调对于处理一系列广泛的任务来说并不理想,而微调行为与具体设计的建筑变化相结合,可导致更好的运作模式。

papers.title: OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Generation via Mixture of Controllers
papers.authors: Han Liang, Jiacheng Bao, Ruichi Zhang, Sihan Ren, Yuecheng Xu, Sibei Yang, Xin Chen, Jingyi Yu, Lan Xu
papers.abstract: We have recently seen tremendous progress in realistic text-to-motion generation. Yet the existing methods often fail or produce implausible motions with unseen text inputs which limits the applications. In this paper we present OMG a novel framework which enables compelling motion generation from zero-shot open-vocabulary text prompts. Our key idea is to carefully tailor the pretrain-then-finetune paradigm into the text-to-motion generation. At the pre-training stage our model improves the generation ability by learning the rich out-of-domain inherent motion traits. To this end we scale up a large unconditional diffusion model up to 1B parameters so as to utilize the massive unlabeled motion data up to over 20M motion instances. At the subsequent fine-tuning stage we introduce motion ControlNet which incorporates text prompts as conditioning information through a trainable copy of the pre-trained model and the proposed novel Mixture-of-Controllers (MoC) block. MoC block adaptively recognizes various ranges of the sub-motions with a cross-attention mechanism and processes them separately with the text-token-specific experts. Such a design effectively aligns the CLIP token embeddings of text prompts to various ranges of compact and expressive motion features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our OMG achieves significant improvements over the state-of-the-art methods on zero-shot text-to-motion generation. Project page: https://tr3e.github.io/omg-page.
papers.title_zh: OMG:通过主计长混合组合,努力实现公开的词汇运动
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,我们在现实的文本到动作一代方面取得了巨大进展。 然而,现有的方法常常失败或产生难以想象的动作,而无形的文本投入限制了应用。 在本文中,我们向OMG展示了一个新颖的框架,它使得从零弹的开放词汇文本的提示中产生有说服力的动脉。 我们的关键思想是仔细地将预演前的纤维化模式适应到文本到动作的一代。 在培训前阶段,我们的模型通过学习内容丰富的外部固有运动特性来提高生成能力。 为此,我们扩大了一个大型无条件扩散模型,达到1B参数,以便利用大型无标签运动数据,达到20M运动实例。 在随后的微调阶段,我们引入了运动控制网,通过经过培训的预培训模式和拟议的新型控制者混合(Mixture)块的可培训副本,将文字提示作为附带条件的信息纳入其中。 媒体部块在适应性上承认具有交叉关注机制的各种小动作,并与具体文本专家分别处理。这种设计有效地将CLIP象征性的文本提示嵌入到各种紧凑和表达式动作功能中。 广泛的实验表明,我们的环境管理集团在零发文本到感动生成的最先进方法方面取得了重大改进,项目网页:https://tr3e.github.io/omg-page。

papers.title: MRFS: Mutually Reinforcing Image Fusion and Segmentation
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Xuhui Zuo, Jie Jiang, Chunchao Guo, Jiayi Ma
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a coupled learning framework to break the performance bottleneck of infrared-visible image fusion and segmentation called MRFS. By leveraging the intrinsic consistency between vision and semantics it emphasizes mutual reinforcement rather than treating these tasks as separate issues. First we embed weakened information recovery and salient information integration into the image fusion task employing the CNN-based interactive gated mixed attention (IGM-Att) module to extract high-quality visual features. This aims to satisfy human visual perception producing fused images with rich textures high contrast and vivid colors. Second a transformer-based progressive cycle attention (PC-Att) module is developed to enhance semantic segmentation. It establishes single-modal self-reinforcement and cross-modal mutual complementarity enabling more accurate decisions in machine semantic perception. Then the cascade of IGM-Att and PC-Att couples image fusion and semantic segmentation tasks implicitly bringing vision-related and semantics-related features into closer alignment. Therefore they mutually provide learning priors to each other resulting in visually satisfying fused images and more accurate segmentation decisions. Extensive experiments on public datasets showcase the advantages of our method in terms of visual satisfaction and decision accuracy. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaoZhang1018/MRFS.
papers.title_zh: MRFS: 相互加强图像融合和分割
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个共同学习框架,以打破红外线可见图像融合和分离的性能瓶颈,称为MRFS。 通过利用视觉和语义之间的内在一致性,本文强调相互加强,而不是将这些任务作为单独问题处理。 首先,我们利用有线电视新闻网的互动式封闭式混合关注(IGM-Att)模块,将削弱的信息恢复和突出的信息整合纳入图像融合任务,以提取高质量的视觉特征。 其目的是满足人类视觉感知,产生富饶的纹理、高对比度和生动颜色的融合图像。 其次,开发了一个基于变压器的渐进循环关注模块(PC-Att),以加强语义分割。 它确立了单一模式的自我加强和跨模式的相互配合,以便能够在机器语义感方面作出更准确的决定。 然后是IGM-Att和PC-Att夫妇图像融合和语义分离任务的级联,隐含着将与视觉和语义有关的特征更紧密地联系起来。 因此,它们相互提供相互学习的前科,从而产生可视满意的装配图像和更准确的分解决定。 对公共数据集的广泛实验展示了我们的方法在视觉满意度和决定准确性方面的优势。 该守则可在https://github.com/HaoZhang1018MRFS上公开查阅。

papers.title: MoPD: Mixture-of-Prompts Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Yang Chen, Shuai Fu, Yu Zhang
papers.abstract: Soft prompt learning methods are effective for adapting vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks. Nevertheless, empirical evidence reveals a tendency of existing methods that they overfit seen classes and exhibit degraded performance on unseen classes. This limitation is due to the inherent bias in the training data towards the seen classes. To address this issue, we propose a novel soft prompt learning method, named Mixture-of-Prompts Distillation (MoPD), which can effectively transfer useful knowledge from hard prompts manually hand-crafted (a.k.a. teacher prompts) to the learnable soft prompt (a.k.a. student prompt), thereby enhancing the generalization ability of soft prompts on unseen classes. Moreover, the proposed MoPD method utilizes a gating network that learns to select hard prompts used for prompt distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MoPD method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines especially on on unseen classes.
papers.title_zh: MOPD: 视觉语言模型混合剂蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 软化的即时学习方法对于使视觉语言模型适应下游任务是有效的,然而,实证证据表明,现有方法的倾向是,它们比目击班长得多,在看不见班级上表现不佳。 之所以有这一限制,是因为培训数据中固有的偏向于所看到的班级。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用一种新的软性快速学习方法,名为“混合生产蒸馏法 ” ( MPD ) , 这种方法可以有效地从手工艺手工艺的硬性手工艺(a.k.a.a.)中传授有用的知识。 微软提示(a.k.a.学生提示)可以学习的软提示(a.k.a.学生提示 ) , 从而增强隐形班级软提示的普及能力。 此外,拟议的微软提示方法还利用一个格子网,学会选择用于快速蒸馏的硬提示。 广泛的实验表明,拟议的MOPD方法优于最新水平的基线,特别是在不可见的类别上。

papers.title: Model Adaptation for Time Constrained Embodied Control
papers.authors: Jaehyun Song, Minjong Yoo, Honguk Woo
papers.abstract: When adopting a deep learning model for embodied agents it is required that the model structure be optimized for specific tasks and operational conditions. Such optimization can be static such as model compression or dynamic such as adaptive inference. Yet these techniques have not been fully investigated for embodied control systems subject to time constraints which necessitate sequential decision-making for multiple tasks each with distinct inference latency limitations. In this paper we present MoDeC a time constraint-aware embodied control framework using the modular model adaptation. We formulate model adaptation to varying operational conditions on resource and time restrictions as dynamic routing on a modular network incorporating these conditions as part of multi-task objectives. Our evaluation across several vision-based embodied environments demonstrates the robustness of MoDeC showing that it outperforms other model adaptation methods in both performance and adherence to time constraints in robotic manipulation and autonomous driving applications.
papers.title_zh: 时间约束内装内装式控制模型适应模型
papers.abstract_zh: 在对体现剂采用深层学习模式时,需要根据具体任务和业务条件优化模型结构,这种优化可以是静态的,如模型压缩或动态,如适应性推断。 然而,尚未对这些技术进行充分调查,以确定具有内涵的受时间限制的控制系统,这就需要就每一项具有明确的推论延缓限制的多重任务进行顺序决策。 在本文中,我们向国防部展示一个使用模块模型适应的具有时间限制的内含控制框架,我们根据资源和时间限制的不同操作条件制定模式适应,作为将这些条件纳入多任务目标的模块网络的动态路线。 我们在若干基于视觉的体现环境中进行的评价表明,DEC的强健性表明,它在机器人操纵和自主驾驶应用方面的性能和遵守时间限制方面优于其他示范适应方法。

papers.title: MoDE: CLIP Data Experts via Clustering
papers.authors: Jiawei Ma, Po-Yao Huang, Saining Xie, Shang-Wen Li, Luke Zettlemoyer, Shih-Fu Chang, Wen-Tau Yih, Hu Xu
papers.abstract: The success of contrastive language-image pretraining (CLIP) relies on the supervision from the pairing between images and captions which tends to be noisy in web-crawled data. We present Mixture of Data Experts (MoDE) and learn a system of CLIP data experts via clustering. Each data expert is trained on one data cluster being less sensitive to false negative noises in other clusters. At inference time we ensemble their outputs by applying weights determined through the correlation between task metadata and cluster conditions. To estimate the correlation precisely the samples in one cluster should be semantically similar but the number of data experts should still be reasonable for training and inference. As such we consider the ontology in human language and propose to use fine-grained cluster centers to represent each data expert at a coarse-grained level. Experimental studies show that four CLIP data experts on ViT-B/16 outperform the ViT-L/14 by OpenAI CLIP and OpenCLIP on zero-shot image classification but with less (<35%) training cost. Meanwhile MoDE can train all data expert asynchronously and can flexibly include new data experts. The code is available here.
papers.title_zh: MoDE: CLIP 数据专家,通过集群
papers.abstract_zh: 对比性语言图像预培训的成功取决于图像和字幕配对的监督,这些图像和字幕往往在网上绘制的数据中吵闹。 我们提出数据专家混合(MoDE)并通过集群学习CLIP数据专家系统。 每个数据专家都接受关于一个数据组的培训,该组对其他组群的虚假负面噪音不那么敏感。 要精确地估计某一组样品的相互关系,就应该具有相似的音义,但数据专家的人数对于培训和推断仍应是合理的。 因此,我们考虑人类语言的本体学,并提议使用精细的组群中心代表每个数据专家粗略的组群一级。 实验研究表明,四个关于Vit-B/16的CLIP数据专家在零发图像分类方面超过了OpenAI CLIP和OpenCLIP的VIT-L/14,但培训成本( < 35%)较低。与此同时,MoE可以不同步地培训所有数据专家,并灵活地包括新的数据专家。这里有代码。

papers.title: Mocap Everyone Everywhere: Lightweight Motion Capture With Smartwatches and a Head-Mounted Camera
papers.authors: Jiye Lee, Hanbyul Joo
papers.abstract: We present a lightweight and affordable motion capture method based on two smartwatches and a head-mounted camera. In contrast to the existing approaches that use six or more expert-level IMU devices our approach is much more cost-effective and convenient. Our method can make wearable motion capture accessible to everyone everywhere enabling 3D full-body motion capture in diverse environments. As a key idea to overcome the extreme sparsity and ambiguities of sensor inputs with different modalities we integrate 6D head poses obtained from the head-mounted cameras for motion estimation. To enable capture in expansive indoor and outdoor scenes we propose an algorithm to track and update floor level changes to define head poses coupled with a multi-stage Transformer-based regression module. We also introduce novel strategies leveraging visual cues of egocentric images to further enhance the motion capture quality while reducing ambiguities. We demonstrate the performance of our method on various challenging scenarios including complex outdoor environments and everyday motions including object interactions and social interactions among multiple individuals.
papers.title_zh: 随处可见:轻量量级运动捕捉,配有智能监视器和一台头向照相机
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种轻量级和负担得起的运动捕捉方法,其依据是两个智能观察器和一个头顶摄像机。 与使用6个或6个以上专家级IMU设备的现有方法相比,我们的方法更具有成本效益,更方便。 我们的方法可以让每个地方的每个人 都能进入可磨损的动作捕捉 使3D全体运动能够捕捉到 不同环境中的3D全体运动 作为一种关键的想法 克服感应器输入的极端偏狭性和模糊性 以及不同的方式 我们整合了6D头部 为了在广泛的室内和室外场景中进行捕捉,我们建议采用一种算法,跟踪和更新楼层变化,以界定头部姿势,并辅之以一个基于多阶段变压器的回归模块。 我们还采用新的战略,利用以自我为中心的图像的视觉提示,进一步提高运动捕捉质量,同时减少含糊不清之处。 我们展示了我们在各种挑战性情景上的方法表现,包括复杂的户外环境和日常行动,包括目标互动和多个个人之间的社会互动。

papers.title: MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
papers.authors: Xiang Yue, Yuansheng Ni, Kai Zhang, Tianyu Zheng, Ruoqi Liu, Ge Zhang, Samuel Stevens, Dongfu Jiang, Weiming Ren, Yuxuan Sun, Cong Wei, Botao Yu, Ruibin Yuan, Renliang Sun, Ming Yin, Boyuan Zheng, Zhenzhu Yang, Yibo Liu, Wenhao Huang, Huan Sun, Yu Su, Wenhu Chen
papers.abstract: We introduce MMMU: a new benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal models on massive multi-discipline tasks demanding college-level subject knowledge and deliberate reasoning. MMMU includes 11.5K meticulously collected multimodal questions from college exams quizzes and textbooks covering six core disciplines: Art & Design Business Science Health & Medicine Humanities & Social Science and Tech & Engineering. These questions span 30 subjects and 183 subfields comprising 30 highly heterogeneous image types such as charts diagrams maps tables music sheets and chemical structures. Unlike existing benchmarks MMMU focuses on advanced perception and reasoning with domain-specific knowledge challenging models to perform tasks akin to those faced by experts. The evaluation of 28 open-source LMMs as well as the proprietary GPT-4V(ision) and Gemini highlights the substantial challenges posed by MMMU. Even the advanced GPT-4V and Gemini Ultra only achieve accuracies of 56% and 59% respectively indicating significant room for improvement. We believe MMMU will stimulate the community to build next-generation multimodal foundation models towards expert artificial general intelligence.
papers.title_zh: MMMMU: 专家AGI的大规模多纪律多纪律多模式多模式理解和理由说明基准
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了MMMMU:一个新的基准,旨在评价要求大学一级主题知识和深思熟虑地推理的大规模多纪律任务的多式联运模式。 MMMMU包括从大学考试测验和涉及六个核心学科的教科书中仔细收集的11.5K多式问题:艺术和设计商业科学、卫生和医学、人文学科和社会科学以及技术和工程。 这些问题涉及30个主题和183个子领域,包括30种高度多样化的图像类型,如图表图示,地图表音乐表和化学结构。 与现有的基准不同的是,MMMMM侧重于先进认识和推理,采用具有领域特定知识的具有挑战性的模式来完成类似于专家所面临的任务,对28个开放源码LMMM以及专利的GPT-4V(ision)和Gemini的评估突出了MMMMMU构成的重大挑战。 即使是先进的GPT-4V和Gemini Ultra也只能分别达到56%和59%的认可率,这表明还有很大的改进余地。 我们认为MMMMU将激励社区建立下一代多式基础模型,以培养专家人工一般智能。

papers.title: MLIP: Enhancing Medical Visual Representation with Divergence Encoder and Knowledge-guided Contrastive Learning
papers.authors: Zhe Li, Laurence T. Yang, Bocheng Ren, Xin Nie, Zhangyang Gao, Cheng Tan, Stan Z. Li
papers.abstract: The scarcity of annotated data has sparked significant interest in unsupervised pre-training methods that leverage medical reports as auxiliary signals for medical visual representation learning. However existing research overlooks the multi-granularity nature of medical visual representation and lacks suitable contrastive learning techniques to improve the models' generalizability across different granularities leading to the underutilization of image-text information. To address this we propose MLIP a novel framework leveraging domain-specific medical knowledge as guiding signals to integrate language information into the visual domain through image-text contrastive learning. Our model includes global contrastive learning with our designed divergence encoder local token-knowledge-patch alignment contrastive learning and knowledge-guided category-level contrastive learning with expert knowledge. Experimental evaluations reveal the efficacy of our model in enhancing transfer performance for tasks such as image classification object detection and semantic segmentation. Notably MLIP surpasses state-of-the-art methods even with limited annotated data highlighting the potential of multimodal pre-training in advancing medical representation learning.
papers.title_zh: MLIP: 提高医疗视觉代表性,采用差异编码器和知识指导的矛盾学习
papers.abstract_zh: 附加说明的数据稀缺,引起了人们对未经监督的培训前方法的极大兴趣,这些方法利用医疗报告作为医学视觉表现学习的辅助信号。 然而,现有的研究忽略了医学视觉表现的多面性,缺乏适当的对比式学习技术来改进模型在不同颗粒中的可通用性,从而导致图像文本信息的利用不足。 为此,我们建议劳动和社会政策部建立一个新的框架,利用具体领域的医疗知识作为指导信号,通过图像文字对比学习,将语言信息纳入视觉领域。 我们的模式包括全球有色人种的学习,我们设计了差异编码器,用于当地象征性的、知识批量的校正对比式学习,以及知识引导的、类别层次的、有专门知识的、有差别的、有差别的学习。 实验评价揭示了我们模型在提高图像分类物体探测和语义分离等任务转移性能方面的功效。 值得注意的是,即使附加说明的数据有限,突出了多式联运预培训在推进医学代理学习方面的潜力,但劳动和残疾人部也超越了最先进的方法。

papers.title: M3-UDA: A New Benchmark for Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Fetal Cardiac Structure Detection
papers.authors: Bin Pu, Liwen Wang, Jiewen Yang, Guannan He, Xingbo Dong, Shengli Li, Ying Tan, Ming Chen, Zhe Jin, Kenli Li, Xiaomeng Li
papers.abstract: The anatomical structure detection of fetal cardiac views is crucial for diagnosing fetal congenital heart disease. In practice there is a large domain gap between different hospitals' data such as the variable data quality due to differences in acquisition equipment. In addition accurate annotation information provided by obstetrician experts is always very costly or even unavailable. This study explores the unsupervised domain adaptive fetal cardiac structure detection issue. Existing unsupervised domain adaptive object detection (UDAOD) approaches mainly focus on detecting objects in natural scenes such as Foggy Cityscapes where the structural relationships of natural scenes are uncertain. Unlike all previous UDAOD scenarios we first collected a Fetal Cardiac Structure dataset from two hospital centers called FCS and proposed a multi-matching UDA approach (M3-UDA) including Histogram Matching (HM) Sub-structure Matching (SM) and Global-structure Matching (GM) to better transfer the topological knowledge of anatomical structure for UDA detection in medical scenarios. HM mitigates the domain gap between the source and target caused by pixel transformation. SM fuses the different angle information of the sub-structure to obtain the local topological knowledge for bridging the domain gap of the internal sub-structure. GM is designed to align the global topological knowledge of the whole organ from the source and target domain. Extensive experiments on our collected FCS and CardiacUDA and experimental results show that M3-UDA outperforms existing UDAOD studies significantly. All datasets and source code are available at : https://github.com/xmed-lab/M3-UDA
papers.title_zh: M3-UDA:不受监督的调节性胎儿心血管结构检测新基准
papers.abstract_zh: 胎儿心脏观察的解剖结构检测对于诊断胎儿先天性心脏病至关重要,实际上,不同医院的数据之间存在巨大的领域差距,例如由于获取设备的差异,数据质量不一。 此外,产科专家提供的准确的注解信息总是非常昂贵,甚至根本没有,本研究报告探讨了未经监督的胎儿心脏结构适应性检测领域问题。 现有的未经监督的适应性天体探测(UDAOD)方法主要侧重于在自然场景,如自然场景的结构关系不确定的福吉城景等自然场景中探测天体。 与以往所有UDAOD情景不同的是,我们首先从两个医院中心(称为FCS)收集了胎儿心脏病结构数据集,并提出了多匹配UDA方法(M3-UDA),包括直方匹配(HM)子结构匹配(SM)和全球结构匹配(GM),以更好地转让用于在医疗情景中检测UDA的解剖结构的地形学知识。 HM缩小了像素变异造成的源和目标之间的域间差距,SM结合了子结构的不同角度信息,以获得当地地形学知识,缩小内部子结构的域间差距。 全球机制旨在从源和目标领域调整整个器官的全球地貌学知识,对我们收集的全氟辛烷磺酰胺和心肺病的广泛实验以及实验结果显示,M3-UDA大大优于现有的UDAOD研究。 所有数据集和源代码均可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/xmed-lab/M3-UDA。

papers.title: LUWA Dataset: Learning Lithic Use-Wear Analysis on Microscopic Images
papers.authors: Jing Zhang, Irving Fang, Hao Wu, Akshat Kaushik, Alice Rodriguez, Hanwen Zhao, Juexiao Zhang, Zhuo Zheng, Radu Iovita, Chen Feng
papers.abstract: Lithic Use-Wear Analysis (LUWA) using microscopic images is an underexplored vision-for-science research area. It seeks to distinguish the worked material which is critical for understanding archaeological artifacts material interactions tool functionalities and dental records. However this challenging task goes beyond the well-studied image classification problem for common objects. It is affected by many confounders owing to the complex wear mechanism and microscopic imaging which makes it difficult even for human experts to identify the worked material successfully. In this paper we investigate the following three questions on this unique vision task for the first time:(i) How well can state-of-the-art pre-trained models (like DINOv2) generalize to the rarely seen domain? (ii) How can few-shot learning be exploited for scarce microscopic images? (iii) How do the ambiguous magnification and sensing modality influence the classification accuracy? To study these we collaborated with archaeologists and built the first open-source and the largest LUWA dataset containing 23130 microscopic images with different magnifications and sensing modalities. Extensive experiments show that existing pre-trained models notably outperform human experts but still leave a large gap for improvements. Most importantly the LUWA dataset provides an underexplored opportunity for vision and learning communities and complements existing image classification problems on common objects.
papers.title_zh: LUWA 数据集:学习微显微图像的液态使用分析
papers.abstract_zh: 使用显微镜图象的液态使用-服装分析(LUWA)是一个探索不足的科学研究远景研究领域,旨在区分对了解考古文物材料互动工具功能和牙科记录至关重要的工作材料。 然而,这一具有挑战性的任务超越了研究周密的通用物体图像分类问题,它受到许多困惑者的影响,因为磨损装置复杂和微镜成像使甚至人类专家都难以成功地确定工作材料。 在本文中,我们第一次调查关于这一独特远景任务的以下三个问题:(一) 最先进的预培训模式(如DINOV2)如何概括到很少见的领域? (二) 如何利用少见的学习来制作稀少的微镜图象? (三) 模糊的放大和感测方式如何影响分类的准确性?为了研究这些,我们与考古学家合作,建立了第一个开放源码和最大的LUWA数据集,其中包含23130个具有不同放大和感测方式的显微图象。 广泛的实验表明,现有的预先培训模式明显优于人类专家,但仍有很大的改进差距,最重要的是,世界妇女联盟数据集为视觉和学习界提供了一个探索不足的机会,补充了共同对象的现有图像分类问题。

papers.title: Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition for Medical Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yuhang Zhou, Haolin Li, Siyuan Du, Jiangchao Yao, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang
papers.abstract: The popularity of large-scale pre-training has promoted the development of medical foundation models. However some studies have shown that although foundation models exhibit strong general feature extraction capabilities their performance on specific tasks is still inferior to task-specific methods. In this paper we explore a new perspective called "Knowledge Decomposition" to improve the performance on specific medical tasks which deconstruct the foundation model into multiple lightweight expert models each dedicated to a particular task with the goal of improving specialization while concurrently mitigating resource expenditure. To accomplish the above objective we design a novel framework named Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition (LoRKD) which explicitly separates graidents by incorporating low-rank expert modules and the efficient knowledge separation convolution. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the decomposed models perform well in terms of performance and transferability even surpassing the original foundation models. Source code is available at: https://github.com/MediaBrain-SJTU/LoRKD
papers.title_zh: 医疗基础模型的低兰克知识分解
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模培训前的普及促进了医疗基础模式的发展,但一些研究显示,尽管基础模式具有很强的一般特征提取能力,但具体任务的业绩仍然低于具体任务的方法。 在本文中,我们探索了一种名为“知识分解”的新视角,以改善具体医疗任务的业绩,这些具体医疗任务将基础模型拆成多个轻量级专家模型,每个模型专门从事一项特定任务,目的是改进专业化,同时减少资源支出。 为了实现上述目标,我们设计了一个名为 " 低兰克知识分解 " (LORKD)的新框架,通过纳入低级专家模块和高效率的知识分解整合,明确区分突出人物。 广泛的实验结果显示,分解的模型在性能和可转移性方面表现良好,甚至超过了原始基础模型,来源代码见https://github.com/MediaBrain-STU/LORKD。

papers.title: LoS: Local Structure-Guided Stereo Matching
papers.authors: Kunhong Li, Longguang Wang, Ye Zhang, Kaiwen Xue, Shunbo Zhou, Yulan Guo
papers.abstract: Estimating disparities in challenging areas is difficult and limits the performance of stereo matching models. In this paper we exploit local structure information (LSI) to enhance stereo matching. Specifically our LSI comprises a series of key elements including the slant plane (parameterised by disparity gradients) disparity offset details and neighbouring relations. This LSI empowers our method to effectively handle intricate structures including object boundaries and curved surfaces. We bootstrap the LSI from monocular depth and subsequently iteratively refine it to better capture the underlying scene geometry constraints. Building upon the LSI we introduce the Local Structure-Guided Propagation (LSGP) which enhances the disparity initialization optimization and refinement processes. By combining LSGP with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) we present our novel stereo matching method referred to as Local Structure-guided stereo matching (LoS). Remarkably LoS achieves top-ranking results on four widely recognized public benchmark datasets (ETH3D Middlebury KITTI 15 & 12) demonstrating the superior capabilities of our proposed model.
papers.title_zh: LoS: 地方结构指导立体对齐
papers.abstract_zh: 难以估计挑战领域的差距,限制了立体声匹配模型的性能,在本文中,我们利用当地结构信息(LSI)加强立体声匹配。 具体地说,我们的LSI由一系列关键要素组成,包括倾斜平面(以差异梯度为参数)差异抵消细节和相邻关系。 LSI授权我们有效处理包括物体边界和曲线表面在内的复杂结构的方法。 我们把LSI从单眼深度引来,然后再反复地加以完善,以更好地捕捉基本场景几何条件的制约。 我们以LSI为基础,引入了“当地结构引导推进”(LSGP ) , 强化差异初始化优化和完善过程。 通过将LSGP与Gated经常股(GRU)合并,我们提出了我们称为地方结构制导立体配对(LOS)的新型立体比对方法。 值得称道的LOS在四套得到广泛承认的公共基准数据集(ETH3D Middlebury KITTI 15和12)上取得了最显著的成果,显示了我们拟议模型的超能力。

papers.title: Learned Representation-Guided Diffusion Models for Large-Image Generation
papers.authors: Alexandros Graikos, Srikar Yellapragada, Minh-Quan Le, Saarthak Kapse, Prateek Prasanna, Joel Saltz, Dimitris Samaras
papers.abstract: To synthesize high-fidelity samples diffusion models typically require auxiliary data to guide the generation process. However it is impractical to procure the painstaking patch-level annotation effort required in specialized domains like histopathology and satellite imagery; it is often performed by domain experts and involves hundreds of millions of patches. Modern-day self-supervised learning (SSL) representations encode rich semantic and visual information. In this paper we posit that such representations are expressive enough to act as proxies to fine-grained human labels. We introduce a novel approach that trains diffusion models conditioned on embeddings from SSL. Our diffusion models successfully project these features back to high-quality histopathology and remote sensing images. In addition we construct larger images by assembling spatially consistent patches inferred from SSL embeddings preserving long-range dependencies. Augmenting real data by generating variations of real images improves downstream classifier accuracy for patch-level and larger image-scale classification tasks. Our models are effective even on datasets not encountered during training demonstrating their robustness and generalizability. Generating images from learned embeddings is agnostic to the source of the embeddings. The SSL embeddings used to generate a large image can either be extracted from a reference image or sampled from an auxiliary model conditioned on any related modality (e.g. class labels text genomic data). As proof of concept we introduce the text-to-large image synthesis paradigm where we successfully synthesize large pathology and satellite images out of text descriptions.
papers.title_zh: 大型一代人学术代表性指导传播模型
papers.abstract_zh: 要合成高忠诚度样品扩散模型,通常需要辅助数据来指导生成过程。 然而,在诸如组织病理学和卫星图像等专门领域开展艰苦的补丁说明工作是不切实际的;这项工作往往由域专家进行,涉及数亿个补丁。 现代自我监督的学习(SSL)演示文稿将丰富的语义和视觉信息编码为内容丰富的语义和视觉信息。在本文中,我们假设这些文体的表达方式足以作为精细的人类标签的代名词。我们引入了一种新颖的方法,即培训以从SSL嵌入为条件的传播模型。 我们的传播模型成功地将这些特征投射到高质量的病理学和遥感图像中。此外,我们还通过收集空间上一致的从保护远程依赖的SSL嵌入中推断出来的补丁来构建更大的图像。 通过产生真实图像的变异来增加真实数据,提高了补丁级和较大图像尺度分类任务的下游分类精确度。 我们的模型甚至对在培训中未遇到的数据集有效,显示其坚固性和可概括性。 从学到的嵌入中生成图像是嵌入源的不可知性。 用于生成大图像的 SSL 嵌入可以从参考图像中提取,也可以从任何相关模式(如类标签文本基因组数据)的辅助模型中提取样本。 作为概念的证明,我们引入了文本到大图像综合模式,我们成功地从文本描述中综合了大型病理学和卫星图像。

papers.title: LASO: Language-guided Affordance Segmentation on 3D Object
papers.authors: Yicong Li, Na Zhao, Junbin Xiao, Chun Feng, Xiang Wang, Tat-seng Chua
papers.abstract: Segmenting affordance in 3D data is key for bridging perception and action in robots. Existing efforts mostly focus on the visual side and overlook the affordance knowledge from a semantic aspect. This oversight not only limits their generalization to unseen objects but more importantly hinders their synergy with large language models (LLMs) which are excellent task planners that can decompose an overarching command into agent-actionable instructions. With this regard we propose a novel task Language-guided Affordance Segmentation on 3D Object (LASO) which challenges a model to segment a 3D object's part relevant to a given affordance question. To facilitate the task we contribute a dataset comprising 19751 point-question pairs covering 8434 object shapes and 870 expert-crafted questions. As a pioneer solution we further propose PointRefer which highlights an adaptive fusion module to identify target affordance regions at different scales. To ensure a text-aware segmentation we adopt a set of affordance queries conditioned on linguistic cues to generate dynamic kernels. These kernels are further used to convolute with point features and generate a segmentation mask. Comprehensive experiments and analyses validate PointRefer's effectiveness. With these efforts We hope that LASO can steer the direction of 3D affordance guiding it towards enhanced integration with the evolving capabilities of LLMs.
papers.title_zh: LASO: 3D对象的语文指导支付能力分割
papers.abstract_zh: 在三维数据中进行分解是机器人连接感知和行动的关键。 现有的努力大多集中在视觉方面,忽略了语义学学知识。 这种监督不仅限制其一般化为无形物体,而且更重要的是妨碍其与大型语言模型(LLMs)的协同作用。 大型语言模型是出色的任务规划者,可以将总体指令分解为可采取行动的指令。 在这方面,我们提出一项新的任务,即三维对象的语言指导支付能力分割(LASO),它挑战了将三维对象与特定负担问题相关的部分分割成三维对象的模式。 为促进这项任务,我们提供了一套数据集,包括19751对涉及8434个天体形状和870个专家设计问题的点问题和19751对点问题数据集,作为首创解决办法,我们进一步提出点参考方案,强调一个适应性聚变模块,以在不同尺度上确定目标发源区域。 为确保文本识别分解,我们采用了一套以语言提示为条件的附加Query方法,以生成动态内核。这些内核还被进一步用于与点特征交融,并产生分解面罩。全面实验和分析验证了PointRefer的有效性。 我们希望,通过这些努力,LASO能够指导3D法则的方向,指导它与LLMs不断发展的能力进一步融合。

papers.title: LASIL: Learner-Aware Supervised Imitation Learning For Long-term Microscopic Traffic Simulation
papers.authors: Ke Guo, Zhenwei Miao, Wei Jing, Weiwei Liu, Weizi Li, Dayang Hao, Jia Pan
papers.abstract: Microscopic traffic simulation plays a crucial role in transportation engineering by providing insights into individual vehicle behavior and overall traffic flow. However creating a realistic simulator that accurately replicates human driving behaviors in various traffic conditions presents significant challenges. Traditional simulators relying on heuristic models often fail to deliver accurate simulations due to the complexity of real-world traffic environments. Due to the covariate shift issue existing imitation learning-based simulators often fail to generate stable long-term simulations. In this paper we propose a novel approach called learner-aware supervised imitation learning to address the covariate shift problem in multi-agent imitation learning. By leveraging a variational autoencoder simultaneously modeling the expert and learner state distribution our approach augments expert states such that the augmented state is aware of learner state distribution. Our method applied to urban traffic simulation demonstrates significant improvements over existing state-of-the-art baselines in both short-term microscopic and long-term macroscopic realism when evaluated on the real-world dataset pNEUMA.
papers.title_zh: LASIL: 长期微型循环模拟学习的模拟模拟模拟学习
papers.abstract_zh: 微型交通模拟在运输工程中发挥着关键作用,通过提供个人车辆行为和总体交通流量的洞察力。 但是,创造一个现实的模拟器,准确复制各种交通条件下的载人驾驶行为,这带来了巨大的挑战。 由于现实世界交通环境的复杂性,依赖超光速模型的传统模拟器往往无法提供准确的模拟。 由于共变转换问题,现有的以学习为基础的模拟器往往无法产生稳定的长期模拟。 在本文中,我们提出一种新颖的方法,叫做学习者认知受监督的模仿学习,以解决多试剂模仿学习中的共变转移问题。 通过同时利用变式自动编码器模拟专家和学习者国家分布,我们的方法扩大了专家的编制,使扩大后的国家意识到学习者国家分布。 我们在城市交通模拟中采用的方法表明,在对真实世界数据集pNEUMA进行评估时,短期微观和长期宏观现实主义的现有最新基线有了显著改进。

papers.title: Language-guided Image Reflection Separation
papers.authors: Haofeng Zhong, Yuchen Hong, Shuchen Weng, Jinxiu Liang, Boxin Shi
papers.abstract: This paper studies the problem of language-guided reflection separation which aims at addressing the ill-posed reflection separation problem by introducing language descriptions to provide layer content. We propose a unified framework to solve this problem which leverages the cross-attention mechanism with contrastive learning strategies to construct the correspondence between language descriptions and image layers. A gated network design and a randomized training strategy are employed to tackle the recognizable layer ambiguity. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by the significant performance advantage over existing reflection separation methods on both quantitative and qualitative comparisons.
papers.title_zh: 语文指导图像反射分离
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究语言指导思考分离问题,其目的是通过引入语言说明提供层次内容,解决反思考分离问题。 我们提出一个统一框架来解决这一问题,利用跨关注机制与对比式学习战略,构建语言描述与图像层之间的对应关系。 采用封闭式网络设计和随机化培训战略,解决可识别的层次模糊问题,通过在定量和定性比较方面与现有的反省分解方法相比,业绩优势很大,从而证明拟议方法的有效性。

papers.title: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Bo Zou, Chao Yang, Yu Qiao, Chengbin Quan, Youjian Zhao
papers.abstract: Significant advancements in video question answering (VideoQA) have been made thanks to thriving large image-language pretraining frameworks. Although these image-language models can efficiently represent both video and language branches they typically employ a goal-free vision perception process and do not interact vision with language well during the answer generation thus omitting crucial visual cues. In this paper we are inspired by the human recognition and learning pattern and propose VideoDistill a framework with language-aware (i.e. goal-driven) behavior in both vision perception and answer generation process. VideoDistill generates answers only from question-related visual embeddings and follows a thinking-observing-answering approach that closely resembles human behavior distinguishing it from previous research. Specifically we develop a language-aware gating mechanism to replace the standard cross-attention avoiding language's direct fusion into visual representations. We incorporate this mechanism into two key components of the entire framework. The first component is a differentiable sparse sampling module which selects frames containing the necessary dynamics and semantics relevant to the questions. The second component is a vision refinement module that merges existing spatial-temporal attention layers to ensure the extraction of multi-grained visual semantics associated with the questions. We conduct experimental evaluations on various challenging video question-answering benchmarks and VideoDistill achieves state-of-the-art performance in both general and long-form VideoQA datasets. In Addition we verify that VideoDistill can effectively alleviate the utilization of language shortcut solutions in the EgoTaskQA dataset.
papers.title_zh: 视频问答用有语言意识的视觉语义学蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 视频问题解答(VideoQA)取得了显著进展,原因是大型图像语言培训前框架蓬勃发展。 虽然这些图像语言模式能够有效地代表视频和语言部门,但它们通常采用一个没有目标的视觉认知过程,在答案生成过程中不与语言很好地互动,从而忽略了关键的视觉提示。 在本文中,我们受到人类认识和学习模式的启发,并提议录影提炼一个有语言意识(即以目标为驱动)行为的框架,既包括视觉认知过程,也包括答案生成过程。 视频蒸馏只从与问题有关的视觉嵌入中产生答案,并遵循一种与人类行为非常相似的思维-观察-解答方法,将它与先前的研究区分开来。 具体地说,我们开发一种语言认知定位机制,以取代标准的交叉注意力机制,避免语言直接融入视觉表现形式。我们将这一机制纳入整个框架的两个关键组成部分。 第一个组成部分是一个不同的稀有取样模块,选择含有与问题相关的必要动态和语义的框框。 第二个组成部分是一个改进远景的模块,将现有的时空空间关注层合并起来,以确保提取与这些问题有关的多重视觉语义。 我们对各种具有挑战性的视频问答基准进行实验性评价,视频蒸馏在一般和长式视频QA数据集中达到SOTA 性能。 校对:Portnoy

papers.title: Instance-level Expert Knowledge and Aggregate Discriminative Attention for Radiology Report Generation
papers.authors: Shenshen Bu, Taiji Li, Yuedong Yang, Zhiming Dai
papers.abstract: Automatic radiology report generation can provide substantial advantages to clinical physicians by effectively reducing their workload and improving efficiency. Despite the promising potential of current methods challenges persist in effectively extracting and preventing degradation of prominent features as well as enhancing attention on pivotal regions. In this paper we propose an Instance-level Expert Knowledge and Aggregate Discriminative Attention framework (EKAGen) for radiology report generation. We convert expert reports into an embedding space and generate comprehensive representations for each disease which serve as Preliminary Knowledge Support (PKS). To prevent feature disruption we select the representations in the embedding space with the smallest distances to PKS as Rectified Knowledge Support (RKS). Then EKAGen diagnoses the diseases and retrieves knowledge from RKS creating Instance-level Expert Knowledge (IEK) for each query image boosting generation. Additionally we introduce Aggregate Discriminative Attention Map (ADM) which uses weak supervision to create maps of discriminative regions that highlight pivotal regions. For training we propose a Global Information Self-Distillation (GID) strategy using an iteratively optimized model to distill global knowledge into EKAGen. Extensive experiments and analyses on IU X-Ray and MIMIC-CXR datasets demonstrate that EKAGen outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 放射学报告编制专家知识和综合争议关注
papers.abstract_zh: 自动放射报告生成可以有效地减少临床医生的工作量,提高效率,从而给他们带来巨大好处。 尽管当前方法具有大有潜力,但在有效提取和防止显著特征退化以及加强对枢轴区域的关注方面,挑战依然存在。 在本文中,我们建议为放射学报告的生成建立一个实事级专家知识和综合争议关注框架(EKAGen),我们将专家报告转换为嵌入空间,为每种疾病提供全面的表述,作为初步知识支持。 为了防止特征中断,我们选择了嵌入空间中最短距离到 PKS 以作为修正知识支持( RKS ) 的表示。 然后, EKAGen 诊断了疾病,并从RKS 中提取知识,为每部插图的生成创建创建点级专家知识( IEK ) 。 此外,我们引入了《全面歧视关注地图》,该地图利用薄弱的监督来绘制重点突出关键区域的歧视性区域地图。 为了培训目的,我们建议采用全球信息自我提炼战略,利用一种迭代优化模式将全球知识提炼成EKAGen,对IU X-Ray和MIMIC-CXR数据集的广泛实验和分析表明,EKAGen的成绩超过了以往的最新方法。

papers.title: Insights from the Use of Previously Unseen Neural Architecture Search Datasets
papers.authors: Rob Geada, David Towers, Matthew Forshaw, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei, A. Stephen McGough
papers.abstract: The boundless possibility of neural networks which can be used to solve a problem - each with different performance - leads to a situation where a Deep Learning expert is required to identify the best neural network. This goes against the hope of removing the need for experts. Neural Architecture Search (NAS) offers a solution to this by automatically identifying the best architecture. However to date NAS work has focused on a small set of datasets which we argue are not representative of real-world problems. We introduce eight new datasets created for a series of NAS Challenges: AddNIST Language MultNIST CIFARTile Gutenberg Isabella GeoClassing and Chesseract. These datasets and challenges are developed to direct attention to issues in NAS development and to encourage authors to consider how their models will perform on datasets unknown to them at development time. We present experimentation using standard Deep Learning methods as well as the best results from challenge participants
papers.title_zh: 对使用以前未见神经结构搜索数据集的观察
papers.abstract_zh: 神经网络无穷无尽的可能性可以用来解决问题----每个网络都有不同的性能----导致要求深学习专家确定最佳神经网络的情况,这与消除专家需求的希望背道而驰。 神经结构搜索(NAS)通过自动识别最佳建筑来解决这个问题。 然而,到目前为止,NAS的工作一直集中在一小套数据组上,我们认为这些数据组并不代表现实世界的问题。 我们推出八个为NAS系列挑战创建的新数据集:AddNIST语言MultNIST CIFARTile Gutenberg Isabella地理分类和Cheseract。 这些数据集和挑战的开发是为了引导人们注意国家科学体系开发中的问题,并鼓励作者考虑其模型如何在开发时他们不知道的数据集上发挥作用。 我们使用标准的深学习方法以及挑战参与者的最佳成果来介绍实验情况

papers.title: Image Textualization: An Automatic Framework for Creating Accurate and Detailed Image Descriptions
papers.authors: Renjie Pi, Jianshu Zhang, Jipeng Zhang, Rui Pan, Zhekai Chen, Tong Zhang
papers.abstract: Image description datasets play a crucial role in the advancement of various applications such as image understanding, text-to-image generation, and text-image retrieval. Currently, image description datasets primarily originate from two sources. One source is the scraping of image-text pairs from the web. Despite their abundance, these descriptions are often of low quality and noisy. Another is through human labeling. Datasets such as COCO are generally very short and lack details. Although detailed image descriptions can be annotated by humans, the high annotation cost limits the feasibility. These limitations underscore the need for more efficient and scalable methods to generate accurate and detailed image descriptions. In this paper, we propose an innovative framework termed Image Textualization (IT), which automatically produces high-quality image descriptions by leveraging existing multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) and multiple vision expert models in a collaborative manner, which maximally convert the visual information into text. To address the current lack of benchmarks for detailed descriptions, we propose several benchmarks for comprehensive evaluation, which verifies the quality of image descriptions created by our framework. Furthermore, we show that LLaVA-7B, benefiting from training on IT-curated descriptions, acquire improved capability to generate richer image descriptions, substantially increasing the length and detail of their output with less hallucination.
papers.title_zh: 图像文字化: 创建准确和详细图像描述的自动框架
papers.abstract_zh: 图像描述数据集在推进图像理解、文本到图像生成和文本图像检索等各种应用方面发挥着关键作用。 目前,图像描述数据集主要来自两个来源。 其中一个来源是从网络上剪裁图像-文本配对。 这些描述尽管丰富,但往往质量低,而且吵闹,另一个是通过人类标签,例如COCO(COCOCO)等数据集通常很短,缺乏细节,尽管详细的图像描述可以由人类附加说明,但高注解成本限制了可行性。 这些局限性突出表明,需要采用更有效、可扩展的方法,准确和详细地描述图像。 在本文中,我们提议了一个称为图像文字化的创新框架,通过以协作方式利用现有的多模式大语言模型和多视觉专家模型,自动产生高质量的图像描述,最大限度地将视觉信息转换成文字。 为解决目前缺乏详细描述基准的问题,我们提出了若干全面评估基准,以核实我们框架所创建的图像描述的质量。 此外,我们表明,LLAVA-7B从信息技术精密描述培训中受益,提高了制作更丰富图像描述的能力,大大地增加了其产出的长度和细节,减少了幻觉。

papers.title: HallusionBench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Tianrui Guan, Fuxiao Liu, Xiyang Wu, Ruiqi Xian, Zongxia Li, Xiaoyu Liu, Xijun Wang, Lichang Chen, Furong Huang, Yaser Yacoob, Dinesh Manocha, Tianyi Zhou
papers.abstract: We introduce "HallusionBench" a comprehensive benchmark designed for the evaluation of image-context reasoning. This benchmark presents significant challenges to advanced large visual-language models (LVLMs) such as GPT-4V(ision) Gemini Pro Vision Claude 3 and LLaVA-1.5 by emphasizing nuanced understanding and interpretation of visual data. The benchmark comprises 346 images paired with 1129 questions all meticulously crafted by human experts. We introduce a novel structure for these visual questions designed to establish control groups. This structure enables us to conduct a quantitative analysis of the models' response tendencies logical consistency and various failure modes. In our evaluation on HallusionBench we benchmarked 15 different models highlighting a 31.42% question-pair accuracy achieved by the state-of-the-art GPT-4V. Notably all other evaluated models achieve accuracy below 16%. Moreover our analysis not only highlights the observed failure modes including language hallucination and visual illusion but also deepens an under standing of these pitfalls. Our comprehensive case studies within HallusionBench shed light on the challenges of hallucination and illusion in LVLMs. Based on these insights we suggest potential pathways for their future improvement. The benchmark and codebase can be accessed at https://github.com/tianyilab/HallusionBench.
papers.title_zh: Hallusion Bench:大型视觉语言模型中被缠绕的语言传明和视觉幻觉的先进诊断套件
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出“Hallusion Bunch”(Hallusion Bunch)综合基准, 这一基准通过强调对视觉数据的细致理解和解释,对GPT-4V(sion)Gemini Pro Vision Claude 3和LLALAVA-1.5等先进的大型视觉语言模型提出了重大挑战。 基准由346张图像组成,配有1129个问题,都是由人类专家精心设计的。我们为这些视觉问题引入了一个新结构,旨在建立控制组。 这一结构使我们能够对模型的反应趋势进行定量分析,分析逻辑一致性和各种失败模式。 在对Hallusion Bunch的评估中,我们设定了15个不同的模型的基准,强调了最新GPT-4V(GPT-4V)所实现的31.42%的问答精确度。 此外,我们的分析不仅突显了观察到的失败模式,包括语言幻觉和视觉幻觉,而且还加深了这些陷阱。 我们在Hallusion Bench进行的全面案例研究揭示了LVLMs的幻觉和幻觉的挑战。 基于这些洞察,我们建议了今后改进这些幻觉和幻觉的可能途径。基准和代码库可以在https://github.com/tianyilab/Hallusion Bench查阅。

papers.title: GeoAuxNet: Towards Universal 3D Representation Learning for Multi-sensor Point Clouds
papers.authors: Shengjun Zhang, Xin Fei, Yueqi Duan
papers.abstract: Point clouds captured by different sensors such as RGB-D cameras and LiDAR possess non-negligible domain gaps. Most existing methods design different network architectures and train separately on point clouds from various sensors. Typically point-based methods achieve outstanding performances on even-distributed dense point clouds from RGB-D cameras while voxel-based methods are more efficient for large-range sparse LiDAR point clouds. In this paper we propose geometry-to-voxel auxiliary learning to enable voxel representations to access point-level geometric information which supports better generalisation of the voxel-based backbone with additional interpretations of multi-sensor point clouds. Specifically we construct hierarchical geometry pools generated by a voxel-guided dynamic point network which efficiently provide auxiliary fine-grained geometric information adapted to different stages of voxel features. We conduct experiments on joint multi-sensor datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoAuxNet. Enjoying elaborate geometric information our method outperforms other models collectively trained on multi-sensor datasets and achieve competitive results with the-state-of-art experts on each single dataset.
papers.title_zh: GeoAuxNet:为多传感器点云普及3D代表制学习
papers.abstract_zh: 由RGB-D摄像机和LiDAR等不同传感器捕获的点云具有不可忽略的域空隙,大多数现有方法设计不同的网络结构,对点云与各种传感器分开培训。 通常的点基方法在从RGB-D摄像机中平均分布的密度点云上取得杰出的成绩,而基于oxel的方法对大范围稀散的激光雷达点云更有效。 在本文中,我们建议进行几何学到微分的辅助学习,使 voxel 表示能够访问点级几何信息,从而支持更好地概括基于 voxel 的骨干,同时对多传感器点云作更多的解释。 具体地说,我们建造由xxel-制导动态点网络产生的等级几何群落,有效地提供辅助性细微几何信息,以适应voxel特征的不同阶段。 我们用联合多传感器数据集进行实验,以证明GeoAuxNet的有效性。享受详尽的几何信息,我们的方法优于在多传感器数据集方面集体培训的其他模型,并与每个数据集方面的最先进的专家取得竞争结果。

papers.title: Generate Like Experts: Multi-Stage Font Generation by Incorporating Font Transfer Process into Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Bin Fu, Fanghua Yu, Anran Liu, Zixuan Wang, Jie Wen, Junjun He, Yu Qiao
papers.abstract: Few-shot font generation (FFG) produces stylized font images with a limited number of reference samples which can significantly reduce labor costs in manual font designs. Most existing FFG methods follow the style-content disentanglement paradigm and employ the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to generate target fonts by combining the decoupled content and style representations. The complicated structure and detailed style are simultaneously generated in those methods which may be the sub-optimal solutions for FFG task. Inspired by most manual font design processes of expert designers in this paper we model font generation as a multi-stage generative process. Specifically as the injected noise and the data distribution in diffusion models can be well-separated into different sub-spaces we are able to incorporate the font transfer process into these models. Based on this observation we generalize diffusion methods to model font generative process by separating the reverse diffusion process into three stages with different functions: The structure construction stage first generates the structure information for the target character based on the source image and the font transfer stage subsequently transforms the source font to the target font. Finally the font refinement stage enhances the appearances and local details of the target font images. Based on the above multi-stage generative process we construct our font generation framework named MSD-Font with a dual-network approach to generate font images. The superior performance demonstrates the effectiveness of our model. The code is available at: https://github.com/fubinfb/MSD-Font .
papers.title_zh: 生成类似专家:通过将字体传输程序纳入传播模式,生成多功能字体
papers.abstract_zh: 微小的字体生成(FFG)生成了带有数量有限的参考样本的Styl化字体图像,这可以大大降低人工字体设计的人工成本。 大多数现有的FFG方法都遵循风格-内容解耦范式,并采用 " 创造对立网络(GAN) " ,将解耦的内容和样式表达式结合起来,生成目标字体。 复杂结构和详细风格同时产生于这些方法中,这些方法可能是FFG任务的次最佳解决方案。 受本文中专家设计师的多数手工字体设计过程的启发,我们将字体生成模拟为多阶段基因化过程。 具体地说,由于注射噪音和扩散模型中的数据分布可以完全分为不同的子空间,我们可以将这些字体转换过程纳入这些模型。 基于这一观察,我们推广推广方法,通过将反向扩散进程分为三个阶段,具有不同功能,以模拟字体变形过程:结构构造阶段首先根据源图像生成目标字符的结构信息,字体转换阶段随后将源字体转换为目标字体。 最后,字体完善阶段将强化目标字体图像的外观和本地细节。 根据上述多阶段发扬过程,我们构建名为 MSD-Font 的字体生成框架, 使用双网络方法生成字体图像 。 该代码可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/fubinfb/MSD-Font。

papers.title: Gated Fields: Learning Scene Reconstruction from Gated Videos
papers.authors: Andrea Ramazzina, Stefanie Walz, Pragyan Dahal, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: Reconstructing outdoor 3D scenes from temporal observations is a challenge that recent work on neural fields has offered a new avenue for. However existing methods that recover scene properties such as geometry appearance or radiance solely from RGB captures often fail when handling poorly-lit or texture-deficient regions. Similarly recovering scenes with scanning lidar sensors is also difficult due to their low angular sampling rate which makes recovering expansive real-world scenes difficult. Tackling these gaps we introduce Gated Fields - a neural scene reconstruction method that utilizes active gated video sequences. To this end we propose a neural rendering approach that seamlessly incorporates time-gated capture and illumination. Our method exploits the intrinsic depth cues in the gated videos achieving precise and dense geometry reconstruction irrespective of ambient illumination conditions. We validate the method across day and night scenarios and find that Gated Fields compares favorably to RGB and LiDAR reconstruction methods
papers.title_zh: Gated 字段:从 Gated 视频中学习重建场景
papers.abstract_zh: 从时间观察中重建户外三维场景是一项挑战,最近有关神经田的工作为这一挑战提供了新的途径。 然而,现有方法,如仅从RGB捕捉的几何外观或弧度等地貌特性的恢复方法,在处理低亮或质地不完善的地区时往往失败。 同样,使用扫描激光雷达传感器的恢复场景也很困难,因为其角取样率低,使得恢复的广度真实世界场景难以恢复。 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了Gated Fields(Gated Fields ) , 这是一种神经场景重建方法,使用活跃的闭门视频序列。 为此,我们建议采取神经转换方法,无缝地结合时间定位捕获和照明。 我们的方法利用闭锁视频的内在深度提示,无论周围的光化条件如何,都实现精确和密集的几何重建。 我们验证了白天和夜间情景中的方法,发现Gated Fields与RGB和LIDAR重建方法相比优于RGB和LIDAR重建方法。

papers.title: FLOSS: Free Lunch in Open-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Yasser Benigmim · Mohammad Fahes · Tuan-Hung Vu · Andrei Bursuc · Raoul de Charette
papers.abstract: Recent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) models extend the CLIP model to segmentation while maintaining the use of multiple templates (e.g., a photo of, a sketch of a, etc.) for constructing class-wise averaged text embeddings, acting as a classifier. In this paper, we challenge this status quo and investigate the impact of templates for OVSS. Empirically, we observe that for each class, there exist single-template classifiers significantly outperforming the conventional averaged classifier. We refer to them as class-experts. Given access to unlabeled images and without any training involved, we estimate these experts by leveraging the class-wise prediction entropy of single-template classifiers, selecting as class-wise experts those which yield the lowest entropy. All experts, each specializing in a specific class, collaborate in a newly proposed fusion method to generate more accurate OVSS predictions. Our plug-and-play method, coined FLOSS, is orthogonal and complementary to existing OVSS methods, offering a “free lunch” to systematically improve OVSS without labels and additional training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLOSS consistently boosts state-of-the-art methods on various OVSS benchmarks. Moreover, the selected expert templates can generalize well from one dataset to others sharing the same semantic categories, yet exhibiting distribution shifts. Additionally, we obtain satisfactory improvements under a low-data regime, where only a few unlabeled images are available. Code will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: FLOSS: 开放词汇语义分割中的免费午餐
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的开放词汇语义分解(OVSS)模型将CLIP模型扩展至分解,同时保持使用多个模板(如照片、a草图等)构建类类平均文本嵌入,作为分类器。 在本文中,我们质疑这一现状,并调查OVSS模板的影响。 简而言之,我们观察到,在每一类中,都有单板分类器,大大优于常规的平均分类器,我们称之为类专家。 鉴于获得未贴标签的图像的机会,而且没有经过任何培训,我们利用单板分类器的类比预测酶来估计这些专家,选择产生最低的倍数的专家作为类比专家。 所有专家,每个专家都专门从事某一类工作,在新提议的聚变方法中进行合作,以得出更准确的OVSS预测。 我们的插座和游戏方法 — — 创建了FLOSS — — 是正统的,是对现有的OVSS方法的补充,提供了“免费午餐 ” , 系统地改善OVSS,没有标签和额外的培训。 广泛的实验表明,FLOSS不断提升各种OVSS基准的最新方法。 此外,所选专家模板还可以从一个数据集向共享相同语义分类的其他数据集全面概括,但分布却呈现变化。 此外,在低数据制度下,我们得到了令人满意的改进,因为在这个制度下只有少量未贴标签的图像。 守则将公布于众。

papers.title: EMCAD: Efficient Multi-scale Convolutional Attention Decoding for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Md Mostafijur Rahman, Mustafa Munir, Radu Marculescu
papers.abstract: An efficient and effective decoding mechanism is crucial in medical image segmentation especially in scenarios with limited computational resources. However these decoding mechanisms usually come with high computational costs. To address this concern we introduce EMCAD a new efficient multi-scale convolutional attention decoder designed to optimize both performance and computational efficiency. EMCAD leverages a unique multi-scale depth-wise convolution block significantly enhancing feature maps through multi-scale convolutions. EMCAD also employs channel spatial and grouped (large-kernel) gated attention mechanisms which are highly effective at capturing intricate spatial relationships while focusing on salient regions. By employing group and depth-wise convolution EMCAD is very efficient and scales well (e.g. only 1.91M parameters and 0.381G FLOPs are needed when using a standard encoder). Our rigorous evaluations across 12 datasets that belong to six medical image segmentation tasks reveal that EMCAD achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with 79.4% and 80.3% reduction in #Params and #FLOPs respectively. Moreover EMCAD's adaptability to different encoders and versatility across segmentation tasks further establish EMCAD as a promising tool advancing the field towards more efficient and accurate medical image analysis. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/SLDGroup/EMCAD.
papers.title_zh: EMCAD: 医疗图像分割的高效多层次革命关注分解
papers.abstract_zh: 高效率和高效益的解码机制对于医疗图像分割至关重要,特别是在计算资源有限的情况下,但是这些解码机制通常会产生高昂的计算成本。 为解决这一关切,我们引入了EMCD, 这是一种新的高效的多级革命注意力解码器,旨在优化性能和计算效率。 EMCD利用一个独特的多级深度变速块,通过多级变速大幅提升地貌地图。 EMCAD还采用频道空间和分组(大内圈)门外关注机制,这些机制在捕捉复杂的空间关系的同时注重突出区域方面非常有效。 使用标准编码器时只需要1.91M参数和0.381G FLOPs。 我们对属于六种医学图像分割任务的12个数据集进行严格评估,结果表明,EMCDAD取得了最新成绩,在#Params和#FLOPs分别减少了79.4%和80.3%。 此外,欧洲疾病防治中心适应不同编码者和跨区任务多功能性的能力,进一步将欧洲疾病防治中心确立为推动该领域更有效和更准确的医学图像分析的一个很有希望的工具,我们的执行情况可在https://github.com/SLDGroup/EMCAD上查阅。

papers.title: Embodied Multi-Modal Agent trained by an LLM from a Parallel TextWorld
papers.authors: Yijun Yang, Tianyi Zhou, Kanxue Li, Dapeng Tao, Lusong Li, Li Shen, Xiaodong He, Jing Jiang, Yuhui Shi
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) excel in a simulated world of texts they struggle to interact with the more realistic world without perceptions of other modalities such as visual or audio signals. Although vision-language models (VLMs) integrate LLM modules (1) aligned with static image features and (2) may possess prior knowledge of world dynamics (as demonstrated in the text world) they have not been trained in an embodied visual world and thus cannot align with its dynamics. On the other hand training an embodied agent in a noisy visual world without expert guidance is often challenging and inefficient. In this paper we train a VLM agent living in a visual world using an LLM agent excelling in a parallel text world. Specifically we distill LLM's reflection outcomes (improved actions by analyzing mistakes) in a text world's tasks to finetune the VLM on the same tasks of the visual world resulting in an Embodied Multi-Modal Agent (EMMA) quickly adapting to the visual world dynamics. Such cross-modality imitation learning between the two parallel worlds is achieved by a novel DAgger-DPO algorithm enabling EMMA to generalize to a broad scope of new tasks without any further guidance from the LLM expert. Extensive evaluations on the ALFWorld benchmark's diverse tasks highlight EMMA's superior performance to SOTA VLM-based agents e.g. 20%-70% improvement in the success rate.
papers.title_zh: 由平行文本世界的LLM培训的装装多模式代理
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然大型语言模型(LLMS)在模拟文本的世界中非常出色,但它们努力与更现实的世界互动,却对视觉或音频信号等其他模式没有认识。 虽然视觉语言模型(VLM)结合了LLM模块(1) (1) 与静态图像特征相一致的LLM模块和(2) 可能事先掌握世界动态知识(如文字世界所显示的),但它们尚未在包含视觉的世界中接受培训,因此无法与其动态保持一致。 另一方面,在一个没有专家指导的吵闹的视觉世界里培训一个装饰的代理人往往具有挑战性和效率低下。 在本文中,我们培训了生活在视觉世界的VLM代理人,使用LLM代理人在平行的文字世界里发挥优势。 具体地说,我们将LLM的反省结果(通过分析错误改进了行动)提炼成文本世界的任务,即根据视觉世界的相同任务对VLM进行微调,从而产生一个迅速适应视觉世界动态的嵌入式多模式代理(EMMA)。 两个平行世界之间的这种交叉模式学习是通过一种新型的Dagger-DPO算法实现的,使EMMA能够在没有法学硕士专家的任何进一步指导的情况下将新的任务推广到广泛的范围。 对ALFWorld基准各项任务的广泛评价突出表明,EMMA公司的业绩优于SOTA VLM代理公司,例如,成功率提高了20%-70%。

papers.title: Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives
papers.authors: Kristen Grauman, Andrew Westbury, Lorenzo Torresani, Kris Kitani, Jitendra Malik, Triantafyllos Afouras, Kumar Ashutosh, Vijay Baiyya, Siddhant Bansal, Bikram Boote, Eugene Byrne, Zach Chavis, Joya Chen, Feng Cheng, Fu-Jen Chu, Sean Crane, Avijit Dasgupta, Jing Dong, Maria Escobar, Cristhian Forigua, Abrham Gebreselasie, Sanjay Haresh, Jing Huang, Md Mohaiminul Islam, Suyog Jain, Rawal Khirodkar, Devansh Kukreja, Kevin J Liang, Jia-Wei Liu, Sagnik Majumder, Yongsen Mao, Miguel Martin, Effrosyni Mavroudi, Tushar Nagarajan, Francesco Ragusa, Santhosh Kumar Ramakrishnan, Luigi Seminara, Arjun Somayazulu, Yale Song, Shan Su, Zihui Xue, Edward Zhang, Jinxu Zhang, Angela Castillo, Changan Chen, Xinzhu Fu, Ryosuke Furuta, Cristina Gonzalez, Prince Gupta, Jiabo Hu, Yifei Huang, Yiming Huang, Weslie Khoo, Anush Kumar, Robert Kuo, Sach Lakhavani, Miao Liu, Mi Luo, Zhengyi Luo, Brighid Meredith, Austin Miller, Oluwatumininu Oguntola, Xiaqing Pan, Penny Peng, Shraman Pramanick, Merey Ramazanova, Fiona Ryan, Wei Shan, Kiran Somasundaram, Chenan Song, Audrey Southerland, Masatoshi Tateno, Huiyu Wang, Yuchen Wang, Takuma Yagi, Mingfei Yan, Xitong Yang, Zecheng Yu, Shengxin Cindy Zha, Chen Zhao, Ziwei Zhao, Zhifan Zhu, Jeff Zhuo, Pablo Arbelaez, Gedas Bertasius, Dima Damen, Jakob Engel, Giovanni Maria Farinella, Antonino Furnari, Bernard Ghanem, Judy Hoffman, C.V. Jawahar, Richard Newcombe, Hyun Soo Park, James M. Rehg, Yoichi Sato, Manolis Savva, Jianbo Shi, Mike Zheng Shou, Michael Wray
papers.abstract: We present Ego-Exo4D a diverse large-scale multimodal multiview video dataset and benchmark challenge. Ego-Exo4D centers around simultaneously-captured egocentric and exocentric video of skilled human activities (e.g. sports music dance bike repair). 740 participants from 13 cities worldwide performed these activities in 123 different natural scene contexts yielding long-form captures from 1 to 42 minutes each and 1286 hours of video combined. The multimodal nature of the dataset is unprecedented: the video is accompanied by multichannel audio eye gaze 3D point clouds camera poses IMU and multiple paired language descriptions---including a novel "expert commentary" done by coaches and teachers and tailored to the skilled-activity domain. To push the frontier of first-person video understanding of skilled human activity we also present a suite of benchmark tasks and their annotations including fine-grained activity understanding proficiency estimation cross-view translation and 3D hand/body pose. All resources are open sourced to fuel new research in the community.
papers.title_zh: Ego-Exo4D:从第一和第三人的角度了解有技能的人的活动
papers.abstract_zh: 我们向Ego-Exo4D展示了多种多样的大型多式多视角视频数据集和基准挑战。 Ego-Exo4D中心围绕技术人类活动(如体育音乐舞蹈自行车修补)同时拍摄的自我中心与外向中心视频。 来自世界各地13个城市的740名参与者在123个不同的自然场景环境中开展了这些活动,每次从1至42分钟的视频和1286小时的视频组合中收集长方形图像。 该数据集的多式性质是前所未有的:该视频配有多道音频眼视3D点云照相机,配有IMU和多种配对语言描述,包括教练和教师根据熟练活动领域专门制作的新颖的“专家评论”。 为了推动第一人视频对熟练人类活动的了解,我们还提出一套基准任务及其说明,包括精细的细微活动,了解熟练程度估计跨视图翻译和3D手/体装。 所有资源都开放来源,为社区的新研究提供燃料。

papers.title: Eagle: Exploring The Design Space for Multimodal LLMs with Mixture of Encoders
papers.authors: Min Shi, Fuxiao Liu, Shihao Wang, Shijia Liao, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Yilin Zhao, De-An Huang, Hongxu Yin, Karan Sapra, Yaser Yacoob, Humphrey Shi, Bryan Catanzaro, Andrew Tao, Jan Kautz, Zhiding Yu, Guilin Liu
papers.abstract: The ability to accurately interpret complex visual information is a crucial topic of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Recent work indicates that enhanced visual perception significantly reduces hallucinations and improves performance on resolution-sensitive tasks, such as optical character recognition and document analysis. A number of recent MLLMs achieve this goal using a mixture of vision encoders. Despite their success, there is a lack of systematic comparisons and detailed ablation studies addressing critical aspects, such as expert selection and the integration of multiple vision experts. This study provides an extensive exploration of the design space for MLLMs using a mixture of vision encoders and resolutions. Our findings reveal several underlying principles common to various existing strategies, leading to a streamlined yet effective design approach.
