papers.abstract: Cross-scene generalizable NeRF models, which can directly synthesize novel views of unseen scenes, have become a new spotlight of the NeRF field. Several existing attempts rely on increasingly end-to-end "neuralized" architectures, i.e., replacing scene representation and/or rendering modules with performant neural networks such as transformers, and turning novel view synthesis into a feed-forward inference pipeline. While those feedforward "neuralized" architectures still do not fit diverse scenes well out of the box, we propose to bridge them with the powerful Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) idea from large language models (LLMs), which has demonstrated superior generalization ability by balancing between larger overall model capacity and flexible per-instance specialization. Starting from a recent generalizable NeRF architecture called GNT, we first demonstrate that MoE can be neatly plugged in to enhance the model. We further customize a shared permanent expert and a geometry-aware consistency loss to enforce cross-scene consistency and spatial smoothness respectively, which are essential for generalizable view synthesis. Our proposed model, dubbed GNT with Mixture-of-View-Experts (GNT-MOVE), has experimentally shown state-of-the-art results when transferring to unseen scenes, indicating remarkably better cross-scene generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings. Our codes are available at https://github.com/VITA-Group/GNT-MOVE.
papers.title_zh: 增强类似于增强力的NERF:通用NERFTransformer和混合查看-专家
papers.abstract_zh: 能够直接综合对不可见场景的新观点的跨层通用NERF模型已成为NERF领域的新焦点。 一些现有的尝试依赖日益终端到终端的“神经化”结构,即用变压器等性能神经网络取代现场表现和/或转换模块,并将新观点合成转化为进料向导导管。 虽然这些进料的“内化”结构仍然不适应外外外的各种不同场景,但我们建议将它们与来自大型语言模型的强大的专家混合(Mixture of-Experters)理念联系起来,后者通过平衡更大的总体模型能力和灵活的每个企业的专业化,显示了超强的普及能力。 我们首先证明MoE可以畅通无阻地插插进去, 来强化模型。 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 校对:Portnoy 我们进一步定制一个共同的常任专家和一个几何一致性损失,以分别实施跨场一致性和空间平滑性,这对可普遍综合的观点至关重要。 我们提议的模型称为GNT,称为Mixture of View-Experts(GNT-MOVE),在向看不见的场景转移时,实验性地展示了最新的结果,表明在零点和微小的场景设置中,交叉场景的概括性明显改进。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/VITA-Group/GNT-MOVE查阅。

papers.title: Efficient and Degradation-Adaptive Network for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Lei Zhang
papers.abstract: "Efficient and effective real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) is a challenging task due to the unknown complex degradation of real-world images and the limited computation resources in practical applications. Recent research on Real-ISR has achieved significant progress by modeling the image degradation space; however, these methods largely rely on heavy backbone networks and they are inflexible to handle images of different degradation levels. In this paper, we propose an efficient and effective degradation-adaptive super-resolution (DASR) network, whose parameters are adaptively specified by estimating the degradation of each input image. Specifically, a tiny regression network is employed to predict the degradation parameters of the input image, while several convolutional experts with the same topology are jointly optimized to specify the network parameters via a non-linear mixture of experts. The joint optimization of multiple experts and the degradation-adaptive pipeline significantly extend the model capacity to handle degradations of various levels, while the inference remains efficient since only one adaptively specified network is used for super-resolving the input image. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that DASR is not only much more effective than existing methods on handling real-world images with different degradation levels but also efficient for easy deployment. Codes, models and datasets are available at https://github.com/csjliang/DASR."
papers.title_zh: 实时世界图像高效和退化-适应网络超级分辨率
papers.abstract_zh: 快速而有效的真实世界图像超分辨率(Real-ISR)是一项具有挑战性的任务, 最近关于Real-ISR的研究通过模拟图像降解空间取得了显著进展;然而,这些方法主要依赖重主干网络,无法灵活地处理不同降解水平的图像。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个高效和有效降解适应性超分辨率网络,其参数通过估计每个输入图像的退化情况加以调整确定。 具体而言,使用一个微小的回归网络来预测输入图像的降解参数,同时对具有相同地形的若干富集专家进行联合优化,以便通过非线性专家混合确定网络参数。 多位专家的共同优化和降解适应管道大大扩展了处理不同层次退化的模型能力,而推断仍然有效,因为只有一个适应性特定网络用于超级解析输入图像。 我们的广泛实验表明,DASR不仅比现有的处理具有不同降解程度的现实世界图像的方法更有效,而且对容易部署也有效。 代码、模型和数据集可在https://github.com/csjliang/DASSR上查阅。

papers.title: Bootstrapping Multi-View Representations for Fake News Detection
papers.authors: Qichao Ying, Xiaoxiao Hu, Yangming Zhou, Zhenxing Qian, Dan Zeng, Shiming Ge
papers.abstract: Previous researches on multimedia fake news detection include a series of complex feature extraction and fusion networks to gather useful information from the news. However, how cross-modal consistency relates to the fidelity of news and how features from different modalities affect the decision-making are still open questions. This paper presents a novel scheme of Bootstrapping Multi-view Representations (BMR) for fake news detection. Given a multi-modal news, we extract representations respectively from the views of the text, the image pattern and the image semantics. Improved Multi-gate Mixture-of-Expert networks (iMMoE) are proposed for feature refinement and fusion. Representations from each view are separately used to coarsely predict the fidelity of the whole news, and the multimodal representations are able to predict the cross-modal consistency. With the prediction scores, we reweigh each view of the representations and bootstrap them for fake news detection. Extensive experiments conducted on typical fake news detection datasets prove that BMR outperforms state-of-the-art schemes.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.title_zh: 用于假新闻探测的多视图演示工具
papers.abstract_zh: 先前关于多媒体假新闻探测的研究包括一系列复杂的特征提取和聚合网络,以便从新闻中收集有用的信息。 然而,跨模式的一致性如何与新闻的忠实性相关,不同模式的特征如何影响决策,这些仍然是尚未解决的问题。 本文提出了一个新颖的计划 — — 采用多视角代表制(BMR)进行假新闻检测。 鉴于多式新闻,我们分别从文字、图像图案和图像语义的角度进行表述,建议改进多门专家混合网络(iMMOE),以完善和融合特色。 每种观点的表述都分别用来粗略地预测整个新闻的真实性,而多式联运的表述能够预测跨模式的一致性。 随着预测分数,我们将每个观点的表述都重新对比,并把它们套起来,以进行假新闻探测。 对典型的假冒新闻探测数据集进行的广泛实验证明,BMR的绩效超过了最新水平的计划。

papers.title: AdaMV-MoE: Adaptive Multi-Task Vision Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Tianlong Chen, Xuxi Chen, Xianzhi Du, Abdullah Rashwan, Fan Yang, Huizhong Chen, Zhangyang Wang, Yeqing Li
papers.abstract: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is becoming a promising paradigm for multi-task learning (MTL). Instead of compressing multiple tasks' knowledge into a single model, MoE separates the parameter space and only utilizes the relevant model pieces given task type and its input, which provides stabilized MTL training and ultra-efficient inference. However, current MoE approaches adopt a fixed network capacity (e.g., two experts in usual) for all tasks. It potentially results in the over-fitting of simple tasks or the under-fitting of challenging scenarios, especially when tasks are significantly distinctive in their complexity. In this paper, we propose an adaptive MoE framework for multi-task vision recognition, dubbed AdaMV-MoE. Based on the training dynamics, it automatically determines the number of activated experts for each task, avoiding the laborious manual tuning of optimal model size. To validate our proposal, we benchmark it on ImageNet classification and COCO object detection & instance segmentation which are notoriously difficult to learn in concert, due to their discrepancy. Extensive experiments across a variety of vision transformers demonstrate a superior performance of AdaMV-MoE, compared to MTL with a shared backbone and the recent state-of-the-art (SoTA) MTL MoE approach. Codes are available online: https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/moe_mtl.
papers.title_zh: Adamva-MoE:适应性多任务视觉组合专家
papers.abstract_zh: 分散激活的专家混合体正在成为多任务学习的有希望的范例(MTL)。 MoE没有将多重任务的知识压缩成单一模型,而是将参数空间分开,只使用相关模型,给定任务类型及其输入,提供稳定的MTL培训和超高效的推断。 然而,目前MoE的做法对所有任务都采用固定的网络能力(例如,通常有两名专家),这可能导致任务过于简单,或对挑战性情景的适应不足,特别是当任务的复杂性明显不同时。 在本文中,我们提出了一个适应性多任务视觉识别MoE框架,称为AdaMV-MOE。 根据培训动态,它自动确定每项任务中被激活专家的人数,避免对最佳模型规模进行艰苦的手工调整。 为了验证我们的提案,我们将其基准以图像网络分类和COCO物体探测和实例分解为基准,这些分解因差异而难以协调学习,这众所周知是难以学习的。 各种视觉变压器的广泛实验表明,AdaMV-MOE的性能优于具有共同骨干和最近最先进的MTL(SoTA)MTL MoE方法的MTL。 代码可在网上查阅:https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/moe_mtl。

papers.title: Vision Relation Transformer for Unbiased Scene Graph Generation
papers.authors: Gopika Sudhakaran, Devendra Singh Dhami, Kristian Kersting, Stefan Roth
papers.abstract: Recent years have seen a growing interest in Scene Graph Generation (SGG), a comprehensive visual scene understanding task that aims to predict entity relationships using a relation encoder-decoder pipeline stacked on top of an object encoder-decoder backbone. Unfortunately, current SGG methods suffer from an information loss regarding the entities' local-level cues during the relation encoding process. To mitigate this, we introduce the Vision rElation TransfOrmer (VETO), consisting of a novel local-level entity relation encoder. We further observe that many existing SGG methods claim to be unbiased, but are still biased towards either head or tail classes. To overcome this bias, we introduce a Mutually Exclusive ExperT (MEET) learning strategy that captures important relation features without bias towards head or tail classes. Experimental results on the VG and GQA datasets demonstrate that VETO + MEET boosts the predictive performance by up to 47% over the state of the art while being 10x smaller.
papers.title_zh: 无偏见景景区图生成的视觉变形器
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,人们对《景象图集》(SGG)的兴趣日益浓厚,这是一项全面的视觉场景理解任务,目的是利用堆在物体编码器-编码器主干线之上的连接编码器-编码器管道预测实体关系。 不幸的是,目前的SGG方法在关系编码过程中,在实体的地方一级提示信息丢失了。 为了减轻这一损失,我们引入了“视觉通缩转换器 ” ( VETO ) , 由新的地方一级实体关系编码器组成。 我们还注意到,许多现有的SGG方法声称是不偏不倚的,但仍然偏向于头类或尾类。 为了克服这一偏向,我们引入了相互排斥ExperT(MEET)学习战略,在不偏向头类或尾类的情况下捕捉重要的关系特征。 VG和GQA数据集的实验结果显示,VETO+MEET将预测性能提升到最高47%,比最新工艺水平低10倍。

papers.title: Variational Causal Inference Network for Explanatory Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Dizhan Xue, Shengsheng Qian, Changsheng Xu
papers.abstract: Explanatory Visual Question Answering (EVQA) is a recently proposed multimodal reasoning task that requires answering visual questions and generating multimodal explanations for the reasoning processes. Unlike traditional Visual Question Answering (VQA) which focuses solely on answering, EVQA aims to provide user-friendly explanations to enhance the explainability and credibility of reasoning models. However, existing EVQA methods typically predict the answer and explanation separately, which ignores the causal correlation between them. Moreover, they neglect the complex relationships among question words, visual regions, and explanation tokens. To address these issues, we propose a Variational Causal Inference Network (VCIN) that establishes the causal correlation between predicted answers and explanations, and captures cross-modal relationships to generate rational explanations. First, we utilize a vision-and-language pretrained model to extract visual features and question features. Secondly, we propose a multimodal explanation gating transformer that constructs cross-modal relationships and generates rational explanations. Finally, we propose a variational causal inference to establish the target causal structure and predict the answers. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of VCIN over state-of-the-art EVQA methods.
papers.title_zh: 解释性视觉问题解析解答变因果推断网络
papers.abstract_zh: 解释性视觉问题回答(EVQA)是一项最近提出的多式联运推理任务,需要回答视觉问题,并为推理过程提出多式解释。 与仅侧重于回答的传统视觉问题解答(VQA)不同,EVQA旨在提供方便用户的解释,以提高推理模型的解释性和可信度。 然而,现有的 " EVQA " 方法通常会分别预测答案和解释,忽略了它们之间的因果关系。 此外,它们忽略了问题词、视觉区域和解释符号之间的复杂关系。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个变式因果关系网络,确定预测的答案和解释之间的因果关系,并捕捉跨模式的关系,以便作出合理的解释。 首先,我们利用一个预设的视觉和语言模型来提取视觉特征和问题特征。 其次,我们建议采用多式解释式变压器来构建跨模式关系,并做出合理的解释。 最后,我们提出一个变式因果推论,以确定目标因果结构并预测答案。 全面实验表明VCIN优于最先进的EVQA方法。

papers.title: V3Det: Vast Vocabulary Visual Detection Dataset
papers.authors: Jiaqi Wang, Pan Zhang, Tao Chu, Yuhang Cao, Yujie Zhou, Tong Wu, Bin Wang, Conghui He, Dahua Lin
papers.abstract: Recent advances in detecting arbitrary objects in the real world are trained and evaluated on object detection datasets with a relatively restricted vocabulary. To facilitate the development of more general visual object detection, we propose V3Det, a vast vocabulary visual detection dataset with precisely annotated bounding boxes on massive images. V3Det has several appealing properties: 1) Vast Vocabulary: It contains bounding boxes of objects from 13,204 categories on real-world images, which is 10 times larger than the existing large vocabulary object detection dataset, e.g., LVIS. 2) Hierarchical Category Organization: The vast vocabulary of V3Det is organized by a hierarchical category tree which annotates the inclusion relationship among categories, encouraging the exploration of category relationships in vast and open vocabulary object detection. 3) Rich Annotations: V3Det comprises precisely annotated objects in 243k images and professional descriptions of each category written by human experts and a powerful chatbot. By offering a vast exploration space, V3Det enables extensive benchmarks on both vast and open vocabulary object detection, leading to new observations, practices, and insights for future research. It has the potential to serve as a cornerstone dataset for developing more general visual perception systems. V3Det is available at https://v3det.openxlab.org.cn/.
papers.title_zh: V3Det: 大字典视觉探测数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界中探测任意物体方面最近取得的进展,在使用相对有限的词汇的物体探测数据集方面得到了培训和评价。 为了便利发展更一般性的视觉物体探测,我们提议V3Det,这是一个庞大的词汇目视探测数据集,在大型图像上有精确的附加说明的捆绑框。 V3Det具有若干具有吸引力的属性:1)大词汇:它包含从真实世界图像上的13,204类物体的捆绑箱,比现有的大型词汇对象探测数据集,例如LVIS,大10倍。 2) 等级类组织:V3Det的庞大词汇由一棵等级类树组成,该树说明各类别之间的包容关系,鼓励在广泛和公开的词汇对象探测中探索类别关系。 3) 丰富的说明:V3Det包含243k图像中精确的附加说明的物体,以及由人类专家和强大的聊天室编写的每一类的专业说明。 V3Det通过提供广阔的探索空间,为广泛和开放的词汇对象探测提供了广泛的基准,为未来研究提供了新的观测、实践和洞察力。 V3Det有可能成为开发更一般的视觉感知系统的基石数据集。 V3Det可查阅https://v3det.openxlab.org.cn/。

papers.title: Tree Structure-Aware Few-Shot Image Classification via Hierarchical Aggregation
papers.authors: Min Zhang, Siteng Huang, Wenbin Li, Donglin Wang
papers.abstract: "In this paper, we mainly focus on the problem of how to learn additional feature representations for few-shot image classification through pretext tasks (e.g., rotation or color permutation and so on). This additional knowledge generated by pretext tasks can further improve the performance of few-shot learning (FSL) as it differs from human-annotated supervision (i.e., class labels of FSL tasks). To solve this problem, we present a plug-in Hierarchical Tree Structure-aware (HTS) method, which not only learns the relationship of FSL and pretext tasks, but more importantly, can adaptively select and aggregate feature representations generated by pretext tasks to maximize the performance of FSL tasks. A hierarchical tree constructing component and a gated selection aggregating component is introduced to construct the tree structure and find richer transferable knowledge that can rapidly adapt to novel classes with a few labeled images. Extensive experiments show that our HTS can significantly enhance multiple few-shot methods to achieve new state-of-the-art performance on four benchmark datasets. The code is available at: https://github.com/remiMZ/HTS-ECCV22."
papers.title_zh: 通过等级式聚合对树结构- 结构- 工具少于热的图像分类
papers.abstract_zh: 本文主要讨论如何透过藉由(如轮值或颜色变换等), 由托辞任务产生的这种额外知识可以进一步改善短视学习(FSL)的绩效,因为它不同于附加人文说明的监督(即FSL任务的类标签)。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个插接式等级树木结构意识(HTS)方法,它不仅了解FSL与托辞任务的关系,而且更重要的是,它能够因地制宜地选择和综合以托辞任务产生的特征表现,以最大限度地发挥FSL任务的绩效。 引入了树的等级结构构件和封闭式选择集成组件,以构建树木结构,并找到较丰富的可转让知识,这些知识可以迅速适应带有几幅标签图像的新颖类。 广泛的实验表明,我们的HTS可以大大加强多种短片方法,在四个基准数据集上实现新的SOTA 性能。 代码可以在https://github.com/remiMZ/HTS-ECCV22上查到。 ”

papers.title: Towards a performance analysis on pre-trained Visual Question Answering models for autonomous driving
papers.authors: Kaavya Rekanar, Ciarán Eising, Ganesh Sistu, Martin Hayes
papers.abstract: This short paper presents a preliminary analysis of three popular Visual Question Answering (VQA) models, namely ViLBERT, ViLT, and LXMERT, in the context of answering questions relating to driving scenarios. The performance of these models is evaluated by comparing the similarity of responses to reference answers provided by computer vision experts. Model selection is predicated on the analysis of transformer utilization in multimodal architectures. The results indicate that models incorporating cross-modal attention and late fusion techniques exhibit promising potential for generating improved answers within a driving perspective. This initial analysis serves as a launchpad for a forthcoming comprehensive comparative study involving nine VQA models and sets the scene for further investigations into the effectiveness of VQA model queries in self-driving scenarios. Supplementary material is available at https://github.com/KaavyaRekanar/Towards-a-performance-analysis-on-pre-trained-VQA-models-for-autonomous-driving.
papers.title_zh: 争取对经过培训的自主驾驶视觉回答问题模型进行业绩分析
papers.abstract_zh: 本简短文件初步分析了三种受欢迎的视觉问答模式,即VilBERT、VilLT和LXMERT,用于回答与驾驶方案有关的问题。 这些模型的性能是通过比较对计算机视觉专家提供的参考答复的答复的相似性来评价的,选择模型的依据是对多式联运结构中变压器利用情况的分析。 结果显示,采用跨模式关注和晚期聚变技术的模式,在从驱动角度改进答案方面,展现出很有希望的潜力。 这一初步分析是即将进行的涉及九个自愿质量评估模型的全面比较研究的启动板,为进一步调查自愿质量评估模型在自我驱动情景中Query的有效性奠定了基础。 补充材料可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/kaavyaRekanar/Nations-a-properation-a-property-ana-analysis-on-pre-edied-VQA-models-for-ault-directive-driving。

papers.title: Taxonomy Adaptive Cross-Domain Adaptation in Medical Imaging via Optimization Trajectory Distillation
papers.authors: Jianan Fan, Dongnan Liu, Hang Chang, Heng Huang, Mei Chen, Weidong Cai
papers.abstract: The success of automated medical image analysis depends on large-scale and expert-annotated training sets. Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been raised as a promising approach to alleviate the burden of labeled data collection. However, they generally operate under the closed-set adaptation setting assuming an identical label set between the source and target domains, which is over-restrictive in clinical practice where new classes commonly exist across datasets due to taxonomic inconsistency. While several methods have been presented to tackle both domain shifts and incoherent label sets, none of them take into account the common characteristics of the two issues and consider the learning dynamics along network training. In this work, we propose optimization trajectory distillation, a unified approach to address the two technical challenges from a new perspective. It exploits the low-rank nature of gradient space and devises a dual-stream distillation algorithm to regularize the learning dynamics of insufficiently annotated domain and classes with the external guidance obtained from reliable sources. Our approach resolves the issue of inadequate navigation along network optimization, which is the major obstacle in the taxonomy adaptive cross-domain adaptation scenario. We evaluate the proposed method extensively on several tasks towards various endpoints with clinical significance. The results demonstrate its effectiveness and improvements over previous methods.
papers.title_zh: 通过优化利用轨迹蒸馏法进行医学成像中的 分类法适应性适应性跨主题适应性适应性
papers.abstract_zh: 自动化医学图像分析的成功取决于大规模和专家附加说明的培训组合,无人监督的域适应(UDA)被提出为减轻标签数据收集负担的一种有希望的办法。 然而,它们通常在封闭式适应设置下运作,假设源领域和目标领域之间有相同的标签,在临床实践中,这种标签过于严格,因为由于分类不一致,各数据集之间通常有新的类别。 虽然已提出几种方法来处理域变换和不一致的标签,但没有一种方法考虑到这两个问题的共同特点,并考虑网络培训过程中的学习动态。 在这项工作中,我们提议优化轨迹蒸馏,这是从新角度处理两个技术挑战的统一办法。 它利用了梯度空间的低级别性质,并设计了双流蒸馏算法,以便利用从可靠来源获得的外部指导,规范说明不足的域和班级的学习动态。 我们的方法解决了在网络优化过程中航行不力的问题,这是分类学适应性跨领域适应性适应方案的主要障碍。 我们广泛评估了针对具有临床重要性的不同端点的若干任务的拟议方法。 结果表明,与以往方法相比,其效力和改进是有效的。

papers.title: Sports Video Analysis on Large-Scale Data
papers.authors: Dekun Wu, He Zhao, Xingce Bao, Richard P. Wildes
papers.abstract: "This paper investigates the modeling of automated machine description on sports video, which has seen much progress recently. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches fall quite short of capturing how human experts analyze sports scenes. There are several major reasons: (1) The used dataset is collected from non-official providers, which naturally creates a gap between models trained on those datasets and real-world applications; (2) previously proposed methods require extensive annotation efforts (i.e., player and ball segmentation at pixel level) on localizing useful visual features to yield acceptable results; (3) very few public datasets are available. In this paper, we propose a novel large-scale NBA dataset for Sports Video Analysis (NSVA) with a focus on captioning, to address the above challenges. We also design a unified approach to process raw videos into a stack of meaningful features with minimum labelling efforts, showing that cross modeling on such features using a transformer architecture leads to strong performance. In addition, we demonstrate the broad application of NSVA by addressing two additional tasks, namely fine-grained sports action recognition and salient player identification. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jackwu502/NSVA."
papers.title_zh: 关于大型数据的体育录像分析
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了体育视频上自动机器描述的模型制作,最近取得了很大进展。 然而,最先进的方法还远远不能捕捉人类专家如何分析体育场景。 有几个主要原因:(1) 使用过的数据集是从非官方提供者收集的,这自然造成关于这些数据集的培训模型与现实世界应用之间的差距;(2) 先前提出的方法需要大量说明(即像素级的播放器和球分解),说明如何将有用的视觉特征本地化,以产生可接受的结果;(3) 很少有公共数据集可供使用。 在本文中,我们提议为体育录像分析建立一个新型的大型NBA数据集(NSVA),重点是字幕,以应对上述挑战。 我们还设计了一种统一的方法,将原始视频加工成一系列有意义的特征,并作出最低限度的标签努力,表明使用变压器结构在这些特征上交叉建模可带来强劲的业绩。 此外,我们通过处理另外两项任务,即精细的体育行动识别和突出角色识别,来证明NSVA的广泛应用。 代码和数据集可在https://github.com/jackwu502/NSVA上查阅。

papers.title: Soft Expert Reward Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Hu Wang, Qi Wu, Chunhua Shen
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to find a specified spot in an unseen environment by following natural language instructions. Dominant methods based on supervised learning clone expert's behaviours and thus perform better on seen environments, while showing restricted performance on unseen ones. Reinforcement Learning (RL) based models show better generalisation ability but have issues as well, requiring large amount of manual reward engineering is one of which. In this paper, we introduce a Soft Expert Reward Learning (SERL) model to overcome the reward engineering designing and generalisation problems of the VLN task. Our proposed method consists of two complementary components: Soft Expert Distillation (SED) module encourages agents to behave like an expert as much as possible, but in a soft fashion; Self Perceiving (SP) module targets at pushing the agent towards the final destination as fast as possible. Empirically, we evaluate our model on the VLN seen, unseen and test splits and the model outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on most of the evaluation metrics."
papers.title_zh: 视觉和语言导航软件专家奖励学习
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉和语言导航(VLN)要求代理人遵循自然语言指令,在无形环境中找到特定地点。 以受监督的学习克隆专家行为为基础的主导方法,因此在可见环境中表现更好,同时在看不见环境中表现有限。 以强化学习(RL)为基础的模式显示更具有概括化能力,但也存在问题,需要大量人工奖励工程,其中之一是需要大量人工奖励工程。 在本文中,我们介绍一个软专家奖励学习模式,以克服VLN任务的奖励工程设计和概括问题。 我们提议的方法由两个相辅相成的组成部分组成:软专家蒸馏单元鼓励代理人尽可能以专家的态度行事,但采取软方式; 自我感知(SP)单元的目标是尽可能快地将代理人推向最终目的地。 我们评估我们关于VLN的模型, 视而不见, 测试分解, 模型在多数评估指标上优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: SimMLM: A Simple Framework for Multi-modal Learning with Missing Modality
papers.authors: Sijie Li · Chen Chen · Jungong Han
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose SimMLM, a simple yet powerful framework for multimodal learning with missing modalities. Unlike existing approaches that rely on sophisticated network architectures or complex data imputation techniques, SimMLM provides a generic and effective solution that can adapt to various missing modality scenarios with improved accuracy and robustness. Specifically, SimMLM consists of a generic Dynamic Mixture of Modality Experts (DMoME) architecture, featuring a dynamic, learnable gating mechanism that automatically adjusts each modality’s contribution in both full and partial modality settings. A key innovation of SimMLM is the proposed More vs. Fewer (MoFe) ranking loss, which ensures that task accuracy improves or remains stable as more modalities are made available. This aligns the model with an intuitive principle: removing one or more modalities should not increase accuracy. We validate SimMLM on multimodal medical image segmentation (BraTS 2018) and multimodal classification (UPMC Food-101, avMNIST) tasks, where it consistently surpasses competitive methods, demonstrating superior accuracy, interpretability, robustness, and reliability across both complete and missing modality scenarios at test time.
papers.title_zh: SimMLMM: 失踪模式多模式学习简单框架
papers.abstract_zh: 在这份文件中,我们提议SimMLMM,这是一个简单而有力的、缺乏模式的多式联运学习框架。 与依靠复杂的网络结构或复杂的数据估算技术的现有方法不同,SimMLMM提供了一种通用的有效解决办法,可以适应各种缺失的模式情景,提高准确性和稳健性。 具体地说,SimMLMM是一个通用的动态模型专家混合结构(DMoME)结构,其特点是一个动态的、可学习的格子机制,自动调整每种模式在全模式和部分模式环境中的贡献。 SimMLMM的一个关键创新是拟议的More vs。 较少(财政部)的排名损失,这确保了任务准确性随着更多模式的提供而提高或保持稳定。 这使得模型符合直观原则:删除一个或多个模式不应提高准确性。 我们验证SimMLMM关于多式医疗图象分割(BraTS 2018)和多式分类(UPMC Food-101, avMNIST)的任务,在这些任务中,它始终超越了竞争方法,在测试时,在完整和缺失的模式情景中表现出了更高的准确性、可解释性、稳健性和可靠性。

papers.title: Self-Evolved Dynamic Expansion Model for Task-Free Continual Learning
papers.authors: Fei Ye, Adrian G. Bors
papers.abstract: Task-Free Continual Learning (TFCL) aims to learn new concepts from a stream of data without any task information. The Dynamic Expansion Model (DEM) has shown promising results in TFCL by dynamically expanding the model's capacity to deal with shifts in the data distribution. However, existing approaches only consider the recognition of the input shift as the expansion signal and ignore the correlation between the newly incoming data and previously learned knowledge, resulting in adding and training unnecessary parameters. In this paper, we propose a novel and effective framework for TFCL, which dynamically expands the architecture of a DEM model through a self-assessment mechanism evaluating the diversity of knowledge among existing experts as expansion signals. This mechanism ensures learning additional underlying data distributions with a compact model structure. A novelty-aware sample selection approach is proposed to manage the memory buffer that forces the newly added expert to learn novel information from a data stream, which further promotes the diversity among experts. Moreover, we also propose to reuse previously learned representation information for learning new incoming data by using knowledge transfer in TFCL, which has not been explored before. The DEM expansion and training are regularized through a gradient updating mechanism to gradually explore the positive forward transfer, further improving the performance. Empirical results on TFCL benchmarks show that the proposed framework outperforms the state-of-the-art while using a reasonable number of parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/dtuzi123/SEDEM/.
papers.title_zh: 自发发展的无任务连续不断学习动态扩展模式
papers.abstract_zh: “动态扩展模式”通过积极扩展该模式处理数据分配变化的能力,在“无任务持续学习”中展示了有希望的成果。 然而,现有办法只考虑承认投入转移是扩展信号,忽视新获得的数据与以往获得的知识之间的相互关系,导致增加和培训不必要的参数。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个新的有效框架,作为扩展信号,通过自我评估机制,评估现有专家的知识多样性,从而积极扩展德国马克模式的结构。 这一机制确保学习采用紧凑模式结构的更多基本数据分布;提议采用新颖的抽样选择办法管理记忆缓冲,迫使新增加的专家从数据流中学习新信息,从而进一步促进专家的多样性。 此外,我们还提议重新利用以往学到的代表性信息,通过在工作队中进行知识转让来学习新获得的数据,而这种知识转让以前从未探讨过。 通过梯度更新机制,使德国妇女发展部的扩大和培训正规化,以逐步探索积极的向前转移,进一步改善业绩。 工作队基准的经验结果表明,拟议框架在使用合理数量的参数的同时,超过了最新水平,该代码可在https://github.com/dtuzi123/SEDEM/上查阅。

papers.title: Scene Graph Contrastive Learning for Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Kunal Pratap Singh, Jordi Salvador, Luca Weihs, Aniruddha Kembhavi
papers.abstract: Training effective embodied AI agents often involves expert imitation, specialized components such as maps, or leveraging additional sensors for depth and localization. Another approach is to use neural architectures alongside self-supervised objectives which encourage better representation learning. However, in practice, there are few guarantees that these self-supervised objectives encode task-relevant information. We propose the Scene Graph Contrastive (SGC) loss, which uses scene graphs as training-only supervisory signals. The SGC loss does away with explicit graph decoding and instead uses contrastive learning to align an agent's representation with a rich graphical encoding of its environment. The SGC loss is simple to implement and encourages representations that encode objects' semantics, relationships, and history. By using the SGC loss, we attain gains on three embodied tasks: Object Navigation, Multi-Object Navigation, and Arm Point Navigation. Finally, we present studies and analyses which demonstrate the ability of our trained representation to encode semantic cues about the environment.
papers.title_zh: 内嵌式导航的场景图对比性学习
papers.abstract_zh: 有效的AI代理机构培训往往涉及专家仿造、地图等专门组成部分或利用其他传感器进行深度和本地化,另一种方法是利用神经结构以及自我监督的目标,鼓励更好的代表性学习。 然而,在实践中,很难保证这些自我监督的目标能编码与任务相关的信息。 我们建议使用场景图表作为仅培训监督信号。 SGC损失与清晰的图形解码解耦,相反,它利用对比性学习将代理人的表述与其环境的丰富的图形编码相匹配。 SGC损失很简单,可以实施并鼓励将物体的语义、关系和历史编码的表述。 通过利用SGC损失,我们在三项包含的任务上取得了成果:物体导航、多物体导航和武器点导航。 最后,我们提出研究和分析,这些研究和分析表明我们经过培训的代表有能力将环境的语义信号编码。

papers.title: RLIPv2: Fast Scaling of Relational Language-Image Pre-Training
papers.authors: Hangjie Yuan, Shiwei Zhang, Xiang Wang, Samuel Albanie, Yining Pan, Tao Feng, Jianwen Jiang, Dong Ni, Yingya Zhang, Deli Zhao
papers.abstract: Relational Language-Image Pre-training (RLIP) aims to align vision representations with relational texts, thereby advancing the capability of relational reasoning in computer vision tasks. However, hindered by the slow convergence of RLIPv1 architecture and the limited availability of existing scene graph data, scaling RLIPv1 is challenging. In this paper, we propose RLIPv2, a fast converging model that enables the scaling of relational pre-training to large-scale pseudo-labelled scene graph data. To enable fast scaling, RLIPv2 introduces Asymmetric Language-Image Fusion (ALIF), a mechanism that facilitates earlier and deeper gated cross-modal fusion with sparsified language encoding layers. ALIF leads to comparable or better performance than RLIPv1 in a fraction of the time for pre-training and fine-tuning. To obtain scene graph data at scale, we extend object detection datasets with free-form relation labels by introducing a captioner (e.g., BLIP) and a designed Relation Tagger. The Relation Tagger assigns BLIP-generated relation texts to region pairs, thus enabling larger-scale relational pre-training. Through extensive experiments conducted on Human-Object Interaction Detection and Scene Graph Generation, RLIPv2 shows state-of-the-art performance on three benchmarks under fully-finetuning, few-shot and zero-shot settings. Notably, the largest RLIPv2 achieves 23.29mAP on HICO-DET without any fine-tuning, yields 32.22mAP with just 1% data and yields 45.09mAP with 100% data. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/JacobYuan7/RLIPv2.
papers.title_zh: RLIPv2:培训前关系语言图像快速缩放
papers.abstract_zh: 关系语言图像预培训(RLIP)旨在将视觉表述与相关文本保持一致,从而增强计算机视觉任务的关系推理能力。 然而,由于RLIPv1结构的趋同速度缓慢以及现有现场图表数据有限,因此缩小 RLIPv1 具有挑战性。 在本文中,我们建议RLIPv2 快速趋同模式,可以将相关预培训规模扩大至大型假标签场景图表数据。 为了能够快速缩放,RLIPv2引入了非对称语言图像融合(ALIF)机制,这一机制便于更早和更深的封闭式跨模式融合与封闭式语言编码层。 ALIF在培训前和微调时间的一小部分时间里比RLIPv1产生类似或更好的效果。 为了获得规模的场景图表数据,我们通过引入一个标题(如BLIP)和一个设计成的“关系塔格”来扩展具有自由形式关系标签的物体探测数据集。“关系塔格”将BLIP产生的关系文本分配给区域对子,从而能够进行更大规模的关系培训前培训。 RLIPv2通过对人体物体相互作用探测和场景图生成进行的广泛实验,展示了在完全调整、微光和零光设置下三项基准的SOTA 性能。 值得注意的是,最大的RLIPv2在没有微调的情况下,在HICO-DET上实现了23.29mAP, 产量为32.22mAP, 数据仅为1%, 产量为45.09mAP, 数据为100%。 代码和模型可在https://github.com/JacobYuan7/RLIPv2上公开查阅。

papers.title: REDIR: Refocus-free Event-based De-occlusion Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: Qi Guo · Hailong Shi · Huan Li · Jinsheng Xiao · Xingyu Gao
papers.abstract: The employment of the event-based synthetic aperture imaging (E-SAI) technique, which has the capability to capture high-frequency light intensity variations, has facilitated its extensive application on scene de-occlusion reconstruction tasks. However, existing methods usually require prior information and have strict restriction of camera motion on SAI acquisition methods. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end refocus-free variable E-SAI de-occlusion image reconstruction approach REDIR, which can align the global and local features of the variable event data and effectively achieve high-resolution imaging of pure event streams. To further improve the reconstruction of the occluded target, we propose a perceptual mask-gated connection module to interlink information between modules, and incorporate a spatial-temporal attention mechanism into the SNN block to enhance target extraction ability of the model. Through extensive experiments, our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality on the traditional E-SAI dataset without prior information, while verifying the effectiveness of the variable event data feature registration method on our newly introduced V-ESAI dataset, which obviates the reliance on prior knowledge and extends the applicability of SAI acquisition methods by incorporating focus changes, lens rotations, and non-uniform motion.
papers.title_zh: REDIR: 无重点事件
papers.abstract_zh: 以事件为基础的合成孔径成像(E-SAI)技术具有捕捉高频光强度变异的能力,它有助于在现场排除隔离重建任务中广泛应用该技术。 然而,现行方法通常要求事先提供信息,并严格限制对最高审计机关采购方法的摄像动议。 本文提出了一种新的无端到端重心无重心的可变E-SAI脱隐蔽图像重建方法REDIR,该方法可以使可变事件数据的全球和当地特点保持一致,并有效地实现纯事件流的高分辨率成像。 为了进一步改善对隐蔽目标的重建,我们提议建立一个概念化蒙面连接模块,将模块间的信息相互连接,并将空间-时间关注机制纳入SNN区块,以提高模型的目标提取能力。 通过广泛的实验,我们的模型在没有事先信息的情况下,在传统的电子高级服务倡议数据集上实现了最先进的重建质量,同时在我们新引进的V-ESAI数据集上核实了可变事件数据特征登记方法的有效性,这避免了对先前知识的依赖,并通过纳入焦点变化、镜头旋转和非统一运动,扩大了SAI获取方法的适用性。

papers.title: Probabilistic Modeling of Inter- and Intra-observer Variability in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Arne Schmidt, Pablo Morales-Álvarez, Rafael Molina
papers.abstract: Medical image segmentation is a challenging task, particularly due to inter- and intra-observer variability, even between medical experts. In this paper, we propose a novel model, called Probabilistic Inter-Observer and iNtra-Observer variation NetwOrk (Pionono). It captures the labeling behavior of each rater with a multidimensional probability distribution and integrates this information with the feature maps of the image to produce probabilistic segmentation predictions. The model is optimized by variational inference and can be trained end-to-end. It outperforms state-of-the-art models such as STAPLE, Probabilistic U-Net, and models based on confusion matrices. Additionally, Pionono predicts multiple coherent segmentation maps that mimic the rater's expert opinion, which provides additional valuable information for the diagnostic process. Experiments on real-world cancer segmentation datasets demonstrate the high accuracy and efficiency of Pionono, making it a powerful tool for medical image analysis.
papers.title_zh: 医学图像分割中观察家之间和内部观察家之间和观察家内部变化的概率建模
papers.abstract_zh: 医学形象分割是一项艰巨的任务,特别是由于观察者之间和观察者内部的变异性,甚至是医学专家之间的变异性。 在本文中,我们提出了一个新颖的模式,叫做概率性观察员间和iNtra-观察员变异 NetwOrk(皮奥诺诺 ) 。 它捕捉每个带有多维概率分布的调频器的标签行为,并将这一信息与图像的地貌图集成,以产生概率分解预测。该模型通过变异推断优化,并可以接受端到端培训。 此外,Pionono预测了多个一致的分解图,以模拟测速器的专家意见,后者为诊断过程提供了其他有价值的信息。 其效果是超越了STAPLE(STAPLE ) 、 概率 U-Net(概率 U-Net)等最新模型以及基于混乱矩阵模型的模型。 此外,Pionono预测了多种一致的分解图,以模拟测速器的专家意见。 后者为诊断过程提供了更多有价值的信息。 现实世界癌症分离数据集实验表明Pionono的精度和效率很高,使其成为医学图像分析的有力工具。

papers.title: PIDRo: Parallel Isomeric Attention with Dynamic Routing for Text-Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Peiyan Guan, Renjing Pei, Bin Shao, Jianzhuang Liu, Weimian Li, Jiaxi Gu, Hang Xu, Songcen Xu, Youliang Yan, Edmund Y. Lam
papers.abstract: Text-video retrieval is a fundamental task with high practical value in multi-modal research. Inspired by the great success of pre-trained image-text models with large-scale data, such as CLIP, many methods are proposed to transfer the strong representation learning capability of CLIP to text-video retrieval. However, due to the modality difference between videos and images, how to effectively adapt CLIP to the video domain is still underexplored. In this paper, we investigate this problem from two aspects. First, we enhance the transferred image encoder of CLIP for fine-grained video understanding in a seamless fashion. Second, we conduct fine-grained contrast between videos and texts from both model improvement and loss design. Particularly, we propose a fine-grained contrastive model equipped with parallel isomeric attention and dynamic routing, namely PIDRo, for text-video retrieval. The parallel isomeric attention module is used as the video encoder, which consists of two parallel branches modeling the spatial-temporal information of videos from both patch and frame levels. The dynamic routing module is constructed to enhance the text encoder of CLIP, generating informative word representations by distributing the fine-grained information to the related word tokens within a sentence. Such model design provides us with informative patch, frame and word representations. We then conduct token-wise interaction upon them. With the enhanced encoders and the token-wise loss, we are able to achieve finer-grained text-video alignment and more accurate retrieval. PIDRo obtains state-of-the-art performance over various text-video retrieval benchmarks, including MSR-VTT, MSVD, LSMDC, DiDeMo and ActivityNet.
papers.title_zh: PIDRO: 并行的有色人种关注与动态的文本视频检索路由
papers.abstract_zh: 文本视频检索是一项基本任务,在多模式研究中具有很高的实际价值,由于经过事先训练的图像文本模型与诸如CLIP等大型数据非常成功,因此建议采取许多方法,将CLIP的强大代表性学习能力转变为文字视频检索。 然而,由于视频和图像之间的模式差异,如何有效地使 CLIP 适应视频域的问题仍未得到充分探讨。 在本文中,我们从两个方面调查了这一问题。 首先,我们提升了CLIP 传输的图像编码器, 以便以无缝的方式对视频进行精细理解。 其次,我们对视频和来自模型改进和损失设计的案文进行细微对比。 特别是,我们提出了一个精细的对比模型,配有平行的异构体关注和动态路径,即PIDRo,用于文字视频检索。 平行的异构体关注模块被用作视频编码器,由两个平行分支组成,从补丁和框架层面模拟视频的空间-时间信息。 动态路由模块的构建是为了加强 CLIP 的文本编码器,通过在句子内将精细刻录的信息传播到相关的单词符号中,产生信息化的单词表达方式。 这种模式设计为我们提供了信息化的补丁、框架和单词表达方式。 然后我们对它们进行象征性的互动。有了强化的编码器和象征性的损失,我们就能够实现更精细的文本-视频对齐和更精确的检索。 PIDRo在各种文本视频检索基准上取得了SOTA 性能,包括MSR-VTT、MSVD、LSMDC、DiDeMo和活动网。

papers.title: PartManip: Learning Cross-Category Generalizable Part Manipulation Policy From Point Cloud Observations
papers.authors: Haoran Geng, Ziming Li, Yiran Geng, Jiayi Chen, Hao Dong, He Wang
papers.abstract: Learning a generalizable object manipulation policy is vital for an embodied agent to work in complex real-world scenes. Parts, as the shared components in different object categories, have the potential to increase the generalization ability of the manipulation policy and achieve cross-category object manipulation. In this work, we build the first large-scale, part-based cross-category object manipulation benchmark, PartManip, which is composed of 11 object categories, 494 objects, and 1432 tasks in 6 task classes. Compared to previous work, our benchmark is also more diverse and realistic, i.e., having more objects and using sparse-view point cloud as input without oracle information like part segmentation. To tackle the difficulties of vision-based policy learning, we first train a state-based expert with our proposed part-based canonicalization and part-aware rewards, and then distill the knowledge to a vision-based student. We also find an expressive backbone is essential to overcome the large diversity of different objects. For cross-category generalization, we introduce domain adversarial learning for domain-invariant feature extraction. Extensive experiments in simulation show that our learned policy can outperform other methods by a large margin, especially on unseen object categories. We also demonstrate our method can successfully manipulate novel objects in the real world.
papers.title_zh: 部分: 从点云观测中学习跨类通用部分操作政策
papers.abstract_zh: 学习普遍适用的物体操纵政策对于一个具有内涵的代理人在复杂的现实世界场景中工作至关重要,而部件作为不同对象类别中共有的组成部分,有可能提高操纵政策的通用能力,实现跨类的物体操纵。 在这项工作中,我们建立了第一个大规模、部分基于部分的跨类别物体操纵基准 " PartManip " ,由11个物体类别、494个物体和6个任务类别中的1432项任务组成。 与以往的工作相比,我们的基准也更加多样化和现实,即有更多的对象,将微小的观测点云作为输入,而没有像分块这样的神器信息。 为了解决基于视觉的政策学习方面的困难,我们首先培训一名基于国家的专家,向他们传授我们提议的部分基于肯尼基化和部分意识到的奖励,然后将知识提炼给基于视觉的学生。 我们还发现一个表达性骨干对于克服不同物体的巨大多样性至关重要。 对于跨类的概括化,我们引入了域对称学习,用于域变量特征提取。 广泛的模拟实验表明,我们所学的政策可以大大优于其他方法,特别是在不可见物体类别方面。 我们还证明,我们的方法可以成功地在现实世界中操纵新的物体。

papers.title: Partition-And-Debias: Agnostic Biases Mitigation via a Mixture of Biases-Specific Experts
papers.authors: Jiaxuan Li, Duc Minh Vo, Hideki Nakayama
papers.abstract: Bias mitigation in image classification has been widely researched, and existing methods have yielded notable results. However, most of these methods implicitly assume that a given image contains only one type of known or unknown bias, failing to consider the complexities of real-world biases. We introduce a more challenging scenario, agnostic biases mitigation, aiming at bias removal regardless of whether the type of bias or the number of types is unknown in the datasets. To address this difficult task, we present the Partition-and-Debias (PnD) method that uses a mixture of biases-specific experts to implicitly divide the bias space into multiple subspaces and a gating module to find a consensus among experts to achieve debiased classification. Experiments on both public and constructed benchmarks demonstrated the efficacy of the PnD. Code is available at: https://github.com/Jiaxuan-Li/PnD.
papers.title_zh: 片段和断段:通过 " 特定 " 专家混合组合减缓 " 微小段和断段:通过 " 特定 " 微小段和断段减缓 " 微小段和断段减缓 " 微小段和 " 微小段 " :通过 " 特定 " 微小段和 " 微小段混合 " 专家减缓 " 微小段和 " 淡化 " 微小段:通过 " 特定 " 微小 " 微小段和 " 微小段 " 微小 " 微小段和 " 淡化 " 微小段:通过 " 特定 " 微小段和 " 微小段混合 " 微小段 " 特专家
papers.abstract_zh: 对图像分类中的偏见的减轻进行了广泛研究,现有方法取得了显著成果,但是,这些方法大多含蓄地假定,某一图像只包含一种已知或未知的偏见,没有考虑到现实世界偏见的复杂性。 我们引入了一个更具挑战性的情景,即减轻不可知偏见,目的是消除偏见,而不论数据集中的偏见类型或类型数量不详。 为了完成这一艰巨任务,我们提出了“分化和偏见”方法,这种方法使用各种偏向专家混合方法,将偏向空间隐含地分为多个子空间和一个格子单元,以便在专家之间达成共识,实现有偏向的分类。 公共和构筑基准的实验都表明PnD的功效。 《守则》可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/Jiaxuan-Li/PnD。

papers.title: NeuralLift-360: Lifting an In-the-Wild 2D Photo to a 3D Object With 360deg Views
papers.authors: Dejia Xu, Yifan Jiang, Peihao Wang, Zhiwen Fan, Yi Wang, Zhangyang Wang
papers.abstract: Virtual reality and augmented reality (XR) bring increasing demand for 3D content generation. However, creating high-quality 3D content requires tedious work from a human expert. In this work, we study the challenging task of lifting a single image to a 3D object and, for the first time, demonstrate the ability to generate a plausible 3D object with 360deg views that corresponds well with the given reference image. By conditioning on the reference image, our model can fulfill the everlasting curiosity for synthesizing novel views of objects from images. Our technique sheds light on a promising direction of easing the workflows for 3D artists and XR designers. We propose a novel framework, dubbed NeuralLift-360, that utilizes a depth-aware neural radiance representation (NeRF) and learns to craft the scene guided by denoising diffusion models. By introducing a ranking loss, our NeuralLift-360 can be guided with rough depth estimation in the wild. We also adopt a CLIP-guided sampling strategy for the diffusion prior to provide coherent guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our NeuralLift-360 significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://vita-group.github.io/NeuralLift-360/
papers.title_zh: NeurLift-360: 用360deg 视图将一张在窗口中的照片 2D 提升为 3D 对象
papers.abstract_zh: 虚拟现实和扩大现实(XR)带来了对3D内容生成的日益增长的需求。 然而,创造高质量的3D内容需要一位人类专家的无聊工作。 在这项工作中,我们研究了将单一图像提升到立体物体的艰巨任务,并首次展示了以360度视图生成一个可信的立体物体的能力,该立体物体与给定的参考图像完全吻合。 通过调整参考图像,我们的模型可以满足对综合图像中物体的新观点的长期好奇心。 我们的技术为3D艺术家和 XR 设计师的工作流程提供了大有希望的方向。 我们提出了一个新的框架 — — 被称为神经里夫特-360,它利用深度觉神经光度代表(NERF ) , 并学习以无名化的传播模型为指南的场景。 通过引入排名损失,我们的神经里夫特-360可以在野外以粗略的深度估计为指导。 我们还采用一种CLIP-指导抽样战略,在提供一致的指导之前进行推广。广泛的实验表明,我们的神经里夫-360明显地超过了现有的最新基线。项目网页:https://vita-group.github.io/NeuralLift-360/

papers.title: NeRF in the Palm of Your Hand: Corrective Augmentation for Robotics via Novel-View Synthesis
papers.authors: Allan Zhou, Moo Jin Kim, Lirui Wang, Pete Florence, Chelsea Finn
papers.abstract: Expert demonstrations are a rich source of supervision for training visual robotic manipulation policies, but imitation learning methods often require either a large number of demonstrations or expensive online expert supervision to learn reactive closed-loop behaviors. In this work, we introduce SPARTN (Synthetic Perturbations for Augmenting Robot Trajectories via NeRF): a fully-offline data augmentation scheme for improving robot policies that use eye-in-hand cameras. Our approach leverages neural radiance fields (NeRFs) to synthetically inject corrective noise into visual demonstrations: using NeRFs to generate perturbed viewpoints while simultaneously calculating the corrective actions. This requires no additional expert supervision or environment interaction, and distills the geometric information in NeRFs into a real-time reactive RGB-only policy. In a simulated 6-DoF visual grasping benchmark, SPARTN improves offline success rates by 2.8x over imitation learning without the corrective augmentations and even outperforms some methods that use online supervision. It additionally closes the gap between RGB-only and RGB-D success rates, eliminating the previous need for depth sensors. In real-world 6-DoF robotic grasping experiments from limited human demonstrations, our method improves absolute success rates by 22.5% on average, including objects that are traditionally challenging for depth-based methods.
papers.title_zh: 手掌掌掌中的内RF:通过新视觉合成对机器人进行纠正性增强
papers.abstract_zh: 专家示范是培训视觉机器人操纵政策的丰富监督来源,但模仿学习方法往往需要大量的示范或昂贵的在线专家监督来学习被动的闭路行为。 在这项工作中,我们引入了SPARTN(通过NERF增强机器人轨迹的合成干扰):一个完全脱机的数据增强计划,用以改进使用手持照相机的机器人政策。 我们的方法是利用神经光亮场合成地将矫正噪音注入视觉演示:利用神经光亮场产生干扰的观点,同时计算纠正行动。 这不需要额外的专家监督或环境互动,而是将NeRFs中的几何信息蒸馏成实时反应性RGB专用政策。 SPARTN在模拟的6-DoF目视捕捉基准中,将离线成功率提高2.8倍,高于模仿学习,而没有矫正增强,甚至优于使用在线监督的一些方法。 它进一步缩小了只使用RGB和只使用RGB-D的成功率之间的差距,消除了以前对深度传感器的需要。 在现实世界6-DoF机器人从有限的人类演示中捕捉实验中,我们的方法将绝对成功率平均提高22.5%,包括传统上对深度方法具有挑战性的物体。

papers.title: Myriad: Large Multimodal Model by Applying Vision Experts for Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Yuanze Li, Haolin Wang, Shihao Yuan, Ming Liu, Debin Zhao, Yiwen Guo, Chen Xu, Guangming Shi, Wangmeng Zuo
papers.abstract: Due to the training configuration, traditional industrial anomaly detection (IAD) methods have to train a specific model for each deployment scenario, which is insufficient to meet the requirements of modern design and manufacturing. On the contrary, large multimodal models~(LMMs) have shown eminent generalization ability on various vision tasks, and their perception and comprehension capabilities imply the potential of applying LMMs on IAD tasks. However, we observe that even though the LMMs have abundant knowledge about industrial anomaly detection in the textual domain, the LMMs are unable to leverage the knowledge due to the modality gap between textual and visual domains. To stimulate the relevant knowledge in LMMs and adapt the LMMs towards anomaly detection tasks, we introduce existing IAD methods as vision experts and present a novel large multimodal model applying vision experts for industrial anomaly detection~(abbreviated to {Myriad}). Specifically, we utilize the anomaly map generated by the vision experts as guidance for LMMs, such that the vision model is guided to pay more attention to anomalous regions. Then, the visual features are modulated via an adapter to fit the anomaly detection tasks, which are fed into the language model together with the vision expert guidance and human instructions to generate the final outputs. Extensive experiments are applied on MVTec-AD, VisA, and PCB Bank benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method not only performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods, but also inherits the flexibility and instruction-following ability of LMMs in the field of IAD. Source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at url{https://github.com/tzjtatata/Myriad}.
papers.title_zh: Myriad:通过应用远见专家对工业异常探测进行大型多式联运模型
papers.abstract_zh: 由于培训的配置,传统的工业异常现象探测方法必须为每一种部署设想方案培训一个具体模型,这不足以满足现代设计和制造的要求。 相反,大型多式联运模式~(LMMs)在各种视觉任务方面表现出突出的概括能力,其认识和理解能力意味着有可能将LMMs应用于内部发展任务。 然而,我们注意到,即使LMM公司对在文字领域发现的工业异常现象拥有丰富的知识,但LMM公司由于在文字领域和视觉领域之间存在模式上的差距而无法利用这种知识。 为了激发有关LMMs的相关知识,并使LMMs适应异常点探测任务,我们以远见专家的身份介绍现有的IAD方法,并提出一种新的大型多式联运模型,应用远见专家来探测工业异常点~(向{Myriad}介绍)。 具体地说,我们利用远景专家绘制的异常图作为LMMs指南,以便指导远景模型更多地注意异常区域。 然后,通过适配器对视觉特征进行调制,以适应异常点探测任务,这些功能连同视觉专家指导和人文指示一起被输入语言模型,以产生最终产出。 对MVTec-AD、VisA和PCB Bank基准进行了广泛的试验,表明我们拟议的方法不仅优于最先进的方法,而且继承了LMM在IAD领域的灵活性和教学能力。 来源代码和预培训模式可在url{https://github.com/tzjtatata/Myriad}公开查阅。

papers.title: Multi-View Active Fine-Grained Visual Recognition
papers.authors: Ruoyi Du, Wenqing Yu, Heqing Wang, Ting-En Lin, Dongliang Chang, Zhanyu Ma
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of Fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) with years of history, it is still limited to recognizing 2 images. Recognizing objects in the physical world (i.e., 3D environment) poses a unique challenge -- discriminative information is not only present in visible local regions but also in other unseen views. Therefore, in addition to finding the distinguishable part from the current view, efficient and accurate recognition requires inferring the critical perspective with minimal glances. E.g., a person might recognize a "Ford sedan" with a glance at its side and then know that looking at the front can help tell which model it is. In this paper, towards FGVC in the real physical world, we put forward the problem of multi-view active fine-grained visual recognition (MAFR) and complete this study in three steps: (i) a multi-view, fine-grained vehicle dataset is collected as the testbed, (ii) a pilot experiment is designed to validate the need and research value of MAFR, (iii) a policy-gradient-based framework along with a dynamic exiting strategy is proposed to achieve efficient recognition with active view selection. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms previous multi-view recognition works and can extend existing state-of-the-art FGVC methods and advanced neural networks to become FGVC experts in the 3D environment.
papers.title_zh: 多视力、多视力、积极性精细视力识别
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在多年历史的精细视觉分类(FGVC)取得显著进展,但仍仅限于识别两幅图像。 有形世界中的物体(即3D环境)的确认是一个独特的挑战 -- -- 歧视性信息不仅存在于可见的地方区域,还存在于其他看不见的观点中。 因此,除了找到与目前观点区别的部分外,有效和准确的承认要求以最小的目光来推断关键的观点。 例如,一个人可以一眼看一眼就认出一辆“福特轿车”,然后知道看前面可以帮助确定它是哪种型号。 在这份文件中,为了在真实的物理世界中使FGVC发挥作用,我们提出了多视图活性细微可见识别问题,并分三个步骤完成这项研究:(一) 将多视图细微可见识别车辆数据集作为测试台收集;(二) 设计一个试点实验,以验证MAFR的需要和研究价值;(三) 提出一个政策优先框架和动态的退出战略,以便在积极选择视图时实现高效识别。 我们的全面实验表明,拟议的方法优于以往的多视图识别工作,可以扩大现有最先进的FGVC方法和先进的神经网络,成为FGVC在3D环境中的专家。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Bidirectional Recurrent Network with Hybrid Correlation for Point Cloud Based Scene Flow Estimation
papers.authors: Wencan Cheng, Jong Hwan Ko
papers.abstract: Scene flow estimation provides the fundamental motion perception of a dynamic scene, which is of practical importance in many computer vision applications. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-scale bidirectional recurrent architecture that iteratively optimizes the coarse-to-fine scene flow estimation. In each resolution scale of estimation, a novel bidirectional gated recurrent unit is proposed to bidirectionally and iteratively augment point features and produce progressively optimized scene flow. The optimization of each iteration is integrated with the hybrid correlation that captures not only local correlation but also semantic correlation for more accurate estimation. Experimental results indicate that our proposed architecture significantly outperforms the existing state-of-the-art approaches on both FlyingThings3D and KITTI benchmarks while maintaining superior time efficiency. Codes and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/cwc1260/MSBRN.
papers.title_zh: 多比额表双向双向双向经常 网,与基于点云点的云层景点流动估算的混合关联
papers.abstract_zh: 场景流量估计提供了动态场景的基本动态感知,这在许多计算机视觉应用中都具有实际重要性。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个新的多级双向重复结构,迭接优化粗皮到精细场景流量估计。 在每个分辨率估计比额表中,提议设立一个新颖的双向门锁式经常单位,以双向和迭接方式增加点特征,并逐渐优化现场流动。 每种迭代的优化都与混合相关关系相结合,不仅考虑到当地的相关性,而且考虑到语义相关关系,以便进行更准确的估计。 实验结果表明,我们提议的架构大大优于飞行3D和KITTI基准的现有最新方法,同时保持较高的时间效率。 代码和预先培训的模式可在https://github.com/cwc1260/MSBRN上公开查阅。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Archaeological Dating of Chinese Bronze Dings Based on a Knowledge-Guided Relation Graph
papers.authors: Rixin Zhou, Jiafu Wei, Qian Zhang, Ruihua Qi, Xi Yang, Chuntao Li
papers.abstract: The archaeological dating of bronze dings has played a critical role in the study of ancient Chinese history. Current archaeology depends on trained experts to carry out bronze dating, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive. For such dating, in this study, we propose a learning-based approach to integrate advanced deep learning techniques and archaeological knowledge. To achieve this, we first collect a large-scale image dataset of bronze dings, which contains richer attribute information than other existing fine-grained datasets. Second, we introduce a multihead classifier and a knowledge-guided relation graph to mine the relationship between attributes and the ding era. Third, we conduct comparison experiments with various existing methods, the results of which show that our dating method achieves a state-of-the-art performance. We hope that our data and applied networks will enrich fine-grained classification research relevant to other interdisciplinary areas of expertise. The dataset and source code used are included in our supplementary materials, and will be open after submission owing to the anonymity policy. Source codes and data are available at: https://github.com/zhourixin/bronze-Ding.
papers.title_zh: 根据知识指导关系图绘制的中国青铜丁多族化考古
papers.abstract_zh: 青铜叮当的考古约会在中国古代历史的研究中起到了关键作用。 当前考古学依赖训练有素的专家进行青铜约会,而这种约会既费时又费力。 对于这种约会,在本研究报告中,我们建议采取基于学习的办法,将先进的深层学习技术和考古知识结合起来。 为了做到这一点,我们首先收集一个大型的青铜叮当图像数据集,其中的属性信息比其他现有精细采集的数据集更为丰富。 其次,我们引入一个多头分类器和一个知识导向关系图,用于描述我属性和叮当时代之间的关系。第三,我们与各种现有方法进行比较实验,结果显示我们的约会方法取得了最先进的性能。 我们希望,我们的数据和应用网络将丰富与其他跨学科专门知识领域相关的精细分类研究,并将所使用的数据集和源代码纳入我们的补充材料,由于匿名政策,这些数据集和源代码将在提交后开放。 来源代码和数据见:https://gitub.com/zhouhrixin/bronze-Ding。

papers.title: MSMDFusion: Fusing LiDAR and Camera at Multiple Scales With Multi-Depth Seeds for 3D Object Detection
papers.authors: Yang Jiao, Zequn Jie, Shaoxiang Chen, Jingjing Chen, Lin Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Fusing LiDAR and camera information is essential for accurate and reliable 3D object detection in autonomous driving systems. This is challenging due to the difficulty of combining multi-granularity geometric and semantic features from two drastically different modalities. Recent approaches aim at exploring the semantic densities of camera features through lifting points in 2D camera images (referred to as "seeds") into 3D space, and then incorporate 2D semantics via cross-modal interaction or fusion techniques. However, depth information is under-investigated in these approaches when lifting points into 3D space, thus 2D semantics can not be reliably fused with 3D points. Moreover, their multi-modal fusion strategy, which is implemented as concatenation or attention, either can not effectively fuse 2D and 3D information or is unable to perform fine-grained interactions in the voxel space. To this end, we propose a novel framework with better utilization of the depth information and fine-grained cross-modal interaction between LiDAR and camera, which consists of two important components. First, a Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) method is used to enhance the depth quality of the lifted points at each interaction level. Second, a Gated Modality-Aware Convolution (GMA-Conv) block is applied to modulate voxels involved with the camera modality in a fine-grained manner and then aggregate multi-modal features into a unified space. Together they provide the detection head with more comprehensive features from LiDAR and camera. On the nuScenes test benchmark, our proposed method, abbreviated as MSMDFusion, achieves state-of-the-art results on both 3D object detection and tracking tasks without using test-time-augmentation and ensemble techniques. The code is available at https://github.com/SxJyJay/MSMDFusion.
papers.title_zh: MSMDFusion: 3D 对象探测用多维种子在多尺度和多维种子中引信激光雷达和相机
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶系统中的精确可靠的三维物体探测必须具备Fusing LiDAR和摄像资料,因为很难将两种截然不同的方式的多谱度几何和语义特征结合起来,因此,这具有挑战性。 最近的做法旨在探索摄像特征的语义密度,通过2D摄像图像(称为“种子”)中的升起点(称为“种子”)进入3D空间,然后通过跨模式互动或聚变技术纳入2D语义学。 然而,当将点移入3D空间时,这些方法的深度信息调查不足,因此2D语义无法可靠地与3D点结合。 此外,它们的多模式融合战略是作为融合或关注执行的,要么无法有效地将2D和3D信息引信,要么无法在 voxel 空间进行精细的相互作用。 为此,我们提议建立一个新的框架,更好地利用深度信息以及LIDAR和照相机之间精细的跨模式互动,其中包括两个重要组成部分。 第一,采用多面不预测法,提高每个互动级别提升点的深度质量。 其次,Gated Modality-Aware Convolution(GMA-Conv)区块以精细刻度的方式用于与照相机模式有关的调制氧化物,然后将多式特征合成成一个统一的空间。它们共同为探测头提供了来自LiDAR和相机的更全面的特征。 在核天文测试基准方面,我们提议的方法(缩写为MSMDFusion)在3D物体探测和跟踪任务上都取得了最新的结果,没有使用测试-时间增强和组合技术,该代码可在https://github.com/SxJyJayJay/MSMDFusion查阅。

papers.title: MRN: Multiplexed Routing Network for Incremental Multilingual Text Recognition
papers.authors: Tianlun Zheng, Zhineng Chen, Bingchen Huang, Wei Zhang, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Multilingual text recognition (MLTR) systems typically focus on a fixed set of languages, which makes it difficult to handle newly added languages or adapt to ever-changing data distribution. In this paper, we propose the Incremental MLTR (IMLTR) task in the context of incremental learning (IL), where different languages are introduced in batches. IMLTR is particularly challenging due to rehearsal-imbalance, which refers to the uneven distribution of sample characters in the rehearsal set, used to retain a small amount of old data as past memories. To address this issue, we propose a Multiplexed Routing Network (MRN). MRN trains a recognizer for each language that is currently seen. Subsequently, a language domain predictor is learned based on the rehearsal set to weigh the recognizers. Since the recognizers are derived from the original data, MRN effectively reduces the reliance on older data and better fights against catastrophic forgetting, the core issue in IL. We extensively evaluate MRN on MLT17 and MLT19 datasets. It outperforms existing general-purpose IL methods by large margins, with average accuracy improvements ranging from 10.3% to 35.8% under different settings. Code is available at https://github.com/simplify23/MRN.
papers.title_zh: MRN: 递增多语种文本识别多语种运行网络
papers.abstract_zh: 多语文文本识别系统通常侧重于固定的一套语文,这使得难以处理新增加的语文或适应不断变化的数据分配。 在本文中,我们建议在逐步学习的背景下开展递增 MLTR(IMLTR)任务,分批采用不同语言。 由于排练-平衡,IMLTR特别具有挑战性,因为排练-平衡是指排练中样本字符分布不均,用于保留少量旧数据作为过去的记忆。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议建立一个多路运行网络(MRN ) 。 MRN为目前看到的每一种语言培训一个识别器。 随后,根据对识别器进行加权的排练,学习了语言域预测器。 由于识别数据来源于原始数据,MRN有效地减少了对旧数据的依赖,并更好地防止灾难性的遗忘,这是国际法的核心问题。 我们广泛评价MLT17和MLT19数据集的MRN。 它以很大幅度比现有的通用IL法表现优于现有通用IL法,在不同情况下,平均精度提高幅度从10.3%到35.8%不等,可在https://github.com/simplify23/MRN查阅《守则》。

papers.title: MRM: Masked Relation Modeling for Medical Image Pre-Training with Genetics
papers.authors: Qiushi Yang, Wuyang Li, Baopu Li, Yixuan Yuan
papers.abstract: Modern deep learning techniques on automatic multimodal medical diagnosis rely on massive expert annotations, which is time-consuming and prohibitive. Recent masked image modeling (MIM)-based pre-training methods have witnessed impressive advances for learning meaningful representations from unlabeled data and transferring to downstream tasks. However, these methods focus on natural images and ignore the specific properties of medical data, yielding unsatisfying generalization performance on downstream medical diagnosis. In this paper, we aim to leverage genetics to boost image pre-training and present a masked relation modeling (MRM) framework. Instead of explicitly masking input data in previous MIM methods leading to loss of disease-related semantics, we design relation masking to mask out token-wise feature relation in both self- and cross-modality levels, which preserves intact semantics within the input and allows the model to learn rich disease-related information. Moreover, to enhance semantic relation modeling, we propose relation matching to align the sample-wise relation between the intact and masked features. The relation matching exploits inter-sample relation by encouraging global constraints in the feature space to render sufficient semantic relation for feature representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework is simple yet powerful, achieving state-of-the-art transfer performance on various downstream diagnosis tasks.
papers.title_zh: MRM: 医学图像在接受遗传学培训前的蒙面关系模型
papers.abstract_zh: 关于自动多式联运医学诊断的现代深层次学习技术依赖于大量专家说明,这种说明既费时又令人望而却步。 最近在以蒙面图像建模为基础的培训前方法方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展,从未贴标签的数据中学习有意义的表述方式,并转入下游任务。 然而,这些方法侧重于自然图像,忽视了医学数据的具体特性,在下游医学诊断中产生了不令人满意的概括性表现。 在本文中,我们的目标是利用遗传学来提升图像预培训,并提供一个蒙面关系模型框架。 我们没有在以往的MIM方法中明确掩盖输入数据,从而导致与疾病有关的语义损失,而是设计了隐蔽关系,以掩盖自我和跨模式水平上的象征性特征关系,从而在输入中保留完整的语义,使模型能够学习与疾病有关的丰富信息。 此外,为加强语义关系建模,我们提议建立匹配关系,以协调完好无损特征与蒙面特征之间的抽样关系。 匹配关系通过鼓励在特征空间方面的全球限制,使特征代表关系具有足够的语义关系,从而利用了抽样关系。 广泛的实验表明,拟议的框架简单而有力,在各种下游诊断任务上取得了最先进的转让业绩。

papers.title: MMG-Ego4D: Multimodal Generalization in Egocentric Action Recognition
papers.authors: Xinyu Gong, Sreyas Mohan, Naina Dhingra, Jean-Charles Bazin, Yilei Li, Zhangyang Wang, Rakesh Ranjan
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study a novel problem in egocentric action recognition, which we term as "Multimodal Generalization" (MMG). MMG aims to study how systems can generalize when data from certain modalities is limited or even completely missing. We thoroughly investigate MMG in the context of standard supervised action recognition and the more challenging few-shot setting for learning new action categories. MMG consists of two novel scenarios, designed to support security, and efficiency considerations in real-world applications: (1) missing modality generalization where some modalities that were present during the train time are missing during the inference time, and (2) cross-modal zero-shot generalization, where the modalities present during the inference time and the training time are disjoint. To enable this investigation, we construct a new dataset MMG-Ego4D containing data points with video, audio, and inertial motion sensor (IMU) modalities. Our dataset is derived from Ego4D dataset, but processed and thoroughly re-annotated by human experts to facilitate research in the MMG problem. We evaluate a diverse array of models on MMG-Ego4D and propose new methods with improved generalization ability. In particular, we introduce a new fusion module with modality dropout training, contrastive-based alignment training, and a novel cross-modal prototypical loss for better few-shot performance. We hope this study will serve as a benchmark and guide future research in multimodal generalization problems. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/MMG_Ego4D
papers.title_zh: MMG-Ego4D: 承认以种族为中心的行动中的多模式普遍化
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们研究了自我中心行动识别方面一个新问题,我们称之为“模块化通用化 ” ( MMG ) 。 MMG旨在研究当某些模式的数据有限甚至完全缺失时,系统如何能够概括化。 我们根据标准监督行动确认以及学习新行动类别更具挑战性的短片环境,对MMG进行彻底调查。 MMG由两种旨在支持安全的新设想和现实应用中的效率考虑组成:(1) 缺少模式的概括化,在推断期间缺少在火车期间存在的某些模式,和(2) 跨模式零点概括化,在推断期间和培训期间存在的模式脱节。 为了进行这一调查,我们建立了一个新的数据集MMG-Ego4D,其中载有带有视频、音频和惯性运动传感器(IMU)模式的数据点。 我们的数据集来自Ego4D数据集,但经过人类专家的处理和全面重新加注,以便利对MMG问题的研究。 我们评估了多种MMG-Ego4D模型,并提出了新的方法,提高了普及能力。 特别是,我们引入了一个新的融合模块,包括模式辍学培训、对比式校正培训以及新颖的跨模式原型损失,以获得更好的微小效果。 我们希望,这项研究将作为一个基准,指导今后对多式联运一般化问题的研究,基准和准则可在https://github.com/facebookresearch/MMG_Ego4D上查阅。

papers.title: MM-REACT: Prompting ChatGPT for Multimodal Reasoning and Action
papers.authors: Zhengyuan Yang, Linjie Li, Jianfeng Wang, Kevin Lin, Ehsan Azarnasab, Faisal Ahmed, Zicheng Liu, Ce Liu, Michael Zeng, Lijuan Wang
papers.abstract: We propose MM-REACT, a system paradigm that integrates ChatGPT with a pool of vision experts to achieve multimodal reasoning and action. In this paper, we define and explore a comprehensive list of advanced vision tasks that are intriguing to solve, but may exceed the capabilities of existing vision and vision-language models. To achieve such advanced visual intelligence, MM-REACT introduces a textual prompt design that can represent text descriptions, textualized spatial coordinates, and aligned file names for dense visual signals such as images and videos. MM-REACT's prompt design allows language models to accept, associate, and process multimodal information, thereby facilitating the synergetic combination of ChatGPT and various vision experts. Zero-shot experiments demonstrate MM-REACT's effectiveness in addressing the specified capabilities of interests and its wide application in different scenarios that require advanced visual understanding. Furthermore, we discuss and compare MM-REACT's system paradigm with an alternative approach that extends language models for multimodal scenarios through joint finetuning. Code, demo, video, and visualization are available at https://multimodal-react.github.io/
papers.title_zh: MM-REACT:为多式联运理由和行动促进聊天
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出MM-REACT,这是一个系统范例,将ChatgPT与一组视觉专家相结合,以实现多式联运推理和行动。 在本文中,我们界定和探讨一份全面的先进远景任务清单,这些任务令人感兴趣地需要解决,但可能超出现有远景和远景模式的能力。 为实现这种先进的视觉情报,MM-REACT引入了一种文字即时设计,可以代表图像和视频等密集视觉信号的文字描述、文字化空间坐标和一致的档案名称。 MM-REACT的迅速设计使语言模式能够接受、联系和处理多式联运信息,从而便利了ChatGPT和各种视觉专家的协同结合。 零射实验表明,MM-REACT在处理特定利益能力方面的有效性,以及它在需要深入视觉理解的不同情景中的广泛应用。 此外,我们讨论和比较MM-REACT的系统范式和另一种办法,即通过联合微调扩大多式联运情况的语言模式。 代码、演示、视频和可视化可在https://multimodal-react.github.io/上查阅。

papers.title: Mitigating Task Interference in Multi-Task Learning via Explicit Task Routing With Non-Learnable Primitives
papers.authors: Chuntao Ding, Zhichao Lu, Shangguang Wang, Ran Cheng, Vishnu Naresh Boddeti
papers.abstract: Multi-task learning (MTL) seeks to learn a single model to accomplish multiple tasks by leveraging shared information among the tasks. Existing MTL models, however, have been known to suffer from negative interference among tasks. Efforts to mitigate task interference have focused on either loss/gradient balancing or implicit parameter partitioning with partial overlaps among the tasks. In this paper, we propose ETR-NLP to mitigate task interference through a synergistic combination of non-learnable primitives (NLPs) and explicit task routing (ETR). Our key idea is to employ non-learnable primitives to extract a diverse set of task-agnostic features and recombine them into a shared branch common to all tasks and explicit task-specific branches reserved for each task. The non-learnable primitives and the explicit decoupling of learnable parameters into shared and task-specific ones afford the flexibility needed for minimizing task interference. We evaluate the efficacy of ETR-NLP networks for both image-level classification and pixel-level dense prediction MTL problems. Experimental results indicate that ETR-NLP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with fewer learnable parameters and similar FLOPs across all datasets. Code is available at this URL.
papers.title_zh: 通过与非可识别的原始元素进行明确任务输出,减缓多任务学习中的任务干扰
papers.abstract_zh: 多任务学习(MTL)试图学习一种单一模式,通过利用任务之间的共享信息完成多重任务,但已知现有的MTL模式在任务之间受到负面干扰。 减轻任务干扰的努力侧重于损失/逐步平衡或隐含参数分割与任务部分重叠。 在这份文件中,我们提议通过将不可清除的原始物和明确的任务路径结合起来,减少任务干扰。 我们的主要想法是,利用不可忽略的原始物,提取一套多样的任务不可知性特征,并将其重新编成一个所有任务共有的共享分支,并为每项任务保留明确的任务特定分支。 不可回收的原始生物和将可学习的参数明确分离为共同的和具体任务参数,为尽量减少任务干扰提供了必要的灵活性。我们评估了ETR-NLP网络在图像级别分类和像素级密集预测MTL问题方面的功效。 实验结果显示,ETR-NLP明显优于最新基线,可学习参数较少,而且所有数据集都有类似的FLOP。

papers.title: METransformer: Radiology Report Generation by Transformer With Multiple Learnable Expert Tokens
papers.authors: Zhanyu Wang, Lingqiao Liu, Lei Wang, Luping Zhou
papers.abstract: In clinical scenarios, multi-specialist consultation could significantly benefit the diagnosis, especially for intricate cases. This inspires us to explore a "multi-expert joint diagnosis" mechanism to upgrade the existing "single expert" framework commonly seen in the current literature. To this end, we propose METransformer, a method to realize this idea with a transformer-based backbone. The key design of our method is the introduction of multiple learnable "expert" tokens into both the transformer encoder and decoder. In the encoder, each expert token interacts with both vision tokens and other expert tokens to learn to attend different image regions for image representation. These expert tokens are encouraged to capture complementary information by an orthogonal loss that minimizes their overlap. In the decoder, each attended expert token guides the cross-attention between input words and visual tokens, thus influencing the generated report. A metrics-based expert voting strategy is further developed to generate the final report. By the multi-experts concept, our model enjoys the merits of an ensemble-based approach but through a manner that is computationally more efficient and supports more sophisticated interactions among experts. Experimental results demonstrate the promising performance of our proposed model on two widely used benchmarks. Last but not least, the framework-level innovation makes our work ready to incorporate advances on existing "single-expert" models to further improve its performance.
papers.title_zh: Metransfor: 由多可学习专家调制的Transformer生成放射学报告
papers.abstract_zh: 在临床假想中,多专家协商可以极大地有利于诊断,特别是复杂案例的诊断。 这激励我们探索“多专家联合诊断”机制,提升当前文献中常见的现有“单一专家”框架。 为此,我们建议METranserform, 这是一种用变压器骨干实现这一想法的方法。 我们方法的关键设计是将多种可学习的“专家”标志引入变压器编码器和解码器。 在编码器中,每个专家标牌都与视觉标牌和其他专家标牌互动,学习到不同的图像区域展示图像。鼓励这些专家标牌通过正向损失获取补充信息,从而尽可能减少重叠。 在解码器中,每一位与会专家象征性文件都指导了输入文字和视觉象征之间的交叉注意力,从而影响了生成的报告,还进一步制定了基于标准的专家投票战略,以产生最后报告。 通过多专家概念,我们的模型享有基于共同方法的优点,但采用的方法是提高计算效率,支持专家之间更复杂的互动。 实验结果表明,我们提议的模型在两个广泛使用的基准上取得了良好的业绩。 最后但并非最不重要的是,框架一级的创新使我们的工作准备就绪,将现有“单一专家”模式的进展纳入其中,以进一步改善其业绩。

papers.title: MethaneMapper: Spectral Absorption Aware Hyperspectral Transformer for Methane Detection
papers.authors: Satish Kumar, Ivan Arevalo, ASM Iftekhar, B S Manjunath
papers.abstract: Methane (CH 4 ) is the chief contributor to global climate change. Recent Airborne Visible-Infrared Imaging Spectrometer-Next Generation (AVIRIS-NG) has been very useful in quantitative mapping of methane emissions. Existing methods for analyzing this data are sensitive to local terrain conditions, often require manual inspection from domain experts, prone to significant error and hence are not scalable. To address these challenges, we propose a novel end-to-end spectral absorption wavelength aware transformer network, MethaneMapper, to detect and quantify the emissions. MethaneMapper introduces two novel modules that help to locate the most relevant methane plume regions in the spectral domain and uses them to localize these accurately. Thorough evaluation shows that MethaneMapper achieves 0.63 mAP in detection and reduces the model size (by 5x) compared to the current state of the art. In addition, we also introduce a large-scale dataset of methane plume segmentation mask for over 1200 AVIRIS-NG flightlines from 2015-2022. It contains over 4000 methane plume sites. Our dataset will provide researchers the opportunity to develop and advance new methods for tackling this challenging green-house gas detection problem with significant broader social impact. Dataset and source code link.
papers.title_zh: 甲烷Mapper: 用于检测甲烷的超光谱Transformer
papers.abstract_zh: 甲烷(CH 4)是全球气候变化的主要促成因素。 近期的空气载体可见红外成像光谱-下一代(AVIRIS-NG)在甲烷排放量定量绘图方面非常有用。 现有数据分析方法对当地地形条件敏感,往往需要域专家人工检查,容易发生重大错误,因此无法缩放。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个新型端对端光谱吸收波长了解变压器网络,甲烷造影器,以检测和量化排放量。 甲烷Mapper引进了两个新的模块,帮助确定光谱域中最相关的甲烷羽流区域的位置,并利用这些模块准确将这些区域本地化。 彻底评估表明,甲烷制造商在检测中实现了0.63 mAP,比目前水平减少了模型规模(5x),此外,我们还为2015-2022年1200多个AVIRIS-NG飞行线引入了大型甲烷羽流分离掩码数据集。 它包含4 000多个甲烷羽流站点。我们的数据集将为研究人员提供机会,以开发和推进新方法,解决这一具有挑战性的、具有重大广泛社会影响的绿色室内气体探测问题。数据集和源代码链接。

papers.title: MDCS: More Diverse Experts with Consistency Self-distillation for Long-tailed Recognition
papers.authors: Qihao Zhao, Chen Jiang, Wei Hu, Fan Zhang, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: Recently, multi-expert methods have led to significant improvements in long-tail recognition (LTR). We summarize two aspects that need further enhancement to contribute to LTR boosting: (1) More diverse experts; (2) Lower model variance. However, the previous methods didn't handle them well. To this end, we propose More Diverse experts with Consistency Self-distillation (MDCS) to bridge the gap left by earlier methods. Our MDCS approach consists of two core components: Diversity Loss (DL) and Consistency Self-distillation (CS). In detail, DL promotes diversity among experts by controlling their focus on different categories. To reduce the model variance, we employ KL divergence to distill the richer knowledge of weakly augmented instances for the experts' self-distillation. In particular, we design Confident Instance Sampling (CIS) to select the correctly classified instances for CS to avoid biased/noisy knowledge. In the analysis and ablation study, we demonstrate that our method compared with previous work can effectively increase the diversity of experts, significantly reduce the variance of the model, and improve recognition accuracy. Moreover, the roles of our DL and CS are mutually reinforcing and coupled: the diversity of experts benefits from the CS, and the CS cannot achieve remarkable results without the DL. Experiments show our MDCS outperforms the state-of-the-art by 1% 2% on five popular long-tailed benchmarks, including CIFAR10-LT, CIFAR100-LT, ImageNet-LT, Places-LT, and iNaturalist 2018. The code is available at https://github.com/fistyee/MDCS.
papers.title_zh: MDCS: 更多样化的专家,具有促进长期承认的一贯性自我蒸馏能力
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,多专家方法导致长尾目识别(LTR)有了重大改进。 我们总结了需要进一步加强的两个方面,以促进LTR的提高:(1) 更加多样化的专家;(2) 模型差异较小,但以往的方法处理不善。 为此,我们建议具有一致性自我蒸馏(MDCS)的更多样化专家来填补先前方法留下的空白,我们的MDCS方法由两个核心部分组成:多样性损失(DL)和一致性自我蒸馏(CS)。 详细来说,DL通过控制专家对不同类别的关注,促进专家之间的多样性。 为了减少模型差异,我们利用KL差异来提炼专家自我蒸馏方面增长不足的例子的丰富知识。 特别是,我们设计 " 机密采样案 " (CIS),为CS选择正确分类的案例,以避免有偏见/有噪音的知识。 在分析和通货膨胀研究中,我们证明,与以往工作相比,我们的方法能够有效地增加专家的多样性,大大缩小模型的差异,提高识别的准确性。 此外,我们的DL和CS的作用是相辅相成的:专家的多样性受益于CS,没有DL,CS就不能取得显著成果。 实验显示,我们的MDCS在五种广受欢迎的长期基准(包括CIFAR10-LT、CIFAR100-LT、图像网络-LT、Places-LT和iNatulatlist 2018)上比最新水平高1%2%,代码见https://github.com/fistyee/MDCS。

papers.title: MaskCon: Masked Contrastive Learning for Coarse-Labelled Dataset
papers.authors: Chen Feng, Ioannis Patras
papers.abstract: Deep learning has achieved great success in recent years with the aid of advanced neural network structures and large-scale human-annotated datasets. However, it is often costly and difficult to accurately and efficiently annotate large-scale datasets, especially for some specialized domains where fine-grained labels are required. In this setting, coarse labels are much easier to acquire as they do not require expert knowledge. In this work, we propose a contrastive learning method, called masked contrastive learning (MaskCon) to address the under-explored problem setting, where we learn with a coarse-labelled dataset in order to address a finer labelling problem. More specifically, within the contrastive learning framework, for each sample our method generates soft-labels with the aid of coarse labels against other samples and another augmented view of the sample in question. By contrast to self-supervised contrastive learning where only the sample's augmentations are considered hard positives, and in supervised contrastive learning where only samples with the same coarse labels are considered hard positives, we propose soft labels based on sample distances, that are masked by the coarse labels. This allows us to utilize both inter-sample relations and coarse labels. We demonstrate that our method can obtain as special cases many existing state-of-the-art works and that it provides tighter bounds on the generalization error. Experimentally, our method achieves significant improvement over the current state-of-the-art in various datasets, including CIFAR10, CIFAR100, ImageNet-1K, Standford Online Products and Stanford Cars196 datasets. Code and annotations are available at https://github.com/MrChenFeng/MaskCon_CVPR2023.
papers.title_zh: 面具: 粗略标签数据集的隐蔽反比学习
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,在先进的神经网络结构和大规模附加说明的数据集的帮助下,深层学习取得了巨大成功。 然而,准确和高效地说明大规模数据集往往成本高,而且难度大,特别是在需要精细标记的一些专门领域,在这一背景下,粗劣标签很容易获得,因为它们不需要专业知识。 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种反比学习方法,称为蒙面反比学习(Maskcon),以解决探索不足的问题环境,我们用粗略标签的数据集学习,以解决更细的标签问题。 更具体地说,在对比式学习框架内,对于每个样本,我们的方法都产生软标签,同时使用粗粗标签与其他样本作对比,并对相关样本进行另一种扩大的观察。 与自我监督的对比性学习相反,在这种学习中,只有样本的增量被视为硬性阳性,在监督的对比性学习中,只有带有相同粗皮标签的样本被视为硬性阳性,我们提出以样本距离为基础的软标签,这些标签被粗粗标签遮盖。 这使得我们既可以使用抽样关系,也可以使用粗糙的标签。 我们证明,我们的方法可以作为特殊案例获得许多现有最先进的作品,并且对一般化错误规定了更严格的界限。 实验性地说,我们的方法在各种数据集,包括CIFAR10、CIFAR100、imageNet-1K、Standford在线产品和斯坦福Cars196数据集中,比目前的最新数据有了显著改进。 代码和说明见https://github.com/ChenFeng/Mrm ChenFeng/MaskCon_CVPR2023。

papers.title: Local or Global: Selective Knowledge Assimilation for Federated Learning with Limited Labels
papers.authors: Yae Jee Cho, Gauri Joshi, Dimitrios Dimitriadis
papers.abstract: Many existing FL methods assume clients with fully-labeled data, while in realistic settings, clients have limited labels due to the expensive and laborious process of labeling. Limited labeled local data of the clients often leads to their local model having poor generalization abilities to their larger unlabeled local data, such as having class-distribution mismatch with the unlabeled data. As a result, clients may instead look to benefit from the global model trained across clients to leverage their unlabeled data, but this also becomes difficult due to data heterogeneity across clients. In our work, we propose FedLabel where clients selectively choose the local or global model to pseudo-label their unlabeled data depending on which is more of an expert of the data. We further utilize both the local and global models' knowledge via global-local consistency regularization which minimizes the divergence between the two models' outputs when they have identical pseudo-labels for the unlabeled data. Unlike other semi-supervised FL baselines, our method does not require additional experts other than the local or global model, nor require additional parameters to be communicated. We also do not assume any server-labeled data or fully labeled clients. For both cross-device and cross-silo settings, we show that FedLabel outperforms other semi-supervised FL baselines by 8-24%, and even outperforms standard fully supervised FL baselines (100% labeled data) with only 5-20% of labeled data.
papers.title_zh: 地方或全球:选择性知识与联邦学习中带有有限标签的选择性知识的比喻
papers.abstract_zh: 许多现有的FL方法假定客户拥有全标签数据,而在现实环境中,客户由于标签手续昂贵和繁琐,标签有限。 客户贴有有限标签的本地数据往往导致其本地模型对较大的无标签的本地数据缺乏概括性能力,例如分类分配与无标签数据不匹配。 因此,客户可能希望从经过培训的全客户全球模式中受益,以利用其未贴标签的数据,但由于客户的数据不均匀,这也变得困难。 在我们的工作中,我们建议FedLabel用户有选择地选择当地或全球模型,以假标签他们未贴标签的数据,这取决于哪个数据专家更多。 我们通过全球-地方一致性规范化,进一步利用当地和全球模型的知识,在两种模型产出为无标签数据提供相同的假标签时,这种规范化最大限度地缩小了这两个模型产出之间的差异。 与其他半监督的FL基线不同,我们的方法并不要求除本地或全球模型以外的额外专家,也不要求通报额外的参数。 我们也不假定任何服务器标签数据或贴满标签的客户。 对于跨构件和跨筒仓设置,我们显示,FedLabel的性能超过其他半监督FL基线8-24%,甚至超过完全监督FL基线(100%标签数据)的标准,只有5-20%的标签数据。

papers.title: Local and Global Logit Adjustments for Long-Tailed Learning
papers.authors: Yingfan Tao, Jingna Sun, Hao Yang, Li Chen, Xu Wang, Wenming Yang, Daniel Du, Min Zheng
papers.abstract: Multi-expert ensemble models for long-tailed learning typically either learn diverse generalists from the whole dataset or aggregate specialists on different subsets. However, the former is insufficient for tail classes due to the high imbalance factor of the entire dataset, while the latter may bring ambiguity in predicting unseen classes. To address these issues, we propose a novel Local and Global Logit Adjustments (LGLA) method that learns experts with full data covering all classes and enlarges the discrepancy among them by elaborated logit adjustments. LGLA consists of two core components: a Class-aware Logit Adjustment (CLA) strategy and an Adaptive Angular Weighted (AAW) loss. The CLA strategy trains multiple experts which excel at each subset using the Local Logit Adjustment (LLA). It also trains one expert specializing in an inversely long-tailed distribution through Global Logit Adjustment (GLA). Moreover, the AAW loss adopts adaptive hard sample mining with respect to different experts to further improve accuracy. Extensive experiments on popular long-tailed benchmarks manifest the superiority of LGLA over the SOTA methods.
papers.title_zh: 长期学习学习的地方和全球逻辑调整
papers.abstract_zh: 用于长期学习的多专家混合模型通常要么从整个数据集中学习不同的通才,要么在不同的子集中集成专家。 然而,由于整个数据集的高度不平衡因素,前者不足以用于尾品类,而后者可能会在预测不可见类方面造成模糊不清。 为解决这些问题,我们提议采用新的地方和全球逻辑调整方法,向专家学习涵盖所有类别的全部数据,并通过详细进行逻辑调整来扩大两者之间的差异。 LGLA由两个核心部分组成:一种为人所知的逻辑调整(CLA)战略和一种适应性角加权(AAAW)损失(AAW)战略培训多位专家,他们利用当地逻辑调整(LLA)在每个子集中优异。 它还培训了一名专家,专门通过全球逻辑调整(GLA)进行反向长尾分配,此外,AAW损失采用适应性硬采样采矿方法,供不同专家使用,以进一步提高准确性。 广泛试验流行的长长基准表明,LGLA优于SOTA方法。
