papers.title: Lip2Vec: Efficient and Robust Visual Speech Recognition via Latent-to-Latent Visual to Audio Representation Mapping
papers.authors: Yasser Abdelaziz Dahou Djilali, Sanath Narayan, Haithem Boussaid, Ebtessam Almazrouei, Merouane Debbah
papers.abstract: Visual Speech Recognition (VSR) differs from the common perception tasks as it requires deeper reasoning over the video sequence, even by human experts. Despite the recent advances in VSR, current approaches rely on labeled data to fully train or finetune their models predicting the target speech. This hinders their ability to generalize well beyond the training set and leads to performance degeneration under out-of-distribution challenging scenarios. Un-like previous works that involve auxiliary losses or com-plex training procedures and architectures, we propose a simple approach, named Lip2Vec that is based on learning a prior model. Given a robust visual speech encoder, this network maps the encoded latent representations of the lip sequence to their corresponding latents from the audio pair, which are sufficiently invariant for effective text decoding. The generated audio representation is then decoded to text using an off-the-shelf Audio Speech Recognition (ASR) model. The proposed model compares favorably with fully-supervised learning methods on the LRS3 dataset achieving 26 WER. Unlike SoTA approaches, our model keeps a rea-sonable performance on the VoxCeleb2-en test set. We believe that reprogramming the VSR as an ASR task narrows the performance gap between the two and paves the way for more flexible formulations of lip reading.
papers.title_zh: Lip2Vec:通过远程到远程视觉到音频代表图绘制的高效和强力视觉语音识别
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语音识别(VSR)与一般认知任务不同,因为它要求对视频序列进行更深入的推理,甚至由人类专家来推理。 尽管最近VSR取得了进步,但目前的做法还是依靠贴标签的数据来充分培训或微调预测目标演讲的模型。 这妨碍了他们的能力,使其无法在培训范围以外广泛推广,并导致在分配外的具有挑战性的情景下业绩下降。 与以往涉及附带损失或复杂培训程序和结构的工程不同,我们建议采用一个简单的方法,即Lip2Vec, 以学习先前的模式为基础。 这个网络以一个强大的视觉语音编码器, 将嘴唇序列的编码潜在表达方式 映射到音频配对的对应暗层上, 而音频配对的暗层是足够易变的, 足以有效解码文字。 生成的音频表示器随后被解码成使用现成的音频语音识别模型(ASR)的文本。 拟议的模型与完全监督下的LRS3数据集的学习方法相比,优于达到26 WER的LRS3数据集的学习方法。 与SoTA方法不同的是,我们的模型在VoxCeleb2en测试集上保持了一种可辨识的性能。 我们认为,将VSR重新编程为ASR任务可以缩小两者之间的性能差距,并为更灵活的唇读法铺平了道路。

papers.title: LiDAR-in-the-Loop Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.authors: Félix Goudreault, Dominik Scheuble, Mario Bijelic, Nicolas Robidoux, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: LiDAR has become a cornerstone sensing modality for 3D vision. LiDAR systems emit pulses of light into the scene, take measurements of the returned signal, and rely on hardware digital signal processing (DSP) pipelines to construct 3D point clouds from these measurements. The resulting point clouds output by these DSPs are input to downstream 3D vision models -- both, in the form of training datasets or as input at inference time. Existing LiDAR DSPs are composed of cascades of parameterized operations; modifying configuration parameters results in significant changes in the point clouds and consequently the output of downstream methods. Existing methods treat LiDAR systems as fixed black boxes and construct downstream task networks more robust with respect to measurement fluctuations. Departing from this approach, the proposed method directly optimizes LiDAR sensing and DSP parameters for downstream tasks. To investigate the optimization of LiDAR system parameters, we devise a realistic LiDAR simulation method that generates raw waveforms as input to a LiDAR DSP pipeline. We optimize LiDAR parameters for both 3D object detection IoU losses and depth error metrics by solving a nonlinear multi-objective optimization problem with a 0th-order stochastic algorithm. For automotive 3D object detection models, the proposed method outperforms manual expert tuning by 39.5% mean Average Precision (mAP).
papers.title_zh: LiDAR 光线超强参数优化
papers.abstract_zh: LiDAR系统向现场发出光脉冲,测量返回的信号,并依靠硬件数字信号处理管道,从这些测量中建造3D点云。 这些目的地服务站产生的点云输出是下游三维视觉模型的投入 -- -- 既以培训数据集的形式,又作为推论时间的投入。 现有的LiDAR DSP由参数化作业的级联组成;修改配置参数导致点云发生重大变化,从而导致下游方法的产出。 现有方法将LiDAR系统视为固定的黑盒,在测量波动方面建立更稳健的下游任务网络。除这一方法外,拟议方法直接优化LiDAR遥感参数和下游任务的DSP参数。 为了调查LIDAR系统参数的优化,我们设计了一种现实的LIDAR模拟方法,生成原始波形,作为LIDAR DSP管道的输入。 我们优化了三维天体探测IoU损失和深度误差度标的LiDAR参数,通过第0级随机算法解决非线性多目标优化问题。 就汽车3D物体探测模型而言,拟议方法比人工专家调试平均平均精密度(MAP)高出39.5%。

papers.title: Learning To Exploit the Sequence-Specific Prior Knowledge for Image Processing Pipelines Optimization
papers.authors: Haina Qin, Longfei Han, Weihua Xiong, Juan Wang, Wentao Ma, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
papers.abstract: The hardware image signal processing (ISP) pipeline is the intermediate layer between the imaging sensor and the downstream application, processing the sensor signal into an RGB image. The ISP is less programmable and consists of a series of processing modules. Each processing module handles a subtask and contains a set of tunable hyperparameters. A large number of hyperparameters form a complex mapping with the ISP output. The industry typically relies on manual and time-consuming hyperparameter tuning by image experts, biased towards human perception. Recently, several automatic ISP hyperparameter optimization methods using downstream evaluation metrics come into sight. However, existing methods for ISP tuning treat the high-dimensional parameter space as a global space for optimization and prediction all at once without inducing the structure knowledge of ISP. To this end, we propose a sequential ISP hyperparameter prediction framework that utilizes the sequential relationship within ISP modules and the similarity among parameters to guide the model sequence process. We validate the proposed method on object detection, image segmentation, and image quality tasks.
papers.title_zh: 学习如何利用用于图像处理管道优化的特定序列前知识
papers.abstract_zh: 硬件图像信号处理(ISP)管道是成像传感器和下游应用之间的中间层,将传感器信号处理成RGB图像。 每个处理模块处理一个子任务,并包含一套金枪鱼可捕量的超参数,大量超参数形成与ISP输出的复杂映射,该行业通常依赖图像专家人工和费时的超参数调整,偏向于人的看法。 最近,出现了几种使用下游评价指标的ISP超参数优化自动方法,然而,现有的ISP调制方法将高维参数空间视为全球优化和预测空间,同时不引领ISP的结构知识。 为此,我们提出一个相继的ISP超参数预测框架,利用ISP模块内的相继关系和参数的相似性来指导模型序列过程。 我们验证了关于物体探测、图像分割和图像质量任务的拟议方法。

papers.title: Learning To Detect and Segment for Open Vocabulary Object Detection
papers.authors: Tao Wang
papers.abstract: Open vocabulary object detection has been greately advanced by the recent development of vision-language pre-trained model, which helps recognizing the novel objects with only semantic categories. The prior works mainly focus on knowledge transferring to the object proposal classification and employ class-agnostic box and mask prediction. In this work, we propose CondHead, a principled dynamic network design to better generalize the box regression and mask segmentation for open vocabulary setting. The core idea is to conditionally parametrize the network heads on semantic embedding and thus the model is guided with class-specific knowledge to better detect novel categories. Specifically, CondHead is composed of two streams of network heads, the dynamically aggregated heads and dynamically generated heads. The former is instantiated with a set of static heads that are conditionally aggregated, these heads are optimized as experts and are expected to learn sophisticated prediction. The Latter is instantiated with dynamically generated parameters and encodes general class-specific information. With such conditional design, the detection model is bridged by the semantic embedding to offer strongly generalizable class-wise box and mask prediction. Our method brings significant improvement to the prior state-of-the-art open vocabulary object detection methods with very minor overhead, e.g., it surpasses a RegionClip model by 3.0 detection AP on novel categories, with only 1.1% more computation.
papers.title_zh: 学习用于探测和部分的开放词汇表对象探测
papers.abstract_zh: 最近开发的视力语言预培训模型极大地推动了对开放词汇对象的探测,这有助于识别只有语义分类的新型物体。 先前的作品主要侧重于向对象建议分类转移知识,并采用类不可知箱和掩码预测。 在这项工作中,我们提议CondHead,这是一个原则性动态网络设计,以更好地概括用于开放词汇设置的盒式回归和掩码分割。 核心理念是有条件地在语义嵌入上对网络头进行平衡,因此模型以特定类别知识为指导,以更好地检测新类别。 具体地说, Condhead由两个网络头、动态组合头和动态生成头组成,由两个网络头、动态组合头和动态生成头组成。 前者即时使用一组有条件地汇总的静态头,这些头部以专家身份优化,并有望学习复杂的预测。 尾部即时使用动态生成参数,并编码一般类别信息。 有了这种有条件的设计,检测模型就通过语义嵌入连接起来,提供非常通用的分类箱和掩码预测。 我们的方法大大改进了先前最先进的开放词汇对象探测方法,其管理管理费用非常小,例如,它比区域剪贴模型高出3.0个新类别探测AP,计算率仅增加1.1%。

papers.title: Learning From Multiple Experts: Self-paced Knowledge Distillation for Long-tailed Classification
papers.authors: Liuyu Xiang, Guiguang Ding, Jungong Han
papers.abstract: In real-world scenarios, data tends to exhibit a long-tailed distribution, which increases the difficulty of training deep networks. In this paper, we propose a novel self-paced knowledge distillation framework, termed Learning From Multiple Experts (LFME). Our method is inspired by the observation that networks trained on less imbalanced subsets of the distribution often yield better performances than their jointly-trained counterparts. We refer to these models as `Experts’, and the proposed LFME framework aggregates the knowledge from multiple `Experts' to learn a unified student model. Specifically, the proposed framework involves two levels of adaptive learning schedules: Self-paced Expert Selection and Curriculum Instance Selection, so that the knowledge is adaptively transferred to the `Student'. We conduct extensive experiments and demonstrate that our method is able to achieve superior performances compared to state-of-the-art methods. We also show that our method can be easily plugged into state-of-the-art long-tailed classification algorithms for further improvements."
papers.title_zh: 向多专家学习:长期分类自定进度知识蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 在现实世界的情景下,数据往往会出现长期的分布,这增加了深层次网络培训的难度。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个新型的自定进度知识蒸馏框架,称为“从多专家学习 ” ( LFME ) 。 我们的方法受到以下看法的启发:在分配中较不不平衡的子集方面受过训练的网络往往比经过联合训练的网络的同行取得更好的业绩。 我们将这些模型称为 " 专家 " ,拟议的LFME框架汇集了来自多个 " 专家 " 的知识,以学习统一的学生模式。 具体而言,拟议框架涉及两个层次的适应性学习时间表:自定进度的专家甄选和课程选案,以便将知识适应性地转让给“学生”。 我们进行了广泛的实验,并证明我们的方法能够比最先进的方法取得优异的成绩。我们还表明,我们的方法可以很容易地连接到最先进的长尾分类算法中,以便进一步改进。”

papers.title: Learning Foresightful Dense Visual Affordance for Deformable Object Manipulation
papers.authors: Ruihai Wu, Chuanruo Ning, Hao Dong
papers.abstract: Understanding and manipulating deformable objects (e.g., ropes and fabrics) is an essential yet challenging task with broad applications. Difficulties come from complex states and dynamics, diverse configurations and high-dimensional action space of deformable objects. Besides, the manipulation tasks usually require multiple steps to accomplish, and greedy policies may easily lead to local optimal states. Existing studies usually tackle this problem using reinforcement learning or imitating expert demonstrations, with limitations in modeling complex states or requiring hand-crafted expert policies. In this paper, we study deformable object manipulation using dense visual affordance, with generalization towards diverse states, and propose a novel kind of foresightful dense affordance, which avoids local optima by estimating states' values for long-term manipulation. We propose a framework for learning this representation, with novel designs such as multi-stage stable learning and efficient self-supervised data collection without experts. Experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed foresightful dense affordance.
papers.title_zh: 学习为变形物体操纵而明智的感官视觉能力
papers.abstract_zh: 理解和操纵变形物体(如绳索和织物)是一项具有广泛应用性但具有挑战性的重要任务,困难来自复杂的状态和动态、不同的配置和变形物体的高度行动空间。 此外,操纵任务通常需要采取多重步骤才能完成,贪婪的政策很容易导致地方最佳国家。 现有研究通常利用强化学习或模仿专家示范来解决这一问题,在建模复杂国家或需要手工设计专家政策方面受到限制。 在本文中,我们研究使用密度高的视觉能力进行变形物体操纵,向不同的州推广,并提出一种新颖的远见强的密集能力,通过估计国家的长期操纵价值来避免当地选择,从而避免当地选择。 我们提议了一个学习这种代表性的框架,它有新的设计,例如多阶段稳定的学习和没有专家的高效的自我监督的数据收集。 实验显示了我们所拟议的远见密集的智慧的优势。

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Style Kernels for Artistic Style Transfer
papers.authors: Wenju Xu, Chengjiang Long, Yongwei Nie
papers.abstract: Arbitrary style transfer has been demonstrated to be efficient in artistic image generation. Previous methods either globally modulate the content feature ignoring local details, or overly focus on the local structure details leading to style leakage. In contrast to the literature, we propose a new scheme "style kernel" that learns spatially adaptive kernel for per-pixel stylization, where the convolutional kernels are dynamically generated from the global style-content aligned feature and then the learned kernels are applied to modulate the content feature at each spatial position. This new scheme allows flexible both global and local interactions between the content and style features such that the wanted styles can be easily transferred to the content image while at the same time the content structure can be easily preserved. To further enhance the flexibility of our style transfer method, we propose a Style Alignment Encoding (SAE) module complemented with a Content-based Gating Modulation (CGM) module for learning the dynamic style kernels in focusing regions. Extensive experiments strongly demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits superior performance in terms of visual quality and efficiency.
papers.title_zh: 艺术风格转让学习动态样式核心
papers.abstract_zh: 任意风格的转移在艺术形象生成方面已证明是有效的。 以往的方法要么是全球调整内容内容,忽略当地细节,要么过于关注导致风格渗漏的本地结构细节。 与文献不同,我们提议一个新的“风格内核”方案,用于学习空间适应性内核,以用于每像素银化,在这个方案下,进化内核是由全球风格-内容对齐功能动态生成的,然后将学习的内核用于调整每个空间位置的内容特性。 这一新方案使得内容和风格特征之间能够灵活地进行全球和地方互动,从而可以很容易地将想要的风格传输到内容图像中,同时可以很容易地保存内容结构。 为了进一步加强我们风格转换方法的灵活性,我们提议采用一个“样式统一编码”模块,辅之以一个基于内容的“基调”模块,用于学习重点地区的动态样式内核。 广泛的实验有力地表明,我们提出的方法优于最新技术,在视觉质量和效率方面表现优异。

papers.title: Learning Bottleneck Concepts in Image Classification
papers.authors: Bowen Wang, Liangzhi Li, Yuta Nakashima, Hajime Nagahara
papers.abstract: Interpreting and explaining the behavior of deep neural networks is critical for many tasks. Explainable AI provides a way to address this challenge, mostly by providing per-pixel relevance to the decision. Yet, interpreting such explanations may require expert knowledge. Some recent attempts toward interpretability adopt a concept-based framework, giving a higher-level relationship between some concepts and model decisions. This paper proposes Bottleneck Concept Learner (BotCL), which represents an image solely by the presence/absence of concepts learned through training over the target task without explicit supervision over the concepts. It uses self-supervision and tailored regularizers so that learned concepts can be human-understandable. Using some image classification tasks as our testbed, we demonstrate BotCL's potential to rebuild neural networks for better interpretability.
papers.title_zh: 图像分类中的学习瓶颈概念
papers.abstract_zh: 解释和解释深层神经网络的行为对于许多任务来说至关重要。 解释和解释深刻的神经网络的行为为应对这一挑战提供了一条途径,主要是通过提供与决定息息相关的东西。 然而,解释这种解释可能需要专家知识。 最近一些争取可解释性的尝试采用了基于概念的框架,使一些概念和示范决定之间具有更高层次的关系。 本文提议采用 " 瓶颈概念学习者 " (Botleck National Learker)(Botleck National Learker)(Botleck National Learker)(BotCL)(BotCL),它代表着一种形象,仅仅因为存在/缺乏通过在没有明确监督概念的情况下对目标任务进行培训而学到的概念。 它使用自我监控和定制的规范化器,这样学习的概念就能够被人类所理解。 我们用一些图像分类任务作为测试台,我们展示了BotCL重建神经网络以获得更好的解释的潜力。

papers.title: Knowing Where to Focus: Event-aware Transformer for Video Grounding
papers.authors: Jinhyun Jang, Jungin Park, Jin Kim, Hyeongjun Kwon, Kwanghoon Sohn
papers.abstract: Recent DETR-based video grounding models have made the model directly predict moment timestamps without any hand-crafted components, such as a pre-defined proposal or non-maximum suppression, by learning moment queries. However, their input-agnostic moment queries inevitably overlook an intrinsic temporal structure of a video, providing limited positional information. In this paper, we formulate an event-aware dynamic moment query to enable the model to take the input-specific content and positional information of the video into account. To this end, we present two levels of reasoning: 1) Event reasoning that captures distinctive event units constituting a given video using a slot attention mechanism; and 2) moment reasoning that fuses the moment queries with a given sentence through a gated fusion transformer layer and learns interactions between the moment queries and video-sentence representations to predict moment timestamps. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the event-aware dynamic moment queries, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches on several video grounding benchmarks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jinhyunj/EaTR.
papers.title_zh: 了解何处聚焦:了解事件Transformer用于视频定位
papers.abstract_zh: 最近以DETR为基础的视频定位模型通过学习时间Query直接预测了时标,而没有手工制作的任何部件,如预先确定的建议或非最大抑制。 然而,他们的输入-不可知时刻Query不可避免地忽略了视频的内在时间结构,提供了有限的定位信息。 在本文中,我们提出一个事件意识动态时刻Query,使模型能够考虑到该视频的具体投入内容和位置信息。 为此,我们提出两个层次的推理:(1) 利用时分注意机制,记录构成特定视频的独特事件单位的事件推理;和(2) 瞬间推理,通过封闭的聚变变变压层,将当场询问与给定的句子连接起来,并学习瞬间Query与视频陈述之间的相互作用,以预测瞬间时间戳。 广泛的实验表明,对事件有觉悟的动态瞬间Query的有效性和效率,在若干视频定位基准上优于最先进的方法,该代码可在https://github.com/jinhyunj/EaTR上公开查阅。

papers.title: Ingredient-Oriented Multi-Degradation Learning for Image Restoration
papers.authors: Jinghao Zhang, Jie Huang, Mingde Yao, Zizheng Yang, Hu Yu, Man Zhou, Feng Zhao
papers.abstract: Learning to leverage the relationship among diverse image restoration tasks is quite beneficial for unraveling the intrinsic ingredients behind the degradation. Recent years have witnessed the flourish of various All-in-one methods, which handle multiple image degradations within a single model. In practice, however, few attempts have been made to excavate task correlations in that exploring the underlying fundamental ingredients of various image degradations, resulting in poor scalability as more tasks are involved. In this paper, we propose a novel perspective to delve into the degradation via an ingredients-oriented rather than previous task-oriented manner for scalable learning. Specifically, our method, named Ingredients-oriented Degradation Reformulation framework (IDR), consists of two stages, namely task-oriented knowledge collection and ingredients-oriented knowledge integration. In the first stage, we conduct ad hoc operations on different degradations according to the underlying physics principles, and establish the corresponding prior hubs for each type of degradation. While the second stage progressively reformulates the preceding task-oriented hubs into single ingredients-oriented hub via learnable Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and employs a dynamic routing mechanism for probabilistic unknown degradation removal. Extensive experiments on various image restoration tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our method. More importantly, our IDR exhibits the favorable generalization ability to unknown downstream tasks.
papers.title_zh: 面向整体的多退化学习,促进图像恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 学习如何利用不同图像恢复任务之间的关系对于解开退化背后的内在因素非常有益。 近年来,各种 " 一体行动 " 方法蓬勃发展,在单一模式下处理多种图像退化问题。 然而,在实践中,在探索各种图像退化的基本成份时,很少尝试挖掘任务的相关性,从而导致随着任务的增加而造成可缩放性差。 在本文中,我们提出了一种新的视角,即通过以成份为导向,而不是以往以任务为导向的方式,探讨可扩展学习的退化问题。 具体地说,我们称为 " 以宏观为导向的退化调整框架 " 的方法包括两个阶段,即以任务为导向的知识收集和以要素为导向的知识整合。 在第一阶段,我们根据基本物理原则对不同的退化进行特别行动,并为每一种类型的退化建立相应的前置中心。 第二阶段通过可学习的主要构成部分分析(PCA),逐步将先前的任务导向中心重新改造为单一成份导向中心,并采用动态路线机制,以概率排除未知的退化。 有关各种图像恢复任务的广泛实验显示了我们方法的有效性和可扩展性。 更重要的是,我们的IDR展示了对未知下游任务有利的普及能力。

papers.title: Imitation Learning As State Matching via Differentiable Physics
papers.authors: Siwei Chen, Xiao Ma, Zhongwen Xu
papers.abstract: Existing imitation learning (IL) methods such as inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) usually have a double-loop training process, alternating between learning a reward function and a policy and tend to suffer long training time and high variance. In this work, we identify the benefits of differentiable physics simulators and propose a new IL method, i.e., Imitation Learning via Differentiable Physics (ILD), which gets rid of the double-loop design and achieves significant improvements in final performance, convergence speed, and stability. The proposed ILD incorporates the differentiable physics simulator as a physics prior into its computational graph for policy learning. It unrolls the dynamics by sampling actions from a parameterized policy, simply minimizing the distance between the expert trajectory and the agent trajectory, and back-propagating the gradient into the policy via temporal physics operators. With the physics prior, ILD policies can not only be transferable to unseen environment specifications but also yield higher final performance on a variety of tasks. In addition, ILD naturally forms a single-loop structure, which significantly improves the stability and training speed. To simplify the complex optimization landscape induced by temporal physics operations, ILD dynamically selects the learning objectives for each state during optimization. In our experiments, we show that ILD outperforms state-of-the-art methods in a variety of continuous control tasks with Brax, requiring only one expert demonstration. In addition, ILD can be applied to challenging deformable object manipulation tasks and can be generalized to unseen configurations.
papers.title_zh: 通过差异物理相匹配的州级模拟学习
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的模拟学习方法,如反向强化学习,通常具有双循环培训过程,在学习奖励职能和政策之间交替进行,而且往往要经历长时间的培训,而且差异很大。 在这项工作中,我们确定不同物理学模拟器的好处,并提出新的国际法方法,即通过不同物理进行模拟学习,摆脱双环设计,在最后性能、趋同速度和稳定性方面实现重大改进。 拟议的国际法司将不同物理学模拟器作为物理学纳入政策学习计算图之前。 它通过从参数化政策中取样行动来释放动态,只是将专家轨迹和物剂轨迹之间的距离缩小到最小,并通过时间物理学操作员对梯度进行反向宣传。 由于以前是物理学,国际法司的政策不仅可以转而采用看不见的环境规格,还可以在各种任务上产生更高的最后性能,此外,国际法司自然形成一个单环结构,大大提高了稳定性和培训速度。 为了简化时间物理学操作引起的复杂的优化景观,国际法司在优化期间动态选择每个州的学习目标。 在我们的实验中,我们证明在与布拉克斯公司进行的各种连续控制任务中,ILD的表现优于最先进的方法,只需要一次专家演示。 此外,ILD可以应用到挑战变形物体操纵任务中,并且可以推广到看不见的配置中。

papers.title: Hierarchical Visual Primitive Experts for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Hanjae Kim, Jiyoung Lee, Seongheon Park, Kwanghoon Sohn
papers.abstract: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize unseen compositions with prior knowledge of known primitives (attribute and object). Previous works for CZSL often suffer from grasping the contextuality between attribute and object, as well as the discriminability of visual features, and the long-tailed distribution of real-world compositional data. We propose a simple and scalable framework called Composition Transformer (CoT) to address these issues. CoT employs object and attribute experts in distinctive manners to generate representative embeddings, using the visual network hierarchically. The object expert extracts representative object embeddings from the final layer in a bottom-up manner, while the attribute expert makes attribute embeddings in a top-down manner with a proposed object-guided attention module that models contextuality explicitly. To remedy biased prediction caused by imbalanced data distribution, we develop a simple minority attribute augmentation (MAA) that synthesizes virtual samples by mixing two images and oversampling minority attribute classes. Our method achieves SoTA performance on several benchmarks, including MIT-States, C-GQA, and VAW-CZSL. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of CoT in improving visual discrimination and addressing the model bias from the imbalanced data distribution. The code is available at https://github.com/HanjaeKim98/CoT.
papers.title_zh: 零热组合学习的等级视觉原始专家
papers.abstract_zh: (CZSL)旨在识别先前对已知原始物(属性和对象)有知识的无形成分。 CZSL 先前的作品往往因掌握属性与对象之间的背景质量、视觉特征的可视性以及真实世界成份数据的长期快速分布而受到影响。 我们提议了一个简单、可扩展的框架,称为“组成变换器”(CoT),以解决这些问题。CoT以独特的方式使用对象和属性专家,利用视觉网络,按等级生成有代表性的嵌入。 对象专家以自下而上的方式从最后一层提取具有代表性的物体嵌入,而属性专家则以自上而下的方式进行属性嵌入,并采用一个拟议的目标引导关注模块,明确模拟背景质量。 为了纠正数据分布不平衡造成的有偏见的预测,我们开发了一个简单的少数民族属性增强(MAA),通过混合两种图像和过度抽样调查少数民族属性类别,合成虚拟样本。 我们的方法在几个基准(包括麻省理工学院国家、C-GQA和VAW-CZSL)上实现了SoTA的业绩,我们还展示了COT在改善视觉歧视和解决数据分布不平衡造成的模式偏差方面的效力,该代码可在https://github.com/HanjaeKim98/CoT上查阅。

papers.title: Hierarchical Separable Video Transformer for Snapshot Compressive Imaging
papers.authors: Ping Wang · Yulun Zhang · Lishun Wang · Xin Yuan
papers.abstract: Recently, deep learning models have achieved impressive success on solving the inverse problem of Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI) for video, ie, reconstructing multiple high-fidelity frames from a single-shot observation. However, existing works lack an insight into the mixed degradation of spatial masking and temporal aliasing, and empirically follow the designs of successful plain video restoration ( eg, denoising, deblurring) models, limiting the overall performance. In this work, we tailor a network architecture and a Hierarchical Separable Video Transformer (HiSViT) as building block, composed of Cross-Scale Separable Multi-head Self-Attention (CSS-MSA) and Gated Self-Modulated Feed-Forward Network (GSM-FFN). CSS-MSA decomposes spatio-temporal similarity calculations into spatial and temporal dimensions but attends to all spatio-temporal tokens at a controllable scale within a single attention layer. GSM-FFN is design to bring locality to CSS-MSA via gated mechanism and space-time separable convolutions. HiSViT is built by multiple groups of CSS-MSA plus GSM-FFN, each of which focuses on different scales, enabling multi-scale interaction and long-range modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves the state-of-the-art performance.
papers.title_zh: 用于抓图压缩成像的分解视频变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,深层学习模式在解决截图压缩成像(SCI)的反面问题方面取得了令人印象深刻的成功。 然而,现有工作缺乏对空间遮蔽和时间化假名混合降解的洞察力,并缺乏经验地遵循成功的平面视频恢复模型(例如,去除、去除、去除)的设计,从而限制了总体性能。 在这项工作中,我们设计了一个网络架构和一个等级分立的视频变形器(HisViT)作为构件,由跨比例分立的多头人自我意识(CSS-MSA)和Gated自变型进餐前进网络(GSM-FFN)组成。 CSS-MSA将时空相近性计算分解成时空空间和时空,但在单一关注层以可控制的规模处理所有时空口号。 GSM-FFN设计通过门形机制和空间时间可分离的演变,将地点移到中央SS-MSA。 HISVYT是由CSS-MSA+GSM-FFN的多个组群组成的,每个组群侧重于不同的尺度,能够进行多尺度的互动和远程建模。 广泛的实验表明,我们的模型取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Gram-based Attentive Neural Ordinary Differential Equations Network for Video Nystagmography Classification
papers.authors: Xihe Qiu, Shaojie Shi, Xiaoyu Tan, Chao Qu, Zhijun Fang, Hailing Wang, Yongbin Gao, Peixia Wu, Huawei Li
papers.abstract: Video nystagmography (VNG) is the diagnostic gold standard of benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV), which requires medical professionals to examine the direction, frequency, intensity, duration, and variation in the strength of nystagmus on a VNG video. This is a tedious process heavily influenced by the doctor's experience, which is error-prone. Recent automatic VNG classification methods approach this problem from the perspective of video analysis without considering medical prior knowledge, resulting in unsatisfactory accuracy and limited diagnostic capability for nystagmographic types, thereby preventing their clinical application. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end data-driven novel BPPV diagnosis framework (TC-BPPV) by considering this problem as an eye trajectory classification problem due to the disease's symptoms and experts' prior knowledge. In this framework, we utilize an eye movement tracking system to capture the eye trajectory and propose the Gram-based attentive neural ordinary differential equations network (Gram-AODE) to perform classification. We validate our framework using the VNG dataset provided by the collaborative university hospital and achieve state-of-the-art performance. We also evaluate Gram-AODE on multiple open-source benchmarks to demonstrate its effectiveness in trajectory classification. Code is available at https://github.com/XiheQiu/Gram-AODE.
papers.title_zh: 视频Ny Stymagraphic 分类普通差异平等网络
papers.abstract_zh: 视网膜镜像(VNG)是良性低氧表面姿势脊椎动物(BPPV)的诊断金标准,它要求医疗专业人员在VNG视频上检查鼻梁的动向、频率、强度、持续时间和强度的变化。 这是一个受医生经验严重影响的乏味过程,容易出错。 近期的VNG自动分类方法从视频分析的角度处理这一问题,而没有考虑医疗前知识,导致对鼻腔类的准确性不令人满意,诊断能力有限,从而阻碍了临床应用。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个端对端数据驱动的新BPPV诊断框架(TC-BPPV),将这一问题视为由于该疾病症状和专家先前的知识而导致的眼线分类问题。 在此框架内,我们利用眼睛运动跟踪系统捕捉眼睛轨迹,并提议采用基于Gram的注意神经正常差异方程式网络(Gram-AODE)进行分类。 我们利用合作大学医院提供的VNG数据集验证我们的框架,并取得SOTA 性能,我们还评估了Gram-AODE的多种开放源基准,以表明其在轨迹分类方面的有效性。 法规可在https://github.com/XiheQiu/Gram-AODE查阅。

papers.title: Global Balanced Experts for Federated Long-Tailed Learning
papers.authors: Yaopei Zeng, Lei Liu, Li Liu, Li Shen, Shaoguo Liu, Baoyuan Wu
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a prevalent distributed machine learning approach that enables collaborative training of a global model across multiple devices without sharing local data. However, the presence of long-tailed data can negatively deteriorate the model's performance in real-world FL applications. Moreover, existing re-balance strategies are less effective for the federated long-tailed issue when directly utilizing local label distribution as the class prior at the clients' side. To this end, we propose a novel Global Balanced Multi-Expert (GBME) framework to optimize a balanced global objective, which does not require additional information beyond the standard FL pipeline. In particular, a proxy is derived from the accumulated gradients uploaded by the clients after local training, and is shared by all clients as the class prior for re-balance training. Such a proxy can also guide the client grouping to train a multi-expert model, where the knowledge from different clients can be aggregated via the ensemble of different experts corresponding to different client groups. To further strengthen the privacy-preserving ability, we present a GBME-p algorithm with a theoretical guarantee to prevent privacy leakage from the proxy. Extensive experiments on long-tailed decentralized datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GBME and GBME-p, both of which show superior performance to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 联邦长期学习全球平衡专家
papers.abstract_zh: 联邦学习(FL)是一种普遍的分布式机器学习方法,它使得能够通过多种设备合作培训全球模式,而无需分享当地数据,然而,长期数据的存在会不利地恶化该模式在现实世界FL应用中的性能。 此外,当直接使用当地标签分配作为客户方面之前的等级时,现有的再平衡战略对联邦长期处理的问题效果较差。 为此,我们提议建立一个新的全球平衡多专家框架,以优化平衡的全球目标,该全球目标不需要超出标准FL管道范围的额外信息。 特别是,代理由客户在当地培训后上传的累积梯度产生,所有客户作为重新平衡培训的先期班共享。 这种代理也可以指导客户群体培训多专家模式,通过不同客户群体不同专家的组合,将不同客户的知识汇集在一起。 为了进一步加强隐私保护能力,我们提出了一个GBME-p算法,其中提供理论保障,防止代理人泄露隐私。 关于长期分散化数据集的广泛实验表明GBME和GBME-p的功效,两者都显示优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: GLIGEN: Open-Set Grounded Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Yuheng Li, Haotian Liu, Qingyang Wu, Fangzhou Mu, Jianwei Yang, Jianfeng Gao, Chunyuan Li, Yong Jae Lee
papers.abstract: Large-scale text-to-image diffusion models have made amazing advances. However, the status quo is to use text input alone, which can impede controllability. In this work, we propose GLIGEN: Open-Set Grounded Text-to-Image Generation, a novel approach that builds upon and extends the functionality of existing pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models by enabling them to also be conditioned on grounding inputs. To preserve the vast concept knowledge of the pre-trained model, we freeze all of its weights and inject the grounding information into new trainable layers via a gated mechanism. Our model achieves open-world grounded text2img generation with caption and bounding box condition inputs, and the grounding ability generalizes well to novel spatial configurations and concepts. GLIGEN's zero-shot performance on COCO and LVIS outperforms existing supervised layout-to-image baselines by a large margin.
papers.title_zh: GLIGEN: 开放的、有固定基础的文本到图像生成
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模文本到图像传播模型取得了惊人的进步,但现状是只使用文本输入,这可能会妨碍可控性。 在这项工作中,我们提议GLIGEN:开放基础的文本到图像生成,这是一种新颖的做法,它以现有的经培训的文本到图像传播模型为基础,并扩展了这些模型的功能,使这些模型也能够以基础投入为条件。 为了保存关于预先培训模式的广泛概念知识,我们冻结其所有重量,并通过封闭机制将地面信息注入新的可训练层。 我们的模型实现了以字幕和捆绑框条件输入的开放世界的基于基础的文本生成2img , 基底能力对新的空间配置和概念非常概括。 GLIGEN在COCO和LVIS上的零弹性能比现有的受监督的布局到图像基线高出很大距离。

papers.title: Generalist: Decoupling Natural and Robust Generalization
papers.authors: Hongjun Wang, Yisen Wang
papers.abstract: Deep neural networks obtained by standard training have been constantly plagued by adversarial examples. Although adversarial training demonstrates its capability to defend against adversarial examples, unfortunately, it leads to an inevitable drop in the natural generalization. To address the issue, we decouple the natural generalization and the robust generalization from joint training and formulate different training strategies for each one. Specifically, instead of minimizing a global loss on the expectation over these two generalization errors, we propose a bi-expert framework called Generalist where we simultaneously train base learners with task-aware strategies so that they can specialize in their own fields. The parameters of base learners are collected and combined to form a global learner at intervals during the training process. The global learner is then distributed to the base learners as initialized parameters for continued training. Theoretically, we prove that the risks of Generalist will get lower once the base learners are well trained. Extensive experiments verify the applicability of Generalist to achieve high accuracy on natural examples while maintaining considerable robustness to adversarial ones. Code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ML/Generalist.
papers.title_zh: 通则:自然和强力解耦
papers.abstract_zh: 通过标准培训获得的深神经网络不断受到对抗性实例的困扰,尽管对抗性培训表明它有能力抵御对抗性实例,但不幸的是,它导致自然的概括性不可避免地下降。 为了解决这一问题,我们将自然的概括和有力的概括与联合培训解耦,并为每个培训制定不同的培训战略。 具体地说,我们建议一个称为通才的双专家框架,同时对基础学习者进行有任务意识战略的培训,以便他们能够专门从事自己的领域,而不是尽可能减少对这两个一般化错误的预期造成的全球损失。 在培训过程中,收集基础学习者的参数并将其合并,每隔一段时间形成全球学习者,然后将全球学习者作为继续培训的初始参数分发给基础学习者。 从理论上讲,我们证明,一旦基础学习者受过良好培训,通才的风险就会降低。 广泛的实验可以验证通才是否适合在自然例子方面实现高度准确性,同时对对抗性例子保持相当强健。 守则可在https://github.com/PKU-ML/Genist查阅。

papers.title: Gated Stereo: Joint Depth Estimation From Gated and Wide-Baseline Active Stereo Cues
papers.authors: Stefanie Walz, Mario Bijelic, Andrea Ramazzina, Amanpreet Walia, Fahim Mannan, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: We propose Gated Stereo, a high-resolution and long-range depth estimation technique that operates on active gated stereo images. Using active and high dynamic range passive captures, Gated Stereo exploits multi-view cues alongside time-of-flight intensity cues from active gating. To this end, we propose a depth estimation method with a monocular and stereo depth prediction branch which are combined in a final fusion stage. Each block is supervised through a combination of supervised and gated self-supervision losses. To facilitate training and validation, we acquire a long-range synchronized gated stereo dataset for automotive scenarios. We find that the method achieves an improvement of more than 50 % MAE compared to the next best RGB stereo method, and 74 % MAE to existing monocular gated methods for distances up to 160 m. Our code, models and datasets are available here: https://light.princeton.edu/gatedstereo/.
papers.title_zh: Gated 立体立体:根据Gated和广基活性立体立体立体对Gated和广基活性立体立体进行的共同深度估计
papers.abstract_zh: 我们建议采用高分辨率和长程深度估计技术Gated Steeo,该技术使用活跃的闭门立体图像。 Gated Steeo使用主动和高动态范围被动捕捉器,在飞行时间强度提示的同时,利用主动悬浮的多视角提示。 为此,我们提出一个深度估算方法,配有一个单眼和立体深度预测分支,在最后的核聚变阶段加以合并,每个区块都通过监督的和封闭的自我监督损失相结合进行监督。 为了便利培训和验证,我们获得了一套汽车假想情况的长距离同步闭门立体数据集。 我们发现该方法比次最佳RGB立体法改进了50%以上的MAE, 现有单眼闭门法改进了74%的MAE,距离可达160米。 我们的代码、模型和数据集可在此查阅:https://light.prienceton.edu/gaatestereo/。

papers.title: Gated Multi-Resolution Transfer Network for Burst Restoration and Enhancement
papers.authors: Nancy Mehta, Akshay Dudhane, Subrahmanyam Murala, Syed Waqas Zamir, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
papers.abstract: Burst image processing is becoming increasingly popular in recent years. However, it is a challenging task since individual burst images undergo multiple degradations and often have mutual misalignments resulting in ghosting and zipper artifacts. Existing burst restoration methods usually do not consider the mutual correlation and non-local contextual information among burst frames, which tends to limit these approaches in challenging cases. Another key challenge lies in the robust up-sampling of burst frames. The existing up-sampling methods cannot effectively utilize the advantages of single-stage and progressive up-sampling strategies with conventional and/or recent up-samplers at the same time. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Gated Multi-Resolution Transfer Network (GMTNet) to reconstruct a spatially precise high-quality image from a burst of low-quality raw images. GMTNet consists of three modules optimized for burst processing tasks: Multi-scale Burst Feature Alignment (MBFA) for feature denoising and alignment, Transposed-Attention Feature Merging (TAFM) for multi-frame feature aggregation, and Resolution Transfer Feature Up-sampler (RTFU) to up-scale merged features and construct a high-quality output image. Detailed experimental analysis on five datasets validate our approach and sets a new state-of-the-art for burst super-resolution, burst denoising, and low-light burst enhancement. Our codes and models are available at https://github.com/nanmehta/GMTNet.
papers.title_zh: Gated 恢复和加强沉重恢复和加强多分辨率传输网络
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,污泥图像处理越来越受欢迎,然而,这是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为个人爆裂图像经历了多重退化,而且经常发生相互错配,导致幽灵和拉链手工艺品。 现有防爆恢复方法通常不考虑防爆框架之间相互关系和非当地背景信息,因为防爆框架往往在具有挑战性的情况下限制这些方法,另一个关键挑战在于强力地标出防爆框架。 现有的上标方法无法同时有效地利用单一阶段和渐进式上标战略与传统和(或)最近的上标战略的优势。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立一个新型的GMT多分辨率传输网络(GMTNet),从一连串低质量原始图像中重建空间精确的高质量图像。 GMTNet由三个为爆破处理任务优化的模块组成:用于特征拆卸和对齐的多尺度布局特征调整模块、用于多框架特征聚合的转储-惯性特征合并模块和用于升级合并功能和构建高质量输出图像的分辨率传输特性更新模块(RTFU)。 对五个数据集的详细实验分析证实了我们的方法,并为爆破超级分辨率、爆破破破分解和低光爆破强化设定了新的最新技术,我们的代码和模型可在https://github.com/nanmehta/GMTNet上查阅。

papers.title: FuseCap: Leveraging Large Language Models for Enriched Fused Image Captions
papers.authors: Noam Rotstein, David Bensaid, Shaked Brody, Roy Ganz, Ron Kimmel
papers.abstract: The advent of vision-language pre-training techniques enhanced substantial progress in the development of models for image captioning. However, these models frequently produce generic captions and may omit semantically important image details. This limitation can be traced back to the image-text datasets; while their captions typically offer a general description of image content, they frequently omit salient details. Considering the magnitude of these datasets, manual reannotation is impractical, emphasizing the need for an automated approach. To address this challenge, we leverage existing captions and explore augmenting them with visual details using "frozen" vision experts including an object detector, an attribute recognizer, and an Optical Character Recognizer (OCR). Our proposed method, FuseCap, fuses the outputs of such vision experts with the original captions using a large language model (LLM), yielding comprehensive image descriptions. We automatically curate a training set of 12M image-enriched caption pairs. These pairs undergo extensive evaluation through both quantitative and qualitative analyses. Subsequently, this data is utilized to train a captioning generation BLIP-based model. This model outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches, producing more precise and detailed descriptions, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed data-centric approach. We release this large-scale dataset of enriched image-caption pairs for the community.
papers.title_zh: FuseCap:利用大型语言模型进行浓缩引信图像说明
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言培训前技术的出现,加强了在制作图像字幕模型方面取得的重大进展,但是,这些模型往往产生通用字幕,可能省略了具有语义重要性的图像细节。 这一限制可以追溯到图像文本数据集;虽然其标题通常提供图像内容的一般描述,但往往忽略了突出的细节。 考虑到这些数据集的规模,人工重新注解是不切实际的,这突出表明了采用自动化方法的必要性。 为了应对这一挑战,我们利用现有的字幕,利用“冻结的”视觉专家,包括物体探测器、属性识别器和光学字符识别器(OCR),探索用视觉细节来补充这些字幕。 我们提出的方法 — — FuseCap — — 用大型语言模型(LLM ) — — 将这些视觉专家的产出与原始字幕结合起来,产生全面的图像描述。 我们自动设计了一套由12M图像丰富字幕配对组成的培训组合。 这些对夫妇通过定量和定性分析进行广泛评价,然后利用这些数据培训以BLIP为基础的字幕生成模式。 这个模型比目前最先进的方法表现得更好,产生更准确和详细的描述,展示了拟议的以数据为中心的方法的有效性。 我们为社区发行了这个大型的关于丰富图像插图配对的数据集。

papers.title: Full or Weak Annotations? An Adaptive Strategy for Budget-Constrained Annotation Campaigns
papers.authors: Javier Gamazo Tejero, Martin S. Zinkernagel, Sebastian Wolf, Raphael Sznitman, Pablo Márquez-Neila
papers.abstract: Annotating new datasets for machine learning tasks is tedious, time-consuming, and costly. For segmentation applications, the burden is particularly high as manual delineations of relevant image content are often extremely expensive or can only be done by experts with domain-specific knowledge. Thanks to developments in transfer learning and training with weak supervision, segmentation models can now also greatly benefit from annotations of different kinds. However, for any new domain application looking to use weak supervision, the dataset builder still needs to define a strategy to distribute full segmentation and other weak annotations. Doing so is challenging, however, as it is a priori unknown how to distribute an annotation budget for a given new dataset. To this end, we propose a novel approach to determine annotation strategies for segmentation datasets, whereby estimating what proportion of segmentation and classification annotations should be collected given a fixed budget. To do so, our method sequentially determines proportions of segmentation and classification annotations to collect for budget-fractions by modeling the expected improvement of the final segmentation model. We show in our experiments that our approach yields annotations that perform very close to the optimal for a number of different annotation budgets and datasets.
papers.title_zh: 完整说明还是弱说明? 受预算限制的批注运动的适应战略
papers.abstract_zh: 指出机器学习任务的新数据集既乏味又费时又费钱。 对于分割应用,负担特别沉重,因为人工划定相关图像内容往往非常昂贵,或者只能由拥有特定领域知识的专家完成。 由于转移学习和培训方面的发展以及监督不力,分化模式现在也可以大大受益于不同种类的说明。 然而,对于任何试图使用薄弱监督手段的新域应用程序,数据集构建器仍需要确定一项战略,以分发完全分解和其他薄弱的注释。 然而,这样做具有挑战性,因为事先不知道如何为特定的新数据集分配注解预算。 为此,我们提议采取新办法,确定分解数据集的说明战略,根据固定预算估算分解和分类说明中应收集的比例。 为此,我们采用的方法通过模拟最终分割模式的预期改进,按顺序确定为预算违规收集的分区和分类说明的比例。 我们在实验中显示,我们的方法产生说明,非常接近于若干不同的说明预算和数据集的最佳效果。

papers.title: Flexi-FSCIL: Adaptive Knowledge Retention for Breaking the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
papers.authors: Wufei Xie · Yalin Wang · Chenliang Liu · Zhaohui Jiang · Xue Yang
papers.abstract: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) is challenged by limited data and expanding class spaces, leading to overfitting and catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods, which often freeze feature extractors and use Nearest Class Mean classifiers, sacrifice adaptability to new feature distributions. To address these issues, we propose Flexi-FSCIL, a semi-supervised framework that integrates three novel strategies: Adaptive Gated Residual Fusion (AGRF), Attention-Guided Dynamic Hybrid Distillation (ADHD), and Prototype Offset Equilibrium (POE). Flexi-FSCIL effectively balances stability and plasticity in FSCIL. AGRF resolves the rigidity of frozen feature extractors by integrating both frozen and trainable components, enabling adaptive feature learning while retaining old-class knowledge. ADHD tackles the imbalance between old and new tasks by dynamically aligning features using cross-attention maps and direct matching, preserving old-class knowledge while facilitating new-class learning. POE addresses the issue of prototype drift in semi-supervised settings by selecting high-quality unlabeled samples, maintaining feature space separability and preventing overfitting. Evaluated on three benchmark datasets, Flexi-FSCIL achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing FSCIL methods with only 12.97 performance drop on CUB200.
papers.title_zh: FLIF-FSCIL:在少温级入门学习中打破稳定-弹性困难的适应性知识保留
papers.abstract_zh: 数据有限,班级空间扩大,导致过度适应和灾难性的遗忘。 现有方法往往冻结特征提取器和使用近等中值分类,牺牲了对新特征分布的适应性。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用弹性-FSCIL(Flexi-FSCIL)这一半监督框架,将以下三种新颖战略结合起来:适应性Gated残余融合(AGRF)、引人注意的动态混合蒸馏(ADHD)和原型平衡平衡(POE),弹性-FSCIL(FFFSCIL)有效地平衡了FSCI的稳定性和可塑性。 AGERF通过整合冻结和可训练的部件,解决冷冻特征提取器的僵硬问题,使适应性特征学习成为可能,同时保留古老的知识。 DADHD解决新旧任务之间的不平衡问题,办法是动态地统一各种特征,使用相互注意的地图和直接匹配,保留旧知识,同时促进新班的学习。 POE通过选择高质量的无标签样本、保持特征空间分离性并防止过度装配,解决半监督环境中原型漂移的问题。 在对三个基准数据集进行评估后,Flexi-FSCIL取得了SOTA 性能,大大优于现有的FSCIL方法,CUB200的绩效仅下降12.97。

papers.title: FineDance: A Fine-grained Choreography Dataset for 3D Full Body Dance Generation
papers.authors: Ronghui Li, Junfan Zhao, Yachao Zhang, Mingyang Su, Zeping Ren, Han Zhang, Yansong Tang, Xiu Li
papers.abstract: Generating full-body and multi-genre dance sequences from given music is a challenging task, due to the limitations of existing datasets and the inherent complexity of the fine-grained hand motion and dance genres. To address these problems, we propose FineDance, which contains 14.6 hours of music-dance paired data, with fine-grained hand motions, fine-grained genres (22 dance genres), and accurate posture. To the best of our knowledge, FineDance is the largest music-dance paired dataset with the most dance genres. Additionally, to address monotonous and unnatural hand movements existing in previous methods, we propose a full-body dance generation network, which utilizes the diverse generation capabilities of the diffusion model to solve monotonous problems, and use expert nets to solve unreal problems. To further enhance the genrematching and long-term stability of generated dances, we propose a Genre&Coherent aware Retrieval Module. Besides, we propose a new metric named Genre Matching Score to measure the genre matching between dance and music. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the quality of FineDance, and the state-of-the-art performance of FineNet.
papers.title_zh: FineDance: 3D 全体舞蹈制作的精美舞蹈数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 从特定音乐中产生全体和多族舞蹈序列是一项艰巨的任务,因为现有数据集有限,精细的手动和舞蹈风格具有内在的复杂性。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议“FineDance ” ( FineDance ) , 它包含14.6小时的音乐舞蹈配对数据,配有精细的手动、精细的基因(22个舞蹈流派 ) 和准确的姿势。 据我们所知,“FineDance ” 是最大的音乐舞蹈配对数据集,配有最多舞蹈流派。 此外,为解决以往方法中存在的单体和非自然手动问题,我们提议建立一个全体舞蹈生成网络,利用扩散模型的多种生成能力解决单体问题,并利用专家网解决非现实问题。 为了进一步加强舞蹈的流派和长期稳定性,我们提议了一个常识和和谐意识回收模块。 此外,我们提议了一个名为“珍尔匹配得分”的新指标,以测量舞蹈和音乐的流派匹配率。 我们建议用“珍尔匹配得分 ” ( Genre 匹配得分 ) , 以测量舞蹈和音乐的流派匹配率。 定量和定性实验显示了罚款的质量以及罚款网的最新表现。

papers.title: FACET: Fairness in Computer Vision Evaluation Benchmark
papers.authors: Laura Gustafson, Chloe Rolland, Nikhila Ravi, Quentin Duval, Aaron Adcock, Cheng-Yang Fu, Melissa Hall, Candace Ross
papers.abstract: Computer vision models have known performance disparities across attributes such as gender and skin tone. This means during tasks such as classification and detection, model performance differs for certain classes based on the demographics of the people in the image. These disparities have been shown to exist, but until now there has not been a unified approach to measure these differences for common use-cases of computer vision models. We present a new benchmark named FACET (FAirness in Computer Vision EvaluaTion), a large, publicly available evaluation set of 32k images for some of the most common vision tasks - image classification, object detection and segmentation. For every image in FACET, we hired expert reviewers to manually annotate person-related attributes such as perceived skin tone and hair type, manually draw bounding boxes and label fine-grained person-related classes such as disk jockey or guitarist. In addition, we use FACET to benchmark state-of-the-art vision models and present a deeper understanding of potential performance disparities and challenges across sensitive demographic attributes. With the exhaustive annotations collected, we probe models using single demographics attributes as well as multiple attributes using an intersectional approach (e.g. hair color and perceived skin tone). Our results show that classification, detection, segmentation, and visual grounding models exhibit performance disparities across demographic attributes and intersections of attributes. These harms suggest that not all people represented in datasets receive fair and equitable treatment in these vision tasks. We hope current and future results using our benchmark will contribute to fairer, more robust vision models. FACET is available publicly at https://facet.metademolab.com
papers.title_zh: FACET: 计算机远景评估基准的公平性
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机视觉模型在性别和肤色等属性之间存在已知的性能差异,这意味着在诸如分类和检测等任务期间,根据图像中的人的人口统计,某些类别的模型性能不同。 这些差异已经证明存在,但到目前为止,还没有统一的方法来衡量计算机视觉模型共同使用情况的这些差异。 我们提出了一个新的基准,名为FACET(计算机视觉天文卫星的危险性),这是一套由32k图像组成的大型公开评价,用于一些最常见的视觉任务 -- -- 图像分类、物体探测和分割。 对于FACET中的每张图像,我们雇用专家审查员手动说明与人有关的属性,例如人们所认为的肤色和发型,手动绘制捆绑盒,并贴上磁盘骑手或吉他手等精细的与人有关的分类标签。 此外,我们利用FACET为最先进的远景模型基准,更深入地了解敏感人口特征之间潜在的业绩差距和挑战。 我们收集了详尽无遗的说明,通过交叉方法(如毛发颜色和感知的肤色),用单一人口特征和多重属性来调查模型。 我们的结果表明,分类、检测、分解和视觉定位模型在人口特征和特征交叉方面表现出不同性能差异。 这些伤害表明,并非所有在数据集中任职的人在这些视觉任务中得到公正和公平的待遇。 我们希望使用我们基准的当前和未来成果将有助于建立更公平、更健全的视觉模型,FACET可在https://facet.metademolab.com上公开查阅。

papers.title: FaceCLIPNeRF: Text-driven 3D Face Manipulation using Deformable Neural Radiance Fields
papers.authors: Sungwon Hwang, Junha Hyung, Daejin Kim, Min-Jung Kim, Jaegul Choo
papers.abstract: As recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have enabled high-fidelity 3D face reconstruction and novel view synthesis, its manipulation also became an essential task in 3D vision. However, existing manipulation methods require extensive human labor, such as a user-provided semantic mask and manual attribute search unsuitable for non-expert users. Instead, our approach is designed to require a single text to manipulate a face reconstructed with NeRF. To do so, we first train a scene manipulator, a latent code-conditional deformable NeRF, over a dynamic scene to control a face deformation using the latent code. However, representing a scene deformation with a single latent code is unfavorable for compositing local deformations observed in different instances. As so, our proposed Position-conditional Anchor Compositor (PAC) learns to represent a manipulated scene with spatially varying latent codes. Their renderings with the scene manipulator are then optimized to yield high cosine similarity to a target text in CLIP embedding space for text-driven manipulation. To the best of our knowledge, our approach is the first to address the text-driven manipulation of a face reconstructed with NeRF. Extensive results, comparisons, and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.title_zh: FaceCLIPNERF: 使用变形神经辐射场进行文字驱动的 3D 脸部操纵
papers.abstract_zh: 由于神经辐射场(NERF)最近的进展使高度忠诚的3D能够面对重建和新颖的观点合成,操纵3D视觉也成为一项基本任务。 然而,现有的操纵方法需要大量的人力劳动,比如用户提供的语义遮罩和人工属性搜索,这些都不适合非专家用户。 相反,我们的方法是要求用单一文本来操纵用NeRF重建的面孔。 为了做到这一点,我们首先训练一个现场操纵器,一个潜伏的代码条件变形的NeRF,在一个动态的场景上,用潜伏代码控制面部变形。 然而,代表一个带有单一潜伏代码的场景变形,对于在不同情况下观察到的局部变形的合成来说是不可取的。 因此,我们提出的定位条件锚组合器(PAC)学会以空间上不同的潜在代码来代表一个被操纵的场景。 然后,它们与现场操纵器的图像得到优化,产生与CLIP中用于文本驱动操作的嵌入空间的目标文本高度相似的共弦性。 就我们所知,我们的方法是第一个解决文本驱动的对用NeRF重建的面孔的操纵。 广泛的结果、比较和通货膨胀研究表明了我们的方法的有效性。

papers.title: ERNIE-ViLG 2.0: Improving Text-to-Image Diffusion Model With Knowledge-Enhanced Mixture-of-Denoising-Experts
papers.authors: Zhida Feng, Zhenyu Zhang, Xintong Yu, Yewei Fang, Lanxin Li, Xuyi Chen, Yuxiang Lu, Jiaxiang Liu, Weichong Yin, Shikun Feng, Yu Sun, Li Chen, Hao Tian, Hua Wu, Haifeng Wang
papers.abstract: Recent progress in diffusion models has revolutionized the popular technology of text-to-image generation. While existing approaches could produce photorealistic high-resolution images with text conditions, there are still several open problems to be solved, which limits the further improvement of image fidelity and text relevancy. In this paper, we propose ERNIE-ViLG 2.0, a large-scale Chinese text-to-image diffusion model, to progressively upgrade the quality of generated images by: (1) incorporating fine-grained textual and visual knowledge of key elements in the scene, and (2) utilizing different denoising experts at different denoising stages. With the proposed mechanisms, ERNIE-ViLG 2.0 not only achieves a new state-of-the-art on MS-COCO with zero-shot FID-30k score of 6.75, but also significantly outperforms recent models in terms of image fidelity and image-text alignment, with side-by-side human evaluation on the bilingual prompt set ViLG-300.
papers.title_zh: ERNIE-VILG 2.0:改进有知识强化混合销毁-专家的文本到图像传播模型
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在传播模型方面的进展使流行的文本到图像生成技术发生了革命性的变化。 虽然现有办法可以产生具有文字条件的具有摄影现实性的高分辨率图像,但仍有一些尚未解决的问题有待解决,这限制了图像忠诚性和文字相关性的进一步改善。 在本文中,我们建议 " ERNIE-VILG 2.0 " ,即一个大型中文文本到图像扩散模型,通过下列方式逐步提高生成图像的质量:(1) 纳入对现场关键要素的精细文字和视觉知识,(2) 利用不同拆分阶段的不同非净化专家。 在拟议的机制下,ERNIE-VILG 2.0不仅在MS-CO上实现了新的最新技术,FID-30k零射分为6.75,而且在图像忠诚和图像-文字调整方面大大优于最近的模型,同时对双语的速成VILG-300进行人际评价。

papers.title: EMQ: Evolving Training-free Proxies for Automated Mixed Precision Quantization
papers.authors: Peijie Dong, Lujun Li, Zimian Wei, Xin Niu, Zhiliang Tian, Hengyue Pan
papers.abstract: Mixed-Precision Quantization (MQ) can achieve a competitive accuracy-complexity trade-off for models. Conventional training-based search methods require time-consuming candidate training to search optimized per-layer bit-width configurations in MQ. Recently, some training-free approaches have presented various MQ proxies and significantly improve search efficiency. However, the correlation between these proxies and quantization accuracy is poorly understood. To address the gap, we first build the MQ-Bench-101, which involves different bit configurations and quantization results. Then, we observe that the existing training-free proxies perform weak correlations on the MQ-Bench-101. To efficiently seek superior proxies, we develop an automatic search of proxies framework for MQ via evolving algorithms. In particular, we devise an elaborate search space involving the existing proxies and perform an evolution search to discover the best correlated MQ proxy. We proposed a diversity-prompting selection strategy and compatibility screening protocol to avoid premature convergence and improve search efficiency. In this way, our Evolving proxies for Mixed-precision Quantization (EMQ) framework allows the auto-generation of proxies without heavy tuning and expert knowledge. Extensive experiments on ImageNet with various ResNet and MobileNet families demonstrate that our EMQ obtains superior performance than state-of-the-art mixed-precision methods at a significantly reduced cost. The code will be released.
papers.title_zh: EMQ:自动混合精密度量化方面不断发展的无培训替代物
papers.abstract_zh: 混合精度量化(MQ)可以实现对模型的竞争性精确度和复杂度的权衡。 常规培训搜索方法需要耗时的候选培训,以搜索MQ中优化的每层位宽配置。 最近,一些无培训做法呈现出多种最低质量标准替代物,大大提高了搜索效率,但对这些替代物与量化准确度之间的相互关系了解甚少。 为了弥补这一差距,我们首先建立MQ-Bench-101,它涉及不同的位元配置和量化结果。 然后,我们观察到,现有的无培训代理在MQ-Bench-101上存在薄弱的关联。 为了高效地寻找上级代理人,我们开发了一种通过演进的算法自动搜索MQ代理框架的方法。 特别是,我们设计了一个复杂的搜索空间,让现有的代理参与其中,并进行进化搜索,以发现最相联的 MQ 代理。 我们提出了一个多样性快速选择战略和兼容性筛选程序,以避免过早的趋同并提高搜索效率。 这样,我们混合精度量化(EMQ)框架(EMQ)不断演变,使得替代物的自动生成无需高调和专业知识。 与各种ResNet和移动网络家庭进行的广泛图像网络实验表明,我们的EMQ的性能优于最先进的混合精度方法,成本大大降低。 代码将被发布。

papers.title: Efficient Frequency Domain-Based Transformers for High-Quality Image Deblurring
papers.authors: Lingshun Kong, Jiangxin Dong, Jianjun Ge, Mingqiang Li, Jinshan Pan
papers.abstract: We present an effective and efficient method that explores the properties of Transformers in the frequency domain for high-quality image deblurring. Our method is motivated by the convolution theorem that the correlation or convolution of two signals in the spatial domain is equivalent to an element-wise product of them in the frequency domain. This inspires us to develop an efficient frequency domain-based self-attention solver (FSAS) to estimate the scaled dot-product attention by an element-wise product operation instead of the matrix multiplication in the spatial domain. In addition, we note that simply using the naive feed-forward network (FFN) in Transformers does not generate good deblurred results. To overcome this problem, we propose a simple yet effective discriminative frequency domain-based FFN (DFFN), where we introduce a gated mechanism in the FFN based on the Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) compression algorithm to discriminatively determine which low- and high-frequency information of the features should be preserved for latent clear image restoration. We formulate the proposed FSAS and DFFN into an asymmetrical network based on an encoder and decoder architecture, where the FSAS is only used in the decoder module for better image deblurring. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs favorably against the state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.title_zh: 高效频率 高品质图像稀释以域为基础的高品质图像变换器
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个有效、高效的方法,探索变形器在高品质图像破损频域的特性。 我们的方法的动因是,在空间域中,两个信号的相关性或相联性相当于它们在频率域中的元素产物。 这激励我们开发一个高效频域域自控自控求解器(FSAS),以估计通过元素化产品操作而不是空间域矩阵乘法而缩小的点产品关注度。 此外,我们注意到,仅仅在Transformer中使用天真的进食前向网络(FFN)并不能产生好的腐蚀结果。 为了克服这一问题,我们建议采用一种简单而有效的基于歧视频率的、基于域的FFFFF(FFFF FF),在FFFF内采用基于联合摄影专家组压缩算法的封闭机制,以区别地确定应保留哪些关于这些特征的低频和高频信息,以便潜在的清晰图像恢复。 我们把拟议的FSAS和DFFN发展成一个基于编码器和解码器结构的不对称网络,其中FSAS只用于解码器模块,以更好地解码。 实验结果显示,拟议的方法与最先进的方法相对应。

papers.title: Efficient Discovery and Effective Evaluation of Visual Perceptual Similarity: A Benchmark and Beyond
papers.authors: Oren Barkan, Tal Reiss, Jonathan Weill, Ori Katz, Roy Hirsch, Itzik Malkiel, Noam Koenigstein
papers.abstract: Visual similarities discovery (VSD) is an important task with broad e-commerce applications. Given an image of a certain object, the goal of VSD is to retrieve images of different objects with high perceptual visual similarity. Although being a highly addressed problem, the evaluation of proposed methods for VSD is often based on a proxy of an identification-retrieval task, evaluating the ability of a model to retrieve different images of the same object. We posit that evaluating VSD methods based on identification tasks is limited, and faithful evaluation must rely on expert annotations. In this paper, we introduce the first large-scale fashion visual similarity benchmark dataset, consisting of more than 110K expert-annotated image pairs. Besides this major contribution, we share insight from the challenges we faced while curating this dataset. Based on these insights, we propose a novel and efficient labeling procedure that can be applied to any dataset. Our analysis examines its limitations and inductive biases, and based on these findings, we propose metrics to mitigate those limitations. Though our primary focus lies on visual similarity, the methodologies we present have broader applications for discovering and evaluating perceptual similarity across various domains.
papers.title_zh: 有效发现和有效评价视觉概念相似性:基准及以后
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉相似性发现(VSD)是具有广泛的电子商务应用的重要任务。 鉴于特定物体的图像,VSD的目标是检索具有高度视觉相似性的不同物体的图像。 虽然评价VSD的拟议方法是一个高度处理的问题,但评价往往以身份识别-检索任务的代理为基础,评价模型检索同一对象不同图像的能力。 我们假设基于识别任务对VSD方法的评价是有限的,而忠实的评价必须依靠专家说明。 在本文中,我们引入了第一个大型时尚视觉相似性基准数据集,由110K以上专家附加说明的图像配对组成。 除了这一重大贡献之外,我们还分享了我们在整理这一数据集时所面临的挑战的见解。 基于这些见解,我们建议了一个新的、高效的标签程序,可用于任何数据集。 我们的分析审查了其局限性和暗示偏见,根据这些调查结果,我们提出了减轻这些局限性的衡量标准。 虽然我们的主要重点是视觉相似性,但我们提出的方法在发现和评价各个领域的观念相似性方面有更广泛的应用。

papers.title: DynamicISP: Dynamically Controlled Image Signal Processor for Image Recognition
papers.authors: Masakazu Yoshimura, Junji Otsuka, Atsushi Irie, Takeshi Ohashi
papers.abstract: Image Signal Processors (ISPs) play important roles in image recognition tasks as well as in the perceptual quality of captured images. In most cases, experts make a lot of effort to manually tune many parameters of ISPs, but the parameters are sub-optimal. In the literature, two types of techniques have been actively studied: a machine learning-based parameter tuning technique and a DNN-based ISP technique. The former is lightweight but lacks expressive power. The latter has expressive power, but the computational cost is too heavy on edge devices. To solve these problems, we propose "DynamicISP," which consists of multiple classical ISP functions and dynamically controls the parameters of each frame according to the recognition result of the previous frame. We show our method successfully controls the parameters of multiple ISP functions and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with low computational cost in single and multi-category object detection tasks.
papers.title_zh: D动态ISP: 图像识别动态控制图像信号处理器
papers.abstract_zh: 图像信号处理器(ISPs)在图像识别任务以及被捕获图像的感知质量方面发挥着重要作用。 在大多数情况下,专家会做出大量努力手动调整ISP的许多参数,但参数是次优的。 在文献中,对两种技术进行了积极研究:机械学习参数调试技术和基于DNN的ISP技术,前者为轻量级,但缺乏表达力,后者具有表达力,但边缘装置的计算成本太高。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议“动态系统”,它由多种古典ISP功能组成,根据前一个框架的确认结果,动态控制每个框架的参数。 我们展示我们的方法成功控制了多个ISP功能的参数,并在单个和多类物体探测任务中以低计算成本实现了最先进的精确度。

papers.title: DynamicDet: A Unified Dynamic Architecture for Object Detection
papers.authors: Zhihao Lin, Yongtao Wang, Jinhe Zhang, Xiaojie Chu
papers.abstract: Dynamic neural network is an emerging research topic in deep learning. With adaptive inference, dynamic models can achieve remarkable accuracy and computational efficiency. However, it is challenging to design a powerful dynamic detector, because of no suitable dynamic architecture and exiting criterion for object detection. To tackle these difficulties, we propose a dynamic framework for object detection, named DynamicDet. Firstly, we carefully design a dynamic architecture based on the nature of the object detection task. Then, we propose an adaptive router to analyze the multi-scale information and to decide the inference route automatically. We also present a novel optimization strategy with an exiting criterion based on the detection losses for our dynamic detectors. Last, we present a variable-speed inference strategy, which helps to realize a wide range of accuracy-speed trade-offs with only one dynamic detector. Extensive experiments conducted on the COCO benchmark demonstrate that the proposed DynamicDet achieves new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs. For instance, with comparable accuracy, the inference speed of our dynamic detector Dy-YOLOv7-W6 surpasses YOLOv7-E6 by 12%, YOLOv7-D6 by 17%, and YOLOv7-E6E by 39%. The code is available at https://github.com/VDIGPKU/DynamicDet.
papers.title_zh: DiveDet:用于物体探测的统一动态结构
papers.abstract_zh: 动态神经网络是深层学习中新出现的研究课题。 随着适应性的推论,动态模型可以实现惊人的准确性和计算效率。 然而,设计一个强大的动态探测器是具有挑战性的,因为没有合适的动态结构,也没有关于天体探测的标准。 为了解决这些困难,我们提议了一个名为动态数据(DiveDet)的动态天体探测框架。 首先,我们根据物体探测任务的性质仔细设计一个动态结构。然后,我们建议一个适应性路由器来分析多尺度信息,并自动决定推论路线。 我们还提出了一个新颖的优化战略,根据我们动态探测器的探测损失标准推出一个退出标准。 最后,我们提出了一个可变速度推论战略,它帮助实现广泛的精确速度权衡,只有一个动态探测器。 对COCO基准进行的广泛实验表明,拟议的动态Det实现了新的最先进的精确速度平衡。 比如,以可比的准确性,我们的动态探测器Dy-YOLOv7-W6的推论速度超过YOLOv7-E6的12%,YOLOv7-D6的17%,YOLOv7-E6的39%。 该代码可在https://github.com/VDIGPKU/DynamicDet查阅。

papers.title: DualRel: Semi-Supervised Mitochondria Segmentation From a Prototype Perspective
papers.authors: Huayu Mai, Rui Sun, Tianzhu Zhang, Zhiwei Xiong, Feng Wu
papers.abstract: Automatic mitochondria segmentation enjoys great popularity with the development of deep learning. However, existing methods rely heavily on the labor-intensive manual gathering by experienced domain experts. And naively applying semi-supervised segmentation methods in the natural image field to mitigate the labeling cost is undesirable. In this work, we analyze the gap between mitochondrial images and natural images and rethink how to achieve effective semi-supervised mitochondria segmentation, from the perspective of reliable prototype-level supervision. We propose a novel end-to-end dual-reliable (DualRel) network, including a reliable pixel aggregation module and a reliable prototype selection module. The proposed DualRel enjoys several merits. First, to learn the prototypes well without any explicit supervision, we carefully design the referential correlation to rectify the direct pairwise correlation. Second, the reliable prototype selection module is responsible for further evaluating the reliability of prototypes in constructing prototype-level consistency regularization. Extensive experimental results on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art semi-supervised segmentation methods. Importantly, with extremely few samples used for training, DualRel is also on par with current state-of-the-art fully supervised methods.
papers.title_zh: 双Rel: 从原型角度的半有效米托昆德里亚分割
papers.abstract_zh: 随着深层学习的发展,自动微分分法非常受欢迎。 但是,现有的方法严重依赖经验丰富的领域专家的劳动密集型手工收集。 在自然图像领域使用半监督的分解方法来降低标签成本是不可取的。 在这项工作中,我们从可靠的原型监督角度,分析线粒体图像与自然图像之间的差距,并重新思考如何实现有效的半监督的米多支离子分解。 我们提议建立一个新型端对端双可靠(DualRel)网络,包括一个可靠的像素组合模块和一个可靠的原型选择模块。 拟议的双雷尔具有若干优点。 首先,为了在没有任何明确监督的情况下很好地学习原型,我们仔细设计了特惠关系,以纠正直接对等关系。 第二,可靠的原型选择模块负责进一步评价原型的可靠性,以建立原型一致性规范化。 在三个具有挑战性的基准上的广泛实验结果表明,我们的方法与最先进的半监督分解方法相比,效果良好。 重要的是,在培训中使用的样本极少的情况下,DualRel(DualRel)也与目前最先进的完全监督的方法相当。

papers.title: Diffusion Probabilistic Model Made Slim
papers.authors: Xingyi Yang, Daquan Zhou, Jiashi Feng, Xinchao Wang
papers.abstract: Despite the visually-pleasing results achieved, the massive computational cost has been a long-standing flaw for diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs), which, in turn, greatly limits their applications on resource-limited platforms. Prior methods towards efficient DPM, however, have largely focused on accelerating the testing yet overlooked their huge complexity and size. In this paper, we make a dedicated attempt to lighten DPM while striving to preserve its favourable performance. We start by training a small-sized latent diffusion model (LDM) from scratch but observe a significant fidelity drop in the synthetic images. Through a thorough assessment, we find that DPM is intrinsically biased against high-frequency generation, and learns to recover different frequency components at different time-steps. These properties make compact networks unable to represent frequency dynamics with accurate high-frequency estimation. Towards this end, we introduce a customized design for slim DPM, which we term as Spectral Diffusion (SD), for lightweight image synthesis. SD incorporates wavelet gating in its architecture to enable frequency dynamic feature extraction at every reverse steps, and conducts spectrum-aware distillation to promote high-frequency recovery by inverse weighting the objective based on spectrum magnitudes. Experimental results demonstrate that, SD achieves 8-18x computational complexity reduction as compared to the latent diffusion models on a series of conditional and unconditional image generation tasks while retaining competitive image fidelity.
papers.title_zh: 传播概率模型
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管取得了目光令人振奋的成果,但庞大的计算成本一直是传播概率模型的长期缺陷,而传播概率模型反过来又大大限制了其在资源有限的平台上的应用。 然而,在采用高效的虫害防治方法之前,我们主要侧重于加快测试速度,但忽略了测试的庞大复杂性和规模。 在本文中,我们专门致力于在努力保持其良好性能的同时,减轻虫害防治。 我们首先从零开始训练一个小型潜伏扩散模型(LDM),但注意到合成图像的忠诚性显著下降。 通过全面评估,我们发现DPM本质上对高频生成有偏见,并学会在不同时间步骤中回收不同频率组件。 这些特性使得紧凑网络无法代表精确高频估计的频率动态。 为此,我们为微缩的 DPM 推出一个定制的设计, 我们称之为光谱扩散(SD), 用于轻量级图像合成。 SD在其结构结构中包含波子凝结,使每个反向步骤都能进行频率动态特征提取,并进行频谱蒸馏,通过根据频谱大小对目标进行反加权,促进高频恢复。 实验结果表明,与一系列有条件和无条件的图像生成任务的潜在扩散模型相比,SD实现了8-18x的计算复杂性降低,同时保持了竞争性图像忠诚。

papers.title: Depth Estimation From Camera Image and mmWave Radar Point Cloud
papers.authors: Akash Deep Singh, Yunhao Ba, Ankur Sarker, Howard Zhang, Achuta Kadambi, Stefano Soatto, Mani Srivastava, Alex Wong
papers.abstract: We present a method for inferring dense depth from a camera image and a sparse noisy radar point cloud. We first describe the mechanics behind mmWave radar point cloud formation and the challenges that it poses, i.e. ambiguous elevation and noisy depth and azimuth components that yields incorrect positions when projected onto the image, and how existing works have overlooked these nuances in camera-radar fusion. Our approach is motivated by these mechanics, leading to the design of a network that maps each radar point to the possible surfaces that it may project onto in the image plane. Unlike existing works, we do not process the raw radar point cloud as an erroneous depth map, but query each raw point independently to associate it with likely pixels in the image -- yielding a semi-dense radar depth map. To fuse radar depth with an image, we propose a gated fusion scheme that accounts for the confidence scores of the correspondence so that we selectively combine radar and camera embeddings to yield a dense depth map. We test our method on the NuScenes benchmark and show a 10.3% improvement in mean absolute error and a 9.1% improvement in root-mean-square error over the best method.
papers.title_zh: 从相机图像和毫米Wave雷达点云中进行深度估计
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法,从摄像头图像和稀少的噪音雷达点云中推断密密深度。 我们首先描述了毫米Wave雷达点云层形成过程及其构成的挑战,即: 模糊的高度、吵闹的深度和方位体组件,在投射到图像时产生不正确的方位,以及现有工作如何忽略了摄像-雷达聚变中的这些细微差别。 我们的方法是由这些机械学驱动的,导致设计一个网络,绘制每个雷达的地图,指出在图像平面上可能投射到的可能表面。 与现有的工作不同,我们不把原始雷达点云作为错误的深度图处理,而是独立地Query每个原始点,将其与图像中可能的像素联系起来 -- -- 绘制半密度雷达深度图。 为了将雷达深度与图像连接起来,我们建议采用一个闭门融合计划,计算通信中的信任分数,以便我们有选择地将雷达和相机嵌入结合起来,绘制一个密集深度图。 我们用Nuscenes基准测试我们的方法,显示平均绝对误差改善10.3%,根平均值差差差比最佳方法改善9.1%。

papers.title: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Hu, Yunsheng Li, Jiancheng Lyu, Dashan Gao, Nuno Vasconcelos
papers.abstract: The problem of class incremental learning (CIL) is considered. State-of-the-art approaches use a dynamic architecture based on network expansion (NE), in which a task expert is added per task. While effective from a computational standpoint, these methods lead to models that grow quickly with the number of tasks. A new NE method, dense network expansion (DNE), is proposed to achieve a better trade-off between accuracy and model complexity. This is accomplished by the introduction of dense connections between the intermediate layers of the task expert networks, that enable the transfer of knowledge from old to new tasks via feature sharing and reusing. This sharing is implemented with a cross-task attention mechanism, based on a new task attention block (TAB), that fuses information across tasks. Unlike traditional attention mechanisms, TAB operates at the level of the feature mixing and is decoupled with spatial attentions. This is shown more effective than a joint spatial-and-task attention for CIL. The proposed DNE approach can strictly maintain the feature space of old classes while growing the network and feature scale at a much slower rate than previous methods. In result, it outperforms the previous SOTA methods by a margin of 4% in terms of accuracy, with similar or even smaller model scale.
papers.title_zh: 课堂增级学习的密集网络扩展
papers.abstract_zh: 班级递增学习(CIL)的问题得到了考虑,最先进的方法使用基于网络扩展(NE)的动态结构,每件任务中都增加一名任务专家,这些方法虽然从计算角度来说有效,但却导致随着任务数量的迅速增长模型。 提议采用新的NE方法,即密集网络扩展(DNE),以便在精确度和模型复杂性之间实现更好的权衡。 为此,在任务专家网络的中间层之间建立了密集的联系,通过特征共享和再利用将知识从旧任务转移到新任务。 这种共享是在基于新的任务关注区块(TAB)的新任务关注区块(TAB)的基础上与跨任务关注区块(TAB)的跨任务关注区块(TAB)实施的一种跨任务关注区机制下实施的,这一任务关注区块使跨任务的信息融合在一起。 与传统的关注区机制不同,TAB在特征混合层运作,并与空间关注区解耦。 这比对CIL采取共同的空间与任务关注更为有效。 拟议的DNE方法可以严格保持旧类的特色空间,同时以比以往方法慢得多的速度扩大网络和特征规模。 结果,其精确度比以前的SOTA方法高出4%的差幅,其模型规模类似甚至较小。

papers.title: Deep Factorized Metric Learning
papers.authors: Chengkun Wang, Wenzhao Zheng, Junlong Li, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.abstract: Learning a generalizable and comprehensive similarity metric to depict the semantic discrepancies between images is the foundation of many computer vision tasks. While existing methods approach this goal by learning an ensemble of embeddings with diverse objectives, the backbone network still receives a mix of all the training signals. Differently, we propose a deep factorized metric learning method (DFML) to factorize the training signal and employ different samples to train various components of the backbone network. We factorize the network to different sub-blocks and devise a learnable router to adaptively allocate the training samples to each sub-block with the objective to capture the most information. The metric model trained by DFML captures different characteristics with different sub-blocks and constitutes a generalizable metric when using all the sub-blocks. The proposed DFML achieves state-of-the-art performance on all three benchmarks for deep metric learning including CUB-200-2011, Cars196, and Stanford Online Products. We also generalize DFML to the image classification task on ImageNet-1K and observe consistent improvement in accuracy/computation trade-off. Specifically, we improve the performance of ViT-B on ImageNet (+0.2% accuracy) with less computation load (-24% FLOPs).
papers.title_zh: 深元素化计量学习
papers.abstract_zh: 学习一种通用和全面的相似性衡量标准,以描述图像之间的语义差异,这是许多计算机视觉任务的基础。 虽然现有方法通过学习一系列包含不同目标的嵌入物来实现这一目标,但骨干网络仍然得到各种培训信号的组合。 不同地说,我们建议采用一种深层次的分因素衡量学习方法(DFML),将培训信号考虑在内,并采用不同的样本来培训骨干网络的各个组成部分。 我们将网络纳入不同的小区块,并设计一个可学习的路由器,以适应性地将培训样品分配给每个小区块,目的是获取最多的信息。 DFML所培训的衡量模型掌握了不同小区块的不同特点,在使用所有小区块时构成一个通用的衡量标准。 拟议的DFML在包括CUB-200-2011、Cars196和斯坦福在线产品在内的所有三项深层计量学习基准上取得了SOTA 性能。 我们还将DFML推广到图像Net-1K的图像分类任务中,并观察到准确性/计算取舍的不断改进。 具体而言,我们在图像网络上改进VIT-B的性能(+0.2%精度),减少计算负荷(24%的FLOPs)。

papers.title: Decoupled Semantic Prototypes Enable Learning From Diverse Annotation Types for Semi-Weakly Segmentation in Expert-Driven Domains
papers.authors: Simon Reiß, Constantin Seibold, Alexander Freytag, Erik Rodner, Rainer Stiefelhagen
papers.abstract: A vast amount of images and pixel-wise annotations allowed our community to build scalable segmentation solutions for natural domains. However, the transfer to expert-driven domains like microscopy applications or medical healthcare remains difficult as domain experts are a critical factor due to their limited availability for providing pixel-wise annotations. To enable affordable segmentation solutions for such domains, we need training strategies which can simultaneously handle diverse annotation types and are not bound to costly pixel-wise annotations. In this work, we analyze existing training algorithms towards their flexibility for different annotation types and scalability to small annotation regimes. We conduct an extensive evaluation in the challenging domain of organelle segmentation and find that existing semi- and semi-weakly supervised training algorithms are not able to fully exploit diverse annotation types. Driven by our findings, we introduce Decoupled Semantic Prototypes (DSP) as a training method for semantic segmentation which enables learning from annotation types as diverse as image-level-, point-, bounding box-, and pixel-wise annotations and which leads to remarkable accuracy gains over existing solutions for semi-weakly segmentation.
papers.title_zh: 分解的语义性原型类型 能够从不同批注类型中学习,以在专家驱动域中进行半微弱分解
papers.abstract_zh: 大量图像和像素说明使我们社区得以为自然领域建立可伸缩的分解解决方案。 然而,向专家驱动的领域,如显微镜应用或医疗保健转移仍然困难重重,因为域专家是一个关键因素,因为提供像素说明的可用性有限。 为了能为这些领域提供负担得起的分解解决方案,我们需要培训战略,既能同时处理各种批注类型,又不附带昂贵的像素说明。 在这项工作中,我们分析现有的培训算法,使其具有不同批注类型和小批注制度的可伸缩性。 我们广泛评价了具有挑战性的器官分解领域,发现现有的半和半薄弱监督的培训算法无法充分利用各种批注类型。 以我们的调查结果为驱动力,我们引入了分解语义原型(DSP),作为语义分解的培训方法,以便从图象、点、边框、像素说明等不同的批注类型中学习,从而在半微分化的现有解决方案中取得显著的准确性收益。

papers.title: DA-NAS: Data Adapted Pruning for Efficient Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Xiyang Dai, Dongdong Chen, Mengchen Liu, Yinpeng Chen, Lu Yuan
papers.abstract: Efficient search is a core issue in Neural Architecture Search (NAS). It is difficult for conventional NAS algorithms to directly search the architectures on large-scale tasks like ImageNet. In general, the cost of GPU hours for NAS grows with regard to training dataset size and candidate set size. One common way is searching on a smaller proxy dataset (e.g., CIFAR-10) and then transferring to the target task (e.g., ImageNet). These architectures optimized on proxy data are not guaranteed to be optimal on the target task. Another common way is learning with a smaller candidate set, which may require expert knowledge and indeed betrays the essence of NAS. In this paper, we present DA-NAS that can directly search the architecture for large-scale target tasks while allowing a large candidate set in a more efficient manner. Our method is based on an interesting observation that the learning speed for blocks in deep neural networks is related to the difficulty of recognizing distinct categories. We carefully design a progressive data adapted pruning strategy for efficient architecture search. It will quickly trim low performed blocks on a subset of target dataset) and then gradually find the best blocks on the whole target dataset. At this time, the original candidate set becomes as compact as possible, providing a faster search in the target task. Experiments on ImageNet verify the effectiveness of our approach. It is $ extbf{2} oldsymbol{ imes}$ faster than previous methods while the accuracy is currently state-of-the-art, at $ extbf{76.2%}$ under small FLOPs constraint. It supports an argument search space (i.e., more candidate blocks) to efficiently search the best-performing architecture."
papers.title_zh: DA-NAS: 数据调整谨慎,促进高效神经结构搜索
papers.abstract_zh: 高效搜索是神经结构搜索(NAS)的一个核心问题,传统的NAS算法很难直接搜索像图像网络这样的大规模任务的结构。 一般来说,NAS的GPU小时成本在培训数据集大小和候选数据集大小方面会增加。 一种常见的方式是搜索一个较小的代用数据集(如CIFAR-10),然后转移到目标任务(如图像网络),这些根据代理数据优化的架构不能保证在目标任务上达到最佳效果。 另一种常见的方法是学习更小的一组候选人,这可能需要专家知识,而且确实背叛了NAS的精髓。 在本文中,我们介绍了DA-NAS,它可以直接搜索大规模目标任务的结构,同时允许以更有效的方式设置一个大的候选人。 我们的方法是基于一个有趣的观察,即深神经网络中街区的学习速度与识别不同类别的难度有关。 我们仔细设计了一个适应数据快速调整的修剪战略,以便高效的建筑搜索。 它将很快地在目标数据集子集上修剪低效度区块),然后逐渐在整个目标数据集中找到最佳区块。 此时,原始候选数据集尽可能紧凑,为目标任务提供更快的搜索。 图像网络上的实验可以验证我们的方法的有效性。 它比以前的方法快 $ extbf{ 2 oldsymbol{ imes} , 而准确性目前是最先进的, 在小FLOPs的限制下, 以 $ extf{76.2 $ 。 它支持一个争论搜索空间(即更多候选区块),

papers.title: Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-View 3D Style Transfer
papers.authors: Renke Wang, Guimin Que, Shuo Chen, Xiang Li, Jun Li, Jian Yang
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method for single-view 3D style transfer that generates a unique 3D object with both shape and texture transfer. Our focus lies primarily on birds, a popular subject in 3D reconstruction, for which no existing single-view 3D transfer methods have been developed. The method we propose seeks to generate a 3D mesh shape and texture of a bird from two single-view images. To achieve this, we introduce a novel shape transfer generator that comprises a dual residual gated network (DRGNet), and a multi-layer perceptron (MLP). DRGNet extracts the features of source and target images using a shared coordinate gate unit, while the MLP generates spatial coordinates for building a 3D mesh. We also introduce a semantic UV texture transfer module that implements textural style transfer using semantic UV segmentation, which ensures consistency in the semantic meaning of the transferred regions. This module can be widely adapted to many existing approaches. Finally, our method constructs a novel 3D bird using a differentiable renderer. Experimental results on the CUB dataset verify that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the single-view 3D style transfer task. Code is available at https://github.com/wrk226/creative_birds.
papers.title_zh: 创意鸟类:自我监督的单视3D风格传输
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一种单一视图 3D 风格传输的新方法,该方法产生一个独特的3D 对象,其形状和质地传输都是如此。 我们的焦点主要放在鸟类上,鸟类是3D 重建中一个受欢迎的主题,目前还没有开发出任何单一视图 3D 传输方法。 我们提出的方法试图从两张单一视图图像中生成一只鸟的 3D 网形形状和纹理。 为了实现这一目标,我们引入了一个新型的形状转换生成器,其中包括一个双层封闭网(DRGNet)和一个多层光谱(MLP) 。 DRGNet利用一个共用坐标门装置提取源和目标图像的特征,而MLP生成空间坐标用于建造3D网格。 我们还引入了一个语义性紫外线纹理传输模块,该模块使用语义性紫外线分解来实施纹理风格的传输,以确保被转移区域的语义含义的一致性。 这个模块可以广泛适用于许多现有的方法。 最后,我们的方法是用一个不同的铸造器构建一个新型的 3D 鸟。 CUB 数据集的实验结果验证了我们的方法在单一视图 3D 风格的传输任务上取得了最先进的表现。 代码可在 https://github.com/wrk226/ creative_birds 上查阅。

papers.title: CreatiLayout: Siamese Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Creative Layout-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Hui Zhang · Dexiang Hong · Yitong Wang · Jie Shao · Xinglong Wu · Zuxuan Wu · Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have been recognized for their ability to generate images that are not only visually appealing but also of high artistic quality. As a result, Layout-to-Image (L2I) generation has been proposed to leverage region-specific positions and descriptions to enable more precise and controllable generation. However, previous methods primarily focus on UNet-based models (e.g., SD1.5 and SDXL), and limited effort has explored Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs), which have demonstrated powerful image generation capabilities. Enabling MM-DiT for layout-to-image generation seems straightforward but is challenging due to the complexity of how layout is introduced, integrated, and balanced among multiple modalities. To this end, we explore various network variants to efficiently incorporate layout guidance into MM-DiT, and ultimately present SiamLayout. To Inherit the advantages of MM-DiT, we use a separate set of network weights to process the layout, treating it as equally important as the image and text modalities. Meanwhile, to alleviate the competition among modalities, we decouple the image-layout interaction into a siamese branch alongside the image-text one and fuse them in the later stage. Moreover, we contribute a large-scale layout dataset, named LayoutSAM, which includes 2.7 million image-text pairs and 10.7 million entities. Each entity is annotated with a bounding box and a detailed description.We further construct the LayoutSAM-Eval benchmark as a comprehensive tool for evaluating the L2I generation quality. Finally, we introduce the Layout Designer, which taps into the potential of large language models in layout planning, transforming them into experts in layout generation and optimization.
papers.title_zh: CrediLayout: 用于创意布局到图像生成的暹罗多模式传播Transformer
