The experiments on ScanNet and 7-Scenes datasets show that our system outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of both accuracy and speed. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first learning-based system that is able to reconstruct dense coherent 3D geometry in real-time. Code is available at the project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralrecon/.
papers.title_zh: 神经功能:实时协调的 3D 重塑独视视频
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个新的框架 名为神经再生 实时3D场景重建 从一个单眼视频。 与以往分别估计每个关键框架的单视深度地图并随后将其连接起来的方法不同,我们提议直接重建当地表面,这些表层被神经网络按顺序显示为每个视频碎片的稀薄的TSDF体积。 利用基于门锁的常规单元的基于学习的TSDF聚变模块,指导网络从以前的碎片中获取引信特性。 这一设计使网络能够在连续重建地表时,在3D表面之前取得当地平坦的先前和全球的形状,从而导致准确、一致和实时的地表重建。 在ScanNet和7-Scenses数据集的实验显示,我们的系统在准确性和速度方面都超过了最先进的方法。 据我们所知,这是第一个能够实时重建密度连贯的3D几何的以学习为基础的系统。 法规可在项目网页上查阅:https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralrecon/。

papers.title: Neural Prototype Trees for Interpretable Fine-Grained Image Recognition
papers.authors: Meike Nauta, Ron van Bree, Christin Seifert
papers.abstract: Prototype-based methods use interpretable representations to address the black-box nature of deep learning models, in contrast to post-hoc explanation methods that only approximate such models. We propose the Neural Prototype Tree (ProtoTree), an intrinsically interpretable deep learning method for fine-grained image recognition. ProtoTree combines prototype learning with decision trees, and thus results in a globally interpretable model by design. Additionally, ProtoTree can locally explain a single prediction by outlining a decision path through the tree. Each node in our binary tree contains a trainable prototypical part. The presence or absence of this learned prototype in an image determines the routing through a node. Decision making is therefore similar to human reasoning: Does the bird have a red throat? And an elongated beak? Then it's a hummingbird! We tune the accuracy-interpretability trade-off using ensemble methods, pruning and binarizing. We apply pruning without sacrificing accuracy, resulting in a small tree with only 8 learned prototypes along a path to classify a bird from 200 species. An ensemble of 5 ProtoTrees achieves competitive accuracy on the CUB-200- 2011 and Stanford Cars data sets. Code is available at https://github.com/M-Nauta/ProtoTree.
papers.title_zh: 用于解析精细图像识别的神经原型树树
papers.abstract_zh: 以原型为基础的方法使用可解释的表述方式来解决深层学习模式的黑盒性质问题,而后热量解释方法仅接近于此类模式。 我们建议使用神经原型树(ProtoTree ) 。 神经原型树(ProtoTree ) 是一个内在的、可解释的深层次学习方法,用于微粒图像识别。 原型树将原型学习与决策树结合起来,从而形成一个设计上可全球解释的模式。 此外, ProtoTree 可以在本地解释单一的预测, 绘制通过树的判定路径 。 我们二进制树的每个节点都包含一个可训练的原型部分 。 图像中的这个已学原型的存在与否决定了通过节点的路径 。 因此,决策与人的推理相似:鸟有红喉吗?是长嘴吗?然后是蜂鸟!我们用混合方法、裁剪和二进制来调整精确易懂的权衡。 我们在不牺牲准确性的情况下进行裁剪,结果造成一棵小树,只有8个学得的原型原型沿着200种物种对鸟类进行分类,5种原型物种的合体在CUB-200-2011和斯坦福汽车数据集上实现了竞争性准确性,代码见https://github.com/M-Nauta/ProtoTree。

papers.title: NEAT: Neural Attention Fields for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Kashyap Chitta, Aditya Prakash, Andreas Geiger
papers.abstract: Efficient reasoning about the semantic, spatial, and temporal structure of a scene is a crucial prerequisite for autonomous driving. We present NEural ATtention fields (NEAT), a novel representation that enables such reasoning for end-to-end imitation learning models. NEAT is a continuous function which maps locations in Bird's Eye View (BEV) scene coordinates to waypoints and semantics, using intermediate attention maps to iteratively compress high-dimensional 2D image features into a compact representation. This allows our model to selectively attend to relevant regions in the input while ignoring information irrelevant to the driving task, effectively associating the images with the BEV representation. In a new evaluation setting involving adverse environmental conditions and challenging scenarios, NEAT outperforms several strong baselines and achieves driving scores on par with the privileged CARLA expert used to generate its training data. Furthermore, visualizing the attention maps for models with NEAT intermediate representations provides improved interpretability.
papers.title_zh: NEAT: 最终至最终自主驾驶的神经关注领域
papers.abstract_zh: 关于场景的语义、空间和时间结构的有效推理是自主驾驶的关键前提。 我们提出了“神经关注场 ” ( NEAT ) , 这是一种新颖的表述方式,它使得端到端学习模式的推理成为可能。 NEAT是一个连续的功能,用于绘制鸟类眼视(BEV)场景坐标,以到路点和语义坐标的位置,使用中间注意地图,将高维2D图像的迭代压缩成一个紧凑的表示面。 这样,我们的模型就能够有选择地关注相关区域的投入,同时忽视与驱动任务无关的信息,有效地将图像与BEV的表示方式联系起来。 在涉及不利环境条件和具有挑战性的假设情况的新评价环境中,NEAT的业绩超过若干强有力的基线,并达到与CARLA专家同等的驾驶分数,该专家用来生成培训数据。 此外,用NEAT中间表示器对模型的注意图进行直观化,可提高可解释性。

papers.title: Multiresolution Knowledge Distillation for Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Mohammadreza Salehi, Niousha Sadjadi, Soroosh Baselizadeh, Mohammad H. Rohban, Hamid R. Rabiee
papers.abstract: Unsupervised representation learning has proved to be a critical component of anomaly detection/localization in images. The challenges to learn such a representation are two-fold. Firstly, the sample size is not often large enough to learn a rich generalizable representation through conventional techniques. Secondly, while only normal samples are available at training, the learned features should be discriminative of normal and anomalous samples. Here, we propose to use the "distillation" of features at various layers of an expert network, which is pre-trained on ImageNet, into a simpler cloner network to tackle both issues. We detect and localize anomalies using the discrepancy between the expert and cloner networks' intermediate activation values given an input sample. We show that considering multiple intermediate hints in distillation leads to better exploitation of the expert's knowledge and a more distinctive discrepancy between the two networks, compared to utilizing only the last layer activation values. Notably, previous methods either fail in precise anomaly localization or need expensive region-based training. In contrast, with no need for any special or intensive training procedure, we incorporate interpretability algorithms in our novel framework to localize anomalous regions. Despite the striking difference between some test datasets and ImageNet, we achieve competitive or significantly superior results compared to SOTA on MNIST, F-MNIST, CIFAR-10, MVTecAD, Retinal-OCT, and two other medical datasets on both anomaly detection and localization.
papers.title_zh: 多分辨率知识蒸馏用于异常检测
papers.abstract_zh: 事实证明,未经监督的代言学习是图像中异常现象检测/定位的一个关键组成部分,了解这种代言方式面临双重挑战,第一,抽样规模往往不够大,无法通过常规技术学习丰富的通用代言方式。 第二,虽然培训时只有正常样品,但学到的特征应该是对正常和异常样品加以区别。 我们建议使用“蒸馏”专家网络不同层面的功能, 将图像网络预培训成更简单的克隆人网络, 解决这两个问题。 校对:Portnoy Net, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy, 校对:Portnoy 我们利用专家网络和克隆人网络的中间活化值之间的差异,通过输入样本来检测异常现象并将其本地化。 我们表明,在蒸馏中考虑多个中间提示,可以更好地利用专家的知识,使两个网络之间更明显地存在差异,而仅使用最后一层活化值。 值得注意的是,以前的方法要么在确切的异常地点化中失败,要么需要昂贵的区域培训。 相反,我们不需要任何特殊或强化培训程序,而是将可解释性算法纳入我们新的框架,将异常地区本地化。 尽管一些测试数据集和图像网络之间存在显著差异,但我们还是取得了与SOTA(MNIST、F-MNIST、CIFAR-10、MVTecAD、Retinal-OCT)和另外两个关于异常点探测和定位的医疗数据集相比,在MNIST、F-MNIST、CIFAR-10、MVTECAD、Retinal-OCT方面取得了竞争性或显著优异的结果。

papers.title: Multiple Heads Are Better Than One: Few-Shot Font Generation With Multiple Localized Experts
papers.authors: Song Park, Sanghyuk Chun, Junbum Cha, Bado Lee, Hyunjung Shim
papers.abstract: A few-shot font generation (FFG) method has to satisfy two objectives: the generated images should preserve the underlying global structure of the target character and present the diverse local reference style. Existing FFG methods aim to disentangle content and style either by extracting a universal representation style or extracting multiple component-wise style representations. However, previous methods either fail to capture diverse local styles or cannot be generalized to a character with unseen components, e.g., unseen language systems. To mitigate the issues, we propose a novel FFG method, named Multiple Localized Experts Few-shot Font Generation Network (MX-Font). MX-Font extracts multiple style features not explicitly conditioned on component labels, but automatically by multiple experts to represent different local concepts, e.g., left-side sub-glyph. Owing to the multiple experts, MX-Font can capture diverse local concepts and show the generalizability to unseen languages. During training, we utilize component labels as weak supervision to guide each expert to be specialized for different local concepts. We formulate the component assign problem to each expert as the graph matching problem, and solve it by the Hungarian algorithm. We also employ the independence loss and the content-style adversarial loss to impose the content-style disentanglement. In our experiments, MX-Font outperforms previous state-of-the-art FFG methods in the Chinese generation and cross-lingual, e.g., Chinese to Korean, generation.
papers.title_zh: 多头比一个要好:与多地方化专家一起鲜热的字体生成
papers.abstract_zh: 要达到两个目标,即生成的图像应保留目标字符的基本全球结构,并展示各种不同的本地参考风格,采用几拍字体生成方法(FFG)必须满足以下两个目标:生成的图像应保存目标字符的基本全球结构。 FFG现有方法旨在通过采用普遍代表性方式或采用多种组成风格,分解内容和风格。 然而,以往的方法要么未能捕捉到多种多样的本地风格,要么不能被概括为具有看不见组成部分的特征,例如,隐形语言系统。 为了缓解问题,我们提议了一种新型的FFG方法,名为多本地化专家(多本地化专家 ) , 名为“ 少见字体生成网络( MX-Font ) ” ( MX-Font ) 。 MX-Font 提取了多种样式特征,这些特征并非明确以部件标签为条件,而是由多个专家自动代表不同的当地概念,例如左侧小格字。由于这些专家众多,MX-Font 能够捕捉不同的当地概念,并显示对看不见语言的可概括性。 在培训过程中,我们使用部件标签作为薄弱的监管工具,引导每一位专家专门研究不同的本地概念。我们把部件设计成每个专家的图表匹配问题,用匈牙利算法来解决问题。 我们还利用独立损失和内容风格的对抗性损失来强加内容风格的分歧。 在我们的实验中,MX-Font在中国一代和跨语言(如中文对韩文)一代中超越了以往最先进的FFG方法。

papers.title: Multi-Target Domain Adaptation With Collaborative Consistency Learning
papers.authors: Takashi Isobe, Xu Jia, Shuaijun Chen, Jianzhong He, Yongjie Shi, Jianzhuang Liu, Huchuan Lu, Shengjin Wang
papers.abstract: Recently unsupervised domain adaptation for the semantic segmentation task has become more and more popular due to the high-cost of pixel-level annotation on real-world images. However, most domain adaptation methods are only restricted to single-source-single-target pair, and can not be directly extended to multiple target domains. In this work, we propose a collaborative learning framework to achieve unsupervised multi-target domain adaptation. An unsupervised domain adaptation expert model is first trained for each source-target pair and is further encouraged to collaborate with each other through a bridge built between different target domains. These expert models are further improved by adding the regularization of making the consistent pixel-wise prediction for each sample with the same structured context. To obtain a single model that works across multiple target domains, we propose to simultaneously learn a student model which is trained to not only imitate the output of each expert on the corresponding target domain but also to pull different expert close to each other with regularization on their weights. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively exploit rich structured information contained in both labeled source domain and multiple unlabeled target domains. Not only does it perform well across multiple target domains but also performs favorably against state-of-the-art unsupervised domain adaptation methods specially trained on a single source-target pair.
papers.title_zh: 多目标域适应与协作一致学习
papers.abstract_zh: 由于在现实世界的图像上进行像素级的像素级说明的成本很高,最近未受监督的用于语义分解任务的域适应越来越受欢迎。 然而,大多数领域的适应方法仅限于单一源单一目标对,不能直接扩大到多个目标领域。 在这项工作中,我们提议了一个合作学习框架,以实现不受监督的多目标领域的适应。 一个不受监督的域适应专家模型首先为每种源目标对进行训练,并进一步鼓励通过在不同目标领域之间搭建的桥梁相互协作。 这些专家模型得到进一步的改进,办法是增加一种正规化,即对每个样本都作出结构相同的结构背景的一致的像素预测。 为了获得一个跨越多个目标领域的单一模式,我们提议同时学习一个学生模式,该模式经过培训,不仅能够模仿每个专家在相应目标领域的产出,而且能够吸引不同的专家彼此接近,并调整其体重。 广泛的实验表明,拟议方法能够有效地利用标签源域和多个未标目标域的丰富结构化信息。 它不仅在多个目标领域表现良好,而且对在单一源目标配对方面受过专门培训的最先进的、不受监督的域适应方法也表现良好。

papers.title: Multi-Expert Adversarial Attack Detection in Person Re-Identification Using Context Inconsistency
papers.authors: Xueping Wang, Shasha Li, Min Liu, Yaonan Wang, Amit K. Roy-Chowdhury
papers.abstract: The success of deep neural networks (DNNs) has promoted the widespread applications of person re-identification (ReID). However, ReID systems inherit the vulnerability of DNNs to malicious attacks of visually inconspicuous adversarial perturbations. Detection of adversarial attacks is, therefore, a fundamental requirement for robust ReID systems. In this work, we propose a Multi-Expert Adversarial Attack Detection (MEAAD) approach to achieve this goal by checking context inconsistency, which is suitable for any DNNs-based ReID systems. Specifically, three kinds of context inconsistencies caused by adversarial attacks are employed to learn a detector for detecting adversarial attacks, i.e., a) the embedding distances between a perturbed query person image and its top-K retrievals are generally larger than those between a benign query image and its top-K retrievals, b) the embedding distances among the top-K retrievals of a perturbed query image are larger than those of a benign query image, c) the top-K retrievals of a benign query image obtained with multiple expert ReID models tend to be consistent, which is not preserved when attacks are present. Extensive experiments on the Market1501 and DukeMTMC-ReID datasets show that, as the first adversarial attack detection approach for ReID, MEAAD effectively detects various adversarial attacks and achieves high ROC-AUC (over 97.5%).
papers.title_zh: 多专家反反向攻击多重专家利用前后不一致的情况重新确定身份
papers.abstract_zh: 深层神经网络的成功促进了个人再识别(ReID)的广泛应用,然而,ReID系统继承了DNN易受目光不明的对立干扰恶意攻击的可能性。 因此,发现对抗性攻击是强有力的ReID系统的基本要求,在这项工作中,我们提议采用多专家反反向攻击探测(MEAAD)方法,通过检查背景不一致来实现这一目标,这种办法适用于任何基于DNNs的ReID系统。 具体地说,对抗性攻击造成的三种情况不一致,用于学习探测对抗性攻击的探测器,即:(a) 受扰动的Query人图像与其顶部K级检索之间的距离通常大于良性Query图像与其顶部K级检索之间的距离;(b) 受扰动的Query图像顶部K级检索之间的距离大于良性Query图像的距离;(c) 由多个专家ReID模型获得的良性Query图像的顶部检索往往一致,当攻击发生时,这种距离得不到维护。 关于市场1501和DukeMTMC-ReID数据集的广泛实验表明,作为ReID的第一种对抗性攻击探测方法,MEAAD有效检测了各种对抗性攻击,并取得了高ROC-AUC(超过97.5%)。

papers.title: MP3: A Unified Model To Map, Perceive, Predict and Plan
papers.authors: Sergio Casas, Abbas Sadat, Raquel Urtasun
papers.abstract: High-definition maps (HD maps) are a key component of most modern self-driving systems due to their valuable semantic and geometric information. Unfortunately, building HD maps has proven hard to scale due to their cost as well as the requirements they impose in the localization system that has to work everywhere with centimeter-level accuracy. Being able to drive without an HD map would be very beneficial to scale self-driving solutions as well as to increase the failure tolerance of existing ones (e.g., if localization fails or the map is not up-to-date). Towards this goal, we propose an end-to-end approach to mapless driving where the input is raw sensor data and a high-level command (e.g., turn left at the intersection). We then predict intermediate representations in the form of an online map and the current and future state of dynamic agents, and exploit them in a novel neural motion planner to make interpretable decisions taking into account uncertainty. We show that our approach is significantly safer, more comfortable, and can follow commands better than the baselines in challenging long-term closed-loop simulations, as well as when compared to an expert driver in a large-scale real-world dataset.
papers.title_zh: MP3:地图、观察、预测和计划统一模型
papers.abstract_zh: 高清晰度地图(HD地图)由于其宝贵的语义和几何信息,是大多数现代自行驾驶系统的一个关键组成部分。 不幸的是,由于建造HD地图的成本以及这些地图对地方化系统的要求,其成本和要求必须准确度达到厘米,因此很难进行比例测量。 没有HD地图就能驾车将非常有利于扩大自我驱动解决方案的规模,并增加现有解决方案的失败容忍度(例如,如果本地化失败或地图没有更新)。 为实现这一目标,我们提议采用端对端办法,在输入为原始传感器数据和高级指令(如十字路口左转)的情况下,采用无地图驾驶方式。 然后我们以在线地图和动态物剂当前和未来状况的形式预测中间代表,并在一个新的神经运动规划师中利用它们做出可解释的决定,同时考虑到不确定性。 我们表明,我们的方法比长期的闭路模拟具有挑战性,而且与大规模真实世界数据集的专家驱动器相比,我们的方法比我们的方法更安全、更舒适,能够比基线更好地遵循命令。

papers.title: MG-GAN: A Multi-Generator Model Preventing Out-of-Distribution Samples in Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction
papers.authors: Patrick Dendorfer, Sven Elflein, Laura Leal-Taixé
papers.abstract: Pedestrian trajectory prediction is challenging due to its uncertain and multimodal nature. While generative adversarial networks can learn a distribution over future trajectories, they tend to predict out-of-distribution samples when the distribution of future trajectories is a mixture of multiple, possibly disconnected modes. To address this issue, we propose a multi-generator model for pedestrian trajectory prediction. Each generator specializes in learning a distribution over trajectories routing towards one of the primary modes in the scene, while a second network learns a categorical distribution over these generators, conditioned on the dynamics and scene input. This architecture allows us to effectively sample from specialized generators and to significantly reduce the out-of-distribution samples compared to single generator methods.
papers.title_zh: MG-GAN:害虫轨迹预测中多驱动器防止分发样品模型
papers.abstract_zh: 人行道预测由于其不确定性和多式联运性质而具有挑战性。 虽然基因对抗网络可以了解未来轨迹的分布,但是,当未来轨迹的分布是多种可能互不连接的模式的混合体时,它们往往预测分布之外的样本。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议了行人轨迹预测的多生成模型。 每个发电机专门学习轨道向现场主要模式之一的路径的分布,而第二个网络则学习这些发电机的绝对分布,以动态和场景输入为条件。 这一结构使我们能够有效地从专门发电机中抽取样品,与单一发电机方法相比,大大减少分配外的样品。

papers.title: MaX-DeepLab: End-to-End Panoptic Segmentation With Mask Transformers
papers.authors: Huiyu Wang, Yukun Zhu, Hartwig Adam, Alan Yuille, Liang-Chieh Chen
papers.abstract: We present MaX-DeepLab, the first end-to-end model for panoptic segmentation. Our approach simplifies the current pipeline that depends heavily on surrogate sub-tasks and hand-designed components, such as box detection, non-maximum suppression, thing-stuff merging, etc. Although these sub-tasks are tackled by area experts, they fail to comprehensively solve the target task. By contrast, our MaX-DeepLab directly predicts class-labeled masks with a mask transformer, and is trained with a panoptic quality inspired loss via bipartite matching. Our mask transformer employs a dual-path architecture that introduces a global memory path in addition to a CNN path, allowing direct communication with any CNN layers. As a result, MaX-DeepLab shows a significant 7.1% PQ gain in the box-free regime on the challenging COCO dataset, closing the gap between box-based and box-free methods for the first time. A small variant of MaX-DeepLab improves 3.0% PQ over DETR with similar parameters and M-Adds. Furthermore, MaX-DeepLab, without test time augmentation, achieves new state-of-the-art 51.3% PQ on COCO test-dev set.
papers.title_zh: MaX-DiepLab:带面罩变形器的端到端全光截面部分
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了第一个端到端的全光分割模型MaX-DeepLab。 我们的方法简化了目前严重依赖代管子任务和手工设计的部件的管道,如箱式检测、非最大抑制、东西合并等。 尽管这些子任务是由地区专家处理的,但它们未能全面解决目标任务。 相反,我们的MaX-DeepLab直接预测了带有面罩变压器的等级标签面罩,并且通过两边配对接受了全方位质量激励损失的培训。 我们的面具变压器使用双路路结构,除了有线电视新闻网路径外,还引入全球记忆路径,从而可以与任何有线电视新闻网层直接沟通。 因此,MaX-DiepLab显示,在具有挑战性的COCO数据集无箱制度下,PQ收益高达7.1%,首次缩小了箱式和无箱式方法之间的差距。 MaX-DiepLab的一个小变体用类似参数和M-Adds将PQ比DETR提高了3.0%。 此外,MaX-DeepLab在没有测试时间增强的情况下,在COCO测试台上实现了新的最先进的51.3%的PQ。

papers.title: Linguistically Routing Capsule Network for Out-of-Distribution Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Qingxing Cao, Wentao Wan, Keze Wang, Xiaodan Liang, Liang Lin
papers.abstract: Generalization on out-of-distribution (OOD) test data is an essential but underexplored topic in visual question answering. Current state-of-the-art VQA models often exploit the biased correlation between data and labels, which results in a large performance drop when the test and training data have different distributions. Inspired by the fact that humans can recognize novel concepts by composing existed concepts and capsule network's ability of representing part-whole hierarchies, we propose to use capsules to represent parts and introduce "Linguistically Routing" to merge parts with human-prior hierarchies. Specifically, we first fuse visual features with a single question word as atomic parts. Then we introduce the "Linguistically Routing" to reweight the capsule connections between two layers such that: 1) the lower layer capsules can transfer their outputs to the most compatible higher capsules, and 2) two capsules can be merged if their corresponding words are merged in the question parse tree. The routing process maximizes the above unary and binary potentials across multiple layers and finally carves a tree structure inside the capsule network. We evaluate our proposed routing method on the CLEVR compositional generation test, the VQA-CP2 dataset and the VQAv2 dataset. The experimental results show that our proposed method can improve current VQA models on OOD split without losing performance on the in-domain test data.
papers.title_zh: 外传视觉问题解答语言分流模块网络
papers.abstract_zh: (OOD)分发外测试数据的一般化是视觉问题解答中一个基本但未得到充分探讨的专题。 目前最先进的VQA模型经常利用数据和标签之间有偏差的关联关系,当测试和培训数据分布不同时,结果造成性能大幅下降。 我们建议用胶囊来代表零件, 并引入“老练的巡回”来将部件与人类的优先等级合并。 我们建议使用胶囊来代表零件, 具体地说,我们首先将视觉特征装配成原子部分 只有一个问题单词。 然后我们推出“老式绕行”来调整两层之间的胶囊连接,以便:(1) 低层胶囊可以将其输出转移到最相容的高层胶囊;(2) 如果两个胶囊的对应词被合并在问题分析树上,那么两个胶囊可以合并。 路由过程使以上单项和二项潜力在多层之间最大化,并最终在胶囊网络中刻出树结构。 我们评估了CLEVR成份生成测试、VQA-CP2数据集和VQAv2数据集的拟议路由方法。 实验结果显示,我们提议的方法可以改进目前关于OOD分离的VQA模型,同时又不丧失内域测试数据的性能。

papers.title: Lifelong Infinite Mixture Model Based on Knowledge-Driven Dirichlet Process
papers.authors: Fei Ye, Adrian G. Bors
papers.abstract: Recent research efforts in lifelong learning propose to grow a mixture of models to adapt to an increasing number of tasks. The proposed methodology shows promising results in overcoming catastrophic forgetting. However, the theory behind these successful models is still not well understood. In this paper, we perform the theoretical analysis for lifelong learning models by deriving the risk bounds based on the discrepancy distance between the probabilistic representation of data generated by the model and that corresponding to the target dataset. Inspired by the theoretical analysis, we introduce a new lifelong learning approach, namely the Lifelong Infinite Mixture (LIMix) model, which can automatically expand its network architectures or choose an appropriate component to adapt its parameters for learning a new task, while preserving its previously learnt information. We propose to incorporate the knowledge by means of Dirichlet processes by using a gating mechanism which computes the dependence between the knowledge learnt previously and stored in each component, and a new set of data. Besides, we train a compact Student model which can accumulate cross-domain representations over time and make quick inferences. The code is available at https://github.com/dtuzi123/Lifelong-infinite-mixture-model.
papers.title_zh: 以知识开发的dirichlet 进程为基础的终身无限混合模型
papers.abstract_zh: 最近对终身学习的研究提议,将各种模型混合起来,以适应越来越多的任务。拟议方法显示,在克服灾难性的遗忘方面,取得了大有希望的成果。然而,这些成功模型背后的理论仍未被人们充分理解。 在本文中,我们对终身学习模式进行理论分析,根据该模式生成的数据的概率表示与目标数据集相对应的数据的概率表示之间的差异,得出风险界限。 在理论分析的启发下,我们引入了新的终身学习方法,即终身无限混合(LIMix)模式,它可以自动扩大其网络结构或选择适当的组成部分,以调整其参数,从而学习新的任务,同时保留其以前学到的信息。 我们建议利用一种计算以前所学到的知识与每个组成部分所储存的知识之间的依赖性的格子机制,以及一套新的数据,通过迪里赫莱特进程纳入知识。 此外,我们培训了一种紧凑的学生模式,该模式可以随着时间的推移积累跨域代表,并快速推论。 该代码可在https://github.com/dtuzi123/Lifelong-infinite-mixture-model上查阅。

papers.title: Learning Cross-Modal Retrieval With Noisy Labels
papers.authors: Peng Hu, Xi Peng, Hongyuan Zhu, Liangli Zhen, Jie Lin
papers.abstract: Recently, cross-modal retrieval is emerging with the help of deep multimodal learning. However, even for unimodal data, collecting large-scale well-annotated data is expensive and time-consuming, and not to mention the additional challenges from multiple modalities. Although crowd-sourcing annotation, e.g., Amazon's Mechanical Turk, can be utilized to mitigate the labeling cost, but leading to the unavoidable noise in labels for the non-expert annotating. To tackle the challenge, this paper presents a general Multimodal Robust Learning framework (MRL) for learning with multimodal noisy labels to mitigate noisy samples and correlate distinct modalities simultaneously. To be specific, we propose a Robust Clustering loss (RC) to make the deep networks focus on clean samples instead of noisy ones. Besides, a simple yet effective multimodal loss function, called Multimodal Contrastive loss (MC), is proposed to maximize the mutual information between different modalities, thus alleviating the interference of noisy samples and cross-modal discrepancy. Extensive experiments are conducted on four widely-used multimodal datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach by comparing to 14 state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 使用吵闹标签学习跨模式检索
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,在深入的多式联运学习的帮助下,跨模式的检索正在出现,然而,即使对于单式数据而言,收集大规模有详细说明的数据成本昂贵且耗时,更不用说多种模式带来的额外挑战了。 虽然众包说明,例如亚马逊的机械土耳其语,可以用来降低标签成本,但会导致非专家说明标签中不可避免的噪音。 为了应对这一挑战,本文提出了一个通用的多模式强力学习框架,用于学习多式噪音标签,以同时减少吵闹的样本和相关的不同模式。 具体地说,我们建议大力集中损失(RC),使深层网络侧重于清洁样品,而不是吵闹的样品。 此外,还提出一个简单而有效的多式联运损失功能,称为多式对抗损失(MC),以尽量扩大不同模式之间的相互信息,从而减轻噪音样品的干扰和跨式差异。 对四套广泛使用的多式联运数据集进行了广泛的试验,通过比较14种最先进的方法,表明拟议方法的有效性。

papers.title: Learning Calibrated Medical Image Segmentation via Multi-Rater Agreement Modeling
papers.authors: Wei Ji, Shuang Yu, Junde Wu, Kai Ma, Cheng Bian, Qi Bi, Jingjing Li, Hanruo Liu, Li Cheng, Yefeng Zheng
papers.abstract: In medical image analysis, it is typical to collect multiple annotations, each from a different clinical expert or rater, in the expectation that possible diagnostic errors could be mitigated. Meanwhile, from the computer vision practitioner viewpoint, it has been a common practice to adopt the ground-truth obtained via either the majority-vote or simply one annotation from a preferred rater. This process, however, tends to overlook the rich information of agreement or disagreement ingrained in the raw multi-rater annotations. To address this issue, we propose to explicitly model the multi-rater (dis-)agreement, dubbed MRNet, which has two main contributions. First, an expertise-aware inferring module or EIM is devised to embed the expertise level of individual raters as prior knowledge, to form high-level semantic features. Second, our approach is capable of reconstructing multi-rater gradings from coarse predictions, with the multi-rater (dis-)agreement cues being further exploited to improve the segmentation performance. To our knowledge, our work is the first in producing calibrated predictions under different expertise levels for medical image segmentation. Extensive empirical experiments are conducted across five medical segmentation tasks of diverse imaging modalities. In these experiments, superior performance of our MRNet is observed comparing to the state-of-the-arts, indicating the effectiveness and applicability of our MRNet toward a wide range of medical segmentation tasks.
papers.title_zh: 通过多动力协议模型化模式校准学习校准医疗图像分割
papers.abstract_zh: 在医学图像分析中,典型的做法是从不同的临床专家或评分员收集多份注解,期望可能的诊断错误可以减轻。 同时,从计算机视觉从业者的观点来看,采用通过多数票投票或仅从首选评票者得到的地面实况记录是一种常见做法。 然而,这一进程往往忽略了原始多层说明中包含的关于协议或分歧的丰富信息,为解决这一问题,我们提议明确示范称为MRNet(MRNet)的多重(不同)协议,它有两个主要贡献。 首先,设计了一个有专门知识的引证模块或EIM, 将个人评分员的专门知识水平作为先前的知识纳入其中,形成高层次的语义特征。 第二,我们的方法能够从粗糙的预测中重建多行分级,进一步利用多行分解信号改善分化性能。 据我们所知,我们的工作是首次在不同专业水平下为医学图像分割进行校准预测,对五种不同成像模式的医学分类任务进行了广泛的实验。 在这些实验中,与最新技术相比,我们的MRNet表现优异,表明我们的MRNet对于广泛的医疗分解任务的有效性和适用性。

papers.title: Learning by Watching
papers.authors: Jimuyang Zhang, Eshed Ohn-Bar
papers.abstract: When in a new situation or geographical location, human drivers have an extraordinary ability to watch others and learn maneuvers that they themselves may have never performed. In contrast, existing techniques for learning to drive preclude such a possibility as they assume direct access to an instrumented ego-vehicle with fully known observations and expert driver actions. However, such measurements cannot be directly accessed for the non-ego vehicles when learning by watching others. Therefore, in an application where data is regarded as a highly valuable asset, current approaches completely discard the vast portion of the training data that can be potentially obtained through indirect observation of surrounding vehicles. Motivated by this key insight, we propose the Learning by Watching (LbW) framework which enables learning a driving policy without requiring full knowledge of neither the state nor expert actions. To increase its data, i.e., with new perspectives and maneuvers, LbW makes use of the demonstrations of other vehicles in a given scene by (1) transforming the ego-vehicle's observations to their points of view, and (2) inferring their expert actions. Our LbW agent learns more robust driving policies while enabling data-efficient learning, including quick adaptation of the policy to rare and novel scenarios. In particular, LbW drives robustly even with a fraction of available driving data required by existing methods, achieving an average success rate of 92% on the original CARLA benchmark with only 30 minutes of total driving data and 82% with only 10 minutes.
papers.title_zh: 观察学习
papers.abstract_zh: 当新的形势或地理位置出现时,驾驶员有非凡的能力观察他人,学习他们自己可能从未做过的动作。 相比之下,现有的学习驱动技术排除了这种可能性,因为它们可以直接接触带有完全已知观察和专家驾驶动作的仪器自制车辆,但是,非自制车辆在通过观察他人学习时不能直接获得这种测量。 因此,在将数据视为极有价值的资产的应用中,现行做法完全抛弃了通过间接观察周围车辆可能获得的大量培训数据。 在这一重要见解的推动下,我们提出了 " 观察学习 " (LbW)框架,使学习驱动政策无需完全了解国家和专家行动。 为了增加数据,即利用新的视角和操作方法,友好社利用其他车辆在特定场景的示范,即(1) 将自我车辆的观察转为其观点,(2) 推断其专家行动。 我们的LbW代理商学习更强有力的驱动政策,同时促进数据效率高的学习,包括根据罕见的新情况迅速调整政策。 特别是,即使现有方法要求的可用驾驶数据只有一小部分,而且总驾驶数据只有30分钟,平均成功率达到CARLA原基准的92%,总驾驶数据只有82%,只有10分钟。

papers.title: Learn-To-Race: A Multimodal Control Environment for Autonomous Racing
papers.authors: James Herman, Jonathan Francis, Siddha Ganju, Bingqing Chen, Anirudh Koul, Abhinav Gupta, Alexey Skabelkin, Ivan Zhukov, Max Kumskoy, Eric Nyberg
papers.abstract: Existing research on autonomous driving primarily focuses on urban driving, which is insufficient for characterising the complex driving behaviour underlying high-speed racing. At the same time, existing racing simulation frameworks struggle in capturing realism, with respect to visual rendering, vehicular dynamics, and task objectives, inhibiting the transfer of learning agents to real-world contexts. We introduce a new environment, where agents Learn-to-Race (L2R) in simulated competition-style racing, using multimodal information|from virtual cameras to a comprehensive array of inertial measurement sensors. Our environment, which includes a simulator and an interfacing training framework, accurately models vehicle dynamics and racing conditions. In this paper, we release the Arrival simulator for autonomous racing. Next, we propose the L2R task with challenging metrics, inspired by learning-to-drive challenges, Formula-style racing, and multimodal trajectory prediction for autonomous driving. Additionally, we provide the L2R framework suite, facilitating simulated racing on high-precision models of real-world tracks. Finally, we provide an official L2R task dataset of expert demonstrations, as well as a series of baseline experiments and reference implementations. We make all code available: https://github.com/learn-to-race/l2r.
papers.title_zh: 学习向种族学习:自主竞赛的多模式控制环境
papers.abstract_zh: 关于自主驾驶的现有研究主要侧重于城市驾驶,这不足以说明高速赛背后复杂的驾驶行为。 与此同时,现有的赛跑模拟框架在捕捉在视觉显示、车辆动态和任务目标方面的现实主义方面挣扎不已,阻碍了学习代理人向现实世界转移。 我们引入了一种新的环境,在模拟竞争式竞赛中,利用从虚拟相机到一系列全面的惯性测量传感器的多式联运信息,代理从“学习”到“学习”到“学习”到“学习”的新环境。 我们的环境,包括模拟器和相互连接的培训框架,精确地模拟车辆动态和赛车条件。 在本文中,我们发行了自动赛车抵达模拟器。 接下来,我们提出具有挑战性指标的L2R任务,其灵感来自从学习到驾驶的挑战、公式式的赛车和自动驾驶的多式联运轨迹预测。 此外,我们提供了L2R框架套件,为模拟模拟模拟真实世界轨道高精度模型的赛车提供了便利。 最后,我们提供了专家示范的正式L2R任务数据集,以及一系列基线试验和参考执行,我们提供了所有代码:https://github.com/learn-to-race/l2r。

papers.title: Learn To Match: Automatic Matching Network Design for Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Zhipeng Zhang, Yihao Liu, Xiao Wang, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
papers.abstract: Siamese tracking has achieved groundbreaking performance in recent years, where the essence is the efficient matching operator cross-correlation and its variants. Besides the remarkable success, it is important to note that the heuristic matching network design relies heavily on expert experience. Moreover, we experimentally find that one sole matching operator is difficult to guarantee stable tracking in all challenging environments. Thus, in this work, we introduce six novel matching operators, namely Concatenation, Pointwise-Addition, Pairwise-Relation, FiLM, Simple-Transformer and Transductive-Guidance, to explore more feasibility on matching operator selection. The analyses reveal these operators' selective adaptability on different environment degradation types, which inspires us to combine them to explore complementary features. To this end, we propose binary channel manipulation (BCM) to search for the optimal combination of these operators. BCM determines to retrain or discard one operator by learning its contribution to other tracking steps. By inserting the learned matching networks to a strong baseline tracker Ocean, our model achieves favorable gains by 67.2 -> 71.4, 52.6 -> 58.3, 70.3 -> 76.0 AUC on OTB100, LaSOT, and TrackingNet, respectively. Notably, Our tracker runs at real-time speed of 50 / 100 FPS using PyTorch / TensorRT.
papers.title_zh: 学习匹配:视觉跟踪自动匹配网络设计
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,暹罗跟踪取得了突破性业绩,其本质是高效匹配操作者交叉关系及其变体。 除了显著的成功之外,重要的是要指出,超自然匹配网络的设计严重依赖专家经验。 此外,我们试验性地发现,一个唯一的匹配操作员难以保证在所有具有挑战性的环境中进行稳定的跟踪。 因此,在这项工作中,我们引入了6个新的匹配操作员,即Concatenation、Pointwith-adtition、Pairwise-Relations、FILM、简单转换和传输指导,以探讨匹配操作员选择的更多可行性。 这些分析揭示了这些操作者对不同类型环境退化的选择性适应性,这激励我们将它们结合起来探索互补特征。 为此,我们建议双轨操纵渠道(BCM)来寻找这些操作者的最佳组合。 业连管通过学习其对其它跟踪步骤的贡献,决定对一个经营者进行再培训或丢弃。通过将学习的匹配网络插入强大的基线跟踪海洋,我们的模型分别取得了67.2 - > 71.4,52.6 - > 58.3,70.3 - > 76.0 ACUC on OTB100, LaSOT,和跟踪网络的有利收益。 值得注意的是,我们的追踪器使用PyTorrch/TensorRT,以50/100的实时速度运行。

papers.title: KING: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios for Robust Imitation via Kinematics Gradients
papers.authors: Niklas Hanselmann, Katrin Renz, Kashyap Chitta, Apratim Bhattacharyya, Andreas Geiger
papers.abstract: "Simulators offer the possibility of safe, low-cost development of self-driving systems. However, current driving simulators exhibit naïve behavior models for background traffic. Hand-tuned scenarios are typically added during simulation to induce safety-critical situations. An alternative approach is to adversarially perturb the background traffic trajectories. In this paper, we study this approach to safety-critical driving scenario generation using the CARLA simulator. We use a kinematic bicycle model as a proxy to the simulator’s true dynamics and observe that gradients through this proxy model are sufficient for optimizing the background traffic trajectories. Based on this finding, we propose KING, which generates safety-critical driving scenarios with a 20% higher success rate than black-box optimization. By solving the scenarios generated by KING using a privileged rule-based expert algorithm, we obtain training data for an imitation learning policy. After fine-tuning on this new data, we show that the policy becomes better at avoiding collisions. Importantly, our generated data leads to reduced collisions on both held-out scenarios generated via KING as well as traditional hand-crafted scenarios, demonstrating improved robustness."
papers.title_zh: KIN: 生成通过营养数学梯度进行强力模拟的安全临界驱动场景
papers.abstract_zh: “模拟器提供了安全、低成本开发自驾驶系统的可能性。然而,目前的驾驶模拟器展示了背景交通的天性行为模型。模拟时通常会增加手调假想,以诱发安全危急情况。 另一种办法是对抗性干扰背景交通轨迹。 在本文中,我们研究了使用CARLA模拟器生成安全临界驾驶情景的方法。 我们使用运动式自行车模型作为模拟器真实动态的替代物,并观察到通过这种代用模型的梯度足以优化背景交通轨迹。 基于这一发现,我们建议英国王室制造安全临界驾驶方案,其成功率比黑匣子优化率高20%。 通过解决英国王室使用特权规则专家算法产生的方案,我们获得了模拟学习政策的培训数据。 在对这一新数据进行微调后,我们发现该政策在避免碰撞方面变得更好。 重要的是,我们生成的数据可以减少通过烹饪以及传统手工制作的两种预设情景的碰撞,从而显示出更强健。 ”

papers.title: Improving Robustness Against Common Corruptions With Frequency Biased Models
papers.authors: Tonmoy Saikia, Cordelia Schmid, Thomas Brox
papers.abstract: CNNs perform remarkably well when the training and test distributions are i.i.d, but unseen image corruptions can cause a surprisingly large drop in performance. In various real scenarios, unexpected distortions, such as random noise, compression artefacts, or weather distortions are common phenomena. Improving performance on corrupted images must not result in degraded i.i.d performance - a challenge faced by many state-of-the-art robust approaches. Image corruption types have different characteristics in the frequency spectrum and would benefit from a targeted type of data augmentation, which, however, is often unknown during training. In this paper, we introduce a mixture of two expert models specializing in high and low-frequency robustness, respectively. Moreover, we propose a new regularization scheme that minimizes the total variation (TV) of convolution feature-maps to increase high-frequency robustness. The approach improves on corrupted images without degrading in-distribution performance. We demonstrate this on ImageNet-C and also for real-world corruptions on an automotive dataset, both for object classification and object detection.
papers.title_zh: 提高对付常见的腐败的有力性,采用频繁、有偏见模式
papers.abstract_zh: 有线电视新闻网在培训和测试发布信息时表现非常出色,但隐形图像腐败可能导致令人惊讶的性能大幅下降。 在各种真实情况下,意外失真(如随机噪音、压缩手工艺品或天气失真)是常见现象。 改善对腐败图像的绩效决不能导致劣质性能,这是许多最先进的稳健方法面临的一项挑战。 图像腐败类型在频谱方面有不同的特征,并将受益于有针对性的数据扩充类型,然而,在培训期间往往不为人所知。 在本文中,我们采用了两种分别专门研究高频和低频稳健性的专家模型的组合。 此外,我们提出了一个新的正规化计划,最大限度地减少变异特征图的总体变化(TV ) , 以提高高频稳健性。 这种方法可以改善腐败形象,而不会降低分配中的绩效。 我们在图像网络-C上展示了这一点,在汽车数据集上也展示了真实世界的腐败,既用于物体分类,也用于物体探测。

papers.title: Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse Response Synthesis
papers.authors: Nikhil Singh, Jeff Mentch, Jerry Ng, Matthew Beveridge, Iddo Drori
papers.abstract: Measuring the acoustic characteristics of a space is often done by capturing its impulse response (IR), a representation of how a full-range stimulus sound excites it. This work generates an IR from a single image, which can then be applied to other signals using convolution, simulating the reverberant characteristics of the space shown in the image. Recording these IRs is both time-intensive and expensive, and often infeasible for inaccessible locations. We use an end-to-end neural network architecture to generate plausible audio impulse responses from single images of acoustic environments. We evaluate our method both by comparisons to ground truth data and by human expert evaluation. We demonstrate our approach by generating plausible impulse responses from diverse settings and formats including well known places, musical halls, rooms in paintings, images from animations and computer games, synthetic environments generated from text, panoramic images, and video conference backgrounds.
papers.title_zh: 图像2Reverb:跨模式变换器 脉冲反应合成
papers.abstract_zh: 测量空间的声学特征,往往通过捕捉其脉冲反应(IR)来进行,这说明全程刺激措施的声势如何刺激空间。 此工作从单一图像生成IR, 然后它可以应用到其他信号中, 使用 Convolution, 模拟图像中显示的空间的反动特性 。 记录这些IR, 既费时又昂贵, 也常常无法进入无法进入的地点 。 我们使用端到端神经网络架构,从单一的声学环境图像中产生可信的音频脉冲反应。 我们通过比较地面真实数据和人类专家评估来评估我们的方法。 我们从各种环境和形式,包括众所周知的地方、音乐厅、绘画室、动画和计算机游戏的图像、文本产生的合成环境、全景图像和视频会议背景,提出可信的积极反应,以此展示我们的做法。

papers.title: Image Inpainting via Conditional Texture and Structure Dual Generation
papers.authors: Xiefan Guo, Hongyu Yang, Di Huang
papers.abstract: Deep generative approaches have recently made considerable progress in image inpainting by introducing structure priors. Due to the lack of proper interaction with image texture during structure reconstruction, however, current solutions are incompetent in handling the cases with large corruptions, and they generally suffer from distorted results. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stream network for image inpainting, which models the structure-constrained texture synthesis and texture-guided structure reconstruction in a coupled manner so that they better leverage each other for more plausible generation. Furthermore, to enhance the global consistency, a Bi-directional Gated Feature Fusion (Bi-GFF) module is designed to exchange and combine the structure and texture information and a Contextual Feature Aggregation (CFA) module is developed to refine the generated contents by region affinity learning and multi-scale feature aggregation. Qualitative and quantitative experiments on the CelebA, Paris StreetView and Places2 datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiefan-Guo/CTSDG.
papers.title_zh: 通过有条件的质质和结构两代来油漆图像
papers.abstract_zh: 深层基因方法最近通过引入结构前科,在图像绘画方面取得了相当大的进展。 然而,由于在结构重建期间没有与图像质地进行适当互动,目前的解决办法在处理大量腐败案件时无能为力,而且通常受到失真的结果的影响。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个新型的两流图像绘画网络,将结构受限制的质地合成和质地制导结构重建结合起来,从而更好地相互利用,促进更合理的一代人。 此外,为加强全球一致性,设计了一个双向地貌特征融合模块(Bi-GFF),以交流和合并结构和质地信息,并开发了一个背景地貌特征聚合模块,以完善通过区域亲近学习和多尺度特征汇总生成的内容。 关于CelebA、Paris Street View and Places2 数据集的定性和定量实验显示了拟议方法的优越性,我们的代码见https://github.com/Xiefan-Guo/CTSDG。

papers.title: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates With Differentiable Polarization
papers.authors: Yi Guo, Huan Yuan, Jianchao Tan, Zhangyang Wang, Sen Yang, Ji Liu
papers.abstract: Model compression techniques are recently gaining explosive attention for obtaining efficient AI models for various real time applications. Channel pruning is one important compression strategy, and widely used in slimming various DNNs. Previous gate-based or importance-based pruning methods aim to remove channels whose "importance" are smallest. However, it remains unclear what criteria the channel importance should be measured on, leading to various channel selection heuristics. Some other sampling-based pruning methods deploy sampling strategy to train sub-nets, which often causes the training instability and the compressed model's degraded performance. In view of the research gaps, we present a new module named Gates with Differentiable Polarization (GDP), inspired by principled optimization ideas. GDP can be plugged before convolutional layers without bells and whistles, to control the on-and-off of each channel or whole layer block. During the training process, the polarization effect will drive a subset of gates to smoothly decrease to exactly zero, while other gates gradually stay away from zero by a large margin. When training terminates, those zero-gated channels can be painlessly removed, while other non-zero gates can be absorbed into the succeeding convolution kernel, causing completely no interruption to training nor damage to the trained model. Experiments conducted over CIFAR-10 and ImageNet datasets show that the proposed GDP algorithm achieves the state-of-the-art performance on various benchmark DNNs at a broad range of pruning ratios. We also apply GDP to DeepLabV3Plus-ResNet50 on the challenging Pascal VOC segmentation task, whose test performance sees no drop (even slightly improved) with over 60% FLOPs saving.
papers.title_zh: GDP: 稳定神经网络网络,通过有区别极化的大门环绕
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,模型压缩技术在为各种实时应用获得高效的AI模型方面正受到爆炸性关注。 频道切割是一个重要的压缩策略,广泛用于缩小各种DNN。 先前的基于大门或基于重要性的修剪方法旨在清除“重要性”最小的频道。 然而,仍不清楚该频道的重要性应该以什么标准来衡量,从而导致各种频道选择超常性。 其他一些基于取样的裁剪方法则采用取样战略来训练次网,这往往造成训练不稳定和压缩模型的退化性能。 鉴于研究差距,我们提出了一个新模块,名为“带差异极化的盖茨 ” ( Gates ) , 受原则优化理念的启发。 GDP可以在没有钟声和哨声的情况下,在进化层之前插入,以控制每个频道或整个层块的开关和关闭。 在培训过程中,两极分化效应将促使一小撮大门顺利地减少到零,而其他大门则会以大幅度距离零而逐渐远离零。 当培训结束时,这些零通道可以无痛地拆除,而其他非零门可以吸收到随后的革命内核中,完全不会中断培训,也不会损害经过训练的模式。 在CIFAR-10和图像网络数据集方面进行的实验表明,拟议的GDP算法在各种基准DNN上以广泛的速率实现了SOTA 性能。 我们还将GDP用于DhiepLabV3Plus-ResNet50,用于具有挑战性的Pascal VOC分割任务,其测试性能没有下降(甚至略有改善),超过60%的FLOP储蓄率。

papers.title: Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection From Temporal Illumination Cues
papers.authors: Frank Julca-Aguilar, Jason Taylor, Mario Bijelic, Fahim Mannan, Ethan Tseng, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: Today's state-of-the-art methods for 3D object detection are based on lidar, stereo, or monocular cameras. Lidar-based methods achieve the best accuracy, but have a large footprint, high cost, and mechanically-limited angular sampling rates, resulting in low spatial resolution at long ranges. Recent approaches using low-cost monocular or stereo cameras promise to overcome these limitations but struggle in low-light or low-contrast regions as they rely on passive CMOS sensors. We propose a novel 3D object detection modality that exploits temporal illumination cues from a low-cost monocular gated imager. We introduce a novel deep detection architecture, Gated3D, that is tailored to temporal illumination cues in gated images. This modality allows us to exploit mature 2D object feature extractors that guide the 3D predictions through a frustum segment estimation. We assess the proposed method experimentally on a 3D detection dataset that includes gated images captured over 10,000 km of driving data. We validate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art monocular and stereo methods, opening up a new sensor modality as an avenue to replace lidar in autonomous driving. https://light.princeton.edu/gated3d
papers.title_zh: Gated3D: 利用时光光化陶瓷探测单体三维物体
papers.abstract_zh: 今天最先进的3D物体探测方法以利达尔、立体或单望远镜摄像机为基础。 以利达尔为基础的方法最准确,但足迹大、成本高、角采样率机械有限,导致远距离空间分辨率低。 最近使用低成本单筒摄像机或立体摄像机的做法有望克服这些限制,但在低光或低争议地区,它们依赖被动的 CMOS 传感器而挣扎。 我们提出一种新的3D 物体探测模式,利用低成本单筒锁定成像仪的时光照明信号。 我们引入了一种新的深层探测结构Gated3D,它适合闭门图像中的时间照明信号。这个模式使我们能够利用成熟的 2D 对象特征提取器,通过粗糙部分估计来指导3D 预测。 我们在3D探测数据集上对拟议方法进行了实验评估,其中包括10 000公里以上的驾驶数据采集的闭门图像。 我们确认,我们的方法优于最先进的单筒和立体法,开启了一种新的传感器模式,以取代自动驾驶的Lidar。 http://light.prienceton.edu/gated3d https://light.princton.edu/gated3d https://light.princton.edu/gated3d https://light.

papers.title: Gated Spatio-Temporal Attention-Guided Video Deblurring
papers.authors: Maitreya Suin, A. N. Rajagopalan
papers.abstract: Video deblurring remains a challenging task due to the complexity of spatially and temporally varying blur. Most of the existing works depend on implicit or explicit alignment for temporal information fusion, which either increases the computational cost or results in suboptimal performance due to misalignment. In this work, we investigate two key factors responsible for deblurring quality: how to fuse spatio-temporal information and from where to collect it. We propose a factorized gated spatio-temporal attention module to perform non-local operations across space and time to fully utilize the available information without depending on alignment. First, we perform spatial aggregation followed by a temporal aggregation step. Next, we adaptively distribute the global spatio-temporal information to each pixel. It shows superior performance compared to existing non-local fusion techniques while being considerably more efficient. To complement the attention module, we propose a reinforcement learning-based framework for selecting keyframes from the neighborhood with the most complementary and useful information. Moreover, our adaptive approach can increase or decrease the frame usage at inference time, depending on the user's need. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method.
papers.title_zh: Gated Spadio- 时时注意- 引导视频稀释
papers.abstract_zh: 由于空间和时间差异模糊性的复杂性,录像破碎仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。 大部分现有工程取决于时间信息聚合的隐含或明确一致,这要么增加了计算成本,要么由于不匹配导致业绩不优化。 在这项工作中,我们调查了造成质量混乱的两个关键因素:如何结合时空信息以及从何处收集这些信息。 我们提出一个因子化封闭的时空注意模块,用于在空间和时间上开展非本地行动,以充分利用现有信息,而不取决于是否对齐。 首先,我们进行空间汇总,然后是时间汇总步骤。 其次,我们适应性地向每个像素传播全球时空空间信息。它比现有的非本地聚变技术表现更好,但效率要高得多。 为了补充关注模块,我们提出了一个基于强化学习的框架,从周边选择具有最互补和最有用信息的关键框架。 此外,根据用户的需要,我们的适应性方法可以增加或减少推论时间框架的使用。 关于多个数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法具有优越性。

papers.title: FrameExit: Conditional Early Exiting for Efficient Video Recognition
papers.authors: Amir Ghodrati, Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi, Amirhossein Habibian
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a conditional early exiting framework for efficient video recognition. While existing works focus on selecting a subset of salient frames to reduce the computation costs, we propose to use a simple sampling strategy combined with conditional early exiting to enable efficient recognition. Our model automatically learns to process fewer frames for simpler videos and more frames for complex ones. To achieve this, we employ a cascade of gating modules to automatically determine the earliest point in processing where an inference is sufficiently reliable. We generate on-the-fly supervision signals to the gates to provide a dynamic trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. Our proposed model outperforms competing methods on three large-scale video benchmarks. In particular, on ActivityNet1.3 and mini-kinetics, we outperform the state-of-the-art efficient video recognition methods with 1.3x and 2.1x less GFLOPs, respectively. Additionally, our method sets a new state of the art for efficient video understanding on the HVU benchmark.
papers.title_zh: FrameExit: 高效视频识别的有条件提前退出
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了高效视频识别的有条件提前退出框架。 虽然现有的工程侧重于选择一组显著框架来降低计算成本,但我们建议使用简单的抽样战略,同时有条件提前退出,以便有效识别。 我们的模型自动学会处理更简单的视频框架和复杂视频框架。 为了实现这一目标,我们使用一系列格子模块自动确定处理中的最早点,只要推断足够可靠。 我们向大门发出现场监督信号,以便在准确性和计算成本之间实现动态权衡。 我们提出的模型在三个大型视频基准上优于相互竞争的方法。 特别是,在活动Net1.3和微型动能学上,我们的表现优于最先进的高效视频识别方法,分别为1.3x和2.1x的GFLOPs,此外,我们的方法为高效视频理解HVU基准设定了新的最新水平。

papers.title: Field-Guide-Inspired Zero-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Utkarsh Mall, Bharath Hariharan, Kavita Bala
papers.abstract: Modern recognition systems require large amounts of supervision to achieve accuracy. Adapting to new domains requires significant data from experts, which is onerous and can become too expensive. Zero-shot learning requires an annotated set of attributes for a novel category. Annotating the full set of attributes for a novel category proves to be a tedious and expensive task in deployment. This is especially the case when the recognition domain is an expert domain. We introduce a new field-guide-inspired approach to zero-shot annotation where the learner model interactively asks for the most useful attributes that define a class. We evaluate our method on classification benchmarks with attribute annotations like CUB, SUN, and AWA2 and show that our model achieves the performance of a model with full annotations at the cost of a significantly fewer number of annotations. Since the time of experts is precious, decreasing annotation cost can be very valuable for real-world deployment.
papers.title_zh: 外地指导启发零热学习
papers.abstract_zh: 现代识别系统需要大量的监督才能达到准确性。 适应新领域需要来自专家的大量数据,这些数据十分繁琐,可能变得太昂贵。 零镜头学习需要一套附加说明的新类别属性。 批注一个新类别的全部属性证明在部署中是一项乏味和昂贵的任务,当承认域是一个专家域时尤其如此。 我们采用一种新的实地指导办法,对零弹记事进行零弹记事说明,即学习者模型互动要求确定一个类别最有用的属性。 我们用CUB、SUN和AW2等属性说明来评价我们的分类基准方法,并表明我们的模型以少得多的说明为代价,实现了配有完整说明的模型的性能。 由于专家的时间宝贵,减少说明费用对于实际部署来说可能非常宝贵。

papers.title: Exploiting Sample Correlation for Crowd Counting With Multi-Expert Network
papers.authors: Xinyan Liu, Guorong Li, Zhenjun Han, Weigang Zhang, Yifan Yang, Qingming Huang, Nicu Sebe
papers.abstract: Crowd counting is a difficult task because of the diversity of scenes. Most of the existing crowd counting methods adopt complex structures with massive backbones to enhance the generalization ability. Unfortunately, the performance of existing methods on large-scale data sets is not satisfactory. In order to handle various scenarios with less complex network, we explored how to efficiently use the multi-expert model for crowd counting tasks. We mainly focus on how to train more efficient expert networks and how to choose the most suitable expert. Specifically, we propose a task-driven similarity metric based on sample's mutual enhancement, referred as co-fine-tune similarity, which can find a more efficient subset of data for training the expert network. Similar samples are considered as a cluster which is used to obtain parameters of an expert. Besides, to make better use of the proposed method, we design a simple network called FPN with Deconvolution Counting Network, which is a more suitable base model for the multi-expert counting network. Experimental results show that multiple experts FDC (MFDC) achieves the best performance on four public data sets, including the large scale NWPU-Crowd data set. Furthermore, the MFDC trained on an extensive dense crowd data set can generalize well on the other data sets without extra training or fine-tuning.
papers.title_zh: 利用多专家网络的人群计数样本关联
papers.abstract_zh: 计票是一项艰巨的任务,因为场景多种多样。 大部分现有计票方法都采用复杂的结构,用庞大的骨干来增强一般化能力。 不幸的是,现有大规模数据集方法的绩效不尽人意。 为了处理网络不那么复杂的各种情况,我们探讨了如何有效地利用多专家模式进行计票工作,我们主要侧重于如何培训效率更高的专家网络以及如何选择最合适的专家。 具体地说,我们根据样本的相互增强,提出一个任务驱动的类似性衡量标准,称为共同型相似性,它可以找到一个更有效的数据子集,用于培训专家网络,类似的样本被视为一个用来获取专家参数的集群。 此外,为了更好地利用拟议方法,我们设计了一个简单的网络,称为FPN和Decconvolution Counting网络,这是多专家计算网络更合适的基础模型。 实验结果表明,多种专家FDC(FDC)在四套公共数据集方面表现最佳,包括大规模NWPU-人群数据集,此外,在广泛密集人群数据集方面受过培训的MFDC可以在没有额外培训或微调的情况下对其他数据集进行全面概括。

papers.title: Evolving Search Space for Neural Architecture Search
papers.authors: Yuanzheng Ci, Chen Lin, Ming Sun, Boyu Chen, Hongwen Zhang, Wanli Ouyang
papers.abstract: Automation of neural architecture design has been a coveted alternative to human experts. Various search methods have been proposed aiming to find the optimal architecture in the search space. One would expect the search results to improve when the search space grows larger since it would potentially contain more performant candidates. Surprisingly, we observe that enlarging search space is unbeneficial or even detrimental to existing NAS methods such as DARTS, ProxylessNAS, and SPOS. This counterintuitive phenomenon suggests that enabling existing methods to large search space regimes is non-trivial. However, this problem is less discussed in the literature. We present a Neural Search-space Evolution (NSE) scheme, the first neural architecture search scheme designed especially for large space neural architecture search problems. The necessity of a well-designed search space with constrained size is a tacit consent in existing methods, and our NSE aims at minimizing such necessity. Specifically, the NSE starts with a search space subset, then evolves the search space by repeating two steps: 1) search an optimized space from the search space subset, 2) refill this subset from a large pool of operations that are not traversed. We further extend the flexibility of obtainable architectures by introducing a learnable multi-branch setting. With the proposed method, we achieve 77.3% top-1 retrain accuracy on ImageNet with 333M FLOPs, which yielded a state-of-the-art performance among previous auto-generated architectures that do not involve knowledge distillation or weight pruning. When the latency constraint is adopted, our result also performs better than the previous best-performing mobile models with a 77.9% Top-1 retrain accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/orashi/NSE_NAS.
papers.title_zh: 神经建筑搜索不断发展的搜索空间
papers.abstract_zh: 神经结构设计自动化是人类专家的一种令人羡慕的替代方法,提出了各种搜索方法,旨在寻找搜索空间的最佳建筑。 令人惊讶的是,我们发现,扩大搜索空间无济于事,甚至有损于现有的NAS方法,如DARTS、代理无氧NAS和SPOS等。 当搜索空间扩大后,搜索结果将会有所改进,因为搜索空间可能包含更多有色人种的候选人。 令人惊讶的是,我们发现,扩大搜索空间无益,甚至有害于现有的NAS方法,如DARTS、代理无氧NAS和SPOS。 这种反直觉现象表明,使现有方法能够用于大型搜索空间制度是非三重性的,但在文献中对这一问题的讨论较少。 我们提出了一个神经搜索空间演变计划,这是第一个专门为大型空间神经结构搜索问题设计的神经结构搜索计划。 在现有方法中,一个设计周密、规模有限的搜索空间的必要性是一种默认,我们的国家安全体系旨在最大限度地减少这种必要性。 具体地说,国家空间局从一个搜索空间子集开始,然后通过重复两个步骤来改变搜索空间:1)从搜索空间子集中搜索一个优化的空间,2)从大量未穿越的作业库中再填充这一子集。 我们通过引入一个可学习的多部门环境,进一步扩大可获取架构的灵活性。 使用拟议方法,我们实现了图像网络上上上层1级再培训准确率的77.3%,拥有333M FLOPs,在以往自动生成的不涉及知识蒸馏或重量裁剪的架构中产生了最先进的性能。 当延缓限制被采纳时,我们的结果也比以往表现最佳的移动模型表现更好,达到77.9%的顶级一级再培训精确度。 代码可在https://github.com/orashi/NSE_NAS上查阅。

papers.title: End-to-End Urban Driving by Imitating a Reinforcement Learning Coach
papers.authors: Zhejun Zhang, Alexander Liniger, Dengxin Dai, Fisher Yu, Luc Van Gool
papers.abstract: End-to-end approaches to autonomous driving commonly rely on expert demonstrations. Although humans are good drivers, they are not good coaches for end-to-end algorithms that demand dense on-policy supervision. On the contrary, automated experts that leverage privileged information can efficiently generate large scale on-policy and off-policy demonstrations. However, existing automated experts for urban driving make heavy use of hand-crafted rules and perform suboptimally even on driving simulators, where ground-truth information is available. To address these issues, we train a reinforcement learning expert that maps bird's-eye view images to continuous low-level actions. While setting a new performance upper-bound on CARLA, our expert is also a better coach that provides informative supervision signals for imitation learning agents to learn from. Supervised by our reinforcement learning coach, a baseline end-to-end agent with monocular camera-input achieves expert-level performance. Our end-to-end agent achieves a 78% success rate while generalizing to a new town and new weather on the NoCrash-dense benchmark and state-of-the-art performance on the more challenging CARLA LeaderBoard.
papers.title_zh: 利用强化学习教练,推动端至端城市发展
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶的端对端方法通常依赖于专家演示。 尽管人类是好的驱动力,但它们不是需要密集政策监督的端对端算法的好导师。 相反,利用特权信息的自动化专家能够有效地产生大规模的政策和非政策示范。 然而,现有的城市驾驶自动化专家大量使用手工制作的规则,甚至在有地面真实信息的情况下,甚至驾驶模拟器也进行副最佳操作。 为解决这些问题,我们培训了一名强化学习专家,该专家将鸟眼图像绘制成持续低水平行动的地图。 在为CARLA设定新的最高性能时,我们的专家还是一个更好的导师,为模仿学习者提供信息化的监督信号,以便学习学习。 在我们的强化学习导师(一个具有单眼摄像投入的基线端对端代理)的监督下,专家级的成绩是专家级的。 我们的端对端代理取得了78%的成功率,同时将新城镇和新天气概括到 " 无崩溃感 " 基准上,并在更具有挑战性的CARLA领袖博ard上取得SOTA 性能。

papers.title: End-to-End High Dynamic Range Camera Pipeline Optimization
papers.authors: Nicolas Robidoux, Luis E. Garcia Capel, Dong-eun Seo, Avinash Sharma, Federico Ariza, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: With a 280 dB dynamic range, the real world is a High Dynamic Range (HDR) world. Today's sensors cannot record this dynamic range in a single shot. Instead, HDR cameras acquire multiple measurements with different exposures, gains and photodiodes, from which an Image Signal Processor (ISP) reconstructs an HDR image. HDR image recovery for dynamic scenes is an open challenge because of motion and because stitched captures have different noise characteristics, resulting in artefacts that the ISP has to resolve---in real time and at triple-digit megapixel resolutions. Traditionally, hardware ISP settings used by downstream vision modules have been chosen by domain experts. Such frozen camera designs are then used for training data acquisition and supervised learning of downstream vision modules. We depart from this paradigm and formulate HDR ISP hyperparameter search as an end-to-end optimization problem. We propose a mixed 0th and 1st-order block coordinate descent optimizer to jointly learn ISP and detector network weights using RAW image data augmented with emulated SNR transition region artefacts. We assess the proposed method for human vision and image understanding. For automotive object detection, the method improves mAP and mAR by 33% compared to expert-tuning and by 22% compared to recent state-of-the-art. The method is validated in an HDR laboratory rig and in the field, outperforming conventional handcrafted HDR imaging and vision pipelines in all experiments.
papers.title_zh: 端端至端端动态高射程相机管道优化
papers.abstract_zh: 以280 dB 动态范围,真实世界是一个高动态范围的世界。 今天的传感器无法将这一动态范围记录在一次镜头中。 相反,《人类发展报告》相机通过不同曝光量、收益和光谱获得多重测量,图像信号处理器(ISP)从中重建了《人类发展报告》的图像。 动态场景的《人类发展报告》图像恢复是一个公开的挑战,因为动态,而且缝合的捕捉具有不同的噪音特征,导致ISP必须实时解决的人工制品问题,并产生三位数的巨型像素分辨率。 传统上,下游视觉模块使用的硬件ISP设置由域专家选择,然后这些冷冻相机设计用于培训数据采集和下游视觉模块的监督学习。 我们从这个模式出发,把《人类发展报告》ISP超参数搜索设计成一个端到端优化问题。 我们提出一个混合的0级和1级连接点协调下层优化器,以联合学习ISP和检测器网络重量,使用RAW图像数据,再加之SNR转型区域复制品。 我们评估了人类视觉和图像理解的拟议方法。 在汽车物体探测方面,该方法比专家调整改进了33%的MAP和MAR, 与最近的最新技术相比则改进了22%的MAP和MAR。 该方法在《人类发展报告》实验室设备中和实地得到验证,在所有实验中都比传统的手工制作的《人类发展报告》成像和视觉管道表现得更好。

papers.title: End-to-end Dynamic Matching Network for Multi-view Multi-person 3d Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Congzhentao Huang, Shuai Jiang, Yang Li, Ziyue Zhang, Jason Traish, Chen Deng, Sam Ferguson, Richard Yi Da Xu
papers.abstract: As an important computer vision task, 3d human pose estimation in a multi-camera, multi-person setting has received widespread attention and many interesting applications have been derived from it. Traditional approaches use a 3d pictorial structure model to handle this task. However, these models suffer from high computation costs and result in low accuracy in joint detection. Recently, especially since the introduction of Deep Neural Networks, one popular approach is to build a pipeline that involves three separate steps: (1) 2d skeleton detection in each camera view, (2) identification of matched 2d skeletons and (3) estimation of the 3d poses. Many existing works operate by feeding the 2d images and camera parameters through the three modules in a cascade fashion. However, all three operations can be highly correlated. For example, the 3d generation results may affect the results of detection in step 1, as does the matching algorithm in step 2. To address this phenomenon, we propose a novel end-to-end training scheme that brings the three separate modules into a single model. However, one outstanding problem of doing so is that the matching algorithm in step 2 appears to disjoint the pipeline. Therefore, we take our inspiration from the recent success in Capsule Networks, in which its Dynamic Routing step is also disjointed, but plays a crucial role in deciding how gradients are flowed from the upper to the lower layers. Similarly, a dynamic matching module in our work also decides the paths in which gradients flow from step 3 to step 1. Furthermore, as a large number of cameras are present, the existing matching algorithm either fails to deliver a robust performance or can be very inefficient. Thus, we additionally propose a novel matching algorithm that can match 2d poses from multiple views efficiently. The algorithm is robust and able to deal with situations of incomplete and false 2d detection as well."
papers.title_zh: 多视图多人3d Pose估计的端端对端动态匹配网络
papers.abstract_zh: 作为一项重要的计算机视觉任务,在多镜头、多人环境中的3D人构成估计得到了广泛的关注,并由此产生了许多有趣的应用。 传统方法使用3d图片结构模型来完成这项任务。 然而,这些模型的计算成本高,导致联合探测的准确性低。 最近,特别是自引进深神经网络以来,一种流行的做法是建造一条管道,其中涉及三个不同的步骤:(1) 每一摄像头查看两具骨架,(2) 辨认匹配的两具骨架,(3) 估计三具骨架。 许多现有工程通过以级联方式通过三个模块输入2D图像和相机参数来运作,但所有三个操作都可能高度相关。例如,3D生成结果可能影响第1步的检测结果,第2步的匹配算法也会影响第1步的检测结果。 为了解决这一现象,我们提出了一个新的端对端培训计划,将三个不同的单元变成一个单一模式。 但是,一个突出的未决问题是第2步的匹配算法似乎使管道脱节。 因此,我们从最近在Capsule网络中取得的成功中得到启发,在该网络中,其动态路由步骤也脱节,但在决定梯度如何从上层流向下层方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 同样,我们工作中的动态匹配模块也决定梯度从第3步流向第1步的路径。 此外,由于存在大量照相机,现有的匹配算法要么不能提供强力性能,要么效率非常低。 因此,我们又提议了一种新的匹配算法,它能有效匹配来自多种观点的2D配置。 算法是健全的,能够处理不完整和虚假的2D检测情况。 ”

papers.title: Dynamic Dual Gating Neural Networks
papers.authors: Fanrong Li, Gang Li, Xiangyu He, Jian Cheng
papers.abstract: In dynamic neural networks that adapt computations to different inputs, gating-based methods have demonstrated notable generality and applicability in trading-off the model complexity and accuracy. However, existing works only explore the redundancy from a single point of the network, limiting the performance. In this paper, we propose dual gating, a new dynamic computing method, to reduce the model complexity at run-time. For each convolutional block, dual gating identifies the informative features along two separate dimensions, spatial and channel. Specifically, the spatial gating module estimates which areas are essential, and the channel gating module predicts the salient channels that contribute more to the results. Then the computation of both unimportant regions and irrelevant channels can be skipped dynamically during inference. Extensive experiments on a variety of datasets demonstrate that our method can achieve higher accuracy under similar computing budgets compared with other dynamic execution methods. In particular, dynamic dual gating can provide 59.7% saving in computing of ResNet50 with 76.41% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, which has advanced the state-of-the-art.
papers.title_zh: 动态双向神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在根据不同投入调整计算结果的动态神经网络中,基于格子的方法表明,模型的复杂性和准确性在取舍中具有显著的普遍性和适用性,但是,现有的工程只探讨网络单一点的冗余,限制了性能。 在本文中,我们提出了一种新的动态计算方法 — — 双格化,以降低运行时的模型复杂性。 对于每个进化区块,双格化将信息特性分为两个不同的维度,即空间和通道。 具体地说,空间定位模块估计哪些区域是必需的,而频道定位模块则预测对结果有更大贡献的显著渠道。 然后,在推断期间,可以动态跳过对不重要区域和无关渠道的计算。 对各种数据集的广泛试验表明,与其他动态执行方法相比,我们的方法在类似计算预算下可以达到更高的准确度。 尤其是,动态双层格子可以在ResNet50的计算中节省59.7%,图像网的准确度达到76.41%的顶层1级,这已经发展到了最新水平。

papers.title: Do Image Classifiers Generalize Across Time?
papers.authors: Vaishaal Shankar, Achal Dave, Rebecca Roelofs, Deva Ramanan, Benjamin Recht, Ludwig Schmidt
papers.abstract: Vision models notoriously flicker when applied to videos: they correctly recognize objects in some frames, but fail on perceptually similar, nearby frames. In this work, we systematically analyze the robustness of image classifiers to such temporal perturbations in videos. To do so, we construct two new datasets, ImageNet-Vid-Robust and YTBB-Robust, containing a total of 57,897 images grouped into 3,139 sets of perceptually similar images. Our datasets were derived from ImageNet-Vid and YouTube-BB, respectively, and thoroughly re-annotated by human experts for image similarity. We evaluate a diverse array of classifiers pre-trained on ImageNet and show a median classification accuracy drop of 16 and 10 points, respectively, on our two datasets. Additionally, we evaluate three detection models and show that natural perturbations induce both classification as well as localization errors, leading to a median drop in detection mAP of 14 points. Our analysis demonstrates that perturbations occurring naturally in videos pose a substantial and realistic challenge to deploying convolutional neural networks in environments that require both reliable and low-latency predictions.
papers.title_zh: 图像分类器是否全面化 ?
papers.abstract_zh: 当应用到视频时,视觉模型会以臭名昭著的方式闪烁:它们正确地识别了某些框中的物体,但是在概念相似的附近框架上却失败了。 在这项工作中,我们系统地分析图像分类者对视频中这种时间扰动的坚固性。 为此,我们新建了两套新的数据集,即图像网-维德-罗布斯特和YTBB-罗布斯特,共包含57,897张图像,分为3,139套概念相似的图像。 我们的数据集分别取自图像网-维德和YouTube-BB, 人类专家对图像相似性作了彻底的重新说明。 我们评估了在图像网络上接受过培训的各类分类人员,显示我们两个数据集的分类精度中位数分别下降了16分和10分。 此外,我们评估了三个探测模型,并表明自然扰动诱发分类和定位错误,导致探测 mAP中位下降14点。 我们的分析表明,视频中自然发生的扰动对在需要可靠和低时空预测的环境中部署进化神经网络构成实质性和现实的挑战。

papers.title: Discover the Unknown Biased Attribute of an Image Classifier
papers.authors: Zhiheng Li, Chenliang Xu
papers.abstract: Recent works find that AI algorithms learn biases from data. Therefore, it is urgent and vital to identify biases in AI algorithms. However, the previous bias identification pipeline overly relies on human experts to conjecture potential biases (e.g., gender), which may neglect other underlying biases not realized by humans. To help human experts better find the AI algorithms' biases, we study a new problem in this work -- for a classifier that predicts a target attribute of the input image, discover its unknown biased attribute. To solve this challenging problem, we use a hyperplane in the generative model's latent space to represent an image attribute; thus, the original problem is transformed to optimizing the hyperplane's normal vector and offset. We propose a novel total-variation loss within this framework as the objective function and a new orthogonalization penalty as a constraint. The latter prevents trivial solutions in which the discovered biased attribute is identical with the target or one of the known-biased attributes. Extensive experiments on both disentanglement datasets and real-world datasets show that our method can discover biased attributes and achieve better disentanglement w.r.t. target attributes. Furthermore, the qualitative results show that our method can discover unnoticeable biased attributes for various object and scene classifiers, proving our method's generalizability for detecting biased attributes in diverse domains of images.
papers.title_zh: 发现一个图像分类器的未知比对属性
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的工作发现,AI 算法从数据中吸取偏差。 因此,确定AI 算法中的偏差是迫切和关键的。 然而,先前的偏见识别管道过分依赖人类专家来推测潜在的偏见(如性别),这可能忽视人类没有认识到的其他潜在偏见。 为了帮助人类专家更好地发现 AI 算法的偏差, 我们研究这个工作中的一个新问题-- 对于一个分类者来说, 用来预测输入图像的目标属性, 发现它未知的偏差属性。 为了解决这一具有挑战性的问题,我们利用基因模型潜在空间中的高空飞机来代表图像属性;因此,原始问题转变为优化高空机的正常矢量和抵消。 在此框架内,我们提出以新的全变法损失作为客观功能,并作为一种约束,新的整形处罚,后者防止了一些无关紧要的解决办法,在这种解决办法中,发现的偏见属性与目标或已知的偏见属性相同。 有关分解数据集和真实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法可以发现偏向性特征,并实现更好的分解目标属性。 此外,质量结果显示,我们的方法可以发现各种对象和场景分类者的不可察觉的偏见属性,证明我们的方法在发现不同图像领域的偏见属性方面具有普遍性。

papers.title: Differentiable Dynamic Wirings for Neural Networks
papers.authors: Kun Yuan, Quanquan Li, Shaopeng Guo, Dapeng Chen, Aojun Zhou, Fengwei Yu, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: A standard practice of deploying deep neural networks is to apply the same architecture to all the input instances. However, a fixed architecture may not be suitable for different data with high diversity. To boost the model capacity, existing methods usually employ larger convolutional kernels or deeper network layers, which incurs prohibitive computational costs. In this paper, we address this issue by proposing Differentiable Dynamic Wirings (DDW), which learns the instance-aware connectivity that creates different wiring patterns for different instances. 1) Specifically, the network is initialized as a complete directed acyclic graph, where the nodes represent convolutional blocks and the edges represent the connection paths. 2) We generate edge weights by a learnable module, Router, and select the edges whose weights are larger than a threshold, to adjust the connectivity of the neural network structure. 3) Instead of using the same path of the network, DDW aggregates features dynamically in each node, which allows the network to have more representation power. To facilitate effective training, we further represent the network connectivity of each sample as an adjacency matrix. The matrix is updated to aggregate features in the forward pass, cached in the memory, and used for gradient computing in the backward pass. We validate the effectiveness of our approach with several mainstream architectures, including MobileNetV2, ResNet, ResNeXt, and RegNet. Extensive experiments are performed on ImageNet classification and COCO object detection, which demonstrates the effectiveness and generalization ability of our approach.
papers.title_zh: 神经网络有区别的动态电线
papers.abstract_zh: 部署深神经网络的标准做法是对所有输入实例适用相同的结构,但固定结构可能不适合具有高度多样性的不同数据。 为提高模型能力,现有方法通常采用较大的革命内核或更深的网络层,从而产生令人望而却步的计算费用。 在本文中,我们通过提出有区别的动态电线(DDW)来解决这一问题,它学习了有实例意识的连通性,这种连通性为不同情况创造了不同的接线模式。 1) 具体地说,网络初始化为一个完整的定向绕圈图,节点代表的是卷变区块,边缘代表的是连接路径。 2) 我们通过一个可学习模块 " 路由器 " 产生边缘重量,并选择其重量大于阈值的边缘,以调整神经网络结构的连通性。 3) DDW不是使用网络的同一路径,而是在每一个节点上动态地集成,使网络具有更大的代表力。 为了便利有效的培训,我们进一步将每个样本的网络连通性作为一个相邻矩阵来代表。 信息总库将更新,以汇总远端通行证的特征,隐藏在记忆中,并在后端通行证中用于梯度计算。 我们用包括移动网络V2、ResNet、ResNeXt和RegNet在内的几个主流结构验证了我们方法的有效性。 对图像网络分类和COCO天体探测进行了广泛的实验,这表明了我们的方法的有效性和普及能力。

papers.title: DECA: Deep Viewpoint-Equivariant Human Pose Estimation Using Capsule Autoencoders
papers.authors: Nicola Garau, Niccolò Bisagno, Piotr Bródka, Nicola Conci
papers.abstract: Human Pose Estimation (HPE) aims at retrieving the 3D position of human joints from images or videos. We show that current 3D HPE methods suffer a lack of viewpoint equivariance, namely they tend to fail or perform poorly when dealing with viewpoints unseen at training time. Deep learning methods often rely on either scale-invariant, translation-invariant, or rotation-invariant operations, such as max-pooling. However, the adoption of such procedures does not necessarily improve viewpoint generalization, rather leading to more data-dependent methods. To tackle this issue, we propose a novel capsule autoencoder network with fast Variational Bayes capsule routing, named DECA. By modeling each joint as a capsule entity, combined with the routing algorithm, our approach can preserve the joints' hierarchical and geometrical structure in the feature space, independently from the viewpoint. By achieving viewpoint equivariance, we drastically reduce the network data dependency at training time, resulting in an improved ability to generalize for unseen viewpoints. In the experimental validation, we outperform other methods on depth images from both seen and unseen viewpoints, both top-view, and front-view. In the RGB domain, the same network gives state-of-the-art results on the challenging viewpoint transfer task, also establishing a new framework for top-view HPE.
papers.title_zh: DECA: 利用Capsule自动编码器进行深视点-等等值人类脉冲估计
papers.abstract_zh: 人类粒子估计(HPE)旨在从图像或视频中获取人类关节的 3D 位置。 我们显示,目前的 3D 人关节方法缺乏观点平等性,即当处理培训时看不见的观点时往往失败或表现不佳。 深层学习方法往往依赖规模变换、翻译变换或轮值变换操作,如最大集合,但采用这种程序并不一定能改善视角的概括化,而是导致更多依赖数据的方法。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立一个名为DECA的新颖胶囊自动编码网络,配有快速变换贝叶斯胶囊路线。 通过将每个联合体模拟成一个胶囊实体,加上路线算法,我们的方法可以维护各联合体在特征空间的等级和几何结构,而与观点无关。 通过实现观点等同,我们大幅降低了培训时间对网络数据的依赖性,从而提高了对无形观点的概括能力。 在实验验证中,我们在深度图像方面表现优于其他方法,既从视觉角度,也从前视角度,包括上视角度和前视角度。 在RGB领域,同一网络在具有挑战性的观点转移任务上提供了最新的结果,还为最高视距高级个人防护设备建立了一个新框架。

papers.title: Concept Generalization in Visual Representation Learning
papers.authors: Mert Bulent Sariyildiz, Yannis Kalantidis, Diane Larlus, Karteek Alahari
papers.abstract: Measuring concept generalization, i.e., the extent to which models trained on a set of (seen) visual concepts can be leveraged to recognize a new set of (unseen) concepts, is a popular way of evaluating visual representations, especially in a self-supervised learning framework. Nonetheless, the choice of unseen concepts for such an evaluation is usually made arbitrarily, and independently from the seen concepts used to train representations, thus ignoring any semantic relationships between the two. In this paper, we argue that the semantic relationships between seen and unseen concepts affect generalization performance and propose ImageNet-CoG, a novel benchmark on the ImageNet-21K (IN-21K) dataset that enables measuring concept generalization in a principled way. Our benchmark leverages expert knowledge that comes from WordNet in order to define a sequence of unseen IN-21K concept sets that are semantically more and more distant from the ImageNet-1K (IN-1K) subset, a ubiquitous training set. This allows us to benchmark visual representations learned on IN-1K out-of-the box. We conduct a large-scale study encompassing 31 convolution and transformer-based models and show how different architectures, levels of supervision, regularization techniques and use of web data impact the concept generalization performance.
papers.title_zh: 视觉代表学习中概念的概括化概念
papers.abstract_zh: 衡量概念的概括化,即能够在多大程度上利用关于一套(见)视觉概念的培训模型来确认一套新的(见)概念,这是评价视觉表现的一种普遍方式,特别是在一个自我监督的学习框架内。 尽管如此,为这种评价选择看不见的概念通常都是任意的,与用来培训陈述的已知概念无关,从而忽视了两者之间的任何语义关系。 在本文中,我们争辩说,视觉概念和看不见概念之间的语义关系影响一般化性能,并提议建立图像网-CoG,这是关于图像网-21K(IN-21K)数据集的新基准,能够以原则性方式衡量概念一般化。 我们的基准利用来自WordNet的专家知识来定义一系列隐蔽的IN-21K概念组,这些概念组在语义上越来越远离无处不在的训练组“图像网络-1K(IN-1K)子集 ” 。 这使得我们可以将从信箱外的IN-1K(IN-1K)上学到的视觉表现作为基准。 我们进行一项大型研究,包括31个革命模型和以变压器为基础的模型,并表明不同的结构、监督级别、正规化技术和网络数据的使用如何影响概念的概括性业绩。

papers.title: CapsuleRRT: Relationships-Aware Regression Tracking via Capsules
papers.authors: Ding Ma, Xiangqian Wu
papers.abstract: Regression tracking has gained more and more attention thanks to its easy-to-implement characteristics, while existing regression trackers rarely consider the relationships between the object parts and the complete object. This would ultimately result in drift from the target object when missing some parts of the target object. Recently, Capsule Network (CapsNet) has shown promising results for image classification benefits from its part-object relationships mechanism, while CapsNet is known for its high computational demand even when carrying out simple tasks. Therefore, a primitive adaptation of CapsNet to regression tracking does not make sense, since this will seriously affect speed of a tracker. To solve these problems, we first explore the spatial-temporal relationships endowed by the CapsNet for regression tracking. The entire regression framework, dubbed CapsuleRRT, consists of three parts. One is S-Caps, which captures the spatial relationships between the parts and the object. Meanwhile, a T-Caps module is designed to exploit the temporal relationships within the target. The response of the target is obtained by STCaps Learning. Further, a prior-guided capsule routing algorithm is proposed to generate more accurate capsule assignments for subsequent frames. Apart from this, the heavy computation burden in CapsNet is addressed with a knowledge distillation pose matrix compression strategy that exploits more tight and discriminative representation with few samples. Extensive experimental results show that CapsuleRRT performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy and speed.
papers.title_zh: CapsuleRRT: 通过 Capsules 追踪关系- 软件回归跟踪
papers.abstract_zh: 回归跟踪由于其易于执行的特点而越来越受到关注,而现有的回归跟踪者很少考虑对象部件与完整对象之间的关系。 这最终将导致目标物体失去部分目标物体时从目标物体中漂移。 最近,Capsule Net(CapsNet)显示,其部分目标关系机制的图像分类效益有希望的结果,而CapsNet以其高计算需求而著称,即使在执行简单的任务时也是如此。 因此,对CapsNet进行原始调整以适应回归跟踪是没有意义的,因为这将严重影响跟踪者的速度。 为了解决这些问题,我们首先探索CapsNet为回归跟踪提供的时空空间关系。 整个回归框架,称为CapsuleRRT,由三部分组成。一个是S-Caps,它捕捉各部分与对象之间的空间关系。同时,T-Caps模块旨在利用目标内的时间关系。 STCaps Learning公司对目标的反应是获得的,此外,还提议采用事先制导的胶囊路线算法,为以后的框架编制更准确的胶囊任务。 除此之外,CapsNet的沉重计算负担通过一种知识蒸馏法来解决,即矩阵压缩战略,利用较少样本的更紧凑、更具有歧视性的代表性。 广泛的实验结果表明,CapsuleRRT在准确性和速度方面优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: Capsule Network Is Not More Robust Than Convolutional Network
papers.authors: Jindong Gu, Volker Tresp, Han Hu
papers.abstract: The Capsule Network is widely believed to be more robust than Convolutional Networks. However, there lack comprehensive comparisons between these two networks, and it is also unknown which components in the CapsNet affect its robustness. In this paper, we first carefully examine the special designs in CapsNet differing from that of a ConvNet, commonly used for image classification. The examination reveals 5 major new/different components in CapsNet: a transformation process, a dynamic routing layer, a squashing function, a marginal loss other than cross-entropy loss, and an additional class-conditional reconstruction loss for regularization. Along with these major differences, we comprehensively ablate their behavior on 3 kinds of robustness, including affine transformation, overlapping digits, and semantic representation. The study reveals that some designs which are thought critical to CapsNet actually can harm its robustness, i.e., the dynamic routing layer and the transformation process, while others are beneficial for the robustness. Based on these findings, we propose enhanced ConvNets simply by introducing the essential components behind the CapsNet's success. The proposed simple ConvNets can achieve better robustness than the CapsNet.
papers.title_zh: Capsule 网络不是比演变网络更强力的网络
papers.abstract_zh: Capsule网络被广泛认为比革命网络更强大,但这两个网络之间缺乏全面比较,也不清楚CapsNet的哪些组成部分影响其稳健性。 在本文中,我们首先仔细研究CapsNet中不同于ConvNet的特别设计,ConvNet通常用于图像分类。 检查揭示了CapsNet的5个新的/不同的主要组成部分:转型过程、动态路由层、挤压功能、跨热带损失以外的边际损失,以及为正规化而附加的等级条件性重建损失。 除了这些重大差异之外,我们全面将他们的行为推向三种强健状态,包括亲吻转变、数字重叠和语义表达。 研究表明,一些被认为对CapsNet至关重要的设计实际上会损害其稳健性,即动态路由层和转型过程,而另一些则有利于稳健性。 基于这些结论,我们建议仅仅通过引入CapsNet成功背后的基本要素来强化ConvNet。 拟议的简单的ConvNet可以比CapsNet更强大。

papers.title: Can We Characterize Tasks Without Labels or Features?
papers.authors: Bram Wallace, Ziyang Wu, Bharath Hariharan
papers.abstract: The problem of expert model selection deals with choosing the appropriate pretrained network ("expert") to transfer to a target task. Methods, however, generally depend on two separate assumptions: the presence of labeled images and access to powerful "probe" networks that yield useful features. In this work, we demonstrate the current reliance on both of these aspects and develop algorithms to operate when either of these assumptions fail. In the unlabeled case, we show that pseudolabels from the probe network provide discriminative enough gradients to perform nearly-equal task selection even when the probe network is trained on imagery unrelated to the tasks. To compute the embedding with no probe network at all, we introduce the Task Tangent Kernel (TTK) which uses a kernelized distance across multiple random networks to achieve performance over double that of other methods with randomly initialized models. Code is available at https://github.com/BramSW/task_characterization_cvpr_2021/.
papers.title_zh: 没有标签或特性, 我们可以指定任务特性吗 ?
papers.abstract_zh: 专家模式选择的问题涉及选择适当的预先培训的网络(“专家”)将任务转移到目标任务,但方法一般取决于两个不同的假设:贴有标签的图像的存在和进入产生有用特征的强大“潜在”网络的机会。 在这项工作中,我们证明目前对这两个方面的依赖,并发展算法,以便在其中任何一个假设失败时运作。 在未贴标签的案例中,我们显示,探测网络的假标签提供了足够具有歧视性的梯度,足以执行几乎平等的任务选择,即使探测网络受过与任务无关的图像培训。 为了在根本没有探测网络的情况下计算嵌入, 我们引入了任务 Tangent 内核(TTK) , 它使用多个随机网络之间的内核距离, 实现性能超过随机初始模型的其他方法的两倍。 法规可在https://github.com/BramSW/task_descrimination_cvpr_2021上查阅。

papers.title: BuildingNet: Learning To Label 3D Buildings
papers.authors: Pratheba Selvaraju, Mohamed Nabail, Marios Loizou, Maria Maslioukova, Melinos Averkiou, Andreas Andreou, Siddhartha Chaudhuri, Evangelos Kalogerakis
papers.abstract: We introduce BuildingNet: (a) a large-scale dataset of 3D building models whose exteriors are consistently labeled, and (b) a graph neural network that labels building meshes by analyzing spatial and structural relations of their geometric primitives. To create our dataset, we used crowdsourcing combined with expert guidance, resulting in 513K annotated mesh primitives, grouped into 292K semantic part components across 2K building models. The dataset covers several building categories, such as houses, churches, skyscrapers, town halls, libraries, and castles. We include a benchmark for evaluating mesh and point cloud labeling.
