Buildings have more challenging structural complexity compared to objects in existing benchmarks (e.g., ShapeNet, PartNet), thus, we hope that our dataset can nurture the development of algorithms that are able to cope with such large-scale geometric data for both vision and graphics tasks e.g., 3D semantic segmentation, part-based generative models, correspondences, texturing, and analysis of point cloud data acquired from real-world buildings. Finally, we show that our mesh-based graph neural network significantly improves performance over several baselines for labeling 3D meshes. Our project page www.buildingnet.org includes our dataset and code.
papers.title_zh: 建筑网:学习到标签3D大楼
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了“建筑网”:(a) 一套大型数据集,由外表标签一致的3D建筑模型组成,(b) 一个图形神经网络,通过分析其几何原始的空间和结构关系,标出建造贝壳的标签。 为了创建我们的数据集,我们利用了众包和专家指导,产生了513K加注的网状原始生物,这些原始生物分为292K语义部分,分布在2K建筑模型中。 数据集覆盖了几类建筑,如房屋、教堂、摩天大楼、市政厅、图书馆和城堡。 我们列入一个评估网格和点云标签的基准。 因此,我们希望我们的数据集能够促进算法的发展,这种算法能够处理这些大型的几何数据,用于视觉和图形任务,例如3D语义分解、基于部分的遗传模型、通信、纹理和分析从现实世界建筑获得的点云数据。 最后,我们显示,我们的网状图形神经网络大大改进了标为3D meshes的若干基线的性能。我们的项目网页www.buildingnet.org包括我们的数据集和代码。

papers.title: Benchmarking Representation Learning for Natural World Image Collections
papers.authors: Grant Van Horn, Elijah Cole, Sara Beery, Kimberly Wilber, Serge Belongie, Oisin Mac Aodha
papers.abstract: Recent progress in self-supervised learning has resulted in models that are capable of extracting rich representations from image collections without requiring any explicit label supervision. However, to date the vast majority of these approaches have restricted themselves to training on standard benchmark datasets such as ImageNet. We argue that fine-grained visual categorization problems, such as plant and animal species classification, provide an informative testbed for self-supervised learning. In order to facilitate progress in this area we present two new natural world visual classification datasets, iNat2021 and NeWT. The former consists of 2.7M images from 10k different species uploaded by users of the citizen science application iNaturalist. We designed the latter, NeWT, in collaboration with domain experts with the aim of benchmarking the performance of representation learning algorithms on a suite of challenging natural world binary classification tasks that go beyond standard species classification. These two new datasets allow us to explore questions related to large-scale representation and transfer learning in the context of fine-grained categories. We provide a comprehensive analysis of feature extractors trained with and without supervision on ImageNet and iNat2021, shedding light on the strengths and weaknesses of different learned features across a diverse set of tasks. We find that features produced by standard supervised methods still outperform those produced by self-supervised approaches such as SimCLR. However, improved self-supervised learning methods are constantly being released and the iNat2021 and NeWT datasets are a valuable resource for tracking their progress.
papers.title_zh: 自然世界图像集代表学习基准
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在自我监督学习方面取得的进展产生了一些模型,这些模型能够从图像收藏中提取丰富的图像,而不需要任何明确的标签监督。 然而,迄今为止,这些方法的绝大多数都局限于图像网络等标准基准数据集的培训,我们认为,植物和动物物种分类等细微的视觉分类问题为自我监督的学习提供了一个信息测试台。 为了促进这一领域的进展,我们提出了两个新的自然世界视觉分类数据集,即iNat2021和NeWT,前者由公民科学应用iNatulist用户上传的10k种不同物种的2.7M图像组成。 我们与域专家合作设计了后者,即NeWT,目的是将代表性学习算法的绩效与一套超越标准物种分类的具有挑战性的自然世界二元分类任务相比较。 这两个新的数据集使我们能够在细细分类中探讨与大规模代表性和转让学习有关的问题。 我们全面分析在对图象网和iNat2021进行监督和不受监督的情况下培训的特征提取器,以了解不同任务中不同学习特征的优缺点。 我们发现,标准监督方法产生的特征仍然优于SimCLR等自我监督方法产生的特征,然而,不断推出改进的自我监督学习方法,iNat2021和NeWT数据集是跟踪其进展的宝贵资源。

papers.title: Benchmark Platform for Ultra-Fine-Grained Visual Categorization Beyond Human Performance
papers.authors: Xiaohan Yu, Yang Zhao, Yongsheng Gao, Xiaohui Yuan, Shengwu Xiong
papers.abstract: Deep learning methods have achieved remarkable success in fine-grained visual categorization. Such successful categorization at sub-ordinate level, e.g., different animal or plant species, however relies heavily on the visual differences that human can observe and the ground-truths are labelled on the basis of such human visual observation. In contrast, few research has been done for visual categorization at the ultra-fine-grained level, i.e., a granularity where even human experts can hardly identify the visual differences or are not yet able to give affirmative labels by inferring observed pattern differences. This paper reports our efforts towards mitigating this research gap. We introduce the ultra-fine-grained (UFG) image dataset, a large collection of 47,114 images from 3,526 categories. All the images in the proposed UFG image dataset are grouped into categories with different confirmed cultivar names. In addition, we perform an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art fine-grained classification methods on the proposed UFG image dataset as comparative baselines. The proposed UFG image dataset and evaluation protocols is intended to serve as a benchmark platform that can advance research of visual classification from approaching human performance to beyond human ability, via facilitating benchmark data of artificial intelligence (AI) not to be limited by the labels of human intelligence (HI). The dataset is available online at https://github.com/XiaohanYu-GU/Ultra-FGVC.
papers.title_zh: 超越人类性能的超精细视力分类基准平台
papers.abstract_zh: 深层学习方法在精细的视觉分类方面取得了显著成功。 然而,在次层次上这种成功的分类,例如,不同的动物或植物物种,在很大程度上依赖于人类能够观察到的视觉差异,地面实况是根据这种人类的视觉观察贴上标签的。 与此相反,在超非植物类的目视分类方面开展的研究很少,即颗粒,即使人类专家也几乎无法辨别视觉差异,或无法通过推断观察到的模式差异来给出肯定标签。 本文报告了我们为缩小这一研究差距所作的努力。我们引入了超松果图像数据集(UFG),大量收集了来自3,526类的47,114个图像。拟议的UFG图像数据集中的所有图像都按不同经证实的栽培名称分类。 此外,我们广泛评价了作为比较基线的拟议UFG图像数据集的最新精细分类方法。 拟议的UFG图像数据集和评价规程旨在作为一个基准平台,通过促进不受人类情报标签限制的人工智能基准数据(AI),推动对视觉分类的研究,从接近人类性能到超越人的能力。 该数据集可在以下网址查阅:https://github.com/XiaohanYu-GU/Ultra-FGVC。

papers.title: AutoSpace: Neural Architecture Search With Less Human Interference
papers.authors: Daquan Zhou, Xiaojie Jin, Xiaochen Lian, Linjie Yang, Yujing Xue, Qibin Hou, Jiashi Feng
papers.abstract: Current neural architecture search (NAS) algorithms still require expert knowledge and effort to design a search space for network construction. In this paper, we consider automating the search space design to minimize human interference, which however faces two challenges: the explosive complexity of the exploration space and the expensive computation cost to evaluate the quality of different search spaces. To solve them, we propose a novel differentiable evolutionary framework named AutoSpace, which evolves the search space to an optimal one with following novel techniques: a differentiable fitness scoring function to efficiently evaluate the performance of cells and a reference architecture to speedup the evolution procedure and avoid falling into sub-optimal solutions. The framework is generic and compatible with additional computational constraints, making it feasible to learn specialized search spaces that fit different computational budgets. With the learned search space, the performance of recent NAS algorithms can be improved significantly compared with using manually de-signed spaces. Remarkably, the models generated from the new search space achieve 77.8% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under the mobile setting (MAdds<=500M), outperforming previous SOTA EfficientNet-B0 by 0.7%. https://github.com/zhoudaquan/AutoSpace.git
papers.title_zh: 自动空间:用较少人干扰的神经结构搜索
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的神经结构搜索算法仍然需要专家知识和努力设计网络建设的搜索空间。 在本文中,我们考虑使搜索空间设计自动化,以尽量减少人类干扰,但人类干扰却面临两个挑战:探索空间的爆炸性复杂性以及评估不同搜索空间质量的昂贵计算成本。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议了一个名为“Autospace”的新颖的、可区别的进化框架,它将搜索空间演变为最佳空间,采用以下新技术:一种可区别的健身评分功能,以有效评价细胞的性能,以及一个加速进化程序和避免落入次优解决方案的参考结构。 该框架是通用的,符合额外的计算限制,因此可以学习适合不同计算预算的专门搜索空间。 有了学习的搜索空间,最近的NAS算法的性能可以大大改进,而使用人工指定空间的情况则不同。 值得注意的是,新搜索空间生成的模型在移动设置下(MAdds500M)在图像网络上实现了77.8%的最高一级精确度,比以前SOTA效率网络-B0高出0.7%。 https://github.com/zhooddaquan/Autospace.git

papers.title: AUFormer: Vision Transformers are Parameter-Efficient Facial Action Unit Detectors
papers.authors: Kaishen Yuan · Zitong Yu · Xin Liu · Weicheng Xie · Huanjing Yue · Jingyu Yang
papers.abstract: Facial Action Units (AU) is a vital concept in the realm of affective computing, and AU detection has always been a hot research topic. Existing methods suffer from overfitting issues due to the utilization of a large number of learnable parameters on scarce AU-annotated datasets or heavy reliance on substantial additional relevant data. Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning (PETL) provides a promising paradigm to address these challenges, whereas its existing methods lack design for AU characteristics. Therefore, we innovatively investigate PETL paradigm to AU detection, introducing AUFormer and proposing a novel Mixture-of-Knowledge Expert (MoKE) collaboration mechanism. An individual MoKE specific to a certain AU with minimal learnable parameters first integrates personalized multi-scale and correlation knowledge. Then the MoKE collaborates with other MoKEs in the expert group to obtain aggregated information and inject it into the frozen Vision Transformer (ViT) to achieve parameter-efficient AU detection. Additionally, we design a Margin-truncated Difficulty-aware Weighted Asymmetric Loss (MDWA-Loss), which can encourage the model to focus more on activated AUs, differentiate the difficulty of unactivated AUs, and discard potential mislabeled samples. Extensive experiments from various perspectives, including within-domain, cross-domain, data efficiency, and micro-expression domain, demonstrate AUFormer's state-of-the-art performance and robust generalization abilities without relying on additional relevant data. The code will be available on GitHub.
papers.title_zh: AUUFIER:视觉变形器是参数有效辅助行动单位探测器
papers.abstract_zh: 辅助行动股(AU)是情感计算领域的一个重要概念,非盟的检测始终是一个热门研究课题。 现有方法因使用大量关于非盟附加说明的紧缺数据集的可学习参数,或严重依赖大量额外相关数据,而存在过多问题。 参数有效转让学习(PETL)为应对这些挑战提供了一个很有希望的模式,而其现有方法缺乏针对非盟特点的设计。 因此,我们创新地调查了PETL范式,让非盟发现,引入了AUFORER,并提出了一个新的知识专家混合(MOKE)协作机制。 一个针对某些非盟的、具有最低可学习参数的单项知识混合,首先结合了个性化多尺度和相关性知识。 然后,科技部与专家组中的其他科技部合作,获取汇总信息,并将其注入冷冻的视觉Transformer(VIT),以实现欧盟的参数高效检测。 此外,我们设计了一种边际困难觉察到的加权损耗(MDWA-Loss),这可以鼓励模型更加注重已启动的非盟,区分未启动非盟的困难,并丢弃可能贴错标签的样本。 从各种角度进行的广泛实验,包括内域、跨域、数据效率和微表达域,都显示了AUFIREMER的最先进性能和强力的概括化能力,而无需依赖其他相关数据。该代码将在GitHub上提供。

papers.title: AIFit: Automatic 3D Human-Interpretable Feedback Models for Fitness Training
papers.authors: Mihai Fieraru, Mihai Zanfir, Silviu Cristian Pirlea, Vlad Olaru, Cristian Sminchisescu
papers.abstract: I went to the gym today, but how well did I do? And where should I improve? Ah, my back hurts slightly... User engagement can be sustained and injuries avoided by being able to reconstruct 3d human pose and motion, relate it to good training practices, identify errors, and provide early, real-time feedback. In this paper we introduce the first automatic system, AIFit, that performs 3d human sensing for fitness training. The system can be used at home, outdoors, or at the gym. AIFit is able to reconstruct 3d human pose and motion, reliably segment exercise repetitions, and identify in real-time the deviations between standards learnt from trainers, and the execution of a trainee. As a result, localized, quantitative feedback for correct execution of exercises, reduced risk of injury, and continuous improvement is possible. To support research and evaluation, we introduce the first large scale dataset, Fit3D, containing over 3 million images and corresponding 3d human shape and motion capture ground truth configurations, with over 37 repeated exercises, covering all the major muscle groups, performed by instructors and trainees. Our statistical coach is governed by a global parameter that captures how critical it should be of a trainee's performance. This is an important aspect that helps adapt to a student's level of fitness (i.e. beginner vs. advanced vs. expert), or to the expected accuracy of a 3d pose reconstruction method. We show that, for different values of the global parameter, our feedback system based on 3d pose estimates achieves good accuracy compared to the one based on ground-truth motion capture. Our statistical coach offers feedback in natural language, and with spatio-temporal visual grounding.
papers.title_zh: AIFit: 自动3D 健身训练人际解释反馈模型
papers.abstract_zh: 我今天去健身房了,但是我做得有多好?我应该在哪里改进呢? 啊,我的背部稍有伤痛...通过重建3人造型和运动,可以维持用户参与和避免伤害,这与良好的培训实践有关,找出错误,并提供早期实时反馈。 在本文中,我们引入了第一个自动系统,即AIFit,该系统为健身培训提供3D人类感知,可在家庭、户外或健身房使用。 IIFitit能够重建3人造型和运动,可靠地进行分部分练习重复,并实时查明从培训人员那里学到的标准与执行受训人员的标准之间的偏差。 因此,为正确开展演习提供局部、定量的反馈,减少受伤风险,以及不断改进,是可能的。 为支持研究和评价,我们推出第一个大型数据集Fit3D,包含300多万图像和相应的3D人形状和运动抓捕地面真相配置,由教员和受训人员进行37次多次练习,涵盖所有主要肌肉组。 我们的统计导师受一个全球参数的制约,该参数记录了受训者业绩的至关重要性。 这是一个重要方面,有助于适应学生的体格水平(如初学者对高级专家对专家),或3D构成重建方法的预期准确性。 我们显示,对于全球参数的不同值来说,基于3D的“3D”估计值的反馈系统与基于地面真实运动捕捉的反馈系统相比,准确性很高。 我们的统计导师以自然语言和时空视觉定位提供反馈。

papers.title: Adversarial VQA: A New Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of VQA Models
papers.authors: Linjie Li, Jie Lei, Zhe Gan, Jingjing Liu
papers.abstract: Benefiting from large-scale pre-training, we have witnessed significant performance boost on the popular Visual Question Answering (VQA) task. Despite rapid progress, it remains unclear whether these state-of-the-art (SOTA) models are robust when encountering examples in the wild. To study this, we introduce Adversarial VQA, a new large-scale VQA benchmark, collected iteratively via an adversarial human-and-model-in-the-loop procedure. Through this new benchmark, we discover several interesting findings. (i) Surprisingly, we find that during dataset collection, non-expert annotators can easily attack SOTA VQA models successfully. (ii) Both large-scale pre-trained models and adversarial training methods achieve far worse performance on the new benchmark than over standard VQA v2 dataset, revealing the fragility of these models while demonstrating the effectiveness of our adversarial dataset. (iii) When used for data augmentation, our dataset can effectively boost model performance on other robust VQA benchmarks. We hope our Adversarial VQA dataset can shed new light on robustness study in the community and serve as a valuable benchmark for future work.
papers.title_zh: Aversarial VQA:评估VQA模式的有力性的新基准
papers.abstract_zh: 从大规模培训前工作中受益,我们目睹了流行的视觉问题解答(VQA)任务显著的绩效提升。 尽管进展迅速,但仍不清楚这些最先进的(SOTA)模型在野外遇到例子时是否强劲。 为了研究这一点,我们引入了Aversarial VQA,这是一个新的大规模VQA基准,通过对抗性人和模范流动程序反复收集。 通过这一新基准,我们发现了几个有趣的发现。 (i) 令人惊讶的是,我们发现,在收集数据集期间,非专家告示员可以很容易地成功攻击SOTA VQA模型。 (二) 大规模预先培训模式和对抗性培训方法在新基准上的表现都远远低于标准VQA v2数据集,暴露了这些模式的脆弱性,同时展示了我们的对抗性数据集的有效性。 (三) 当用于数据扩充时,我们的数据集能够有效地促进其他稳健的VQA基准的模型性能,我们希望我们的Adversarial VQA数据集能够对社区的稳健性研究提供新的启示,并成为今后工作的宝贵基准。

papers.title: ACE: Ally Complementary Experts for Solving Long-Tailed Recognition in One-Shot
papers.authors: Jiarui Cai, Yizhou Wang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.abstract: One-stage long-tailed recognition methods improve the overall performance in a "seesaw" manner, i.e., either sacrifice the head's accuracy for better tail classification or elevate the head's accuracy even higher but ignore the tail. Existing algorithms bypass such trade-off by a multi-stage training process: pre-training on imbalanced set and fine-tuning on balanced set. Though achieving promising performance, not only are they sensitive to the generalizability of the pre-trained model, but also not easily integrated into other computer vision tasks like detection and segmentation, where pre-training of classifier solely is not applicable. In this paper, we propose a one-stage long-tailed recognition scheme, ally complementary experts (ACE), where the expert is the most knowledgeable specialist in a sub-set that dominates its training, and is complementary to other experts in the less-seen categories without disturbed by what it has never seen. We design a distribution-adaptive optimizer to adjust the learning pace of each expert to avoid over-fitting. Without special bells and whistles, the vanilla ACE outperforms the current one-stage SOTA method by 3 10% on CIFAR10-LT, CIFAR100-LT, ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist datasets. It is also shown to be the first one to break the "seesaw" trade-off by improving the accuracy of the majority and minority categories simultaneously in only one stage.
papers.title_zh: ACE: 解决单层长期不合格识别的 Ally 补充专家
papers.abstract_zh: 单阶段长尾识别方法以“锯子”方式改善总体性能,即要么牺牲头部的准确性,以更好地分类尾巴,要么提高头部的准确性,但忽略尾巴。 现有的算法绕过多阶段培训过程,绕过这种权衡:关于不平衡设置的预先培训和关于平衡设置的微调。 尽管取得了有希望的业绩,但它们不仅敏感地认识到预先培训模式的可普遍适用性,而且不易纳入其他计算机视觉任务,如探测和分解,因为仅仅进行分类员的预培训并不适用。 在这份文件中,我们提议了一个阶段长的承认计划,即盟国补充专家(ACE),在该计划中,专家是其培训占主导地位的子类中知识最丰富的专家,并且是对其他低级类专家的补充,而没有受到从未见过的干扰。 我们设计了一个分配适应性优化器,以调整每位专家的学习速度,以避免过度适应。 没有特殊的钟声和哨子,香草ACE在CIFAR10-LT、CIFAR100-LT、图像网-LT和iNatulist数据集上比目前的一阶段SOTA方法高出3-10%。 事实还表明,这是第一个通过在仅仅一个阶段同时提高多数群体和少数群体类别的准确性来打破“锯锯”权衡的。

papers.title: A Realistic Evaluation of Semi-Supervised Learning for Fine-Grained Classification
papers.authors: Jong-Chyi Su, Zezhou Cheng, Subhransu Maji
papers.abstract: We evaluate the effectiveness of semi-supervised learning (SSL) on a realistic benchmark where data exhibits considerable class imbalance and contains images from novel classes. Our benchmark consists of two fine-grained classification datasets obtained by sampling classes from the Aves and Fungi taxonomy. We find that recently proposed SSL methods provide significant benefits, and can effectively use out-of-class data to improve performance when deep networks are trained from scratch. Yet their performance pales in comparison to a transfer learning baseline, an alternative approach for learning from a few examples. Furthermore, in the transfer setting, while existing SSL methods provide improvements, the presence of out-of-class is often detrimental. In this setting, standard fine-tuning followed by distillation-based self-training is the most robust. Our work suggests that semi-supervised learning with experts on realistic datasets may require different strategies than those currently prevalent in the literature.
papers.title_zh: 精细分类半监督学习的现实评估
papers.abstract_zh: 我们评估了半监督学习(SSL)在现实基准上的有效性,在现实基准上,数据显示出相当严重的阶级不平衡,并包含来自新类的图像。 我们的基准包括两个细微的分类数据集,由Aves和Fungi分类学抽样分类组获得。 我们发现,最近提出的SSL方法带来了巨大的好处,并且能够有效地利用阶级外数据来改善深层网络从零开始接受培训时的绩效。 然而,与转移学习基线相比,它们的业绩不如转移学习基线 — — 这是从几个例子中学习的替代方法。 此外,在转让环境中,虽然现有的SSL方法提供了改进,但课外人员的存在往往有害无益,在这一背景下,最有力的是标准微调,然后是基于蒸馏的自我培训。 我们的工作表明,在与专家就现实的数据集进行半监督的学习方面,可能需要采取不同于文献中目前流行的战略。

papers.title: A Machine Teaching Framework for Scalable Recognition
papers.authors: Pei Wang, Nuno Vasconcelos
papers.abstract: We consider the scalable recognition problem in the fine-grained expert domain where large-scale data collection is easy whereas annotation is difficult. Existing solutions are typically based on semi-supervised or self-supervised learning. We propose an alternative new framework, MEMORABLE, based on machine teaching and online crowdsourcing platforms. A small amount of data is first labeled by experts and then used to teach online annotators for the classes of interest, who finally label the entire dataset. Preliminary studies show that the accuracy of classifiers trained on the final dataset is a function of the accuracy of the student annotators. A new machine teaching algorithm, CMaxGrad, is then proposed to enhance this accuracy by introducing explanations in a state-of-the-art machine teaching algorithm. For this, CMaxGrad leverages counterfactual explanations, which take into account student predictions, thereby proving feedback that is student-specific, explicitly addresses the causes of student confusion, and adapts to the level of competence of the student. Experiments show that both MEMORABLE and CMaxGrad outperform existing solutions to their respective problems.
papers.title_zh: 一种可缩放承认的机械教学框架
papers.abstract_zh: 我们认为,在精细的专家领域,大规模数据收集很容易,而批注则困难。 现有解决方案通常基于半监督或自我监督的学习。 我们提出了一个基于机器教学和在线众包平台的替代新框架 — — Memorable。 首先,专家给少量数据贴上标签,然后用这些数据为感兴趣的类别教授在线告示员,他们最终给整个数据集贴上标签。 初步研究表明,接受过最终数据集培训的分类员的准确性取决于学生笔记员的准确性。 然后建议采用新的机器教学算法(CMaxGrad ) , 通过在最先进的机器教学算法中引入解释来提高这一准确性。 为此,CMaxGrad利用反事实解释,其中考虑到学生的预测,从而证明反馈是针对学生的,明确解决学生混乱的原因,并适应学生的能力水平。 实验表明,Memobable和CMaxGrad都优于解决各自问题的现有办法。

papers.title: 3D-FRONT: 3D Furnished Rooms With layOuts and semaNTics
papers.authors: Huan Fu, Bowen Cai, Lin Gao, Ling-Xiao Zhang, Jiaming Wang, Cao Li, Qixun Zeng, Chengyue Sun, Rongfei Jia, Binqiang Zhao, Hao Zhang
papers.abstract: We introduce 3D-FRONT (3D Furnished Rooms with layOuts and semaNTics), a new, large-scale, and compre- hensive repository of synthetic indoor scenes highlighted by professionally designed layouts and a large number of rooms populated by high-quality textured 3D models with style compatibility. From layout semantics down to texture details of individual objects, our dataset is freely available to the academic community and beyond. Currently, 3D- FRONT contains 6,813 CAD houses, where 18,968 rooms diversely furnished by 3D objects, far surpassing all publicly available scene datasets. The 13,151 furniture objects all come with high-quality textures. While the floorplans and layout designs (i.e., furniture arrangements) are directly sourced from professional creations, the interior de- signs in terms of furniture styles, color, and textures have been carefully curated based on a recommender system we develop to attain consistent styles as expert designs. Furthermore, we release Trescope, a light-weight rendering tool, to support benchmark rendering of 2D images and annotations from 3D-FRONT. We demonstrate two applications, interior scene synthesis and texture synthesis, that are especially tailored to the strengths of our new dataset.
papers.title_zh: 3D-FRONT: 3D 装有外露和血肿的房间
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了3D-FRONT(3D装饰室,外观和血型),这是一个新的、大规模和精密的室内合成场景储存库,以专业设计的布局和大量房间为突出显示,这些室内合成场景由具有风格兼容性的高质量3D型纹理模型组成。 从设计语义到单个物体的纹理细节,我们的数据集可以免费提供给学术界和学术界。 目前,3D-FRONT包含6,813个CAD房屋,其中18,968个房间由3D对象提供,远远超过了所有公开的现场数据集。 13 151件家具都配有优质质地。 虽然楼面计划和布局设计(即家具安排)直接来源于专业创作,但内部家具样式、颜色和纹理的标记则根据我们开发的推荐系统进行了仔细整理,以达到作为专家设计的统一风格。 此外,我们推出一个轻量级转换工具,即Trescope系统,以支持3D-FRONT的2D图像和说明的基准提供。 我们展示了两种应用,即内部场景合成和质地合成,它们特别适合我们新数据集的长处。

papers.title: 3D Graph Anatomy Geometry-Integrated Network for Pancreatic Mass Segmentation, Diagnosis, and Quantitative Patient Management
papers.authors: Tianyi Zhao, Kai Cao, Jiawen Yao, Isabella Nogues, Le Lu, Lingyun Huang, Jing Xiao, Zhaozheng Yin, Ling Zhang
papers.abstract: The pancreatic disease taxonomy includes ten types of masses (tumors or cysts) [20, 8]. Previous work focuses on developing segmentation or classification methods only for certain mass types. Differential diagnosis of all mass types is clinically highly desirable [20] but has not been investigated using an automated image understanding approach. We exploit the feasibility to distinguish pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) from the nine other nonPDAC masses using multi-phase CT imaging. Both image appearance and the 3D organ-mass geometry relationship are critical. We propose a holistic segmentation-mesh-classification network (SMCN) to provide patient-level diagnosis, by fully utilizing the geometry and location information, which is accomplished by combining the anatomical structure and the semantic detection-by-segmentation network. SMCN learns the pancreas and mass segmentation task and builds an anatomical correspondence-aware organ mesh model by progressively deforming a pancreas prototype on the raw segmentation mask (i.e., mask-to-mesh). A new graph-based residual convolutional network (Graph-ResNet), whose nodes fuse the information of the mesh model and feature vectors extracted from the segmentation network, is developed to produce the patient-level differential classification results. Extensive experiments on 661 patients' CT scans (five phases per patient) show that SMCN can improve the mass segmentation and detection accuracy compared to the strong baseline method nnUNet (e.g., for nonPDAC, Dice: 0.611 vs. 0.478; detection rate: 89% vs. 70%), achieve similar sensitivity and specificity in differentiating PDAC and nonPDAC as expert radiologists (i.e., 94% and 90%), and obtain results comparable to a multimodality test [20] that combines clinical, imaging, and molecular testing for clinical management of patients.
papers.title_zh: 3D 图 3D 图 血管质分解、诊断和定量病人管理解剖几何-综合网络
papers.abstract_zh: 胰腺疾病分类学包括10种质量(肿瘤或细胞)[20、8],以前的工作重点是只为某些质量类型制定分解或分类方法。 对所有质量类型的不同诊断在临床上是十分可取的[20],但并未采用自动图像理解方法进行调查。 我们利用这一可行性,利用多阶段CT成像将胰腺肾上腺瘤(PDAC)与另外九种非PDAC质量(PDAC)区别开来。 图像外观和3D器官-质量几何关系都至关重要。 我们建议建立一个全方位分类网,通过充分利用几何和位置信息,提供病人一级的诊断,通过将解剖结构和语义分解检测网络相结合来实现。 SMCN学会了胰腺和质量分解任务,并逐步变形了原分解面罩(即面罩到乳胶)上的胰腺原型,从而建立了解剖对应显像器官网状模型。 开发了一个新的基于图形的剩余变速网络(Graph-ResNet),其节点将网状模型和从分割网中提取的特质矢量的信息集成在一起,以产生病人一级的差别分类结果。 关于661名病人的CT扫描(每个病人5个阶段)的广泛实验表明,与强力基准方法nnUNet(例如,非PDAC,Dice:0.611对0.478;检测率:89%对0.478)相比,SMCN可以提高质量分离和检测准确度。 在将PDAC和非PDAC区别为专家放射学家(即94%和90%)方面,实现了类似的敏感性和特殊性,并取得了与将临床管理病人的临床、成像和分子试验结合起来的多式联运试验[20] 相类似的结果。

papers.title: Neural Data Server: A Large-Scale Search Engine for Transfer Learning Data
papers.authors: Xi Yan, David Acuna, Sanja Fidler
papers.abstract: Transfer learning has proven to be a successful technique to train deep learning models in the domains where little training data is available. The dominant approach is to pretrain a model on a large generic dataset such as ImageNet and finetune its weights on the target domain. However, in the new era of an ever-increasing number of massive datasets, selecting the relevant data for pretraining is a critical issue. We introduce Neural Data Server (NDS), a large-scale search engine for finding the most useful transfer learning data to the target domain. NDS consists of a dataserver which indexes several large popular image datasets, and aims to recommend data to a client, an end-user with a target application with its own small labeled dataset. The dataserver represents large datasets with a much more compact mixture-of-experts model, and employs it to perform data search in a series of dataserver-client transactions at a low computational cost. We show the effectiveness of NDS in various transfer learning scenarios, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on several target datasets and tasks such as image classification, object detection and instance segmentation. Neural Data Server is available as a web-service at http://aidemo s.cs.toronto.edu/nds/.
papers.title_zh: 神经数据服务器:用于传输学习数据的大型搜索引擎
papers.abstract_zh: 实践证明,在培训数据少的领域,转让学习是培训深层学习模式的成功方法,主要方法是预先开发一个大型通用数据集模型,如图像网络,并微调目标领域的权重。 然而,在数量不断增加的庞大数据集的新时代,为培训前选择相关数据是一个关键问题。 我们引入了神经数据服务器(NDS ) , 这是一种大规模搜索引擎,用于寻找最有用的向目标领域传输学习数据。 国家数据服务系统包括一个数据服务器,该服务器将若干大型广受欢迎的图像数据集编入索引,目的是向客户推荐数据,客户是终端用户,有目标应用程序,有自己的贴有标签的小数据集。 数据服务器代表大型数据集,具有更为紧凑的专家混合模型,并用于在一系列数据服务器-客户交易中以低计算成本进行数据搜索。 我们展示了国家数据系统在各种转让学习情景中的有效性,展示了若干目标数据集和任务的最新表现,如图像分类、物体探测和实例分割,神经数据服务器作为网络服务可在http://aidemos.cs.toronto.edu/nds/上查阅。

papers.title: Mixture of experts with convolutional and variational autoencoders for anomaly detection
papers.authors: Qien Yu, Muthu Subash Kavitha, Takio Kurita
papers.title_zh: 专家与变变和变变自动编码器混合,以探测异常现象

papers.title: Differentiable Adaptive Computation Time for Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Cristobal Eyzaguirre, Alvaro Soto
papers.abstract: This paper presents a novel attention-based algorithm for achieving adaptive computation called DACT, which, unlike existing ones, is end-to-end differentiable. Our method can be used in conjunction with many networks; in particular, we study its application to the widely know MAC architecture, obtaining a significant reduction in the number of recurrent steps needed to achieve similar accuracies, therefore improving its performance to computation ratio. Furthermore, we show that by increasing the maximum number of steps used, we surpass the accuracy of even our best non-adaptive MAC in the CLEVR dataset, demonstrating that our approach is able to control the number of steps without significant loss of performance. Additional advantages provided by our approach include considerably improving interpretability by discarding useless steps and providing more insights into the underlying reasoning process. Finally, we present adaptive computation as an equivalent to an ensemble of models, similar to a mixture of expert formulation. Both the code and the configuration files for our experiments are made available to support further research in this area.
papers.title_zh: 可区别的可视理由可调适计算时间
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的注重关注的算法,用于实现适应性计算,称为DACT,与现有计算法不同,这种算法在终端到终端之间是可以区别的。 我们的方法可以与许多网络结合使用;特别是,我们研究该方法在广泛了解的停战委员会架构中的应用,使实现类似理念所需的经常步骤数目大幅减少,从而改善其性能与计算比率。 此外,我们表明,通过增加所使用步骤的最大数量,我们甚至超过了CLEVR数据集中最佳非适应性MAC的准确性,这表明我们的方法能够控制步骤的数量,而不会严重丧失性能。 我们的方法提供的额外好处包括:通过放弃无用的步骤和对基本推理过程提供更深入的了解,大大改进可解释性;最后,我们提出适应性计算相当于一系列模型,类似于专家组合。 我们实验的代码和配置文件都可用于支持这一领域的进一步研究。

papers.title: Biased Mixtures of Experts: Enabling Computer Vision Inference Under Data Transfer Limitations
papers.authors: Alhabib Abbas, Yiannis Andreopoulos
papers.abstract: We propose a novel mixture-of-experts class to optimize computer vision models in accordance with data transfer limitations at test time. Our approach postulates that the minimum acceptable amount of data allowing for highly-accurate results can vary for different input space partitions. Therefore, we consider mixtures where experts require different amounts of data, and train a sparse gating function to divide the input space for each expert. By appropriate hyperparameter selection, our approach is able to bias mixtures of experts towards selecting specific experts over others. In this way, we show that the data transfer optimization between visual sensing and processing can be solved as a convex optimization problem. To demonstrate the relation between data availability and performance, we evaluate biased mixtures on a range of mainstream computer vision problems, namely: (i) single shot detection, (ii) image super resolution, and (iii) realtime video action classification. For all cases, and when experts constitute modified baselines to meet different limits on allowed data utility, biased mixtures significantly outperform previous work optimized to meet the same constraints on available data.
papers.title_zh: 具有偏见的专家混合:根据数据传输限制的计算机视觉推理
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个新的专家混合类别,以根据测试时的数据传输限制优化计算机视觉模型。 我们的方法假设,允许高度准确结果的最低可接受数据数量对于不同的输入空间分割区可能有所不同。 因此,当专家需要不同数量的数据时,我们考虑混合物,并训练一种稀疏的格子功能来分配每位专家的输入空间。 通过适当的超参数选择,我们的方法能够偏向于专家混合选择特定专家而不是其他专家。 这样,我们表明,视觉遥感和处理之间的数据传输优化可以作为一个曲线优化问题来解决。 为了证明数据可用性和性能之间的关系,我们评估了计算机常规视觉问题中各种有偏向的混合物,即:(一) 单发检测,(二) 图像超分辨率,(三) 实时视频动作分类。 在所有情况下,如果专家构成经修改的基准,以满足对允许的数据效用的不同限制,则有偏向的混合物大大超过先前的工作,而优化后则满足对现有数据的同样限制。

papers.title: Att-MoE: Attention-based Mixture of Experts for nuclear and cytoplasmic segmentation
papers.authors: Jinhua Liu, Christian Desrosiers, Yuanfeng Zhou
papers.title_zh: Att-MoE:核和细胞图层分解专家以关注为基础的混合体

papers.title: Weakly-Supervised Salient Object Detection via Scribble Annotations
papers.authors: Jing Zhang, Xin Yu, Aixuan Li, Peipei Song, Bowen Liu, Yuchao Dai
papers.abstract: Compared with laborious pixel-wise dense labeling, it is much easier to label data by scribbles, which only costs 1 2 seconds to label one image. However, using scribble labels to learn salient object detection has not been explored. In this paper, we propose a weakly-supervised salient object detection model to learn saliency from such annotations. In doing so, we first relabel an existing large-scale salient object detection dataset with scribbles, namely S-DUTS dataset. Since object structure and detail information is not identified by scribbles, directly training with scribble labels will lead to saliency maps of poor boundary localization. To mitigate this problem, we propose an auxiliary edge detection task to localize object edges explicitly, and a gated structure-aware loss to place constraints on the scope of structure to be recovered. Moreover, we design a scribble boosting scheme to iteratively consolidate our scribble annotations, which are then employed as supervision to learn high-quality saliency maps. As existing saliency evaluation metrics neglect to measure structure alignment of the predictions, the saliency map ranking may not comply with human perception. We present a new metric, termed saliency structure measure, as a complementary metric to evaluate sharpness of the prediction. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method not only outperforms existing weakly-supervised/unsupervised methods, but also is on par with several fully-supervised state-of-the-art models (Our code and data is publicly available at: https://github.com/JingZhang617/Scribble_Saliency).
papers.title_zh: 通过刻字说明探测微弱、超强威弱的高威威力物体
papers.abstract_zh: 与费力的像素密度标签相比,用刻字标出数据更容易得多,而用刻字标出一个图像只需要12秒钟。 但是,没有探索使用刻字标来学习显眼物体探测。 在本文中,我们提出了一个受微弱监督的显著物体探测模型,从这些说明中了解显著的物体探测模型。在这样做的时候,我们首先用拼字将现有的大型显著物体探测数据集,即S-DUTS数据集重新贴上标签。 由于目标结构和详细信息没有用书写形式加以识别,直接使用书写标签进行直接培训将导致绘制边界定位差的突出地图。 为缓解这一问题,我们提议开展辅助边缘探测任务,明确确定物体边缘的定位,并开展闭门结构意识损失,以限制有待回收的结构范围。 此外,我们设计了一种拼图推进计划,以迭接地巩固我们的拼图说明,然后将这些说明用作监督,以学习高质量的突出地图。 由于现有的突出评价指标忽视了测量预测的结构一致性,突出的地图排名可能不符合人类的认知。 我们提出了一个新的指标,称为显著的结构衡量标准,作为评估预测的清晰度的补充衡量标准。 关于六个基准数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法不仅优于现有的低监管/不受监督的方法,而且与几个完全监管的最新模型相当(我们的代码和数据公布在https://github.com/Jing Zhang617/Scribbow_Saliente网站上)。

papers.title: Visual-Textual Capsule Routing for Text-Based Video Segmentation
papers.authors: Bruce McIntosh, Kevin Duarte, Yogesh S Rawat, Mubarak Shah
papers.abstract: Joint understanding of vision and natural language is a challenging problem with a wide range of applications in artificial intelligence. In this work, we focus on integration of video and text for the task of actor and action video segmentation from a sentence. We propose a capsule-based approach which performs pixel-level localization based on a natural language query describing the actor of interest. We encode both the video and textual input in the form of capsules, which provide a more effective representation in comparison with standard convolution based features. Our novel visual-textual routing mechanism allows for the fusion of video and text capsules to successfully localize the actor and action. The existing works on actor-action localization are mainly focused on localization in a single frame instead of the full video. Different from existing works, we propose to perform the localization on all frames of the video. To validate the potential of the proposed network for actor and action video localization, we extend an existing actor-action dataset (A2D) with annotations for all the frames. The experimental evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness of our capsule network for text selective actor and action localization in videos. The proposed method also improves upon the performance of the existing state-of-the art works on single frame-based localization.
papers.title_zh: 文本视频分割视频的视觉- 文本缩放路由
papers.abstract_zh: 对视觉和自然语言的共同理解是一个具有挑战性的问题,在人工智能中应用范围很广。 在这项工作中,我们侧重于将视频和文字结合到一个句子中的行为者的任务和行动视频分割中。 我们提出一个基于胶囊的方法,在描述有关行为者的自然语言Query的基础上进行像素级本地化。 我们以胶囊的形式对视频和文本输入进行编码,这比标准革命特征更有效。 我们的新视觉-文字路由机制使得视频和文本胶囊得以融合,从而成功地将行为者和行动本地化。 现有的关于行为者-行动本地化的工作主要侧重于单一框架的本地化,而不是完整的视频。 与现有的作品不同,我们提议在视频的所有框上进行本地化。 为了验证拟议中的行为体和行动视频本地化网络的潜力,我们扩展了现有的行为体行动数据集,并对所有框做了说明。 实验性评价表明,我们的胶囊网络在视频中选择文本的行为者和行动定位方面是有效的,拟议方法还改进了现有最新艺术作品在单一框架化地方化方面的表现。

papers.title: Unsupervised Model Personalization While Preserving Privacy and Scalability: An Open Problem
papers.authors: Matthias De Lange, Xu Jia, Sarah Parisot, Ales Leonardis, Gregory Slabaugh, Tinne Tuytelaars
papers.abstract: This work investigates the task of unsupervised model personalization, adapted to continually evolving, unlabeled local user images. We consider the practical scenario where a high capacity server interacts with a myriad of resource-limited edge devices, imposing strong requirements on scalability and local data privacy. We aim to address this challenge within the continual learning paradigm and provide a novel Dual User-Adaptation framework (DUA) to explore the problem. This framework flexibly disentangles user-adaptation into model personalization on the server and local data regularization on the user device, with desirable properties regarding scalability and privacy constraints. First, on the server, we introduce incremental learning of task-specific expert models, subsequently aggregated using a concealed unsupervised user prior. Aggregation avoids retraining, whereas the user prior conceals sensitive raw user data, and grants unsupervised adaptation. Second, local user-adaptation incorporates a domain adaptation point of view, adapting regularizing batch normalization parameters to the user data. We explore various empirical user configurations with different priors in categories and a tenfold of transforms for MIT Indoor Scene recognition, and classify numbers in a combined MNIST and SVHN setup. Extensive experiments yield promising results for data-driven local adaptation and elicit user priors for server adaptation to depend on the model rather than user data. Hence, although user-adaptation remains a challenging open problem, the DUA framework formalizes a principled foundation for personalizing both on server and user device, while maintaining privacy and scalability.
papers.title_zh: 维护隐私和可扩缩性的同时未受监督的模型人格化模式:一个未决问题
papers.abstract_zh: 这项工作调查了不受监督的模型个性化任务,适应不断演变、无标签的本地用户图像。 我们考虑了高容量服务器与众多资源有限的边缘装置相互作用的实际情景,对可扩缩性和当地数据隐私提出了强烈要求。 我们的目标是在持续学习范式内应对这一挑战,并提供一个新的双重用户适应框架,以探讨这一问题。 这一框架灵活地分解了用户适应在服务器上的模型个性化和用户装置的本地数据规范化,在可缩放性和隐私限制方面具有可取的特性。 首先,在服务器上,我们引入了对具体任务专家模型的渐进学习,随后使用隐蔽的、无人监督的用户进行汇总。 聚合避免再培训,而用户先前隐藏敏感的原始用户数据,并允许不受监督的适应。 第二,地方用户适应纳入一个领域适应观点,根据用户数据调整批次正常化参数的正规化。 我们探索各种经验型用户配置,其前科类别不同,门场识别MIT Indoor Seen识别变换10倍,并将数字归为MNIST和SVHN的组合。 广泛的实验在数据驱动的地方适应方面产生了大有希望的结果,并吸引了用户在服务器适应前视模型而非用户数据而定。 因此,虽然用户适应仍然是一个具有挑战性的未解决的问题,但DUA框架正式确定了服务器和用户设备个人化的原则基础,同时保持隐私和可扩缩性。

papers.title: Transferring Cross-Domain Knowledge for Video Sign Language Recognition
papers.authors: Dongxu Li, Xin Yu, Chenchen Xu, Lars Petersson, Hongdong Li
papers.abstract: Word-level sign language recognition (WSLR) is a fundamental task in sign language interpretation. It requires models to recognize isolated sign words from videos. However, annotating WSLR data needs expert knowledge, thus limiting WSLR dataset acquisition. On the contrary, there are abundant subtitled sign news videos on the internet. Since these videos have no word-level annotation and exhibit a large domain gap from isolated signs, they cannot be directly used for training WSLR models. We observe that despite the existence of a large domain gap, isolated and news signs share the same visual concepts, such as hand gestures and body movements. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel method that learns domain-invariant visual concepts and fertilizes WSLR models by transferring knowledge of subtitled news sign to them. To this end, we extract news signs using a base WSLR model, and then design a classifier jointly trained on news and isolated signs to coarsely align these two domain features. In order to learn domain-invariant features within each class and suppress domain-specific features, our method further resorts to an external memory to store the class centroids of the aligned news signs. We then design a temporal attention based on the learnt descriptor to improve recognition performance. Experimental results on standard WSLR datasets show that our method outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods significantly. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on automatically localizing signs from sign news, achieving 28.1 for AP@0.5.
papers.title_zh: 传播跨域视频手语识别知识
papers.abstract_zh: 语言手语识别(WSLR)是手语翻译的一项基本任务,需要模型识别视频中孤立的手语。然而,对手语识别(WSLR)数据的说明需要专家知识,从而限制手语翻译(WSLR)数据集的获取。 相反,互联网上有很多字幕标志性新闻视频。 由于这些视频没有字级注解,而且与孤立的信号存在巨大的领域差距,因此不能直接用于培训WSLR模型。 我们注意到,尽管存在巨大的领域差距,但孤立和新闻信号有着相同的视觉概念,例如手势和身体运动。 基于这一观察,我们提议一种新颖的方法,通过向它们传授字幕新闻标志知识,学习域变量视觉概念,并施肥WSLR模型。 为此,我们使用WSLR模型提取新闻信号,然后设计一个联合接受新闻和孤立信号培训的分类师,粗略地对这两个域名进行统一。 为了学习每一类中的域变量特征并抑制特定域的特征,我们的方法进一步利用外部记忆存储对应新闻信号的类类中子。 然后我们根据所学的描述符设计一个时间关注点,以提高识别性能。 WSLR标准数据集的实验结果显示,我们的方法比以往最先进的方法表现得要好得多。 我们还展示了我们的方法在信号新闻自动定位信号上的有效性,在AP@0.5中实现了28.1。

papers.title: Transferring and Regularizing Prediction for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Yiheng Zhang, Zhaofan Qiu, Ting Yao, Chong-Wah Ngo, Dong Liu, Tao Mei
papers.abstract: Semantic segmentation often requires a large set of images with pixel-level annotations. In the view of extremely expensive expert labeling, recent research has shown that the models trained on photo-realistic synthetic data (e.g., computer games) with computer-generated annotations can be adapted to real images. Despite this progress, without constraining the prediction on real images, the models will easily overfit on synthetic data due to severe domain mismatch. In this paper, we novelly exploit the intrinsic properties of semantic segmentation to alleviate such problem for model transfer. Specifically, we present a Regularizer of Prediction Transfer (RPT) that imposes the intrinsic properties as constraints to regularize model transfer in an unsupervised fashion. These constraints include patch-level, cluster-level and context-level semantic prediction consistencies at different levels of image formation. As the transfer is label-free and data-driven, the robustness of prediction is addressed by selectively involving a subset of image regions for model regularization. Extensive experiments are conducted to verify the proposal of RPT on the transfer of models trained on GTA5 and SYNTHIA (synthetic data) to Cityscapes dataset (urban street scenes). RPT shows consistent improvements when injecting the constraints on several neural networks for semantic segmentation. More remarkably, when integrating RPT into the adversarial-based segmentation framework, we report to-date the best results: mIoU of 53.2%/51.7% when transferring from GTA5/SYNTHIA to Cityscapes, respectively.
papers.title_zh: 语义分割的传输和规范化预测
papers.abstract_zh: 语义分解往往需要大量带有像素级注释的图像。 考虑到极其昂贵的专家标签,最近的研究表明,在具有计算机产生的注释的摄影现实合成数据(例如计算机游戏)方面受过培训的模型可以适应真实的图像。 尽管如此,尽管取得了这些进步,在不限制对真实图像的预测的情况下,模型由于严重的域错配,很容易对合成数据过度适用。 在本文中,我们以新颖的方式利用语义分割的内在特性来缓解模型转移的此类问题。 具体地说,我们提出一个预测转让管制制度,把内在特性作为限制条件,以不受监督的方式规范模式转让。 这些制约因素包括不同图像形成层次的补丁层次、集群层次和背景层次的语义预测组合,由于这种转移是无标签和数据驱动的,因此通过有选择地将一组图像区域用于模型正规化,解决了预测的稳健性。 进行了广泛的实验,以核实欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚方案关于将接受过GTA5和SYNTHIA(合成数据)培训的模型转换到城景数据集(城市街道场景)的建议,欧洲防止酷刑和不人道或有辱人格的待遇或处罚方案在对若干神经网络进行语义分解的限制时显示出不断的改进。 更显著的是,在将RTT/PT纳入以对抗性为基础的分割框架时,我们报告取得的最佳成果是:从GTA5/SYNTHIA向城市景色转移时,MIOU分别占53.2%/51.7%。

papers.title: Temporal-aware Query Routing for Real-time Video Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Zesen Cheng · Kehan Li · Yian Zhao · Hang Zhang · Chang Liu · Jie Chen
papers.abstract: With the rise of applications such as embodied intelligence, developing high real-time online video instance segmentation (VIS) has become increasingly important. However, through time profiling of the components in advanced online VIS architecture (i.e., transformer-based architecture), we find that the transformer decoder significantly hampers the inference speed. Further analysis of the similarities between the outputs from adjacent frames at each transformer decoder layer reveals significant redundant computations within the transformer decoder. To address this issue, we introduce Temporal-Aware query Routing (TAR) mechanism. We embed it before each transformer decoder layer. By fusing the optimal queries from the previous frame, the queries output by the preceding decoder layer, and their differential information, TAR predicts a binary classification score and then uses an argmax operation to determine whether the current layer should be skipped. Experimental results demonstrate that integrating TAR into the baselines achieves significant efficiency gains (24.7 → 34.6 FPS for MinVIS, 22.4 → 32.8 FPS for DVIS++) while also improving performance (e.g., on YoutubeVIS 2019, 47.4 → 48.4 AP for MinVIS, 55.5 → 55.7 AP for DVIS++). Furthermore, our analysis of the TAR mechanism shows that the number of skipped layers increases as the differences between adjacent video frames decrease, which suggests that our method effectively utilizes inter-frame differences to reduce redundant computations in the transformer decoder.
papers.title_zh: 实时视频集线切换实时视频集线Query
papers.abstract_zh: 随着内装情报等应用程序的增多,开发高实时在线视频实例分解(VIS)变得日益重要。 然而,通过对先进的在线VIS结构(即以变压器为基础的结构)的组件进行时间剖析,我们发现变压器拆解器大大妨碍了推论速度。 进一步分析每个变压器解码器层相邻框架的输出结果的相似性,发现变压器解码器内部有大量的重复计算。 为解决这一问题,我们引入了时间- 软件Query路由机制( TAR) 。 我们将其嵌入到每个变压器解码器层之前 。 TAR通过模拟前一个框架的最佳Query、前一个解码层的Query输出及其差异信息,预测二进制分类分数,然后使用回压操作来确定是否跳过当前层。 实验结果显示,将TAR纳入基线可实现显著的增效(MinVIS为24.7 +34.6 FPS,DVIS++为22.4 + 32.8 FPS),同时提高业绩(例如,YoutubeVIS 2019,47.4 48.4 APS,DVIS++为55.5 55.7 APS)。 此外,我们对TAR机制的分析表明,随着相邻视频框架差异的缩小,被跳过层的数目有所增加,这表明我们的方法有效利用了框架间差异,以减少变压器解码器中的冗余计算。

papers.title: Switchable Online Knowledge Distillation
papers.authors: Biao Qian, Yang Wang, Hongzhi Yin, Richang Hong, Meng Wang
papers.abstract: "Online Knowledge Distillation (OKD) improves the involved models by reciprocally exploiting the difference between teacher and student. Several crucial bottlenecks over the gap between them -- e.g., Why and when does a large gap harm the performance, especially for student? How to quantify the gap between teacher and student? -- have received limited formal study. In this paper, we propose Switchable Online Knowledge Distillation (SwitOKD), to answer these questions.Instead of focusing on the accuracy gap at test phase by the existing arts, the core idea of SwitOKD is to adaptively calibrate the gap at training phase, namely distillation gap, via a switching strategy be-tween two modes -- expert mode (pause the teacher while keep the student learning) and learning mode (restart the teacher). To possess an appropriate distillation gap, we further devise an adaptive switching threshold, which provides a formal criterion as to when to switch to learning mode or expert mode, and thus improves the student’s performance. Meanwhile, the teacher benefits from our adaptive switching threshold and keeps basically on a par with other online arts. We further extend SwitOKD to multiple networks with two basis topologies. Finally, extensive experiments and analysis validate the merits of SwitOKD for classification over the state-of-the-arts. Our code is available at https://github.com/hfutqian/SwitOKD."
papers.title_zh: 在线知识蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: “在线知识蒸馏(OKD)通过对等利用教师和学生之间的差别来改善参与模式。 解决两者间差距的几个关键瓶颈 — — 例如,为什么和何时出现巨大差距会损害业绩,特别是学生的绩效? ” 如何量化师生之间的差距? -- -- 接受的正式学习有限。 在本文中,我们提出了可移植在线知识蒸馏(SwitOKD),以回答这些问题。 SwitOKD的核心思想不是强调现有艺术在测试阶段的准确性差距,而是通过转换战略,即两种模式 -- -- 专家模式(在学生继续学习的同时暂停教师)和学习模式(重新开始教师),在培训阶段适应性地校准差距,即蒸馏差距。 为了拥有适当的蒸馏差距,我们进一步设计了适应性转换阈值,该阈值为何时改用学习模式或专家模式提供了一个正式标准,从而改善了学生的表现。 与此同时,教师从我们适应性的转换阈值中受益,并与其他在线艺术基本保持相同。 我们进一步将SwitOKD推广到有两种基础结构的多个网络。 最后,广泛的实验和分析证实了SwitOKD在最新艺术分类方面的优点。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/hfutqian/SwitOKD上查阅。

papers.title: Structure Boundary Preserving Segmentation for Medical Image With Ambiguous Boundary
papers.authors: Hong Joo Lee, Jung Uk Kim, Sangmin Lee, Hak Gu Kim, Yong Man Ro
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel image segmentation method to tackle two critical problems of medical image, which are (i) ambiguity of structure boundary in the medical image domain and (ii) uncertainty of the segmented region without specialized domain knowledge. To solve those two problems in automatic medical segmentation, we propose a novel structure boundary preserving segmentation framework. To this end, the boundary key point selection algorithm is proposed. In the proposed algorithm, the key points on the structural boundary of the target object are estimated. Then, a boundary preserving block (BPB) with the boundary key point map is applied for predicting the structure boundary of the target object. Further, for embedding experts' knowledge in the fully automatic segmentation, we propose a novel shape boundary-aware evaluator (SBE) with the ground-truth structure information indicated by experts. The proposed SBE could give feedback to the segmentation network based on the structure boundary key point. The proposed method is general and flexible enough to be built on top of any deep learning-based segmentation network. We demonstrate that the proposed method could surpass the state-of-the-art segmentation network and improve the accuracy of three different segmentation network models on different types of medical image datasets.
papers.title_zh: 边界结构 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界 边界
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出一种新的图像分割方法,以解决医学图像的两个关键问题,即(一) 医学图像领域结构界限的模糊性;(二) 没有专门领域知识的分割区域的不确定性。 为了解决自动医疗分离这两个问题,我们建议建立一个新型结构边界保护分离框架。 为此,提出了边界关键点选择算法。 在拟议的算法中,对目标物体结构边界的要点进行了估计。 然后,在预测目标物体的结构边界时,使用带有边界关键点地图的边界保护区块(BBB)。 此外,为了将专家的知识嵌入完全自动分割中,我们提议建立一个新型的边界意识评估(SBE),配有专家指出的地面真相结构信息。 拟议的边界意识评估(SBE)可以向基于结构边界关键点的分割网络提供反馈。 拟议的方法既笼统又灵活,足以在任何深层的基于学习的分化网络之上建立起来。 我们证明,拟议方法可以超过最新分类网络,提高不同类型医学图像数据集三个不同分类网络模型的准确性。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Fusion in 3D CNNs: A Probabilistic View
papers.authors: Yizhou Zhou, Xiaoyan Sun, Chong Luo, Zheng-Jun Zha, Wenjun Zeng
papers.abstract: Despite the success in still image recognition, deep neural networks for spatiotemporal signal tasks (such as human action recognition in videos) still suffers from low efficacy and inefficiency over the past years. Recently, human experts have put more efforts into analyzing the importance of different components in 3D convolutional neural networks (3D CNNs) to design more powerful spatiotemporal learning backbones. Among many others, spatiotemporal fusion is one of the essentials. It controls how spatial and temporal signals are extracted at each layer during inference. Previous attempts usually start by ad-hoc designs that empirically combine certain convolutions and then draw conclusions based on the performance obtained by training the corresponding networks. These methods only support network-level analysis on limited number of fusion strategies. In this paper, we propose to convert the spatiotemporal fusion strategies into a probability space, which allows us to perform network-level evaluations of various fusion strategies without having to train them separately. Besides, we can also obtain fine-grained numerical information such as layer-level preference on spatiotemporal fusion within the probability space. Our approach greatly boosts the efficiency of analyzing spatiotemporal fusion. Based on the probability space, we further generate new fusion strategies which achieve the state-of-the-art performance on four well-known action recognition datasets.
papers.title_zh: 3D CNN 3D 的相片时间融合:概率观点
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在形象识别方面仍然取得了成功,但是在过去几年里,超时信号任务的深层神经网络(如视频中的人的行动识别)仍然效力低,效率低。 最近,人类专家更加努力地分析3D进化神经网络(3D CNNs)中不同组成部分的重要性,以设计更强大的时空学习骨干。 除其他外,中时融合是关键之一。 它控制着在推论期间如何在每一层中提取时空信号。 先前的尝试通常从将某些演变从经验上结合起来的特设设计开始,然后根据培训相应的网络所获得的业绩得出结论。 这些方法只支持对数量有限的聚变战略进行网络级分析。 在本文中,我们提议将中时聚变战略转换为概率空间,从而使我们能够对各种聚变战略进行网络级评价,而不必对其进行单独培训。 此外,我们还可以获得精细的数字信息,比如在概率空间范围内对间歇性聚变的层次偏好。 我们的方法极大地提高了对间歇性聚变的分析效率。 根据概率空间,我们进一步制定新的聚变战略,在四个众所周知的行动识别数据集上取得SOTA 性能。

papers.title: Sequential Mastery of Multiple Visual Tasks: Networks Naturally Learn to Learn and Forget to Forget
papers.authors: Guy Davidson, Michael C. Mozer
papers.abstract: We explore the behavior of a standard convolutional neural net in a continual-learning setting that introduces visual classification tasks sequentially and requires the net to master new tasks while preserving mastery of previously learned tasks. This setting corresponds to that which human learners face as they acquire domain expertise serially, for example, as an individual studies a textbook. Through simulations involving sequences of ten related visual tasks, we find reason for optimism that nets will scale well as they advance from having a single skill to becoming multi-skill domain experts. We observe two key phenomena. First, forward facilitation---the accelerated learning of task n+1 having learned n previous tasks---grows with n. Second, backward interference---the forgetting of the n previous tasks when learning task n+1 ---diminishes with n. Amplifying forward facilitation is the goal of research on metalearning, and attenuating backward interference is the goal of research on catastrophic forgetting. We find that both of these goals are attained simply through broader exposure to a domain.
papers.title_zh: 多重视觉任务序列掌握:自然学习学习和忘记遗忘的网络
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探讨标准进化神经网在不断学习环境中的行为,这种学习环境按顺序引入视觉分类任务,要求网络掌握新任务,同时保持掌握以前学到的任务的能力。 这种环境与人类学习者在获得领域专门知识时所面临的环境相对应,例如,作为个人研究教科书。 通过涉及10项相关视觉任务的序列的模拟,我们有理由乐观地认为,蚊帐的规模将会扩大,并且从拥有单一技能发展到成为多技能领域专家。 我们观察了两个关键现象。 首先,前期便利- 加速学习任务n+1, 学习了前期任务- 第二, 后向干扰- 学习任务n+1时忘记了前期任务n+1- 与 n 的二进制。 扩大前向促进是金属收益研究的目标,减少后向干扰是灾难性遗忘研究的目标。 我们发现,这两个目标都是通过更广泛地接触一个领域来实现的。

papers.title: Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: Deep Multimodal Sensor Fusion in Unseen Adverse Weather
papers.authors: Mario Bijelic, Tobias Gruber, Fahim Mannan, Florian Kraus, Werner Ritter, Klaus Dietmayer, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: The fusion of multimodal sensor streams, such as camera, lidar, and radar measurements, plays a critical role in object detection for autonomous vehicles, which base their decision making on these inputs. While existing methods exploit redundant information in good environmental conditions, they fail in adverse weather where the sensory streams can be asymmetrically distorted. These rare "edge-case" scenarios are not represented in available datasets, and existing fusion architectures are not designed to handle them. To address this challenge we present a novel multimodal dataset acquired in over 10,000 km of driving in northern Europe. Although this dataset is the first large multimodal dataset in adverse weather, with 100k labels for lidar, camera, radar, and gated NIR sensors, it does not facilitate training as extreme weather is rare. To this end, we present a deep fusion network for robust fusion without a large corpus of labeled training data covering all asymmetric distortions. Departing from proposal-level fusion, we propose a single-shot model that adaptively fuses features, driven by measurement entropy. We validate the proposed method, trained on clean data, on our extensive validation dataset. Code and data are available here https://github.com/princeton-computational-imaging/SeeingThroughFog.
papers.title_zh: 在看不见的不利天气中通过雾而看不到雾:深多式感应器融合
papers.abstract_zh: 摄影机、激光雷达和雷达测量等多式传感器流的融合在自动车辆的物体探测方面发挥着关键作用,而自动车辆的物体探测是根据这些输入量作出决定的。 虽然现有方法在良好的环境条件下利用多余信息,但在不利的天气中却失败,因为感官流可能会被不对称地失真。 这些稀有的“尖端情况”情景没有体现在现有的数据集中,而现有的聚变结构也不是用来处理的。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出了一套在北欧超过10 000公里的驾驶上获得的新的多式联运数据集。 虽然该数据集是不利天气中第一个大型多式联运数据集,为利达尔、照相机、雷达和封闭式国家清单报告传感器贴了100公里的标签,但由于极端天气少见,该数据集无助于培训。 为此,我们为强力融合提供了一个深层融合网络,而没有包含所有不对称失真现象的大量有标签的培训数据。 我们从建议一级的融合中分离出一个单发模型,该模型由测量导力驱动,具有适应性引信特性。 我们根据我们广泛的验证数据集,验证了在清洁数据方面受过培训的拟议方法。 代码和数据见于https://github.com/princeton-computational-imaging/SeingThroughFog。

papers.title: Searching Central Difference Convolutional Networks for Face Anti-Spoofing
papers.authors: Zitong Yu, Chenxu Zhao, Zezheng Wang, Yunxiao Qin, Zhuo Su, Xiaobai Li, Feng Zhou, Guoying Zhao
papers.abstract: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) plays a vital role in face recognition systems. Most state-of-the-art FAS methods 1) rely on stacked convolutions and expert-designed network, which is weak in describing detailed fine-grained information and easily being ineffective when the environment varies (e.g., different illumination), and 2) prefer to use long sequence as input to extract dynamic features, making them difficult to deploy into scenarios which need quick response. Here we propose a novel frame level FAS method based on Central Difference Convolution (CDC), which is able to capture intrinsic detailed patterns via aggregating both intensity and gradient information. A network built with CDC, called the Central Difference Convolutional Network (CDCN), is able to provide more robust modeling capacity than its counterpart built with vanilla convolution. Furthermore, over a specifically designed CDC search space, Neural Architecture Search (NAS) is utilized to discover a more powerful network structure (CDCN++), which can be assembled with Multiscale Attention Fusion Module (MAFM) for further boosting performance. Comprehensive experiments are performed on six benchmark datasets to show that 1) the proposed method not only achieves superior performance on intra-dataset testing (especially 0.2% ACER in Protocol-1 of OULU-NPU dataset), 2) it also generalizes well on cross-dataset testing (particularly 6.5% HTER from CASIA-MFSD to Replay-Attack datasets). The codes are available at https://github.com/ZitongYu/CDCN.
papers.title_zh: 寻找中心差异搜索中心 革命网络 对抗威胁
papers.abstract_zh: 面部识别系统(FAS)在面部识别系统中发挥着至关重要的作用。 大多数最先进的FAS方法1 依靠堆叠式的集成和专家设计的网络,这些网络在描述详细的精细信息方面软弱无力,在环境变化(例如不同的照明)时很容易失效;2 倾向于使用长顺序作为输入,以提取动态特征,使其难以用于需要快速反应的情景。 在此,我们根据中央差异革命(CDC)提出一个新的FAS级框架水平方法,它能够通过汇总强度和梯度信息来捕捉内在的详细模式。 与疾控中心(称为中央差异革命网络(CDCN))建立的网络能够提供比与香草革命建立的对口网络更强健的建模能力。 此外,在专门设计的CDC搜索空间中,神经结构搜索(NAS)被用来发现一个更强大的网络结构(CDCN+++),可以与多级聚聚聚模块(MAFM)组装,以进一步提高性能。 对6个基准数据集进行了全面试验,以表明:1)拟议方法不仅在内部数据集测试(特别是OULU-NPU数据集协议1中的0.2%的ACER)上取得优异性能,2)还广泛概括了交叉数据集测试(特别是CASIA-MFSD到回放-Atack数据集的6.5% HTER)。 这些代码可在https://github.com/ZitongYu/CDCN上查阅。

papers.title: RoutedFusion: Learning Real-Time Depth Map Fusion
papers.authors: Silvan Weder, Johannes Schonberger, Marc Pollefeys, Martin R. Oswald
papers.abstract: The efficient fusion of depth maps is a key part of most state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction methods. Besides requiring high accuracy, these depth fusion methods need to be scalable and real-time capable. To this end, we present a novel real-time capable machine learning-based method for depth map fusion. Similar to the seminal depth map fusion approach by Curless and Levoy, we only update a local group of voxels to ensure real-time capability. Instead of a simple linear fusion of depth information, we propose a neural network that predicts non-linear updates to better account for typical fusion errors. Our network is composed of a 2D depth routing network and a 3D depth fusion network which efficiently handle sensor-specific noise and outliers. This is especially useful for surface edges and thin objects for which the original approach suffers from thickening artifacts. Our method outperforms the traditional fusion approach and related learned approaches on both synthetic and real data. We demonstrate the performance of our method in reconstructing fine geometric details from noise and outlier contaminated data on various scenes.
papers.title_zh: 路由:学习实时深度图组合
papers.abstract_zh: 深度地图的有效融合是大多数最先进的3D重建方法的关键部分。 这些深度融合方法除了要求高精度外,还需要具有可缩放和实时能力。 为此,我们提出了一个新型的基于实时机能学习的深度地图融合方法。 类似Curless和Levoy的原始深度地图聚合方法,我们只更新本地的氧化物组以确保实时能力。 我们提议建立一个神经网络,预测非线性更新,以更好地说明典型的聚变错误。 我们的网络由2D深度路由网络和3D深度聚变网络组成,它们高效地处理传感器特有的噪音和外部离子,对于最初方法受到厚度文物影响的表面边缘和稀薄物体特别有用。 我们的方法优于传统的聚合法和关于合成数据和真实数据的相关学习方法。 我们展示了我们从噪音和外部污染数据中重建精细几何细节的方法在各种场景的表现。

papers.title: Progressive Relation Learning for Group Activity Recognition
papers.authors: Guyue Hu, Bo Cui, Yuan He, Shan Yu
papers.abstract: Group activities usually involve spatio-temporal dynamics among many interactive individuals, while only a few participants at several key frames essentially define the activity. Therefore, effectively modeling the group-relevant and suppressing the irrelevant actions (and interactions) are vital for group activity recognition. In this paper, we propose a novel method based on deep reinforcement learning to progressively refine the low-level features and high-level relations of group activities. Firstly, we construct a semantic relation graph (SRG) to explicitly model the relations among persons. Then, two agents adopting policy according to two Markov decision processes are applied to progressively refine the SRG. Specifically, one feature-distilling (FD) agent in the discrete action space refines the low-level spatio-temporal features by distilling the most informative frames. Another relation-gating (RG) agent in continuous action space adjusts the high-level semantic graph to pay more attention to group-relevant relations. The SRG, FD agent, and RG agent are optimized alternately to mutually boost the performance of each other. Extensive experiments on two widely used benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach.
papers.title_zh: 群体活动识别渐进关系学习
papers.abstract_zh: 团体活动通常涉及许多互动个人之间的时空空间动态,而几个关键框架只有少数参与者基本上界定了活动。 因此,有效模拟与群体相关的行动,制止不相关行动(和互动),对于确认群体活动至关重要。 在本文中,我们提出基于深层强化学习的新颖方法,以逐步完善小组活动的低层次特征和高级别关系,首先,我们建立一个语义关系图(SRG),以明确模拟人与人之间的关系。 然后,根据两个Markov决定程序通过政策的两个代理商应用来逐步完善SRG,具体地说,离散行动空间的一个特性蒸馏剂(FD)通过提炼信息最丰富的框架来完善低水平的时空空间特征。 连续行动空间中的另一个关系定位代理(RG)对高级语义图进行了调整,以更加关注与群体的关系。 SRG、FD代理和RG代理相互优化,以相互促进对方的性能。 在两个广泛使用的基准上进行广泛试验,表明拟议办法的有效性和优越性。

papers.title: Progressive Adversarial Networks for Fine-Grained Domain Adaptation
papers.authors: Sinan Wang, Xinyang Chen, Yunbo Wang, Mingsheng Long, Jianmin Wang
papers.abstract: Fine-grained visual categorization has long been considered as an important problem, however, its real application is still restricted, since precisely annotating a large fine-grained image dataset is a laborious task and requires expert-level human knowledge. A solution to this problem is applying domain adaptation approaches to fine-grained scenarios, where the key idea is to discover the commonality between existing fine-grained image datasets and massive unlabeled data in the wild. The main technical bottleneck lies in that the large inter-domain variation will deteriorate the subtle boundaries of small inter-class variation during domain alignment. This paper presents the Progressive Adversarial Networks (PAN) to align fine-grained categories across domains with a curriculum-based adversarial learning framework. In particular, throughout the learning process, domain adaptation is carried out through all multi-grained features, progressively exploiting the label hierarchy from coarse to fine. The progressive learning is applied upon both category classification and domain alignment, boosting both the discriminability and the transferability of the fine-grained features. Our method is evaluated on three benchmarks, two of which are proposed by us, and it outperforms the state-of-the-art domain adaptation methods.
papers.title_zh: 先进广域适应进步反向网络
papers.abstract_zh: 长期以来,人们一直认为精细的视觉分类是一个重要问题,然而,其实际应用仍然受到限制,因为准确指出一个精细的大型图像数据集是一项艰巨的任务,需要专家一级的人类知识。 解决这一问题的一个解决办法是对微小设想方案采用领域适应办法,其中关键的想法是发现现有微小图像数据集与野外大量无标签数据之间的共性。 主要的技术瓶颈在于,大型的部间差异将恶化域对齐期间小类间差异的微妙界限。 本文介绍渐进反向网络,使各领域的细微类别与基于课程的对抗性学习框架保持一致。 特别是,在整个学习过程中,对域的适应是通过所有多重特性进行的,逐步利用标签等级,从粗俗到罚款。 累进学习既适用于分类分类,也适用于域对齐,同时促进细细收成特征的可区别性和可转移性。 我们的方法按照三个基准进行评估,其中两个由我们提出,它比最先进的领域适应方法要好。

papers.title: LiDAR-Based Online 3D Video Object Detection With Graph-Based Message Passing and Spatiotemporal Transformer Attention
papers.authors: Junbo Yin, Jianbing Shen, Chenye Guan, Dingfu Zhou, Ruigang Yang
papers.abstract: Existing LiDAR-based 3D object detectors usually focus on the single-frame detection, while ignoring the spatiotemporal information in consecutive point cloud frames. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end online 3D video object detector that operates on point cloud sequences. The proposed model comprises a spatial feature encoding component and a spatiotemporal feature aggregation component. In the former component, a novel Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) is proposed to encode each discrete point cloud frame. It adaptively collects information for a pillar node from its neighbors by iterative message passing, which effectively enlarges the receptive field of the pillar feature. In the latter component, we propose an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) to aggregate the spatiotemporal information, which enhances the conventional ConvGRU with an attentive memory gating mechanism. AST-GRU contains a Spatial Transformer Attention (STA) module and a Temporal Transformer Attention (TTA) module, which can emphasize the foreground objects and align the dynamic objects, respectively. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed 3D video object detector achieves state-of-the-art performance on the large-scale nuScenes benchmark.
papers.title_zh: 以LiDAR为基础的在线3D视频对象探测,以图表为基础的信件传递和瞬时变换器关注
papers.abstract_zh: 现有基于 LiDAR 的三维天体探测器通常侧重于单框架探测,而忽略连续点云框中的时空信息。 在本文中,我们提议使用点云序列运行的端对端三维视频天体探测器。 拟议模式包括一个空间特征编码部分和一个时空特征汇总部分,在前一个部分中,提议建立一个新的支柱信息传递网络(PMPNet),为每个离散点云框架编码。 它通过反复传递信息,从邻国收集支柱节点的信息,这有效地扩大了支柱特征的可接受领域。 在后一个组成部分中,我们提议设立一个快速超时变压器GRU(AST-GRU),以汇总时空信息,通过一个专注的记忆定位机制,加强常规的ConvGRU。 AST-GRU包含一个空间变换引力模块和一个时空变换引力模块,可以分别强调前景对象和对动态对象进行对齐。 实验结果显示,拟议的3D视频物体探测器在大型核监视基准上取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Learning to Optimize on SPD Manifolds
papers.authors: Zhi Gao, Yuwei Wu, Yunde Jia, Mehrtash Harandi
papers.abstract: Many tasks in computer vision and machine learning are modeled as optimization problems with constraints in the form of Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) matrices. Solving such optimization problems is challenging due to the non-linearity of the SPD manifold, making optimization with SPD constraints heavily relying on expert knowledge and human involvement. In this paper, we propose a meta-learning method to automatically learn an iterative optimizer on SPD manifolds. Specifically, we introduce a novel recurrent model that takes into account the structure of input gradients and identifies the updating scheme of optimization. We parameterize the optimizer by the recurrent model and utilize Riemannian operations to ensure that our method is faithful to the geometry of SPD manifolds. Compared with existing SPD optimizers, our optimizer effectively exploits the underlying data distribution and learns a better optimization trajectory in a data-driven manner. Extensive experiments on various computer vision tasks including metric nearness, clustering, and similarity learning demonstrate that our optimizer outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods consistently.
papers.title_zh: 学习如何优化 SPD 的 SPD 挂图
papers.abstract_zh: 计算机视觉和机器学习方面的许多任务都以优化问题为模式,其制约形式是正负缺矩阵(SPD)。 解决这种优化问题之所以具有挑战性,是因为SPD的方方面面没有线性,使SPD限制的优化严重依赖专家知识和人的参与。 在本文中,我们提出了一种元学习方法,以自动学习SPD的方方面面的迭代优化器。 具体地说,我们引入了一种考虑到输入梯度结构并确定更新优化办法的新颖的重复模式。 我们用重复模式对优化进行参数化,并利用里曼尼亚操作确保我们的方法符合SPD 元的几何结构。 与现有的SPD优化器相比,我们的优化器有效地利用了基本数据分布,并以数据驱动的方式学习了更好的优化轨迹。 关于各种计算机视觉任务的广泛实验,包括测量近距离、集群和相似性学习,表明我们的优化优于现有最先进方法的一贯性。

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Routing for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Yanwei Li, Lin Song, Yukang Chen, Zeming Li, Xiangyu Zhang, Xingang Wang, Jian Sun
papers.abstract: Recently, numerous handcrafted and searched networks have been applied for semantic segmentation. However, previous works intend to handle inputs with various scales in pre-defined static architectures, such as FCN, U-Net, and DeepLab series. This paper studies a conceptually new method to alleviate the scale variance in semantic representation, named dynamic routing. The proposed framework generates data-dependent routes, adapting to the scale distribution of each image. To this end, a differentiable gating function, called soft conditional gate, is proposed to select scale transform paths on the fly. In addition, the computational cost can be further reduced in an end-to-end manner by giving budget constraints to the gating function. We further relax the network level routing space to support multi-path propagations and skip-connections in each forward, bringing substantial network capacity. To demonstrate the superiority of the dynamic property, we compare with several static architectures, which can be modeled as special cases in the routing space. Extensive experiments are conducted on Cityscapes and PASCAL VOC 2012 to illustrate the effectiveness of the dynamic framework. Code is available at https://github.com/yanwei-li/DynamicRouting.
papers.title_zh: 语义分割的学习动态路由
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,许多手工制作和搜索的网络被应用于语义分割,然而,先前的工程打算以各种规模处理预先界定的静态结构(如FCN、U-Net和DeepLab系列)的投入。 本文研究一种概念上新的方法,以缓解语义表达方式上的规模差异,称为动态路由,拟议框架产生依赖数据的路径,适应每个图像的规模分布。 为此,提议采用一个称为软性有条件门的可区别的格子功能,以选择天体上的规模变形路径,此外,可以通过对格子功能实行预算限制,以端对端的方式进一步降低计算成本。 我们进一步放松网络一级的路线空间,以支持多途径传播和每个前方的跳过连接,从而带来大量的网络能力。 为了显示动态属性的优越性,我们比较了几个静态结构,这些结构可以作为路由空间的特例进行建模,对城市景区和2012年PACAL VOC进行了广泛的实验,以说明动态框架的有效性。 法规可在https://github.com/yanwei-li/DynicRouting查阅。

papers.title: Improving the Robustness of Capsule Networks to Image Affine Transformations
papers.authors: Jindong Gu, Volker Tresp
papers.abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) achieve translational invariance by using pooling operations. However, the operations do not preserve the spatial relationships in the learned representations. Hence, CNNs cannot extrapolate to various geometric transformations of inputs. Recently, Capsule Networks (CapsNets) have been proposed to tackle this problem. In CapsNets, each entity is represented by a vector and routed to high-level entity representations by a dynamic routing algorithm. CapsNets have been shown to be more robust than CNNs to affine transformations of inputs. However, there is still a huge gap between their performance on transformed inputs compared to untransformed versions. In this work, we first revisit the routing procedure by (un)rolling its forward and backward passes. Our investigation reveals that the routing procedure contributes neither to the generalization ability nor to the affine robustness of the CapsNets. Furthermore, we explore the limitations of capsule transformations and propose affine CapsNets (Aff-CapsNets), which are more robust to affine transformations. On our benchmark task, where models are trained on the MNIST dataset and tested on the AffNIST dataset, our Aff-CapsNets improve the benchmark performance by a large margin (from 79% to 93.21%), without using any routing mechanism.
papers.title_zh: 提高 Capsule 网络的强度, 使图像折叠转换
papers.abstract_zh: 革命性神经网络(CNNs)通过使用集合操作实现翻译差异,然而,这些操作并不维护所学的演示中的空间关系。 因此,CNN无法推断投入的各种几何转换。 最近,为解决这一问题,提议了Capsule网络(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets))(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets))(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(Caps)(CapsNets (CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CapsNets)(CaptsNets)(Caps)(CaptsNets)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(CaptsNets) (Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(CapsNetsNetsNets)(CaptsNets)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(CapsNets)(Caps)(Caps)(Crection) (Caps)(CapsNetsNetsNetsNetsNets)(Caps) () () () () () () (CapsNets) () () (Caps)(Caps)(Caps)(CapsNets)(Caps)(Caps)(Caps) 然而,与非变换版本相比,它们在转换投入方面的表现仍然存在着巨大的差距。 在这项工作中,我们首先通过前向和后向的移动来重新审视路径程序。 我们的调查显示,路线程序既无助于普及能力,也无助于CapsNets的稳健性。 此外,我们探索胶囊变形的局限性,并提议建立更能适应同系物变形的Aff-CapsNets(Aff-CapsNets ) , 并提议建立更能适应同系物变形的Aff-CapsNets(Aff-CapsNets ) 。 在我们的基准任务方面,在对模型进行MNIST数据集培训并在AffNIST数据集上测试时,我们的Aff-CapsNet在不使用任何路由机制的情况下,大大改进了基准业绩(从79%到93.21%)。

papers.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop End-to-End Optimization of Camera Image Processing Pipelines
papers.authors: Ali Mosleh, Avinash Sharma, Emmanuel Onzon, Fahim Mannan, Nicolas Robidoux, Felix Heide
papers.abstract: Commodity imaging systems rely on hardware image signal processing (ISP) pipelines. These low-level pipelines consist of a sequence of processing blocks that, depending on their hyperparameters, reconstruct a color image from RAW sensor measurements. Hardware ISP hyperparameters have a complex interaction with the output image, and therefore with the downstream application ingesting these images. Traditionally, ISPs are manually tuned in isolation by imaging experts without an end-to-end objective. Very recently, ISPs have been optimized with 1st-order methods that require differentiable approximations of the hardware ISP. Departing from such approximations, we present a hardware-in-the-loop method that directly optimizes hardware image processing pipelines for end-to-end domain-specific losses by solving a nonlinear multi-objective optimization problem with a novel 0th-order stochastic solver directly interfaced with the hardware ISP. We validate the proposed method with recent hardware ISPs and 2D object detection, segmentation, and human viewing as end-to-end downstream tasks. For automotive 2D object detection, the proposed method outperforms manual expert tuning by 30% mean average precision (mAP) and recent methods using ISP approximations by 18% mAP.
papers.title_zh: 相机图像处理管道的自动优化
papers.abstract_zh: 商品成像系统依靠硬件图像信号处理(ISP)管道,这些低水平管道由一系列加工区块组成,这些加工区块视其超分光计而定,从RAW传感器测量中重建彩色图像。 硬硬件 ISP 超参数与输出图像有复杂的交互作用,因此,下游应用程序摄取这些图像。 传统上,ISP由成像专家单独手工调整,没有端到端目标。 最近,互联网服务提供商得到了优化,采用第一顺序方法,要求硬件互联网服务提供商采用不同的近似值。 我们脱离了这种近似值,提出了一种 " 流动硬件 " 方法,通过解决非线性多目标优化问题,直接优化硬件图像处理管道,处理端至端特定领域损失,解决非线性多目标优化问题,解决新颖的零级随机求解器,直接与硬件ISP接口。 我们以最近的硬件ISP和2D物体探测、分割和人视作为端到端的下游任务来验证拟议方法。 就汽车2D物体探测而言,拟议方法比人工专家调整平均精度(mAP)高出30%,而最近使用ISP近似值(mAP)的方法则超过18% mAP。

papers.title: Gated Channel Transformation for Visual Recognition
papers.authors: Zongxin Yang, Linchao Zhu, Yu Wu, Yi Yang
papers.abstract: In this work, we propose a generally applicable transformation unit for visual recognition with deep convolutional neural networks. This transformation explicitly models channel relationships with explainable control variables. These variables determine the neuron behaviors of competition or cooperation, and they are jointly optimized with the convolutional weight towards more accurate recognition. In Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) Networks, the channel relationships are implicitly learned by fully connected layers, and the SE block is integrated at the block-level. We instead introduce a channel normalization layer to reduce the number of parameters and computational complexity. This lightweight layer incorporates a simple l2 normalization, enabling our transformation unit applicable to operator-level without much increase of additional parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our unit with clear margins on many vision tasks, i.e., image classification on ImageNet, object detection and instance segmentation on COCO, video classification on Kinetics.
papers.title_zh: 用于视觉识别的 Ged 通道变换
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个普遍适用的转换单元,用于与深层进化神经网络进行视觉识别。这种转换明确地模拟了与可解释的控制变量的频道关系。 这些变量决定了竞争或合作的神经行为,它们与进化权重共同优化,争取更准确的识别。 在挤压和抽取(SE)网络中,频道关系通过完全连接的层层暗含地学习,而SE区块则在区块一级整合。 相反,我们引入了一个频道正常化层,以减少参数和计算复杂性。 这一轻量级包含一个简单的12级正常化,使我们的改造单位能够适用于运营商一级,而不会大大增加额外的参数。 广泛的实验表明,我们的单位在很多视觉任务上,即图像网络图像分类、COCO的物体探测和实例分类、动因学视频分类方面,有着明显的边际。

papers.title: Gate-Shift Networks for Video Action Recognition
papers.authors: Swathikiran Sudhakaran, Sergio Escalera, Oswald Lanz
papers.abstract: Deep 3D CNNs for video action recognition are designed to learn powerful representations in the joint spatio-temporal feature space. In practice however, because of the large number of parameters and computations involved, they may under-perform in the lack of sufficiently large datasets for training them at scale. In this paper we introduce spatial gating in spatial-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels. We implement this concept with Gate-Shift Module (GSM). GSM is lightweight and turns a 2D-CNN into a highly efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor. With GSM plugged in, a 2D-CNN learns to adaptively route features through time and combine them, at almost no additional parameters and computational overhead. We perform an extensive evaluation of the proposed module to study its effectiveness in video action recognition, achieving state-of-the-art results on Something Something-V1 and Diving48 datasets, and obtaining competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with far less model complexity.
papers.title_zh: 视频行动识别门式智能网络
papers.abstract_zh: 用于视频动作识别的深三维有线电视新闻网旨在学习在联合时空地貌空间的强大表现,但实际上,由于涉及大量参数和计算,它们可能表现不佳,缺乏足够大的数据组进行大规模培训。 在本文中,我们在3D内核的空间时空分解中引入空间引力。我们用门-门式模件(GSM)实施这一概念。 GSM是轻量级的,将 2D-CNN 转化为高效的时空特征提取器。 2D-CNN在连接全球通路后,在几乎没有额外参数和计算间接费用的情况下,通过时间学习适应性地选择线路特征,并结合这些特征。 我们广泛评价了拟议的单元,以研究其在视频行动识别、在某处V1和Diving48数据集上取得最新成果、在模型复杂程度远不高的EPIC-Kitchens取得竞争性结果方面的效力。

papers.title: Factorized Higher-Order CNNs With an Application to Spatio-Temporal Emotion Estimation
papers.authors: Jean Kossaifi, Antoine Toisoul, Adrian Bulat, Yannis Panagakis, Timothy M. Hospedales, Maja Pantic
papers.abstract: Training deep neural networks with spatio-temporal (i.e., 3D) or multidimensional convolutions of higher-order is computationally challenging due to millions of unknown parameters across dozens of layers. To alleviate this, one approach is to apply low-rank tensor decompositions to convolution kernels in order to compress the network and reduce its number of parameters. Alternatively, new convolutional blocks, such as MobileNet, can be directly designed for efficiency. In this paper, we unify these two approaches by proposing a tensor factorization framework for efficient multidimensional (separable) convolutions of higher-order. Interestingly, the proposed framework enables a novel higher-order transduction, allowing to train a network on a given domain (e.g., 2D images or N-dimensional data in general) and using transduction to generalize to higher-order data such as videos (or (N+K)--dimensional data in general), capturing for instance temporal dynamics while preserving the learnt spatial information. We apply the proposed methodology, coined CP-Higher-Order Convolution (HO-CPConv), to spatio-temporal facial emotion analysis. Most existing facial affect models focus on static imagery and discard all temporal information. This is due to the above-mentioned burden of training 3D convolutional nets and the lack of large bodies of video data annotated by experts. We address both issues with our proposed framework. Initial training is first done on static imagery before using transduction to generalize to the temporal domain. We demonstrate superior performance on three challenging large scale affect estimation datasets, AffectNet, SEWA, and AFEW-VA.
papers.title_zh: 应用空间时时情绪估计的有线有线电视新闻网
papers.abstract_zh: 由于数十个层次的数以百万计的未知参数,对具有时空(即3D)孔径或高阶多层面变异的深层神经网络的培训在计算上具有挑战性。 为了减轻这一影响,一种办法是将低级高压分解装置应用到电流内核,以压缩网络并减少其参数数量。 或者,可以直接设计新的电动网络等革命区块来提高效率。 在本文中,我们统一了这两种做法,为高层次的高效多层面(可分离的)演进提出一个强因子化框架。 有趣的是,拟议框架使新颖的更高层次的转换成为可能,从而能够在特定领域(例如,2D图像或一般的N维数据)上培训一个网络,并利用转换将诸如视频(或一般的(N+K)维数据)等更高层次的数据概括化,在保存所学空间信息的同时捕捉时间动态等。 我们运用拟议的方法,即制造的CP-高端运动(HO-CPConv)来进行时空面部情绪分析。 大部分现有的面部影响模型,侧重于静态图像,并抛弃所有时间信息。 这是因为上述培训3D革命网的负担,以及缺乏大量专家附加说明的录像数据,我们用我们提议的框架处理这两个问题,先进行关于静态图像的初步培训,然后才进行转换,推广到时间域。 在三个具有挑战性的大规模影响估算数据集的方面,我们表现出了优异的绩效:AffectNet、SEWA和AFEW-VA。

papers.title: Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Learning for Vision-Based Urban Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Aditya Prakash, Aseem Behl, Eshed Ohn-Bar, Kashyap Chitta, Andreas Geiger
papers.abstract: Data aggregation techniques can significantly improve vision-based policy learning within a training environment, e.g., learning to drive in a specific simulation condition. However, as on-policy data is sequentially sampled and added in an iterative manner, the policy can specialize and overfit to the training conditions. For real-world applications, it is useful for the learned policy to generalize to novel scenarios that differ from the training conditions. To improve policy learning while maintaining robustness when training end-to-end driving policies, we perform an extensive analysis of data aggregation techniques in the CARLA environment. We demonstrate how the majority of them have poor generalization performance, and develop a novel approach with empirically better generalization performance compared to existing techniques. Our two key ideas are (1) to sample critical states from the collected on-policy data based on the utility they provide to the learned policy in terms of driving behavior, and (2) to incorporate a replay buffer which progressively focuses on the high uncertainty regions of the policy's state distribution. We evaluate the proposed approach on the CARLA NoCrash benchmark, focusing on the most challenging driving scenarios with dense pedestrian and vehicle traffic. Our approach improves driving success rate by 16% over state-of-the-art, achieving 87% of the expert performance while also reducing the collision rate by an order of magnitude without the use of any additional modality, auxiliary tasks, architectural modifications or reward from the environment.
papers.title_zh: 探索在政策学习中汇总数据,促进以视觉为基础的城市自主驱动
