We utilize the TreeNet weight sharing architecture as well as introduce the Inverted TreeNet architecture. While both weight sharing architectures reduce memory requirements, our proposed Inverted TreeNet also achieves improved accuracy.
papers.title_zh: 深神经网络质量强力混合
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究对质量失真的图像进行分类的深层神经网络;如果网络对失真的数据进行微调,那么低质量图像的深层网络性能可以大大提高;然而,单一个微调网络很难在多种失真类型之间运行良好。 我们建议一种混合的专家混合方法MixQualNet(MixQualNet),它能抵御多种不同类型的失真。 我们模型中的“专家”就某种特定的失真进行了培训。 模型的输出是专家模型的加权总和,加权数由单独的格子网决定,对格子网进行培训,以预测特定失真类型和层次的加权数。 在测试过程中,网络对失真水平和类型视而不见,但仍能给专家模型分配适当的权重。 为了降低计算的复杂性,我们引入了混合QualNet的权重共享。 我们使用树头网的权重共享架构,并引入了倒置树头网架构。 虽然两个权重共享架构都降低了记忆要求,但我们提议的倒置树头网也提高了准确性。

papers.title: Progressive Modeling of Steered Mixture-of-Experts for Light Field Video Approximation
papers.authors: Ruben Verhack, Glenn Van Wallendael, Martijn Courteaux, Peter Lambert, Thomas Sikora
papers.abstract: Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) is a novel framework for the approximation, coding, and description of image modalities. The future goal is to arrive at a representation for Six Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) image data. The goal of this paper is to introduce SMoE for 4D light field videos by including the temporal dimension. However, these videos contain vast amounts of samples due to the large number of views per frame. Previous work on static light field images mitigated the problem by hard subdividing the modeling problem. However, such a hard subdivision introduces visually disturbing block artifacts on moving objects in dynamic image data. We propose a novel modeling method that does not result in block artifacts while minimizing the computational complexity and which allows for a varying spread of kernels in the spatio-temporal domain. Experiments validate that we can progressively model light field videos with increasing objective quality up to 0.97 SSIM.
papers.title_zh: Steered 光场视频近似光场专家的Steered Mixture 逐步建模
papers.abstract_zh: Steered Mixture of-Experts(SMoE)是近似、编码和描述图像模式的新框架。 未来的目标是获得6度自由(6度自由)图像数据的代表。 本文的目的是通过纳入时间维度,为4D光场视频介绍SMoE,然而,这些视频包含大量样本,因为每个框架的浏览量很大。 以往关于静态光场图像的工作通过硬性地分解模型问题缓解了这一问题。 然而,这种硬分区在动态图像数据中,在移动物体时引入了令人目视不安的块状文物。 我们建议一种新的模型方法,不产生块状文物,同时尽量减少计算的复杂性,允许时空空间内核的不同扩散。 实验证实,我们可以逐步模拟光场视频,提高客观质量,达到0.97 SSIM。

papers.title: Hard Real-Time, Pixel-Parallel Rendering of Light Field Videos Using Steered Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Ignace Saenen, Ruben Verhack, Vasileios Avramelos, Glenn Van Wallendael, Peter Lambert
papers.abstract: Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) is a novel framework for the approximation, coding, and description of image modalities such as light field images and video. The future goal is to arrive at a representation for Six Degrees-of-Freedom (6DoF) image data. Previous research has shown the feasibility of real-time pixel-parallel rendering of static light field images. Each pixel is independently reconstructed by kernels that lay in its vicinity. The number of kernels involved forms the bottleneck on the achievable framerate. The goal of this paper is twofold. Firstly, we introduce pixel-level rendering of light field video, as previous work only rendered static content. Secondly, we investigate rendering using a predefined number of most significant kernels. As such, we can deliver hard real-time constraints by trading off the reconstruction quality.
papers.title_zh: 使用Steered Mixture 专家的硬实时、像素- Parallel 光场视频制作像素- Parallel
papers.abstract_zh: Steered Mixture of-Experts(SMoE)是近似、编码和描述图像模式(如光场图像和视频)的新框架。 未来的目标是获得6度自由(6DoF)图像数据的代表。 先前的研究显示,静态光场图像的实时像素-平行投影是可行的。 每一个像素都由位于其附近的内核独立重建。 所涉及的内核数量构成了可实现框架速率的瓶颈。 本文的目标是双重的 。 首先,我们引入像素水平的光场视频,因为先前的工作只提供了静态内容。 其次,我们用一个预定数量的最重要核心来调查数据。 因此,我们可以通过交换重建质量来提供硬性实时限制。

papers.title: Visual Text Correction
papers.authors: Amir Mazaheri, Mubarak Shah
papers.abstract: Videos, images, and sentences are mediums that can express the same semantics. One can imagine a picture by reading a sentence or can describe a scene with some words. However, even small changes in a sentence can cause a significant semantic inconsistency with the corresponding video/image. For example, by changing the verb of a sentence, the meaning may drastically change. There have been many efforts to encode a video/sentence and decode it as a sentence/video. In this research, we study a new scenario in which both the sentence and the video are given, but the sentence is inaccurate. A semantic inconsistency between the sentence and the video or between the words of a sentence can result in an inaccurate description. This paper introduces a new problem, called Visual Text Correction (VTC), i.e., finding and replacing an inaccurate word in the textual description of a video. We propose a deep network that can simultaneously detect an inaccuracy in a sentence, and fix it by replacing the inaccurate word(s). Our method leverages the semantic interdependence of videos and words, as well as the short-term and long-term relations of the words in a sentence. In our formulation, part of a visual feature vector for every single word is dynamically selected through a gating process. Furthermore, to train and evaluate our model, we propose an approach to automatically construct a large dataset for VTC problem. Our experiments and performance analysis demonstrates that the proposed method provides very good results and also highlights the general challenges in solving the VTC problem. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first of its kind for the Visual Text Correction task.
papers.title_zh: 视觉文字校正
papers.abstract_zh: 视频、图像和句子是能够表达相同语义的媒介。 人们可以通过阅读句子来想象图片,也可以用一些词描述场景。 但是,即使对句子稍作改动,也可能导致语义与相应的视频/图像大相径庭。 例如,通过改变一个句子的动词,其含义可能会发生巨大变化。 已经做出了许多努力来将一个视频/判刑编码,并把它破译为句子/录像。 在这个研究中,我们研究了一种既给出了该句子又给出了视频的新情景,但该句子是不准确的。 句子和视频之间的语义不一致或句子的词句不一致可能导致描述不准确。 本文提出了一个新问题,叫做视觉文字校正(VTC ) , 也就是在视频文字描述中查找和替换一个不准确的词。 我们建议建立一个深层次的网络,能够同时发现一个句子中的不准确之处,并通过替换不准确的单词来解决这个问题。 我们的方法利用了视频和单词的语义相互依存关系,以及句子中词句的短期和长期关系。 在我们的提法中,每个单词的视觉特征矢量的一部分都是通过加格过程动态选择的。 此外,为了培训和评估我们的模型,我们建议了一种方法,为VTC问题自动建立一个大型数据集。 我们的实验和业绩分析表明,拟议的方法提供了非常好的结果,也突出了解决VTC问题的总体挑战。 据我们所知,这项工作是视觉文字校正任务的首项此类工作。

papers.title: Video Re-localization
papers.authors: Yang Feng, Lin Ma, Wei Liu, Tong Zhang, Jiebo Luo
papers.abstract: Many methods have been developed to help people find the video content they want efficiently. However, there are still some unsolved problems in this area. For example, given a query video and a reference video, how to accurately localize a segment in the reference video such that the segment semantically corresponds to the query video? We define a distinctively new task, namely extbf{video re-localization}, to address this need. Video re-localization is an important enabling technology with many applications, such as fast seeking in videos, video copy detection, as well as video surveillance. Meanwhile, it is also a challenging research task because the visual appearance of a semantic concept in videos can have large variations. The first hurdle to clear for the video re-localization task is the lack of existing datasets. It is labor expensive to collect pairs of videos with semantic coherence or correspondence, and label the corresponding segments. We first exploit and reorganize the videos in ActivityNet to form a new dataset for video re-localization research, which consists of about 10,000 videos of diverse visual appearances associated with the localized boundary information. Subsequently, we propose an innovative cross gated bilinear matching model such that every time-step in the reference video is matched against the attentively weighted query video. Consequently, the prediction of the starting and ending time is formulated as a classification problem based on the matching results. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the baseline methods.
papers.title_zh: 视频重新定位
papers.abstract_zh: 已经开发了许多方法来帮助人们有效地找到他们想要的视频内容,然而,在这方面仍然存在一些尚未解决的问题。 例如,给一个Query视频和一个参考视频,如何精确地将参考视频中的一段位置定位,使该段的音义与Query视频相对应?我们定义了一种独特的新任务,即EXBF{视频重新定位},以满足这一需要。 视频重新定位是一个重要的赋能技术,有许多应用,比如快速寻找视频、视频复制检测以及视频监控。 与此同时,它也是一项具有挑战性的研究任务,因为视频中语义概念的视觉外观可以产生巨大的变化。 视频重新定位任务要清除的第一个障碍是缺少现有的数据集。 收集具有语义一致性或通信的两对视频并贴上相应部分的标签需要花费大量人力。 我们首先利用并重组“活动网”中的视频, 以形成一个新的数据集, 用于视频重新定位研究, 由大约10,000个视频组成, 随后,我们提出了一个创新的跨门双线匹配模式,使参考视频的每一个时间步骤都与仔细加权Query视频相匹配,因此,根据匹配结果,将开始和结束时间的预测作为一个分类问题。 广泛的实验结果显示,拟议方法的业绩超过了基准方法。

papers.title: Towards Robust Face Recognition with Comprehensive Search
papers.authors: Manyuan Zhang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu, Hongsheng Li
papers.abstract: "Data cleaning, architecture, and loss function design are important factors contributing to high-performance face recognition. Previously, the research community tries to improve the performance of each single aspect but failed to present a unified solution on the joint search of the optimal designs for all three aspects.In this paper, we for the first time identify that these aspects are tightly coupled to each other. Optimizing the design of each aspect actually greatly limits the performance and biases the algorithmic design.Specifically, we find that the optimal model architecture or loss function is closely coupled with the data cleaning. To eliminate the bias of single-aspect research and provide an overall understanding of the face recognition model design, we first carefully design the search space for each aspect, then a comprehensive search method is introduced to jointly search optimal data cleaning, architecture, and loss function design.In our framework, we make the proposed comprehensive search as flexible as possible, by using an innovative reinforcement learning based approach.Extensive experiments on million-level face recognition benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our newly-designed search space for each aspect and the comprehensive search. We outperform expert algorithms developed for each single research track by large margins. More importantly, we analyze the difference between our searched optimal design and the independent design of the single factors. We point out that strong models tend to optimize with more difficult training datasets and loss functions. Our empirical study can provide guidance in future research towards more robust face recognition systems."
papers.title_zh: 努力以全面搜索实现硬性脸部识别
papers.abstract_zh: “数据清理、建筑和损失功能设计是促使高性能面部识别的重要因素。 以前,研究界试图改进每个方面的业绩,但未能就联合寻找所有三个方面的最佳设计提出统一的解决办法。 优化每个方面的设计实际上大大限制了性能和对算法设计的偏向。 具体地说,我们发现最佳模型结构或损失功能与数据清理密切相关。 为了消除单一区域研究的偏向,并全面了解面部识别模型的设计,我们首先仔细设计每个方面的搜索空间,然后采用全面搜索方法,共同搜索最佳数据清理、架构和损失功能设计。 在我们的框架内,我们采用创新的强化学习方法,尽可能灵活地开展拟议的全面搜索。 百万级面部识别基准的广泛实验表明我们新设计的每个方面的搜索空间和全面搜索的有效性。 更重要的是,我们分析了我们所搜索的最佳设计和单项因素的独立设计之间的区别。 我们指出,强健的模型往往以更困难的培训数据集和损失功能来优化。 我们的经验研究可以为未来研究提供指导,以建立更健全的面部识别系统。 ”

papers.title: Tips and Tricks for Visual Question Answering: Learnings From the 2017 Challenge
papers.authors: Damien Teney, Peter Anderson, Xiaodong He, Anton van den Hengel
papers.abstract: This paper presents a state-of-the-art model for visual question answering (VQA), which won the first place in the 2017 VQA Challenge. VQA is a task of significant importance for research in artificial intelligence, given its multimodal nature, clear evaluation protocol, and potential real-world applications. The performance of deep neural networks for VQA is very dependent on choices of architectures and hyperparameters. To help further research in the area, we describe in detail our high-performing, though relatively simple model. Through a massive exploration of architectures and hyperparameters representing more than 3,000 GPU-hours, we identified tips and tricks that lead to its success, namely: sigmoid outputs, soft training targets, image features from bottom-up attention, gated tanh activations, output embeddings initialized using GloVe and Google Images, large mini-batches, and smart shuffling of training data. We provide a detailed analysis of their impact on performance to assist others in making an appropriate selection.
papers.title_zh: 视觉问答提示和秘诀:从2017年挑战中学习
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了视觉问题回答的最新模型(VQA),该模型在2017年VQA挑战中名列第一位。 鉴于人工智能的多式性质、明确的评估协议和潜在的现实应用,VQA是一项对人工智能研究非常重要的任务。 VQA深层神经网络的性能非常取决于建筑和超参数的选择。 为了帮助该领域的进一步研究,我们详细描述了我们高性能、尽管相对简单的模型。 通过大规模探索代表3 000多个GPU小时的建筑和超参数,我们发现了导致其成功的窍门和技巧,即:小类输出、软培训目标、自下而上关注的图像特征、闭锁的制革装置、使用GloVe和Google图像初始化的输出嵌入、大型微型工具以及智能化的培训数据转换。 我们详细分析了它们对业绩的影响,以协助其他方面作出适当选择。

papers.title: SkipNet: Learning Dynamic Routing in Convolutional Networks
papers.authors: Xin Wang, Fisher Yu, Zi-Yi Dou, Trevor Darrell, Joseph E. Gonzalez
papers.abstract: While deeper convolutional networks are needed to achieve maximum accuracy in visual perception tasks, for many inputs shallower networks are sufficient. We exploit this observation by learning to skip convolutional layers on a per-input basis. We introduce SkipNet, a modified residual network, that uses a gating network to selectively skip convolutional blocks based on the activations of the previous layer. We formulate the dynamic skipping problem in the context of sequential decision making and propose a hybrid learning algorithm that combines supervised learning and reinforcement learning to address the challenges of non-differentiable skipping decisions. We show SkipNet reduces computation by 30-90% while preserving the accuracy of the original model on four benchmark datasets and outperforms the state-of-the-art dynamic networks and static compression methods. We also qualitatively evaluate the gating policy to reveal a relationship between image scale and saliency and the number of layers skipped.
papers.title_zh: SkippNet: 在革命网络中学习动态运行
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然需要更深层的革命网络来实现视觉认知任务的最大精确度,但对于许多输入的浅度网络来说,就足够了。 我们利用这一观察方法,学习每个投入都跳过革命层。 我们介绍SkippNet, 一个经过修改的剩余网络, 使用一个标志网络, 选择跳过基于前一层激活的 革命区块。 我们从顺序决策的角度提出动态跳跃问题,并提出混合学习算法,将监督学习与强化学习结合起来,以应对无差别跳跃决定的挑战。 我们显示SkippNet将计算减少30-90%,同时保持四个基准数据集原始模型的准确性,优于最先进的动态网络和静态压缩方法。 我们还从质量上评价这一政策,以揭示图像规模和突出度与跳过层数量之间的关系。

papers.title: Semantic Video Segmentation by Gated Recurrent Flow Propagation
papers.authors: David Nilsson, Cristian Sminchisescu
papers.abstract: Semantic video segmentation is challenging due to the sheer amount of data that needs to be processed and labeled in order to construct accurate models. In this paper we present a deep, end-to-end trainable methodology for video segmentation that is capable of leveraging the information present in unlabeled data, besides sparsely labeled frames, in order to improve semantic estimates. Our model combines a convolutional architecture and a spatio-temporal transformer recurrent layer that is able to temporally propagate labeling information by means of optical flow, adaptively gated based on its locally estimated uncertainty. The flow, the recognition and the gated temporal propagation modules can be trained jointly, end-to-end. The temporal, gated recurrent flow propagation component of our model can be plugged into any static semantic segmentation architecture and turn it into a weakly supervised video processing one. Our experiments in the challenging CityScapes and Camvid datasets, and for multiple deep architectures, indicate that the resulting model can leverage unlabeled temporal frames, next to a labeled one, in order to improve both the video segmentation accuracy and the consistency of its temporal labeling, at no additional annotation cost and with little extra computation.
papers.title_zh: 由 Gatet 经常流量传播的语义视频截线
papers.abstract_zh: 由于需要处理和贴标签以建立准确模型的数据数量之多,因此语义性视频分离具有挑战性。 在本文中,我们提出了一个深入的、端到端的可培训的视频分解方法,除了贴有很少标签的框外,还能利用未贴标签数据中的信息,以改进语义估计。 我们的模型结合了一个革命建筑和一个时空变压器的常态层,它能够通过光学流动的时间传播标签信息,根据当地估计的不确定性适应性地封住。 流动、识别和锁定的时间传播模块可以联合培训,最终到最终。 我们模型中的时间、锁定的经常性流动传播组件可以插进任何静态语义分割结构,并把它变成一个监管薄弱的视频处理模块。 我们在具有挑战性的CityScapes和Camvid数据集以及多个深层建筑的实验中发现,所产生的模型能够利用贴有标签的模型旁边的未贴标签的时间框架,以提高视频分割的准确性和时间标签的一致性,而无需额外的注解成本,也无需额外的计算。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Multi-Level Face Model Learning for Monocular Reconstruction at Over 250 Hz
papers.authors: Ayush Tewari, Michael Zollhöfer, Pablo Garrido, Florian Bernard, Hyeongwoo Kim, Patrick Pérez, Christian Theobalt
papers.abstract: The reconstruction of dense 3D models of face geometry and appearance from a single image is highly challenging and ill-posed. To constrain the problem, many approaches rely on strong priors, such as parametric face models learned from limited 3D scan data. However, prior models restrict generalization of the true diversity in facial geometry, skin reflectance and illumination. To alleviate this problem, we present the first approach that jointly learns 1) a regressor for face shape, expression, reflectance and illumination on the basis of 2) a concurrently learned parametric face model. Our multi-level face model combines the advantage of 3D Morphable Models for regularization with the out-of-space generalization of a learned corrective space. We train end-to-end on in-the-wild images without dense annotations by fusing a convolutional encoder with a differentiable expert-designed renderer and a self-supervised training loss, both defined at multiple detail levels. Our approach compares favorably to the state-of-the-art in terms of reconstruction quality, better generalizes to real world faces, and runs at over 250Hz.
papers.title_zh: 在250赫兹以上的单体重建自上一级多层次模拟学习
papers.abstract_zh: 从单一图像中重建密集的三维面部几何模型和外观模型是极具挑战性和错误的。 为了遏制这一问题,许多方法都依赖强大的前科,比如从有限的三维扫描数据中学习的参数面部模型。 然而,以前的模型限制了面部几何、皮肤反射和照明方面真实多样性的概括化。 为了缓解这一问题,我们提出了第一种办法,即共同学习(1) 以2为基础,为面部形状、表达、反射和照明而学习1 一种后退器;(2) 一种同时学习的模拟面部模型。 我们的多层次面观模型结合了3D可打字模型的优势,将3D可打字模型的正规化与在空间外普及学习的纠正空间结合起来。 在没有密集的注释的情况下,我们通过将一个革命编码器与一个不同专家设计的制作人和一种自我监督的培训损失结合起来,对一成不变的图像进行端对端培训,两者在多个细节层次上都有定义。 在重建质量方面,我们的方法优于最先进的方法,更好地概括到现实世界的面孔上,其速度超过250赫兹。

papers.title: Rethinking Spatiotemporal Feature Learning: Speed-Accuracy Trade-offs in Video Classification
papers.authors: Saining Xie, Chen Sun, Jonathan Huang, Zhuowen Tu, Kevin Murphy
papers.abstract: Despite the steady progress in video analysis led by the adoption of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), the relative improvement has been less drastic as that in 2D static image classification. Three main challenges exist including spatial (image) feature representation, temporal information representation, and model/computation complexity. It was recently shown by Carreira and Zisserman that 3D CNNs, inflated from 2D networks and pretrained on ImageNet, could be a promising way for spatial and temporal representation learning. However, as for model/computation complexity, 3D CNNs are much more expensive than 2D CNNs and prone to overfit. We seek a balance between speed and accuracy by building an effective and efficient video classification system through systematic exploration of critical network design choices. In particular, we show that it is possible to replace many of the 3D convolutions by low-cost 2D convolutions. Rather surprisingly, best result (in both speed and accuracy) is achieved when replacing the 3D convolutions at the bottom of the network, suggesting that temporal representation learning on high-level ``semantic'' features is more useful. Our conclusion generalizes to datasets with very different properties. When combined with several other cost-effective designs including separable spatial/temporal convolution and feature gating, our system results in an effective video classification system that that produces very competitive results on several action classification benchmarks (Kinetics, Something-something, UCF101 and HMDB), as well as two action detection (localization) benchmarks (JHMDB and UCF101-24).
papers.title_zh: 重新思考时地外特征学习:视频分类的快速准确取舍
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在采用革命性神经网络(CNNs)的引导下,视频分析取得了稳步进展,但相对改善不如2D静态图像分类那样显著。 存在三大挑战,包括空间(图像)特征代表、时间信息代表以及模型/计算的复杂性。 卡雷拉(Carreira)和齐塞曼(Zisserman)最近表明,3DCNN(3D CNN)从2D网络上膨胀,在图像网络上预先培训,可以成为空间和时间代表性学习的有希望途径。 然而,就模型/计算的复杂性而言,3DCNN比2DCNN(2D CNN)更昂贵,而且容易过度使用。 我们通过系统地探索关键的网络设计选择,建立高效益、高效率的视频分类系统,力求在速度和准确性之间取得平衡。 特别是,我们证明,可以用低成本的2D组合取代3D组合中的许多组合。 相当令人惊讶的是,在取代网络底部的3D演进时,最佳结果(速度和准确性)是实现了的,这表明时间代表性学习关于高级“修饰”特征的学习更为有用。 我们的结论概括了具有非常不同属性的数据集。 我们的系统与包括空间/时变和地貌特征分离在内的其他若干具有成本效益的设计相结合,形成一个有效的视频分类系统,在几项行动分类基准(Kinetics, something- something, UCF101和HMDB)以及两项行动检测(定位)基准(JHMDB和UCF101-24)上产生非常有竞争力的结果。

papers.title: Recurrent Scene Parsing With Perspective Understanding in the Loop
papers.authors: Shu Kong, Charless C. Fowlkes
papers.abstract: Objects may appear at arbitrary scales in perspective images of a scene, posing a challenge for recognition systems that process images at a fixed resolution. We propose a depth-aware gating module that adaptively selects the pooling field size in a convolutional network architecture according to the object scale (inversely proportional to the depth) so that small details are preserved for distant objects while larger receptive fields are used for those nearby. The depth gating signal is provided by stereo disparity or estimated directly from monocular input. We integrate this depth-aware gating into a recurrent convolutional neural network to perform semantic segmentation. Our recurrent module iteratively efines the segmentation results, leveraging the depth and semantic predictions from the previous iterations. Through extensive experiments on four popular large-scale datasets, we demonstrate this approach achieves competitive semantic segmentation performance with a model which is substantially more compact. We carry out extensive analysis of this architecture including variants that operate on monocular RGB but use depth as side-information during training, unsupervised gating as a generic attentional mechanism, and multi-resolution gating. We find that gated pooling for joint semantic segmentation and depth yields state-of-the-art results for quantitative monocular depth estimation.
papers.title_zh: 经常在环圈中以透视了解的方式进行场景
papers.abstract_zh: 物体在场景的视觉图像中可能以任意的尺度出现,对以固定分辨率处理图像的识别系统构成挑战。 我们建议一个深觉定位模块,根据对象比例(与深度成反比),适应性地选择组合网络结构中的集合字段大小,以便为远方物体保留小细节,而附近物体则使用更大的可接收字段。 深度测深信号由立体差异提供,或由单体输入直接估算。我们将这种深度测深信号整合到一个经常性的进化神经网络中,以进行语义分离。 我们的经常性模块迭代地破坏分解结果,利用以前迭代的深度和语义预测。 通过对四个流行的大规模数据集进行广泛试验,我们证明这一方法能够实现具有竞争力的语义分解性,其模式要紧得多。 我们对这一结构进行了广泛分析,包括利用单眼RGB操作的变体,但在培训期间将深度用作侧边信息,将无人监督的引力作为一般的注意机制,以及多分辨率加固。 我们发现,为联合语义分解和深度联合集中的封闭式集合能够产生最新的结果,以进行定量单眼深度估计。

papers.title: Planar Shape Detection at Structural Scales
papers.authors: Hao Fang, Florent Lafarge, Mathieu Desbrun
papers.abstract: Interpreting 3D data such as point clouds or surface meshes depends heavily on the scale of observation. Yet, existing algorithms for shape detection rely on trial-and-error parameter tunings to output configurations representative of a structural scale. We present a framework to automatically extract a set of representations that capture the shape and structure of man-made objects at different key abstraction levels. A shape-collapsing process first generates a fine-to-coarse sequence of shape representations by exploiting local planarity. This sequence is then analyzed to identify significant geometric variations between successive representations through a supervised energy minimization. Our framework is flexible enough to learn how to detect both existing structural formalisms such as the CityGML Levels Of Details, and expert-specified levels of abstraction. Experiments on different input data and classes of man-made objects, as well as comparisons with existing shape detection methods, illustrate the strengths of our approach in terms of efficiency and flexibility.
papers.title_zh: 结构规模的板形形状探测
papers.abstract_zh: 3D数据,如点云或表面介质等三维数据的解释在很大程度上取决于观测的规模。 然而,现有的形状探测算法依赖于对代表结构规模的产出配置的试镜和传感器参数调整。 我们提出了一个框架来自动抽取一套显示人造物体在不同关键抽象层次的形状和结构的表示方式。 形状叠叠过程首先通过利用局部的图案来产生细到粗的形状表示顺序。 然后对这个序列进行分析,以确定通过有监督的最大限度减少能量,在相继表示之间发生的重大几何变化。 我们的框架足够灵活,可以学习如何发现现有的结构形式,如城市GML详细程度和专家指定的抽象程度。 对不同输入数据和人造物体类别进行的实验,以及与现有形状探测方法的比较,说明了我们在效率和灵活性方面的优势。

papers.title: Pivot Correlational Neural Network for Multimodal Video Categorization
papers.authors: Sunghun Kang, Junyeong Kim, Hyunsoo Choi, Sungjin Kim, Chang D. Yoo
papers.abstract: This paper considers an architecture for multimodal video categorization referred to as Pivot Correlational Neural Network (Pivot CorrNN). The architecture is trained to maximizes the correlation between the hidden states as well as the predictions of the modal-agnostic pivot stream and modal-specific stream in the network. Here, the modal-agnostic pivot hidden state considers all modal inputs without distinction while the modal-specific hidden state is dedicated exclusively to one specific modal input. The Pivot CorrNN consists of three modules: (1) maximizing pivot-correlation module that attempts to maximally correlate the modal-agnostic and a modal-specific hidden-state as well as their predictions, (2) contextual Gated Recurrent Unit (cGRU) module which extends the capability of a generic GRU to take multimodal inputs in updating the pivot hidden-state, and (3) adaptive aggregation module that aggregates all modal-specific predictions as well as the modal-agnostic pivot predictions into one final prediction. We evaluate the Pivot CorrNN on two publicly available large-scale multimodal video categorization datasets, FCVID and YouTube-8M. From the experimental results, Pivot CorrNN achieves the best performance on the FCVID database and performance comparable to the state-of-the-art on YouTube-8M database.
papers.title_zh: 用于多式视频视频分类的Pivit 相关神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 本文审议了称为“Pivot CorrNN”的多式视频分类结构,称为“Pivot 相关神经网络”(Pivot CorrNN)。 该结构经过培训,以最大限度地扩大隐蔽状态之间的相互关系,并预测网络中模式-不可知分分流和特定模式流。 在这里, 模式- 不可知的轴心隐藏状态 不加区别地考虑所有模式输入, 而模式特定隐藏状态 则专用于一个特定的模式输入 。 Pivot CorrNN由三个单元组成:(1) 尽量扩大试图最大限度地将模式-不可知性和模式-特定隐藏状态及其预测联系起来的枢纽-枢纽模块;(2) 环境Ged 经常单元(cGRU)模块,该模块扩大了通用GRU在更新枢纽隐藏状态时采用多式联运投入的能力;(3) 适应综合模块,该模块将所有模式-特定预测以及模式-不可知性-枢纽预测汇总到一个最终预测中。 我们对两个公开提供的大型多式视频分类数据集(FCVID和YouTube-8M)的Pivot CorrNNN进行评估。 根据实验结果,Pivot CorrNNN在FCVID数据库上取得最佳业绩,其业绩与YouTube-8M数据库上最新技术相比。

papers.title: Neural Sign Language Translation
papers.authors: Necati Cihan Camgoz, Simon Hadfield, Oscar Koller, Hermann Ney, Richard Bowden
papers.abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) has been an active research field for the last two decades. However, most research to date has considered SLR as a naive gesture recognition problem. SLR seeks to recognize a sequence of continuous signs but neglects the underlying rich grammatical and linguistic structures of sign language that differ from spoken language. In contrast, we introduce the Sign Language Translation (SLT) problem. Here, the objective is to generate spoken language translations from sign language videos, taking into account the different word orders and grammar. We formalize SLT in the framework of Neural Machine Translation (NMT) for both end-to-end and pretrained settings (using expert knowledge). This allows us to jointly learn the spatial representations, the underlying language model, and the mapping between sign and spoken language. To evaluate the performance of Neural SLT, we collected the first publicly available Continuous SLT dataset, RWTH-PHOENIX-Weather 2014T. It provides spoken language translations and gloss level annotations for German Sign Language videos of weather broadcasts. Our dataset contains over .95M frames with >67K signs from a sign vocabulary of >1K and >99K words from a German vocabulary of >2.8K. We report quantitative and qualitative results for various SLT setups to underpin future research in this newly established field. The upper bound for translation performance is calculated at 19.26 BLEU-4, while our end-to-end frame-level and gloss-level tokenization networks were able to achieve 9.58 and 18.13 respectively.
papers.title_zh: 神经手势语言翻译
papers.abstract_zh: 过去二十年来,手语识别(SLR)一直是一个积极的研究领域,但迄今为止,大多数研究都认为手语识别(SLR)是一个天真的手势识别问题。 SLR试图识别一系列连续的标志,但忽视了与口语不同的手语的丰富的语法和语言结构。 相反,我们引入了手语翻译问题。 在此,目标是从手语视频中生成口语翻译,同时考虑到不同的文字顺序和语法。 我们在神经机器翻译(NMT)框架内为终端到终端和预培训环境(利用专家知识)正式确定SLT(SLT ) 。 这使得我们可以共同学习空间表现、基本语言模式以及手语和口语之间的绘图。 为了评估神经SLT的性能,我们收集了第一个公开提供的连续SLT数据集,即RWTH-PHONIX-Weather 2014T。 它为天气广播的德语手语视频提供口语翻译和光滑水平说明。我们的数据集包含超过 95M 框架,其中的符号为 > 1K 符号字典中的 > 67K 符号和> 99K 字词来自 > 2.8K 的德语词汇。 我们报告各种特别技术项目的数量和质量结果,以支持今后在这个新建立的领域进行研究。 笔译工作业绩的上限为19.26 BLEU-4,而我们的端对端框架级和格罗斯级象征性化网络分别实现了9.58和18.13。

papers.title: Neural Network Encapsulation
papers.authors: Hongyang Li, Xiaoyang Guo, Bo DaiWanli Ouyang, Xiaogang Wang
papers.abstract: A capsule is a collection of neurons which represents different variants of a pattern in the network. The routing scheme ensures only certain capsules who resemble lower counterparts in the higher layer should be activated. However, the computational complexity becomes an bottleneck for scaling up to larger networks, as lower capsules need to correspond to each and every higher capsule. To resolve this limitation, we approximate the routing process with two branches: a master branch which collects primary information from its direct contact in the lower layer and an aide branch that replenishes master based on pattern variants encoded in other lower capsules. Compared with previous iterative and unsupervised routing scheme, these two branches are communicated in a fast, supervised and one-time pass fashion. The complexity and runtime of the model are therefore decreased by a large margin. Motivated by the routing to make higher capsule have agreement with lower capsule, we extend the mechanism as a compensation for the rapid loss of information in nearby layers. We devise a feedback agreement unit to send back higher capsules as feedback. It could be regarded as an additional regularization to the network. The feedback agreement is achieved by comparing the optimal transport divergence between two distributions. Such an add-on witnesses a unanimous gain in both capsule and vanilla networks. Our proposed EncapNet performs favorably better against previous state-of-the-arts on CIFAR10/100, SVHN and a subset of ImageNet which consists of 200 hardest object classes.
papers.title_zh: 神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 胶囊是一种神经元的集合,代表着网络模式的不同变体。 路由方案只确保某些类似较高层较低层的胶囊被激活。 然而,计算的复杂性成为扩大至更大网络的瓶颈,因为低层胶囊需要与每个更高层的胶囊相对应。 为解决这一限制,我们把路由过程与两个分支相近:一个主分支从下层的直接接触中收集基本信息,另一个辅助分支根据其他下层胶囊编码的模式变体补充主机。 与以前的迭代和无人监督的路线安排相比,这两个分支以快速、监督和一次性的传承方式进行沟通,因此,模式的复杂性和运行时间大大缩短。 受高胶囊路线驱动,我们与低胶囊达成了协议,我们扩大了这一机制,作为对附近层信息迅速丢失的补偿。 我们设计了一个反馈协议单位,将高胶囊作为反馈发送回去。 反馈协议是通过比较两种分配之间的最佳运输差异来实现的,这种附加证人在胶囊和香草网络上都获得了一致的收益。 我们提议的EncapNet比以前在CIFAR10/100、SVHN和由200个最难对象类组成的图像网络子集上的最新作品表现更好。

papers.title: Multi-object Tracking with Neural Gating Using Bilinear LSTM
papers.authors: Chanho Kim, Fuxin Li, James M. Rehg
papers.abstract: In recent deep online and near-online multi-object tracking approaches, a difficulty has been to incorporate long-term appearance models to efficiently score object tracks under severe occlusion and multiple missing detections. In this paper, we propose a novel recurrent network model, the bilinear LSTM, in order to improve long-term appearance models via a recurrent network. Based on intuitions drawn from recursive least squares, bilinear LSTM stores building blocks of a linear predictor in its memory, which is then coupled with the input in a multiplicative manner, instead of the additive coupling in conventional LSTM approaches. Such coupling resembles an online learned classifier/regressor at each time step, which we have found to improve performances in using LSTM for appearance modeling. We also propose novel data augmentation approaches to efficiently train recurrent models that score object tracks on both appearance and motion. We train an LSTM that can score object tracks based on both appearance and motion and utilize it in a multiple hypothesis tracking framework. In experiments, we show that with our novel LSTM model, we achieved state-of-the-art performance on near-online multiple object tracking on the MOT 2016 and MOT 2017 benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: 使用双线性LSTM进行神经定位的多物体跟踪
papers.abstract_zh: 在最近的深线在线和近线多物体跟踪方法中,难以采用长期外观模型,以便在严重隔离和多处缺失的探测下,有效评分对象轨道。 在本文中,我们提出一个新的经常性网络模式,即双线LSTM,以便通过经常性网络改进长期外观模式。 根据从递归性最小的平方中得出的直觉,双线LSTM储存了内存线性预测器的构件,然后以倍增方式输入,而不是常规LSTM方法中的添加式组合。 这种组合在每一个步骤上都类似于在线学习的分类/回归器,我们发现这改善了使用 LSTM 进行外观建模的绩效。 我们还提出了新的数据增强方法,以高效地培训在外观和运动上标注对象的经常性模型。 我们训练了一个基于外观和运动的天体轨迹的LSTM, 并在多个假设跟踪框架中加以利用。在实验中,我们展示了我们利用我们的新颖的LSTM模型,在近线多天体轨迹跟踪上,在2016年MOT和2017年MOT基准上取得了最新成绩。

papers.title: Multi-Cue Correlation Filters for Robust Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Ning Wang, Wengang Zhou, Qi Tian, Richang Hong, Meng Wang, Houqiang Li
papers.abstract: In recent years, many tracking algorithms achieve impressive performance via fusing multiple types of features, however, most of them fail to fully explore the context among the adopted multiple features and the strength of them. In this paper, we propose an efficient multi-cue analysis framework for robust visual tracking. By combining different types of features, our approach constructs multiple experts through Discriminative Correlation Filter (DCF) and each of them tracks the target independently. With the proposed robustness evaluation strategy, the suitable expert is selected for tracking in each frame. Furthermore, the divergence of multiple experts reveals the reliability of the current tracking, which is quantified to update the experts adaptively to keep them from corruption. Through the proposed multi-cue analysis, our tracker with standard DCF and deep features achieves outstanding results on several challenging benchmarks: OTB-2013, OTB-2015, Temple-Color and VOT 2016. On the other hand, when evaluated with only simple hand-crafted features, our method demonstrates comparable performance amongst complex non-realtime trackers, but exhibits much better efficiency, with a speed of 45 FPS on a CPU.
papers.title_zh: 用于强力视觉跟踪的多 Ce 关联过滤器
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,许多跟踪算法通过发挥多种特征而取得令人印象深刻的成绩,但是,其中多数未能充分探讨所采用的多种特征的背景及其强度。 在本文中,我们提出了一个高效的多曲线分析框架,以进行稳健的视觉跟踪。 通过整合不同类型特征,我们的方法通过差异性关联过滤器(DCF)构建了多个专家,每个专家都独立跟踪目标。 采用拟议的稳健性评价战略,选择合适的专家在每个框架中跟踪,此外,多位专家的分歧表明目前跟踪的可靠性,目前的跟踪是量化的,以适应性地更新专家,防止他们腐败。 通过拟议的多曲线分析,我们的跟踪器与标准DCF和深层特征的跟踪器在几个具有挑战性的基准(OTB-2013、OTB-2015、Temple-Color和VOT-2016)上取得了突出成果。 另一方面,在只用简单的手工制作特征进行评估时,我们的方法显示,在复杂的非实时跟踪器中,我们的性能相当,但效率要好得多,在CPU上的速度为45个FPS。

papers.title: Lifelong Learning via Progressive Distillation and Retrospection
papers.authors: Saihui Hou, Xinyu Pan, Chen Change Loy, Zilei Wang, Dahua Lin
papers.abstract: Lifelong learning aims at adapting a learned model to new tasks while retaining the knowledge gained earlier. A key challenge for lifelong learning is how to strike a balance between the preservation on old tasks and the adaptation to a new one within a given model. Approaches that combine both objectives in training have been explored in previous works. Yet the performance still suffers from considerable degradation in a long sequence of tasks. In this work, we propose a novel approach to lifelong learning, which tries to seek a better balance between preservation and adaptation via two techniques: Distillation and Retrospection. Specifically, the target model adapts to the new task by knowledge distillation from an intermediate expert, while the previous knowledge is more effectively preserved by caching a small subset of data for old tasks. The combination of Distillation and Retrospection leads to a more gentle learning curve for the target model, and extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach can bring consistent improvements on both old and new tasks.
papers.title_zh: 通过累进蒸馏和回查进行终身学习
papers.abstract_zh: 终身学习旨在让学习模式适应新任务,同时保留早先获得的知识,终生学习的一个关键挑战是如何在保留旧任务和在特定模式内适应新任务之间取得平衡。 以往的工作曾探讨过将两个培训目标结合起来的方法,但是,在一系列长期任务中,业绩仍然严重退化。 在这项工作中,我们提议对终身学习采取新的方法,试图通过两种技术(蒸馏和回溯)在保存和适应之间寻求更好的平衡。 具体地说,目标模型通过来自中级专家的知识提炼适应新任务,而以前的知识则通过为旧任务收集少量数据而得到更有效的保存。 将蒸馏和回溯相结合,为目标模式带来一个更温和的学习曲线,而广泛的实验表明,我们的方法能够不断改进新旧任务。

papers.title: Learning Semantic Neural Tree for Human Parsing
papers.authors: Ruyi Ji, Dawei Du, Libo Zhang, Longyin Wen, Yanjun Wu, Chen Zhao, Feiyue Huang, Siwei Lyu
papers.abstract: In this paper, we design a novel semantic neural tree for human parsing, which uses a tree architecture to encode physiological structure of human body, and design a coarse to fine process in a cascade manner to generate accurate results. Specifically, the semantic neural tree is designed to segment human regions into multiple semantic sub-regions (g, face, arms, and legs) in a hierarchical way using a new designed attention routing module. Meanwhile, we introduce the semantic aggregation module to combine multiple hierarchical features to exploit more context information for better performance. Our semantic neural tree can be trained in an end-to-end fashion by standard stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with back-propagation. Several experiments conducted on four challenging datasets for both single and multiple human parsing, ie, LIP, PASCAL-Person-Part, CIHP and MHP-v2, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Code can be found at url{https://isrc.iscas.ac.cn/gitlab/research/sematree}."
papers.title_zh: 人类剖析学习语义神经树
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们设计了一个新的语义神经树 用于人类剖析, 它使用树结构来编码人体的生理结构, 并设计粗糙的精细过程 以级联的方式产生准确的结果。 具体地说,语义神经树的设计是利用一个新的设计注意力路由模块,将人类区域分成多个语义分区(g、脸、胳膊和腿)。 与此同时,我们引入了语义汇总模块,将多重等级特征结合起来,以利用更多背景信息改善性能。 我们的语义神经树可以通过标准随机梯度梯度下降(SGD)进行端到端培训,并进行后传。 在四个具有挑战性的数据组上就单一和多重人类分析、即、LIP、PACAL-Person-Part、CIHP和MHP-V2等四个具有挑战性的人类分析、即LIP、PACAL-Person-Part、CIHP和MHP-V2等进行了若干实验,这些实验显示了拟议方法的有效性。

papers.title: Learning Semantic Concepts and Order for Image and Sentence Matching
papers.authors: Yan Huang, Qi Wu, Chunfeng Song, Liang Wang
papers.abstract: Image and sentence matching has made great progress recently, but it remains challenging due to the large visual semantic discrepancy. This mainly arises from that the representation of pixel-level image usually lacks of high-level semantic information as in its matched sentence. In this work, we propose a semantic-enhanced image and sentence matching model, which can improve the image representation by learning semantic concepts and then organizing them in a correct semantic order. Given an image, we first use a multi-regional multi-label CNN to predict its semantic concepts, including objects, properties, actions, etc. Then, considering that different orders of semantic concepts lead to diverse semantic meanings, we use a context-gated sentence generation scheme for semantic order learning. It simultaneously uses the image global context containing concept relations as reference and the groundtruth semantic order in the matched sentence as supervision. After obtaining the improved image representation, we learn the sentence representation with a conventional LSTM, and then jointly perform image and sentence matching and sentence generation for model learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned semantic concepts and order, by achieving the state-of-the-art results on two public benchmark datasets.
papers.title_zh: 学习图像和判决匹配的语义概念和命令
papers.abstract_zh: 图像和句子匹配最近取得了很大进展,但由于视觉语义差异很大,这仍具有挑战性。 这主要是因为像素级图像的表达方式通常缺乏与其对应的句子中的高级语义信息。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个语义强化图像和句子匹配模型,通过学习语义概念来改进图像的表述,然后按照正确的语义顺序加以组织。 从图像来看,我们首先使用多区域多标签有线电视新闻网来预测其语义概念,包括物体、属性、动作等。 然后,考虑到语义概念的不同顺序导致不同的语义含义,我们使用一种基于背景的句子生成计划来学习语义顺序。 它同时使用包含概念关系作为参考的图像全球背景,同时使用相应的句子中的地面真实语义顺序作为监督。 在获得改进后的图像表述后,我们用传统的LSTM学习句子表述,然后为示范学习联合进行图像和句子配对和生成句子。 广泛的实验通过在两个公共基准数据集上取得最新结果,表明我们所学的语义概念和秩序的有效性。

papers.title: Learning Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation From Multi-View Images
papers.authors: Helge Rhodin, Jörg Spörri, Isinsu Katircioglu, Victor Constantin, Frédéric Meyer, Erich Müller, Mathieu Salzmann, Pascal Fua
papers.abstract: Accurate 3D human pose estimation from single images is possible with sophisticated deep-net architectures that have been trained on very large datasets. However, this still leaves open the problem of capturing motions for which no such database exists. Manual annotation is tedious, slow, and error-prone. In this paper, we propose to replace most of the annotations by the use of multiple views, at training time only. Specifically, we train the system to predict the same pose in all views. Such a consistency constraint is necessary but not sufficient to predict accurate poses. We therefore complement it with a supervised loss aiming to predict the correct pose in a small set of labeled images, and with a regularization term that penalizes drift from initial predictions. Furthermore, we propose a method to estimate camera pose jointly with human pose, which lets us utilize multi-view footage where calibration is difficult, e.g., for pan-tilt or moving handheld cameras. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on established benchmarks, as well as on a new Ski dataset with rotating cameras and expert ski motion, for which annotations are truly hard to obtain.
papers.title_zh: 从多视图图像中学习单目 3D 人类脉冲估计
papers.abstract_zh: 利用单一图像准确估算 3D 人类构成是可能的,因为精密的深网结构已经接受了关于非常大型数据集的培训。 但是,这仍然没有解决捕捉没有这种数据库的动作的问题。 人工批注是乏味的、缓慢的和容易出错的。 在本文中,我们建议只用培训时间使用多种观点来取代大部分说明,具体地说,我们培训系统,以预测所有观点中相同的构成,这种一致性限制是必要的,但不足以预测准确的构成。 因此,我们用一种有监督的损失来补充它,目的是预测一小套贴有标签的图像的正确布局,并加上一个正规化的术语,惩罚从最初的预测中流出的情况。 此外,我们建议采用一种方法来估计照相机与人体姿势合在一起的姿势,这样我们就可以利用难以校准的多视镜头,例如,用于板状照相机或移动手持照相机。 我们展示了我们在既定基准方面的做法的有效性,并展示了在配备旋转摄像机和专家滑雪运动的新的滑雪数据集方面的做法的有效性,对此,说明确实很难获得。

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Memory Networks for Object Tracking
papers.authors: Tianyu Yang, Antoni B. Chan
papers.abstract: Template-matching methods for visual tracking have gained popularity recently due to their comparable performance and fast speed. However, they lack effective ways to adapt to changes in the target object’s appearance, making their tracking accuracy still far from state-of-the-art. In this paper, we propose a dynamic memory network to adapt the template to the target’s appearance variations during tracking. An LSTM is used as a memory controller, where the input is the search feature map and the outputs are the control signals for the reading and writing process of the memory block. As the location of the target is at first unknown in the search feature map, an attention mechanism is applied to concentrate the LSTM input on the potential target. To prevent aggressive model adaptivity, we apply gated residual template learning to control the amount of retrieved memory that is used to combine with the initial template. Unlike tracking-by-detection methods where the object’s information is maintained by the weight parameters of neural networks, which requires expensive online fine-tuning to be adaptable, our tracker runs completely feed-forward and adapts to the target’s appearance changes by updating the external memory. Moreover, unlike other tracking methods where the model capacity is fixed after offline training – the capacity of our tracker can be easily enlarged as the memory require- ments of a task increase, which is favorable for memorizing long-term ob- ject information. Extensive experiments on OTB and VOT demonstrates that our tracker MemTrack performs favorably against state-of-the-art tracking methods while retaining real-time speed of 50 fps.
papers.title_zh: 物体跟踪学习动态记忆网络
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉跟踪的模板匹配方法最近由于其可比较的性能和快速速度而越来越受欢迎。 但是,它们缺乏适应目标对象外观变化的有效方法,使其跟踪准确性远远低于最新水平。 在本文中,我们建议建立一个动态的内存网络,使模板适应目标在跟踪过程中的外观变化。 LSTM被用作内存控制器,输入为搜索功能图,输出为内存块读写过程的控制信号。 由于搜索特征图中最初不知道目标的位置,因此采用了关注机制,将LSTM输入的内容集中到潜在目标上。 为了防止进取模型的适应性,我们应用封锁的剩余模板学习来控制检索到的内存数量,这些内存与初始模板合并使用。 用神经网络的重量参数来维持物体的信息,需要昂贵的在线微调才能适应,而我们的追踪器则与跟踪逐次检测的方法不同,我们的追踪器完全向前进,通过更新外部记忆来适应目标的外观变化。 此外,与模型能力在离线培训后固定的其他跟踪方法不同,我们的跟踪器的能力很容易随着记忆需要而扩大,任务增加的内存也会增加,这有利于记住长期的隐性信息。 关于OTB和VOT的广泛实验表明,我们的追踪器MemTrack在保持50英尺的实时速度的同时,对最先进的跟踪方法表现良好。

papers.title: Lean Multiclass Crowdsourcing
papers.authors: Grant Van Horn, Steve Branson, Scott Loarie, Serge Belongie, Pietro Perona
papers.abstract: We introduce a method for efficiently crowdsourcing multiclass annotations in challenging, real world image datasets. Our method is designed to minimize the number of human annotations that are necessary to achieve a desired level of confidence on class labels. It is based on combining models of worker behavior with computer vision. Our method is general: it can handle a large number of classes, worker labels that come from a taxonomy rather than a flat list, and can model the dependence of labels when workers can see a history of previous annotations. Our method may be used as a drop-in replacement for the majority vote algorithms used in online crowdsourcing services that aggregate multiple human annotations into a final consolidated label. In experiments conducted on two real-life applications we find that our method can reduce the number of required annotations by as much as a factor of 5.4 and can reduce the residual annotation error by up to 90% when compared with majority voting. Furthermore, the online risk estimates of the models may be used to sort the annotated collection and minimize subsequent expert review effort.
papers.title_zh: 里昂多阶层众众包
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在具有挑战性的、真实的世界图像数据集中引入了高效众包多级说明的方法。 我们的方法旨在尽可能减少人类说明的数量,这些是达到对类标签达到理想信任水平所必需的。 其基础是将工人行为模式与计算机视觉相结合。 我们的方法很一般:它可以处理大量的分类、工人标签,这些标签来自分类学而不是平板列表,并且可以在工人看到先前说明的历史时模拟标签的依赖性。 我们的方法可以用来取代在线众包服务中所使用的多数票算法,这些算法将多重人文说明合并成最后的综合标签。 在对两种实际应用进行的实验中,我们发现,我们的方法可以将所需说明的数量减少5.4倍,并将剩余注释误差比多数投票减少90%。 此外,这些模型的在线风险估计可用于对附加说明的收集进行分类,并尽量减少随后的专家审评工作。

papers.title: Interpret Neural Networks by Identifying Critical Data Routing Paths
papers.authors: Yulong Wang, Hang Su, Bo Zhang, Xiaolin Hu
papers.abstract: Interpretability of a deep neural network aims to explain the rationale behind its decisions and enable the users to understand the intelligent agents, which has become an important issue due to its importance in practical applications. To address this issue, we develop a Distillation Guided Routing method, which is a flexible framework to interpret a deep neural network by identifying critical data routing paths and analyzing the functional processing behavior of the corresponding layers. Specifically, we propose to discover the critical nodes on the data routing paths during network inferring prediction for individual input samples by learning associated control gates for each layer's output channel. The routing paths can, therefore, be represented based on the responses of concatenated control gates from all the layers, which reflect the network's semantic selectivity regarding to the input patterns and more detailed functional process across different layer levels. Based on the discoveries, we propose an adversarial sample detection algorithm by learning a classifier to discriminate whether the critical data routing paths are from real or adversarial samples. Experiments demonstrate that our algorithm can effectively achieve high defense rate with minor training overhead.
papers.title_zh: 识别关键数据运行路径,通过识别关键数据运行路径来解释神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 深层神经网络的可解释性旨在解释其决定背后的理由,使用户能够理解智能剂,由于其在实际应用中的重要性,这已成为一个重要问题。 为解决这一问题,我们开发了一个蒸馏制导路由方法,这是一个灵活的框架,通过确定关键数据路径和分析相应层的功能处理行为,来解释深神经网络。 具体地说,我们提议通过学习每个层输出通道的相关控制门,在网络推算单个输入样本预测过程中,发现数据路径的关键节点。 因此,路由路径可以代表来自所有层次的集中控制门的反应,这反映了网络对输入模式的语义选择以及不同层次的更详细功能过程。 基于这些发现,我们建议采用对抗性样本检测算法,通过学习分类师来区分关键数据路径是来自真实还是对抗性样本。 实验表明我们的算法可以有效地实现高防御率,只需少量培训管理费。

papers.title: Independently Recurrent Neural Network (IndRNN): Building a Longer and Deeper RNN
papers.authors: Shuai Li, Wanqing Li, Chris Cook, Ce Zhu, Yanbo Gao
papers.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been widely used for processing sequential data. However, RNNs are commonly difficult to train due to the well-known gradient vanishing and exploding problems and hard to learn long-term patterns. Long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) were developed to address these problems, but the use of hyperbolic tangent and the sigmoid action functions results in gradient decay over layers. Consequently, construction of an efficiently trainable deep network is challenging. In addition, all the neurons in an RNN layer are entangled together and their behaviour is hard to interpret. To address these problems, a new type of RNN, referred to as independently recurrent neural network (IndRNN), is proposed in this paper, where neurons in the same layer are independent of each other and they are connected across layers. We have shown that an IndRNN can be easily regulated to prevent the gradient exploding and vanishing problems while allowing the network to learn long-term dependencies. Moreover, an IndRNN can work with non-saturated activation functions such as relu (rectified linear unit) and be still trained robustly. Multiple IndRNNs can be stacked to construct a network that is deeper than the existing RNNs. Experimental results have shown that the proposed IndRNN is able to process very long sequences (over 5000 time steps), can be used to construct very deep networks (21 layers used in the experiment) and still be trained robustly. Better performances have been achieved on various tasks by using IndRNNs compared with the traditional RNN and LSTM.
papers.title_zh: 独立经常性神经网络(IndRNNN):建设更长、更深的神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 经常性神经网络(RNN)被广泛用于处理连续数据,但是,由于众所周知的梯度消失和爆炸问题以及难以了解长期模式,经常神经网络通常难以培训。 为了解决这些问题,开发了长期短期内存(LSTM)和封闭式经常单元(GRU),但使用双曲正切值和小行星动作功能导致层层的梯度衰减,因此,建设高效训练的深层网络具有挑战性。 此外,NNN层的所有神经元都缠在一起,其行为难以解释。 为解决这些问题,本文提出了一种新型的NNN,称为独立的经常性神经网络(IndRNN),同一层的神经元相互独立,并相互连接。 我们已表明,印度红外线网可以很容易地进行调节,以防止梯度爆炸和问题消失,同时让网络学习长期依赖性。 此外,印度红外网可以使用不饱和的激活功能,如再生功能(再生线性单元 ) , 并且仍然接受强力培训。 可以堆叠多个网络网络,以构建一个比现有网络网络更深的网络。 实验结果表明,拟议的INDRNN能够处理非常长的序列(超过5000个时间步骤),可以用来建造非常深的网络(试验中使用的21层),并且仍然得到强有力的培训。 与传统的网络NN和LSTM相比,通过使用IndRNN和LSTM,在各项任务上取得了更好的业绩。

papers.title: HydraNets: Specialized Dynamic Architectures for Efficient Inference
papers.authors: Ravi Teja Mullapudi, William R. Mark, Noam Shazeer, Kayvon Fatahalian
papers.abstract: There is growing interest in improving the design of deep network architectures to be both accurate and low cost. This paper explores semantic specialization as a mechanism for improving the computational efficiency (accuracy-per-unit-cost) of inference in the context of image classification. Specifically, we propose a network architecture template called HydraNet, which enables state-of-the-art architectures for image classification to be transformed into dynamic architectures which exploit conditional execution for efficient inference. HydraNets are wide networks containing distinct components specialized to compute features for visually similar classes, but they retain efficiency by dynamically selecting only a small number of components to evaluate for any one input image. This design is made possible by a soft gating mechanism that encourages component specialization during training and accurately performs component selection during inference. We evaluate the HydraNet approach on both the CIFAR-100 and ImageNet classification tasks. On CIFAR, applying the HydraNet template to the ResNet and DenseNet family of models reduces inference cost by 2-4x while retaining the accuracy of the baseline architectures. On ImageNet, applying the HydraNet template improves accuracy up to 2.5% when compared to an efficient baseline architecture with similar inference cost.
papers.title_zh: HydraNets:高效推断的专门动态结构
papers.abstract_zh: 人们对改进深网络结构的设计,使其既准确又低廉的兴趣日益浓厚,本文探讨了语义专业化问题,以此作为提高图像分类中推断的计算效率(准确性-单位成本-成本-计算效率)的一种机制。 具体地说,我们提出一个网络架构模板,名为“海德拉网”,使最先进的图像分类架构能够转化为动态架构,利用有条件执行来有效推断。 HydraNet是宽广的网络,包含专门用来计算视觉相似类特征的不同组件,但它们通过动态选择数量不多的组件来评价任何一种输入图像,从而保持了效率。 之所以能够进行这一设计,是因为采用了软性标签机制,鼓励在培训期间进行组件专门化,并在推论期间准确地进行部件选择,我们评估了海德拉网在CIFAR-100和图像网络分类任务方面的做法。 在CIFAR上,将海德拉网模板应用于ResNet和DenseNet系列模型,将推论费用减少2-4x,同时保持基线结构的准确性。 在图像网络上,采用海德拉网模板,与具有类似推论成本的高效基线结构相比,精确度提高2.5%。

papers.title: Hierarchy of Alternating Specialists for Scene Recognition
papers.authors: Hyo Jin Kim, Jan-Michael Frahm
papers.abstract: We introduce a method for improving convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for scene classification. We present a hierarchy of specialist networks, which disentangles the intra-class variation and inter-class similarity in a coarse to fine manner. Our key insight is that each subset within a class is often associated with different types of inter-class similarity. This suggests that existing network of experts approaches that organize classes into coarse categories are suboptimal. In contrast, we group images based on high-level appearance features rather than their class membership and dedicate a specialist model per group. In addition, we propose an alternating architecture with a global ordered- and a global orderless-representation to account for both the coarse layout of the scene and the transient objects. We demonstrate that it leads to better performance than using a single type of representation as well as the fused features. We also introduce a mini-batch soft k-means that allows end-to-end fine-tuning, as well as a novel routing function for assigning images to specialists. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves a significant improvement over baselines including the existing tree-structured CNNs with class-based grouping.
papers.title_zh: 场点识别不同专家的分级制度
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种改进进化神经网络(CNNs)以进行现场分类的方法。 我们呈现了专家网络的等级,以粗略至细微的方式分解了阶级内部的变异和阶级之间的相似性。 我们的主要见解是,一个类别中的每个子集往往与不同种类的类别间相似性相关联。 这表明现有的将类别分为粗略类别的专家网络方法并不理想。 与此相反,我们根据高级别外貌特征而不是其阶级成员构成情况对图像进行分组,每个群体专门设计一个专家模型。 此外,我们提议建立一个交替结构,有一个全球有秩序的和无秩序的全球代表结构,既考虑到场景的粗糙布局,又考虑到瞬时物体。 我们证明,它比使用单一类型的代表形式和引信特征更能产生更好的性能。 我们还引入一种小型软K手段,允许端到端的微调,以及一种向专家分配图像的新路线功能。 实验结果显示,拟议办法比基线大有改进,包括现有按级分类的有线电视新闻网。

papers.title: Guided Proofreading of Automatic Segmentations for Connectomics
papers.authors: Daniel Haehn, Verena Kaynig, James Tompkin, Jeff W. Lichtman, Hanspeter Pfister
papers.abstract: Automatic cell image segmentation methods in connectomics produce merge and split errors, which require correction through proofreading. Previous research has identified the visual search for these errors as the bottleneck in interactive proofreading. To aid error correction, we develop two classifiers that automatically recommend candidate merges and splits to the user. These classifiers use a convolutional neural network (CNN) that has been trained with errors in automatic segmentations against expert-labeled ground truth. Our classifiers detect potentially-erroneous regions by considering a large context region around a segmentation boundary. Corrections can then be performed by a user with yes/no decisions, which reduces variation of information 7.5x faster than previous proofreading methods. We also present a fully-automatic mode that uses a probability threshold to make merge/split decisions. Extensive experiments using the automatic approach and comparing performance of novice and expert users demonstrate that our method performs favorably against state-of-the-art proofreading methods on different connectomics datasets.
papers.title_zh: 向导校对连接组的自动区段
papers.abstract_zh: 连接组别中的自动单元格图像分离方法产生合并和分裂错误,需要通过校对校正校正。 先前的研究发现,这些错误的视觉搜索是交互校对中的瓶颈。 为了帮助纠正错误,我们开发了两个自动推荐候选人合并和分解给用户的分类器。 这些分类器使用一个革命性神经网络(CNN),该网络经过了针对专家标签的地面真相的自动分解错误的培训。 我们的分类者通过考虑围绕分割边界的大环境区域来探测潜在偏差区域。 然后,校正可以由有/无决定的用户进行,从而比以前的校对方法更快地减少信息变化7.5倍。 我们还提出了一个全自动模式,使用概率阈值作出合并/分割决定。 使用自动方法进行的广泛试验以及比较新手和专家用户的性能表明,我们的方法优于不同连接组数据集的最新校对方法。

papers.title: Gated Fusion Network for Single Image Dehazing
papers.authors: Wenqi Ren, Lin Ma, Jiawei Zhang, Jinshan Pan, Xiaochun Cao, Wei Liu, Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient algorithm to directly restore a clear image from a hazy input. The proposed algorithm hinges on an end-to-end trainable neural network that consists of an encoder and a decoder. The encoder is exploited to capture the context of the derived input images, while the decoder is employed to estimate the contribution of each input to the final dehazed result using the learned representations attributed to the encoder. The constructed network adopts a novel fusion-based strategy which derives three inputs from an original hazy image by applying White Balance (WB), Contrast Enhancing (CE), and Gamma Correction (GC). We compute pixel-wise confidence maps based on the appearance differences between these different inputs to blend the information of the derived inputs and preserve the regions with pleasant visibility. The final dehazed image is yielded by gating the important features of the derived inputs. To train the network, we introduce a multi-scale based approach so that the halo artifacts can be avoided. Extensive experimental results on both synthetic and real-world images demonstrate that the proposed algorithm performs favorably against the state-of-the-art algorithms.
papers.title_zh: 单图像解密 Ged 聚合网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个高效的算法,直接从模糊输入中恢复清晰的图像。 提议的算法取决于由编码器和解码器组成的端到端可训练神经网络。 编码器被利用来捕捉衍生输入图像的背景,而编码器则用来利用编码器的学术表述来估计每项输入对最后解密结果的贡献。 所建造的网络采用了一种新的以聚变为基础的战略,通过应用白平衡(WB)、对比增强(CE)和伽玛校正(GC),从原始的模糊图像中得出三项投入。 我们根据这些不同投入之间的外观差异计算像素智能地图,以混合派生投入的信息,并保持区域能见度。 最后解密的图像通过勾划派生投入的重要特征产生。 为了培训这个网络,我们引入了一种基于多尺度的方法,以避免光环工艺品。 合成图像和真实世界图像的广泛实验结果表明,拟议的算法对最先进的算法有利。

papers.title: Fully Convolutional Adaptation Networks for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Yiheng Zhang, Zhaofan Qiu, Ting Yao, Dong Liu, Tao Mei
papers.abstract: The recent advances in deep neural networks have convincingly demonstrated high capability in learning vision models on large datasets. Nevertheless, collecting expert labeled datasets especially with pixel-level annotations is an extremely expensive process. An appealing alternative is to render synthetic data (e.g., computer games) and generate ground truth automatically. However, simply applying the models learnt on synthetic images may lead to high generalization error on real images due to domain shift. In this paper, we facilitate this issue from the perspectives of both visual appearance-level and representation-level domain adaptation. The former adapts source-domain images to appear as if drawn from the ``style" in the target domain and the latter attempts to learn domain-invariant representations. Specifically, we present Fully Convolutional Adaptation Networks (FCAN), a novel deep architecture for semantic segmentation which combines Appearance Adaptation Networks (AAN) and Representation Adaptation Networks (RAN). AAN learns a transformation from one domain to the other in the pixel space and RAN is optimized in an adversarial learning manner to maximally fool the domain discriminator with the learnt source and target representations. Extensive experiments are conducted on the transfer from GTA5 (game videos) to Cityscapes (urban street scenes) on semantic segmentation and our proposal achieves superior results when comparing to state-of-the-art unsupervised adaptation techniques. More remarkably, we obtain a new record: mIoU of 47.5% on BDDS (drive-cam videos) in an unsupervised setting.
papers.title_zh: 语义分割完全革命适应网络
papers.abstract_zh: 深层神经网络最近的进展令人信服地证明,在大型数据集上学习视觉模型的能力很高,然而,收集专家标签数据集,特别是像素级说明,是一个极其昂贵的过程。 一个有吸引力的替代办法是使合成数据(例如计算机游戏)自动成为合成数据(例如计算机游戏),并自动产生地面真相。 然而,仅仅应用合成图像上所学的模型就可能导致由于域变换而在真实图像上出现高度的概括错误。 在本文中,我们从视觉外观层面和代表层面域适应的角度为这一问题提供便利。 前者将源域图像调整为显示目标域“ 风格” 的“ 风格” , 而后者则试图学习域内差异的表达方式。 具体而言,我们介绍了全面革命适应网络(FCAN),这是一个新型的语义分离深层结构,将外观适应网络(AAN)和代表型适应网络(RAN)结合起来。 AAN学会在像素空间从一个领域向另一个领域转变,RAN以对抗性学习方式得到优化,以最大限度愚弄领域歧视者,使其与所学的来源和目标表现相匹配。 对从GTA5(游戏录像)转移到城市景区(城市街道场景)进行关于语义分割的广泛试验,我们的建议在与最先进的、不受监督的适应技术相比时,取得了优异的结果。 更显著的是,我们获得了一个新的记录:在无人监督的环境下,BDDS(驱动摄像头视频)的MIOU为47.5%。

papers.title: Folded Recurrent Neural Networks for Future Video Prediction
papers.authors: Marc Oliu, Javier Selva, Sergio Escalera
papers.abstract: This work introduces double-mapping Gated Recurrent Units (dGRU), an extension of standard GRUs where the input is considered as a recurrent state. An extra set of logic gates is added to update the input given the output. Stacking multiple such layers results in a recurrent auto-encoder: the operators updating the outputs comprise the encoder, while the ones updating the inputs form the decoder. Since the states are shared between corresponding encoder and decoder layers, the representation is stratified during learning: some information is not passed to the next layers. We test our model on future video prediction. Main challenges for this task include high variability in videos, temporal propagation of errors, and non-specificity of future frames. We show how only the encoder or decoder needs to be applied for encoding or prediction. This reduces the computational cost and avoids re-encoding predictions when generating multiple frames, mitigating error propagation. Furthermore, it is possible to remove layers from a trained model, giving an insight to the role of each layer. Our approach improves state of the art results on MMNIST and UCF101, being competitive on KTH with 2 and 3 times less memory usage and computational cost than the best scored approach.
papers.title_zh: 为未来视频预测创建的经常神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 这项工作引入了双映 GGRU 常务单位( dGRU ) , 这是标准 GRU 的延伸, 标准 GRU 输入被视为经常性状态 。 添加了一组额外的逻辑门以更新根据输出更新输入 。 堆叠多个此类层导致一个经常性自动编码器:更新产出的操作员包括编码器,而更新输入的操作员构成编码器。 由于各州在相应的编码器和解码器层之间共享,因此在学习期间,其代表性是分级的:有些信息不会传递到下层。我们测试我们未来视频预测模型。 这项任务的主要挑战包括视频的高度变异性、误差的时间传播以及未来框架的不具体性。 我们展示了只有编码器或解码器需要如何用于编码或预测。 这样可以降低计算成本,避免在生成多个框架时进行重新编码预测,减轻错误传播。 此外,还可以从经过培训的模型中去除层层,以洞察每个层的作用。 我们的方法改善了MMNIST和UCF101的最新结果,在KTH上具有竞争力,其记忆使用和计算成本比最佳得分方法少2倍和3倍。

papers.title: Dynamic Graph Generation Network: Generating Relational Knowledge From Diagrams
papers.authors: Daesik Kim, YoungJoon Yoo, Jee-Soo Kim, SangKuk Lee, Nojun Kwak
papers.abstract: In this work, we introduce a new algorithm for analyzing a diagram, which contains visual and textual information in an abstract and integrated way. Whereas diagrams contain richer information compared with individual image-based or language-based data, proper solutions for automatically understanding them have not been proposed due to their innate characteristics of multi-modality and arbitrariness of layouts. To tackle this problem, we propose a unified diagram-parsing network for generating knowledge from diagrams based on an object detector and a recurrent neural network designed for a graphical structure. Specifically, we propose a dynamic graph-generation network that is based on dynamic memory and graph theory. We explore the dynamics of information in a diagram with activation of gates in gated recurrent unit (GRU) cells. On publicly available diagram datasets, our model demonstrates a state-of-the-art result that outperforms other baselines. Moreover, further experiments on question answering shows potentials of the proposed method for various applications.
papers.title_zh: 动态图形生成网络: 从图表生成关系知识
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了用于分析图表的新算法,该算法以抽象和综合的方式包含视觉和文字信息。 虽然图表所载信息较个人图像数据或语言数据更为丰富,但由于其固有的多时制特点和布局的任意性,尚未提出自动理解这些数据的适当解决办法。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议建立一个统一的图表划分网络,以便从基于物体探测器的图表和为图形结构设计的经常性神经网络生成知识。具体地说,我们建议建立一个基于动态内存和图形理论的动态图形生成网络。 我们在一张图表中探索信息动态,该图表激活了大门的常规单元(GRU)细胞。 在公开提供的图表数据集中,我们的模型展示了比其他基线更先进的结果。 此外,关于回答问题的进一步实验显示了拟议方法在各种应用方面的潜力。

papers.title: Dual Skipping Networks
papers.authors: Changmao Cheng, Yanwei Fu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Wei Liu, Wenlian Lu, Jianfeng Feng, Xiangyang Xue
papers.abstract: Inspired by the recent neuroscience studies on the left-right asymmetry of the human brain in processing low and high spatial frequency information, this paper introduces a dual skipping network which carries out coarse-to-fine object categorization. Such a network has two branches to simultaneously deal with both coarse and fine-grained classification tasks. Specifically, we propose a layer-skipping mechanism that learns a gating network to predict which layers to skip in the testing stage. This layer-skipping mechanism endows the network with good flexibility and capability in practice. Evaluations are conducted on several widely used coarse-to-fine object categorization benchmarks, and promising results are achieved by our proposed network model.
papers.title_zh: 双跳过网络
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在处理低空频和高空频信息过程中,对人体大脑的右偏不对称问题进行了神经科学研究,在这项研究的启发下,本文引入了一个双跳网络,进行粗略到细微的物体分类。 这种网络有两个分支,可以同时处理粗糙和细细的分类任务。 具体地说,我们建议一个层层倾斜机制,学习一个滑板网络,以预测测试阶段要跳过哪些层。 这种层层倾斜机制使网络在实际中具有良好的灵活性和能力,对若干广泛使用的粗略至细微物体分类基准进行评价,并通过我们拟议的网络模式取得有希望的成果。

papers.title: DOTA: A Large-Scale Dataset for Object Detection in Aerial Images
papers.authors: Gui-Song Xia, Xiang Bai, Jian Ding, Zhen Zhu, Serge Belongie, Jiebo Luo, Mihai Datcu, Marcello Pelillo, Liangpei Zhang
papers.abstract: Object detection is an important and challenging problem in computer vision. Although the past decade has witnessed major advances in object detection in natural scenes, such successes have been slow to aerial imagery, not only because of the huge variation in the scale, orientation and shape of the object instances on the earth's surface, but also due to the scarcity of well-annotated datasets of objects in aerial scenes. To advance object detection research in Earth Vision, also known as Earth Observation and Remote Sensing, we introduce a large-scale Dataset for Object deTection in Aerial images (DOTA). To this end, we collect 2806 aerial images from different sensors and platforms. Each image is of the size about 4000-by-4000 pixels and contains objects exhibiting a wide variety of scales, orientations, and shapes. These DOTA images are then annotated by experts in aerial image interpretation using 15 common object categories. The fully annotated DOTA images contains 188,282 instances, each of which is labeled by an arbitrary (8 d.o.f.) quadrilateral. To build a baseline for object detection in Earth Vision, we evaluate state-of-the-art object detection algorithms on DOTA. Experiments demonstrate that DOTA well represents real Earth Vision applications and are quite challenging.
papers.title_zh: DOTA:用于空中图像中物体探测的大型数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 物体探测是计算机视觉方面一个重要和具有挑战性的问题。 虽然过去十年在自然场景物体探测方面取得了重大进步,但这种成功对空中图像来说却缓慢,不仅因为地球表面物体情况的规模、方向和形状差异很大,而且由于空中场景中缺少附有说明的物体数据集。 为了推进地球展望(又称地球观测和遥感)中的物体探测研究,我们推出了一个用于空中图像中物体探测的大规模数据集(DOTA),为此,我们从不同的传感器和平台上收集了2806个空中图像。 每张图像的大小约为4000x4000像素, 包含显示各种大小、 方向和形状的物体。 这些 DOTA 图像然后由专家使用 15 个共同对象类别进行空中图像判读时附加说明 。 附有充分说明的DOTA图像包含188,282个实例,每个实例都有任意(8 d.o.f.)四边形的标签。为了在地球展望中建立物体探测基线,我们评估了DOTA上最先进的物体探测算法。 实验表明,DOTA很好地代表了真实的地球展望应用,而且相当具有挑战性。

papers.title: Divide and Grow: Capturing Huge Diversity in Crowd Images With Incrementally Growing CNN
papers.authors: Deepak Babu Sam, Neeraj N. Sajjan, R. Venkatesh Babu, Mukundhan Srinivasan
papers.abstract: Automated counting of people in crowd images is a challenging task. The major difficulty stems from the large diversity in the way people appear in crowds. In fact, features available for crowd discrimination largely depend on the crowd density to the extent that people are only seen as blobs in a highly dense scene. We tackle this problem with a growing CNN which can progressively increase its capacity to account for the wide variability seen in crowd scenes. Our model starts from a base CNN density regressor, which is trained in equivalence on all types of crowd images. In order to adapt with the huge diversity, we create two child regressors which are exact copies of the base CNN. A differential training procedure divides the dataset into two clusters and fine-tunes the child networks on their respective specialties. Consequently, without any hand-crafted criteria for forming specialties, the child regressors become experts on certain types of crowds. The child networks are again split recursively, creating two experts at every division. This hierarchical training leads to a CNN tree, where the child regressors are more fine experts than any of their parents. The leaf nodes are taken as the final experts and a classifier network is then trained to predict the correct specialty for a given test image patch. The proposed model achieves higher count accuracy on major crowd datasets. Further, we analyse the characteristics of specialties mined automatically by our method.
papers.title_zh: 以不断增长的有线电视新闻网在人群图像中捕捉巨大的多样性。
papers.abstract_zh: 人群图像中的人群自动计数是一项艰巨的任务,主要困难在于人群中人们的出现方式差异很大。 事实上,人群歧视的特征在很大程度上取决于人群密度,以至于人们只被视为高度密集的场景中的空洞。 我们用日益壮大的有线电视新闻网来解决这个问题,它可以逐步提高应对人群场景所看到的广泛变异的能力。 我们的模型始于一个有线电视新闻网基础密度递减器,它在所有类型的人群图像上都受过等值培训。 为了适应巨大的多样性,我们创建了两个儿童退步者,它们就是有线电视新闻网的准印本。 差别培训程序将数据集分成两个组,并根据儿童网络各自的专业对其进行微调。 因此,如果没有任何手工制作的专业形成标准,儿童退步者就成为某些类型的人群的专家,儿童网络又被反复分割,在每个分部都产生两名专家。 这种分级培训导致有线电视新闻网的一棵树,在这个树上,儿童递减者比他们的父母中的任何一个都更精细。 叶节点被当作最终专家,然后对分类者网络进行培训,以预测特定测试图像补丁的正确专长。 拟议的模型使主要人群数据集的计数准确性更高,此外,我们用我们的方法分析自动开采的特质的特点。

papers.title: Demo2Vec: Reasoning Object Affordances From Online Videos
papers.authors: Kuan Fang, Te-Lin Wu, Daniel Yang, Silvio Savarese, Joseph J. Lim
papers.abstract: Watching expert demonstrations is an important way for humans and robots to reason about affordances of unseen objects. In this paper, we consider the problem of reasoning object affordances through the feature embedding of demonstration videos. We design the Demo2Vec model which learns to extract embedded vectors of demonstration videos and predicts the interaction region and the action label on a target image of the same object. We introduce the Online Product Review dataset for Affordance (OPRA) by collecting and labeling diverse YouTube product review videos. Our Demo2Vec model outperforms various recurrent neural network baselines on the collected dataset.
papers.title_zh: Demo2Vec: 在线视频提供合理目标的报价
papers.abstract_zh: 观察专家演示对于人类和机器人来说,是解释隐形物体的承载能力的重要方法。 在本文中,我们通过演示视频的嵌入功能来考虑推理标的承载能力问题。 我们设计了Demo2Vec模型,该模型学习提取演示视频的嵌入矢量,预测互动区域和同一对象目标图像上的动作标签。 我们通过收集和标注各种YouTube产品审查视频,引入了在线产品审查数据集(OPRA ) 。 我们的Demo2Vec模型在收集的数据集上优于各种经常性神经网络基线。

papers.title: Deep Regionlets for Object Detection
papers.authors: Hongyu Xu, Xutao Lv, Xiaoyu Wang, Zhou Ren, Navaneeth Bodla, Rama Chellappa
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel object detection framework named "Deep Regionlets" by establishing a bridge between deep neural networks and conventional detection schema for accurate generic object detection. Motivated by the abilities of regionlets for modeling object deformation and multiple aspect ratios, we incorporate regionlets into an end-to-end trainable deep learning framework. The deep regionlets framework consists of a region selection network and a deep regionlet learning module. Specifically, given a detection bounding box proposal, the region selection network provides guidance on where to select regions to learn the features from. The regionlet learning module focuses on local feature selection and transformation to alleviate local variations. To this end, we first realize non-rectangular region selection within the detection framework to accommodate variations in object appearance. Moreover, we design a ``gating network" within the regionlet leaning module to enable soft regionlet selection and pooling. The Deep Regionlets framework is trained end-to-end without additional efforts. We perform ablation studies and conduct extensive experiments on the PASCAL VOC and Microsoft COCO datasets. The proposed framework outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms, such as RetinaNet and Mask R-CNN, even without additional segmentation labels.
papers.title_zh: 用于物体探测的深区域
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提议建立一个名为“深区域”的新式物体探测框架,在深神经网络和常规探测模型之间建立桥梁,以便准确探测通用物体。 在模拟物体变形和多面比率的区域小区的能力推动下,我们把区域小区纳入一个端对端可培训的深层学习框架,深区域小区框架包括一个区域选择网络和一个深区域小区学习模块。 具体而言,根据检测捆绑框提案,区域选择网络就选择区域从何处学习特征提供指导,区域学习模块侧重于地方特征选择和改造,以缓解地方差异。 为此,我们首先在探测框架内实现非矩形区域选择,以适应物体外观的变异。 此外,我们设计了区域内部的“引力网络 ” , 以便进行软区域选择和集合。 深海区域框架经过培训,无需额外努力,即端对端,我们对PASCAL VOC和微软COCO数据集进行通缩研究并进行广泛试验。 拟议的框架表现优于最新的算法,如RetinaNet和Mask R-CNN,即使没有额外的分解标签。

papers.title: Data-Driven Sparse Structure Selection for Deep Neural Networks
papers.authors: Zehao Huang, Naiyan Wang
papers.abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks have liberated its extraordinary power on various tasks. However, it is still very challenging to deploy state-of-the-art models into real-world applications due to their high computational complexity. How can we design a compact and effective network without massive experiments and expert knowledge? In this paper, we propose a simple and effective framework to learn and prune deep models in an end-to-end manner. In our framework, a new type of parameter -- scaling factor is first introduced to scale the outputs of specific structures, such as neurons, groups or residual blocks. Then we add sparsity regularizations on these factors, and solve this optimization problem by a modified stochastic Accelerated Proximal Gradient (APG) method. By forcing some of the factors to zero, we can safely remove the corresponding structures, thus prune the unimportant parts of a CNN. Comparing with other structure selection methods that may need thousands of trials or iterative fine-tuning, our method is trained fully end-to-end in one training pass without bells and whistles. We evaluate our method, Sparse Structure Selection with several state-of-the-art CNNs, and demonstrate very promising results with adaptive depth and width selection. Code is available at: https://github.com/huangzehao/sparse-structure-selection.
papers.title_zh: 用于深神经网络的 Data- Driven Sparse 结构选择
papers.abstract_zh: 然而,将最先进的模型运用到现实世界的应用中仍然非常困难,因为它们的计算复杂性很高。 我们如何能够在没有大规模实验和专业知识的情况下设计一个紧凑而有效的网络? 在本文中,我们提出了一个简单而有效的框架,以便以端对端的方式学习和利用深层模型。 在我们的框架内,我们首先采用了一种新的参数类型 -- -- 缩放系数,以缩放具体结构的产出,如神经元、组群或残余区块。 然后,我们增加这些因素的宽度规范化,并通过修改的随机加速速进法(APG)来解决优化问题。 通过将某些因素强制到零,我们可以安全地清除相应的结构,从而缩小CNN的无关紧要部分。 与可能需要数千次试验或迭代微调的其他结构选择方法相比,我们的方法在一个没有钟声和哨声的培训通行证中经过全面端对端培训。 我们用几个最先进的CNN来评估我们的方法,即“粗皮结构选择”,并用适应性的深度和宽度选择来展示非常有希望的结果。 代码可在https://github.com/huangzehao/sparse-sequal-select。

papers.title: Context-Aware Deep Feature Compression for High-Speed Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Jongwon Choi, Hyung Jin Chang, Tobias Fischer, Sangdoo Yun, Kyuewang Lee, Jiyeoup Jeong, Yiannis Demiris, Jin Young Choi
papers.abstract: We propose a new context-aware correlation filter based tracking framework to achieve both high computational speed and state-of-the-art performance among real-time trackers. The major contribution to the high computational speed lies in the proposed deep feature compression that is achieved by a context-aware scheme utilizing multiple expert auto-encoders; a context in our framework refers to the coarse category of the tracking target according to appearance patterns. In the pre-training phase, one expert auto-encoder is trained per category. In the tracking phase, the best expert auto-encoder is selected for a given target, and only this auto-encoder is used. To achieve high tracking performance with the compressed feature map, we introduce extrinsic denoising processes and a new orthogonality loss term for pre-training and fine-tuning of the expert auto-encoders. We validate the proposed context-aware framework through a number of experiments, where our method achieves a comparable performance to state-of-the-art trackers which cannot run in real-time, while running at a significantly fast speed of over 100 fps.
papers.title_zh: 高频视觉跟踪高频视频跟踪的 深功能压缩
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提议一个新的基于环境意识的关联过滤跟踪框架,以实现实时跟踪器的高计算速度和最先进的性能。 高计算速度的主要促成因素在于拟议中的深度特征压缩,这是利用多位专家自动编码器进行的背景认知计划所实现的;我们框架中的上下文是指根据外观模式跟踪目标的粗略类别。 在培训前阶段,每个类别培训一名专家自动编码器,在跟踪阶段,为特定目标选择最佳专家自动编码器,只使用该自动编码器。 为了在压缩特征图上实现高跟踪性能,我们引入了外部去注程序,并引入了对专家自动编译员进行预培训和微调的新的整形损失学期。 我们通过若干试验来验证拟议的环境意识框架,我们的方法在这种试验中取得了与最先进的跟踪器相当的业绩,这些跟踪器无法实时运行,而运行速度非常快,超过100英尺。

papers.title: Context Contrasted Feature and Gated Multi-Scale Aggregation for Scene Segmentation
papers.authors: Henghui Ding, Xudong Jiang, Bing Shuai, Ai Qun Liu, Gang Wang
papers.abstract: Scene segmentation is a challenging task as it need label every pixel in the image. It is crucial to exploit discriminative context and aggregate multi-scale features to achieve better segmentation. In this paper, we first propose a novel context contrasted local feature that not only leverages the informative context but also spotlights the local information in contrast to the context. The proposed context contrasted local feature greatly improves the parsing performance, especially for inconspicuous objects and background stuff. Furthermore, we propose a scheme of gated sum to selectively aggregate multi-scale features for each spatial position. The gates in this scheme control the information flow of different scale features. Their values are generated from the testing image by the proposed network learnt from the training data so that they are adaptive not only to the training data, but also to the specific testing image. Without bells and whistles, the proposed approach achieves the state-of-the-arts consistently on the three popular scene segmentation datasets, Pascal Context, SUN-RGBD and COCO Stuff.
papers.title_zh: 场点分割的背景对比特征和Gated多级集成
papers.abstract_zh: 场景分割是一项具有挑战性的任务,因为它需要标出图像中的每一个像素。 利用歧视性背景和综合多尺度特征实现更好的分割至关重要。 在本文中,我们首先提出一种与地方特征形成对比的新背景,这种特征不仅利用了信息背景,而且突出地方信息,而与地方信息相对照。 拟议的背景对比与当地特点形成对比,大大改进了区分性能,特别是对于不显眼的物体和背景材料。 此外,我们提议了一个门加门办法,为每个空间位置选择综合的多尺度特征。 该计划的大门控制着不同规模特征的信息流动,其价值来自从培训数据中学习的拟议网络的测试图像,以便不仅适应培训数据,而且适应特定测试图像。 在没有钟声和哨声的情况下,拟议办法始终如一地在三个流行的场景截面数据集(帕斯卡尔环境、SUN-RGBD和COCO Stuff)上取得最新进展。

papers.title: Attend and Rectify: a gated attention mechanism for fine-grained recovery
papers.authors: Pau Rodriguez, Josep M. Gonfaus, Guillem Cucurull, F. XavierRoca, Jordi Gonzalez
papers.abstract: We propose a novel attention mechanism to enhance Convolutional Neural Networks for fine-grained recognition. It learns to attend to lower-level feature activations without requiring part annotations and uses these activations to update and rectify the output likelihood distribution. In contrast to other approaches, the proposed mechanism is modular, architecture-independent and efficient both in terms of parameters and computation required. Experiments show that networks augmented with our approach systematically improve their classification accuracy and become more robust to clutter. As a result, Wide Residual Networks augmented with our proposal surpasses the state of the art classification accuracies in CIFAR-10, the Adience gender recognition task, Stanford dogs, and UEC Food-100.
papers.title_zh: 出勤和矫正:为微重恢复提供门外注意机制
papers.abstract_zh: 我们建议建立一个新的关注机制,加强进化神经网络,以进行精细的识别。 它学会在不需要部分说明的情况下处理较低级别的功能启动,并利用这些激活来更新和纠正产出可能性分布。 与其他方法不同,拟议的机制是模块化的,建筑独立,在所需参数和计算方面都是有效的。 实验表明,随着我们的方法而扩大的网络系统提高了分类准确性,并变得更加强大,以产生混乱。 因此,由于我们的提议,扩大的大型残余网络超过了CIFAR-10、承认性别任务、斯坦福犬和UEC食品-100的先进分类标准。

papers.title: AMC: AutoML for Model Compression and Acceleration on Mobile Devices
papers.authors: Yihui He, Ji Lin, Zhijian Liu, Hanrui Wang, Li-Jia Li, Song Han
papers.abstract: Model compression is an effective technique to efficiently deploy neural network models on mobile devices which have limited computation resources and tight power budgets. Conventional model compression techniques rely on hand-crafted features and require domain experts to explore the large design space trading off among model size, speed, and accuracy, which is usually sub-optimal and time-consuming. In this paper, we propose AutoML for Model Compression (AMC) which leverages reinforcement learning to efficiently sample the design space and can improve the model compression quality. We achieved state-of- the-art model compression results in a fully automated way without any human efforts. Under 4× FLOPs reduction, we achieved 2.7% better accuracy than the hand-crafted model compression method for VGG-16 on ImageNet. We applied this automated, push-the-button compression pipeline to MobileNet-V1 and achieved a speedup of 1.53x on the GPU (Titan Xp) and 1.95x on an Android phone (Google Pixel 1), with negligible loss of accuracy.
papers.title_zh: AMC: 移动设备模型压缩和加速的自动ML
papers.abstract_zh: 模型压缩是一种有效的技术,可以有效地在计算资源有限和电力预算紧张的移动设备上部署神经网络模型。 常规模式压缩技术依靠手工制作的特征,需要域专家探索模型大小、速度和精确度之间的大型设计空间交换,这种交换通常不尽人意,耗费时间。 在本文中,我们提出“模型压缩自动ML ” ( AMC ) , 利用强化学习对设计空间进行高效取样,并能够提高模型压缩质量。 我们完全自动化地实现了最先进的模型压缩结果,而人类没有做出任何努力。 在减少4xFLOPs下,我们比图像网络上VGG-16的手工制作模型压缩方法的精确度提高了2.7%。 我们将这个自动、按键压缩管道应用到移动网络V1上,在GPU(Titan Xp)上加速了1.53x,在安卓电话(Google Pixel 1)上加速了1.95x,精确度微乎其微。

papers.title: Adding Attentiveness to the Neurons in Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.authors: Pengfei Zhang, Jianru Xue, Cuiling Lan, Wenjun Zeng, Zhanning Gao, Nanning Zheng
papers.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are capable of modeling the temporal dynamics of complex sequential information. However, the structures of existing RNN neurons mainly focus on controlling the contributions of current and historical information but do not explore the different importance levels of different elements in an input vector of a time slot.
