We propose adding a simple yet effective Element-wise-Attention Gate (EleAttG) to an RNN block (e.g., all RNN neurons in a network layer) that empowers the RNN neurons to have the attentiveness capability. For an RNN block, an EleAttG is added to adaptively modulate the input by assigning different levels of importance, i.e., attention, to each element/dimension of the input. We refer to an RNN block equipped with an EleAttG as an EleAtt-RNN block. Specically, the modulation of the input is content adaptive and is performed at ne granularity, being element-wise rather than input-wise. The proposed EleAttG, as an additional fundamental unit, is general and can be applied to any RNN structures, e.g., standard RNN, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), or Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed EleAtt-RNN by applying it to the action recognition tasks on both 3D human skeleton data and RGB videos. Experiments show that adding attentiveness through EleAttGs to RNN blocks signicantly boosts the power of RNNs.
papers.title_zh: 在经常性神经网络中添加对新神经网络的注意
papers.abstract_zh: 经常性神经网络能够模拟复杂连续信息的时间动态。 然而,现有RNN神经元的结构主要侧重于控制当前和历史信息的贡献,但没有探讨时间档输入矢量中不同元素的不同重要性。 我们建议,在RNN区块(例如网络层中所有RNN神经元)中增加一个简单而有效的元素自备门(EleAttG),使RNN神经元具备关注能力。 对于 RNN 区块, EleATTG 被添加到适应性调控输入中,方法是对输入的每个元素/分层给予不同程度的重视,即注意。 我们将配备 EleATTG 的 RNN 区块称为 EleATT-RNN 区块。 很明显,输入的调制是内容适应性,以纳粒度进行,是元素性而非投入性。 拟议的EleAttG作为一个额外的基本单位,是一般性的,可适用于任何区域网络网结构,例如标准区域网、长期短期内存或Gated经常股。 我们通过将EleATT-RNN应用于3D人类骨骼数据和RGB视频的行动识别任务,表明了拟议中的EleATT-RNN的有效性。 实验表明,通过EleATGs对RNN街区的注意,明显地提高了RNN的力量。

papers.title: Quality Resilient Deep Neural Networks
papers.authors: Samuel Dodge, Lina J. Karam
papers.abstract: We study deep neural networks for classification of images with quality distortions. We first show that networks fine-tuned on distorted data greatly outperform the original networks when tested on distorted data. However, fine-tuned networks perform poorly on quality distortions that they have not been trained for. We propose a mixture of experts ensemble method that is robust to different types of distortions. The "experts" in our model are trained on a particular type of distortion. The output of the model is a weighted sum of the expert models, where the weights are determined by a separate gating network. The gating network is trained to predict optimal weights for a particular distortion type and level. During testing, the network is blind to the distortion level and type, yet can still assign appropriate weights to the expert models. We additionally investigate weight sharing methods for the mixture model and show that improved performance can be achieved with a large reduction in the number of unique network parameters.
papers.title_zh: 具有质量抗力的深神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究对质量失真图像进行分类的深层神经网络。 我们首先发现,在对失真数据进行测试时,对失真数据进行微调的网络大大优于原始网络。 然而,微调的网络在质量失真方面表现不佳,而质量失真是它们没有受过训练的。 我们建议了一种混合的专家混合方法,该方法对不同类型的失真非常有效。 我们模型中的“专家”就某种特定的失真类型接受了培训。模型的输出是专家模型的加权总和,其加权由单独的格子网决定。 导航网经过培训,可以预测特定失真类型和水平的最佳重量;在测试期间,网络对失真程度和类型视而不见,但仍能给专家模型分配适当的重量。 我们进一步调查混合模型的权重分担方法,并表明通过大量减少独特的网络参数,可以提高性能。

papers.title: Hard Mixtures of Experts for Large Scale Weakly Supervised Vision
papers.authors: Sam Gross, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato, Arthur Szlam
papers.abstract: Training convolutional networks (CNN's) that fit on a single GPU with minibatch stochastic gradient descent has become effective in practice. However, there is still no effective method for training large networks that do not fit in the memory of a few GPU cards, or for parallelizing CNN training. In this work we show that a simple hard mixture of experts model can be efficiently trained to good effect on large scale hashtag (multilabel) prediction tasks. Mixture of experts models are not new [??], but in the past, researchers have had to devise sophisticated methods to deal with data fragmentation. We show empirically that modern weakly supervised data sets are large enough to support naive partitioning schemes where each data point is assigned to a single expert. Because the experts are independent, training them in parallel is easy, and evaluation is cheap for the size of the model. Furthermore, we show that we can use a single decoding layer for all the experts, allowing a unified feature embedding space. We demonstrate that it is feasible (and in fact relatively painless) to train far larger models than could be practically trained with standard CNN architectures, and that the extra capacity can be well used on current datasets.
papers.title_zh: 大型脆弱监督视野专家的硬混合体
papers.abstract_zh: 然而,目前还没有有效的方法来培训那些不适应少数GPU卡记忆的大型网络,或同时提供CNN培训。 在这项工作中,我们证明,一个简单的硬性专家混合模型可以得到有效的培训,从而对大规模标签(多标签)预测任务产生良好效果。 专家模型的混合并不是新的[? ],但在过去,研究人员不得不设计复杂的方法来处理数据分散问题。 我们从经验上表明,现代监管薄弱的数据集足够大,足以支持天真的分割计划,因为每一个数据点都分配给了一位专家。 由于专家是独立的,因此平行培训是很容易的,对于模型的规模来说,评估是廉价的。 此外,我们表明,我们可以为所有专家使用一个单一的解码层,允许有一个统一的特性嵌入空间。 我们证明,培训远大于可实际接受有线电视新闻网标准架构培训的模型是可行的(事实上相对无痛的),而且额外能力可以很好地用于目前的数据集。

papers.title: Changing Model Behavior at Test-Time Using Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Augustus Odena, Dieterich Lawson, Christopher Olah
papers.abstract: Machine learning models are often used at test-time subject to constraints and trade-offs not present at training-time. For example, a computer vision model operating on an embedded device may need to perform real-time inference, or a translation model operating on a cell phone may wish to bound its average compute time in order to be power-efficient. In this work we describe a mixture-of-experts model and show how to change its test-time resource-usage on a per-input basis using reinforcement learning. We test our method on a small MNIST-based example.
papers.title_zh: 利用强化学习在测试时改变模型行为
papers.abstract_zh: 机械学习模式往往在测试时使用,但受培训时没有的制约和权衡。 例如,在嵌入装置上运行的计算机视觉模型可能需要进行实时推断,或者在移动电话上运行的翻译模型可能希望将其平均计算时间捆绑起来,以便具有电效。 在这项工作中,我们描述一个专家混合模型,并展示如何利用强化学习来改变每个投入的测试时间资源使用情况。我们用一个小型的基于MNIST的例子来测试我们的方法。

papers.title: What Will Happen Next? Forecasting Player Moves in Sports Videos
papers.authors: Panna Felsen, Pulkit Agrawal, Jitendra Malik
papers.abstract: A large number of very popular team sports involve the act of one team trying to score a goal against the other. During this game play, defending players constantly try to predict the next move of the attackers to prevent them from scoring, whereas attackers constantly try to predict the next move of the defenders in order to defy them and score. Such behavior is a prime example of the general human faculty to make predictions about the future and is an important facet of human intelligence. An algorithmic solution to learning a model of the external world from sensory inputs in order to make forecasts is an important unsolved problem. In this work we develop a generic framework for forecasting future events in team sports videos directly from visual inputs. We introduce water polo and basketball datasets towards this end and compare the predictions of the proposed methods against expert and non-expert humans.
papers.title_zh: 下一步会发生什么? 在体育视频中预测玩家移动
papers.abstract_zh: 许多非常受欢迎的团队体育运动涉及一个团队试图对另一个团队达到一个目标的行为。 在这场游戏中,捍卫者不断试图预测攻击者的下一步行动,以防止他们得分,而攻击者则不断试图预测捍卫者的下一步行动,以反抗他们并得分。 这种行为是一般人的能力对未来作出预测的典型例子,也是人类智慧的一个重要方面。 从感官投入中学习外部世界模型以作出预测的算法解决方案是一个尚未解决的重要问题。 在这项工作中,我们制定了一个通用框架,直接从视觉投入中通过团队体育录像预测未来活动,为此引入水球和篮球数据集,并将对拟议方法的预测与专家和非专家人类进行比较。

papers.title: Temporal Attention-Gated Model for Robust Sequence Classification
papers.authors: Wenjie Pei, Tadas Baltrusaitis, David M.J. Tax, Louis-Philippe Morency
papers.abstract: Typical techniques for sequence classification are designed for well-segmented sequences which have been edited to remove noisy or irrelevant parts. Therefore, such methods cannot be easily applied on noisy sequences expected in real-world applications. In this paper, we present the Temporal Attention-Gated Model (TAGM) which integrates ideas from attention models and gated recurrent networks to better deal with noisy or unsegmented sequences. Specifically, we extend the concept of attention model to measure the relevance of each observation (time step) of a sequence. We then use a novel gated recurrent network to learn the hidden representation for the final prediction. An important advantage of our approach is interpretability since the temporal attention weights provide a meaningful value for the salience of each time step in the sequence. We demonstrate the merits of our TAGM approach, both for prediction accuracy and interpretability, on three different tasks: spoken digit recognition, text-based sentiment analysis and visual event recognition.
papers.title_zh: 强力序列分类时间引时注意模型
papers.abstract_zh: 序列分类的典型技术是为经过编辑以去除噪音或无关部件的精密分层序列设计的,因此,在现实应用中,这种方法无法轻易地应用于预期的噪音序列。 在本文中,我们介绍了时间关注定位模型(TAGM ) , 该模型整合了关注模型和封闭的经常性网络的想法,以便更好地处理噪音或无分层序列。 具体而言,我们扩展了关注模型的概念,以衡量每个观察序列(时间步骤)的相关性。 然后,我们用一个新颖的封锁的经常性网络来学习最终预测的隐性表现。 我们方法的一个重要优点是可解释性,因为时间关注权重为每个时间步骤的突出程度提供了有意义的价值。 我们用三种不同的任务,即语音数字识别、基于文字的情绪分析和视觉事件识别,展示了我们的TAGM方法在预测准确性和可解释性方面的优点。

papers.title: SubUNets: End-To-End Hand Shape and Continuous Sign Language Recognition
papers.authors: Necati Cihan Camgoz, Simon Hadfield, Oscar Koller, Richard Bowden
papers.abstract: We propose a novel deep learning approach to solve simultaneous alignment and recognition problems (referred to as "Sequence-to-sequence" learning). We decompose the problem into a series of specialised expert systems referred to as SubUNets. The spatio-temporal relationships between these SubUNets are then modelled to solve the task, while remaining trainable end-to-end. The approach mimics human learning and educational techniques, and has a number of significant advantages. SubUNets allow us to inject domain-specific expert knowledge into the system regarding suitable intermediate representations. They also allow us to implicitly perform transfer learning between different interrelated tasks, which also allows us to exploit a wider range of more varied data sources. In our experiments we demonstrate that each of these properties serves to significantly improve the performance of the overarching recognition system, by better constraining the learning problem. The proposed techniques are demonstrated in the challenging domain of sign language recognition. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on hand-shape recognition outperforming previous techniques by more than 30%). Furthermore, we are able to obtain comparable sign recognition rates to previous research, without the need for an alignment step to segment out the signs for recognition.
papers.title_zh: 子UNets: 端到端手形状和持续手语识别
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的深层次的学习方法,以解决同时调整和承认问题(称为“顺序到顺序”的学习 ) 。 我们把这个问题分解成一系列专门专家系统,称为子联合国。 这些子联合国之间的时空关系随后被模拟来解决任务,同时保持可训练的端对端。 这种方法模仿人类学习和教育技术,并具有许多重大优势。 SubUNets使我们能够将特定领域的专家知识输入系统,涉及适当的中间代表,还使我们能够隐含地在不同相互关联的任务之间传授知识,这也使我们能够利用范围更广的、更多样化的数据来源。 在我们的实验中,我们证明其中的每一种特性都有助于通过更好地限制学习问题,大大改善总体承认体系的绩效。 所提出的技术表现在手语承认这一具有挑战性的领域中。 此外,我们可以获得与以往研究可比的标志识别率,而不必采取调整步骤来将识别信号分割开来。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Multiplier Networks for Video Action Recognition
papers.authors: Christoph Feichtenhofer, Axel Pinz, Richard P. Wildes
papers.abstract: This paper presents a general ConvNet architecture for video action recognition based on multiplicative interactions of spacetime features. Our model combines the appearance and motion pathways of a two-stream architecture by motion gating and is trained end-to-end. We theoretically motivate multiplicative gating functions for residual networks and empirically study their effect on classification accuracy. To capture long-term dependencies we inject identity mapping kernels for learning temporal relationships. Our architecture is fully convolutional in spacetime and able to evaluate a video in a single forward pass. Empirical investigation reveals that our model produces state-of-the-art results on two standard action recognition datasets.
papers.title_zh: 视频行动识别的 Spatotopotoral 视频行动识别多动器网络
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ConvNet基于空间特征的多倍互动的视频行动识别总体结构。 我们的模型通过运动滑动将双流结构的外观和运动路径结合起来,并经过培训的端到端。 我们从理论上激励留守网络的多倍化定位功能,从经验上研究其对分类准确性的影响。 为了捕捉长期依赖性,我们为学习时间关系输入身份测绘内核。 经验调查显示,我们的模型在两个标准行动识别数据集上产生了最新的结果。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Meets Visual Odometry
papers.authors: Nico Messikommer · Giovanni Cioffi · Mathias Gehrig · Davide Scaramuzza
papers.abstract: Visual Odometry (VO) is essential to downstream mobile robotics and augmented/virtual reality tasks. Despite recent advances, existing VO methods still rely on heuristic design choices that require several weeks of hyperparameter tuning by human experts, hindering generalizability and robustness. We address these challenges by reframing VO as a sequential decision-making task and applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to adapt the VO process dynamically. Our approach introduces a neural network, operating as an agent within the VO pipeline, to make decisions such as keyframe and grid-size selection based on real-time conditions. Our method minimizes reliance on heuristic choices using a reward function based on pose error, runtime, and other metrics to guide the system. Our RL framework treats the VO system and the image sequence as an environment, with the agent receiving observations from keypoints, map statistics, and prior poses. Experimental results using classical VO methods and public benchmarks demonstrate improvements in accuracy and robustness, validating the generalizability of our RL-enhanced VO approach to different scenarios. We believe this paradigm shift advances VO technology by eliminating the need for time-intensive parameter tuning of heuristics. We will release our code upon acceptance.
papers.title_zh: 强化学习 符合视觉测量
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉测量(VO)对于下游移动机器人和强化/虚拟现实任务至关重要。 尽管最近有所进步,但现有的VO方法仍然依赖于需要数周由人类专家进行超参数调试的超湿度设计选择,这阻碍了通用性和稳健性。 我们应对这些挑战的方式是,将VO重新组合为连续决策任务,并运用加强学习(RL)来积极调整VO进程。 我们的做法引入了神经网络,作为VO输油管内的代理商,根据实时条件做出关键框架和网格大小选择等决定。 我们的方法将使用基于错误、运行时间和其他指标的奖赏功能来引导系统,最大限度地减少对疲劳主义选择的依赖。 我们的RL框架将VO系统和图像序列视为一种环境,代理接受关键点、地图统计数据和先前配置的观察。 使用传统的VO方法和公共基准的实验结果表明,准确性和稳健性有所提高,证实了我们强化的RLV方法对不同情景的普遍适用性。 我们相信,这种范式的转变可以消除时间密集参数调整疲劳症的需要,从而推动VO技术的发展。 一旦被接受,我们将发布我们的代码。

papers.title: PVChat: Personalized Video Chat with One-Shot Learning
papers.authors: YUFEI SHI · Weilong Yan · Gang Xu · Yumeng Li · Yucheng Chen · ZhenXi Li · Fei Yu · Ming Li · Si Yong Yeo
papers.abstract: Video large language models (ViLLMs) excel in general video understanding, e.g., recognizing activities like talking and eating, but struggle with identity-aware comprehension, such as ''Wilson is receiving chemotherapy" or ''Tom is discussing with Sarah", limiting their applicability in smart healthcare and smart home environments. To address this limitation, we propose a one-shot learning framework PVChat, the first personalized ViLLM that enables subject-aware question answering (QA) from a single video for each subject. Our approach optimizes a Mixture-of-Heads (MoH) enhanced ViLLM on a synthetically augmented video-QA dataset, leveraging a progressive image-to-video learning strategy. Specifically, we introduce an automated augmentation pipeline that synthesizes identity-preserving positive samples and retrieves hard negatives from existing video corpora, generating a diverse training dataset with four QA types: existence, appearance, action, and location inquiries. To enhance subject-specific learning, we propose a ReLU Routing MoH attention mechanism, alongside two novel objectives: (1) Smooth Proximity Regularization for progressive learning through exponential distance scaling and (2) Head Activation Enhancement for balanced attention routing. Finally, we adopt a two-stage training strategy, transitioning from image pre-training to video fine-tuning, enabling a gradual learning process from static attributes to dynamic representations. We evaluate PVChat on diverse datasets covering medical scenarios, TV series, anime, and real-world footage, demonstrating its superiority in personalized feature understanding after learning from a single video, compared to state-of-the-art ViLLMs.
papers.title_zh: PVChat: 个人化视频聊天与单点学习
papers.abstract_zh: 视频大型语言模型(VELLMs)在一般视频理解方面非常出色,例如,承认诸如聊天和吃饭等活动,但与认同性理解斗争,如“Wilson正在接受化疗”或“Tom正在与Sarah讨论”,限制了其在智能保健和智能家庭环境中的适用性。 为解决这一限制,我们提议一个一次性学习框架PVChat,这是第一个个性化的VillM,使每个主题都能从单一的视频中回答主题问题(QA)。 我们的方法优化了混合头像(MoH)在合成增强的视频-QA数据集上强化的VillM,利用了逐步的图像到视频学习战略。 具体而言,我们引入了自动扩增管道,该管道综合了身份保存正面样本,并从现有视频公司中提取硬底片,生成了多种培训数据集,包含四种质量保证类型:存在、外观、行动和地点调查。 为加强具体专题的学习,我们提议设立一个RELU关注卫生部的机制,同时提出两个新的目标:(1) 平稳近距离固定化,以通过指数式远程缩放逐步学习;和(2) 提高主导活动能力,以平衡关注路线。 最后,我们采取了一个两阶段培训战略,从图像预培训向视频微调过渡,使从静态属性到动态体现的逐步学习过程得以进行。 我们评价PVChat对医疗情景、电视系列、动画片和真实世界的录像等不同数据集的评估,与最新的Villms相比,在从单一视频中学习后,显示其在个性化特征理解方面的优越性。

papers.title: Person Search With Natural Language Description
papers.authors: Shuang Li, Tong Xiao, Hongsheng Li, Bolei Zhou, Dayu Yue, Xiaogang Wang
papers.abstract: Searching persons in large-scale image databases with the query of natural language description has important applications in video surveillance. Existing methods mainly focused on searching persons with image-based or attribute-based queries, which have major limitations for a practical usage. In this paper, we study the problem of person search with natural language description. Given the textual description of a person, the algorithm of the person search is required to rank all the samples in the person database then retrieve the most relevant sample corresponding to the queried description. Since there is no person dataset or benchmark with textual description available, we collect a large-scale person description dataset with detailed natural language annotations and person samples from various sources, termed as CUHK Person Description Dataset (CUHK-PEDES). A wide range of possible models and baselines have been evaluated and compared on the person search benchmark. An Recurrent Neural Network with Gated Neural Attention mechanism (GNA-RNN) is proposed to establish the state-of-the art performance on person search.
papers.title_zh: 以自然语言搜索的人
papers.abstract_zh: 在大规模图像数据库中搜寻自然语言描述Query的人,在视频监视方面有重要应用,现有方法主要侧重于搜索有图像Query或属性Query的人,这些Query对实际使用有重大限制。 在本文中,我们用自然语言描述研究人员搜寻问题,根据一个人的文字描述,个人搜寻的算法要求将所有样本排在个人数据库中,然后取回与所询问的描述相对应的最相关的样本。 由于没有可用的个人数据集或有文字说明的基准,我们收集了大型个人描述数据集,其中包括详细的自然语言说明和各种来源的人样本,称为CUHK人称数据集(CUHK-PEDES)。 对各种可能的模型和基线进行了评估,并比较了人员搜索基准,提议设立一个带有GNA-RNN(GNA-RNN)机制的经常性神经网络,以建立最先进的人员搜索表现。

papers.title: Multigrid Neural Architectures
papers.authors: Tsung-Wei Ke, Michael Maire, Stella X. Yu
papers.abstract: We propose a multigrid extension of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Rather than manipulating representations living on a single spatial grid, our network layers operate across scale space, on a pyramid of grids. They consume multigrid inputs and produce multigrid outputs; convolutional filters themselves have both within-scale and cross-scale extent. This aspect is distinct from simple multiscale designs, which only process the input at different scales. Viewed in terms of information flow, a multigrid network passes messages across a spatial pyramid. As a consequence, receptive field size grows exponentially with depth, facilitating rapid integration of context. Most critically, multigrid structure enables networks to learn internal attention and dynamic routing mechanisms, and use them to accomplish tasks on which modern CNNs fail. Experiments demonstrate wide-ranging performance advantages of multigrid. On CIFAR and ImageNet classification tasks, flipping from a single grid to multigrid within the standard CNN paradigm improves accuracy, while being compute and parameter efficient. Multigrid is independent of other architectural choices; we show synergy in combination with residual connections. Multigrid yields dramatic improvement on a synthetic semantic segmentation dataset. Most strikingly, relatively shallow multigrid networks can learn to directly perform spatial transformation tasks, where, in contrast, current CNNs fail. Together, our results suggest that continuous evolution of features on a multigrid pyramid is a more powerful alternative to existing CNN designs on a flat grid.
papers.title_zh: 多种电磁神经结构
papers.abstract_zh: 我们建议多电网扩展进化神经网络(CNNs ) 。 我们的网络层不是在单一空间网格上操控代表,而是在一条网格金字塔上跨空间运行。 它们消耗多电网输入并产生多电网输出; 连动过滤器本身具有规模内和跨规模的范围。 这与简单的多尺度设计截然不同, 后者只处理不同规模的输入。 从信息流动的角度来看,一个多电网将信息传递到一个空间金字塔上,因此,可接受场面积随着深度而成倍增长,促进了环境的快速融合。 最重要的是,多电网结构使网络能够学习内部注意力和动态路由机制,并利用它们完成现代CNN失败的任务。 实验显示了多电网的广泛性能优势。 在CIFAR和图像网络分类任务方面,在标准CNN范式内从单一网格转向多网格可以提高准确性,同时进行计算和提高参数效率。 Multigrid独立于其他建筑选择;我们展示了协同效应,与剩余连接相结合。 在合成语义分离数据集上,多格丽德能够带来巨大的改善。 最引人注目的是,相对浅的多格丽德网络可以直接学习执行空间转换任务,而与此形成对照的是,当前的有线电视新闻网却失败了。 我们的结果表明,多电网金字塔上的特征的不断演变是比现有CNN在平板网上的设计更强有力的替代方法。

papers.title: MoFA: Model-Based Deep Convolutional Face Autoencoder for Unsupervised Monocular Reconstruction
papers.authors: Ayush Tewari, Michael Zollhofer, Hyeongwoo Kim, Pablo Garrido, Florian Bernard, Patrick Perez, Christian Theobalt
papers.abstract: In this work we propose a novel model-based deep convolutional autoencoder that addresses the highly challenging problem of reconstructing a 3D human face from a single in-the-wild color image. To this end, we combine a convolutional encoder network with an expert-designed generative model that serves as decoder. The core innovation is the differentiable parametric decoder that encapsulates image formation analytically based on a generative model. Our decoder takes as input a code vector with exactly defined semantic meaning that encodes detailed face pose, shape, expression, skin reflectance and scene illumination. Due to this new way of combining CNN-based with model-based face reconstruction, the CNN-based encoder learns to extract semantically meaningful parameters from a single monocular input image. For the first time, a CNN encoder and an expert-designed generative model can be trained end-to-end in an unsupervised manner, which renders training on very large (unlabeled) real world data feasible. The obtained reconstructions compare favorably to current state-of-the-art approaches in terms of quality and richness of representation.
papers.title_zh: 外务省:无监督的单体重建示范深层革命面体自动编码器
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个新的基于模型的深层进化自动编码模型,该模型将解决从单一的电动彩色图像中重建3D人脸这一极具挑战性的问题。 为此,我们将一个进化编码器网络与专家设计的基因模型结合起来,作为解码器。 核心创新是不同参数解码器,该解码器根据基因模型对图像的形成进行分析,包罗不同参数解码器。 我们的解码器将精确定义的语义含义为详细面容、形状、表达、皮肤反射和场景照明编码的代码矢量作为输入。 由于这种以CNN为基础的新方式与以模型为基础的面部重建相结合,以CNN为基础的编码器学会从单一的单眼输入图像中提取具有词义意义的参数。 有线电视新闻网编码器和专家设计的基因模型首次可以在无人监督的情况下接受端对端培训,从而使关于非常大(未贴标签的)真实世界数据的培训成为可行。 从代表性的质量和丰富性方面来说,获得的重建与目前最先进的方法相比是有利的。

papers.title: LSTM Self-Supervision for Detailed Behavior Analysis
papers.authors: Biagio Brattoli, Uta Buchler, Anna-Sophia Wahl, Martin E. Schwab, Bjorn Ommer
papers.abstract: Behavior analysis provides a crucial non-invasive and easily accessible diagnostic tool for biomedical research. A detailed analysis of posture changes during skilled motor tasks can reveal distinct functional deficits and their restoration during recovery. Our specific scenario is based on a neuroscientific study of rodents recovering from a large sensorimotor cortex stroke and skilled forelimb grasping is being recorded. Given large amounts of unlabeled videos that are recorded during such long-term studies, we seek an approach that captures fine-grained details of posture and its change during rehabilitation without costly manual supervision. Therefore, we utilize self-supervision to automatically learn accurate posture and behavior representations for analyzing motor function. Learning our model depends on the following fundamental elements: (i) limb detection based on a fully convolutional network is ini- tialized solely using motion information, (ii) a novel self- supervised training of LSTMs using only temporal permu- tation yields a detailed representation of behavior, and (iii) back-propagation of this sequence representation also im- proves the description of individual postures. We establish a novel test dataset with expert annotations for evaluation of fine-grained behavior analysis. Moreover, we demonstrate the generality of our approach by successfully applying it to self-supervised learning of human posture on two standard benchmark datasets.
papers.title_zh: LSTM 详细行为分析自译自审
papers.abstract_zh: 行为分析为生物医学研究提供了关键的非侵入性和容易获取的诊断工具,对熟练机动任务期间的态势变化进行详细分析,可以发现明显的功能缺陷,并在恢复期间加以恢复。 我们的具体设想是,正在记录对从大型感官穆托氏皮层中风中恢复过来的和熟练的前天捕捉动物进行神经科学研究的结果。 鉴于在这种长期研究期间录制了大量未贴标签的录像,我们寻求一种办法,在恢复期间,在没有昂贵的人工监督的情况下,捕捉关于姿态及其变化的精细细节。 因此,我们利用自我监督来自动学习准确的姿态和行为表现来分析运动功能。 学习我们的模型取决于以下基本要素:(一) 完全进化网络基础上的四肢检测完全使用运动信息进行分解;(二) 仅使用时间跨度对LSTMs进行新的自我监督培训,仅使用时间跨度进行详细的行为表现;以及(三) 这种序列表现的反向调整也初步证明了个人姿态的描述。 我们建立了一个具有专家说明的新测试数据集,用于评估细微行为分析。 此外,我们还成功地将它应用于在两个标准基准数据集上自我监督的人类态势学习,从而证明了我们方法的普遍性。

papers.title: Locality-Sensitive Deconvolution Networks With Gated Fusion for RGB-D Indoor Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Yanhua Cheng, Rui Cai, Zhiwei Li, Xin Zhao, Kaiqi Huang
papers.abstract: This paper focuses on indoor semantic segmentation using RGB-D data. Although the commonly used deconvolution networks (DeconvNet) have achieved impressive results on this task, we find there is still room for improvements in two aspects. One is about the boundary segmentation. DeconvNet aggregates large context to predict the label of each pixel, inherently limiting the segmentation precision of object boundaries. The other is about RGB-D fusion. Recent state-of-the-art methods generally fuse RGB and depth networks with equal-weight score fusion, regardless of the varying contributions of the two modalities on delineating different categories in different scenes. To address the two problems, we first propose a locality-sensitive DeconvNet (LS-DeconvNet) to refine the boundary segmentation over each modality. LS-DeconvNet incorporates locally visual and geometric cues from the raw RGB-D data into each DeconvNet, which is able to learn to upsample the coarse convolutional maps with large context whilst recovering sharp object boundaries. Towards RGB-D fusion, we introduce a gated fusion layer to effectively combine the two LS-DeconvNets. This layer can learn to adjust the contributions of RGB and depth over each pixel for high-performance object recognition. Experiments on the large-scale SUN RGB-D dataset and the popular NYU-Depth v2 dataset show that our approach achieves new state-of-the-art results for RGB-D indoor semantic segmentation.
papers.title_zh: RGB-D 室内语义分解带G化融合的局部敏感分解进化网络
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然常用的分解网络(DeconvNet)在这项任务上取得了令人印象深刻的成果,但我们发现在两个方面仍有改进的余地,其中之一是边界分割。 DeconvNet 集成大环境来预测每个像素的标签,这必然限制物体边界的分解精度。 另一个是关于RGB-D聚变。 最近的先进方法通常将RGB和深度网络结合成同等重量分分的混合体,而不论这两种模式在不同场景划分不同类别的方式有何不同贡献。 为了解决这两个问题,我们首先提议建立一个对地点敏感的DeconvNet(LS-DeconvNet),以完善每种模式的边界分隔。 LS-DeconvNet将原始 RGB-D 数据中的本地视觉和几何线索纳入每个DeconvNet, 后者能够在恢复尖锐天体边界的同时, 学会用大背景对粗革命图进行上传。 在RGB-D核聚变方面,我们引入了一个封闭的聚变层,将两个 LS-DeconvNets 有效结合。 这个层可以学会调整RGB的贡献和每个像素的深度, 以便高性能对象识别 。 在大规模SUN RGB-D数据集和流行的NYU-Depth v2数据集方面的实验表明,我们的方法为RGB-D室内语义分离取得了新的最新结果。

papers.title: Learning to Reason: End-To-End Module Networks for Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Ronghang Hu, Jacob Andreas, Marcus Rohrbach, Trevor Darrell, Kate Saenko
papers.abstract: Natural language questions are inherently compositional, and many are most easily answered by reasoning about their decomposition into modular sub-problems. For example, to answer "is there an equal number of balls and boxes?" we can look for balls, look for boxes, count them, and compare the results. The recently proposed Neural Module Network (NMN) architecture implements this approach to question answering by parsing questions into linguistic substructures and assembling question-specific deep networks from smaller modules that each solve one subtask. However, existing NMN implementations rely on brittle off-the-shelf parsers, and are restricted to the module configurations proposed by these parsers rather than learning them from data. In this paper, we propose End-to-End Module Networks (N2NMNs), which learn to reason by directly predicting instance-specific network layouts without the aid of a parser. Our model learns to generate network structures (by imitating expert demonstrations) while simultaneously learning network parameters (using the downstream task loss). Experimental results on the new CLEVR dataset targeted at compositional question answering show that N2NMNs achieve an error reduction of nearly 50% relative to state-of-the-art attentional approaches, while discovering interpretable network architectures specialized for each question.
papers.title_zh: 学习到原因:视觉问答的终端到终端模块网络
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言问题本质上是构成性的,许多自然语言问题最容易通过将其分解成模块子问题的推理来解答。 比如,答案是“是否有相同数量的球和盒子? ”我们可以寻找球、寻找盒子、计数和比较结果。 最近提议的神经模块网络架构(NMN)采用这种回答问题的方法,将问题分解成语言分结构,将每个小模块解决一个子任务的问题的深层网络集合在一起。 然而,现有的NMN实施依靠易碎的现成分析器,仅限于这些分析器提议的模块配置,而不是从数据中学习。 在本文中,我们提议建立端对端模块网络(N2NMNNs),通过直接预测具体实例的网络布局来学习理性,而无需专家协助。 我们的模式学会产生网络结构(模仿专家示范),同时学习网络参数(使用下游任务损失)。 新的CLEVR数据集的实验结果是,针对组成问题回答的新的CLEVR数据集显示,N2NMNNN在发现每个问题专用的可解释网络结构的同时,与最先进的关注方法相比,差差幅减少了近50%。

papers.title: Learning Long-Term Dependencies for Action Recognition With a Biologically-Inspired Deep Network
papers.authors: Yemin Shi, Yonghong Tian, Yaowei Wang, Wei Zeng, Tiejun Huang
papers.abstract: Despite a lot of research efforts devoted in recent years, how to efficiently learn long-term dependencies from sequences still remains a pretty challenging task. As one of the key models for sequence learning, recurrent neural network (RNN) and its variants such as long short term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) are still not powerful enough in practice. One possible reason is that they have only feedforward connections, which is different from the biological neural system that is typically composed of both feedforward and feedback connections. To address this problem, this paper proposes a biologically-inspired deep network, called shuttleNet. Technologically, the shuttleNet consists of several processors, each of which is a GRU while associated with multiple groups of hidden states. Unlike traditional RNNs, all processors inside shuttleNet are loop connected to mimic the brain's feedforward and feedback connections, in which they are shared across multiple pathways in the loop connection. Attention mechanism is then employed to select the best information flow pathway. Extensive experiments conducted on two benchmark datasets (i.e UCF101 and HMDB51) show that we can beat state-of-the-art methods by simply embedding shuttleNet into a CNN-RNN framework.
papers.title_zh: 学习长期依赖以生物激发的深层网络采取行动承认
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管近年来进行了大量研究努力,但如何有效地从序列中了解长期依赖性仍然是一项相当艰巨的任务。 作为序列学习的关键模式之一,经常性神经网络及其变体,如长期短期内存和封闭式经常性单元,在实践中仍然不够强大。 其中一个可能的原因是它们只有进化前连接,这与生物神经系统不同,生物神经系统通常由进化前连接和反馈连接组成。 为解决这一问题,本文建议建立一个由生物启发的深层网络,即穿梭网。 从技术上讲,穿梭网由几台处理器组成,每台处理器都是GRU,但与多组隐蔽国家有关联。 与传统的 RNN 不同,穿梭网内的所有处理器都通过循环连接来模仿大脑的进料和反馈连接,在循环连接中,它们通过多个路径共享。然后使用注意机制来选择最佳的信息流路径。 对两个基准数据集(即UCF101和HMDB51)进行的广泛实验表明,我们可以简单地将穿梭网嵌入CNN-RNN框架,从而战胜最先进的方法。

papers.title: Higher-Order Integration of Hierarchical Convolutional Activations for Fine-Grained Visual Categorization
papers.authors: Sijia Cai, Wangmeng Zuo, Lei Zhang
papers.abstract: The success of fine-grained visual categorization (FGVC) extremely relies on the modeling of appearance and interactions of various semantic parts. This makes FGVC very challenging because: (i) part annotation and detection require expert guidance and are very expensive; (ii) parts are of different sizes; and (iii) the part interactions are complex and of higher-order. To address these issues, we propose an end-to-end framework based on higher-order integration of hierarchical convolutional activations for FGVC. By treating the convolutional activations as local descriptors, hierarchical convolutional activations can serve as a representation of local parts from different scales. A polynomial kernel based predictor is proposed to capture higher-order statistics of convolutional activations for modeling part interaction. To model inter-layer part interactions, we extend polynomial predictor to integrate hierarchical activations via kernel fusion. Our work also provides a new perspective for combining convolutional activations from multiple layers. While hypercolumns simply concatenate maps from different layers, and holistically-nested network uses weighted fusion to combine side-outputs, our approach exploits higher-order intra-layer and inter-layer relations for better integration of hierarchical convolutional features. The proposed framework yields more discriminative representation and achieves competitive results on the widely used FGVC datasets.
papers.title_zh: 高端整合精细视力分类的等级级革命活动
papers.abstract_zh: 精细的视觉分类(FGVC)的成功极其依赖于对各种语义部分的外观和相互作用进行建模。 这使得FGVC非常具有挑战性,因为:(一) 部分注解和检测需要专家指导,而且费用非常昂贵;(二) 部分大小不同;(三) 部分互动复杂,级别较高。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议一个端对端框架,其基础是将FGVC的级级变动激活进行更上级整合。 通过将变动激活作为地方描述器处理,级变动激活可以代表不同规模的地方部分。 提议建立一个基于多层内核的预测器,以获取用于模拟部分互动的进化激活的较高级统计数据。 为了模拟两层间互动,我们扩展了多层内核预测器,以通过内核聚变整合等级激活。 我们的工作也为将多层次的连动活动结合起来提供了新的视角。 超大学只是将不同层次的地图汇集在一起,而整体上被遗忘的网络则利用加权聚合将副产出结合起来,而我们的方法则利用较高层次的层次内和层次间关系,更好地整合等级级的演变特征。 拟议的框架具有更具有歧视性的代表性,并在广泛使用的FGVC数据集上取得竞争结果。

papers.title: Gaze Embeddings for Zero-Shot Image Classification
papers.authors: Nour Karessli, Zeynep Akata, Bernt Schiele, Andreas Bulling
papers.abstract: Zero-shot image classification using auxiliary information, such as attributes describing discriminative object properties, requires time-consuming annotation by domain experts. We instead propose a method that relies on human gaze as auxiliary information, exploiting that even non-expert users have a natural ability to judge class membership. We present a data collection paradigm that involves a discrimination task to increase the information content obtained from gaze data. Our method extracts discriminative descriptors from the data and learns a compatibility function between image and gaze using three novel gaze embeddings: Gaze Histograms (GH), Gaze Features with Grid (GFG) and Gaze Features with Sequence (GFS). We introduce two new gaze-annotated datasets for fine-grained image classification and show that human gaze data is indeed class discriminative, provides a competitive alternative to expert-annotated attributes, and outperforms other baselines for zero-shot image classification.
papers.title_zh: 零热图像分类加热嵌入器
papers.abstract_zh: 使用辅助信息,如描述歧视物体特性的属性等零光图像分类,需要域专家作费时的注解。 相反,我们提出了一种依靠人类视线作为辅助信息的方法,利用甚至非专家用户也自然有能力判断阶级成员资格。 我们提出了一个数据收集模式,其中涉及一项歧视任务,以增加从凝视数据中获得的信息内容。 我们的方法从数据中提取歧视性描述符,并用三种新颖的凝视嵌入器(GH)、GEG(GFG)、GEG(GFG)和GAZE(GFS)来学习图像与凝视的兼容功能。 我们为细微图像分类引入了两套新的目视附加说明数据集,并表明人类视觉数据确实具有等级歧视性,为专家附加说明属性提供了有竞争力的替代物,并且超过了零光图像分类的其他基线。

papers.title: Gated Feedback Refinement Network for Dense Image Labeling
papers.authors: Md Amirul Islam, Mrigank Rochan, Neil D. B. Bruce, Yang Wang
papers.abstract: Effective integration of local and global contextual information is crucial for dense labeling problems. Most existing methods based on an encoder-decoder architecture simply concatenate features from earlier layers to obtain higher-frequency details in the refinement stages. However, there are limits to the quality of refinement possible if ambiguous information is passed forward. In this paper we propose Gated Feedback Refinement Network (G-FRNet), an end-to-end deep learning framework for dense labeling tasks that addresses this limitation of existing methods. Initially, G-FRNet makes a coarse prediction and then it progressively refines the details by efficiently integrating local and global contextual information during the refinement stages. We introduce gate units that control the information passed forward in order to filter out ambiguity. Experiments on three challenging dense labeling datasets (CamVid, PASCAL VOC 2012, and Horse-Cow Parsing) show the effectiveness of our method. Our proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art results on the CamVid and Horse-Cow Parsing datasets, and produces competitive results on the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset.
papers.title_zh: Gated 反馈图像标签标签改进网络
papers.abstract_zh: 当地和全球背景信息的有效整合对于贴标签的密集问题至关重要。 大多数基于编码器解码器结构的现有方法只是将前几层的特征融合在一起,以便在完善阶段获得高频细节。 然而,如果传递含糊不清的信息,改进的质量就会受到限制,在本文中,我们提议Gated反馈改进网络(G-FRNet),这是一个针对现有方法这一局限性的密集标签任务的端对端深层次学习框架。 最初,G-FRNet做了粗略的预测,然后通过在完善阶段有效整合当地和全球背景信息,逐步完善细节。 我们引入了控制传递信息的大门单位,以排除模糊性。 在三个具有挑战性的密集标签数据集(CamVid、PASCAL VOC 2012和马牛剖析)上进行的实验显示了我们的方法的有效性。 我们提出的方法在CamVid和马牛剖析数据集上取得了最新结果,并在PASCAL VOC 2012数据集上产生了竞争性结果。

papers.title: Expert Gate: Lifelong Learning With a Network of Experts
papers.authors: Rahaf Aljundi, Punarjay Chakravarty, Tinne Tuytelaars
papers.abstract: In this paper we introduce a model of lifelong learning, based on a Network of Experts. New tasks / experts are learned and added to the model sequentially, building on what was learned before. To ensure scalability of this process, data from previous tasks cannot be stored and hence is not available when learning a new task. A critical issue in such context, not addressed in the literature so far, relates to the decision which expert to deploy at test time. We introduce a set of gating autoencoders that learn a representation for the task at hand, and, at test time, automatically forward the test sample to the relevant expert. This also brings memory efficiency as only one expert network has to be loaded into memory at any given time. Further, the autoencoders inherently capture the relatedness of one task to another, based on which the most relevant prior model to be used for training a new expert, with fine-tuning or learning-without-forgetting, can be selected. We evaluate our method on image classification and video prediction problems.
papers.title_zh: 专家门:与专家网络终身学习
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们以专家网络为基础,引入了终身学习模式,学习新的任务/专家,并依次加入到这一模式中,以以前学到的东西为基础。 为确保这一进程的可扩展性,以前任务的数据无法储存,因此在学习新任务时无法提供,在这种背景下的一个关键问题(迄今为止在文献中尚未涉及)涉及专家在测试时部署的决定。 我们引入一套带格的自动编码器,用于学习手头任务的表示式,并在测试时自动将测试样本转发给相关专家。这也带来了记忆效率,因为任何特定时间都只需将一个专家网络装入内存。 此外,自动编码器本身就反映了一项任务与另一项任务的相关性,在此基础上,可以选择以前用于培训新专家的最相关模型,进行微调或不忘学习。我们评估了我们关于图像分类和视频预测问题的方法。

papers.title: Detecting Faces Using Inside Cascaded Contextual CNN
papers.authors: Kaipeng Zhang, Zhanpeng Zhang, Hao Wang, Zhifeng Li, Yu Qiao, Wei Liu
papers.abstract: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) achieve substantial improvements in face detection in the wild. Classical CNN-based face detection methods simply stack successive layers of filters where an input sample should pass through all layers before reaching a face/non-face decision. Inspired by the fact that for face detection, filters in deeper layers can discriminate between difficult face/non-face samples while those in shallower layers can efficiently reject simple non-face samples, we propose Inside Cascaded Structure that introduces face/non-face classifiers at different layers within the same CNN. In the training phase, we propose data routing mechanism which enables different layers to be trained by different types of samples, and thus deeper layers can focus on handling more difficult samples compared with traditional architecture. In addition, we introduce a two-stream contextual CNN architecture that leverages body part information adaptively to enhance face detection. Extensive experiments on the challenging FDDB and WIDER FACE benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive accuracy to the state-of-the-art techniques while keeps real time performance.
papers.title_zh: 利用内部连锁背景有线电视新闻网检测面孔
papers.abstract_zh: 深革命神经网络(CED Convolutional Neural Networks)在野外的面部检测方面取得了重大进步。 经典CNN脸部检测方法只是堆叠连续一层的过滤器,输入样本应该通过所有层,然后才能做出面部/非面部决定。 更深层的过滤器可以区分困难的面部/非面部样本, 而浅层的过滤器可以有效地拒绝简单的非面部样本, 在培训阶段,我们提议建立数据路径机制,使不同层次能够接受不同类型样品的培训,因此,更深层次可以侧重于处理比传统结构更困难的样品。 此外,我们引入了一个双流的有线电视新闻网背景架构,利用身体部分的适应性信息,加强面部检测。 关于具有挑战性的捍卫布隆迪民主力量和WIDER FACE基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法在保持实时性能的同时,实现了最先进技术的竞争准确性。

papers.title: Automatic Discovery, Association Estimation and Learning of Semantic Attributes for a Thousand Categories
papers.authors: Ziad Al-Halah, Rainer Stiefelhagen
papers.abstract: Attribute-based recognition models, due to their impressive performance and their ability to generalize well on novel categories, have been widely adopted for many computer vision applications. However, usually both the attribute vocabulary and the class-attribute associations have to be provided manually by domain experts or large number of annotators. This is very costly and not necessarily optimal regarding recognition performance, and most importantly, it limits the applicability of attribute-based models to large scale data sets. To tackle this problem, we propose an end-to-end unsupervised attribute learning approach. We utilize online text corpora to automatically discover a salient and discriminative vocabulary that correlates well with the human concept of semantic attributes. Moreover, we propose a deep convolutional model to optimize class-attribute associations with a linguistic prior that accounts for noise and missing data in text. In a thorough evaluation on ImageNet, we demonstrate that our model is able to efficiently discover and learn semantic attributes at a large scale. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art in zero-shot learning on three data sets: ImageNet, Animals with Attributes and aPascal/aYahoo. Finally, we enable attribute-based learning on ImageNet and will share the attributes and associations for future research.
papers.title_zh: 千类语义属性自动发现、协会估计和学习协会
papers.abstract_zh: 以属性为基础的识别模型,由于其令人印象深刻的性能和对新型类别进行广泛推广的能力,已被广泛用于许多计算机视觉应用。 然而,通常,属性词汇和分类归属协会都必须由域名专家或大量注解员手动提供。 这是非常昂贵的,在确认业绩方面不一定是最佳的,而且最重要的是,它限制了基于属性的模式对大规模数据集的适用性。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用最终到最终不受监督的属性学习方法。 我们利用在线文本公司自动发现一个与语义属性的人类概念密切相关的突出和歧视性词汇。 此外,我们提出一个深刻的进化模式,优化具有语言前科的分类属性协会,在文字中说明噪音和缺失的数据。 在对图像网络的彻底评估中,我们证明我们的模型能够大规模有效地发现和学习语义属性。 此外,我们证明我们的模型在三个数据集(图象网、有属性的动物和aPascal/aYahoo)的零速学习方面优于最新水平。 最后,我们在图象网上进行基于属性的学习,并将分享未来研究的属性和协会。

papers.title: Attribute-Enhanced Face Recognition With Neural Tensor Fusion Networks
papers.authors: Guosheng Hu, Yang Hua, Yang Yuan, Zhihong Zhang, Zheng Lu, Sankha S. Mukherjee, Timothy M. Hospedales, Neil M. Robertson, Yongxin Yang
papers.abstract: Deep learning has achieved great success in face recognition, however deep-learned features still have limited invariance to strong intra-personal variations such as large pose. It is observed that some facial attributes (e.g. eyebrow thickness, gender) are invariant to such variations. We present the first work to systematically explore how the fusion of face recognition feature (FRF) and facial attribute feature (FAF) can enhance face recognition performance in various challenging scenarios. Despite this helpfulness of FAF, in practice, we find the existing fusion methods cannot reliably improve the recognition performance. Thus, we develop a powerful tensor-based framework which formulates this fusion as a low-rank tensor optimisation problem. It is non-trivial to directly optimise this tensor due to the large number of parameters to optimise. To solve this problem, we establish a theoretical equivalence between tensor optimisation and a two-stream gated neural network. This equivalence allows tractable computation and the use of standard neural network optimisation tools, leading to an accurate and stable optimisation. Experimental results show the fused feature works better than individual features thus proving for the first time that facial attributes aid face recognition. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on databases such as MultiPIE, CASIA NIR-VIR2.0 and LFW.
papers.title_zh: 具有神经质变融合网络的增强属性的面部识别
papers.abstract_zh: 深层学习在面部识别方面取得了巨大成功,然而,深层的学习特征对于个人内部的巨大差异,例如巨大的姿势,仍然差异有限,据观察,有些面部特征(如眉毛厚度、性别)与这种差异不相容。 我们首次开展工作,系统地探讨面部识别特征(FRF)和面部属性特征(FAF)的融合如何在各种具有挑战性的情景中提高面部识别绩效。 尽管FAF有这种帮助,但在实践中,我们发现现有的聚变方法无法可靠地改善识别性能。 因此,我们制定了一个强大的以抗拉为基础的框架,将这种聚变发展成一个低级的拉动优化问题。 由于需要优化的参数数量众多,直接优化这一压力是非三维的。 为了解决这一问题,我们建立了高压优化和双流门门式神经网络之间的理论等同。 这种等同使得能够进行可移植的计算和使用标准神经网络优化工具,从而实现准确和稳定的优化。 实验结果表明,引信功能比个体功能效果更好,从而首次证明面部属性有助于识别面部属性。 我们在多指标类集调查、CASIA NIR-VIR2.0和LFW等数据库上取得SOTA 性能。

papers.title: Am I a Baller? Basketball Performance Assessment From First-Person Videos
papers.authors: Gedas Bertasius, Hyun Soo Park, Stella X. Yu, Jianbo Shi
papers.abstract: This paper presents a method to assess a basketball player's performance from his/her first-person video. A key challenge lies in the fact that the evaluation metric is highly subjective and specific to a particular evaluator. We leverage the first-person camera to address this challenge. The spatiotemporal visual semantics provided by a first-person view allows us to reason about the camera wearer's actions while he/she is participating in an unscripted basketball game. Our method takes a player's first-person video and provides a player's performance measure that is specific to an evaluator's preference. To achieve this goal, we first use a convolutional LSTM network to detect atomic basketball events from first-person videos. Our network's ability to zoom-in to the salient regions addresses the issue of a severe camera wearer's head movement in first-person videos. The detected atomic events are then passed through the Gaussian mixtures to construct a highly non-linear visual spatiotemporal basketball assessment feature. Finally, we use this feature to learn a basketball assessment model from pairs of labeled first-person basketball videos, for which a basketball expert indicates, which of the two players is better. We demonstrate that despite not knowing the basketball evaluator's criterion, our model learns to accurately assess the players in real-world games. Furthermore, our model can also discover basketball events that contribute positively and negatively to a player's performance.
papers.title_zh: 我是球员吗 从第一人录影带看篮球的成绩评估
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了从第一人视频中评估篮球运动员表现的一种方法,一个关键的挑战在于评价指标高度主观,而且针对某个评价员。 我们利用第一人相机来应对这一挑战。 由第一人称视图提供的时空视觉语义, 使我们得以解释摄影机磨损者的行为, 而他(她)正在参加一场无标注的篮球比赛。 我们的方法是使用玩家第一人视频, 提供播放员的性能衡量标准, 具体针对评价员的偏好。 为了实现这一目标, 我们首先使用一个革命性 LSTM 网络, 从第一人视频中检测原子篮球事件 。 我们的网络将放大到突出区域的能力,解决了重相机穿戴者头部在第一人称视频中移动的问题。 检测到的原子事件随后通过高山混合物传递,以构建一个高度非线性视觉时空篮球评估功能。 最后,我们利用这个功能,从一对贴有名牌的第一人篮球录像中学习篮球评估模型,一位篮球专家指出,这两个球员中的哪一个更好。 我们证明,尽管我们不知道篮球评估员的标准,但我们的模型学会了准确评估现实世界游戏中的玩家。 此外,我们的模型还可以发现篮球赛事件对玩家的表现有积极和消极的贡献。

papers.title: Adaptive Relaxed ADMM: Convergence Theory and Practical Implementation
papers.authors: Zheng Xu, Mario A. T. Figueiredo, Xiaoming Yuan, Christoph Studer, Tom Goldstein
papers.abstract: Many modern computer vision and machine learning applications rely on solving difficult optimization problems that involve non-differentiable objective functions and constraints. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used approach to solve such problems. Relaxed ADMM is a generalization of ADMM that often achieves better performance, but its efficiency depends strongly on algorithm parameters that must be chosen by an expert user. We propose an adaptive method that automatically tunes the key algorithm parameters to achieve optimal performance without user oversight. Inspired by recent work on adaptivity, the proposed adaptive relaxed ADMM (ARADMM) is derived by assuming a Barzilai-Borwein style linear gradient. A detailed convergence analysis of ARADMM is provided, and numerical results on several applications demonstrate fast practical convergence.
papers.title_zh: ADMMD:融合理论和实际实施
papers.abstract_zh: 许多现代计算机视觉和机器学习应用依靠解决困难的优化问题,这些问题涉及不可区分的客观功能和限制,乘数交替方向法(ADMM)是解决这类问题的一种广泛使用的方法。 放松的ADMM(ADMM)是ADMM(ADM)的概括,通常能取得更好的业绩,但其效率在很大程度上取决于专家用户必须选择的算法参数。 我们建议了一种自动调整关键算法参数的适应方法,以便在没有用户监督的情况下实现最佳性能。 在适应性方面最近开展的工作的启发下,拟议的适应性放松的ADMM(ARAMM)是假设巴兹赖-博温风格线性梯度,对ARADMM进行了详细的趋同分析,若干应用的数值结果显示出快速的实际趋同。

papers.title: A Practical Method for Fully Automatic Intrinsic Camera Calibration Using Directionally Encoded Light
papers.authors: Mahdi Abbaspour Tehrani, Thabo Beeler, Anselm Grundhofer
papers.abstract: Calibrating the intrinsic properties of a camera is one of the fundamental tasks required for a variety of computer vision and image processing tasks. The precise measurement of focal length, location of the principal point as well as distortion parameters of the lens is crucial, for example, for 3D reconstruction. Although a variety of methods exist to achieve this goal, they are often cumbersome to carry out, require substantial manual interaction, expert knowledge, and a significant operating volume. We propose a novel calibration method based on the usage of directionally encoded light rays for estimating the intrinsic parameters. It enables a fully automatic calibration with a small device mounted close to the front lens element and still enables an accuracy comparable to standard methods even when the lens is focused up to infinity. Our method overcomes the mentioned limitations since it guarantees an accurate calibration without any human intervention while requiring only a limited amount of space. Besides that, the approach also allows to estimate the distance of the focal plane as well as the size of the aperture. We demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method by evaluating several camera/lens configurations using prototypical devices.
papers.title_zh: 使用直接编码光光进行全自动内晶照相机校准的实用方法
papers.abstract_zh: 校准相机的内在特性是各种计算机视觉和图像处理任务的基本任务之一,精确测量焦距、主点的位置以及镜头的失真参数对于3D重建等至关重要。 尽管为实现这一目标存在各种方法,但往往难以执行,需要大量手工互动、专门知识和大量业务量。 我们提议一种新的校准方法 以使用定向编码的光线 来估计内在参数 它能够完全自动校准一个安装在前镜元素附近的小型装置,并且仍然能够精确到与标准方法相当的精确度,即使镜头聚焦到无限。 我们的方法克服了上述限制,因为它保证了精确校准,而没有人为的干预,而只需要有限的空间。 此外,这种方法还允许估计焦平面的距离和孔径的大小。 我们通过使用原型装置评价若干摄像/镜头配置,展示了拟议方法的优点。

papers.title: Video representation and coding using a sparse steered mixture-of-experts network
papers.authors: Lieven Lange, Ruben Verhack, Thomas Sikora
papers.abstract: In this paper, we introduce a novel approach for video compression that explores spatial as well as temporal redundancies over sequences of many frames in a unified framework. Our approach supports “compressed domain vision” capabilities. To this end, we developed a sparse Steered Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) regression network for coding video in the pixel domain. This approach drastically departs from the established DPCM/Transform coding philosophy. Each kernel in the Mixture-of-Experts network steers along the direction of highest correlation, both in spatial and temporal domain, with local and global support. Our coding and modeling philosophy is embedded in a Bayesian framework and shows strong resemblance to Mixture-of-Experts neural networks. Initial experiments show that at very low bit rates the SMoE approach can provide competitive performance to H.264.
papers.title_zh: 使用分散的专家混合网络的录像介绍和编码
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们引入了一种新的视频压缩方法,在统一框架内探索许多框架序列的空间和时间冗余。 我们的方法支持“压缩的域观”能力。 为此,我们开发了一个稀有的Steered Mixture- of-experts(SMoE)回归网络,用于像素域的编码视频。 这种方法与既定的DPCM/ Transform 编码理念大相径庭。 专家混合网络的每个核心都在当地和全球的支持下,沿着空间和时空领域最高相关性的方向前进。 我们的编码和建模哲学嵌入了贝叶斯框架,与专家混合神经网络非常相似。 初步实验表明,以非常低的比特率,SMoE方法可以为H264提供有竞争力的业绩。

papers.title: A multimodal mixture-of-experts model for dynamic emotion prediction in movies
papers.authors: Ankit Goyal, Naveen Kumar, Tanaya Guha, Shrikanth Narayanan
papers.abstract: This paper addresses the problem of continuous emotion prediction in movies from multimodal cues. The rich emotion content in movies is inherently multimodal, where emotion is evoked through both audio (music, speech) and video modalities. To capture such affective information, we put forth a set of audio and video features that includes several novel features such as, Video Compressibility and Histogram of Facial Area (HFA). We propose a Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based fusion model that dynamically combines information from the audio and video modalities for predicting the emotion evoked in movies. A learning module, based on hard Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, is presented for the MoE model. Experiments on a database of popular movies demonstrate that our MoE-based fusion method outperforms popular fusion strategies (e.g. early and late fusion) in the context of dynamic emotion prediction.
papers.title_zh: 电影中动态情感预测多式专家混合模型
papers.abstract_zh: 本文讨论的是从多式提示中不断从电影中预测情感的问题。 电影中丰富的情感内容本质上是多式的,通过音频(音乐、演讲)和视频方式唤起情感。 为了捕捉这种感官信息,我们提出了一套音频和视频特征,其中包括若干新的特征,如视频压缩和法西地区直线图(HFA)。 我们提出一个基于专家混合(MoE)的聚合模型,该模型能动态地将来自视听模式的信息结合起来,以预测电影中产生的情感。 为MoE模型提供了一个基于硬期望-最大化算法的学习模块。 在流行电影数据库上进行的实验表明,在动态情绪预测的背景下,我们的MoE的聚变方法优于流行聚变战略(如早期和晚期聚变)。

papers.title: Recurrent Face Aging
papers.authors: Wei Wang, Zhen Cui, Yan Yan, Jiashi Feng, Shuicheng Yan, Xiangbo Shu, Nicu Sebe
papers.abstract: Modeling the aging process of human face is important for cross-age face verification and recognition. In this paper, we introduce a recurrent face aging (RFA) framework based on a recurrent neural network which can identify the ages of people from 0 to 80. Due to the lack of labeled face data of the same person captured in a long range of ages, traditional face aging models usually split the ages into discrete groups and learn a one-step face feature transformation for each pair of adjacent age groups. However, those methods neglect the in-between evolving states between the adjacent age groups and the synthesized faces often suffer from severe ghosting artifacts. Since human face aging is a smooth progression, it is more appropriate to age the face by going through smooth transition states. In this way, the ghosting artifacts can be effectively eliminated and the intermediate aged faces between two discrete age groups can also be obtained. Towards this target, we employ a two-layer gated recurrent unit as the basic recurrent module whose bottom layer encodes a young face to a latent representation and the top layer decodes the representation to a corresponding older face. The experimental results demonstrate our proposed RFA provides better aging faces over other state-of-the-art age progression methods.
papers.title_zh: 经常经常经常的 " 面对老龄化 "
papers.abstract_zh: 模拟人老化过程对于交叉年龄的面孔核实和识别十分重要,在本文中,我们引入了一个基于经常性神经网络的经常性面孔老化框架,可以确定0至80岁人口的年龄。 由于缺乏在长年中被捕获的同一个人的贴上标签的面部数据,传统的面部老化模式通常将年龄分割成不同的群体,为每对相邻年龄组学习一步步的面部特征转变。 然而,这些方法忽视了相邻年龄组与合成面孔之间不断演变的状态之间的相互影响。 由于人类面部老龄化是一个平稳的进化过程,因此通过平稳的转型状态将面部老化更为合适。 这样,就能够有效地消除隐形文物,并获得两个不同年龄组的中年人脸部。 为了实现这一目标,我们使用一个两层封闭式的经常性单元作为基本的经常性单元,其底层层将年轻面孔编码为潜在代表,顶层将代表代码编码为相应的老面孔。 实验结果显示,我们提议的外地住房方案在其他最先进的年龄发展方法中提供了更老化的面孔。

papers.title: Multimodal Spontaneous Emotion Corpus for Human Behavior Analysis
papers.authors: Zheng Zhang, Jeff M. Girard, Yue Wu, Xing Zhang, Peng Liu, Umur Ciftci, Shaun Canavan, Michael Reale, Andy Horowitz, Huiyuan Yang, Jeffrey F. Cohn, Qiang Ji, Lijun Yin
papers.abstract: Emotion is expressed in multiple modalities, yet most research has considered at most one or two. This stems in part from the lack of large, diverse, well-annotated, multimodal databases with which to develop and test algorithms. We present a well-annotated, multimodal, multidimensional spontaneous emotion corpus of 140 participants. Emotion inductions were highly varied. Data were acquired from a variety of sensors of the face that included high-resolution 3D dynamic imaging, high-resolution 2D video, and thermal (infrared) sensing, and contact physiological sensors that included electrical conductivity of the skin, respiration, blood pressure, and heart rate. Facial expression was annotated for both the occurrence and intensity of facial action units from 2D video by experts in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS). The corpus further includes derived features from 3D, 2D, and IR (infrared) sensors and baseline results for facial expression and action unit detection. The entire corpus will be made available to the research community.
papers.title_zh: 人类行为分析的多模式自发情感组织
papers.abstract_zh: 情感以多种方式表达,但大多数研究最多只考虑了一、二种形式,部分原因是缺乏庞大、多样、有详细说明的多式数据库来开发和测试算法。 我们展示了140名参与者的多式、多式、多维自发情感材料。 数据来自面部各种传感器,包括高分辨率3D动态成像、高分辨率2D视频和热(红外)传感器,以及包括皮肤电传、呼吸、血压和心率在内的接触生理传感器。 2D视频专家在 " FACS行动编码系统 " (FACS)上对面部动作装置的出现和强度作了说明,对面部动作装置的出现和强度作了说明,该装置还包括3D、2D和IR(红外)传感器的衍生特征,以及面部表现和动作装置探测的基线结果。 整个身体将提供给研究界。

papers.title: Image Question Answering Using Convolutional Neural Network With Dynamic Parameter Prediction
papers.authors: Hyeonwoo Noh, Paul Hongsuck Seo, Bohyung Han
papers.abstract: We tackle image question answering (ImageQA) problem by learning a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a dynamic parameter layer whose weights are determined adaptively based on questions. For the adaptive parameter prediction, we employ a separate parameter prediction network, which consists of gated recurrent unit (GRU) taking a question as its input and a fully-connected layer generating a set of candidate weights as its output. However, it is challenging to construct a parameter prediction network for a large number of parameters in the fully-connected dynamic parameter layer of the CNN. We reduce the complexity of this problem by incorporating a hashing technique, where the candidate weights given by the parameter prediction network are selected using a predefined hash function to determine individual weights in the dynamic parameter layer. The proposed network---joint network with the CNN for ImageQA and the parameter prediction network---is trained end-to-end through back-propagation, where its weights are initialized using a pre-trained CNN and GRU. The proposed algorithm illustrates the state-of-the-art performance on all available public ImageQA benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: 使用具有动态参数预测的动态神经神经网络回答图像问题
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过学习一个具有动态参数层的进化神经网络(CNN), 其重量根据问题根据适应性决定, 来解决图像问题解答(图像QA)问题。 对于适应参数预测,我们使用一个单独的参数预测网络,由闭门的经常性单位(GRU)组成,将一个问题作为输入,一个完全连接的层,产生一组候选权重作为输出。 然而,在CNN完全连通的动态参数层为大量参数建立一个参数预测网络是具有挑战性的。 我们通过采用散列技术来降低这一问题的复杂性,即使用预先定义的散列函数选择参数预测网络给出的候选权重,以确定动态参数层中的个别权重。 与有线电视新闻网(CNN)为图像QA和参数预测网络(参数预测网络)建立的拟议网络-联合网络,是经过培训的通过后方通信实现端对端,其重量是使用经过预先培训的CNN和GRU来初始化的。 拟议算法说明所有现有公共图像质量A基准的最新表现。

papers.title: Hierarchically Gated Deep Networks for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Guo-Jun Qi
papers.abstract: Semantic segmentation aims to parse the scene structure of images by annotating the labels to each pixel so that images can be segmented into different regions. While image structures usually have various scales, it is difficult to use a single scale to model the spatial contexts for all individual pixels. Multi-scale Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and their variants have made striking success for modeling the global scene structure for an image. However, they are limited in labeling fine-grained local structures like pixels and patches, since spatial contexts might be blindly mixed up without appropriately customizing their scales. To address this challenge, we develop a novel paradigm of multi-scale deep network to model spatial contexts surrounding different pixels at various scales. It builds multiple layers of memory cells, learning feature representations for individual pixels at their customized scales by hierarchically absorbing relevant spatial contexts via memory gates between layers.Such Hierarchically Gated Deep Networks (HGDNs) can customize a suitable scale for each pixel, thereby delivering better performance on labeling scene structures of various scales. We conduct the experiments on two datasets, and show competitive results compared with the other multi-scale deep networks on the semantic segmentation task.
papers.title_zh: 用于语义分割的等级化深端网络
papers.abstract_zh: 语义区段的目的是通过将标签标记标记到每个像素来分析图像的场景结构,这样图像可以分割成不同的区域。 虽然图像结构通常有不同的尺度,但很难使用单一尺度来模拟所有单个像素的空间环境。 多规模革命神经网络(CNNs)及其变体在为图像建模全球场景结构方面取得了显著成功。 然而,它们在贴上像素和补丁等精细的当地结构标签方面受到限制,因为空间环境可能盲目地混淆在一起,而没有适当定制其尺度。 为了应对这一挑战,我们开发了一种新型的多尺度深层网络模式,以模拟不同尺度不同像素周围的空间环境。 它建立多层的记忆细胞,学习个人像素在定制尺度上的特征表现,通过层之间的内存门按等级吸收相关空间环境。 如此高层次的纵向深层网络(HGDNs)可以为每个像素定制一个合适的尺度,从而在不同尺度的标签场景结构上产生更好的性能。 我们在两个数据集上进行实验,并与其他关于语义分解任务的多尺度深层网络相比,显示竞争性结果。

papers.title: Exploring Fine-Grained Audiovisual Categorization with the SSW60 Dataset
papers.authors: Grant Van Horn, Rui Qian, Kimberly Wilber, Hartwig Adam, Oisin Mac Aodha, Serge Belongie
papers.abstract: "We present a new benchmark dataset, Sapsucker Woods 60 (SSW60), for advancing research on audiovisual fine-grained categorization. While our community has made great strides in fine-grained visual categorization on images, the counterparts in audio and video fine-grained categorization are relatively unexplored. To encourage advancements in this space, we have carefully constructed the SSW60 dataset to enable researchers to experiment with classifying the same set of categories in three different modalities: images, audio, and video. The dataset covers 60 species of birds and is comprised of images from existing datasets, and brand new, expert curated audio and video datasets. We thoroughly benchmark audiovisual classification performance and modality fusion experiments through the use of state-of-the-art transformer methods. Our findings show that performance of audiovisual fusion methods is better than using exclusively image or audio based methods for the task of video classification. We also present interesting modality transfer experiments, enabled by the unique construction of SSW60 to encompass three different modalities. We hope the SSW60 dataset and accompanying baselines spur research in this fascinating area."
papers.title_zh: 探索与 SSSW60 数据集相匹配的精细成色视听分类
papers.abstract_zh: “我们展示了一个新的基准数据集,Sapsucker Woods 60 (SSSW60),用于推进视听微粒分类研究。 虽然我们的社区在图像微粒视觉分类方面取得了长足进步,但音频和视频微粒分类的对应方却相对没有被探索。 ” 为了鼓励在这一空间取得进展,我们仔细建造了SSW60数据集,使研究人员能够试验用三种不同的方式对同一组类别进行分类:图像、音频和视频。 该数据集涵盖60种鸟类,由现有数据集的图像和全新的、专家专门设计的视听数据集组成,我们通过使用最先进的变压器方法,对视听分类性能和模式融合实验进行彻底基准。 我们的研究结果表明,视听融合方法的性能比完全使用图像或音频方法来进行视频分类的任务要好。 我们还介绍了有趣的模式转移实验,这种实验通过SSW60的独特构建得以包括三种不同模式。 我们希望SSW60数据集及相伴的基线能刺激在这个令人着迷的领域进行研究。”

papers.title: Deep Decision Network for Multi-Class Image Classification
papers.authors: Venkatesh N. Murthy, Vivek Singh, Terrence Chen, R. Manmatha, Dorin Comaniciu
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present a novel Deep Decision Network (DDN) that provides an alternative approach towards building an efficient deep learning network. During the learning phase, starting from the root network node, DDN automatically builds a network that splits the data into disjoint clusters of classes which would be handled by the subsequent expert networks. This results in a tree-like structured network driven by the data. The proposed method provides an insight into the data by identifying the group of classes that are hard to classify and require more attention when compared to others. DDN also has the ability to make early decisions thus making it suitable for time-sensitive applications. We validate DDN on two publicly available benchmark datasets: CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 and it yields state-of-the-art classification performance on both the datasets. The proposed algorithm has no limitations to be applied to any generic classification problems.
papers.title_zh: 多类图像图像分类深度决策网络
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中,我们提出了一个新的深层决策网络,为建立一个高效的深层学习网络提供了另一种办法。 在从根网络节点开始的学习阶段,DDN自动建立一个网络,将数据分成分解为分解的分类组群,由随后的专家网络处理,结果形成一个由数据驱动的树形结构化网络。 拟议的方法通过确定难以分类和与其他类别相比需要更多注意的类别类别,使人们对数据有了深入的了解。 缺碘症全国网络还有能力尽早作出决定,从而适合时间敏感的应用。 我们根据两个公开的基准数据集(CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100)验证DDN,该数据集在这两个数据集上都具有最新的分类性能,拟议的算法没有任何限制适用于任何通用分类问题。

papers.title: Joint Learning of Multiple Regressors for Single Image Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Kai Zhang, Baoquan Wang, Wangmeng Zuo, Hongzhi Zhang, Lei Zhang
papers.abstract: Using a global regression model for single image super-resolution (SISR) generally fails to produce visually pleasant output. The recently developed local learning methods provide a remedy by partitioning the feature space into a number of clusters and learning a simple local model for each cluster. However, in these methods the space partition is conducted separately from local model learning, which results in an abundant number of local models to achieve satisfying performance. To address this problem, we propose a mixture of experts (MoE) method to jointly learn the feature space partition and local regression models. Our MoE consists of two components: gating network learning and local regressors learning. An expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm is adopted to train MoE on a large set of LR/HR patch pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can use much less local models and time to achieve comparable or superior results to state-of-the-art SISR methods, providing a highly practical solution to real applications.
papers.title_zh: 单一图像超分辨率的多重后退者联合学习
papers.abstract_zh: 使用全球回归模型进行单一图像超分辨率(SISSR)通常无法产生视觉上令人愉快的输出。 最近开发的本地学习方法提供了一种补救办法,将特征空间分成若干组群,并学习了每个组群的简单本地模型。 然而,在这些方法中,空间分隔与当地模式学习分开进行,由此产生了大量当地模式,以达到令人满意的性能。 为解决这一问题,我们建议采用专家混合方法,共同学习特征空间分割和局部回归模型。我们的MoE由两个部分组成:连接网络学习和本地回归者学习。 采用预期最大化算法,对MoE进行关于大套LR/HR配对板的培训。 实验结果显示,拟议方法可以使用的地方模型和时间少得多,以取得与最先进的SISR方法可比或优异的结果,为实际应用提供非常实用的解决办法。

papers.title: Efficient Large Scale Video Classification
papers.authors: Balakrishnan Varadarajan, George Toderici, Sudheendra Vijayanarasimhan, Natsev, Apostol
papers.abstract: Video classification has advanced tremendously over the recent years. A large part of the improvements in video classification had to do with the work done by the image classification community and the use of deep convolutional networks (CNNs) which produce competitive results with hand- crafted motion features. These networks were adapted to use video frames in various ways and have yielded state of the art classification results. We present two methods that build on this work, and scale it up to work with millions of videos and hundreds of thousands of classes while maintaining a low computational cost. In the context of large scale video processing, training CNNs on video frames is extremely time consuming, due to the large number of frames involved. We propose to avoid this problem by training CNNs on either YouTube thumbnails or Flickr images, and then using these networks' outputs as features for other higher level classifiers. We discuss the challenges of achieving this and propose two models for frame-level and video-level classification. The first is a highly efficient mixture of experts while the latter is based on long short term memory neural networks. We present results on the Sports-1M video dataset (1 million videos, 487 classes) and on a new dataset which has 12 million videos and 150,000 labels.
papers.title_zh: 高效大型视频视频分类
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,视频分类取得了巨大进展,视频分类的改进在很大程度上与图像分类界的工作和使用深层革命网络有关,这些网络通过手工制作的动作功能产生竞争性结果。 这些网络经过改造,以各种方式使用视频框架,并产生了最新水平的分类结果。 我们展示了以这项工作为基础的两种方法,并推广到使用数百万视频和数十万个班级,同时保持较低的计算成本。 在大规模视频处理方面,对有线电视新闻网的视频框架培训极其耗时,因为涉及的视频框架很多。 我们建议避免这一问题,通过在YouTube缩略图或Flickr图像上培训有线电视新闻网,然后将这些网络的产出作为其他更高层次分类者的特征。 我们讨论实现这一目标的挑战,并提出框架和视频等级分类的两个模式。 第一个是高度高效的专家组合,而后者则以长期短期记忆神经网络为基础,我们在体育-1M视频数据集(100万个视频、487个班)和新数据集上展示结果,新数据集有1 200万个视频和150 000个标签。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Normalized Cuts for Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Selene E. Chew, Nathan D. Cahill
papers.abstract: Since its introduction as a powerful graph-based method for image segmentation, the Normalized Cuts (NCuts) algorithm has been generalized to incorporate expert knowledge about how certain pixels or regions should be grouped, or how the resulting segmentation should be biased to be correlated with priors. Previous approaches incorporate hard must-link constraints on how certain pixels should be grouped as well as hard cannot-link constraints on how other pixels should be separated into different groups. In this paper, we reformulate NCuts to allow both sets of constraints to be handled in a soft manner, enabling the user to tune the degree to which the constraints are satisfied. An approximate spectral solution to the reformulated problem exists without requiring explicit construction of a large, dense matrix; hence, computation time is comparable to that of unconstrained NCuts. Using synthetic data and real imagery, we show that soft handling of constraints yields better results than unconstrained NCuts and enables more robust clustering and segmentation than is possible when the constraints are strictly enforced.
papers.title_zh: 图像分割的半超半正常化切分
papers.abstract_zh: 自作为以图表为基础的图像分割法引入以来, " 普通化剪切 " (NCuts)算法被普遍采用,以纳入关于某些像素或区域应如何分组的专家知识,或由此产生的分解应如何偏向于与前科相关联的专家知识。 以往的做法包含了对如何对某些像素进行分组的硬性必连锁限制,以及对如何将其他像素分为不同组别的硬性不可连锁限制。 在本文中,我们重新拟订国家技术委员会,以便以软方式处理这两组制约因素,使用户能够调整这些制约因素得到满足的程度。 重订问题的近似光谱解决办法已经存在,不需要明确构建一个大型、密集的矩阵;因此,计算时间与未受限制的NCuts相似。 使用合成数据和真实图像,我们表明,软处理制约比未受限制的NCuts产生更好的结果,并且能够比严格实行制约时可能做到的更稳健的集群和分割。

papers.title: Real-Time Visual Analysis of Microvascular Blood Flow for Critical Care
papers.authors: Chao Liu, Hernando Gomez, Srinivasa Narasimhan, Artur Dubrawski, Michael R. Pinsky, Brian Zuckerbraun
papers.abstract: Microcirculatory monitoring plays an important role in diagnosis and treatment of critical care patients. Sidestream Dark Field (SDF) imaging devices have been used to visualize and support interpretation of the micro-vascular blood flow. However, due to subsurface scattering within the tissue that embeds the capillaries, transparency of plasma, imaging noise and lack of features, it is difficult to obtain reliable physiological data from SDF videos. Therefore, thus far microcirculatory videos have been analyzed manually with significant input from expert clinicians. In this paper, we present a framework that automates the analysis process. It includes stages of video stabilization, enhancement, and micro-vessel extraction, in order to automatically estimate statistics of the micro blood flows from SDF videos. Our method has been validated in critical care experiments conducted carefully to record the microcirculatory blood flow in test animal subjects before, during and after induced bleeding episodes, as well as to study the effect of fluid resuscitation. Our method is able to extract microcirculatory measurements that are consistent with clinical intuition and it has a potential to become a useful tool in critical care medicine.
papers.title_zh: 用于关键护理的微生物血管血液流动实时视觉分析
papers.abstract_zh: 微循环监测在诊断和治疗关键护理病人方面发挥着重要作用,侧流黑暗场成像装置被用来直观和支持对微血管血液流动的解释。 然而,由于组织内嵌入毛细、等离子体透明、成像噪音和缺乏特征的地表下散射,很难从SDF视频中获得可靠的生理数据。 因此,迄今为止,在专家临床医生的重要投入下,对微循环视频进行了人工分析。 在本文中,我们提出了一个使分析过程自动化的框架。 它包括视频稳定、增强和微型船只提取阶段,以便自动估计SDF视频的微血流统计数据。 我们的方法在关键护理实验中得到验证,这些实验是仔细进行的,目的是在诱发出血事件前后和期间在动物试验科目中记录微循环血液流,并研究液体复苏的影响。 我们的方法能够提取出符合临床直觉的微循环测量结果,并且有可能成为关键护理医学的有用工具。

papers.title: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Dual Domain Filters Based Texture and Structure Preserving Image Non-Blind Deconvolution
papers.authors: Hang Yang, Ming Zhu, Yan Niu, Yujing Guan, Zhongbo Zhang
papers.abstract: The following message is relayed from an update made on IEEE Xplore. Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles "Dual Domain Filters Based Texture and Structure Preserving Image Non-Blind Deconvolution" by Hang Yang, Ming Zhu, Yan Niu, Yujing Guan, and Zhongbo Zhang in the Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), June 2015, pp. 705-713 After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE’s Publication Principles. This paper copied portions of text from the papers cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper titles) and without permission. "Group-Based Sparse Representation for Image Restoration" by Jian Zhang, Debin Zhao, and Wen Gao in the IEEE Transactions on Image Processing, Vol 23, No 8, August 2014, pp. 3336-3351 "Dual-domain Image Denoising" by Claude Knaus, Matthias Zwicker in the Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Image Processing, (ICIP), September 2013, pp. 440-444 "A Machine Learning Approach for Non-blind Image Deconvolution" by Christian Schuler, Harold Christopher Burger, Stefan Harmeling, and Bernhard Scholkopf in the Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), June 2013, pp. 1067-1074 Image deconvolution continues to be an active research topic of recovering a sharp image, given a blurry one generated by a convolution. One of the most challenging problems in image deconvolution is how to preserve the fine scale texture structures while removing blur and noise. Various methods have been implemented in both spatial and transform domains, such as gradient based methods, nonlocal self-similarity methods, sparsity based methods. However, each domain has its advantages and shortcomings, which can be complemented by each other. In this work we propose a new approach for efficient image deconvolution based on dual domain filters. In the deblurring process, we offer a hybrid method that a novel rolling guidance filter is used to ensure proper texture/structure separation, and then in the transform domain, we use the short-time Fourier transform to recover the textures while removing noise with energy shrinkage. Our hybrid algorithm that is surprisingly easy to implement, and experimental results clearly show that the proposed algorithm outperforms many state-of-the-art deconvolution algorithms in terms of both quantitative measure and visual perception quality.
papers.title_zh: 通知违反IEEE 出版原则:基于双域过滤器的纹理和结构保护图像的非黑色进化
papers.abstract_zh: 以下信息来自IEEE Xplore的最新消息。 Hang Yang、Ming Zhu、Yan Niu、Yujing Guan和Zhongbo Zhang在2015年6月国际EEEE计算机远景和模式识别会议议事录中发出的关于违反IEEE出版物原则“基于二域过滤器的纺织品和结构保护图像非外向进化”的通知,2015年6月,pp. 705-713 经过由适当组成的专家委员会仔细和仔细审查本文的内容和编写情况后,发现该文件违反了能源、环境和能源研究所的《出版原则》,并抄录了以下文件的部分案文。 原文照抄时没有归属(包括适当提及原作者和/或纸张标题),未经许可。 Jian Zhang、Debin Zhao和Wen Gao在《IEEE的图像处理交易》第23卷,第8期,2014年8月,第8页。 3336-3351 “Dual-domain image Disoising”,Claude Knaus著,Matthias Zwicker,《IEEE图像处理国际会议记录》,(ICIP),2013年9月,pp. Christian Schuler、Harold Christopher Burger、Stefan Harmeling和Bernhard Scholkopf于2013年6月在计算机视觉和模式识别国际电子教育研究所计算机视觉和模式识别会议议事录(CVPR,2013年6月)上发表题为“非盲人图像进化的机器学习方法”的440-444。 1067-1074 图像变形仍然是一个积极的研究课题,即如何在清除模糊和噪音的同时保持微小的纹理结构。 在空间和变换领域都采用了各种方法,如梯度法、非本地自差法、宽度法,但每个领域都有其优点和缺点,可以相互补充。 在这项工作中,我们提出了基于双域过滤器的高效图像分解新办法。 在拆解过程中,我们提出一种混合方法,即使用一个新的滚动制导过滤器来确保适当的纹理/结构分离,然后在变换域中,我们使用短时间的Fourier变换法来恢复质地,同时消除能量缩水的噪音。 我们的混合算法令人惊讶地容易实施,实验结果清楚地表明,拟议的算法在数量测量和视觉感知质量两方面都优于许多最先进的分解算法。

papers.title: Differential Recurrent Neural Networks for Action Recognition
papers.authors: Vivek Veeriah, Naifan Zhuang, Guo-Jun Qi
papers.abstract: The long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network is capable of processing complex sequential information since it utilizes special gating schemes for learning representations from long input sequences. It has the potential to model any time-series or sequential data, where the current hidden state has to be considered in the context of the past hidden states. This property makes LSTM an ideal choice to learn the complex dynamics of various actions. Unfortunately, the conventional LSTMs do not consider the impact of spatio-temporal dynamics corresponding to the given salient motion patterns, when they gate the information that ought to be memorized through time. To address this problem, we propose a differential gating scheme for the LSTM neural network, which emphasizes on the change in information gain caused by the salient motions between the successive frames. This change in information gain is quantified by Derivative of States (DoS), and thus the proposed LSTM model is termed as differential Recurrent Neural Network (dRNN). We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model by automatically recognizing actions from the real-world 2D and 3D human action datasets. Our study is one of the first works towards demonstrating the potential of learning complex time-series representations via high-order derivatives of states.
papers.title_zh: 不同经常性不同神经网络的行动确认
papers.abstract_zh: 长期短期内存(LSTM)神经网络能够处理复杂的顺序信息,因为它利用特殊的格子机制从长输入序列中学习陈述。 它有可能建模任何时间序列或序列数据,而当前隐藏状态必须结合过去隐藏状态来考虑。 这一属性使LSTM成为学习各种行动的复杂动态的理想选择。 不幸的是,传统的LSTMs没有考虑到与特定突出运动模式相对应的时空空间动态的影响,而当这些动态模式封闭了应当随着时间的推移记住的信息时。 为了解决这一问题,我们为LSTM神经网络提出了一个差别化计划,强调连续两个框架之间的突出动议在信息获取方面引起的变化。 信息获取方面的这一变化是由国家衍生数据量化的,因此,拟议的LSTM模式被称为差异性经常性神经网络(dRNN),我们通过自动确认来自现实世界2D和3D人类行动数据集的行动,来证明拟议模式的有效性。 我们的研究是首批展示通过国家高阶衍生物学习复杂时间序列代表的潜力的工作之一。

papers.title: Conditional High-Order Boltzmann Machine: A Supervised Learning Model for Relation Learning
papers.authors: Yan Huang, Wei Wang, Liang Wang
papers.abstract: Relation learning is a fundamental operation in many computer vision tasks. Recently, high-order Boltzmann machine and its variants have exhibited the great power of modelling various data relation. However, most of them are unsupervised learning models which are not very discriminative and thus cannot server as a standalone solution to relation learning tasks. In this paper, we explore supervised learning algorithms and propose a new model named Conditional High-order Boltzmann Machine (CHBM), which can be directly used as a bilinear classifier to assign similarity scores for pairwise images. Then, to better deal with complex data relation, we propose a gated version of CHBM which untangles factors of variation by exploiting a set of latent variables to gate classification. We perform four-order tensor factorization for parameter reduction, and present two efficient supervised learning algorithms from the perspectives of being generative and discriminative, respectively. The experimental results of image transformation visualization, binary-way classification and face verification demonstrate that, by performing supervised learning, our models can greatly improve the performance.
papers.title_zh: 有条件的高级命令博尔茨曼机器:受监督的关系学习模式
papers.abstract_zh: 关系学习是许多计算机视觉任务的一个基本操作。 最近,高阶波尔茨曼机器及其变体展示了模拟各种数据关系的强大力量。 然而,其中大多数是不受监督的学习模式,这些模式不是极具歧视性的,因此不能将服务器作为独立解决相关学习任务的办法。 在本文中,我们探索受监督的学习算法,并提出一个新的模型,名为 " 条件性高阶波尔茨曼机器 " (CHBM),可直接用作双线分类器,为配对图像分配相似的分数。 然后,为了更好地处理复杂的数据关系,我们提出一个封闭式的CHBM版本,它通过利用一系列潜在变量进行门级分类,将变异因素分解开来。 我们用四级压力因素来降低参数,并分别从基因化和歧视性的角度提出两种有效的、受监督的学习算法。 图像转换可视化、二元路分类和面对面核查的实验结果表明,通过在监督下学习,我们的模型可以大大改进性能。

papers.title: Conditional Convolutional Neural Network for Modality-Aware Face Recognition
papers.authors: Chao Xiong, Xiaowei Zhao, Danhang Tang, Karlekar Jayashree, Shuicheng Yan, Tae-Kyun Kim
papers.abstract: Faces in the wild are usually captured with various poses, illuminations and occlusions, and thus inherently multimodally distributed in many tasks. We propose a conditional Convolutional Neural Network, named as c-CNN, to handle multimodal face recognition. Different from traditional CNN that adopts fixed convolution kernels, samples in c-CNN are processed with dynamically activated sets of kernels. In particular, convolution kernels within each layer are only sparsely activated when a sample is passed through the network. For a given sample, the activations of convolution kernels in a certain layer are conditioned on its present intermediate representation and the activation status in the lower layers. The activated kernels across layers define the sample-specific adaptive routes that reveal the distribution of underlying modalities. Consequently, the proposed framework does not rely on any prior knowledge of modalities in contrast with most existing methods. To substantiate the generic framework, we introduce a special case of c-CNN via incorporating the conditional routing of the decision tree, which is evaluated with two problems of multimodality - multi-view face identification and occluded face verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over the counterparts unaware of modalities.
papers.title_zh: 现代-意识面对面识别有条件的革命神经神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 野外的面孔通常被各种姿势、照明和隔离所捕捉,因此在很多任务中必然以多式联运方式分布。 我们提议建立一个称为C-CNN的有条件的进化神经网络(C-CNN)来处理多式联运面部识别问题。 与采用固定电动内核的传统有线电视新闻网不同的是,C-CNN的样品是用动态活性内核处理的,特别是,每个层内的电动内核只有在通过网络通过样品时才会很少被激活。 对于特定样本而言,某一层的熔化内核的激活取决于其目前的中间代表状态和下层的激活状态,跨层的活化内核界定了显示基本模式分布的样本特定适应性途径。 因此,拟议框架与大多数现有方法不同,并不依赖事先对模式的任何了解。 为了证实通用框架,我们引入了C-CNN这一特例,将决策树的有条件路线纳入其中,评估时有两个多式问题,即多视角面孔识别和隐蔽面孔核查。 广泛的实验表明,相对于不了解模式的对应方,不断改进。

papers.title: Building a Bird Recognition App and Large Scale Dataset With Citizen Scientists: The Fine Print in Fine-Grained Dataset Collection
papers.authors: Grant Van Horn, Steve Branson, Ryan Farrell, Scott Haber, Jessie Barry, Panos Ipeirotis, Pietro Perona, Serge Belongie
papers.abstract: We introduce tools and methodologies to collect high quality, large scale fine-grained computer vision datasets using citizen scientists -- crowd annotators who are passionate and knowledgeable about specific domains such as birds or airplanes.
