To effectively learn diverse task patterns, we design a Dual Gating Mixture-of-Experts (DGMoE) mechanism, where not only input tokens but also self-aware experts adaptively decide their activation. Finally, we propose an Expert-Driven Aggregation strategy at the federated server, where model aggregation is guided by activated experts, ensuring effective cross-client knowledge transfer. Extensive simulations and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposals. Notably, DGMoE significantly improves computational efficiency compared to its vanilla counterpart, while FedVLA achieves task success rates comparable to centralized training, effectively preserving data privacy.
papers.title_zh: FFVLA: 具有机器人操纵双重专家混合的联邦视觉-语言-行动学习
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型(VLA)使机器人能够为执行任务解释语言指示,从而大大推进了机器人操纵。 然而,这些模式的培训往往依赖大规模用户专用数据,引起对隐私和安全的关切,这反过来又限制了对隐私和安全的更广泛采用。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议提出一个名称,这是第一个联邦化的VLA学习框架,使分布式示范培训成为可能,既保护数据隐私,又不损害业绩。 我们的框架将任务意识代表性学习、适应性专家选择和专家驱动的联盟汇总结合起来,从而能够对VLA模式进行有效和隐私保护培训。 具体而言,我们引入了以指示为导向的现场定位机制,根据任务指示分解和加强目标层面的特征,增进对背景的了解。 为了有效地学习不同的任务模式,我们设计了一种双重组合专家(DGMoE)机制,其中不仅有输入符号,而且有自觉的专家根据自己的需要决定其激活。 最后,我们提议在联合服务器上采用专家-驱动聚合战略,模型汇总由活跃专家指导,确保有效的跨客户知识转让,广泛的模拟和现实世界机器人实验表明我们建议的有效性。 值得注意的是,与香草对应方相比,DGMoE显著提高了计算效率,而FedVLA取得了与集中培训相当的任务成功率,从而有效地保护了数据隐私。

papers.title: Fast Training of Diffusion Transformer with Extreme Masking for 3D Point Clouds Generation
papers.authors: Shentong Mo · Enze Xie · Yue Wu · Junsong Chen · Matthias Niessner · ZHENGUO LI
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers have recently shown remarkable effectiveness in generating high-quality 3D point clouds. However, training voxel-based diffusion models for high-resolution 3D voxels remains prohibitively expensive due to the cubic complexity of attention operators, which arises from the additional dimension of voxels. Motivated by the inherent redundancy of 3D compared to 2D, we propose FastDiT-3D, a novel masked diffusion transformer tailored for efficient 3D point cloud generation, which greatly reduces training costs. Specifically, we draw inspiration from masked autoencoders to dynamically operate the denoising process on masked voxelized point clouds. We also propose a novel voxel-aware masking strategy to adaptively aggregate background/foreground information from voxelized point clouds. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with an extreme masking ratio of nearly 99%. Moreover, to improve multi-category 3D generation, we introduce Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) in 3D diffusion model. Each category can learn a distinct diffusion path with different experts, relieving gradient conflict. Experimental results on the ShapeNet dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art high-fidelity and diverse 3D point cloud generation performance. Our FastDiT-3D improves 1-Nearest Neighbor Accuracy and Coverage metrics when generating 128-resolution voxel point clouds, using only 6.5% of the original training cost.
papers.title_zh: 为三维点云生成提供极掩蔽的传播Transformer快速培训
papers.abstract_zh: 最近,传播Transformer在产生高质量的3D点云方面显示出显著的效益。 然而,高分辨率3Doxel的基于培训的Voxel扩散模型仍然过于昂贵,因为注意操作员的立方复杂,这来自Voxel的额外层面。 基于3D与2D的内在冗余,我们提议Fast DiT-3D,这是为高效的3D点云生成而专门设计的新式蒙面扩散变压器,大大降低了培训费用。 具体地说,我们从蒙面自动编码器中汲取灵感,以动态操作蒙面氧化点云的除尘过程。 我们还提出了一个新颖的反毒意识掩码策略,以适应性地汇总来自氧化点云的背景/地面信息。 我们的方法以近99%的极端掩蔽率实现了最先进的表现。 此外,为了改善多类3D一代,我们在3D扩散模型中引入了3D专家混合(MOE ) 。 每个类别都可以与不同的专家学习不同的传播路径,缓解梯度冲突。 形状网数据集的实验结果显示,我们的方法达到了最先进的高忠诚度和不同的3D点云生成性能。 我们的快速DiT-3D在产生128分辨率的福克斯点云时改进了邻居最接近的准确度和覆盖范围度量,只使用了最初培训费用的6.5%。

papers.title: DICE: Staleness-Centric Optimizations for Parallel Diffusion MoE Inference
papers.authors: Jiajun Luo · Lizhuo Luo · Jianru Xu · Jiajun Song · Rongwei Lu · Chen Tang · Zhi Wang
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts-based (MoE-based) diffusion models demonstrate remarkable scalability in high-fidelity image generation, yet their reliance on expert parallelism introduces critical communication bottlenecks. State-of-the-art methods alleviate such overhead in parallel diffusion inference through computation-communication overlapping, termed displaced parallelism. However, we identify that these techniques inherently induce severestaleness-the utilization of outdated activations from previous timesteps that significantly degrades quality, especially in expert-parallel scenarios. We tackle this fundamental tension and propose DICE, a staleness-centric optimization framework with a three-fold approach: (1) Interweaved Parallelism introduces staggered pipelines, effectively halving step-level staleness for free; (2) Selective Synchronization operates at layer-level and protects critical layers vulnerable from staled activations; and (3) Conditional Communication, a token-level, training-free method that dynamically adjusts communication frequency based on token importance. Together, these strategies effectively reduce staleness, achieving 1.26x speedup with minimal quality degradation. Empirical results establish DICE as an effective and scalable solution. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DICE-FF04
papers.title_zh: DICIC: 平行扩散部的平行扩散推论的成份-中值优化
papers.abstract_zh: 以专家为基础的混合(基于MOE的)传播模型表明,在高忠诚形象生成方面,可显著扩展,然而,这些模型依赖专家的平行性带来了关键的通信瓶颈。 最先进的方法通过计算和通信的重叠,即所谓的流离失所的平行法,通过平行的传播推论,减轻这种间接费用。 然而,我们发现,这些技术本身就会导致严重迟缓,即利用以往时间步骤中过时的引爆装置,大大降低质量,特别是在专家平行情景中。 我们处理这一根本性的紧张关系,并提议DICE, 即采用三重方法的老化、以老化为中心的优化框架:(1) 互交错的平行主义引入了交错的管道,有效地将逐步递减的免费输油管减半;(2) 选择性同步化在层层一级运作,保护容易受固定激活影响的关键层;(3) 有条件通信,这是一种象征性的、无培训的方法,根据象征性重要性动态调整通信频率。 这些战略合在一起,有效地减少了腐烂程度,实现了1.26x的加速,且质量降低到最低程度。经验成果将DICE确定为有效且可扩展的解决办法。我们的代码可在https://anonomous4open.science/r/DICE-FF04上公开查阅。

papers.title: Controllable-LPMoE: Adapting to Challenging Object Segmentation via Dynamic Local Priors from Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Yanguang Sun · Jiawei Lian · jian Yang · lei luo
papers.abstract: Large-scale pre-trained models provide powerful feature representations for downstream object segmentation tasks. However, when adapted to specific tasks through the full-parameter fine-tuning, the enormous parameters being updated often results in significant computational overhead, creating a bottleneck in training efficiency. Although existing methods attempt to fine-tune frozen models by directly embedding trainable prompts, these prompts lack inherent semantic priors, limiting the adaptability of large-scale models. In this paper, we propose a novel dynamic priors-based fine-tuning paradigm with fewer trainable parameters, dubbed Controllable-LPMoE, which adaptively modulates frozen foundation models by dynamically controlling local priors to enhance fine-grained perception for specific segmentation tasks. More specifically, we construct a lightweight dynamic mixed local priors extractor that captures diverse local priors from input images through heterogeneous convolutions while employing a gating network to dynamically output expert priors required for the subsequent fine-tuning. Furthermore, we design a bi-directional interaction adapter that employs cosine-aligned deformable attention and channel-oriented adaptive scale enhancement to interact and restructure between frozen and trainable features, achieving efficient fine-tuning. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of our Controllable-LPMoE approach, demonstrating excellent segmentation performance compared to 31 state-of-the-art methods and adaptability to multiple binary object segmentation tasks.
papers.title_zh: LPMoE:通过Mixture of-Experts的动态本地前科,适应挑战性天体分离
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模的预先培训模式为下游物体分离任务提供了强有力的特征说明。 然而,如果通过整数微调适应具体任务,经过更新的巨大参数往往会导致大量的计算间接费用,从而在培训效率方面造成瓶颈。 虽然现有方法试图通过直接嵌入可训练的提示器来微调冻结的模型,但这些提示器缺乏固有的语义前科,限制了大规模模型的适应性。 在本文中,我们提出一种新的动态前期微调模式,其可训练参数较少,称为“控制可控-LPMoE”,该模式通过动态控制当地前期,对冻结的基础模型进行适应性调整,以加强对具体分割任务的细微感知。 更具体地说,我们建立一个轻量级动态混合的本地前身提取器,通过各种变异的变异,从输入图像中捕捉不同地方的前身,同时利用一个引线网络,向动态产出专家提供随后微调所需的前科。 此外,我们设计了双向互动适配器,利用可调整的可变注意和以频道为导向的适应规模增强,在冻结和可训练的功能之间进行互动和调整,实现高效的微调。 广泛的实验验证了我们的可控LPMoE方法的优越性,表明与31种最先进的方法和适应多项二元物体分离任务的适应性相比,我们具有极佳的分离性能。

papers.title: COME: Dual Structure-Semantic Learning with Collaborative MoE for Universal Lesion Detection Across Heterogeneous Ultrasound Datasets
papers.authors: Lingyu Chen · Yawen Zeng · Yue Wang · Peng Wan · Guo-chen Ning · Hongen Liao · Daoqiang Zhang · Fang Chen
papers.abstract: Conventional single-dataset training often fails with new data distributions, especially in ultrasound (US) image analysis due to limited data, acoustic shadows, and speckle noise.Therefore, constructing a universal framework for multi-heterogeneous US datasets is imperative. However, a key challenge arises: how to effectively mitigate inter-dataset interference while preserving dataset-specific discriminative features for robust downstream task? Previous approaches utilize either a single source-specific decoder or a domain adaptation strategy, but these methods experienced a decline in performance when applied to other domains. Considering this, we propose a Universal Collaborative Mixture of Heterogeneous Source-Specific Experts (COME). Specifically, COME establishes dual structure-semantic shared experts that create a universal representation space and then collaborate with source-specific experts to extract discriminative features through providing complementary features. This design enables robust generalization by leveraging cross-datasets experience distributions and providing universal US priors for small-batch or unseen data scenarios. Extensive experiments under three evaluation modes (single-dataset, intra-organ, and inter-organ integration datasets) demonstrate COME's superiority, achieving significant mean AP improvements over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.title_zh: 知识库:两结构-语言学习,与合作部合作进行跨异源超声波数据集的环流探测双结构-语言学习
papers.abstract_zh: 常规单一数据集培训往往因新数据发布而失败,特别是在超声波图像分析方面,因为数据有限、声影和闪烁的噪音。 因此,为多异性美国数据集构建一个普遍框架势在必行。 然而,出现了一个关键的挑战:如何有效减少数据交换干扰,同时为强有力的下游任务保留数据集特有的歧视性特征? 以前的办法使用单一的源特定解码器或领域适应战略,但这些方法在应用到其他领域时的绩效下降。 有鉴于此,我们建议采用不同源特定专家的通用合作混合方法。 具体地说,“知识、知识、知识、知识、创新和知识”组织设立了双重结构-区域共有专家,以创造普遍代表性空间,然后与特定来源的专家合作,通过提供互补特征来提取歧视性特征。 这一设计通过利用交叉数据集的经验分布和为小型或无形数据情景提供通用的美国前科,使得能够进行有力的概括化。 在三种评价模式(单一数据集、机构内和机构间一体化数据集)下进行的广泛试验表明,知识组织具有优越性,在先进方法上取得了显著的《行动方案》进步。

papers.title: Boost Your NeRF: A Model-Agnostic Mixture of Experts Framework for High Quality and Efficient Rendering
papers.authors: Francesco Di Sario · Riccardo Renzulli · Marco Grangetto · Enzo Tartaglione
papers.abstract: Since the introduction of NeRFs, considerable attention has been focused on improving their training and inference times, leading to the development of Fast-NeRFs models. Despite demonstrating impressive rendering speed and quality, the rapid convergence of such models poses challenges for further enhancing reconstruction quality. Common strategies to improve rendering quality involves augmenting model parameters or increasing the number of sampled points. However, these computationally intensive approaches encounter limitations in achieving significant quality enhancements. This study introduces a model-agnostic framework inspired by Sparsely-Gated Mixture of Experts to enhance rendering quality without escalating computational complexity. Our approach enables specialization in rendering different scene components by employing a mixture of experts with varying resolutions. We present a novel gate formulation designed to maximize expert capabilities and propose a resolution-based routing technique to effectively induce sparsity and decompose scenes. Our work significantly enhances reconstruction quality while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.title_zh: 推进您的 NERF: 高质量和高效竞标专家框架模型-不可知混合框架
papers.abstract_zh: 自引入NeRFs以来,相当重视改进其培训和推论时间,从而发展了快速NERFs模式。 尽管这些模型在速度和质量上表现出令人印象深刻,但迅速趋同给进一步提高重建质量带来了挑战,提高质量的共同战略包括扩大模型参数或增加抽样点的数目。 然而,这些计算密集的方法在实现大幅度提高质量方面受到限制,本研究报告引入了一个模型----不可知性框架,该框架受专家粗略组合的启发,目的是提高质量,而不会增加计算复杂性。 我们的方法使得能够通过专家混合,通过不同决议,在提供不同场景组成部分方面实现专业化。 我们提出了一个新颖的大门配方,旨在最大限度地发挥专家能力,并提出基于决议的路线技术,以有效诱发混乱和分解场景。 我们的工作大大提高了重建质量,同时保持了竞争业绩。

papers.title: WISE: Whitebox Image Stylization by Example-Based Learning
papers.authors: Winfried Lötzsch, Max Reimann, Martin Büssemeyer, Amir Semmo, Jürgen Döllner, Matthias Trapp
papers.abstract: "Image-based artistic rendering can synthesize a variety of expressive styles using algorithmic image filtering. In contrast to deep learning-based methods, these heuristics-based filtering techniques can operate on high-resolution images, are interpretable, and can be parameterized according to various design aspects. However, adapting or extending these techniques to produce new styles is often a tedious and error-prone task that requires expert knowledge. We propose a new paradigm to alleviate this problem: implementing algorithmic image filtering techniques as differentiable operations that can learn parametrizations aligned to certain reference styles. To this end, we present WISE, an example-based image-processing system that can handle a multitude of stylization techniques, such as watercolor, oil, or cartoon stylization, within a common framework. By training parameter prediction networks for global and local filter parameterizations, we can simultaneously adapt effects to reference styles and image content, e.g., to enhance facial features. Our method can be optimized in a style-transfer framework or learned in a generative-adversarial setting for image-to-image translation. We demonstrate that jointly training an xDoG filter and a CNN for postprocessing can achieve comparable results to a state-of-the-art GAN-based method."
papers.title_zh: WISE: 白箱图像通过实例学习的立体化
papers.abstract_zh: 利用算法图像过滤, 以图像为基础的艺术创作可以综合各种表达风格。 与深层次的以学习为基础的方法不同,这些以超自然学为基础的过滤技术可以对高分辨率图像进行操作,可以解释,可以根据不同的设计方面进行参数化。 然而,调整或推广这些技术以产生新的风格,往往是一项乏味和容易出错的任务,需要专家知识。 我们建议一种新的模式来缓解这一问题:采用算法图像过滤技术,作为不同操作,可以学习与某些参考风格相一致的准美化。 为此,我们提出WISE,这是一个以实例为基础的图像处理系统,可在一个共同框架内处理多种石化技术,如水彩色、石油或卡通石化。 通过培训全球和地方过滤参数参数化的参数预测网络,我们可以同时调整对参考样式和图像内容的影响,例如加强面部特征。 我们的方法可以在风格传输框架内优化,或者在图像到图像翻译的基因对抗环境中学习。 我们证明联合培训一个 xDoG 过滤器和一个用于后处理的CNN能够取得与最先进的GAN 方法类似的效果。 ”

papers.title: WeaveSeg: Iterative Contrast-weaving and Spectral Feature-refining for Nuclei Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiajia Li · Huisi Wu · Jing Qin
papers.abstract: histopathology images is a fundamental task in computational pathology. It is also a very challenging task due to complex nuclei morphologies, ambiguous boundaries, and staining variations. Existing methods often struggle to precisely delineate overlapping nuclei and handle class imbalance. We introduce WeaveSeg, a novel deep learning model for nuclei instance segmentation that significantly improves segmentation performance via synergistic integration of adaptive spectral feature refinement and iterative contrast-weaving. WeaveSeg features an adaptive spectral detail refinement (SAR) module for multi-scale feature enhancement via adaptive frequency component fusion, and an iterative contrast-weaving (ICW) module that progressively refines features through integrating contrastive attention, decoupled semantic context, and adaptive gating. Furthermore, we introduce a specialized uncertainty loss to explicitly model ambiguous regions, and a novel local contrast-based self-adaptive adjustment mechanism to accommodate dynamic feature distributions. Extensive experiments on MoNuSeg and CoNSeP demonstrate WeaveSeg's SOTA performance over existing models. Code will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: WeaveSeg: 核心区段的迭代对比交织和光谱地貌调整
papers.abstract_zh: 生理病理学图像是计算病理学的一项根本任务。 由于复杂的核形态、模糊的界限和污点的变异,它也是一项非常具有挑战性的任务。 现有的方法往往难以准确划定重叠的核并处理阶级不平衡。 我们引入了WeaveSeg,这是一个新颖的关于核体分解的深层次学习模式,通过将适应性光谱特征的完善和迭接的对比度编织协同结合,显著改善分解性能。 WeaveSeg的特点是通过适应性频率元件聚合增强多尺度特征的适应性光谱细节改进模块,以及迭接式对比编织模块,该模块通过结合对比关注、分解的语义背景和适应性带宽,逐步完善特征。 此外,我们引入了一种专门的不确定性损失,以明确模拟模棱两可的地区,并引入了一种新的基于对比的本地自我适应调整机制,以适应动态特征分布。 关于MoNuSeg和CONSeP的广泛实验展示了WeaveSeg相对于现有模式的SOTA绩效。 守则将公布于众。

papers.title: Wave-MambaAD: Wavelet-driven State Space Model for Multi-class Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Qiao Zhang · Mingwen Shao · Xinyuan Chen · Xiang Lv · Kai Xu
papers.abstract: The Mamba model excels in anomaly detection through efficient long-range dependency modeling and linear complexity. However, Mamba-based anomaly detectors still face two critical challenges: (1) insufficient modeling of diverse local features leading to inaccurate detection of subtle anomalies; (2) spatial-wise scanning mechanism disrupting the spatial continuity of large-scale anomalies, resulting in incomplete localization. To address these challenges, we propose Wave-MambaAD, a wavelet-driven state space model for unified subtle and large-scale anomaly detection. Firstly, to capture subtle anomalies, we design a high-frequency state space model that employs horizontal, vertical, and diagonal scanning mechanisms for processing directionally aligned high-frequency components, enabling precise anomaly detection through multidimensional feature extraction. Secondly, for comprehensive localization of large-scale anomalies, we propose a low-frequency state space model implementing channel-adaptive dynamic scanning mechanisms to maintain structural coherence in global contexts, which facilitates large-scale anomaly detection via adaptive feature integration. Finally, we develop a dynamic spatial enhancement block to improve anomalous feature representation by enhancing feature diversity through coordinated inter-channel communication and adaptive gating mechanisms. Comprehensive experiments on benchmark anomaly detection datasets show that Wave-MambaAD achieves competitive performance at lower parameters and computational costs.
papers.title_zh: Wave-MambaAD:Wavelet驱动的多级不受监督异常探测国家空间模型
papers.abstract_zh: Mamba模型通过高效的长距离受扶养人模型和线性复杂性,在异常点探测方面优异。 然而,设在曼巴的异常点探测器仍面临两个重大挑战:(1) 不同地方特征的建模不足,导致对微妙异常点的探测不准确;(2) 空间扫描机制扰乱大规模异常点的空间连续性,造成局部化不完全。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用波浪驱动型国家空间模型,即波浪驱动型国家空间模型,以统一微妙和大规模地探测异常现象。 首先,为了捕捉微妙的异常现象,我们设计了一个高频状态空间模型,采用水平、垂直和对角扫描机制处理方向对齐的高频组件,通过多维特征提取能够准确探测出异常现象。 第二,为了将大规模异常现象全面本地化,我们提议建立一个低频国家空间模型,实施频道适应性动态扫描机制,以保持全球背景下的结构性一致性,通过适应性特征整合,促进大规模异常现象探测。 最后,我们开发了一个动态空间增强块,通过协调的渠道间通信和适应性加固机制,通过增强特征多样性,改善异常特征的代表性。 关于基准异常现象探测数据集的全面实验表明,Wave-MambaAD以较低的参数和计算成本实现了竞争性业绩。

papers.title: VRBench: A Benchmark for Multi-Step Reasoning in Long Narrative Videos
papers.authors: Jiashuo Yu · Yue Wu · Meng Chu · Zhifei Ren · Zizheng Huang · Pei Chu · Ruijie Zhang · Yinan He · Qirui Li · Songze Li · Zhenxiang Li · Zhongying Tu · Conghui He · Yu Qiao · Yali Wang · Yi Wang · Limin Wang
papers.abstract: We present VRBench, the first long narrative video benchmark crafted for evaluating large models' multi-step reasoning capabilities, addressing limitations in existing evaluations that overlook temporal reasoning and procedural validity. It comprises 1,010 long videos (average duration 1.6 hours) along with 9,468 human-labeled multi-step question-answering pairs and 30,292 reasoning steps. These videos are curated via a multi-stage filtering process including expert inter-rater reviewing to prioritize plot coherence. We develop a human-AI collaborative framework that generates coherent reasoning processes, each requiring multiple temporally grounded steps, spanning seven types (e.g., event attribution, implicit inference). VRBench designs a multi-phase evaluation pipeline that both evaluates models from the outcome and process level. Apart from the MCQs for the final results, we propose two metrics for progress-level evaluation: (1) LLM-guided scoring for logical coherence and factual accuracy, and (2) Stepwise multiple choice question decomposition to validate causal progression. Through extensive evaluations of 12 LLMs and 16 VLMs on VRBench, we undertake a thorough analysis and provide valuable insights that advance the field of multi-step reasoning. VRBench will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: VRBENCH:长语视频多层次理由基准
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍VRBench,这是为评价大型模型的多步推理能力而设计的第一个长篇叙述性视频基准,以解决现有评价中忽视时间推理和程序有效性的局限性。 它包括1 010个长长的视频(平均持续1.6小时)以及9 468个人类标签的多步问答配对和30 292个推理步骤,这些视频通过一个多阶段过滤程序,包括专家间审查,以优先考虑地块的一致性。 我们制定了一个人类-AI协作框架,产生连贯一致的推理过程,每个过程都要求采取多重基于时间的步骤,涉及七种类型(例如事件归属、隐含的推论)。 VRBENCH设计了一个多阶段评价管道,既从结果层面评价模型,又从过程层面评价模型。 除了最终结果的MCQ标准外,我们还提出了两个进度评估标准:(1) 以LLM为指南的评分,以便实现逻辑一致性和事实准确性;(2) 分步选择的多重选择问题分解,以验证因果进展。 通过对关于VRBench的12个LMs和16个VLMs进行广泛评价,我们进行了透彻的分析,提供了宝贵的见解,推进了多步骤推理领域。

papers.title: VQA-Diff: Exploiting VQA and Diffusion for Zero-Shot Image-to-3D Vehicle Asset Generation in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yibo Liu · Zheyuan Yang · Guile Wu · Yuan REN · Kejian Lin · Liu Bingbing · Yang Liu · JINJUN SHAN
papers.abstract: Generating 3D vehicle assets from in-the-wild observations is crucial to autonomous driving. Existing image-to-3D methods cannot well address this problem because they learn generation merely from image RGB information without a deeper understanding of in-the-wild vehicles (such as car models, manufacturers, etc). This leads to their poor zero-shot prediction capability to handle real-world observations with occlusion or tricky viewing angles. To solve this problem, in this work, we propose VQA-Diff, a novel framework that leverages in-the-wild vehicle images to create photorealistic 3D vehicle assets for autonomous driving. VQA-Diff exploits the real-world knowledge inherited from the Large Language Model in the Visual Question Answering (VQA) model for robust zero-shot prediction and the rich image prior knowledge in Diffusion Models for structure and appearance generation. In particular, we utilize a multi-expert Diffusion Models strategy to generate the structure information and employ a subject-driven structure-controlled generation mechanism to model appearance information. As a result, without the necessity to learn from a large-scale image-to-3D vehicle dataset collected from the real world, VQA-Diff still has a robust zero-shot image-to-novel-view generation ability. We conduct experiments on various datasets, including Pascal 3D+, Waymo, and Objaverse, to demonstrate that VQA-Diff outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
papers.title_zh: VQA-Diff:利用VQA和为自动驱动的零热图像到3D车辆资产生成进行传播
papers.abstract_zh: 从现场观察中生成3D车辆资产对于自主驾驶至关重要。 现有的图像到3D方法无法很好地解决这一问题,因为它们仅仅从图像RGB信息中学习生成,而没有更深入地了解汽车模型、制造商等。 这导致他们处理现实世界观测的零射预测能力差,无法以隐蔽或微妙的角度进行真实世界观测。 为了解决这个问题,我们在这项工作中提出VQA-Diff,这是一个新颖的框架,它能利用汽车图像来创造具有摄影现实性的三维汽车资产,用于自动驾驶。 VQA-Diff利用视觉问答模型中大语言模型遗留下来的实世知识,以进行稳健的零射预测,并利用传播模型中先前在结构和外观生成方面的丰富形象知识。 特别是,我们利用多专家传播模式战略生成结构信息,并采用主题驱动、结构控制的生成机制模拟外观信息。 因此,VQA-Diff不必从从从现实世界收集的大规模图像到3D车辆数据集中学习,仍然拥有强大的零射图像到新奇图像生成能力。 我们对各种数据集进行实验,包括Pascal 3D+、Waymo和Objaverse,以证明VQA-Diff在质量和数量上都超过了现有的最新方法。

papers.title: VideoOrion: Tokenizing Object Dynamics in Videos
papers.authors: Yicheng Feng · Yijiang Li · Wanpeng Zhang · Sipeng Zheng · Hao Luo · Zihao Yue · Zongqing Lu
papers.abstract: We present VideoOrion, a Video Large Language Model (Video-LLM) that explicitly captures the key semantic information in videos—the spatial-temporal dynamics of objects throughout the videos. VideoOrion employs expert vision models to extract object dynamics through a detect-segment-track pipeline, encoding them into a set of object tokens by aggregating spatial-temporal object features. Our method addresses the persistent challenge in Video-LLMs of efficiently compressing high-dimensional video data into semantic tokens that are comprehensible to LLMs. Compared to prior methods which resort to downsampling the original video or aggregating visual tokens using resamplers, leading to information loss and entangled semantics, VideoOrion not only offers a more natural and efficient way to derive compact, disentangled semantic representations but also enables explicit object modeling of video content with minimal computational cost. Moreover, the introduced object tokens naturally allow VideoOrion to accomplish video-based referring tasks. Experimental results show that VideoOrion can learn to make good use of the object tokens, and achieves competitive results on both general video question answering and video-based referring benchmarks.
papers.title_zh: VideoOrition: 将对象动态化为视频
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出视频大语言视频模型(Video-LLM), 明确记录视频中关键语义信息, 视频视轨利用专家视觉模型,通过探测分解轨道管道提取物体动态,通过汇总时空物体特征将其编码成一组物体标志。 我们的方法是应对视频-LLMS中长期存在的挑战,即高效率地将高维视频数据压缩为可被LLMS所理解的语义符号。 与以前采用的方法相比,以前采用的方法是利用复苏器对原始视频进行取样或汇总视觉标识,导致信息丢失和相互缠绕的语义学,而视频Orion不仅提供了一种更自然、更有效的方法,可以产生紧凑、分解的语义表达方式,而且能够以最低的计算成本对视频内容进行明确对象建模。 此外,引入的天体标牌自然可以让视频Orion完成视频参考任务。 实验结果表明,视频Orion可以学习如何很好地利用天体标牌,并在一般视频答题和视频参考基准上实现竞争性结果。

papers.title: VideoAds: Where Opensource Foundation Models Beat GPT-4o & Gemini-1.5 Pro
papers.authors: Zheyuan Zhang · Wanying Dou · Linkai Peng · Hongyi Pan · Ulas Bagci · Boqing Gong
papers.abstract: Advertisement videos serve as a rich and valuable source of purpose-driven information, encompassing high-quality visual, textual, and contextual cues designed to engage viewers. They are often more complex than general videos of similar duration due to their structured narratives and rapid scene transitions, posing significant challenges to multi-modal large language models (MLLMs). In this work, we introduce VideoAds, the first dataset tailored for benchmarking the performance of MLLMs on advertisement videos. VideoAds comprises well-curated advertisement videos with complex temporal structures, accompanied by manually annotated diverse questions across three core tasks: visual finding, video summary, and visual reasoning. We propose a quantitative measure to compare VideoAds against existing benchmarks in terms of video complexity. Through extensive experiments, we find that Qwen2.5-VL-72B, an opensource MLLM, achieves 73.35 % accuracy on VideoAds, outperforming GPT-4o (66.82 %) and Gemini-1.5 Pro (69.66 %); the two proprietary models especially fall behind the opensource model in video summarization and reasoning, but perform the best in visual finding. Notably, human experts easily achieve a remarkable accuracy of 94.27 %. These results underscore the necessity of advancing MLLMs' temporal modeling capabilities and highlight VideoAds as a potentially pivotal benchmark for future research in video-language understanding. The dataset and evaluation code will be publicly available at url{https://videoadsbenchmark.netlify.app}.
papers.title_zh: 视频片段:在开放源码基金会模型击败GPT-4o & Gemini-1.5 Pro
papers.abstract_zh: 广告视频是目的驱动信息的一个丰富和宝贵的来源,包括高质量的视觉、文字和背景提示,旨在吸引观众。 由于其结构化叙述和迅速的场景过渡,它们往往比具有类似持续时间的一般录像更为复杂,对多模式大型语言模式(MLLM)构成重大挑战。 在这项工作中,我们介绍视频Ads,这是第一个为将MLLMS在广告视频上的性能设定基准而专门设计的数据集。 视频片段包括有复杂时间结构的精密广告视频,同时还有视觉发现、视频摘要和视觉推理这三项核心任务上人工加注的不同问题。 我们建议采取定量措施,将录像片段与视频复杂程度方面的现有基准进行比较。 通过广泛的实验,我们发现,Quen2.5-VL-72B(开放源码MLLM)在视频Ads上实现了73.35%的精度,优于GPT-4o(66.82%)和Gemini-1.5 Pro(69.66%);这两种专利模型在视频总结和推理方面特别落后于开源模型,但在视觉发现方面表现最佳。 值得注意的是,人类专家很容易达到94.27%的惊人精确度。 这些结果突出表明,必须提高MLLMS的时间建模能力,并突出视频Ads,作为今后在视频理解方面研究的潜在关键基准。 数据集和评价代码将在url{https://vieviaadsbenchmark.netlify.app}上公布。

papers.title: Unsupervised Shape and Pose Disentanglement for 3D Meshes
papers.authors: Keyang Zhou, Bharat Lal Bhatnagar, Gerard Pons-Moll
papers.abstract: Parametric models of humans, faces, hands and animals have been widely used for a range of tasks such as image-based reconstruction, shape correspondence estimation, and animation. Their key strength is the ability to factor surface variations into shape and pose dependent components. Learning such models requires lots of expert knowledge and hand-defined object-specific constraints, making the learning approach unscalable to novel objects. In this paper, we present a simple yet effective approach to learn disentangled shape and pose representations in an unsupervised setting. We use a combination of self-consistency and cross-consistency constraints to learn pose and shape space from registered meshes. We additionally incorporate as-rigid-as-possible deformation(ARAP) into the training loop to avoid degenerate solutions. We demonstrate the usefulness of learned representations through a number of tasks including pose transfer and shape retrieval. The experiments on datasets of 3D humans, faces, hands and animals demonstrate the generality of our approach. Code is made available at https://virtualhumans.mpi-inf.mpg.de/unsup_shape_pose/."
papers.title_zh: 3D Meshes 不受监督的形状和波贝分离
papers.abstract_zh: 人类、面部、手和动物的参数模型被广泛用于一系列任务,如基于图像的重建、通信估计和动画。 它们的关键力量是能够将表面变化因素转化为形状并构成依附成分。 学习这种模式需要大量专家知识和手定义的特定对象制约,使得学习方法无法适用于新对象。 在本文中,我们提出了一个简单而有效的方法来学习分解的形状和在无人监督的环境中进行表达。 我们用自相矛盾和自相矛盾的制约相结合的方法来从注册的甲草胺中学习形状和塑造空间。 我们还将可能发生的硬化变形(ARAP)纳入培训循环,以避免退化的解决方案。 我们通过包括外形转移和形状检索在内的若干任务,展示了有学识的表述的有用性,关于3D人、面部、手部和动物数据集的实验显示了我们方法的普遍性。 守则可在https://viltualhumans.mpi-inf.mpg.de/unsup_shape_pose/上查阅。”

papers.title: UniPortrait: A Unified Framework for Identity-Preserving Single- and Multi-Human Image Personalization
papers.authors: Junjie He · Yifeng Geng · Liefeng Bo
papers.abstract: This paper presents UniPortrait, an innovative human image personalization framework that unifies single- and multi-ID customization with high face fidelity, extensive facial editability, free-form input description, and diverse layout generation. UniPortrait consists of only two plug-and-play modules: an ID embedding module and an ID routing module. The ID embedding module extracts versatile editable facial features with a decoupling strategy for each ID and embeds them into the context space of diffusion models. The ID routing module then combines and distributes these embeddings adaptively to their respective regions within the synthesized image, achieving the customization of single and multiple IDs. With a carefully designed two-stage training scheme, UniPortrait achieves superior performance in both single- and multi-ID customization. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the advantages of our method over existing approaches as well as its good scalability, e.g., the universal compatibility with existing generative control tools.
papers.title_zh: 单一光线:身份保留、单一和多人形象个性化统一框架
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍一个创新的人类形象个性化框架UniPrait,这个框架将单一和多ID定制化,面部高度忠诚、面部可编辑性广泛、自由形式输入描述和多种布局生成统一起来。 UniPrait 由两个插件和游戏模块组成: 一个 ID 嵌入模块和一个 ID 路由模块。 ID 嵌入模块提取多种可编辑的面部功能, 配有每个ID 的解耦策略, 并将其嵌入扩展模型的背景空间 。 ID路由模块随后将这些嵌入的嵌入模块组合起来,并在综合图像中根据各自区域的具体情况予以分发,实现单个和多个标识的定制化。 通过精心设计的两阶段培训计划,UniPrait在单一和多ID定制方面都取得了优异的成绩。 定量和定性实验表明,我们的方法优于现有方法,而且具有良好的可伸缩性,例如,与现有基因控制工具的普遍兼容性。

papers.title: Unifying Visual Perception by Dispersible Points Learning
papers.authors: Jianming Liang, Guanglu Song, Biao Leng, Yu Liu
papers.abstract: "We present a conceptually simple, flexible, and universal visual perception head for variant visual tasks, e.g., classification, object detection, instance segmentation and pose estimation, and different frameworks, such as one-stage or two-stage pipelines. Our approach effectively identifies an object in an image while simultaneously generating a high-quality bounding box or contour-based segmentation mask or set of keypoints. The method, called UniHead, views different visual perception tasks as the dispersible points learning via the transformer encoder architecture. Given a fixed spatial coordinate, UniHead adaptively scatters it to different spatial points and reasons about their relations by transformer encoder. It directly outputs the final set of predictions in the form of multiple points, allowing us to perform different visual tasks in different frameworks with the same head design. We show extensive evaluations on ImageNet classification and all three tracks of the COCO suite of challenges, including object detection, instance segmentation and pose estimation. Without bells and whistles, UniHead can unify these visual tasks via a single visual head design and achieve comparable performance compared to expert models developed for each task. We hope our simple and universal UniHead will serve as a solid baseline and help promote universal visual perception research. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Sense-X/UniHead."
papers.title_zh: 通过分散点学习统一视觉感知
papers.abstract_zh: “我们为不同的视觉任务,例如分类、物体探测、例分解和估计,以及不同框架,例如一阶段或两阶段管道,提出了一个概念简单、灵活和通用的视觉感知头。 我们的方法在图像中有效地识别对象,同时生成一个高质量的捆绑框或基于等深线的分隔面罩或一组关键点。 这种方法叫做“UniHead ” , 将不同的视觉感知任务视为通过变压器编码器结构学习的分散点。 在固定的空间坐标下,Unicle Head通过变压器编码器将它分散到不同的空间点和关于它们之间关系的理由。 它直接以多点的形式提出最后一套预测,使我们能够在不同的框架内执行不同的视觉任务,设计相同的头。 我们展示了对图像网络分类的广泛评价,以及COCO系列挑战的所有三个轨道,包括物体探测、例分解和估计。 没有钟声和哨声,大学校长可以通过单一的视觉头部设计来统一这些视觉任务,并实现与为每项任务开发的专家模型相比的类似性能。 我们希望我们简单而通用的大学校长能够成为坚实的基线,帮助促进全视感知研究。 守则和模型可在https://github.com/Sense-X/Unihead上查阅。”

papers.title: Unified Local-Cloud Decision-Making via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Kathakoli Sengupta · Zhongkai Shangguan · Sandesh Bharadwaj · Sanjay Arora · Eshed Ohn-Bar · Renato Mancuso
papers.abstract: Embodied vision-based real-world systems, such as mobile robots, require careful balancing between energy consumption, compute latency, and safety constraints to optimize operation across dynamic tasks and contexts. As local computation tends to be restricted, offloading the computation, i.e., to a remote server, can save local resources while providing access to high-quality predictions from powerful and large models. Yet, the resulting communication and latency overhead has led to limited usability of cloud models in dynamic, safety-critical, real-time settings. Towards effectively addressing this trade-off, in this work, we introduce UniLCD, a novel hybrid inference framework for enabling flexible local-cloud collaboration. By efficiently optimizing a flexible routing module via reinforcement learning and a suitable multi-task objective, UniLCD is specifically designed to support multiple constraints of safety-critical end-to-end mobile systems. We validate the proposed approach using a challenging crowded navigation task requiring frequent and timely switching between local and cloud operations. UniLCD demonstrates both improved overall performance and efficiency, by over 17% compared to state-of-the-art baselines based on various split computing strategies.
papers.title_zh: 通过强化学习作出统一的地方-城市决策
papers.abstract_zh: 移动机器人等基于视觉的嵌入式现实世界系统需要谨慎地平衡能源消耗、计算延时性和安全限制,以便在动态任务和环境下优化运作。 由于本地计算往往受到限制,卸载计算,即向远程服务器卸载计算,可以节省当地资源,同时提供获得强大和大型模型高质量预测的机会。 然而,由此产生的通信和潜伏间接费用导致云模型在动态、安全、关键、实时环境下的可用性受到限制。 为了有效解决这一权衡问题,我们在这项工作中引入了“UniLCD ” ( UniLCD ) , 这是一种新颖的混合推论框架,有利于灵活的当地-集体协作。 通过通过强化学习和适当的多任务目标,高效率地优化一个灵活的路线模块,UniLCD是专门设计用来支持安全关键端对端移动系统的多重限制。 我们用艰巨的拥挤导航任务来验证拟议方法,这需要当地和云层操作之间频繁和及时的转换。 UNILCD显示总体性能和效率都有所改善,比基于各种分裂计算战略的最新基线提高了17%以上。

papers.title: Uncover Treasures in DCT: Advancing JPEG Quality Enhancement by Exploiting Latent Correlations
papers.authors: jing Yang · Qunliang Xing · Mai Xu · Minglang Qiao
papers.abstract: Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) achieves data compression by quantizing Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients, which inevitably introduces compression artifacts. Most existing JPEG quality enhancement methods operate in the pixel domain, suffering from the high computational costs of decoding. Consequently, direct enhancement of JPEG images in the DCT domain has gained increasing attention. However, current DCT-domain methods often exhibit limited performance. To address this challenge, we identify two critical types of correlations within the DCT coefficients of JPEG images. Building on this insight, we propose an Advanced DCT-domain JPEG Quality Enhancement (AJQE) method that fully exploits these correlations. The AJQE method enables the adaptation of numerous well-established pixel-domain models to the DCT domain, achieving superior performance with reduced computational complexity. Compared to the pixel-domain counterparts, the DCT-domain models derived by our method demonstrate a 0.35 dB improvement in PSNR and a 60.5% increase in enhancement throughput on average. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: DCT中未覆盖的宝藏:通过利用突发事件来提高JPEG质量
papers.abstract_zh: 联合摄影专家组(JPEG)通过量化不可避免引入压缩文物的分辨共生变异系数(DCT)实现数据压缩。 大部分现有的JPEG质量提高方法在像素领域运作,因为解码的计算成本很高。 因此,直接提升DCT域的JPEG图像得到越来越多的关注,然而,目前的DCT域方法往往表现有限,为了应对这一挑战,我们确定了JPEG图像DCT系数中的两种关键关联类型。 基于这一洞察力,我们提出了一种充分利用这些相互关系的高级DCT-域名JPEG质量提高(AJQE)方法。 AJQE方法使得许多成熟的像素-域名模型能够适应DCT领域,在计算复杂性降低的情况下实现优异性能。 与像素-域对等数据相比,通过我们的方法得出的DCT-域模型表明,PSNR改进了0.35 dB,平均增加60.5%的增强量。该代码将公布于众。

papers.title: TWIST & SCOUT: Grounding Multimodal LLM-Experts by Forget-Free Tuning
papers.authors: Aritra Bhowmik · Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani · Dennis Koelma · Yuki Asano · Martin Oswald · Cees Snoek
papers.abstract: Spatial awareness is key to enable embodied multimodal AI systems. Yet, without vast amounts of spatial supervision, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle at this task. In this paper, we introduce TWIST & SCOUT, a framework that equips pre-trained MLLMs with visual grounding ability without forgetting their existing image and language understanding skills. To this end, we propose TWIST, a twin-expert stepwise tuning module that modifies the decoder of the language model using one frozen module pre-trained on image understanding tasks and another learnable one for visual grounding tasks. This allows the MLLM to retain previously learned knowledge and skills, while acquiring what is missing. To fine-tune the model effectively, we generate a high-quality synthetic dataset we call SCOUT, which mimics human reasoning in visual grounding. This dataset provides rich supervision signals, describing a step-by-step multimodal reasoning process, thereby simplifying the task of visual grounding. We evaluate our approach on several standard benchmark datasets, encompassing grounded image captioning, zero-shot localization, and visual grounding tasks. Our method consistently delivers strong performance across all tasks, while retaining the pre-trained image understanding capabilities.
papers.title_zh: TWIST & SCOUT: 以免忘调试的方式将多模式LLM-专家设为禁地
papers.abstract_zh: 空间意识是促成体现多式通用语言系统的关键所在,然而,在缺乏大量空间监督的情况下,当前多式大语言模式在这项任务上挣扎不已。 在本文中,我们介绍TWIST & SCOUT, 这个框架让经过训练的MLLMs具备视觉定位能力, 为此,我们提议TWIST,这是一个双专家分步调制模块,它使用一个在图像理解任务方面经过预先培训的冻结模块和另一个用于视觉定位任务的可学习模块,对语言模式的解码器进行修改。 这使得MLLM能够保留先前学到的知识和技能,同时获得缺失的东西。 为了有效地微调模型,我们产生了一个高质量的合成数据集,我们称之为SCOUT,它模仿视觉地面的人类推理。 这一数据集提供了丰富的监督信号,描述了一个渐进式多式联运推理过程,从而简化了视觉定位任务。 我们评估了我们在若干标准基准数据集上的做法,其中包括有根有据的图像字幕、零投影本地化和视觉定位任务。 我们的方法始终不渝地在所有任务中提供强有力的业绩,同时保留经过培训的图像理解能力。

papers.title: Triad: Empowering LMM-based Anomaly Detection with Expert-guided Region-of-Interest Tokenizer and Manufacturing Process
papers.authors: Yuanze Li · Shihao Yuan · Haolin Wang · Qizhang Li · Ming Liu · Chen Xu · Guangming Shi · Wangmeng Zuo
papers.abstract: Although recent methods have tried to introduce large multimodal models (LMMs) into industrial anomaly detection (IAD), their generalization in the IAD field is far inferior to that for general purposes. We summarize the main reasons for this gap into two aspects. On one hand, general-purpose LMMs lack cognition of defects in the visual modality, thereby failing to sufficiently focus on defect areas. Therefore, we propose to modify the AnyRes structure of the LLaVA model, providing the potential anomalous areas identified by existing IAD models to the LMMs. On the other hand, existing methods mainly focus on identifying defects by learning defect patterns or comparing with normal samples, yet they fall short of understanding the causes of these defects. Considering that the generation of defects is closely related to the manufacturing process, we propose a manufacturing-driven IAD paradigm. An instruction-tuning dataset for IAD (InstructIAD) and a data organization approach for Chain-of-Thought with manufacturing (CoT-M) are designed to leverage the manufacturing process for IAD. Based on the above two modifications, we present Triad, a novel LMM-based method incorporating an expert-guided region-of-interest tokenizer and manufacturing process for industrial anomaly detection. Extensive experiments show that our Triad not only demonstrates competitive performance against current LMMs but also achieves further improved accuracy when equipped with manufacturing processes. Source code, training data, and pre-trained models will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 三合一:赋予以LMM 为基础的以LMM为基础的以专家指导的感兴趣地区和制造过程为基础的非正常检测能力
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然最近的一些方法试图将大型多式联运模式(LMMs)引入工业异常现象检测(IAD),但在IAD领域,这些模式的概括性远远低于一般目的,我们将造成这一差距的主要原因归纳为两个方面。 一方面,一般用途LMM系统缺乏对视觉模式缺陷的认知,因此未能充分关注缺陷领域,因此,我们提议修改LLAVA模型的AnyRes结构,向LVA模型提供现有IAD模型确定的潜在异常领域。 另一方面,现有方法主要侧重于通过学习缺陷模式或与正常样本进行比较来查明缺陷,但无法理解这些缺陷的原因。 考虑到缺陷的产生与制造过程密切相关,我们建议采用由制造部门驱动的内部审计司模式。 设计IAD(InstructIAD)的指令调整数据集和与制造有关的研究链(CoT-M)的数据组织办法,目的是利用IAD的制造过程。 根据上述两项修改,我们介绍三合会,这是一种基于LMM的新颖的LMM方法,其中含有专家指导的利息地区代用品和工业异常现象检测制造过程。 广泛的实验表明,我们的三合会不仅展示了与目前的LMM相比的竞争性表现,而且在配备制造工艺时也进一步提高了准确性。 源码、培训数据和预培训模型将公开提供。

papers.title: TREAD: Token Routing for Efficient Architecture-agnostic Diffusion Training
papers.authors: Felix Krause · Timy Phan · Ming Gui · Stefan A. Baumann · Vincent Tao Hu · Björn Ommer
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as the mainstream approach for visual generation. However, these models typically suffer from sample inefficiency and high training costs. Consequently, methods for efficient finetuning, inference and personalization were quickly adopted by the community. However, training these models in the first place still remains very costly. While several recent approaches—including masking, distillation, and architectural modifications—have been proposed to improve training efficiency, each of these methods comes with its own tradeoffs: some achieve enhanced performance at the expense of increased computational cost. In contrast, this work aims to improve training efficiency as well as generative performance at the same time through routes that act as transport mechanism for randomly selected tokens from early layers to deeper layers of the model. Our method is not limited to the common transformer-based model - it can also be applied to state-space models and achieves this without architectural modifications or additional parameters. Finally, we show that TREAD reduces the computational cost and simultaneously boosts model performance on the standard benchmark ImageNet-256 in class-conditional synthesis. Both of these benefits multiply to a convergence speedup of 14x at 400K training iterations compared to DiT and 37x compared to the best benchmark performance of DiT at 7M training iterations. Further, we achieve a competitive FID of 2.09 in a guided and 3.93 in an unguided setting which improves upon the DiT, without architectural changes. We will release our code.
papers.title_zh: TREAD: 高效建筑-不可知传播培训的当心路
papers.abstract_zh: 传播模型已成为视觉生成的主流方法,但这些模型通常因抽样的低效率和高培训成本而受到影响,因此,社区迅速采用了高效微调、推论和个性化的方法。 然而,首先培训这些模式的费用仍然很高。 虽然最近提出了若干办法,包括掩蔽、蒸馏和建筑改造,以提高培训效率,但其中每一种方法都有其自身的权衡:有些方法以增加计算费用为代价,提高了业绩。 与此形成对照的是,这项工作的目的是提高培训效率,同时通过作为随机选择代用品的运输机制的路线,提高培训效率,提高基因性能,从模型的早期到更深的层次。 我们的方法并不限于通用的变压器模型----它也可以适用于州空间模型,在没有建筑修改或附加参数的情况下实现这一点。 最后,我们证明TREAD降低了计算成本,同时提升了标准基准图像网络256在等级条件合成中的模型性能。 与DiT和37x相比,与DiT在7M培训迭代的最佳基准业绩相比,这两个好处都增加了14倍的趋同速度,在400K培训迭代时达到14倍,而DiT在7M培训迭代时达到37倍。 此外,我们还在无制导环境中实现了2.09的竞争性FID,在无制导环境中实现了3.93的竞争性FID,在不改变建筑的情况下改进了DIT,我们将发布我们的代码。

papers.title: Training A Small Emotional Vision Language Model for Visual Art Comprehension
papers.authors: Jing Zhang · Liang Zheng · Meng Wang · Dan Guo
papers.abstract: This paper develops small vision language models to understand visual art, which, given an art work, aims to identify its emotion category and explain this prediction with natural language. While small models are computationally efficient, their capacity is much limited compared with large models. To break this trade-off, this paper builds a small emotional vision language model (SEVLM) by emotion modeling and input-output feature alignment. On the one hand, based on valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) knowledge annotated by psychology experts, we introduce and fuse emotional features derived through VAD dictionary and a VAD head to align VAD vectors of predicted emotion explanation and the ground truth. This allows the vision language model to better understand and generate emotional texts, compared with using traditional text embeddings alone. On the other hand, we design a contrastive head to pull close embeddings of the image, its emotion class, and explanation, which aligns model outputs and inputs. On two public affective explanation datasets, we show that the proposed techniques consistently improve the visual art understanding performance of baseline SEVLMs. Importantly, the proposed model can be trained and evaluated on a single RTX 2080 Ti while exhibiting very strong performance: it not only outperforms the state-of-the-art small models but is also competitive compared with LLaVA 7B after fine-tuning and GPT4(V). Code will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 为视觉艺术理解培训一个小型情感视觉视觉语言模式
papers.abstract_zh: 本文开发了理解视觉艺术的小型视觉语言模型,在艺术作品中,这些模型旨在识别其情感类别,用自然语言解释这一预测。 虽然小型模型在计算上效率很高,但与大型模型相比,其能力非常有限。 为了打破这一权衡,本文通过情感建模和投入-产出特征协调,建立了一个小型情感视觉语言模型(SEVLM)。 一方面,根据心理学专家附加说明的VAD(VAD)知识,我们引入并融合了通过VAD字典和VAD(VAD)头部获得的情感特征,将VAD(VAD)的预期情感解释矢量与地面真相联系起来。 与仅仅使用传统文本嵌入方式相比,这让视觉语言模型能够更好地理解和生成情感文字。 另一方面,我们设计了一个对比鲜明的脑袋来拉动图像、其情感阶级和解释的紧密嵌入,它们将模型产出和投入结合起来。 关于两个公开的情感解释数据集,我们表明,拟议的技术不断提高基线SEVLMS的视觉艺术理解性能。 重要的是,提议的模式可以在单一RTX 2080 Ti上进行训练和评价,同时表现出很强的性能:它不仅优于最先进的小型模型,而且与经过微调的LALAVA 7B和GPT4(V)相比,具有竞争力。 守则将公布于众。

papers.title: TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D Models for Category-unified 3D Point Cloud Tracking
papers.authors: Mengmeng Wang · Haonan Wang · Yulong Li · Xiangjie Kong · Jiaxin Du · Feng Xia · Guojiang Shen
papers.abstract: 3D LiDAR-based single object tracking (SOT) relies on sparse and irregular point clouds, posing challenges from geometric variations in scale, motion patterns, and structural complexity across object categories. Current category-specific approaches achieve good accuracy but are impractical for real-world use, requiring separate models for each category and showing limited generalization.To tackle these issues, we propose TrackAny3D, the first framework to transfer large-scale pretrained 3D models for category-agnostic 3D SOT. We first integrate parameter-efficient adapters to bridge the gap between pretraining and tracking tasks while preserving geometric priors. Then, we introduce a Mixture-of-Geometry-Experts (MoGE) architecture that adaptively activates specialized subnetworks based on distinct geometric characteristics. Additionally, we design a temporal context optimization strategy that incorporates learnable temporal tokens and a dynamic mask weighting module to propagate historical information and mitigate temporal drift.Experiments on three commonly-used benchmarks show that TrackAny3D establishes new state-of-the-art performance on category-agnostic 3D SOT, demonstrating strong generalization and competitiveness. We hope this work will enlighten the community on the importance of unified models and further expand the use of large-scale pretrained models in this field. The source code will be released.
papers.title_zh: 音轨 Any3D: 传输 3D 类统一三维点云跟踪的预先训练的3D 模型
papers.abstract_zh: 以 3D LiDAR 为基础的基于LIDAR 的单一物体跟踪(SOT) 依赖稀少和不规则的点云,这带来了规模、运动模式和不同物体类别结构复杂性等几何变化的挑战。 为解决这些问题,我们提议ChontAny3D,这是第一个将经过预先培训的大规模3D模型转让给类别不可知的3D SOT的框架。 我们首先整合了具有参数效率的适应器,以弥合培训前任务和跟踪任务之间的差距,同时保留几何前科。 然后,我们引入了一种基于不同几何特征适应性地激活专门子网络的模型结构。 此外,我们设计了一个时间环境优化战略,其中包括可学习的时间标志和一个动态面罩加权模块,以传播历史信息并减缓时间漂移。 对三个常用基准的实验显示,ControlAny3D在3D SOT类不可知性3D SOT上建立了新的SOTA 性能,显示了强大的概括性和竞争力。 我们希望,这项工作将使社区了解统一模式的重要性,并进一步扩大在这一领域使用大规模预先培训模式,源代码将予公布。

papers.title: Think2Drive: Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Thinking with Latent World Model for Autonomous Driving (in CARLA-v2)
papers.authors: Qifeng Li · Xiaosong Jia · Shaobo Wang · Junchi Yan
papers.abstract: Real-world autonomous driving (AD) especially urban driving involves many corner cases. The lately released AD simulator CARLA v2 adds 39 common events in the driving scene, and provides more quasi-realistic testbed compared to CARLA v1. It poses new challenges to the community and so far no literature has reported any success on the new scenarios in V2 as existing works mostly have to rely on specific rules for planning yet they cannot cover the more complex cases in CARLA v2. In this work, we take the initiative of directly training a planner and the hope is to handle the corner cases flexibly and effectively, which we believe is also the future of AD. To our best knowledge, we develop the first model-based RL method named Think2Drive for AD, with a world model to learn the transitions of the environment, and then it acts as a neural simulator to train the planner. This paradigm significantly boosts the training efficiency due to the low dimensional state space and parallel computing of tensors in the world model. As a result, Think2Drive is able to run in an expert-level proficiency in CARLA v2 within 3 days of training on a single A6000 GPU, and to our best knowledge, so far there is no reported success (100 % route completion) on CARLA v2. We also propose CornerCaseRepo, a benchmark that supports the evaluation of driving models by scenarios. Additionally, we propose a new and balanced metric to evaluate the performance by route completion, infraction number, and scenario density, so that the driving score could give more information about the actual driving performance.
papers.title_zh: 思考2Drive:通过思考原始世界自主驾驶模式提高学习效率(CARLA-v2)
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界自主驾驶(AD),特别是城市驾驶(AD)涉及许多角落案例。 最近发布的AD模拟器CARLA v2在驾驶场增加了39个常见事件,提供了比CARLA v1更准现实的测试床。 它给社区带来了新的挑战,到目前为止,没有任何文献报告在V2中的新情景方面取得了任何成功,因为现有的工程大多要依赖具体的规划规则,但它们无法涵盖CARLA v2中较复杂的案例。 在这项工作中,我们主动直接培训一名规划人员,希望灵活和有效地处理转角案件,我们认为这也是AD的未来。 据我们所知,我们开发了第一种基于模型的RL方法,名为DAD的DEG2Drive, 这是一种学习环境转型的世界模型, 然后它作为神经模拟器来训练规划者。 由于世界模型中的低维状态空间和对数以万计的平行计算,这一模式大大提高了培训效率。 因此, " 思考2Drive " 能够在单一A6000GPU培训后3天内以专家水平参加CARLA v2, 据我们所知,到目前为止,据报告,CARLA v2没有成功(100%的路线完成)。 我们还提议CornerCaseRepo,这是一个支持按情景评价驱动模型的基准。 此外,我们提议采用新的、平衡的衡量标准,按路线完成、违规次数和情景密度来评价业绩,以便驾驶分数能提供更多关于实际驾驶业绩的信息。

papers.title: The Surprisingly Straightforward Scene Text Removal Method with Gated Attention and Region of Interest Generation: A Comprehensive Prominent Model Analysis
papers.authors: Hyeonsu Lee, Chankyu Choi
papers.abstract: "Scene text removal (STR), a task of erasing text from natural scene images, has recently attracted attention as an important component of editing text or concealing private information such as ID, telephone, and license plate numbers. While there are a variety of different methods for STR actively being researched, it is difficult to evaluate superiority because previously proposed methods do not use the same standardized training/evaluation dataset. We use the same standardized training/testing dataset to evaluate the performance of several previous methods after standardized re-implementation. We also introduce a simple yet extremely effective Gated Attention (GA) and Region-of-Interest Generation (RoIG) methodology in this paper. GA uses attention to focus on the text stroke as well as the textures and colors of the surrounding regions to remove text from the input image much more precisely. RoIG is applied to focus on only the region with text instead of the entire image to train the model more efficiently. Experimental results on the benchmark dataset show that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in almost all metrics with remarkably higher-quality results. Furthermore, because our model does not generate a text stroke mask explicitly, there is no need for additional refinement steps or sub-models, making our model extremely fast with fewer parameters. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/naver/garnet."
papers.title_zh: 令人惊讶的直向直向直流场景文本清除方法,引人关注,引人关注,引人关注,引人关注,引人关注,引人关注,引人关注:综合性著名模型分析
papers.abstract_zh: “扫描文字删除(STR)是一项从自然场景图像中删除文字的任务, 最近引起注意, 成为编辑文字或隐藏私密信息的重要内容, 例如身份证、电话、车牌号码等。 虽然积极研究的可疑交易报告有各种不同的方法,但很难评价优越性,因为以前提出的方法没有使用同样的标准化培训/评价数据集。 我们使用同样的标准化培训/测试数据集,在标准化的重新实施后,评价以前若干方法的性能,并在本文中采用简单但极为有效的 " 关注 " (GA)和 " 热心一代区域 " (RoIG)方法。 GA 关注关注文字中风以及周围区域的纹理和颜色,以便更精确地从输入图像中删除文字。 ROIG 用于只关注带文字的区域,而不是整个图像,以便更有效地培训模型。 基准数据集的实验结果显示,我们的方法在几乎所有质量显著提高的计量标准中都大大优于现有最先进方法。 此外,由于我们的模型没有明确地产生文字中风面具,因此没有必要采取进一步的改进步骤或子模型,使我们的模型以较少的参数非常快。 数据集和代码可在https://github.com/naver/garnet上查阅。

papers.title: StyleBabel: Artistic Style Tagging and Captioning
papers.authors: Dan Ruta, Andrew Gilbert, Pranav Aggarwal, Naveen Marri, Ajinkya Kale, Jo Briggs, Chris Speed, Hailin Jin, Baldo Faieta, Alex Filipkowski, Zhe Lin, John Collomosse
papers.abstract: "We present StyleBabel, a unique open access dataset of natural language captions and free-form tags describing the artistic style of over 135K digital artworks, collected via a novel participatory method from experts studying at specialist art and design schools. StyleBabel was collected via an iterative method, inspired by ‘Grounded Theory’: a qualitative approach that enables annotation while co-evolving a shared language for fine-grained artistic style attribute description. We demonstrate several downstream tasks for StyleBabel, adapting the recent ALADIN architecture for fine-grained style similarity, to train cross-modal embeddings for: 1) free-form tag generation; 2) natural language description of artistic style; 3) fine-grained text search of style. To do so, we extend ALADIN with recent advances in Visual Transformer (ViT) and cross-modal representation learning, achieving a state of the art accuracy in fine-grained style retrieval."
papers.title_zh: 样式Babel: 艺术风格标签和标题
papers.abstract_zh: “我们介绍StyleBabel, 这是一套独特的开放访问自然语言字幕数据集, 以及描述超过135K位数字艺术作品艺术风格的自由形式标签, StyleBabel是通过一种迭接方法收集的,受“圆形理论”的启发:一种质化方法,既能进行批注,又能共同为精细雕刻艺术风格属性描述开发一种共同语言。 我们为StyleBabel展示了几项下游任务,将最近ALADIN结构调整为精细的风格相似性,以培训跨模式嵌入:1) 自由制标签生成;2) 艺术风格的自然语言描述;3) 精细制成的风格文本搜索。 为了做到这一点,我们将ALADIN与视觉Transformer(VIT)和跨模式代表性学习的最新进展相扩展,

papers.title: Style-Agnostic Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Juyong Lee, Seokjun Ahn, Jaesik Park
papers.abstract: "We present a novel method of learning style-agnostic representation using both style transfer and adversarial learning in the reinforcement learning framework. The style, here, refers to task-irrelevant details such as the color of the background in the images, where generalizing the learned policy across environments with different styles is still a challenge. Focusing on learning style-agnostic representations, our method trains the actor with diverse image styles generated from an inherent adversarial style perturbation generator, which plays a min-max game between the actor and the generator, without demanding expert knowledge for data augmentation or additional class labels for adversarial training. We verify that our method achieves competitive or better performances than the state-of-the-art approaches on Procgen and Distracting Control Suite benchmarks, and further investigate the features extracted from our model, showing that the model better captures the invariants and is less distracted by the shifted style. The code is available at https://github.com/POSTECH-CVLab/style-agnostic-RL."
papers.title_zh: 风格学强化学习
papers.abstract_zh: “我们展示了一种新颖的学习风格-不可知的代表性方法, 使用风格转移和在强化学习框架中的对抗学习。 此处的样式指的是任务无关的细节, 如图像背景的颜色, 将学习到的政策推广到不同风格的环境, 仍是一个挑战 。 我们的方法侧重于学习风格和不可知性的表现,用一种固有的对抗性风格扰动生成器所产生的不同图像风格来培训演员,该生成器在演员和生成器之间玩一个微调的游戏,而不需要掌握数据增强或为对抗性培训增加类别标签方面的专业知识。 我们核查我们的方法是否取得了比先质和扰动控制套件基准最先进的方法更具有竞争力或更好的业绩,并进一步调查从我们模型中提取的特征,表明模型更好地捕捉了变异因素,较少被变化的风格分心。 该代码可在https://github.com/POSTECH-CVLab/style-novistic-RL上查阅。

papers.title: StreamMind: Unlocking Full Frame Rate Streaming Video Dialogue through Event-Gated Cognition
papers.authors: Xin Ding · Hao Wu · Yifan Yang · Shiqi Jiang · Qianxi Zhang · Donglin Bai · Zhibo Chen · Ting Cao
papers.abstract: With the rise of real-world human-AI interaction applications, such as AI assistants, the need for Streaming Video Dialogue is critical. To address this need, we introduce StreamMind, a video LLM framework that achieves ultra-FPS streaming video processing (100 fps on a single A100) and enables proactive, always-on responses in real time, without explicit user intervention. To solve the key challenge of the contradiction between linear video streaming speed and quadratic transformer computation cost, we propose a novel perception-cognition interleaving paradigm named ''event-gated LLM invocation'', in contrast to the existing per-time-step LLM invocation. By introducing a Cognition Gate network between the video encoder and the LLM, LLM is only invoked when relevant events occur. To realize the event feature extraction with constant cost, we propose Event-Preserving Feature Extractor (EPFE) based on state-space method, generating a single perception token for spatiotemporal features. These techniques enable the video LLM with full-FPS perception and real-time cognition response. Experiments on Ego4D and SoccerNet streaming tasks, as well as standard offline benchmarks, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both model capability and real-time efficiency, paving the way for ultra-high-FPS applications, such as Game AI Copilot and interactive media.
papers.title_zh: StreamMind: 通过事件定位认知解锁全框架速率流动视频对话框
papers.abstract_zh: 随着诸如大赦国际助理等现实世界人类-大赦国际互动应用的兴起,必须开展视频对话。 为满足这一需要,我们引入了StreamMind,这是一个视频LLM框架,它实现超功能、节能、流动视频处理(单一A100上100个fps),并能够实时作出主动、始终如一的反应,而没有明确的用户干预。 为了解决线性视频流速度和二次变压器计算成本之间矛盾的关键挑战, 我们提出一个新的概念认知互换模式, 名为“ 活动加载 LLM 援引 ” , 与现有的每时段LLM 引用不同 。 通过引入视频编码器和LLM之间的认知门网络,LLM只在相关事件发生时才被援引。 为了以恒定成本实现事件特征提取,我们提议基于州空间方法的“事件保存特征提取器 ” ( EPFE ) , 为时空特征制作一个单一的感知标志。 这些技术使得视频LLM能够具有完整的FPS感知和实时认知响应。 Ego4D和SoccerNet流成任务实验,以及标准离线基准,显示了模型能力和实时效率方面的最先进业绩,为超高的FPS应用,如Game AI 联合驾驶和交互式媒体铺平了道路。

papers.title: SMoLoRA: Exploring and Defying Dual Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Visual Instruction Tuning
papers.authors: Ziqi Wang · Chang Che · Qi Wang · Yangyang Li · Zenglin Shi · Meng Wang
papers.abstract: Visual instruction tuning (VIT) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to effectively handle a wide range of vision tasks by framing them as language-based instructions. Building on this, continual visual instruction tuning (CVIT) extends the capability of MLLMs to incrementally learn new tasks, accommodating evolving functionalities. While prior work has advanced CVIT through the development of new benchmarks and approaches to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, these efforts largely follow traditional continual learning paradigms, neglecting the unique challenges specific to CVIT. We identify a dual form of catastrophic forgetting in CVIT, where MLLMs not only forget previously learned visual understanding but also experience a decline in instruction following abilities as they acquire new tasks. To address this, we introduce the Separable Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation (SMoLoRA) framework, which employs separable routing through two distinct modules—one for visual understanding and another for instruction following. This dual-routing design enables specialized adaptation in both domains, preventing forgetting while improving performance. Furthermore, we propose a new CVIT benchmark that goes beyond existing benchmarks by additionally evaluating a model's ability to generalize to unseen tasks and handle diverse instructions across various tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMoLoRA outperforms existing methods in mitigating dual forgetting, improving generalization to unseen tasks, and ensuring robustness in following diverse instructions.
papers.title_zh: SMoLORA:探索和战胜在连续视觉教学中遗忘的双重灾难
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉教育调整使多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)能够有效地处理广泛的视觉任务,将其设计成基于语言的指示。 在此基础上,持续视觉教学调整(CVIT)扩大了MLLMS的能力,以逐步学习新任务,适应不断演变的功能。 虽然以前的工作通过制定新的基准和办法,减轻灾难性的遗忘现象,推进了CVIT,但这些努力基本上遵循传统的持续学习模式,忽视了CVIT特有的独特挑战。 我们在CVIT中发现了一种灾难性遗忘的双重形式,在那里,MLLMS不仅忘记了以前学到的视觉理解,而且在获得新任务时,在学习能力后,教学也有所下降。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了 " 低Rank适应的可分离混合体(SMoLORA)框架 " ,该框架通过两个不同的模块(一个用于视觉理解,另一个用于随后的教学)采用可分离的路线。 这种双轨制设计能够在这两个领域进行专门调整,防止遗忘,同时改善业绩。 此外,我们提议新的国际热带木材中心基准,该基准超越现有基准,进一步评价一个模型是否有能力推广到看不见的任务,并处理不同任务的不同指示。 广泛的实验表明,SMoLORA在减少双重遗忘、改进对不可见任务的概括化和确保遵循不同指示的稳健性方面比现有的方法要好。

papers.title: Sketching Image Gist: Human-Mimetic Hierarchical Scene Graph Generation
papers.authors: Wenbin Wang, Ruiping Wang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen
papers.abstract: Scene graph aims to faithfully reveal humans' perception of image content. When humans analyze a scene, they usually prefer to describe image gist first, namely major objects and key relations in a scene graph. This humans' inherent perceptive habit implies that there exists a hierarchical structure about humans' preference during the scene parsing procedure. Therefore, we argue that a desirable scene graph should be also hierarchically constructed, and introduce a new scheme for modeling scene graph. Concretely, a scene is represented by a human-mimetic Hierarchical Entity Tree (HET) consisting of a series of image regions. To generate a scene graph based on HET, we parse HET with a Hybrid Long Short-Term Memory (Hybrid-LSTM) which specifically encodes hierarchy and siblings context to capture the structured information embedded in HET. To further prioritize key relations in the scene graph, we devise a Relation Ranking Module (RRM) to dynamically adjust their rankings by learning to capture humans' subjective perceptive habits from objective entity saliency and size. Experiments indicate that our method not only achieves state-of-the-art performances for scene graph generation, but also is expert in mining image-specific relations which play a great role in serving downstream tasks. "
papers.title_zh: 雕刻图像 Gist: 人类-分子等级地貌图生成
papers.abstract_zh: 场景图旨在忠实地揭示人类对图像内容的看法。 当人类分析场景时,他们通常倾向于首先描述图像格子,即主要物体和关键关系。 这种人类固有的感知习惯意味着在现场分析过程中存在关于人类偏好的等级结构。 因此,我们认为,理想的场景图也应按等级结构构建,并引入新的模型化场景图方案。 具体地说,一幕由一系列图像区域组成的人类模拟等级实体树(HET)所呈现。 为了生成基于HET的场景图,我们用一个混合的短期内存(Hybrid-LSTM)来分析HET,其中专门编码了等级和兄弟姐妹背景,以捕捉HET所含的结构化信息。 为了进一步确定景象图中关键关系的优先次序,我们设计了一个关系分级模块(RRM),以便通过学习从客观实体的显著性和大小中捕捉人类主观感知习惯来动态调整其排名。 实验表明,我们的方法不仅在现场图表生成方面达到最新水平,而且也是采矿图象特有关系方面的专家,在为下游任务服务方面发挥着重大作用。 "

papers.title: SITE: towards Spatial Intelligence Thorough Evaluation
papers.authors: Wenqi Wang · Reuben Tan · Pengyue Zhu · Jianwei Yang · Zhengyuan Yang · Lijuan Wang · Andrey Kolobov · Jianfeng Gao · Boqing Gong
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence (SI) represents a cognitive ability encompassing the visualization, manipulation, and reasoning about spatial relationships, underpinning disciplines from neuroscience to robotics. We introduce SITE, a benchmark dataset towards SI Thorough Evaluation in a standardized format of multi-choice visual question-answering, designed to assess large vision-language models’s spatial intelligence across diverse visual modalities (single-image, multi-image, and video) and SI factors (figural to environmental scales, spatial visualization and orientation, intrinsic and extrinsic, static and dynamic). Our approach to curating the benchmark combines a bottom-up survey about 31 existing datasets and a top-down strategy drawing upon three classification systems in cognitive science, which prompt us to design two novel types of tasks about view-taking and dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments reveal that leading models fall behind human experts especially in spatial orientation, a fundamental SI factor. Moreover, we demonstrate a positive correlation between a model’s spatial reasoning proficiency and its performance on an em bodied AI task. Code and data will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: STITE:走向空间情报彻底评估
papers.abstract_zh: 空间情报(SI)代表一种认知能力,包括可视化、操纵和关于空间关系的推理,支撑从神经科学到机器人学的学科。 我们引入了SITE,这是SI彻底评价的基准数据集,采用标准格式,采用多种选择式视觉问答,旨在评估大型视觉语言模型的空间情报,涵盖各种视觉模式(单一图像、多图像和视频)和SI要素(环境尺度、空间可视化和定向、内在和外在、静态和动态)。 我们确定基准的方法结合了大约31个现有数据集的自下而上调查以及借鉴认知科学三个分类系统的自上而下战略,这促使我们设计两种关于视觉和动态场景的新任务。 广泛的实验表明,领先模型落后于人类专家,特别是在空间定向方面,空间定位是国际科学学会的基本因素。 此外,我们证明模型的空间推理熟练度与其在全方位的AI任务上的表现之间存在正相关关系。 代码和数据将公布于众。

papers.title: Should All Proposals Be Treated Equally in Object Detection?
papers.authors: Yunsheng Li, Yinpeng Chen, Xiyang Dai, Dongdong Chen, Mengchen Liu, Pei Yu, Ying Jin, Lu Yuan, Zicheng Liu, Nuno Vasconcelos
papers.abstract: "The complexity-precision trade-off of an object detector is a critical problem for resource constrained vision tasks. Previous works have emphasized detectors implemented with efficient backbones. The impact on this trade-off of proposal processing by the detection head is investigated in this work. It is hypothesized that improved detection efficiency requires a paradigm shift, towards the unequal processing of proposals, assigning more computation to good proposals than poor ones. This results in better utilization of available computational budget, enabling higher accuracy for the same FLOPS. We formulate this as a learning problem where the goal is to assign operators to proposals, in the detection head, so that the total computational cost is constrained and the precision is maximized. The key finding is that such matching can be learned as a function that maps each proposal embedding into a one-hot code over operators. While this function induces a complex dynamic network routing mechanism, it can be implemented by a simple MLP and learned end-to-end with off-the-shelf object detectors. This it dynamic proposal processing (DPP) is shown to outperform state-of-the-art end-to-end object detectors (DETR, Sparse R-CNN) by a clear margin for a given computational complexity."
papers.title_zh: 所有提案在物体探测中应否同等对待?
papers.abstract_zh: “物体探测器的复杂精密取舍是资源受限的视觉任务的一个关键问题。以前的工作强调用高效的骨干执行探测器。在这项工作中,将调查探测头处理的投标书对权衡的影响。 据推测,提高检测效率需要范式转变,转向处理建议书的不平等,对好建议书的计算比对差建议书的计算要多,这导致更好地利用现有的计算预算,使相同的FLOPS的精确度提高。 我们将此作为一个学习问题来阐述,其目标是在检测头指派操作员提出建议,以便限制总计算成本,使精确度最大化。 关键发现是,这种匹配可以作为一种功能来学习,它可以将每个提案都嵌入操作员的单热代码中。虽然这一功能会引发复杂的动态网络路由机制,但可以通过简单的 MLP 实施,并与现成的天体探测器学习端对端。 这种动态的投标书处理(DPP)显示,在计算复杂度方面,这种动态的投标书处理(DPP)显然比最新的端对端天体探测器(DETR、Sparse R-CNN)的表现要好得多。

papers.title: Shot by Shot: Film-Grammar-Aware Training-Free Audio Description Generation
papers.authors: Junyu Xie · Tengda Han · Max Bain · Arsha Nagrani · Eshika Khandelwal · Gül Varol · Weidi Xie · Andrew Zisserman
papers.abstract: Our objective is automatic generation of Audio Descriptions (ADs) for edited video material, such as movies and TV series. To achieve this, we propose a two-stage framework that leverages "shots" as the fundamental units of video understanding. This includes extending temporal context to neighboring shots and incorporating film grammar devices, such as shot scales and thread structures, to guide AD generation. Our method is compatible with both open-source and proprietary Visual-Language Models (VLMs), integrating expert knowledge from add-on modules without requiring additional training of the VLMs. We achieve state-of-the-art performance among all prior training-free approaches and even surpass fine-tuned methods on several benchmarks. To evaluate the quality of predicted ADs, we introduce a new evaluation measure -- an action score -- specifically targeted to assessing this important aspect of AD. Additionally, we propose a novel evaluation protocol that treats automatic frameworks as AD generation assistants and asks them to generate multiple candidate ADs for selection.
papers.title_zh: 拍摄:电影-电影-电影-电影-电影-电影-电影-电影-电影-软件-培训-无音频描述制作
papers.abstract_zh: 我们的目标是为电影和电视系列等经过编辑的视频材料自动生成音频描述(ADs),为此,我们提出一个两阶段框架,利用“拍摄”作为视频理解的基本单位。 这包括将时间背景延伸到相邻拍摄,并纳入电影语法装置,如射线标和线形结构,以引导AD一代人。 我们的方法与开放源码和专有视觉语言模型(VLMs)兼容,将附加模块的专家知识结合起来,而无需对VLMs进行额外培训。 我们在所有先前的无培训做法中取得了最先进的业绩,甚至超过了若干基准的微调方法。为了评估预测的反倾销的质量,我们引入了新的评价措施 -- -- 行动分 -- -- 专门用来评估反倾销的这一重要方面。 此外,我们提议一项新的评价议定书,将自动框架作为AD代助理处理,并要求他们提出多个候选人AD,供选择。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Video Desnowing Network via Temporal Decoupling Experts and Distribution-Driven Contrastive Regularization
papers.authors: Hongtao Wu · Yijun Yang · Angelica I Aviles-Rivero · Jingjing Ren · Sixiang Chen · Haoyu Chen · Lei Zhu
papers.abstract: Snow degradations present formidable challenges to the advancement of computer vision tasks by the undesirable corruption in outdoor scenarios. While current deep learning-based desnowing approaches achieve success on synthetic benchmark datasets, they struggle to restore out-of-distribution real-world snowy videos due to the deficiency of paired real-world training data. To address this bottleneck, we devise a new paradigm for video desnowing in a semi-supervised spirit to involve unlabeled real data for the generalizable snow removal. Specifically, we construct a real-world dataset with 85 snowy videos, and then present a Semi-supervised Video Desnowing Network (SemiVDN) equipped by a novel Distribution-driven Contrastive Regularization. The elaborated contrastive regularization mitigates the distribution gap between the synthetic and real data, and consequently maintains the desired snow-invariant background details. Furthermore, based on the atmospheric scattering model, we introduce a Prior-guided Temporal Decoupling Experts module to decompose the physical components that make up a snowy video in a frame-correlated manner. We evaluate our SemiVDN on benchmark datasets and also the collected real snowy data. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our approach against state-of-the-art image- and video-level desnowing methods.
papers.title_zh: 通过时间解耦专家和分销驱动违规正规化,建立半超视频断层网络
papers.abstract_zh: 由于户外的不良腐败现象,雪层退化对推进计算机远景任务构成巨大挑战。 虽然目前基于深层次学习的脱新颖方法在合成基准数据集方面取得了成功,但由于缺乏对齐的现实世界培训数据,它们正在努力恢复分配之外的真实世界雪地视频。 为了解决这一瓶颈问题,我们设计一个新的模式,让视频以半受监督的精神脱落,让无标签的真实数据参与到可推广的除雪工作中。 具体地说,我们建造了一个包含85个雪景视频的真实世界数据集,然后推出一个半监督的视频脱落网络(SemiVDN),配有新颖的发行驱动的反常规化。 精心拟订的对比式正规化缩小了合成数据与实际数据之间的分布差距,因此保持了所期望的雪变背景细节。 此外,基于大气散射模型,我们引入了前制时间解耦专家模块,以拆分构成雪地视频的物理部件,这些部件以与框架孔有关的方式组成雪地视频。我们用基准数据集和收集到的真实雪地数据来评估我们的半VDN。 实验结果表明,我们的方法优于最先进的图像和视频级消化方法。

papers.title: Seeing the Unseen: A Frequency Prompt Guided Transformer for Image Restoration
papers.authors: shihao zhou · Jinshan Pan · Jinglei Shi · Duosheng Chen · Lishen Qu · Jufeng Yang
papers.abstract: How to explore useful features from images as prompts to guide the deep image restoration models is an effective way to solve image restoration. In contrast to mining spatial relations within images as prompt, which leads to characteristics of different frequencies being neglected and further remaining subtle or undetectable artifacts in the restored image, we develop a Frequency Prompting image restoration method, dubbed FPro, which can effectively provide prompt components from a frequency perspective to guild the restoration model address these differences. Specifically, we first decompose input features into separate frequency parts via dynamically learned filters, where we introduce a gating mechanism for suppressing the less informative elements within the kernels. To propagate useful frequency information as prompt, we then propose a dual prompt block, consisting of a low-frequency prompt modulator (LPM) and a high-frequency prompt modulator (HPM), to handle signals from different bands respectively. Each modulator contains a generation process to incorporate prompting components into the extracted frequency maps, and a modulation part that modifies the prompt feature with the guidance of the decoder features. Experimental results on commonly used benchmarks have demonstrated the favorable performance of our pipeline against SOTA methods on 5 image restoration tasks, including deraining, deraindrop, demoireing, deblurring, and dehazing. The source code is provided in the supplementary materials.
papers.title_zh: 看见未见的景象:一个频率快速导向变形器,用于图像恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 如何从图像中探索有用的特征,作为引导深层图像恢复模型的提示,是解决图像恢复的有效方法。 图像内部空间关系迅速发展,导致不同频率的特点被忽视,在恢复的图像中进一步保留微妙或无法探测的文物,与此形成对照的是,我们开发了一个称为FPro的频率加速图像恢复方法,该方法能够有效地从频率角度提供快速组件,使恢复模型与这些差异联系起来。 具体地说,我们首先通过动态学习的过滤器将输入特征分解成不同的频率部分,在那里我们引入一种抑制内核中信息较少的元素的格子机制。 为了迅速传播有用的频率信息,我们然后提议一个双速区块,由低频即时调制器和高频即时调制器组成,分别处理不同波段的信号。 每个调制解调器都包含一个生成过程,以在提取的频率图中包含催化元件,并包含一个调制部分,该调制部分在解码器特性的指导下对即时特性进行修改。 常用基准的实验结果表明,我们在5项图像恢复任务(包括排水、排水、排水、复员、排污和拆解)上,对SOTA方法的管道表现良好,补充材料中提供了源代码。

papers.title: ScribblePrompt: Fast and Flexible Interactive Segmentation for Any Biomedical Image
papers.authors: Hallee E. Wong · Marianne Rakic · John Guttag · Adrian V. Dalca
papers.abstract: Medical image segmentation is a crucial part of both scientific research and clinical care. With enough labelled data, deep learning models can be trained to accurately automate specific medical image segmentation tasks. However, manually segmenting images to create training data is highly labor intensive and requires domain expertise. We present ScribblePrompt, a flexible neural network based interactive segmentation tool for biomedical imaging that enables human annotators to segment previously unseen structures using scribbles, clicks, and bounding boxes. Through rigorous quantitative experiments, we demonstrate that given comparable amounts of interaction, ScribblePrompt produces more accurate segmentations than previous methods on datasets unseen during training. In a user study with domain experts, ScribblePrompt reduced annotation time by 28 % while improving Dice by 15 % compared to the next best method. ScribblePrompt's success rests on a set of careful design decisions. These include a training strategy that incorporates both a highly diverse set of images and tasks, novel algorithms for simulated user interactions and labels, and a network that enables fast inference. We showcase ScribblePrompt in an interactive online demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/anon5167/ScribblePrompt
papers.title_zh: ScribboutPrompt: 任何生物医学图像的快速和灵活互动区块
papers.abstract_zh: 医学图像分割是科学研究和临床护理的关键部分。 有了足够的贴标签数据,深层学习模式可以接受培训,以准确实现特定医学图像分割任务的自动化。 然而,为创建培训数据而手工分割图像的劳动密集程度很高,需要领域专门知识。 我们展示了ScriblepPrompt, 这是一种灵活的神经网络网络互动分割工具,用于生物医学成像, 使人类告发员能够使用刻字、点击和捆绑盒, 将先前看不见的结构分割开来。 通过严格的量化实验,我们证明,考虑到互动的可比数量,ScribboutPrompt比以往在培训期间对未见数据集采用的方法更准确的分类。 ScribblePrompt在一项与域专家进行的用户研究中,将批注时间减少了28%,同时将骰子的利用率比下一个最佳方法提高了15%。 ScribblePROmpt的成功取决于一系列谨慎的设计决定。 其中包括一项培训战略,既包括一套高度多样化的图像和任务,也包括模拟用户互动和标签的新型算法,以及一个能够快速推断的网络。 我们在互动在线演示中展示了ScribblePrompt:https://huggingface.co/spaces/anon5167/ScriblepPrompt。

papers.title: Scaling Tumor Segmentation: Best Lessons from Real and Synthetic Data
papers.authors: Qi Chen · Xinze Zhou · Chen Liu · Hao Chen · Wenxuan Li · Zekun Jiang · Ziyan Huang · Yuxuan Zhao · Dexin Yu · Junjun He · Yefeng Zheng · Ling Shao · Alan Yuille · Zongwei Zhou
papers.abstract: AI development for tumor segmentation is challenged by the scarcity of large, annotated datasets, due to the intensive annotation effort and required medical expertise. Analyzing a proprietary dataset of 3,000 per-voxel annotated pancreatic tumor scans, we discovered that beyond 1,500 scans, AI performance plateaus despite more data. We further incorporated synthetic data, showing that AI could reach the plateaus with only 500 real scans. This indicates that synthetic augmentation steepens the scaling laws, enhancing AI performance more efficiently than real data alone.Motivated by these lessons, we created CancerVerse---a dataset of 10,136 CT scans with a total of 10,260 tumor instances per-voxel manually annotated in six organs (pancreas, liver, kidney, colon, esophagus, uterus) and 5,279 control scans. This monumental effort by eight expert radiologists offers a dataset scale that surpasses existing public tumor datasets by several orders of magnitude. While we continue to expand the scale of data and annotations, we believe that the current CancerVerse can already provide a solid foundation---based on our lessons from the proprietary dataset---to enable AI to segment tumors in these six organs, offering significant improvements in both in-distribution (+7% DSC) and out-of-distribution (+16% DSC) evaluations over those trained on current public datasets. More importantly, AI trained on CancerVerse, supplemented by synthetic tumors at scale, has approached similar performance to Radiologists reported in the literature in liver and pancreatic tumor detection.
papers.title_zh: 缩放图层分割:从真实和合成数据中吸取的最佳经验教训
papers.abstract_zh: 由于大量注解努力和所需的医疗专门知识,大量附加说明的数据集稀缺,对肿瘤分解的人工智能开发构成挑战。 在分析3000个每伏伏特加注解的胰腺肿瘤扫描的专有数据集时,我们发现除了1500个扫描之外,AI性能高原尽管数据更多。 我们还进一步纳入了合成数据,表明AI只能通过500个实际扫描到达高原。 这表明合成增殖法比实际数据更能提高人工智能的性能。 我们利用这些教训,创建了10,136个CT扫描数据集,共10,260个肿瘤病例,每伏人工在6个器官(肝脏、肝脏、肾脏、结肠、食道、子宫)和5,279个控制扫描中加注了10,260个肿瘤病例。 8名专家放射学家的这一巨大努力提供了一个数据集规模,比现有的公共肿瘤数据集高出几个数量级。 虽然我们继续扩大数据和说明的规模,但我们认为,目前的癌症疫苗已经能够根据我们从专有数据集中汲取的教训提供一个坚实的基础,使AI能够将肿瘤分解到这六个器官中,大大改进了分布(+7%的DSC)和分配外(+16%的DSC)评价,超过了那些受过目前公共数据集培训的评价。 更重要的是,大赦国际对癌症抗体进行了培训,并以规模的合成肿瘤作为补充,与肝脏和胰腺肿瘤检测方面的文献中报告的放射科医生相似。

papers.title: RoboMM: All-in-One Multimodal Large Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Feng yan · Fanfan Liu · Yiyang Huang · ZechaoGuan ZechaoGuan · Liming Zheng · Yufeng Zhong · Chengjian Feng · Lin Ma
papers.abstract: In recent years, robotics has advanced significantly through the integration of larger models and large-scale datasets. However, challenges remain in applying these models to 3D spatial interactions and managing data collection costs. To address these issues, we propose the multimodal robotic manipulation model, RoboMM, along with the comprehensive dataset, RoboData.RoboMM enhances 3D perception through camera parameters and occupancy supervision. Building on OpenFlamingo, it incorporates Modality-Isolation-Mask and multimodal decoder blocks, improving modality fusion and fine-grained perception. RoboData offers the complete evaluation system by integrating several well-known datasets, achieving the first fusion of multi-view images, camera parameters, depth maps, and actions, and the space alignment facilitates comprehensive learning from diverse robotic datasets.Equipped with RoboData and the unified physical space, RoboMM is the first generalist policy that surpasses expert models, enabling simultaneous evaluation of all tasks across multiple datasets, rather than being limited to specific data or task selections.Its design significantly enhances robotic manipulation performance, increasing the average sequence length on the CALVIN from 1.7 to 3.5 and ensuring cross-embodiment capabilities, achieving state-of-the-art results across multiple datasets, including both simulated and real-world data.
papers.title_zh: RopoMM: 机器人操纵全在一个多式大型全模式模型
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,机器人通过整合大型模型和大型数据集取得了显著进步,但在应用这些模型进行3D空间互动和管理数据收集费用方面仍然存在挑战。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用多式机器人操纵模型RoboMM,连同综合数据集RoboData。 RoboMM通过摄像参数和占用率监督增强3D感知。 在开放火林哥的基础上,它包括了模式-孤立-马斯克和多式联运解码块,改进了模式融合和细微感知。 RoboData提供完整的评价系统,方法是将几个众所周知的数据集合并,首次将多视图图像、相机参数、深度地图和行动合并,空间调整有助于从各种机器人数据集中全面学习。 配置RoboData和统一的物理空间,RoboData是第一个超越专家模型的总体政策,使得能够同时评价多个数据集中的所有任务,而不是局限于特定的数据或任务选择。 它的设计大大增强了机器人操纵性能,将CALVIN的平均序列长度从1.7增加到3.5,并确保交叉输入能力,实现包括模拟数据和真实世界数据在内的多个数据集中的最新结果。

papers.title: RICA^2: Rubric-Informed, Calibrated Assessment of Actions
papers.authors: Abrar Majeedi · Viswanatha Reddy Gajjala · Satya Sai Srinath Namburi GNVV · Yin Li
papers.abstract: The ability to quantify how well an action is carried out, also known as action quality assessment (AQA), is widely studied across scientific disciplines due to its broad range of applications. Therefore, there has been a surging interest in the vision community to develop video-based AQA. Unfortunately, prior methods often ignore the score rubric used by human experts and fall short at quantifying the uncertainty of the model prediction. To bridge the gap, we present RICA^2--- a deep probabilistic model that integrates score rubric and accounts for prediction uncertainty for AQA. Central to our method lies in stochastic embeddings of action steps, defined on a graph structure that encodes the score rubric. The embeddings spread probabilistic density in the latent space, and allow our method to represent model uncertainty. The graph encodes the scoring criteria, based on which the quality scores can be decoded. We demonstrate that our method establishes new state-of-the-art on public benchmarks including FineDiving, MTL-AQA, and JIGSAWS, with superior performance in score prediction and uncertainty calibration.
papers.title_zh: RIICA 2:对行动进行机械化的、经过校准的行动评估
papers.abstract_zh: 行动质量评估(AQA)由于应用范围广泛,在科学学科中广泛研究其执行程度如何,因此,人们越来越有兴趣在视觉界开发基于视频的AQA, 以量化行动做得好的能力,又称行动质量评估(AQA)。 不幸的是,以前的方法往往忽视了人类专家使用的评分标准,在量化模型预测的不确定性方面做得不够。 为了弥合差距,我们提出了RICA2 — — 一种将评分标准与AQA预测不确定性进行整合的深层次概率模型。 我们的方法的核心在于以图表结构定义的动作步骤的随机嵌入。 嵌入过程在潜伏空间中散布概率密度,并使我们的方法代表模型不确定性。 图表对评分标准进行了编码,据此可以对质量评分进行解码。 我们证明我们的方法在公共基准方面建立了新的最新水平,包括精准潜水、MTL-AQA和JIGSAWS,在得分预测和不确定性校准方面表现优异。

papers.title: Rethinking Layered Graphic Design Generation with a Top-Down Approach
