papers.abstract_zh: 复制人类在任何颗粒中根据自由形式文本探测所有物体的固有能力,对于大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)来说,仍然是一项艰巨的挑战,目前的LVLMs主要只能找到一个原有的单一物体。 这一限制导致模型设计妥协,导致引入视觉专家模型或定制头结构。 除了这些限制外,我们的研究还发现LVLMs的基本物体感知能力,使其能够准确识别和定位相关对象。 基于这一见解,我们推出新的语言促进本地化数据集,以充分释放LVLMs在精细定位物体感知和准确定位意识方面的能力。 更重要的是,我们介绍了纯粹基于LVLM的基线Griffon,该基线没有引入任何特殊标志、专家模型或额外的探测模块。 它只是通过统一各种与本地化有关的情景的数据格式,与流行的LVLMs保持一个一致的结构,并通过精心设计的管道接受端对端培训。 全面实验表明,葛里芬不仅在精细RefCO系列和Flickrs30K实体中取得了SOTA 性能,而且还接近专家模型 " 更快的RCNNN " 的能力,即探测基准MSCO。 将公布数据集、代码和模型。

papers.title: Griffon v2: Advancing Multimodal Perception with High-Resolution Scaling and Visual-Language Co-Referring
papers.authors: Yufei Zhan · Shurong Zheng · Yousong Zhu · Hongyin Zhao · Fan Yang · Ming Tang · Jinqiao Wang
papers.abstract: Large Vision Language Models have achieved fine-grained object perception, but the limitation of image resolution remains a significant obstacle to surpassing the performance of task-specific experts in complex and dense scenarios. Such limitation further restricts the model's potential to achieve nuanced visual and language referring in domains such as GUI Agents, counting, etc. To address this issue, we introduce a unified high-resolution generalist model, Griffon v2, enabling flexible object referring with visual and textual prompts. To efficiently scale up image resolution, we design a simple and lightweight down-sampling projector to overcome the input tokens constraint in Large Language Models. This design inherently preserves the complete contexts and fine details and significantly improves multimodal perception ability, especially for small objects. Building upon this, we further equip the model with visual-language co-referring capabilities through a plug-and-play visual tokenizer. It enables user-friendly interaction with flexible target images, free-form texts, and even coordinates. Experiments demonstrate that Griffon v2 can localize objects of interest with visual and textual referring, achieve state-of-the-art performance on REC and phrase grounding, and outperform expert models in object detection, object counting, and REG. Data, codes, and models will be released.
papers.title_zh: Griffon v 2: 推进具有高分辨率缩放和视觉语言共同参照的多式感知
papers.abstract_zh: 大型 " 视觉语言模型 " 已达到精细的物体感知,但图像分辨率的局限性仍然是在复杂和密集的情景下超越具体任务专家业绩的重大障碍。 这种限制进一步限制了模型在诸如图形用户界面代理、计数等领域实现细微的视觉和语言参考的潜力。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了一个统一的高分辨率通用模型,即Griffon v2, 使灵活对象能够以视觉和文字提示参考。 为了有效提升图像分辨率,我们设计了一个简单和轻量级的下取样投影仪,以克服大语言模型中输入符号的限制。 这一设计本质上保留了完整的背景和精细细节,并大大提高了多式联运的感知能力,特别是小物体的感知能力。 在此基础上,我们进一步通过插件和剧本视觉代用品为模型配备了视觉语言共同参照能力。 它能够与灵活的目标图像、自由文本甚至协调进行方便用户的互动。 实验表明,Griffon v2 可以用视觉和文字参考将感兴趣的对象本地化,在REC和短语定位方面达到最新水平的性能,在物体探测、物体计数和REG方面优异的专家模型。 数据、代码和模型将发布。

papers.title: GIViC: Generative Implicit Video Compression
papers.authors: Ge Gao · Siyue Teng · Tianhao Peng · Fan Zhang · David Bull
papers.abstract: While video compression based on implicit neural representations (INRs) has recently demonstrated great potential, existing INR-based video codecs still cannot achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance compared to their conventional or autoencoder-based counterparts given the same coding configuration. In this context, we propose aGenerativeImplicitVideoCompression framework,GIViC, aiming at advancing the performance limits of this type of coding methods. GIViC is inspired by the characteristics that INRs share with large language and diffusion models in exploitinglong-term dependencies. Through the newly designedimplicit diffusionprocess, GIViC performs diffusive sampling across coarse-to-fine spatiotemporal decompositions, gradually progressing from coarser-grained full-sequence diffusion to finer-grained per-token diffusion. A novelHierarchical Gated Linear Attention-based transformer(HGLA), is also integrated into the framework, which dual-factorizes global dependency modeling along scale and sequential axes. The proposed GIViC model has been benchmarked against SOTA conventional and neural codecs using a Random Access (RA) configuration (YUV 4:2:0, GOPSize=32), and yields BD-rate savings of 15.94%, 22.46% and 8.52% over VVC VTM, DCVC-FM and NVRC, respectively. As far as we are aware, GIViC is thefirst INR-based video codec that outperforms VTM based on the RA coding configuration. The source code will be made available.
papers.title_zh: GIVIC: 产生隐含视频压缩
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然基于隐含神经表象的视频压缩最近显示出巨大的潜力,但鉴于相同的编码配置,现有基于IR的视频编码器仍然无法取得与常规或自动编码器对口单位相比的最新性能。 在这方面,我们提议一个“通用抑制障碍框架”,GIVIC, 目的是提高这类编码方法的性能限度,它受到IRR在利用长期依赖性时与大量语言和传播模式共有的特征的启发。 通过新设计的隐性扩散过程,GIVIC通过粗到松的间歇时空分解法进行不同的取样,从粗到粗的全序列扩散逐渐发展到精到精的每吨扩散。 一个新的等级式直线式直线式倾斜式变压器(HGLA)也被纳入了这个框架,这个框架具有双重因素,按照规模和顺序轴构建全球依赖性模型。 拟议的GIVIC模型以SOTA常规和神经编码为基准,采用随机存取(RA)配置(YUV 4:2:0,GOPSIZE=32),比VVVC VTM、DCVC-FM和NVRC分别节省15.94%、22.46%和8.52%的BD率。 据我们所知,GIVIC是第一个以IRN为基础的视频编码器,根据RA编码配置,其性能优于VTM。

papers.title: GenFlowRL: Shaping Rewards with Generative Object-Centric Flow in Visual Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Kelin Yu · Sheng Zhang · Harshit Soora · Furong Huang · Heng Huang · Pratap Tokekar · Ruohan Gao
papers.abstract: Recent advances have shown that video generation models can enhance robot learning by deriving effective robot actions through inverse dynamics. However, these methods heavily depend on the quality of generated data and struggle with fine-grained manipulation due to the lack of environment feedback. While video-based reinforcement learning improves policy robustness, it remains constrained by the uncertainty of video generation and the challenges of collecting large-scale robot datasets for training diffusion models. To address these limitations, we propose GenFlowRL, which derives shaped rewards from generated flow trained from easy-to-collect cross-embodiment datasets. This enables learning generalizable and robust policies from expert demostrations using low-dimensional, object-centric features. Experiments on 10 manipulation tasks, both in simulation and real-world cross-embodiment evaluations, demonstrate that GenFlowRL effectively leverages manipulation features extracted from generated object-centric flow, consistently achieving superior performance across diverse and challenging scenarios.
papers.title_zh: GenFlowRL:在视觉强化学习中以产生物体-中心流来生成的奖励
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的进展表明,视频生成模型可以通过反向动态生成有效的机器人动作来增强机器人的学习能力,然而,由于缺乏环境反馈,这些方法在很大程度上取决于生成数据的质量,并在很大程度上依赖于精细操作。 虽然基于视频的强化学习提高了政策的稳健性,但因视频生成的不确定性和为培训推广模型收集大型机器人数据集的挑战而受到限制。 为了克服这些限制,我们提议GenFlowRL,它从通过容易收集的交叉录入数据集培训的源源流中获取成形的回报,从而能够从使用低维、以物体为中心的特征的专家降格中学习可概括和有力的政策。 在模拟和现实世界交叉录入评价方面对10项操纵任务进行的实验表明,GenFlowRL有效地利用了从生成的以物体为中心的流动中提取的操纵功能,在各种和具有挑战性的情景中不断取得优异业绩。

papers.title: GenerateCT: Text-Conditional Generation of 3D Chest CT Volumes
papers.authors: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci · Sezgin Er · Anjany Sekuboyina · Enis Simsar · Alperen Tezcan · Ayse Gulnihan Simsek · Sevval Nil Esirgun · Furkan Almas · Irem Dogan · Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen · Chinmay Prabhakar · Hadrien Reynaud · Sarthak Pati · Christian Bluethgen · Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir · Bjoern Menze
papers.abstract: Text-conditional medical image generation is vital for radiology, augmenting small datasets, preserving data privacy, and enabling patient-specific modeling. However, its applications in 3D medical imaging, such as CT and MRI, which are crucial for critical care, remain unexplored. In this paper, we introduce GenerateCT, the first approach to generating 3D medical imaging conditioned on free-form medical text prompts. GenerateCT incorporates a text encoder and three key components: a novel causal vision transformer for encoding 3D CT volumes, a text-image transformer for aligning CT and text tokens, and a text-conditional super-resolution diffusion model. Without directly comparable methods in 3D medical imaging, we benchmarked GenerateCT against cutting-edge methods, demonstrating its superiority across all key metrics. Importantly, we explored GenerateCT's clinical applications by evaluating its utility in a multi-abnormality classification task. First, we established a baseline by training a multi-abnormality classifier on our real dataset. To further assess the model's generalization to external datasets and its performance with unseen prompts in a zero-shot scenario, we employed an external dataset to train the classifier, setting an additional benchmark. We conducted two experiments in which we doubled the training datasets by synthesizing an equal number of volumes for each set using GenerateCT. The first experiment demonstrated an 11% improvement in the AP score when training the classifier jointly on real and generated volumes. The second experiment showed a 7% improvement when training on both real and generated volumes based on unseen prompts. Moreover, GenerateCT enables the scaling of synthetic training datasets to arbitrary sizes. As an example, we generated 100,000 3D CT volumes, fivefold the number in our real dataset, and trained the classifier exclusively on these synthetic volumes. Impressively, this classifier surpassed the performance of the one trained on all available real data by a margin of 8%. Lastly, domain experts evaluated the generated volumes, confirming a high degree of alignment with the text prompts. Access our code, model weights, training data, and generated data at https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT
papers.title_zh: 3D Chest CT 卷的文字条件生成
papers.abstract_zh: 对放射学、扩大小数据集、保护数据隐私和帮助建立病人专用模型而言,生成有条件的医学图像至关重要。 但是,在三维医学成像(如CT和MRI)中的应用(这些对关键护理至关重要)仍未被探索。 在本文中,我们引入了CenerateCT,这是产生3D医学成像的第一个方法,以自由式医学文本提示为条件。 生成CT包含一个文本编码器和三个关键组成部分:3D CT 卷编码的新因果视觉变压器,对CT 和文本符号进行对齐的文本图像变压器,以及文本条件超分辨率扩散模型。 没有直接可比的3D医学成像方法,我们对照尖端方法对CenterateCT进行了基准测试,显示了它在所有关键指标中的优越性。 重要的是,我们通过评估它在多常态分类任务中的实用性,探索了CenerateCT的临床应用。 首先,我们通过培训一个掌握真实数据集的多异常分类员,建立了一个基线。 为了进一步评估模型对外部数据集的概括化及其在零光情景下以无形提示进行性能评估,我们使用了外部数据集来培训分类员,并设定了额外的基准。 我们进行了两个实验,我们用基因CT合成每组相同数量的数量,使培训数据集翻了一番。 第一次实验显示,在对分类员进行实际和生成量联合培训时,AP分数提高了11%。 第二次实验显示,在以不可见的提示为基础进行实际量和生成量的培训时,实际量和生成量的培训都提高了7%。 此外,CenerateCT使得合成培训数据集的大小可以任意扩大。 举例来说,我们生成了100,000 3D CT 数量,是我们真实数据集的五倍,并专门就这些合成数量对分类员进行了培训。 令人印象深刻的是,这个分类员比所有现有真实数据培训的分类员的性能高出8%。 最后,域专家评价了所制作的卷,证实了与文本提示高度一致。查阅我们的代码、模型重量、培训数据,并在https://github.com/ibrahimethemhamamci/GenerateCT上生成数据。

papers.title: GDKVM: Echocardiography Video Segmentation via Spatiotemporal Key-Value Memory with Gated Delta Rule
papers.authors: Rui Wang · Yimu Sun · Jingxing Guo · Huisi Wu · Jing Qin
papers.abstract: Accurate segmentation of cardiac chamber structures in echocardiogram sequences is of great significance for clinical diagnosis and treatment. The imaging noise, artifacts, and the deformation and motion of the heart pose challenges to segmentation algorithms. Existing methods based on convolutional neural networks, Transformers, and space-time memory have indeed improved segmentation accuracy to some extent, but they are often restricted by limited local receptive fields and insufficient temporal memory retrieval.In this paper, we propose a novel model for echocardiography video segmentation, called GDKVM. The model employs linear key-value associations (LKVA) to effectively model inter-frame correlations, and introduces the gated delta rule (GDR) to ideally store intermediate memory states. The key-pixel feature fusion (KPFF) module is designed to integrate local and global features at multiple scales, enhancing robustness against boundary blurring and noise interference. We validated GDKVM on two mainstream echocardiogram video datasets (CAMUS and EchoNet-Dynamic) and compared it with various state-of-the-art methods. Experimental results show that GDKVM outperforms existing approaches in terms of segmentation accuracy and robustness, while ensuring real-time performance. GDKVM provides more accurate and efficient cardiac chamber segmentation outcomes for clinical applications.The code will be released upon publication.
papers.title_zh: GDKVM: 通过使用 Gated Delta 规则的时空键值内存进行心心电图视频分割
papers.abstract_zh: 在回声心电图序列中,心室结构的准确分离对临床诊断和治疗具有重大意义。 成像噪音、人工制品以及心脏变形和运动对分解算法提出了挑战。 基于进化神经网络、变换器和时空内存的现有方法确实在某种程度上提高了断裂的准确性,但往往受到有限的局部可接收字段和时间内存检索不足的限制。 在本文中,我们提出一个称为GDKVM的回声心电图视频分离新模式。 该模型采用线性关键价值协会(LKVA),以有效模拟各框架间的相互关系,并采用门式三角洲规则(GDR),以理想地储存中间内存状态。 关键像素特征聚合模块旨在将多个尺度的当地和全球特征结合起来,加强抵御边界模糊和噪音干扰的力度。 我们用两个主流回声心电图视频数据集(CAMUS和EchoNet-Dynamic)验证了GDKVM(GDKVM ) , 并将其与各种最新方法进行了比较。 实验结果表明,GDKVM在分解准确性和稳健性方面比现有方法要好,同时确保实时性能。 GDKVM为临床应用提供更准确和高效的心室分解结果。 该代码将在公布后公布。

papers.title: Fusion Meets Diverse Conditions: A High-diversity Benchmark and Baseline for UAV-based Multimodal Object Detection with Condition Cues
papers.authors: Chen Chen · Kangcheng Bin · Hu Ting · Jiahao Qi · Xingyue Liu · Tianpeng Liu · Zhen Liu · Yongxiang Liu · Ping Zhong
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV)-based object detection with visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) images facilitates robust around-the-clock detection, driven by advancements in deep learning techniques and the availability of high-quality dataset. However, the existing dataset struggles to fully capture real-world complexity for limited imaging conditions. To this end, we introduce a high-diversity dataset ATR-UMOD covering varying scenarios, spanning altitudes from 80m to 300m, angles from 0° to 75°, and all-day, all-year time variations in rich weather and illumination conditions. Moreover, each RGB-IR image pair is annotated with 6 condition attributes, offering valuable high-level contextual information. To meet the challenge raised by such diverse conditions, we propose a novel prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF) to adaptively reassign multimodal contributions by leveraging annotated condition cues. By encoding imaging conditions as text prompts, PCDF effectively models the relationship between conditions and multimodal contributions through a task-specific soft-gating transformation. A prompt-guided condition-decoupling module further ensures the availability in practice without condition annotations. Experiments on ATR-UMOD dataset reveal the effectiveness of PCDF.
papers.title_zh: 融合满足多种条件:基于无人驾驶航空器的多式物体与条件库的多式物体探测的高度多样性基准和基线
papers.abstract_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器(无人驾驶飞行器)用可见(RGB)和红外线(IR)图像探测的无人驾驶物体,有助于在深层学习技术的进步和高质量数据集的可用性推动下,全天24小时进行严密的探测。 然而,现有的数据集很难在有限的成像条件下充分捕捉到现实世界的复杂性。 为此,我们推出一个高多样性数据集ATR-UMOD,涵盖不同情景,高度从80米至300米,角度从0°至75°,以及丰富天气和照明条件全年全年变化。 此外,每个RGB-IR图像配对都有附加说明,附有6个条件属性,提供了宝贵的高水平背景信息。 为了应对这些不同条件带来的挑战,我们建议采用新的快速指导条件意识动态聚合(PCDF),利用附加说明的条件提示,适应性地重新分配多式联运捐款。 通过将成像条件与文字提示相编码,多功能开发基金通过具体任务的软制式转换,有效地模拟了条件与多式联运贡献之间的关系。 一个快速导导条件解耦模块进一步确保了在实际中不附带条件说明的可用性。 ATR-UMOD数据集实验揭示了多氯二苯并呋喃的有效性。

papers.title: FS-COCO: Towards Understanding of Freehand Sketches of Common Objects in Context
papers.authors: Pinaki Nath Chowdhury, Aneeshan Sain, Ayan Kumar Bhunia, Tao Xiang, Yulia Gryaditskaya, Yi-Zhe Song
papers.abstract: "We advance sketch research to scenes with the first dataset of freehand scene sketches, FSCOCO. With practical applications in mind, we collect sketches that convey well scene content but can be sketched within a few minutes by a person with any sketching skills. Our dataset comprises 10,000 freehand scene vector sketches with per point space-time information by 100 non-expert individuals, offering both object- and scene-level abstraction. Each sketch is augmented with its text description. Using our dataset, we study for the first time the problem of fine-grained image retrieval from freehand scene sketches and sketch captions. We draw insights on: (i) Scene salience encoded in sketches using the strokes temporal order; (ii) Performance comparison of image retrieval from a scene sketch and an image caption; (iii) Complementarity of information in sketches and image captions, as well as the potential benefit of combining the two modalities. In addition, we extend a popular vector sketch LSTM-based encoder to handle sketches with larger complexity than was supported by previous work. Namely, we propose a hierarchical sketch decoder, which we leverage at a sketch-specific “pretext” task. Our dataset enables for the first time research on freehand scene sketch understanding and its practical applications. We will release the dataset upon acceptance."
papers.title_zh: FS-COCO: 努力了解上下文中自由手件共同物品的成套工具
papers.abstract_zh: “我们用第一套手动现场草图数据集,将草图研究推进到场景,FSCO。考虑到实际应用,我们收集草图,这些草图传达了良好的场景内容,但可以在几分钟内由具有任何草图技能的人绘制。 我们的数据集由100名非专家个人提供的10 000个自由手场景矢量草图和每点空间时间信息组成,提供了对象和场景层面的抽象数据,每幅草图都用文字说明加以补充。 使用我们的数据集,我们第一次研究 如何从手持现场素描和草图字幕中 提取精细图像的问题。 我们深入了解:(一) 利用中风时间顺序在草图中编码的显著之处;(二) 现场草图图像检索和图像字幕的性能比较;(三) 草图和图像字幕中信息的互补性,以及将两种模式结合起来的潜在好处。 此外,我们扩展了一个广受欢迎的矢量草图 LSTM 的编码器,用于处理比先前工作更复杂的草图。 也就是说,我们提出一个层次的草图解码器,我们利用它来完成一个具体的草图“预言”任务。 我们的数据集首次使人们得以研究手持的现场素描理解及其实际应用。一旦被接受,我们将发布数据集。”

papers.title: From Imitation to Innovation: The Emergence of AI's Unique Artistic Styles and the Challenge of Copyright Protection
papers.authors: Zexi Jia · Chuanwei Huang · Hongyan Fei · Yeshuang Zhu · Zhiqiang Yuan · Ying Deng · Jiapei Zhang · Jinchao Zhang · Jie Zhou
papers.abstract: Current legal frameworks consider AI-generated works eligible for copyright protection when they meet originality requirements and involve substantial human intellectual input. However, systematic legal standards and reliable evaluation methods for AI art copyrights are lacking. Through comprehensive analysis of legal precedents, we establish three essential criteria for determining distinctive artistic style: stylistic consistency, creative uniqueness, and expressive accuracy. To address these challenges, we introduce ArtBulb, an interpretable and quantifiable framework for AI art copyright judgment that combines a novel style description-based multimodal clustering method with multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We also present AICD, the first benchmark dataset for AI art copyright annotated by artists and legal experts. Experimental results demonstrate that ArtBulb outperforms existing models in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Our work aims to bridge the gap between the legal and technological communities and bring greater attention to the societal issue of AI art copyrights.
papers.title_zh: 《从模仿到创新:大赦国际独一艺术风格的出现和版权保护的挑战》
papers.abstract_zh: 现行法律框架认为,AI产生的作品如果符合原始要求并涉及大量人类知识投入,就有资格获得版权保护,然而,AI艺术版权缺乏系统的法律标准和可靠的评价方法。 通过全面分析法律先例,我们确立了确定独特艺术风格的三个基本标准:文体一致性、创造性独特性和表达准确性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了ArtBulb,这是大赦国际艺术版权判决的一个可解释和量化的框架,它将新型的、以描述为基础的多式联运集群法与大型多式联运语言模式相结合。 我们还介绍了AICD,这是由艺术家和法律专家附加说明的AI艺术版权首个基准数据集。 实验结果表明,ArtBulb在定量和定性评估方面都超越了现有模式。 我们的工作旨在弥合法律界与技术界之间的差距,并使人们更加关注大赦国际艺术版权的社会问题。

papers.title: FREE-Merging: Fourier Transform for Efficient Model Merging
papers.authors: Shenghe Zheng · Hongzhi Wang
papers.abstract: With the rapid growth of deep learning, there is an increasing availability of open-source models for various tasks. However, single fine-tuned models often fall short of meeting the diverse needs of users. Model merging has thus emerged as an efficient method to integrate the capabilities of existing models into a unified model. Nevertheless, existing model merging methods face challenging trade-offs between performance and deployment costs, primarily due to task interference. For the first time, we reveal that task interference is evident in the frequency domain of model parameters, yet current efforts only focus on spatial domain solutions, which are largely ineffective in addressing frequency domain interference. To mitigate the impact of frequency domain interference, we proposeFR-Merging, an innovative method that effectively filters harmful frequency domain interference on the backbone with minimal computational overhead. Since performance loss is inevitable with cost-free methods, we propose a lightweight task-specific expert module that dynamically compensates for information loss during merging. This proposed framework,FREE-Merging(FR-Merging with experts), strikes a balanced trade-off between training cost, inference latency, storage requirements, and performance. We demonstrate the effectiveness of both FR-Merging and FREE-Merging on multiple tasks across CV, NLP, and Multi-Modal domains and show that they can be flexibly adapted to specific needs.
papers.title_zh: FREE-Merging: 实现高效模型合并的四倍变换
papers.abstract_zh: 随着深层学习的迅速增长,为各种任务提供的开放源码模式越来越多,但单一的微调模式往往不能满足用户的不同需求。 因此,合并模式已成为将现有模式的能力纳入统一模式的有效方法,但是,主要由于任务干扰,现有合并模式在业绩和部署费用之间面临权衡困难。 我们第一次发现,任务干扰在模型参数的频度领域是显而易见的,但目前的努力只侧重于空间域解决办法,这些办法在处理频度域干扰方面基本上没有效力。 为了减轻频率域干扰的影响,我们提议采用FR-Merging这一创新方法,以最低计算间接费用,有效地过滤对骨干有害频域干扰。 由于以免费方法,业绩损失是不可避免的,因此我们提议一个轻量级任务专家模块,以动态方式弥补合并期间的信息损失。 这个拟议框架FREE-Merging(FR-Miging与专家一起)在培训费用、推论延迟期、储存要求和绩效之间实现平衡的权衡。 我们展示了联邦抵抗阵线和自由欧洲统一部队在CV、NLP和多模式领域多重任务方面的效力,并表明它们可以灵活地适应具体需要。

papers.title: Forest2Seq: Revitalizing Order Prior for Sequential Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.authors: Qi Sun · Hang Zhou · Wengang Zhou · Li Li · Houqiang Li
papers.abstract: Synthesizing realistic 3D indoor scenes is a challenging task that traditionally relies on manual arrangement and annotation by expert designers. Recent advances in autoregressive models have automated this process, but they often lack semantic understanding of the relationships and hierarchies present in real-world scenes, yielding limited performance. In this paper, we propose Forest2Seq, a framework that formulates indoor scene synthesis as an order-aware sequential learning problem. Forest2Seq organizes the inherently unordered collection of scene objects into structured, ordered hierarchical scene trees and forests. By employing a clustering-based algorithm and a breadth-first traversal, Forest2Seq derives meaningful orderings and utilizes a transformer to generate realistic 3D scenes autoregressively. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate Forest2Seq's superiority in synthesizing more realistic scenes compared to top-performing baselines, with significant improvements in FID and KL scores. Our additional experiments for downstream tasks and ablation studies also confirm the importance of incorporating order as a prior in 3D scene generation.
papers.title_zh: Forest2Seq: 序列室内现场合成的重置顺序
papers.abstract_zh: 综合现实的3D室内场景是一项具有挑战性的任务,传统上依赖专家设计师的手工安排和说明。 近来自动递减模式的进展使这一进程自动化,但它们往往缺乏对现实世界景象中存在的关系和等级的语义理解,导致绩效有限。 在本文中,我们提出了Forest2Seq(Forest2Seq ) , 这个框架将室内场景合成设计成一个有秩序的连续学习问题。 Forest2Seq(Forest2Seq)将原始的未经排序的场景物体收集组织成结构有序的、有顺序的级级景树木和森林。 Forest2Seq通过采用基于集群的算法和宽度第一跨行法,获得有意义的订单,并利用变压器自动后退地产生现实的3D场景。 标准基准的实验结果显示,森林2Seq在综合与业绩最佳的基线相比更现实的场景方面具有优势,国际开发公司和KL的分数有了显著改善。 我们在下游任务和通货膨胀研究方面进行的额外实验也证实,在3D场景一代中,必须先纳入秩序。

papers.title: FlashTex: Fast Relightable Mesh Texturing with LightControlNet
papers.authors: Kangle Deng · Timothy Omernick · Alexander B Weiss · Deva Ramanan · Jun-Yan Zhu · Tinghui Zhou · Maneesh Agrawala
papers.abstract: Manually creating textures for 3D meshes is time-consuming, even for expert visual content creators. We propose a fast approach for automatically texturing an input 3D mesh based on a user-provided text prompt. Importantly, our approach disentangles lighting from surface material/reflectance in the resulting texture so that the mesh can be properly relit and rendered in any lighting environment. Our method introduces LightControlNet, a new text-to-image model based on the ControlNet architecture, that allows the specification of the desired lighting as a conditioning image to the model. Our text-to-texture pipeline then constructs the texture in two stages. The first stage produces a sparse set of visually consistent reference views of the mesh using LightControlNet. The second stage applies a texture optimization based on Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) that works with LightControlNet to increase the texture quality while disentangling surface material from lighting. We show that this pipeline is significantly faster than previous text-to-texture methods, while producing high-quality and relightable textures.
papers.title_zh: FlashTex: 使用光控网快速点亮的网格纹理
papers.abstract_zh: 手动为 3D meshes 创建纹理很费时, 即使是对专业视觉内容创作者也是如此。 我们提出了一个快速方法, 用于根据用户提供的文本提示自动纹理输入 3D 网格 。 重要的是,我们的方法将照明与表面材料解耦/对由此产生的纹理的反射分离开来,以便在任何照明环境中能够适当地对网目进行再光和改造。 我们的方法引入了LightControlNet,这是一个基于控制网架构的新的文本到图像模型,它允许指定理想的照明作为模型的调节图像。 我们的文本到文本管道然后分两个阶段构建纹理。 第一阶段对使用光控网网的网状生成了少量的视觉一致参考视图。 第二阶段采用基于分蒸馏取样的质地优化,该质地优化与光控网合作,以提高质地质,同时将表面材料与照明解耦。 我们表明,这一管道比以往的文本到文本方法快得多,同时产生高质量和可点效的质地。

papers.title: Fashionpedia: Ontology, Segmentation, and an Attribute Localization Dataset
papers.authors: Menglin Jia, Mengyun Shi, Mikhail Sirotenko, Yin Cui, Claire Cardie , Bharath Hariharan, Hartwig Adam, Serge Belongie
papers.abstract: Segmentation, and an Attribute Localization Dataset","In this work, we focus on the task of instance segmentation with attribute localization. This unifies instance segmentation (detect and segment each object instance) and visual categorization of fine-grained attributes (classify one or multiple attributes). The proposed task requires both localizing an object and describing its properties. To illustrate the various aspects of this task, we focus on the domain of fashion and introduce Fashionpedia as a step toward mapping out the visual aspects of the fashion world. Fashionpedia consists of two parts: (1) an ontology built by fashion experts containing 27 main apparel categories, 19 apparel parts, and 294 fine-grained attributes and their relationships and (2) a dataset consisting of everyday and celebrity event fashion images annotated with segmentation masks and their associated fine-grained attributes, built upon the backbone of the Fashionpedia ontology. In order to solve this challenging task, we propose a novel Attribute-Mask R-CNN model to jointly perform instance segmentation and localized attribute recognition, and provide a novel evaluation metric for the task. Fashionpedia is available at https://fashionpedia.github.io/home/. "
papers.title_zh: 时装:本体学、分区和属性本地化数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 和属性本地化数据集 ” ” 。 在此工作中, 我们集中关注带有属性本地化的实例分割任务 。 此任务将实例分割( 每个对象实例的探测和段段) 和细微属性的视觉分类( 分类一个或多个属性 ) 统一为实例分割( 每个对象实例的探测和段段) 。 拟议的任务既要求物体本地化,也需要描述其特性。 为了说明这项任务的各个方面,我们把重点放在时尚领域,并引入时尚,作为绘制时尚世界视觉方面的一个步骤。 时装由两部分组成:(1) 时装专家建造的本体学,包括27个主要服装类别、19个服装部件和294个细毛属性及其关系;(2) 数据集,包括每日和名人事件时装图象,带有分解面罩及其相关的细毛属性,以时装本体为主。 为了解决这一具有挑战性的任务,我们提议采用一个新的属性-Mask R-CNN模式,共同进行实例分割和局部属性识别,并为这项任务提供新的评价标准。 " 时尚版可在https://fashionpedia.github.io/home/查阅。 "

papers.title: FADE: Fusing the Assets of Decoder and Encoder for Task-Agnostic Upsampling
papers.authors: Hao Lu, Wenze Liu, Hongtao Fu, Zhiguo Cao
papers.abstract: "We consider the problem of task-agnostic feature upsampling in dense prediction where an upsampling operator is required to facilitate both region-sensitive tasks like semantic segmentation and detail-sensitive tasks such as image matting. Existing upsampling operators often can work well in either type of the tasks, but not both. In this work, we present FADE, a novel, plug-and-play, and task-agnostic upsampling operator. FADE benefits from three design choices: i) considering encoder and decoder features jointly in upsampling kernel generation; ii) an efficient semi-shift convolutional operator that enables granular control over how each feature point contributes to upsampling kernels; iii) a decoder-dependent gating mechanism for enhanced detail delineation. We first study the upsampling properties of FADE on toy data and then evaluate it on large-scale semantic segmentation and image matting. In particular, FADE reveals its effectiveness and task-agnostic characteristic by consistently outperforming recent dynamic upsampling operators in different tasks. It also generalizes well across convolutional and transformer architectures with little computational overhead. Our work additionally provides thoughtful insights on what makes for task-agnostic upsampling. Code is available at: http://lnkiy.in/fade_in"
papers.title_zh: FADE: 解码器和编码器资产解码器和编码器资产的引信,用于任务不可知性抽样取样
papers.abstract_zh: “我们考虑在密集预测中进行任务不可知特征抽样的问题, 需要一名对区域敏感的作业, 如语义分割和图像配对等对细节敏感的作业。 现有的抽样操作员通常可以在两种任务中都能很好地发挥作用,但不能两者兼而有之。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了FADE(FADE ) , 一个新型的、插接和游戏的和任务不可知的抽样操作员。 FADE从三种设计选择中受益:(一) 考虑在采样内核生成中联合使用编码器和解码器的特征;(二) 高效的半轮变换操作器,使颗粒控制每个特征点如何有助于采样内核;(三) 一个分离器独立格机制,以加强详细划界。 我们首先研究FADE在玩具数据上的更新特征,然后对大规模语义分解和图像配对进行评估。 特别是,FADE通过在不同的任务中持续优于最近的动态抽样操作员来展示其有效性和任务不可知性特征。 我们的工作还就任务-不可知的抽取提供了深思熟虑的洞察力。 代码可在http://lnkiy.in/fade_in上查阅。

papers.title: Facial Affective Behavior Analysis with Instruction Tuning
papers.authors: Yifan Li · Anh Dao · Wentao Bao · Zhen Tan · Tianlong Chen · Huan Liu · Yu Kong
papers.abstract: Facial affective behavior analysis (FABA) is crucial for understanding human mental states from images. However, traditional approaches primarily deploy models to discriminate among discrete emotion categories, and lack the fine granularity and reasoning capability for complex facial behaviors. The advent of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has been proven successful in general visual understanding tasks. However, directly harnessing MLLMs for FABA is challenging due to the scarcity of datasets and benchmarks, neglecting facial prior knowledge, and low training efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce (i) an instruction-following dataset for two FABA tasks, e.g., emotion and action unit recognition, (ii) a benchmark FABA-Bench with a new metric considering both recognition and generation ability, and (iii) a new MLLM ''EmoLA'' as a strong baseline to the community. Our initiative on the dataset and benchmarks reveal the nature and rationale of facial affective behaviors, i.e., fine-grained facial movement, interpretability, and reasoning. Moreover, to build an effective and efficient FABA MLLM, we introduce a facial prior expert module with face structure knowledge and a low-rank adaptation module into pre-trained MLLM. We conduct extensive experiments on FABA-Bench and four commonly-used FABA datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed facial prior expert can boost the performance and EmoLA achieves the best results on our FABA-Bench. On commonly-used FABA datasets, EmoLA is competitive rivaling task-specific state-of-the-art models.
papers.title_zh: 带有指示图示的子宫性行为分析
papers.abstract_zh: 但是,传统方法主要是运用模型来区分离散情感类别,并且缺乏复杂的面部行为的细微颗粒和推理能力。 事实证明,多模式大语言模型(MLLM)的出现在一般视觉理解任务中取得了成功,但是,由于缺少数据集和基准、忽视面部先前知识以及培训效率低,直接利用MLLMS为FABA服务具有挑战性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了(一) 为FABA的两项任务(如情感和行动单位识别)提供一套遵循指令的数据集,(二) FABA-Bench基准,其中考虑到承认和生育能力的新标准,以及(三) 一个新的MLLM“EmoLA”作为社区的坚实基线。 我们关于数据集和基准的倡议揭示了面部感官行为的性质和理由,即细微的面部运动、可解释性和推理。 此外,为了建立一个有效和高效的FABA MLLM,我们将面部结构知识的面部前专家模块和一个低级适应模块引入培训前MLLM。 我们对FABA-Bench和四个常用的FABA数据集进行了广泛的实验。 结果显示,拟议的面部前专家可以提升业绩,而EmoLA在我们的FABA-Bunch上取得了最佳效果。 在常用的FABA数据集中,EmoLA是竞争对手,与具体任务最先进的模型相对应。

papers.title: Explaining Human Preferences via Metrics for Structured Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jack Langerman · Denis Rozumny · Yuzhong Huang · Dmytro Mishkin
papers.abstract: What cannot be measured cannot be improved while likely never uttered by Lord Kelvin, summarizes effectively the purpose of this work. This paper presents a detailed evaluation of automated metrics for evaluating structured 3D reconstructions. Pitfalls of each metric are discussed, and a thorough analyses through the lens of expert 3D modelers' preferences is presented. A set of systematic "unit tests" are proposed to empirically verify desirable properties, and context aware recommendations as to which metric to use depending on application are provided. Finally, a learned metric distilled from human expert judgments is proposed and analyzed.
papers.title_zh: 通过结构性重建的计量方法解释人类的偏好
papers.abstract_zh: 无法测量的东西无法改进,但Kelvin勋爵可能从未说过,他有效地总结了这项工作的目的。 本文详细评估了用于评估结构化的3D重建的自动衡量标准。 讨论了每项指标的空洞之处,从专家3D模型者的偏好角度进行了透彻的分析,提出了一套系统化的“单位测试”,以从经验上核实可取的特性,并就根据应用情况提供何种衡量标准提出了了解背景的建议。 最后,建议并分析了从人类专家判断中总结出来的一套总结经验的衡量标准。

papers.title: ERA: Expert Retrieval and Assembly for Early Action Prediction
papers.authors: Lin Geng Foo, Tianjiao Li, Hossein Rahmani, Qiuhong Ke, Jun Liu
papers.abstract: "Early action prediction aims to successfully predict the class label of an action before it is completely performed. This is a challenging task because the beginning stages of different actions can be very similar, with only minor subtle differences for discrimination. In this paper, we propose a novel Expert Retrieval and Assembly (ERA) module that retrieves and assembles a set of experts most specialized at using discriminative subtle differences, to distinguish an input sample from other highly similar samples. To encourage our model to effectively use subtle differences for early action prediction, we push experts to discriminate exclusively between samples that are highly similar, forcing these experts to learn to use subtle differences that exist between those samples. Additionally, we design an effective Expert Learning Rate Optimization method that balances the experts’ optimization and leads to better performance. We evaluate our ERA module on four public action datasets and achieve state-of-the-art performance. Code will be released."
papers.title_zh: ERA:早期行动预测专家检索和早期行动大会
papers.abstract_zh: 早期行动预测旨在成功预测一项行动在完全完成之前的分类标签。 这是一项具有挑战性的任务, 因为不同行动的起始阶段可能非常相似, 歧视的细微差别很小。 在本文中,我们提议建立一个新的专家检索和组装单元,以检索和组装一批最专门使用区别性微妙差异的专家,将输入样本与其他非常相似的样本区分开来。 为了鼓励我们的模型有效地利用细微差异进行早期行动预测,我们促使专家对非常相似的样品进行专门区分,迫使这些专家学会使用这些样品之间存在的细微差异。 此外,我们设计了一个有效的专家学习率优化方法,平衡专家的优化,并导致更好的业绩。 我们用四个公共行动数据集来评估我们的电子逆向拍卖模块,并实现最先进的绩效。 守则将发布。”

papers.title: Enhancing Plausibility Evaluation for Generated Designs with Denoising Autoencoder
papers.authors: Jiajie Fan · Amal Trigui · Thomas Bäck · Hao Wang
papers.abstract: A great interest has arisen in using Deep Generative Models (DGM) for generative design. When assessing the quality of the generated designs, human designers focus more on structural plausibility, e.g., no missing component, rather than visual artifacts, e.g., noises in the images. Meanwhile, commonly used metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) may not evaluate accurately as they tend to penalize visual artifacts instead of structural implausibility. As such, FID might not be suitable to assess the performance of DGMs for a generative design task. In this work, we propose to encode the input designs with a simple Denoising Autoencoder (DAE) and measure the distribution distance in the latent space thereof. We experimentally test our DAE-based metrics with FID and other state-of-the-art metrics on three data sets: compared to FID and some more recent works, e.g., FD (DINOv2) and topology distance, DAE-based metrics can effectively detect implausible structures and are more consistent with structural inspection by human experts.
papers.title_zh: 增强使用自定义自动编码器生成的设计的比值评价
papers.abstract_zh: 使用深创模型进行基因设计引起了极大的兴趣,在评估所产生设计的质量时,人类设计师更注重结构的可辨性,例如没有缺失的部件,而不是视觉文物,例如图像中的噪音。 与此同时,通常使用的指标,如Fréchet Inception Convention(FID)可能无法准确评估,因为它们倾向于惩罚视觉文物而不是结构性的不可信性。 因此,FID可能不适合评估DGM在基因设计任务方面的性能。 在这项工作中,我们提议用简单的Denoising Autoencoder(DAE)编码输入设计,并测量其潜在空间的分布距离。 我们实验性地用基于DAE的测量标准,用基于FID和其他最先进的测量标准来测试三个数据集:与FID和最近的一些工程,例如FD(DINOV2)和地形距离相比,基于DAE的测量标准能够有效检测出不可信的结构,更符合人类专家的结构检查。

papers.title: Elysium: Exploring Object-level Perception in Videos through Semantic Integration Using MLLMs
papers.authors: Han Wang · Yanjie Wang · Ye Yongjie · Yuxiang Nie · Can Huang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated their ability to perceive objects in still images, but their application in video-related tasks, such as object tracking, remains relatively unexplored. This lack of exploration is primarily due to two key challenges. Firstly, extensive pretraining on large-scale video datasets is required to equip MLLMs with the capability to perceive objects across multiple frames and understand inter-frame relationships. Secondly, processing a large number of frames within the context window of Large Language Models (LLMs) can impose a significant computational burden. To address the first challenge, we introduce ElysiumTrack-1M, a large-scale video dataset paired with novel tasks: Referring Single Object Tracking (RSOT) and Video Referring Expression Generation (Video-REG). ElysiumTrack-1M contains 1.27 million annotated video frames with corresponding object boxes and descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, we conduct training of MLLMs and propose a token-compression model T-Selector to tackle the second challenge. Our proposed approach, Elysium: Exploring Object-level Perception in Videos via MLLM, is an end-to-end trainable MLLM that makes the first attempt to conduct object-level tasks in videos without requiring any additional plug-in or expert models. All codes and datasets will be released soon.
papers.title_zh: Elysium: 利用 MLLMs 利用语义集成探索视频视频中对象层次的感知
papers.abstract_zh: 多式大语言模型(MLLM)已经表明它们有能力在静态图像中看到物体,但在与视频有关的任务(如物体跟踪)中应用这些模型的情况仍然相对未探索,这种缺乏探索的主要原因是两大挑战。 首先,需要对大型视频数据集进行广泛的预先培训,使MLLMS能够感知跨越多个框架的物体,并了解各框架之间的关系。 第二,在大语言模型上下文窗口内处理大量框架,可带来巨大的计算负担。 为了应对第一个挑战,我们引入了ElysiumTrack-1M,这是一个大型视频数据集,配有新的任务:参考单一物体跟踪(RSOT)和视频参考表达生成(Video-REG)。 ElysiumTrack-1M包含127万个附加说明的视频框,并配有相应的对象框和描述。 我们利用这一数据集,对MLLMS进行培训,并提出一个象征性压缩模型T-选择,以应对第二个挑战。 我们提议的方法,即Elysium:通过MLLM探索视频中的物体感知,是一个端到端可受训的MLLM,首次尝试在视频中执行物体感知,而不需要额外的插件或专家模型。所有代码和数据集不久将发布。

papers.title: Efficient Unsupervised Shortcut Learning Detection and Mitigation in Transformers
papers.authors: Lukas Kuhn · sari sadiya · Jörg Schlötterer · Florian Buettner · Christin Seifert · Gemma Roig
papers.abstract: Shortcut learning, i.e., a model's reliance on undesired features not directly relevant to the task, is a major challenge that severely limits the applications of machine learning algorithms, particularly when deploying them to assist in making sensitive decisions, such as in medical diagnostics. In this work, we leverage recent advancements in machine learning to create an unsupervised framework that is capable of both detecting and mitigating shortcut learning in transformers. We validate our method on multiple datasets. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves both worst-group accuracy (samples misclassified due to shortcuts) and average accuracy, while minimizing human annotation effort. Moreover, we demonstrate that the detected shortcuts are meaningful and informative to human experts, and that our framework is computationally efficient, allowing it to be run on consumer hardware.
papers.title_zh: 在变换器中不受监督的捷径学习探测和减缓
papers.abstract_zh: 快捷式学习,即模型依赖与任务没有直接关联的不理想特征,是一项重大挑战,严重限制了机器学习算法的应用,特别是在部署这些算法协助作出敏感决策时,例如在医疗诊断方面。 在这项工作中,我们利用最近在机器学习方面取得的进步,建立了一个不受监督的框架,既能够探测变压器中的捷径学习,又能够减轻这种学习的捷径。我们验证了我们关于多个数据集的方法。 结果表明,我们的框架大大提高了最坏群体的准确性(因捷径而误分类的样本)和平均准确性,同时尽量减少了人类的批注努力。 此外,我们证明,所发现的捷径对于人类专家来说是有意义和翔实的,而且我们的框架在计算上是有效率的,能够用消费者硬件运行。

papers.title: Efficient Frequency-Domain Image Deraining with Contrastive Regularization
papers.authors: Ning Gao · xingyu jiang · Xiuhui Zhang · Yue Deng
papers.abstract: Most current single image-deraining (SID) methods are based on the Transformer, which brings global modeling capabilities and is critical for high-quality reconstruction. However, their architectures only consider constructing long-range dependencies from the spatial domain, which suffers from a significant computational burden to keep effectiveness. Besides, these methods either overlook negative sample information in the optimization pipeline or underutilize the rain streak characteristics present in the negative ones. To tackle these problems, we propose a Frequency-Aware Deraining Transformer Framework (FADformer) that fully captures frequency domain features to achieve efficient rain removal. Specifically, we first construct the FADBlock, which comprises the Fused Fourier Convolution Mixer (FFCM) and Prior-Gated Feed-forward Network (PGFN). Unlike self-attention mechanisms, the FFCM exclusively conducts convolution operations in both spatial and frequency domains, endowing it with local-global capturing capabilities and efficiency. Simultaneously, the PGFN introduces residue channel prior in a gate-controlled manner to both enhance local details and retain the structure of features. Furthermore, we introduce a Frequency-domain Contrastive Regularization (FCR) during the training phase. The FCR facilitates contrastive learning in the frequency domain, enhancing the contribution of rain streak patterns in negative samples to improve performance. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that the proposed method significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches. We will release the code soon after the paper is accepted.
papers.title_zh: 与违反常规化的脱排
papers.abstract_zh: 目前大多数单一的图像排减法以Transformer为基础,带来全球建模能力,对高质量的重建至关重要。 然而,它们的建筑只考虑从空间领域建立远程依赖关系,而空间领域在保持有效性方面承受着巨大的计算负担。 此外,这些方法要么忽略了优化管道中的负面抽样信息,要么未充分利用负数管道中的连续降雨特征。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个频率软件排减Transformer框架,充分捕捉频率域特性,以有效排除雨水。 具体地说,我们首先建造了FADBlock,它由Fused Fourier Convolution Mixer(FFCM)和前制进餐网络(PGFFN)组成。 FFCM不同于自控机制,只在空间和频度领域开展连动行动,使其具备地方-全球的捕捉能力和效率。 同时,PGFN在培训阶段以门控制的方式事先引入残余通道,以加强本地细节和保持特征结构。 此外,在培训阶段,我们引入了频率-持续竞争常规化(FCR ) 。 对合成和真实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,拟议的方法大大优于最新方法。 我们将在文件被接受后马上发布密码

papers.title: DynamicID: Zero-Shot Multi-ID Image Personalization with Flexible Facial Editability
papers.authors: Xirui Hu · Jiahao Wang · Hao chen · Weizhan Zhang · Benqi Wang · yikun Li · Haishun Nan
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in text-to-image generation have spurred interest in personalized human image generation, which aims to create novel images featuring specific human identities as reference images indicate. Although existing methods achieve high-fidelity identity preservation, they often struggle with limited multi-ID usability and inadequate facial editability. We present DynamicID, a tuning-free framework supported by a dual-stage training paradigm that inherently facilitates both single-ID and multi-ID personalized generation with high fidelity and flexible facial editability. Our key innovations include: 1) Semantic-Activated Attention (SAA), which employs query-level activation gating to minimize disruption to the original model when injecting ID features and achieve multi-ID personalization without requiring multi-ID samples during training. 2) Identity-Motion Reconfigurator (IMR), which leverages contrastive learning to effectively disentangle and re-entangle facial motion and identity features, thereby enabling flexible facial editing. Additionally, we have developed the curated VariFace-10k facial dataset, comprising 10k unique individuals, each represented by 35 distinct facial images. Experimental results demonstrate that DynamicID outperforms state-of-the-art methods in identity fidelity, facial editability, and multi-ID personalization capability.
papers.title_zh: 动态ID:零热多ID图像个性化
papers.abstract_zh: 近来在文字到图像生成方面的进展激发了人们对个性化的人类形象生成的兴趣,这种生成的目的是创造以参考图像所示的具体人类身份为特征的新图像。 虽然现有方法实现了高度忠诚身份保护,但往往难以做到多维可用性和面部编辑能力不足。 我们提出一个无调试框架,由两阶段培训模式支持,它固有的内在作用是,以高度忠诚和灵活的面部编辑方式,促进单一身份和多身份的个性化一代。 我们的主要创新包括:1) 语义活跃关注(SAA),它采用Query级启动格子,以尽量减少在注射身份识别特征时对原始模型的干扰,实现多ID个性化,而无需在培训期间进行多ID样本。 (2) 身份-运动重新配置仪(IMR),它利用对比性学习有效地分解和重新组合面部运动和身份特征,从而能够灵活进行面部编辑。 此外,我们还开发了由10k个独特个人组成的 " Variface-10k " 面部数据集,每个由35张不同的面部图象组成。 实验结果表明,动态ID在身份忠诚、面部编辑和多身份个性化能力方面表现优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: Dual-Expert Consistency Model for Efficient and High-Quality Video Generation
papers.authors: Zhengyao Lyu · Chenyang Si · Tianlin Pan · Zhaoxi Chen · Kwan-Yee K. Wong · Yu Qiao · Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: Diffusion Models have achieved remarkable results in video synthesis but require iterative denoising steps, leading to substantial computational overhead. Consistency Models have made significant progress in accelerating diffusion models. However, directly applying them to video diffusion models often results in severe degradation of temporal consistency and appearance details. In this paper, by analyzing the training dynamics of Consistency Models, we identify a key conflicting learning dynamics during the distillation process: there is a significant discrepancy in the optimization gradients and loss contributions across different timesteps. This discrepancy prevents the distilled student model from achieving an optimal state, leading to compromised temporal consistency and degraded appearance details.To address this issue, we propose a parameter-efficient Dual-Expert Consistency Model~(DCM), where a semantic expert focuses on learning semantic layout and motion, while a detail expert specializes in fine detail refinement. Furthermore, we introduce Temporal Coherence Loss to improve motion consistency for the semantic expert and apply GAN and Feature Matching Loss to enhance the synthesis quality of the detail expert. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art visual quality with significantly reduced sampling steps, demonstrating the effectiveness of expert specialization in video diffusion model distillation. Our code and models will be made publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 高效和高质量制作视频的双重专家一致性模式
papers.abstract_zh: 传播模型在视频合成方面取得了显著成果,但需要采取迭代除去音步骤,导致大量计算间接费用。 一致性模型在加速传播模型方面取得了显著进展。 然而,直接将其应用于视频传播模型往往导致时间一致性和外观细节严重退化。 在本文中,通过分析一致性模型的培训动态,我们确定了在蒸馏过程中的一个关键的相互冲突的学习动态:优化梯度和在不同时间步骤中损失的贡献存在重大差异。 为了解决这一问题,我们建议采用一个具有参数效率的双重专家一致性模型~(DCM),其中一位语义专家侧重于学习语义布局和运动,而一位详细专家则精细地完善。 此外,我们引入了时间一致性损失,以提高语义专家的动作一致性,并应用GAN和特点匹配损失来提高细节专家的合成质量。 我们的方法实现了最先进的视觉质量,大大降低了取样步骤,显示了视频传播模型蒸馏专家专业化的有效性,我们的代码和模型将公开提供。

papers.title: DOPE: Distillation Of Part Experts for whole-body 3D pose estimation in the wild
papers.authors: Philippe Weinzaepfel, Romain Brégier, Hadrien Combaluzier, Vincent Leroy, Grégory Rogez
papers.abstract: We introduce DOPE, the first method to detect and estimate whole-body 3D human poses, including bodies, hands and faces, in the wild. Achieving this level of details is key for a number of applications that require understanding the interactions of the people with each other or with the environment. The main challenge is the lack of in-the-wild data with labeled whole-body 3D poses. In previous work, training data has been annotated or generated for simpler tasks focusing on bodies, hands or faces separately. In this work, we propose to take advantage of these datasets to train independent experts for each part, namely a body, a hand and a face expert, and distill their knowledge into a single deep network designed for whole-body 2D-3D pose detection. In practice, given a training image with partial or no annotation, each part expert detects its subset of keypoints in 2D and 3D and the resulting estimations are combined to obtain whole-body pseudo ground-truth poses. A distillation loss encourages the whole-body predictions to mimic the experts' outputs. Our results show that this approach significantly outperforms the same whole-body model trained without distillation while staying close to the performance of the experts. Importantly, DOPE is computationally less demanding than the ensemble of experts and can achieve real-time performance. Test code and models are available at https://europe.naverlabs.com/research/computer-vision/dope."
papers.title_zh: DOPE: 将全体 3D 构成野外估计的部件专家进行蒸馏
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了DOPE,这是在野外检测和估计整个身体3D的人的外形,包括身体、手和脸部的第一种方法。 达到这一详细程度对于一些需要理解人们彼此之间或与环境之间互动的应用至关重要。 主要挑战在于缺乏贴有标签的全体3D构成的全体数据。 在以往的工作中,培训数据是附加说明的,或为更简单的任务生成的,重点是分别关注身体、手或脸部。 在这项工作中,我们提议利用这些数据集来培训每个部分的独立专家,即一个机构、一只手和一位面部专家,并将他们的知识提炼成一个为整个2D-3D体的探测而设计的单一的深层网络。 在实践中,鉴于培训形象部分或没有说明说明,每个部分的专家都检测到其2D和3D的一组关键点,因此将所作的估计结合起来,以获得全体假地面真相的外形。 蒸馏损失鼓励整个身体的预测模仿专家的产出。 我们的结果表明,这种方法在接近专家业绩的同时,大大优于未经蒸馏而经过培训的同一全体模型。 重要的是,在计算上,DOPE比专家组合的要求要低,并且能够实现实时业绩。 测试代码和模型可在https://europe.naverlabs.com/research/ com-research/comecopic-vision/dope上查阅。”

papers.title: Domain Knowledge-Informed Self-Supervised Representations for Workout Form Assessment
papers.authors: Paritosh Parmar, Amol Gharat, Helge Rhodin
papers.abstract: "Maintaining proper form while exercising is important for preventing injuries and maximizing muscle mass gains. Detecting errors in workout form naturally requires estimating human’s body pose. However, off-the-shelf pose estimators struggle to perform well on the videos recorded in gym scenarios due to factors such as camera angles, occlusion from gym equipment, illumination, and clothing. To aggravate the problem, the errors to be detected in the workouts are very subtle. To that end, we propose to learn exercise-oriented image and video representations from unlabeled samples such that a small dataset annotated by experts suffices for supervised error detection. In particular, our domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) exploit the harmonic motion of the exercise actions, and capitalize on the large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination to learn powerful representations. To facilitate our self-supervised pretraining, and supervised finetuning, we curated a new exercise dataset, Fitness-AQA (https://github.com/ParitoshParmar/Fitness-AQA), comprising of three exercises: BackSquat, BarbellRow, and OverheadPress. It has been annotated by expert trainers for multiple crucial and typically occurring exercise errors. Experimental results show that our self-supervised representations outperform off-the-shelf 2D- and 3D-pose estimators and several other baselines. We also show that our approaches can be applied to other domains/tasks such as pose estimation and dive quality assessment."
papers.title_zh: 解决形式评估中的知识化自我监督代表
papers.abstract_zh: “在锻炼时保持适当的形式对于防止伤害和最大限度地增加肌肉质量收益十分重要。 检测锻炼形式的错误自然需要估计人体的姿势。 ” 然而,由于摄影角度、体育设备隔离、照明和衣着等因素,现成的估测者们在健身场景中录制的视频上为表现良好而挣扎。 更严重的是,在健身场中检测到的错误非常微妙。 为此,我们提议从未贴标签的样本中学习注重实际的图像和视频演示,以便有专家附加说明的小型数据集足以在监督下检测出错误。 特别是,我们领域的知识知情的自我监督方法(通过对比学习和运动解耦)利用演习行动的和谐运动,并利用摄像角度、衣服和照明的巨大差异来学习强大的表现。 为了便利我们自我监督的训练前和有监督的微调,我们制作了一套新的演习数据集“Fitness-AQA”(https://github.com/Paritosh-Parmar/Fitness-AQA),其中包括三项演习:BackSquat、BarbellRow和“管理”新闻。 专家培训员对它做了说明,指出它存在多重关键和典型的演练错误。 实验结果表明,我们自我监督的演练表现优于现成的2D和3D目的估计员和其他几个基线。 我们还表明,我们的方法可以适用于其他领域/任务,例如提出估计和下潜质量评估。”

papers.title: Diffusion Reward: Learning Rewards via Conditional Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Tao Huang · Guangqi Jiang · Yanjie Ze · Huazhe Xu
papers.abstract: Learning rewards from expert videos offers an affordable and effective solution to specify the intended behaviors for reinforcement learning (RL) tasks. In this work, we propose Diffusion Reward, a novel framework that learns rewards from expert videos via conditional video diffusion models for solving complex visual RL problems. Our key insight is that lower generative diversity is exhibited when conditioning diffusion on expert trajectories. Diffusion Reward is accordingly formalized by the negative of conditional entropy that encourages productive exploration of expert behaviors. We show the efficacy of our method over 10 robotic manipulation tasks from MetaWorld and Adroit with visual input and sparse reward. Moreover, Diffusion Reward can even solve unseen tasks successfully and effectively, largely surpassing baseline methods.
papers.title_zh: 传播奖励:通过有条件的视频传播进行学习奖励
papers.abstract_zh: 从专家视频中学习的奖励提供了一种负担得起和有效的解决办法,以具体说明加强学习(RL)任务的预期行为。 在这项工作中,我们建议推广奖励,这是一个新颖的框架,通过有条件的视频传播模型从专家视频中学习奖励,以解决复杂的视觉RL问题。 我们的关键见解是,在调整专家轨迹的传播时,可以展示出较低的基因多样性。 因此,通过鼓励对专家行为进行富有成效的探索的有条件的催化酶的负值,传播奖就正式化了。 我们用视觉输入和微薄的奖励来展示我们的方法超过MetaWorld和Adroit的10项机器人操纵任务的效果。 此外,传播奖励甚至能够成功和有效地完成无法见的任务,大大超过基线方法。

papers.title: Derm1M: A Million-scale Vision-Language Dataset Aligned with Clinical Ontology Knowledge for Dermatology
papers.authors: Siyuan Yan · Ming Hu · Yiwen Jiang · Xieji Li · Hao Fei · Philipp Tschandl · Harald Kittler · Zongyuan Ge
papers.abstract: The emergence of vision-language models has transformed medical AI, enabling unprecedented advances in diagnostic capability and clinical applications. However, progress in dermatology has lagged behind other medical domains due to the lack of standard image-text pairs. Existing dermatological datasets are limited in both scale and depth, offering only single-label annotations across a narrow range of diseases instead of rich textual descriptions, and lacking the crucial clinical context needed for real-world applications. To address these limitations, we present Derm1M, the first large-scale vision-language dataset for dermatology, comprising 1,029,761 image-text pairs. Built from diverse educational resources and structured around a standard ontology collaboratively developed by experts, Derm1M provides comprehensive coverage for over 390 skin conditions across four hierarchical levels and 130 clinical concepts with rich contextual information such as medical history, symptoms, and skin tone. To demonstrate Derm1M’s potential in advancing both AI research and clinical application, we pretrained a series of CLIP-like models, collectively called DermLIP, on this dataset. The DermLIP family significantly outperforms state-of-the-art foundation models on eight diverse datasets across multiple tasks, including zero-shot skin disease classification, clinical and artifacts concept identification, few-shot/full-shot learning, and cross-modal retrieval. Our dataset and code will be public.
papers.title_zh: Derm1M:与皮肤学临床肿瘤学知识相一致的百万规模的视觉语言数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型的出现改变了医学人工智能,使得诊断能力和临床应用取得了前所未有的进步,然而,由于缺乏标准图像文本配对,皮肤学的进展落后于其他医学领域。 现有的皮肤数据集在规模和深度上都有限,仅提供范围狭窄的疾病单一标签说明,而不是丰富的文字说明,缺乏现实世界应用所需的关键临床环境。 为了克服这些限制,我们介绍Derm1M,这是第一个大型皮肤学视觉语言数据集,包括1 029 761对图像文本。 Derm1M利用各种教育资源,围绕专家合作开发的标准本体学,全面覆盖了四级390多种皮肤病,130个临床概念,包括医学史、症状和肤色等丰富的背景信息。 为了证明Derm1M公司在推进AI研究和临床应用方面的潜力,我们事先在这个数据集上训练了一系列类似于CLIP的模型,统称为DermLIP。 DermLIP家族在涉及多种任务的8个不同数据集方面明显优于最先进的基础模型,包括零射皮肤病分类、临床和人工制品概念识别、几发/全射学习和跨模式检索。我们的数据集和代码将公开。

papers.title: Deep Space Weather Model: Long-Range Solar Flare Prediction from Multi-Wavelength Images
papers.authors: Shunya Nagashima · Komei Sugiura
papers.abstract: Accurate, reliable solar flare prediction is crucial for mitigating potential disruptions to critical infrastructure, while predicting solar flares remains a significant challenge. Existing methods based on heuristic physical features often lack representation learning from solar images. On the other hand, end-to-end learning approaches struggle to model long-range temporal dependencies in solar images.In this study, we propose Deep Space Weather Model (Deep SWM), which is based on multiple deep state space models for handling both ten-channel solar images and long-range spatio-temporal dependencies. Deep SWM also features a sparse masked autoencoder, a novel pretraining strategy that employs a two-phase masking approach to preserve crucial regions such as sunspots while compressing spatial information.Furthermore, we built FlareBench, a new public benchmark for solar flare prediction covering a full 11-year solar activity cycle, to validate our method.Our method outperformed baseline methods and even human expert performance on standard metrics in terms of performance and reliability. The project page can be found at https://iccv25-6qrol.kinsta.page.
papers.title_zh: 深空间气象模型:从多维长图像中测得长红太阳火焰预测
papers.abstract_zh: 准确、可靠的太阳耀斑预测对于减轻关键基础设施的潜在中断至关重要,而预测太阳耀斑仍是一个重大挑战。 现有基于疲劳物理特征的方法往往缺乏从太阳图像中学习的体现。 另一方面,端到端的学习方法在努力模拟太阳图像的长期时间依赖性。 在这次研究中,我们提议采用深空间气象模型(深海SWM),该模型以多个深层空间模型为基础,用于处理10个通道太阳图像和远程时空依赖性。 深层SWM还展示了一种稀有的蒙面自动编码器,这是一种新颖的训练前战略,采用两阶段的蒙面法,在压缩空间信息的同时保护太阳点等关键区域。 此外,我们建造了FlareBench,这是覆盖整个11年太阳活动周期的太阳耀斑预测的一个新的公共基准,以验证我们的方法。 我们的方法在性能和可靠性方面超过了基线方法,甚至超过了标准指标方面的人类专家业绩。 项目网页见https://iccv25-6qrol.kinsta.page。

papers.title: Decouple to Reconstruct: High Quality UHD Restoration via Active Feature Disentanglement and Reversible Fusion
papers.authors: Yidi Liu · Dong Li · Yuxin Ma · Jie Huang · Wenlong Zhang · Xueyang Fu · Zheng-Jun Zha
papers.abstract: Ultra-high-definition (UHD) image restoration often faces computational bottlenecks and information loss due to its extremely high resolution. Existing studies based on Variational Autoencoders (VAE) improve efficiency by transferring the image restoration process from pixel space to latent space. However, degraded components are inherently coupled with background elements in degraded images, both information loss during compression and information gain during compensation remain uncontrollable. These lead to restored images often exhibiting image detail loss and incomplete degradation removal. To address this issue, we propose a Controlled Differential Disentangled VAE, which utilizes Hierarchical Contrastive Disentanglement Learning and an Orthogonal Gated Projection Module to guide the VAE to actively discard easily recoverable background information while encoding more difficult-to-recover degraded information into the latent space. Additionally, we design a Complex Invertible Multiscale Fusion Network to handle background features, ensuring their consistency, and utilize a latent space restoration network to transform the degraded latent features, leading to more accurate restoration results. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively alleviates the information loss problem in VAE models while ensuring computational efficiency, significantly improving the quality of UHD image restoration, and achieves state-of-the-art results in six UHD restoration tasks with only 1M parameters.
papers.title_zh: 重建的十二分点:通过主动特征分解和可逆熔化实现高质量UHD恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 超高清晰度图像恢复常常因其极高分辨率而面临计算瓶颈和信息损失,基于变式自动电解器的现有研究通过将图像恢复过程从像素空间转移到潜伏空间而提高了效率。 然而,退化的成份与退化图象中的背景要素有着内在的结合,无论是压缩期间的信息损失还是补偿期间的信息增益,都仍然无法控制,导致恢复的图象往往显示图像详细损失和不完全的降解去除。 为解决这一问题,我们提议采用控制差异分解的VAE, 利用等级相异分解学习和正统剖析投影模块指导VAE积极丢弃易于回收的背景资料,同时将更难恢复的退化信息编码为潜藏空间。 此外,我们设计了一个复杂、可视多尺度融合网络,处理背景特征,确保其一致性,并利用潜在的空间恢复网络改造退化的潜在特征,从而产生更准确的恢复结果。 广泛的实验结果显示,我们的方法有效地缓解了VAE模型中的信息损失问题,同时确保计算效率,大大提高UHD图像恢复的质量,并取得最新成果,完成了6项UHD恢复任务,只有1M参数。

papers.title: ControlCap: Controllable Region-level Captioning
papers.authors: Yuzhong Zhao · Liu Yue · Zonghao Guo · Weijia Wu · Chen Gong · Qixiang Ye · Fang Wan
papers.abstract: Region-level captioning is challenged by the caption degeneration issue, which refers to that pre-trained multimodal models tend to predict the most frequent captions but miss the less frequent ones. In this study, we propose a controllable region-level captioning (ControlCap) approach, which introduces control words to a multimodal model to address the caption degeneration issue. In specific, ControlCap leverages a discriminative module to generate control words within the caption space to partition it to multiple sub-spaces. The multimodal model is constrained to generate captions within a few sub-spaces containing the control words, which increases the opportunity of hitting less frequent captions, alleviating the caption degeneration issue. Furthermore, interactive control words can be given by either a human or an expert model, which enables captioning beyond the training caption space, enhancing the model’s generalization ability. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome and RefCOCOg datasets show that ControlCap respectively improves the CIDEr score by 21.6 and 2.2, outperforming the state-of-the-arts by significant margins. The code is enclosed in the supplementary material
papers.title_zh: 控制能力:可控地区级指令
papers.abstract_zh: 地区一级的字幕减少问题对地区一级的字幕减少问题提出了挑战,其中提到经过预先培训的多式联运模式往往预测最常见的字幕,但忽略了不太常见的字幕。 在本研究报告中,我们建议采用可控制的区域一级字幕(ControlCap)办法,将控制词引入多式联运模式,以解决字幕退化问题。 具体而言,CreckCap利用一个歧视性模块,在标题空间内生成控制词,将其分割到多个子空间。 多式联运模式不得不在含有控制词的几个小空间内产生字幕,这增加了打击频率较低的字幕的机会,缓解了字幕退化问题。 此外,交互式控制词可以由人或专家模型来提供,这样就可以在培训说明空间之外加注字幕,从而增强模型的概括能力。 关于视觉基因组和RefCOCOg数据集的广泛实验表明,控制Cap的分数分别提高了21.6分和2.2分,以显著的差幅比最新技术成绩好,代号附在补充材料中。

papers.title: Context-Gated Convolution
papers.authors: Xudong Lin, Lin Ma, Wei Liu, Shih-Fu Chang
papers.abstract: As the basic building block of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), the convolutional layer is designed to extract local patterns and lacks the ability to model global context in its nature. Many efforts have been recently devoted to complementing CNNs with the global modeling ability, especially by a family of works on global feature interaction. In these works, the global context information is incorporated into local features before they are fed into convolutional layers. However, research on neuroscience reveals that the neurons' ability of modifying their functions dynamically according to context is essential for the perceptual tasks, which has been overlooked in most of CNNs. Motivated by this, we propose one novel Context-Gated Convolution (CGC) to explicitly modify the weights of convolutional layers adaptively under the guidance of global context. As such, being aware of the global context, the modulated convolution kernel of our proposed CGC can better extract representative local patterns and compose discriminative features. Moreover, our proposed CGC is lightweight and applicable with modern CNN architectures, and consistently improves the performance of CNNs according to extensive experiments on image classification, action recognition, and machine translation. Our code of this paper is available at https://github.com/XudongLinthu/context-gated-convolution."
papers.title_zh: 内 景 变 变 变
papers.abstract_zh: 作为革命性神经网络的基本构件,革命层旨在提取当地模式,缺乏从性质上模拟全球背景的能力。 最近,有线电视新闻网(CNN)以全球模式能力补充全球模式能力,特别是全球特征交互工作系列。 在这些工作中,全球背景信息被融入当地特征,然后才被注入进进进进进进进进进到进化层。 然而,对神经科学的研究表明,神经元根据实际情况动态改变功能的能力对于感官任务至关重要,大多数CNN都忽略了这种任务。 出于这一动机,我们提议采用一个新的 " 环发革命 " (CGC),在全球形势的指导下,明确修改进化层的权重。 因此,认识到全球背景,我们拟议中的GC集团的调和的融合核心可以更好地提取具有代表性的地方模式,并构成歧视特征。 此外,我们提议的CGC较轻,适用于现代有线电视新闻网架构,并根据关于图像分类、行动识别和机器翻译的广泛实验,不断改善有线电视新闻网的性能。 本文的代码可在https://github.com/XudongLinthu/context-gated-comproduction查阅。

papers.title: Co-Painter: Fine-Grained Controllable Image Stylization via Implicit Decoupling and Adaptive Injection
papers.authors: Bowen Fu · Wei Wei · Jiaqi Tang · Jiangtao Nie · Yanyu Ye · Xiaogang Xu · Ying-Cong Chen · Lei Zhang
papers.abstract: Controllable diffusion models have been widely applied in image stylization. However, existing methods often treat the style in the reference image as a single, indivisible entity, which makes it difficult to transfer specific stylistic attributes. To address this issue, we propose a fine-grained controllable image stylization framework, Co-Painter, to decouple multiple attributes embedded in the reference image and adaptively inject it into the diffusion model. We first build a multi-condition image stylization framework based on the text-to-image generation model. Then, to drive it, we develop a fine-grained decoupling mechanism to implicitly separate the attributes from the image. Finally, we design a gated feature injection mechanism to adaptively regulate the importance of multiple attributes. To support the above procedure, we also build a dataset with fine-grained styles. It comprises nearly 48,000 image-text pairs samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed model achieves an optimal balance between text alignment and style similarity to reference images, both in standard and fine-grained settings.
papers.title_zh: 共同 Painter:通过隐性解耦和适应性注射使微粒可控控制图像立体化
papers.abstract_zh: 控制扩散模型已广泛用于图像元化,但现有方法往往将参考图像的风格视为一个单一、不可分割的实体,因此难以转让特定的文体属性。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立一个精细的可控图像同步化框架,即共同定位框架,以拆分参考图像中嵌入的多个属性,并适应性地将其注入扩散模型。 我们首先建立一个基于文本到图像生成模型的多条件图像同步化框架。 然后,为了驱动它,我们开发了一个精细的解耦机制,以隐含地将属性与图像区分开来。 最后,我们设计了一种封闭的特性注射机制,以适应性地调节多重属性的重要性。为了支持上述程序,我们还建立了一个带有精细刻度的数据集。它包含近48 000个图像文本样本。 广泛的实验表明,拟议的模型在标准设置和精细刻度设置中,在文本对齐和风格与参考图像相似之间实现了最佳平衡。

papers.title: Chimera: Improving Generalist Model with Domain-Specific Experts
papers.authors: Tianshuo Peng · Mingsheng Li · Jiakang Yuan · Hongbin Zhou · Renqiu Xia · Renrui Zhang · LEI BAI · Song Mao · Bin Wang · Aojun Zhou · Botian Shi · Tao Chen · Bo Zhang · Xiangyu Yue
papers.abstract: Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs), trained on web-scale datasets predominantly composed of natural images, have demonstrated remarkable performance on general tasks. However, these models often exhibit limited specialized capabilities for domain-specific tasks that require extensive domain prior knowledge. An intuitive solution is to post-train LMMs on a specific domain, but often suffers from the labor-intensive annotating process and the inaccessibility of private training data. Directly integrating expert models tailored for those tasks is also challenging due to representational gaps and imbalanced optimization. To address these challenges, we introduce Chimera, a scalable and low-cost multi-modal pipeline designed to boost the ability of existing LMMs with domain-specific experts. Specifically, we design a progressive training strategy to integrate features from expert models into the input of a generalist LMM. To address the imbalanced optimization caused by the well-aligned general visual encoder, we introduce a novel Generalist-Specialist Collaboration Masking (GSCM) mechanism. This results in a versatile model that excels across the chart, table, math, and document domains, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multi-modal reasoning and visual content extraction tasks, both of which are challenging tasks for assessing existing LMMs. We will release model weights, along with the data used for training and evaluation, to facilitate future research on LMMs.
papers.title_zh: Chimera:与特定领域专家改进通才模式
papers.abstract_zh: 在主要由自然图像组成的网络规模数据集方面受过培训的大型多模式模型显示,这些模型在一般任务方面表现显著,然而,这些模型在具体领域任务方面往往表现出有限的专门能力,需要广泛的领域事先知识。 一种直观的解决办法是,在特定领域对培训后LMM(LMM)进行培训,但往往受到劳动密集型批注过程和私人培训数据难以获取的影响。 直接整合专为这些任务量身定制的专家模式也因为代表性差距和优化不平衡而具有挑战性。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了Chimera(Chimera ) , 这是一种可扩缩和低成本的多模式管道,目的是提高现有LMM公司与具体领域专家的能力。 具体地说,我们设计了一个渐进式培训战略,将专家模型的特征纳入通用LMM公司的投入中。 为了解决由完全一致的一般视觉编码器造成的不平衡优化问题,我们引入了新颖的通才专家协作面具机制。 由此形成了一个多功能模型,在图表、表格、数学和文件领域都优异,在多模式推理和视觉内容提取任务方面达到了最先进的业绩,而这两个任务都是评估现有LMM的艰巨任务。 我们将公布模型加权数以及用于培训和评价的数据,以便利今后对低活度、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性、低活性的研究。

papers.title: Chat-Edit-3D: Interactive 3D Scene Editing via Text Prompts
papers.authors: Shuangkang Fang · Yufeng Wang · Yi-Hsuan Tsai · Yi Yang · Wenrui Ding · Shuchang Zhou · Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.abstract: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing. However, existing schemes for 3D scene editing still exhibit certain shortcomings, hindering their further interactive design. Such schemes typically adhere to fixed input patterns, limiting users' flexibility in text input. Moreover, their editing capabilities are constrained by a single or a few 2D visual models and require intricate pipeline design to integrate these models into 3D reconstruction processes. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose a dialogue-based 3D scene editing approach, termed CE3D, which is centered around a large language model that allows for arbitrary textual input from users and interprets their intentions, subsequently facilitating the autonomous invocation of the corresponding visual expert models. Furthermore, we design a scheme utilizing Hash-Atlas to represent 3D scene views, which transfers the editing of 3D scenes onto 2D atlas images. This design achieves complete decoupling between the 2D editing and 3D reconstruction processes, enabling CE3D to flexibly integrate a wide range of existing 2D or 3D visual models without necessitating intricate fusion designs. Experimental results demonstrate that CE3D effectively integrates multiple visual models to achieve diverse editing visual effects, possessing strong scene comprehension and multi-round dialog capabilities.
papers.title_zh: 聊天-编辑-3D:交互式 3D 场景编辑,通过文本提示
papers.abstract_zh: 最近基于视觉语言培训前模式的图像内容操纵工作已有效扩展到以文字驱动的三维场景编辑,但现有的三维场景编辑计划仍存在某些缺陷,妨碍其进一步的互动设计。 这类计划通常遵循固定输入模式,限制了用户在文本输入方面的灵活性,此外,它们的编辑能力受到一个或几个2D视觉模型的限制,需要复杂的管道设计,以便将这些模型纳入3D重建进程。 为了解决上述问题,我们提议采用基于对话的三维场景编辑方法,称为CE3D,该方法以大型语言模式为中心,允许用户任意提供文字投入,解释其意图,随后便利自主地使用相应的视觉专家模式。 此外,我们设计了一个计划,利用Hash-Atlas代表3D场景视图,将3D场景的编辑转移到2D地图集图像上。 这一设计实现了2D编辑和3D重建进程之间的完全解耦,使CE3D能够灵活地整合各种现有的2D或3D视觉模型,而不需要复杂的聚合设计。 实验结果表明,CE3D有效地整合了多种视觉模型,以实现不同的编辑视觉效果,具有很强的现场理解和多轮对话能力。

papers.title: CardiacNet: Learning to Reconstruct Abnormalities for Cardiac Disease Assessment from Echocardiogram Videos
papers.authors: JIEWEN YANG · Yiqun Lin · Bin Pu · Jiarong GUO · Xiaowei Xu · Xiaomeng Li
papers.abstract: Echocardiography plays a crucial role in analyzing cardiac function and diagnosing cardiac diseases. Current deep neural network methods primarily aim to enhance diagnosis accuracy by incorporating prior knowledge, such as segmenting cardiac structures or lesions annotated by human experts. However, diagnosing the inconsistent behaviours of the heart, which exist across both spatial and temporal dimensions, remains extremely challenging. For instance, the analysis of cardiac motion acquires both spatial and temporal information from the heartbeat cycle. To address this issue, we propose a novel reconstruction-based approach named CardiacNet to learn a better representation of local cardiac structures and motion abnormalities through echocardiogram videos. CardiacNet is accompanied by the Consistency Deformation Codebook (CDC) and the Consistency Deformed-Discriminator (CDD) to learn the commonalities across abnormal and normal samples by incorporating cardiac prior knowledge. In addition, we propose benchmark datasets named CardiacNet-PAH and CardiacNet-ASD for evaluating the effectiveness of cardiac disease assessment. In experiments, our CardiacNet can achieve state-of-the-art results in downstream tasks, i.e., classification and regression, on public datasets CAMUS, EchoNet, and our datasets. The codes and datasets will be publicly available.
papers.title_zh: 心心脏病网:学习如何从心心动录像中重新构建心脏病病评估的异常情况
papers.abstract_zh: 心电图学在分析心脏功能和诊断心脏疾病方面发挥着关键作用,目前深神经网络方法的主要目的是通过吸收先前的知识,例如分解心脏结构或人类专家说明的损伤,提高诊断准确性。 然而,对存在于空间和时间层面的心脏的不一致行为进行诊断仍然极具挑战性,例如,对心脏运动的分析从心跳周期获得空间和时间信息。 为解决这一问题,我们提议采用名为 " 心电图网 " 的新颖重建方法,通过回声心电图视频更好地反映当地的心脏结构和运动异常。 心电图网络配有《一致性变形代码手册》和《一致性变形差异分析器》,通过纳入心前知识,学习异常和正常样本的共性。 此外,我们提议使用名为 " 心肺病网-PAH " 和 " 心肺病网-ASD " 的基准数据集,以评估心血管疾病评估的有效性。 在实验中,我们的心电图网络可以在下游任务(即分类和回归、公共数据集CAMUS、EchoNet和我们的数据集)上取得最新的结果。代码和数据集将公开提供。

papers.title: Bridging the Visual Semantic Gap in VLN via Semantically Richer Instructions
papers.authors: Joaquín Ossandón, Benjamín Earle, Alvaro Soto
papers.abstract: "The Visual-and-Language Navigation (VLN) task requires understanding a textual instruction to navigate a natural indoor environment using only visual information. While this is a trivial task for most humans, it is still an open problem for AI models. In this work, we hypothesize that poor use of the visual information available is at the core of the low performance of current models. To support this hypothesis, we provide experimental evidence showing that state-of-the-art models are not severely affected when they receive just limited or even no visual data, indicating a strong overfitting to the textual instructions. To encourage a more suitable use of the visual information, we propose a new data augmentation method that fosters the inclusion of more explicit visual information in the generation of textual navigational instructions. Our main intuition is that current VLN datasets include textual instructions that are intended to inform an expert navigator, such as a human, but not a beginner visual navigational agent, such as a randomly initialized DL model. Specifically, to bridge the visual semantic gap of current VLN datasets, we take advantage of metadata available for the Matterport3D dataset that, among others, includes information about object labels that are present in the scenes. Training a state-of-the-art model with the new set of instructions increase its performance by 8% in terms of success rate on unseen environments, demonstrating the advantages of the proposed data augmentation method."
papers.title_zh: 通过 " 永盛富人教育 " 缩小南韩的视觉语义差距
papers.abstract_zh: “视觉和语言导航(VLN)任务需要理解文字指令, 以便仅使用视觉信息在室内自然环境中航行。 虽然这对大多数人类来说是一个微不足道的任务, 但对于人工智能模型来说仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。 在这项工作中,我们假设,现有视觉信息使用不当是当前模型表现不佳的核心。 为支持这一假设,我们提供实验性证据表明,当最先进的模型只收到有限的甚至没有视觉数据时,它们不会受到严重影响,这表明它们与文字指示的高度匹配。 为了鼓励更适当地使用视觉信息,我们提议采用新的数据扩充方法,促进在生成文字导航指示时纳入更明确的视觉信息。 我们的主要直觉是,目前VLN数据集包含文字指令,意在告知专家导航员,如人类,但并非初学者视觉导航剂,如随机初始化的DL模型。 具体地说,为了弥合目前VLN数据集的视觉语义差距,我们利用“物质3D”数据集的现有元数据,其中包括关于场景中存在的物体标签的信息。 训练最先进的模式, 使用新的指示组, 使其在看不见环境中的成功率提高8%, 说明建议的数据扩增方法的优点。

papers.title: Bi-TTA: Bidirectional Test-Time Adapter for Remote Physiological Measurement
papers.authors: Haodong LI · Hao LU · Yingcong Chen
papers.abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is gaining prominence for its non-invasive approach to monitoring physiological signals using only cameras. Despite its promise, the adaptability of rPPG models to new, unseen domains is hindered due to the environmental sensitivity of physiological signals. To address this issue, we pioneer the Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) in rPPG, enabling the adaptation of pre-trained models to the target domain during inference, sidestepping the need for annotations or source data due to privacy considerations. Particularly, utilizing only the user's face video stream as the accessible target domain data, the rPPG model is adjusted by tuning on each single instance it encounters. However, 1) TTA algorithms are designed predominantly for classification tasks, ill-suited in regression tasks such as rPPG due to inadequate supervision. 2) Tuning pre-trained models in a single-instance manner introduces variability and instability, posing challenges to effectively filtering domain-relevant from domain-irrelevant features while simultaneously preserving the learned information. To overcome these challenges, we present Bi-TTA, a novel domain knowledge-based Bidirectional Test-Time Adapter framework. Specifically, leveraging two expert-knowledge priors for providing self-supervision, our Bi-TTA primarily comprises two modules: a prospective adaptation (PA) module using sharpness-aware minimization to eliminate domain-irrelevant noise, enhancing the stability and efficacy during the adaptation process, and a retrospective stabilization (RS) module to dynamically reinforce crucial learned model parameters, averting performance degradation caused by overfitting or catastrophic forgetting. To this end, we established a large-scale benchmark for rPPG tasks under TTA protocol, promoting advancements in both the rPPG and TTA fields. The experimental results demonstrate the significant superiority of our approach over the state-of-the-art (SoTA).
papers.title_zh: Bi-TTA: 用于远距离生理测量的双向测试-时间适应器
papers.abstract_zh: 远程光谱成像仪(rPPG)在仅使用照相机监测生理信号方面采取了非侵入性方法,因此其重要性正日益突出。 尽管它很有希望,但由于生理信号对环境的敏感性,RPPG模型适应新的、看不见的领域受到阻碍。 为解决这一问题,我们率先在RPPG中采用试验时间适应办法,以便能够在推断期间将预先培训的模型调整到目标领域,并出于隐私考虑,绕过对说明或源数据的需求。 特别是,只利用用户的面部视频流作为可访问的目标域数据,对RPPG模式进行调整,对它遇到的每个案例进行调整。 然而,1) TTA算法主要为分类任务设计,由于监督不力,不适合诸如PRPPG等回归任务。 2) 以单一方式对培训前模式进行辅导,引入变异性和不稳定性,对从与领域无关的特征中有效过滤与领域相关的领域构成挑战,同时保存所学到的信息。 为了克服这些挑战,我们提出了基于知识的新颖的以知识为基础的双向测试-时间适应器框架Bi-TTA。 具体而言,利用两个专家-知识前科提供自我监督,我们的双轨技术协定主要包括两个模块:一个未来适应模块,利用敏锐的觉悟最小化来消除与域无关的噪音,加强适应进程中的稳定性和效力,一个回溯稳定模块,以动态地加强关键的知识模型参数,避免因过于适应或灾难性的遗忘而造成性能退化。 为此,我们为《德黑兰贸易协定议定书》下的《亚太贸易协定》任务确立了一个大规模基准,促进了《亚太贸易协定》和《德黑兰贸易协定》领域的进展。 实验结果表明,我们的做法大大优于最新技术(《亚太贸易协定》 ) 。

papers.title: Bi-directional Cross-Modality Feature Propagation with Separation-and-Aggregation Gate for RGB-D Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Xiaokang Chen, Kwan-Yee Lin, Jingbo Wang, Wayne Wu, Chen Qian, Hongsheng Li, Gang Zeng
papers.abstract: Depth information has proven to be a useful cue in the semantic segmentation of RGB-D images for providing a geometric counterpart to the RGB representation. Most existing works simply assume that depth measurements are accurate and well-aligned with the RGB pixels and models the problem as a cross-modal feature fusion to obtain better feature representations to achieve more accurate segmentation. This, however, may not lead to satisfactory results as actual depth data are generally noisy, which might worsen the accuracy as the networks go deeper.In this paper, we propose a unified and efficient Cross-modality Guided Encoder to not only effectively recalibrate RGB feature responses, but also to distill accurate depth information via multiple stages and aggregate the two recalibrated representations alternatively. The key of the proposed architecture is a novel Separation-and-Aggregation Gating operation that jointly filters and recalibrates both representations before cross-modality aggregation. Meanwhile, a Bi-direction Multi-step Propagation strategy is introduced, on the one hand, to help to propagate and fuse information between the two modalities, and on the other hand, to preserve their specificity along the long-term propagation process. Besides, our proposed encoder can be easily injected into the previous encoder-decoder structures to boost their performance on RGB-D semantic segmentation. Our model outperforms state-of-the-arts consistently on both in-door and out-door challenging datasets. Code of this work is available at https://charlescxk.github.io/."
papers.title_zh: RGB-D 语义分离和隔离门
papers.abstract_zh: 实践证明,深度信息在RGB-D图像的语义分割方面是一个有用的提示,可以提供RGB代表面的几何对应物。 大多数现有工程只是假设深度测量准确,并与RGB像素和模型一致,将问题作为一种跨模式特征聚合,以获得更好的特征表现,实现更准确的分离。 然而,这也许不会带来令人满意的结果,因为实际深度数据一般都很吵闹,随着网络的深度加深,可能会降低准确性。 在本文中,我们建议统一和高效的跨模式导导编码器不仅有效调整RGB特性响应,而且通过多个阶段提炼准确的深度信息,将两个经过重新校准的表述合并在一起。 拟议架构的关键是一个新的分离和集合化作业,在跨模式汇总之前联合过滤和重新校准两种表述。 同时,采取了双向多步骤传播战略,一方面帮助在两种模式之间传播和整合信息,另一方面在长期传播过程中保持信息的特殊性。 此外,我们提议的编码器很容易被注入先前的编码器解码器结构,以提升其在 RGB-D 语义分解上的性能。 我们的模型在室内和室外具有挑战性的数据集上都一贯优于最新技术。 这项工作守则可在https://charlescxk.github.io/上查阅。”

papers.title: Beyond Brain Decoding: Visual-Semantic Reconstructions to Mental Creation Extension Based on fMRI
papers.authors: Haodong Jing · Dongyao Jiang · Yongqiang Ma · Haibo Hua · Bo Huang · Nanning Zheng
papers.abstract: Decoding visual information from fMRI signals is an important pathway to understand how the brain represents the world, and is a cutting-edge field of artificial general intelligence. Decoding fMRI should not be limited to reconstructing visual stimuli, but also further transforming them into descriptions, creating actions, and even generating unseen content. We purposefully propose a novel and efficient brain multimodal architecture, NeuroCreat, which combines the powerful visual and textual abilities of LLM to capture fine-grained semantic information from fMRI, transformed it into an embodied implementation of different neural representations. Specifically, we innovatively designed a brain expert adaption (BEA) module, effectively capturing commonalities and individual differences among subjects through the collaborative learning of shared/routed experts. Inspired by human visual working memory, we extracted `creation'' information from higher visual cortex for idea generation. We further constructed a prompt variant alignment module, seamlessly integrates fMRI-visual-semantic-creation into LLM to achieve flexible incorporation of different semantics in the decoding of neural representations. Experiments on different fMRI datasets show that NeuroCreat achieves SOTA performance on multiple brain decoding tasks. More importantly, we have innovatively achieved few-shot brain video creation, which opens up a new direction for demonstrating the brain'simaginative’ ability.
papers.title_zh: 超越大脑解码:基于FMRI的精神创造扩展的视觉-语言重建
papers.abstract_zh: 从FMRI信号中解码视觉信息是了解大脑如何代表世界的重要途径,也是人工一般智能的前沿领域。 解说FMRI不应仅限于重建视觉刺激,还应进一步将其转化为描述,创造行动,甚至产生看不见的内容。 我们有意提出一个新的、高效的大脑多式联运结构,即NeuroCreat,它将LLM强大的视觉和文字能力结合起来,从FMRI中捕捉精细的语义信息,将其转化为体现不同神经表现的体现。 具体而言,我们创新地设计了一个大脑专家适应模块,通过共享/引导专家的合作学习,有效地捕捉各学科的共性和个人差异。 在人类视觉工作记忆的启发下,我们从更高的视觉皮层中提取“创造”信息,用于创意生成。 我们还建造了一个快速变体校正模块,将FMRI-视听-语义创作无缝地纳入LLM,以便灵活地将不同语义纳入神经代言解码。 在不同的FMRI数据集上进行的实验表明,NeuroCreat在多个大脑解码任务上实现了SOTA的性能。 更重要的是,我们创新地实现了几发脑视频创建,为展示大脑的想象能力开辟了新的方向。

papers.title: Benchmarking Omni-Vision Representation through the Lens of Visual Realms
papers.authors: Yuanhan Zhang, Zhenfei Yin, Jing Shao, Ziwei Liu
papers.abstract: "Though impressive performance has been achieved in specific visual realms ( eg faces, dogs, and places), an omni-vision representation that can generalize to many natural visual domains is highly desirable. Nonetheless, the existing benchmark for evaluating visual representations, such as ImageNet, VTAB-natural, and CLIP benchmark suite, is either limited in the spectrum of realms or built by arbitrarily integrating the current datasets. In this paper, we propose Omni-Realm Benchmark (OmniBenchmark) that enables systematically measuring the generalization ability across a wide range of visual realms. OmniBenchmark firstly integrates the concepts from Wikidata to enlarge the storage of concepts of each sub-tree of WordNet. Then, it leverages expert knowledge from WordNet to define a comprehensive spectrum of 21 semantic realms in the natural domain, which is twice of ImageNet’s.
