Finally, we manually annotate all 7,372 valid concepts, forming a 21-realm dataset with 1,074,346 images. With OmniBenchmark, we propose a hierarchical instance contrastive learning framework for learning better omni-vision representation, ie Relational Contrastive learning (ReCo), boosting the performance of representation learning across omni-realms. As the hierarchical semantic relation naturally emerges in the label system of visual datasets, ReCo attracts the representations within the same semantic realm during pre-training, facilitating the model converges faster than conventional contrastive learning when ReCo is further fine-tuned to the specific realm. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of ReCo over state-of-the-art contrastive learning methods on both ImageNet and OmniBenchmark. Beyond that, We conduct a systematic investigation of recent advances in both architectures (from CNNs to transformers) and learning paradigms (from supervised learning to self-supervised learning) on our benchmark. Multiple practical observations are revealed to facilitate future research."
papers.title_zh: 通过视觉视镜镜头设定全视代表比例基准
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管在特定的视觉领域(如脸部、狗和场所)取得了令人印象深刻的成绩, 尽管如此,用于评价直观表现的现有基准,如图像网络、VTAB自然和CLIP基准套件,要么在领域范围上受到限制,要么通过任意整合现有数据集来建立。 在本文中,我们提出了Omni-Realm基准(Omni Benchmark ) , 以便能够系统地测量广泛视觉领域的普及能力。 Omni Benchmark首先整合了维基数据的概念,以扩大WordNet每一子树的概念储存。 然后,它利用WordNet的专家知识来定义自然界中21个语义界的全面范围,这是图像网的两倍。 最后,我们手动对全部7,372个有效概念进行批注,形成一个包含1,074,346个图像的21位现实数据集。 与OmniBenchmark合作,我们提出一个等级对比式学习框架,以学习更好的全视代表性,即关系差异性学习,提高全世代表性学习的绩效。 由于等级语义关系自然出现在视觉数据集的标签系统中,ReCo在培训前吸引了同一语义领域的代表,在ReCo进一步调整到特定领域时,促进模型比传统的对比性学习更快地融合。 广泛的实验表明,ReCo在图像网和OmniBenchmark上,优于最先进的对比式学习方法,表现优于最先进的图像网和OmniBenchmark。 此外,我们系统调查了我们基准上两个结构(从CNN到变压器)和学习模式(从受监督的学习到自监督的学习)的最新进展,并披露了多种实际观察,以促进未来的研究。

papers.title: Attention-Aware Learning for Hyperparameter Prediction in Image Processing Pipelines
papers.authors: Haina Qin, Longfei Han, Juan Wang, Congxuan Zhang, Yanwei Li, Bing Li, Weiming Hu
papers.abstract: "Between the imaging sensor and the image applications, the hardware image signal processing (ISP) pipelines reconstruct an RGB image from the sensor signal and feed it into downstream tasks. The processing blocks in ISPs depend on a set of tunable hyperparameters that have a complex interaction with the output. Manual setting by image experts is the traditional way of hyperparameter tuning, which is time-consuming and biased towards human perception. Recently, ISP has been optimized by the feedback of the downstream tasks based on different optimization algorithms. Unfortunately, these methods should keep parameters fixed during the inference stage for arbitrary input without considering that each image should have specific parameters based on its feature. To this end, we propose an attention-aware learning method that integrates the parameter prediction network into ISP tuning and utilizes the multi-attention mechanism to generate the attentive mapping between the input RAW image and the parameter space. The proposed method integrates downstream tasks end-to-end, predicting specific parameters for each image while considering feedback from downstream tasks. We validate the proposed method on object detection, image segmentation, and human viewing tasks. In these applications, our method outperforms the existing optimization methods and expert tuning."
papers.title_zh: 图像处理管道中超分光计预测的注意知识学习
papers.abstract_zh: “在图像传感器和图像应用中,硬件图像信号处理(ISP)管道从传感器信号中重建了RGB图像并将其输入下游任务。ISP的加工区块依赖于一系列与输出有复杂相互作用的金枪鱼可捕量的超参数。 图像专家的手工设置是传统的超参数调试方式,它耗时费时,偏重于人的看法。 最近,基于不同优化算法的下游任务反馈优化了ISP。 不幸的是,这些方法应该保留在任意输入的推论阶段确定的参数,而不考虑每个图像应该有基于其特征的具体参数。 为此,我们建议采用关注度学习方法,将参数预测网络纳入ISP的调整,并利用多注意机制在输入的RAW图像和参数空间之间进行仔细绘图。 拟议的方法将下游任务从端到端结合起来,预测每个图像的具体参数,同时考虑下游任务的反馈。我们验证了关于物体探测、图像分割和人类观察任务的拟议方法。 在这些应用中,我们的方法优于现有优化方法和专家调试。”

papers.title: ArgMatch: Adaptive Refinement Gathering for Efficient Dense Matching
papers.authors: Yuxin Deng · Kaining Zhang · Linfeng Tang · Jiaqi Yang · Jiayi Ma
papers.abstract: Establishing dense correspondences is crucial yet computationally expensive in many multi-view tasks. Although the state-of-the-art dense matchers typically adopt a coarse-to-fine scheme to mitigate the computational cost, their efficiency is often compromised by the use of heavy models with redundant feature representations, which are essential for desirable results. In this work, we introduce adaptive refinement gathering that significantly alleviates the demand on such computational burdens without sacrificing too much accuracy. The pipeline consists of (i) context-aware offset estimator: exploiting content information for rough features to enhance the offset decoding accuracy. (ii) Locally consistent match rectifier: correcting erroneous initial matches with local consistency. (iii) Locally consistent upsampler: mitigating over-smoothing at depth-discontinuous edges. Additionally, we propose an adaptive gating strategy, combined with the nature of local consistency, to dynamically modulate the contribution of different components and pixels, enabling adaptive gradient backpropagation and fully unleashing the network's capacity. Compared to the state-of-the-art, our lightweight network, termed ArgMatch, achieves competitive performance on MegaDepth, while using 90% fewer parameters, 73% less computation time, and 84% lower memory cost.
papers.title_zh: ArgMatch: 高效调高匹配感应量适应性改进集合
papers.abstract_zh: 建立密集的通信系统至关重要,但在许多多视角任务中,计算成本却非常昂贵。 虽然最先进的密集匹配者通常采用粗略到精密的办法来降低计算成本,但其效率往往由于使用具有多余特征的重型模型而受到影响,而这些模型对于取得理想的结果是必不可少的。 在这项工作中,我们引入了适应性改进收集方法,以大大减轻对此类计算负担的需求,同时又不牺牲过多的准确性。 管道包括(一) 环境意识抵消估计值:利用内容信息作为粗略特征,提高抵消解码准确性。 (二) 地方一致的匹配校正词句:纠正错误的初始匹配词句与地方一致。 (三) 地方一致的加固词句:在深度和不连续边缘减少过度悬浮。 此外,我们提出一项适应性带宽战略,加上地方一致性的性质,以动态调节不同组成部分和像素的贡献,使适应性梯度回推进,并充分释放网络的能力。 与最新技术相比,我们的轻量级网络,叫做ArgMatch,在Mega Depth上取得了竞争性业绩,同时使用90%的参数,73%的计算时间,84%的内存成本。

papers.title: Analytic Subspace Routing: How Recursive Least Squares Works in Continual Learning of Large Language Model
papers.authors: Kai Tong · Kang Pan · Xiao Zhang · Erli Meng · Run He · Yawen Cui · Nuoyan Guo · Huiping Zhuang
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) possess encompassing capabilities that can process diverse language-related tasks. However, finetuning on LLMs will diminish this general skills and continual finetuning will further cause severe degradation on accumulated knowledge. Recently, Continual Learning (CL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) arises which aims to continually adapt the LLMs to new tasks while maintaining previously learned knowledge and inheriting general skills. Existing techniques either leverage previous data to replay, leading to extra computational costs, or utilize a single parameter-efficient module to learn the downstream task, constraining new knowledge absorption with interference between different tasks. Toward these issues, this paper proposes Analytic Subspace Routing(ASR) to address these challenges. For each task, we isolate the learning within a subspace of deep layers' features via low-rank adaptation, eliminating knowledge interference between different tasks. Additionally, we propose an analytic routing mechanism to properly utilize knowledge learned in different subspaces. Our approach employs Recursive Least Squares to train a multi-task router model, allowing the router to dynamically adapt to incoming data without requiring access to historical data. Also, the router effectively assigns the current task to an appropriate subspace and has a non-forgetting property of previously learned tasks with a solid theoretical guarantee. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves near-perfect retention of prior knowledge while seamlessly integrating new information, effectively overcoming the core limitations of existing methods. Our code will be released after acceptance.
papers.title_zh: 分析子空间运行分析:在继续不断学习大语言模式中如何使最起码的广场恢复
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)拥有处理多种语言相关任务的能力,但微调LLMs将减少这种一般技能,不断微调将进一步导致积累的知识严重退化。 最近,出现了大语言模式的不断学习,其目的是不断使LLMs适应新的任务,同时保持以前学到的知识并继承一般技能。 现有技术要么利用先前的数据重现,导致额外的计算成本,要么利用单一的参数效率模块学习下游任务,限制新知识吸收,干扰不同任务。 针对这些问题,本文建议分析子空间运行(ASR)来应对这些挑战。 对于每一项任务,我们通过低级别适应,将深层特征子空间的学习分离出来,消除不同任务之间的知识干扰。 此外,我们还提出一个分析路径机制,以适当利用不同子空间所学知识。 我们的方法是利用累进最小广场来培训多任务路由器模型,让路由器在不需要历史数据的情况下动态地适应所接收的数据。 此外,路由器有效地将当前的任务分配到一个适当的子空间,并且具有坚实的理论保证,具有先前学到的任务的不追溯性能。 实验结果显示,我们的方法在无缝地整合新信息、有效克服现有方法的核心局限性的同时,实现了几乎完美地保留了先前的知识。 我们的代码将在接受后发布。

papers.title: All Parts Matter: A Unified Mask-Free Virtual Try-On Framework
papers.authors: Chenghu Du · Shengwu Xiong · Yi Rong
papers.abstract: Current virtual try-on methods primarily enhance performance through network optimization, like coarse-to-fine structures and referenceNet for clothing information injection. However, limited sample quantity and diversity restrict their improvement. To overcome this, we present a unified mask-free virtual try-on framework. It utilizes diffusion models' inherent properties to boost each pipeline part's ability to deeply fit the target sample distribution, thus improving performance. On the input side, our proposed text-driven pseudo-input preparation approach increases the diversity of clothing-agnostic regions in person pseudo-samples. This prompts the generator to focus more on variations in these areas and improves the model's generalization ability. At the generator, we propose gated manipulation to prevent weight forgetting and cut training costs, and introduce texture-aware injection to explicitly add human-perceptible clothing texture info. For inference, our proposed refining conditional inference approach reduces Gaussian noise randomness, thus preserving identity information and clothing details in results. Extensive experiments demonstrate our method outperforms previous virtual try-on methods.
papers.title_zh: 所有部分物质:无面具统一虚拟试验框架
papers.abstract_zh: 目前虚拟试运行方法主要是通过网络优化提高性能,如粗体结构到细体结构,以及服装信息注入参考网,但样本数量和多样性有限,限制了它们的改进。 为了克服这一点,我们提出了一个统一的无面具虚拟试运行框架,它利用扩散模型的内在特性来提高每一管道部分的能力,使其与目标样本分布高度匹配,从而改进性能。 在投入方面,我们提议的文本驱动的伪投入准备方法增加了人造假样中服装不可知区的多样性。 这促使生成者更多地关注这些领域的差异,提高模型的概括能力。 在发电机上,我们提议进行门外操纵,以防止体重忘记和降低培训费用,并引入有质感的注射,以明确添加人能察觉的服装纹理信息。 为了推断,我们拟议中的完善有条件推断方法降低了高斯噪音随机性,从而保留了身份信息和衣物细节。 广泛的实验证明我们的方法比以往的虚拟试演方法要好。

papers.title: AlignGuard: Scalable Safety Alignment for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Runtao Liu · I Chen · Jindong Gu · Jipeng Zhang · Renjie Pi · Qifeng Chen · Philip Torr · Ashkan Khakzar · Fabio Pizzati
papers.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have become widespread, but their limited safety guardrails expose end users to harmful content and potentially allow for model misuse. Current safety measures are typically limited to text-based filtering or concept removal strategies, able to remove just a few concepts from the model's generative capabilities. In this work, we introduce AlignGuard, a method for safety alignment of T2I models. We enable the application of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for safety purposes in T2I models by synthetically generating a dataset of harmful and safe image-text pairs, which we call CoProV2. Using a custom DPO strategy and this dataset, we train safety experts, in the form of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) matrices, able to guide the generation process away from specific safety-related concepts. Then, we merge the experts into a single LoRA using a novel merging strategy for optimal scaling performance. This expert-based approach enables scalability, allowing us to remove 7 times more harmful concepts from T2I models compared to baselines. AlignGuard consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art on many benchmarks and establishes new practices for safety alignment in T2I networks. We will release code and models.
papers.title_zh: 对齐方对齐: 生成文本到图像的可缩放安全对齐
papers.abstract_zh: 文字到图像(T2I)模式已变得很普遍,但其有限的安全保护装置使最终用户受到有害内容的影响,并可能允许模式滥用。 目前的安全措施通常限于基于文本的过滤或概念清除战略,能够从模型的基因能力中去除几个概念。 在这项工作中,我们引入了AleignGuard,这是T2I模型安全匹配的方法。 我们通过合成生成一个有害和安全的图像文本数据集(我们称之为CoProV2),能够将直接优化(DPO)应用于T2I模型的安全目的。 使用定制的DPO战略和这一数据集,我们以低级别适应(LORA)矩阵的形式培训安全专家,能够引导产生过程远离特定的安全相关概念。 然后,我们用新的整合战略来优化规模绩效,将专家合并为单一的LORA。 这种以专家为基础的方法可以调整范围,使我们能够从T2I模型中去除比基线多7倍的有害概念。 对等保护一贯优于许多基准的最新水平,并为T2I网络的安全协调制定了新做法。 我们将发布代码和模型。

papers.title: Align Your Rhythm: Generating Highly Aligned Dance Poses with Gating-Enhanced Rhythm-Aware Feature Representation
papers.authors: Congyi Fan · Jian Guan · Xuanjia Zhao · Dongli Xu · Youtian Lin · Tong Ye · Pengming Feng · Haiwei Pan
papers.abstract: Automatically generating natural, diverse and rhythmic human dance movements driven by music is vital for virtual reality and film industries. However, generating dance that naturally follows music remains a challenge, as existing methods lack proper beat alignment and exhibit unnatural motion dynamics. In this paper, we propose Danceba, a novel framework that leverages gating mechanism to enhance rhythm-aware feature representation for music-driven dance generation, which achieves highly aligned dance poses with enhanced rhythmic sensitivity. Specifically, we introduce Phase-Based Rhythm Extraction (PRE) to precisely extract rhythmic information from musical phase data, capitalizing on the intrinsic periodicity and temporal structures of music. Additionally, we propose Temporal-Gated Causal Attention (TGCA) to focus on global rhythmic features, ensuring that dance movements closely follow the musical rhythm. We also introduce Parallel Mamba Motion Modeling (PMMM) architecture to separately model upper and lower body motions along with musical features, thereby improving the naturalness and diversity of generated dance movements. Extensive experiments confirm that Danceba outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving significantly better rhythmic alignment and motion diversity.
papers.title_zh: 调正你的节奏:以Gate-Enhanced Rhythm-Aware 特色代表制作高度一致的舞蹈表演
papers.abstract_zh: 由音乐驱动的自然、多样和有节奏的人类舞蹈运动自动产生,对于虚拟现实和电影产业来说至关重要。 但是,随着音乐的自然而然地产生舞蹈仍是一个挑战,因为现有的方法缺乏适当的节拍配合,并表现出非自然的动作动态。 在本文中,我们提出Danceba,这是一个新的框架,它利用插座机制,加强音乐驱动舞蹈制作的节奏感特征代表,使舞蹈配制高度一致,并增强节奏敏感性。 具体地说,我们采用分阶段节奏提取法,精确地从音乐阶段数据中提取有节奏的信息,利用音乐固有的周期性和时间结构。 此外,我们建议时装性诱因关注(TGCA)重点关注全球节奏特征,确保舞蹈运动密切遵循音乐节奏。 我们还引入了平行的曼巴运动模拟结构,分别将上下身运动和音乐特色作为上下身运动的模型,从而改善舞蹈运动的自然性和多样性。 广泛的实验证实,舞蹈表演优于最先进的方法,大大改善了节奏配合和运动多样性。

papers.title: AIGI-Holmes: Towards Explainable and Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection via Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Ziyin Zhou · Yunpeng Luo · Yuanchen Wu · Ke Sun · Jiayi Ji · Ke Yan · Shouhong Ding · Xiaoshuai Sun · Yunsheng Wu · Rongrong Ji
papers.abstract: The rapid development of AI-generated content (AIGC) technology has led to the misuse of highly realistic AI-generated images (AIGI) in spreading misinformation, posing a threat to public information security. Although existing AIGI detection techniques are generally effective, they face two issues: 1) a lack of human-verifiable explanations, and 2) a lack of generalization in the latest generation technology. To address these issues, we introduce a large-scale and comprehensive dataset, Holmes-Set, which includes the Holmes-SFTSet, an instruction-tuning dataset with explanations on whether images are AI-generated, and the Holmes-DPOSet, a human-aligned preference dataset. Our work introduces an efficient data annotation method called the Multi-Expert Jury, enhancing data generation through structured MLLM explanations and quality control via cross-model evaluation, expert defect filtering, and human preference modification. In addition, we propose Holmes Pipeline, a meticulously designed three-stage training framework comprising visual expert pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization. Holmes Pipeline adapts multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for AIGI detection while generating human-verifiable and human-aligned explanations, ultimately yielding our model AIGI-Holmes. During the inference stage, we introduce a collaborative decoding strategy that integrates the model perception of the visual expert with the semantic reasoning of MLLMs, further enhancing the generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our AIGI-Holmes.
papers.title_zh: AIGI-Holmes:努力通过多模式大语言模型,探索可解释和可普遍适用的AI光学图像
papers.abstract_zh: AIG(AIGC)产生的内容技术的迅速发展导致滥用高度现实的AIGI(AIGI)产生的图像传播错误信息,对公共信息安全构成威胁。 虽然现有的全球信息基础设施探测技术一般有效,但它们面临两个问题:(1) 缺乏可核实的人类解释;(2) 现代技术缺乏普及化。 为解决这些问题,我们推出一个大规模和全面的数据集,即 " Holmes-Set " ,其中包括 " Holmes-SFTSet " 、 " 指示调整数据集 " 、 " 说明图像是否是AI生成的 " 和 " Holmes-DPOSet " ,这是一个与人类一致的偏好数据集。 我们的工作采用了一种称为多专家陪审团的高效数据说明方法,通过结构化的MLLM解释和质量控制,通过跨模范评价、专家缺陷过滤和人类偏好修改,加强数据生成。 此外,我们提议霍姆斯管道,这是一个精心设计的三阶段培训框架,包括视觉专家培训前培训、监督下的微调和直接优惠优化。 Holmes 管道调整了多式联运大语言模型,供AIGI检测,同时产生可核实和与人类一致的解释,最终产生我们的AIGI-Holmes模型。 在推论阶段,我们引入了合作解码战略,将视觉专家的模型概念与MLLMs的语义推理结合起来,进一步提高了一般化能力。 在三个基准上的广泛实验证实了我们AIGI-Holmes的有效性。

papers.title: AgroBench: Vision-Language Model Benchmark in Agriculture
papers.authors: Risa Shinoda · Nakamasa Inoue · Hirokatsu Kataoka · Masaki Onishi · Yoshitaka Ushiku
papers.abstract: Precise automated understanding of agricultural tasks such as disease identification is essential for the sustainable crop production. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to further expand the range of agricultural tasks by facilitating human-model interaction through easy, text-based communication. Here, we introduce AgroBench (Agronomist AI Benchmark), a benchmark for evaluating VLM models across seven agricultural topics, covering key areas in agricultural engineering and relevant to real-world farming. Unlike recent agricultural VLM benchmarks, AgroBench is annotated by expert agronomists. Our AgroBench covers a state-of-the-art range of categories, including 197 crop categories and 682 disease categories, to thoroughly evaluate VLM capabilities. In our evaluation on AgroBench, we reveal that VLMs have room for improvement in fine-grained identification tasks. Notably, in weed identification, most open-source VLMs perform close to random. With our wide range of topics and expert-annotated categories, we analyze the types of errors made by VLMs and suggest potential pathways for future VLM development. Our dataset and code will be available.
papers.title_zh: Agrobunch:农业远景-语言示范基准农业基准
papers.abstract_zh: 精确地自动了解诸如疾病识别等农业任务对于可持续的作物生产至关重要。 视觉语言模式(VLMs)的近期进展预计将通过简便、基于文字的交流促进人类模式的互动,从而进一步扩大农业任务的范围。 在此,我们引入了AgroBench(Agronomist AI B基准 ) ( AgroBench ) ( AgroBench ) ( AgroBench ) ( Agronomist AI B基准 ) ( AgroBench ) ( AgroBench ) , 这是评估七个农业主题的VLM 模型的基准,涵盖农业工程的关键领域以及与现实世界农业相关的领域。 与最近的农业VLM 基准不同,AgroBench 得到了农业学家的注解。 我们的农业区涵盖最先进的类别,包括197个作物类别和682个疾病类别,以彻底评估VLM能力。 在对AgroBench的评估中,我们发现VLM在精细的识别任务方面有改进的余地。 值得注意的是,在杂草识别中,大多数开放源码VLMs的运行几乎是随机的。 我们利用我们广泛的专题和专家附加说明的分类,分析VLMs的错误类型,并提出未来VLM开发的潜在途径。 我们的数据集和代码将可用。

papers.title: Adversarial Erasing Framework via Triplet with Gated Pyramid Pooling Layer for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Sung-Hoon Yoon, Hyeokjun Kweon, Jegyeong Cho, Shinjeong Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon
papers.abstract: "Weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) has employed Class Activation Maps (CAMs) to localize the objects. However, the CAMs typically do not fit along the object boundaries and highlight only the most-discriminative regions. To resolve the problems, we propose a Gated Pyramid Pooling (GPP) layer which is a substitute for a Global Average Pooling (GAP) layer, and an Adversarial Erasing Framework via Triplet (AEFT). In the GPP layer, a feature pyramid is obtained by pooling the CAMs at multiple spatial resolutions, and then be aggregated into an attention for class prediction by gated convolution. With the process, CAMs are trained not only to capture the global context but also to preserve fine-details from the image. Meanwhile, the AEFT targets an over-expansion, a chronic problem of Adversarial Erasing (AE). Although AE methods expand CAMs by erasing the discriminative regions, they usually suffer from the over-expansion due to an absence of guidelines on when to stop erasing. We experimentally verify that the over-expansion is due to rigid classification, and metric learning can be a flexible remedy for it. AEFT is devised to learn the concept of erasing with the triplet loss between the input image, erased image, and negatively sampled image. With the GPP and AEFT, we achieve new state-of-the-art both on the PASCAL VOC 2012 val/test and MS-COCO 2014 val set by 70.9%/71.7% and 44.8% in mIoU, respectively."
papers.title_zh: 通过与Gated金字池合金层一起的三联车,为弱力监督的语义分割而建立反向除法框架
papers.abstract_zh: “受到严密监督的语系分隔图(WSSS)使用分类激活地图(CAMs)来定位物体。然而,CAMs通常不适合物体边界,只突出最偏差的区域。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议建立一个Gated金字塔集合层,取代全球平均集合层,并通过Triplet(AEFT)建立一个反向扩大框架。 在GPP层,通过以多种空间分辨率汇集CAMs获得一个特质金字塔,然后通过门形变迁将之汇总为课堂预测的关注点。 通过这一过程,CPM不仅为了捕捉全球背景,而且为了保护图像的细细细节,CAM都接受了培训。 与此同时,AEFT(AE)针对的是过度扩张(AE ) , 即一个长期存在的反侵蚀(AE)问题。 尽管AE方法通过消除歧视地区而扩大了CAM,但由于缺乏关于何时停止消除的指导方针,它们通常会因过度扩张而受害。 我们实验性地核实过度扩张是由于僵化的分类,而衡量学习可以作为灵活的解决办法。 AEFT旨在学习在输入图像、被删除图像和负面抽样图像之间三重损失中消除三重损失的概念。 通过GPP和AEFT, 我们在PASCAL VOC 2012 Val/测试和MS-COCO 2014 val上都取得了新的最新技术, mIoU的这个比率分别为70.9%/71.7%和44.8%。

papers.title: Adaptive Routing of Text-to-Image Generation Requests Between Large Cloud Model and Light-Weight Edge Model
papers.authors: Zewei Xin · Qinya Li · Chaoyue Niu · Fan Wu · Guihai Chen
papers.abstract: Large text-to-image models demonstrate impressive generation capabilities; however, their substantial size necessitates expensive cloud servers for deployment. Conversely, light-weight models can be deployed on edge devices at lower cost but often with inferior generation quality for complex user prompts. To strike a balance between performance and cost, we propose a routing framework, called RouteT2I, which dynamically selects either the large cloud model or the light-weight edge model for each user prompt. Since generated image quality is challenging to measure and compare directly, RouteT2I establishes multi-dimensional quality metrics, particularly, by evaluating the similarity between the generated images and both positive and negative texts that describe each specific quality metric. RouteT2I then predicts the expected quality of the generated images by identifying key tokens in the prompt and comparing their impact on the quality. RouteT2I further introduces the Pareto relative superiority to compare the multi-metric quality of the generated images. Based on this comparison and predefined cost constraints, RouteT2I allocates prompts to either the edge or the cloud. Evaluation reveals that RouteT2I significantly reduces the number of requesting large cloud model while maintaining high-quality image generation.
papers.title_zh: 大云模型和轻重边缘模型之间文本到图像生成要求的适应性分流
papers.abstract_zh: 大型文字到图像模型显示了令人印象深刻的生成能力;然而,由于规模庞大,需要部署昂贵的云服务器。 相反,轻量级模型可以以较低成本部署在边缘设备上,但对于复杂的用户提示而言,其生成质量往往较低。 为了在业绩和成本之间取得平衡,我们提议了一个称为 " 路由T2I " 的路线框架,以动态方式选择大云模型或每个用户的轻量级边际模型。 由于产生的图像质量难以直接衡量和比较,因此,T2I路透社特别通过评价生成的图像与描述每个具体质量指标的正反两面文本的相似性,建立了多维质量指标。 然后,路由T2I通过快速识别关键符号并比较其对质量的影响来预测生成图像的预期质量。 路由T2I进一步介绍了Pareto相对优势,以比较生成图像的多度质量。 根据这一比较和预先确定的成本限制,路透图2I将提示分配给边缘或云层。 评价显示,路透图2I在保持高质量图像生成的同时,大大减少了请求大云模型的数量。

papers.title: AdaNAT: Exploring Adaptive Policy for Token-Based Image Generation
papers.authors: Zanlin Ni · Yulin Wang · Renping Zhou · Rui Lu · Jiayi Guo · Jinyi Hu · Zhiyuan Liu · Yuan Yao · Gao Huang
papers.abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of token-based methods for visual content generation. As a representative work, non-autoregressive Transformers (NATs) are able to synthesize images with decent quality in a small number of steps. However, NATs usually necessitate configuring a complicated generation policy comprising multiple manually-designed scheduling rules. These heuristic-driven rules are prone to sub-optimality and come with the requirements of expert knowledge and labor-intensive efforts. Moreover, their one-size-fits-all nature cannot flexibly adapt to the diversified characteristics of each individual sample. To address these issues, we propose AdaNAT, a learnable approach that automatically configures a suitable policy tailored for every sample to be generated. In specific, we formulate the determination of generation policies as a Markov decision process. Under this framework, a lightweight policy network for generation can be learned via reinforcement learning. Importantly, we demonstrate that simple reward designs such as FID or pre-trained reward models, may not reliably guarantee the desired quality or diversity of generated samples. Therefore, we propose an adversarial reward design to guide the training of policy networks effectively. Comprehensive experiments on four benchmark datasets, i.e., ImageNet-256 & 512, MS-COCO, and CC3M, validate the effectiveness of AdaNAT. All the code and models will be released after acceptance.
papers.title_zh: AdaNAT: 探索以立体图像生成的适应性政策
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究表明,基于象征性方法的视觉内容生成方法是有效的,作为一种具有代表性的工作,非航空式Transformer能够在少数步骤中以体面的质量合成图像。 然而,NAT通常需要配置由多重手工设计的日程安排规则组成的复杂一代政策。 这些超自然规则容易不尽人意,并符合专业知识和劳动密集型努力的要求。 此外,它们的 " 一刀切 " 性质无法灵活地适应每个样本的多样化特点。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议AdaNAT(AdaNAT),这是一个可学习的方法,自动配置适合每个样本的适合政策。 具体地说,我们把确定代际政策作为马尔科夫的决策过程。 在这个框架下,可以通过强化学习学习来学习轻量级的代际政策网络。 重要的是,我们证明简单的奖赏设计,如FID或预先培训的奖赏模式,可能无法可靠地保证所生成的样本的预期质量或多样性。 因此,我们提出一个对抗性奖赏设计,以有效指导政策网络的培训。 四个基准数据集的综合实验,即图像网256和512、MS-COCO和CC3M,验证AdaNAT的有效性。 所有代码和模型在接受后都将发布。

papers.title: AcZeroTS: Active Learning for Zero-shot Tissue Segmentation in Pathology Images
papers.authors: Jiao Tang · Junjie Zhou · Bo Qian · Peng Wan · Yingli Zuo · WEI SHAO · Daoqiang Zhang
papers.abstract: Tissue segmentation in pathology images is crucial for computer-aided diagnostics of human cancers. Traditional tissue segmentation models rely heavily on large-scale labeled datasets, where every tissue type must be annotated by experts. However, due to the complexity of tumor micro-environment, collecting annotations for all possible tissue types is challenging, which makes the traditional methods ineffective in segmenting unseen tissue types with zero training samples. With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), recent studies extend their powerful zero-shot capabilities to pixel-level segmentation tasks, where the model is trained only on seen classes but can perform tissue segmentation on both seen and unseen categories in the testing phase. However, these VLM-based zero-shot segmentation models still require substantial annotation efforts on seen classes. To attach desirable segmentation performance on both seen and unseen categories with limited labeled data, we propose AcZeroTS, a novel active learning framework for zero-shot tissue segmentation in pathology images. Specifically, AcZeroTS is built on a VLM-based prototype-guided zero-shot segmentation model called ProZS. We introduce a novel active selection criterion to select the most valuable samples for annotation on seen classes, which not only considers both uncertainty and diversity of unlabeled samples, but also ensures that the generated prototypes of ProZS can effectively summarize both seen and unseen classes during inference. We evaluate our method on two pathology datasets (TNBC and HPBC) as well as a natural dataset (Pascal VOC 2012), and the experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method in comparison with the existing studies.
papers.title_zh: AcZeroTS: 病理图象零射组织分解积极学习
papers.abstract_zh: 病理图象中的组织分解对于计算机辅助人类癌症诊断至关重要,传统组织分解模型严重依赖大规模贴标签的数据集,其中每个组织类型都必须由专家附加说明。 然而,由于肿瘤微环境的复杂性,收集所有可能组织类型的说明具有挑战性,这使得传统方法无法有效地用零培训样本将隐形组织类型分割开来。 随着视觉语言模型的迅速发展,最近的研究将其强大的零射速能力扩大到像素级分解任务,该模型仅对可见班级进行培训,但能够在测试阶段对可见和看不见的类别进行组织分解。 然而,这些基于VLM的零发分解模型仍然需要对可见分类进行大量注解。 为了在有有限标签数据的可见和看不见类别上附加理想的分解性能,我们提议AcZeroTS,这是一个新的积极学习框架,用于在病理图象中进行零光组织分解。 具体而言,AcZeroTS是建立在VLM原型制导零弹分解模型之上的,称为ProZS。 我们采用了一种新的积极选择标准,选择最有价值的样本,用于在可见类别上作注释,这不仅考虑到未贴标签样本的不确定性和多样性,而且还确保ProZS生成的原型在推论期间能够有效地总结可见和看不见的类别。 我们评估了我们两个病理数据集(TNBC和HPBC)和自然数据集(Pascal VOC,2012年)的方法,实验结果表明,与现有研究相比,我们的方法优于现有研究。
